# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Laser Interferometric Runout Metrology & Angular Pitch/Yaw Runout Validation

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-LIR01`  
**Classification:** Gen 2 (µm) Mechanical & Metrology Validation  
**Target Architecture:** 180nm 1T1C Folded Bitline DRAM ($8F^2$ Cell Topology, Wordline/Bitline Pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Calibration  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the execution protocol for calibrating and validating the multi-axis stage fixture runout using dual-beam multi-axis laser interferometry. The goal is to constrain linear Abbe errors and dynamic angular pitch/yaw deviations across stage travel to prevent sub-micron overlay and registration drift during $180\text{ nm}$ access transistor diffusion patterning and shared bitline contact ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$) tooling setups.

---

### 2. Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Setup Dual-Beam     │
│  Laser Interferometer  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Mount Reference     │
│    Kinematic Mirror    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Execute Incremental   │
│   Stage Stroke Along   │
│      Travel Axis       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Simultaneous      │
│  Acquisition: Linear   │
│   Runout & Pitch/Yaw   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Criteria Pass?     │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
      ┌──────┴──────┐
      │ Yes         │ No
      ▼             ▼
┌────────────┐┌────────────┐
│    Lock    ││   Adjust   │
│ Kinematic  ││ Preload &  │
│  Fixture   ││  Re-test   │
└────────────┘└────────────┘
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental Stabilization & Optical Alignment:**
   - Establish cleanroom thermal stabilization at $20.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.1^\circ\text{C}$ to suppress air refractive index fluctuations and thermal drift.
   - Mount the stabilized He-Ne dual-frequency laser head onto the vibration-isolated granite metrology datum.
   - Align the measurement and reference beams through beam-splitters onto the retroreflector and dual-axis angular plane mirror mounted to the kinematic stage fixture. Optimize optical return signal strength to $> 85\%$.

2. **Zero-Datum & Axis Calibration:**
   - Position the stage at the origin ($X=0, Y=0$) corresponding to the primary wafer chuck kinematic reference point.
   - Reset the interferometric fringe counters, zeroing phase angle measurements across linear displacement, angular pitch ($\theta_x$), and yaw ($\theta_y$).

3. **Multi-Step Stroke Metrology Run:**
   - Step the stage along the travel axis in discrete $10\text{ mm}$ increments over the full stroke range ($200\text{ mm}$ travel envelope).
   - Dwell for $500\text{ ms}$ at each point to eliminate settling transients; record $1000$ samples per coordinate at $10\text{ kHz}$ acquisition frequency.
   - Acquire simultaneous linear runout ($\Delta Z$ straightness, $\Delta Y$ orthogonal runout) and angular deviations (Pitch and Yaw).

4. **Multi-Pass Repeatability Verification:**
   - Repeat the travel stroke over 5 forward and reverse cycles to extract dynamic hysteresis, Abbe pitch/yaw error vectors, and positioning repeatability.

5. **Pass/Fail Decision & Fixture Locking:**
   - Evaluate measured datasets against the acceptance envelope. If compliant, torque kinematic clamp mounts to nominal spec ($3.5\text{ N}\cdot\text{m}$) and generate the compensation matrix. If failing, inspect kinematic seat preloads and realign.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                     Stage Runout Metrology Limits      
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░                                  │
  Repeatability┤░░░░░                                  │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
  Yaw Deviation┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
Pitch Deviation┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Linear Runout┤███████████                            │
               │███████████                            │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
              0.00      0.11     0.23      0.34    0.45 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Max Linear Runout ($\Delta Z$ / $\Delta Y$)** | $\le 0.12$ | $\mu\text{m}$ ($120\text{ nm}$) | Dual-frequency laser interferometric fringe counting along $200\text{ mm}$ travel |
| **Angular Pitch Deviation ($\Delta \theta_x$)** | $\le 0.45$ | $\mu\text{rad}$ ($0.093\text{ arcsec}$) | Differential dual-beam optical interferometry |
| **Angular Yaw Deviation ($\Delta \theta_y$)** | $\le 0.40$ | $\mu\text{rad}$ ($0.082\text{ arcsec}$) | Differential dual-beam optical interferometry |
| **Bidirectional Repeatability ($3\sigma$)** | $\le 0.05$ | $\mu\text{m}$ ($50\text{ nm}$) | 5-cycle bidirectional stroke statistical runout dispersion |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** 
  - Access transistor critical dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and shared bitline contact geometry dictate sub-micron runout constraints to avoid cell mismatch and overlay failure.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** 
  - Wordline and bitline pitch dimensions ($\sim 360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$) enforce stage angular pitch/yaw error budgets within sub-micro-radian levels ($\le 0.45\,\mu\text{rad}$) to prevent dimensional distortion across the $8F^2$ array.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:** 
  - Metrology positioning and alignment protocols leverage optical phase difference principles, non-destructive optical mapping, and coordinate repeatability across automated multi-point sweeps.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Linear runout and angular pitch/yaw errors directly scale Abbe offset errors during access transistor diffusion and bitline contact pattern projection. In 180nm 8F2 layout architectures with Gen 2 fixturing (targeting +/-5 um overlay/positional accuracy across a 100mm travel stage), an uncompensated pitch or yaw deviation exceeding 10 arcseconds translates to over 2.4 um of Abbe lateral displacement at an optical working distance of 50mm, consuming nearly half of the entire overlay budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dual-beam or multi-axis laser interferometry (HeNe 632.8nm) is necessary to isolate pure translational runout (dX, dY, dZ) from parasitic rotational runout (theta_X pitch, theta_Y yaw). When kinematic mounts interface with the vacuum chuck, micro-slip or contact Hertzian stress relaxation causes non-repeatable angular wander during multi-pass indexing. The metrology loop must decouple environmental thermal drift (dn/dT of air refractive index) using Edlen equation compensation sensors (ambient P, T, RH) during runout scans.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Single-frequency stabilized HeNe laser sources (e.g., Renishaw XL-80 or Keysight 5530 series) and matched retroreflectors/angular optical blocks have lead times exceeding 16 weeks in domestic supply lines. Sourcing secondary precision optical wedges, dual-axis differential interferometers, and kinematic mounts with tungsten carbide contact balls requires pre-cleared logistics routes to avoid stalling tool calibration.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Calibration and runout validation gating must execute prior to loading active 180nm diffusion/contact masks into the aligner. If interferometric certification fails, the precision tooling fixture cannot be signed off for mechanical assembly integration, halting wafer-level step-and-repeat operations. Calibration overhead must not exceed 4 hours per kinematic mount swap.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Abbe lever arm error amplification causing active diffusion to bitline contact overlay misalignment exceeding 5 um due to uncompensated angular yaw runout.
1. Atmospheric refractive index fluctuation leading to false interferometric fringe count drift during prolonged stage travel calibration scans.
1. Kinematic ball-and-groove micro-fretting or thermal hysteresis yielding non-repeatable pitch runout across bi-directional stage travel.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-1-3-3-01` | **Dual-Axis Interferometric Angular Pitch and Yaw Runout Verification** | Stabilized HeNe Dual-Frequency Laser Interferometer (632.8 nm) with Angular Interferometer Head, Angular Retroreflector mounted on kinematic fixture chuck, environmental compensation station (ambient air temperature +/-0.05 C, pressure +/-10 Pa, relative humidity +/-1%). | 1. Align the angular interferometer beam to the angular retroreflector on the kinematic chuck across full 100 mm travel range along the primary axis. 2. Zero the interferometric phase counter at the home origin position. 3. Step the stage forward in 5 mm increments at 2 mm/s up to 100 mm, pausing 3 seconds at each node to acquire 1000 angular pitch and yaw samples. 4. Reverse the stage travel back to origin in identical 5 mm increments to capture bi-directional hysteresis. 5. Repeat the bidirectional cycle across 5 independent runs to calculate mean runout and 3-sigma repeatability. | `Maximum peak-to-valley angular pitch runout <= 5.0 arcseconds; maximum peak-to-valley angular yaw runout <= 4.0 arcseconds; bi-directional angular repeatability (3-sigma) <= 1.5 arcseconds across all 100 mm travel.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-1-3-3-02` | **Multi-Point Linear Total Runout & Abbe Offset Displacement Mapping** | Linear Displacement Laser Interferometer with differential plane mirror interferometer (DPMI) target mounted at the access transistor mask-to-substrate interface plane, calibrated displacement inductive gauging probe as secondary cross-check. | 1. Set the optical reference path at the nominal 50 mm Abbe offset plane relative to the stage kinematic reference datum. 2. Sweep the kinematic fixture along orthogonal X and Y axes across 100 mm x 100 mm grid in 10 mm intervals. 3. Simultaneously log linear position deviations (dX, dY, dZ) at 1 kHz sample rate. 4. Compute composite Abbe error displacement by combining linear runout with angular pitch/yaw coupling vectors. 5. Generate 2D surface runout topography map. | `Total composite linear runout (including angular Abbe projection at 50 mm offset) <= 1.2 um across full 100 mm travel; Z-axis vertical runout (defocus tilt) <= 0.8 um peak-to-valley.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 3R/3B Laser Safety Goggles (OD 5+ at 632.8 nm), Nitrile cleanroom gloves (accelerator-free, 6 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified clear impact safety spectacles, ESD-safe cleanroom smock and grounded wrist strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvent cleaners, flush affected area with copiously flowing water for 15 minutes. For eye contact with solvent or laser beam reflection, immediately flush eyes at emergency eyewash station for 15 minutes and seek ophthalmologic medical evaluation. For optical laser flash exposure, cover affected eye and transport to physician.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Local exhaust ventilation (LEV) / fume extraction duct operating at face velocity >= 0.5 m/s during solvent wipe-down of kinematic references and optical retros. Cleanroom HEPA laminar flow velocity maintained at 0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent-soaked wipes and swabs in designated airtight hazardous waste cans with flame arrestor caps. Dispose of through hazardous organic solvent waste stream in compliance with environmental cleanroom protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Solvent-cleaned, particulate-free (< Class 100 cleanroom level), degreased kinematic contact pads and optically polished retroreflector surfaces.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Interferometrically certified, dry N2 purged, mounted in sealed desiccated transport enclosure with vacuum chuck surface particulate count < 5 particles (> 0.5 um).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric airborne particle deposition on kinematic vee-grooves causing false tilt, baseline runout shifts (> 2 um), and ambient moisture condensation altering interfacial contact compliance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full laser interferometric runout and angular pitch/yaw validation of the Gen 2 kinematic tooling fixture for 180nm DRAM cell layout lithographic projection, confirming Abbe-corrected mechanical errors remain strictly within the 8F2 alignment envelope.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `laser_interferometric_runout_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `angular_pitch_yaw_spatial_scan_raw_data.csv`
- [ ] `kinematic_abbe_error_topography_map.tiff`

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Five consecutive bi-directional laser interferometric travel scans across 100mm verifying angular pitch <= 5.0 arcseconds, yaw <= 4.0 arcseconds, and Abbe-projected linear runout <= 1.2 um, signed off by Systems Engineering and Metrology leads.

nodes.label: Process Parameter Benchmarking for Access Transistor Diffusion & Shared Bitline Contact Layout Definition (8F²)
nodes.primary_metric: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV
nodes.sop_content:
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)                                                               |
| Task: Process Parameter Benchmarking for Access Transistor Diffusion & Shared Bitline Contact   |
| Node: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Folded Bitline Topology) | Action Type: Make                   |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 1. Objective & Scope
Define and benchmark process parameters for access transistor active diffusion ($W/L$) and the shared central bitline contact (BLC via tungsten plug) in an $8F^2$ folded-bitline unit cell. This procedure ensures required charge retention, sub-femtoampere junction leakage, and proper differential signal margins.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
  [Step 1: Active Area (OD) Patterning & Well Definition]
                           │
                           ▼
  [Step 2: Gate Dielectric Growth & Poly Wordline Definition]
                           │
                           ▼
  [Step 3: Source/Drain Implantation & Diffusion Formation]
                           │
                           ▼
  [Step 4: Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Etch & Tungsten Plug Fill]
                           │
                           ▼
  [Step 5: In-Line Physical Metrology & Electrical Benchmarking]
```

1. **Active Area (OD) Patterning & Well Definition**:
   - Perform shallow trench isolation (STI) and active area photolithography to define continuous active silicon tracks with access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Execute retrograde p-well channel-stop and threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) adjustment implantations.

2. **Gate Dielectric Growth & Wordline Definition**:
   - Perform dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}$ to $900^\circ\text{C}$ in pure $\text{O}_2$ ambient to grow a thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric with target physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Deposit polysilicon/poly-cide gate layer and pattern wordline (WL) tracks at physical channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ on a pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

3. **Source/Drain Implantation & Diffusion Formation**:
   - Form self-aligned lightly doped drain/source extensions followed by spacer deposition and high-dose $\text{N}^+$ source/drain implantation.
   - The central diffusion region serves as the shared bitline node between two adjacent access transistors; the outer nodes connect to the stacked capacitor plugs.
   - Anneal with rapid thermal processing (RTP) to activate dopants while minimizing lateral junction diffusion under the $180\text{ nm}$ gate.

4. **Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Etch & Tungsten Plug Fill**:
   - Deposit pre-metal dielectric (PMD) inter-layer oxide.
   - Pattern and anisotropically etch shared central bitline contact vias landing directly on the central active diffusion node between adjacent wordlines.
   - Deposit adhesion/barrier layer followed by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of tungsten (W-plug) and chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) to complete the contact plug.

5. **In-Line Physical Metrology & Electrical Benchmarking**:
   - Inspect critical dimensions (CD-SEM) across the active width ($W$), gate length ($L$), and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$–$400\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform parametric wafer-probe testing to verify subthreshold swing, $I_{off}$, and reverse junction leakage.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Geometry** | Length $L = 180 \pm 10$, Width $W = 220 \pm 12$ | $\text{nm}$ | Top-Down CD-SEM |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Thermal Oxidation Temperature** | $850 \text{ to } 900$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Diffusion Furnace Pyrometer/TC |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line Scatterometry / CD-SEM |
| **Subthreshold & Junction Leakage** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated Parametric Tester (WAT) |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout: Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells in an $8F^2$ stacked capacitor architecture with tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Electrical leakage constraint: Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Gate dielectric: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$–$900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Array pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch benchmarked at $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - Folded bitline topology requirements and cell capacitance charge budget context ($C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$–$150\text{ mV}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline cell configuration at the 180nm node (F=180nm, cell area ~0.259 µm²), allocating shared bitline diffusion contact between adjacent transfer gates requires a tight lithographic budget. With a contact pitch constrained by 2F wordline spacing and minimum contact diameter of 170-180 nm, overlay errors (>35 nm) between poly gate edges and contact cutouts will induce parasitic wordline-to-bitline bridging or severe gate dielectric punch-through. The layout diffusion perimeter must incorporate active dog-boning or serif OPC to maintain contact landing area without increasing bitline junction capacitance (C_bl) beyond the 15% cell budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) for N+ arsenic/phosphorus implant diffusion under the shared bitline contact plug (Ti/TiN liner + W-plug) must not exceed 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm² to prevent sensing signal attenuation during charge transfer. Standard TLM test structures with spacing gaps of 5 to 80 µm must validate whether low-temperature pre-clean (dilute HF dip / in-situ Ar sputter) eliminates interfacial native oxide (SiO2) before Ti barrier deposition, as an interfacial oxide >1.2 nm will elevate contact resistance Rc by >300% and degrade cell tRCD by >8 ns.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor gases for titanium silicide contact barrier formation (TiCl4 or TDMAT) and tungsten plug deposition (WF6 with SiH4/H2 reduction) face stringent purity and lead-time constraints. Sourcing electronic-grade WF6 (>=99.999% purity) and high-purity silane within open-foundry multi-project wafer (MPW) runs requires strict slot reservations 14 weeks prior to tapeout. Failure to secure qualified TiCl4/WF6 batches risks run cancellation or forced substitution with sputtering targets that fail to meet high-aspect-ratio (AR > 2.5:1) contact hole step coverage.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical layout benchmark requires clean DRC/LVS closure against open-source PDK rules (SKY130 / 180nm variants) with 5nm placement snapping. Schedule milestones for wafer lot TCAD calibration and TLM matrix e-test verification must freeze within 6 weeks of baseline reticle delivery to avoid downstream delays in capacitor cell integration (SN contact and bottom electrode node). Buffer windows must account for tool availability on the 248nm KrF stepper and automated 4-point probe test bench.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial native oxide regrowth or residual fluorocarbon polymer in high-aspect-ratio shared bitline contact vias causing high contact resistance (Rc > 150 Ohm/contact) or open-contact sensing failure.
1. Poly gate to diffusion contact misalignment exceeding the 35nm overlay margin, causing gate-to-bitline punch-through leakage or catastrophic short-circuit.
1. Arsenic diffusion dopant deactivation or transient enhanced diffusion (TED) during subsequent silicide anneals leading to subthreshold drain leakage (>1 pA/cell) and sub-64ms retention failure.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-01` | **Automated Kelvin & TLM Contact Resistivity Benchmarking for Shared Bitline Diffusion** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with triaxial shielding, 4-point probe Kelvin configuration. | 1. Land micro-probes on the metallized Kelvin contact pads of the 0.18 um shared bitline contact structure. 2. Force current I_force from -100 uA to +100 uA in 10 uA increments while measuring voltage drop V_sense across the diffusion-contact interface. 3. Extract Kelvin contact resistance R_c = dV/dI. 4. Step probe chuck to the 5-pitch TLM array; apply I_test = 1.0 mA across adjacent pad pairs (d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um) and measure total resistance R_T for each gap. 5. Perform linear regression of R_T versus d to extract slope (R_s / W) and x-intercept (-2*L_T). 6. Compute specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm2; Kelvin contact resistance R_c for 0.18 um x 0.18 um contact plug must be <= 65.0 Ohm; linearity of TLM regression R^2 >= 0.998.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-02` | **Cross-Sectional Critical Dimension & Overlay Verification via CD-SEM and In-Line TEM** | Hitachi S-9380 II In-Line Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) and Thermo Fisher Helios 5 DualBeam FIB-TEM. | 1. Align wafer to the 8F2 cell array test site containing shared bitline contacts between adjacent 180nm gate lines. 2. Acquire top-down CD-SEM images at 100kX magnification across 9 exposure fields (center, 4 edges, 4 corners). 3. Measure bottom contact diameter (CD_bottom), top contact diameter (CD_top), and contact-to-gate spacing. 4. Mill dual-beam FIB cross-section along the bitline axis slicing through the center of the shared contact plug. 5. Acquire high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) STEM image to inspect Ti/TiN barrier continuity and overlay offset relative to gate poly edges. | `Contact bottom CD must be 180 nm +/- 12 nm; contact-to-gate overlay error must be <= 30 nm (absolute); Ti/TiN liner step coverage at contact bottom corners must be >= 8.0 nm with zero pinholes or interfacial voids.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A chemical splash suit with integrated butyl rubber gloves, Supplied-air respirator (SCBA) or full-face chemical cartridge respirator with acid-gas/P100 filter, Secondary Neoprene over-gloves conforming to ASTM F739, Full-face polycarbonate splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Chemical-resistant safety boots with steel toe cap and metatarsal guard
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF dermal exposure: Flush affected area with cold water for exactly 2 minutes; immediately apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel massage continuously until medical personnel arrive; inject 10% calcium gluconate subcutaneously if deep tissue exposure occurs. For WF6 / TiCl4 toxic inhalation: Move patient to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen via non-rebreather mask, maintain seated posture to prevent pulmonary edema, initiate emergency physician protocol immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous dedicated local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on chemical wet benches and CVD dry pumps maintaining minimum capture velocity of 120 FPM (0.61 m/s) at face opening; toxic gas cabinets connected to negative pressure exhaust (-0.5 in. w.g.) routed to multi-stage point-of-use (POU) burn-wet thermal scrubbers.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous fluoride-bearing effluents routed to dedicated industrial fluoride precipitation system; treated with hydrated calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) and coagulant to precipitate insoluble CaF2; neutralized to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to certified hazardous effluent disposal. Effluent WF6/TiCl4 gases fully scrubbed through potassium hydroxide (KOH) caustic scrubbers.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Pre-metal dip)** | `7664-39-3` | Semiconductor Grade (SEMI C12, TraceMetal) | `0.5% - 1.0% aqueous solution (dHF 100:1)` |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (W-plug CVD)** | `7783-82-1` | Electronic Grade 5N (>= 99.999%) | `100% liquified gas under pressure` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (Ti/TiN barrier precursor)** | `7550-45-0` | Electronic Grade (>= 99.99%) | `99.9% liquid` |
| **Silane (Nucleation promoter)** | `7803-62-5` | Electronic Grade 6N (>= 99.9999%) | `100% compressed gas` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly opened silicon contact vias etched to N+ active diffusion with fluorocarbon etch polymer stripped via in-situ O2/CF4 plasma ash followed by 100:1 dilute HF clean, yielding a hydrogen-terminated (H-passivated) hydrophobic silicon surface.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Continuous conformal CVD/ALD Ti/TiN barrier layer (minimum 10nm Ti / 15nm TiN) completely encapsulating the contact bottom and sidewalls, sealed against ambient oxygen and humidity, prepared for W-plug nucleation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces spontaneous native oxide (SiO2) re-growth >1.0 nm and moisture condensation inside 180nm contact vias, causing silicide peeling, catastrophic increase in contact resistivity (rho_c > 1.0e-5 Ohm*cm2), and complete contact open circuit.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Process parameter benchmarking dataset and validated DRC/LVS physical design layout for the 8F2 access transistor shared bitline contact (0.18 um technology). Delivery includes fully extracted electrical TLM contact resistivity curves, SEM/TEM cross-sectional metrology reports confirming Ti/TiN step coverage and overlay margins, and GDSII macro library with verified design rule decks.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SHARED_BL_CONTACT_BENCHMARK_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `TLM_KELVIN_RESISTIVITY_MATRIX_DATA.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM_8F2_BITLINE_CONTACT_MACRO.gds`
- [ ] `CONTACT_CROSS_SECTION_HAADF_STEM.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-01` | **Specific contact resistivity of the N+ diffusion shared bitline contact interface** | `3.5e-7` | <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2 | Automated 4-point probe TLM gap regression and Kelvin cross-bridge e-test extraction on Keysight B1500A |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-02` | **Shared bitline contact bottom critical dimension (CD)** | `180.0` | +/- 12.0 nm | Top-down CD-SEM automated measurement over 9 wafer field sites (Hitachi S-9380 II) |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-03` | **Gate poly to shared bitline contact overlay margin** | `0.0` | <= 28.0 nm absolute offset | In-line cross-sectional FIB-STEM metrology and optical scatterometry overlay inspection |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit signoff requires 100% DRC/LVS rule clearance on DRAM_8F2_BITLINE_CONTACT_MACRO.gds with zero antenna violations, e-test verification showing specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm2 across >= 95% of tested dies across 3 qualification wafers, and physical confirmation of >= 8nm Ti/TiN barrier thickness at the contact bottom corners with no voiding in TEM imaging.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: TCAD Implantation & Diffusion Profiling for Access Transistor Junctions

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Workflow

This procedure defines the TCAD process simulation and junction profiling workflow for the NMOS access transistor within an $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM cell architecture at the 180 nm node ($F = 180\text{ nm}$, cell area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$). The simulation tunes ion implantation doses, tilt/twist angles, and rapid thermal annealing (RTA) parameters to control junction depth, lateral dopant encroachment under the wordline gate, and ultra-low leakage targets.

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Substrate Prep     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Channel & Halo     │
│     Implantation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  LDD & Source/Drain   │
│     Implantation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Rapid Thermal     │
│     Annealing RTA     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼

│                       │
│      TCAD Mesh &      │
│  Transport Profiling  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒       │

                 │▓▓                                   │

                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       55       110      165     220

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Gate Stack Initialization**:
   - Define a p-type Si (100) simulation domain matching unit access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, transistor active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Grow gate dielectric oxide ($t_{ox}$) and deposit polysilicon/poly-gate stack patterning for wordline layout matching the $8F^2$ layout ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ unit cell).

2. **Well & Channel Stop / Anti-Punchthrough Implantation**:
   - Perform Boron ($B^{11}$) channel and anti-punchthrough/halo ion implantation to set baseline threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) and prevent subsurface source-to-drain punchthrough across the 180 nm gate length.

3. **Lightly Doped Drain (LDD) Implantation**:
   - Perform low-energy Phosphorus ($P^{31}$) or Arsenic ($As^{75}$) implantation to form shallow LDD junctions adjacent to the wordline gate edge to minimize hot-carrier injection and lower peak drain electric fields.
   - Form spacer dielectric liners along the gate sidewalls.

4. **Source/Drain & Shared Bitline Contact Heavy Implantation**:
   - Perform heavy Arsenic ($As^{75}$) source/drain implantation at the shared bitline contact node (shared between two adjacent cells) and the storage node contact plug region.
   - Set tilt at $7^\circ$ with $0^\circ$ twist to suppress ion channeling along the Si (100) axis.

5. **Rapid Thermal Annealing (RTA) & Dopant Activation**:
   - Simulate transient RTA (peak temperature $950^\circ\text{C} - 1050^\circ\text{C}$, ramp rate $\ge 50^\circ\text{C}/\text{s}$, soak time $< 10\text{ s}$) using kinetic Monte Carlo or continuum advanced diffusion models (pair diffusion and point defect interstitial/vacancy clustering).
   - Ensure complete dopant electrical activation while limiting excessive lateral junction diffusion into the 180 nm channel.

6. **Electrical & TLM Verification in Device Simulator**:
   - Couple the diffusion profile into the device TCAD simulator.
   - Simulate $I_{DS}-V_{GS}$ transfer characteristics at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate subthreshold slope and junction leakage under storage node capacitor bias conditions.
   - Verify specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) across the contact interface using TLM baseline formulation ($R_T = 2R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$).

---

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target | Physical Units | Evaluation Condition / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Channel Length ($L$)** | **$180$** | $\text{nm}$ | Mask layout and TCAD gate boundary definition |
| **Physical Channel Active Width ($W$)** | **$220$** | $\text{nm}$ | Mask layout and active mesa boundary |
| **Cell Off-State Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | **$< 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | TCAD device transport extraction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($V_{DS} = V_{DD}$, $V_{GS} = 0\text{ V}$) |
| **Cell Footprint (Folded Bitline)** | **$0.259$** | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | Geometric DRC layout check ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$) |
| **Nominal Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28.0$** (range: $25.0 - 30.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | Integrated stacked capacitor extraction target |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | **$5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$** (must be $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless | Bitline parasitic budget ($150 - 250\text{ fF}$) over cell $C_s$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Extracted Parameters*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact between adjacent cells; cell sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; storage capacitor target $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
  - *Extracted Parameters*: $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$; $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (nominally $28\text{ fF}$); $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$; capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ strictly maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$).
- **Source: Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity**
  - *Extracted Formulation*: $R_T = 2R_c + (R_s / W) \cdot d$, with specific contact resistivity $\rho_c = R_c \cdot W \cdot L_T = R_s \cdot L_T^2\ [\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2]$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Access Transistor Well and Halo/Pocket Implantation Parameter Setup
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) | **Cell Architecture:** 8F² 1T1C COB | **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   P-Well Retrograde    │
│      Implantation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gate Stack Formation  │
│     W/L=220/180nm      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Self-Aligned Halo /   │
│   Pocket Boron Tilt    │
│        Implant         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Shallow N+ LDD &    │
│      Flash Anneal      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Junction Leakage &   │
│      Vt Metrology      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Cell Array P-Well Retrograde Implantation:**
   - Align the DRAM cell array open-area mask over the active array region.
   - Perform multi-energy Boron ($^{11}\text{B}^+$) retrograde well implantation into the p-substrate to suppress punch-through and form a deep isolation barrier beneath the shared bitline and storage node contact junctions.
2. **Access Transistor Gate Stack Verification:**
   - Verify gate dielectric thickness grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation ($T_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Pattern and inspect polysilicon wordline access gate critical dimensions targeting channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
3. **Quad-Tilt Self-Aligned Halo / Pocket Implantation:**
   - Mount wafer into the high-current/medium-current implanter with electrostatic tilt fixture.
   - Perform four-quadrant ($4 \times 90^\circ$ twist) tilt angle Boron / $\text{BF}_2^+$ halo implantation self-aligned to the $180\text{ nm}$ wordline gate stack edges.
   - The localized p-type pocket suppresses drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) and sub-threshold roll-off across the $180\text{ nm}$ physical gate length while preventing abrupt junction band-to-band tunneling at the storage node.
4. **Shallow Junction Extension (LDD) & Spacer Definition:**
   - Perform shallow $N^+$ LDD implantation (Arsenic/Phosphorus) at $0^\circ$ tilt to define symmetrical junctions for the shared bitline contact node and capacitor node.
   - Form dielectric side-wall spacers prior to high-dose contact activation.
5. **Rapid Thermal Anneal (RTA) / Activation:**
   - Execute rapid thermal spike anneal to activate dopants and repair crystalline displacement damage while minimizing Boron transient enhanced diffusion (TED) into the channel.
6. **Electrical & In-Line Metrology:**
   - Measure sheet resistance ($R_s$), threshold voltage roll-off, and junction/sub-threshold leakage at elevated temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

---

### 3. Context Citations & Literature Traceability

1. **Gate Dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$):**
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
   - Quote: *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells."*
2. **Thermal Oxidation Profile & Thickness ($850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$, $3.5\text{ nm}$):**
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
   - Quote: *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."*
3. **Leakage Current Upper Bound ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$):**
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
   - Quote: *"Leakage Current Target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve refresh interval of"*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Halo/pocket implantation profile engineering directly trades off short-channel effect suppression against gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) and junction band-to-band tunneling (BTBT). At the 180nm node (L_eff ~ 180nm, W = 220nm), an overly aggressive Boron or BF2 halo dose (> 3.5e13 cm^-2) elevates electric field contours at the storage node contact junction beyond 0.6 MV/cm, dramatically spiking off-state leakage past the sub-1 fA/cell at 85°C retention budget. The retrofit must precisely tune the retrograde p-well and angled pocket tilt (typically 20° to 28° quad-rotation) to guarantee threshold voltage roll-off stability without compromising the 64ms retention interval.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For access nMOS transistor junctions in an 8F^2 stacked capacitor DRAM architecture, transient enhanced diffusion (TED) of Boron driven by implant damage interstitials can severely deform the channel metallurgical length during post-implant rapid thermal annealing (RTA). A low-energy Boron (10-15 keV) or BF2 (30-45 keV) halo combined with a deep Phosphorus/Arsenic retrograde well (150-250 keV) requires fine-calibrated TCAD monte-carlo/BCS kinetic damage modeling. Furthermore, the storage node junction must remain asymmetric or lightly doped (LDD offset) compared to the bitline contact side to decouple storage node leakage from bitline drive current (I_on >= 35 µA/µm).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Source material availability for isotopic Boron trifluoride (11BF3) and Diborane (B2H6) precursor gas cylinders in specialty 3S/DOT canisters meets regional SEZ fab supply chains in Southeast Asia; however, ion implanter arc chamber tungsten filament degradation and source cathode life are severely degraded by high-dose BF3 cracking. Lead time for high-purity replacement extraction optics and deceleration lens assemblies from Tier-1 suppliers exceeds 16-20 weeks, mandating predictive consumable replacement schedules aligned with batch implant campaigns.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Implant angle shadowing from thick 180nm DUV photoresist masks (aspect ratio > 3:1 over gate stacks) presents acute wafer yield risks across quad-step rotations. Quad-rotation halo alignment requires strict tool-matching across medium-current implanters. The project milestone requires freezing the halo tilt/twist, dose matrix, and well dopant recipe within 14 calendar days to avoid stalling downstream RTA thermal calibration and spacer dielectric deposition lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. GIDL and BTBT leakage surge exceeding 5 fA/cell at storage node junction caused by localized halo dopant pile-up and steep electric field (> 0.7 MV/cm) at V_sub = -0.5V and V_BL = 1.8V.
1. Asymmetric threshold voltage (V_th) shift and drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL > 120 mV/V) across orthogonal cell orientations due to photoresist sidewall shadowing during angled quad-halo implantation.
1. Junction breakdown degradation below 3.0V at the storage node diffusion edge due to end-of-range (EOR) dislocation loops surviving 950°C-1000°C spike annealing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-1-01` | **Access Transistor Sub-Threshold and Off-State Junction Leakage Verification** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1517A High Resolution SMU (fA resolution), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with thermal chuck at 85°C, shielded triaxial cabling. | 1. Set thermal chuck temperature to 85.0°C +/- 0.5°C and allow 30 min thermal stabilization. 2. Contact the shared bitline node (SMU1), storage node junction (SMU2), wordline gate (SMU3), and p-well tap (SMU4). 3. Apply V_well = -0.5V, V_gate = 0.0V, V_BL = 0.0V. 4. Sweep V_SN (storage node) from 0.0V to 1.8V in 20mV increments with 100ms integration delay per point. 5. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B cleanroom chemical apron with full face shield (ANSI Z87.1 D3 rated), Butyl rubber outer gloves over double nitrile cleanroom gloves (0.4mm minimum thickness), Self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) or positive pressure supplied-air respirator during gas cylinder changeout, Static-dissipative cleanroom safety shoes with conductive toe protection
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: BF3 inhalation or skin contact releases toxic HF upon hydrolysis: Flush contaminated skin immediately with water for 5 minutes, followed by continuous application and massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel until medical personnel arrive. For eye exposure, irrigate with 1% Calcium Gluconate eye solution or isotonic saline for minimum 15 minutes. For AsH3/PH3 inhalation: Immediately evacuate victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, keep warm and at absolute rest. - **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Gas cabinets and ion source housings must maintain continuous negative static pressure with exhaust capture velocity >= 150 LFPM (0.76 m/s) at face opening. - **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Scrubber effluent containing fluoride and arsenic/phosphorus oxy-salts is routed to the Industrial Wastewater Treatment Plant (IWTP) fluoride precipitation train. Treat with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry at pH 8.5-9.5 to precipitate Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) and Calcium Arsenate (Ca3(AsO4)2). Flocculate with polyaluminum chloride (PAC), press into dry sludge cake for hazardous landfill disposal (RCRA/EPA HazWaste Class D004), ensuring treated liquid discharge contains As < 0.05 ppm and F- < 10.0 ppm.

critics.systems_engineer: Halo/pocket implantation profile engineering directly trades off short-channel effect suppression against gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL) and junction band-to-band tunneling (BTBT). At the 180nm node (L_eff ~ 180nm, W = 220nm), an overly aggressive Boron or BF2 halo dose (> 3.5e13 cm^-2) elevates electric field contours at the storage node contact junction beyond 0.6 MV/cm, dramatically spiking off-state leakage past the sub-1 fA/cell at 85°C retention budget. The retrofit must precisely tune the retrograde p-well and angled pocket tilt (typically 20° to 28° quad-rotation) to guarantee threshold voltage roll-off stability without compromising the 64ms retention interval.
critics.domain_expert: For access nMOS transistor junctions in an 8F^2 stacked capacitor DRAM architecture, transient enhanced diffusion (TED) of Boron driven by implant damage interstitials can severely deform the channel metallurgical length during post-implant rapid thermal annealing (RTA). A low-energy Boron (10-15 keV) or BF2 (30-45 keV) halo combined with a deep Phosphorus/Arsenic retrograde well (150-250 keV) requires fine-calibrated TCAD monte-carlo/BCS kinetic damage modeling. Furthermore, the storage node junction must remain asymmetric or lightly doped (LDD offset) compared to the bitline contact side to decouple storage node leakage from bitline drive current (I_on >= 35 µA/µm).
critics.supply_chain: Source material availability for isotopic Boron trifluoride (11BF3) and Diborane (B2H6) precursor gas cylinders in specialty 3S/DOT canisters meets regional SEZ fab supply chains in Southeast Asia; however, ion implanter arc chamber tungsten filament degradation and source cathode life are severely degraded by high-dose BF3 cracking. Lead time for high-purity replacement extraction optics and deceleration lens assemblies from Tier-1 suppliers exceeds 16-20 weeks, mandating predictive consumable replacement schedules aligned with batch implant campaigns.
critics.laya_pm: Implant angle shadowing from thick 180nm DUV photoresist masks (aspect ratio > 3:1 over gate stacks) presents acute wafer yield risks across quad-step rotations. Quad-rotation halo alignment requires strict tool-matching across medium-current implanters. The project milestone requires freezing the halo tilt/twist, dose matrix, and well dopant recipe within 14 calendar days to avoid stalling downstream RTA thermal calibration and spacer dielectric deposition lots.
critical_failure_modes: GIDL and BTBT leakage surge exceeding 5 fA/cell at storage node junction caused by localized halo dopant pile-up and steep electric field (> 0.7 MV/cm) at V_sub = -0.5V and V_BL = 1.8V.

Asymmetric threshold voltage (V_th) shift and drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL > 120 mV/V) across orthogonal cell orientations due to photoresist sidewall shadowing during angled quad-halo implantation.
Junction breakdown degradation below 3.0V at the storage node diffusion edge due to end-of-range (EOR) dislocation loops surviving 950°C-1000°C spike annealing.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 2D/3D TCAD Kinetic Monte Carlo Diffusion and Thermal Anneal Simulation

**Hierarchy Path:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²)` > `1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²)` > `Access Transistor Diffusion & Shared Bitline Contact Layout Definition (8F²)` > `Process Parameter Benchmarking for Access Transistor Diffusion & Shared Bitline Contact Layout Definition` > `TCAD Implantation & Diffusion Profiling for Access Transistor Junctions` > **2D/3D TCAD Kinetic Monte Carlo Diffusion and Thermal Anneal Simulation**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       1. TCAD 2D/3D Domain & Mesh Setup       │
│    (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm, tox = 3.5 nm)    │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│        2. Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC)          │
│       Defect & Dopant Damage Seeding         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       3. Thermal Anneal Simulation Run       │
│    (850°C-900°C Furnace / Dry O2 Kinetics)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│       4. TED Dissolution & Clustering        │
│          Dynamic Evolution Tracking          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    5. Junction Leakage Extraction & Export   │
│            (< 1 fA/cell at 85°C)             │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **TCAD Domain Definition & Mesh Initialization:**
   - Construct the 2D/3D cell simulation structure for the $8F^2$ folded-bitline unit cell geometry:
     - Nominal access transistor channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Shared bitline contact pitch and wordline pitch window: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Include the thermally grown gate dielectric stack with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.
   - Define adaptive meshing with refinement across the gate oxide-silicon interface ($\Delta x \le 0.5\text{ nm}$) and source/drain junction regions.

2. **Ion Implantation Damage & Dopant Seeding for KMC:**
   - Import binary collision approximation (BCA) or direct Monte Carlo ion implantation damage cascades for LDD (Lightly Doped Drain) and source/drain implants.
   - Initialize point defect populations (self-interstitials $I$, vacancies $V$, {311} interstitial clusters, and boron/arsenic clusters) directly into the atomistic/super-particle KMC coordinate space.

3. **Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) Thermal Anneal Execution:**
   - Configure the thermal anneal profile reflecting furnace activation and oxidation conditions at $850^\circ\text{C}$ to $900^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$ ambient (consistent with the Deal-Grove linear-parabolic oxidation regime).
   - Execute KMC event steps tracking:
     - Hop rates governed by activation energy $E_a$ and temperature $T$.
     - Interstitial-dopant pair migration ($AI$, $BI$) driving Transient Enhanced Diffusion (TED).
     - Cluster dissolution and recombination at the $\text{Si/SiO}_2$ interface ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).

4. **Transient Enhanced Diffusion (TED) & Lateral Spread Verification:**
   - Monitor junction encroachment beneath the $180\text{ nm}$ gate electrode to prevent punch-through and short-channel degradation.
   - Verify that active dopant concentration stabilizes following defect annihilation.

5. **Electrical Leakage & Junction Extraction:**
   - Solve Poisson and drift-diffusion transport equations on the resulting active dopant profile at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Extract sub-threshold leakage, gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL), and reverse-bias junction leakage at the storage node drain junction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Physical Unit | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | 2D/3D TCAD structure coordinate verification |
| **Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | 3D mesh boundary dimension inspection |
| **Thermal Anneal Temperature Window** | $850 \text{ to } 900$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | TCAD thermal recipe boundary check |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Interface profile extraction across $\text{SiO}_2$ mesh |
| **Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Simulated reverse-bias leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric: thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Data retention: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor unit cell geometry: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Thermal oxidation kinetic model: $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$.
  - Interface trap density target: $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$.
  - Gate dielectric thickness target: $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-2-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-2-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

# Standard Operating Procedure: Junction Doping Profile Calibration and Sub-fA Off-State Leakage Verification

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180-042`  
**Process Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip)  
**Classification:** Metrology & Electrical Test / Process Calibration  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Prep: 180nm    │
│    Test Structures     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SIMS and SRP Doping   │
│    Depth Profiling     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Calibrate TCAD     │
│    Diffusion Models    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Triaxial Guarding    │
│  and Thermal Chuck at  │
│          85C           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sub-fA Off-State    │
│  Leakage Verification  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Wafer Loading & Scribe-Line Test Structure Alignment**:
   - Transfer 180nm test wafers containing access transistor arrays ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and dedicated 1T1C test structures into the analytical metrology chamber.
   - Align to the dedicated kerf/scribe-line test structures containing unpatterned and large-area access transistor diffusion pads.

2. **Physical & Chemical Junction Depth Profiling (SIMS & SRP)**:
   - Perform Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) depth profiling on calibrated monitor pads to quantify chemical dopant profiles (donor/acceptor concentrations versus junction depth).
   - Execute Spreading Resistance Profiling (SRP) to determine electrically activated carrier concentration across the source/drain junctions and drain-to-body interface.

3. **TCAD Implantation & Diffusion Model Tuning**:
   - Extract junction depth ($X_j$), lateral straggle, and active concentration from SIMS/SRP traces.
   - Correlate physical profiles against 1D/2D TCAD diffusion simulations. Calibrate transient enhanced diffusion (TED) and thermal budget parameters to align access transistor channel boundary contours ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).

4. **Triaxial Prober & Parametric Analyzer Setup**:
   - Mount wafer onto a dark-box shielded, thermal chuck equipped with triaxial Kelvin connections and driven guard shields to suppress parasitic cable charging and ambient electromagnetic interference.
   - Pre-condition electrometer/Source Measure Units (SMUs) with integration times optimized for sub-femtoampere resolution (Long NPLC mode).

5. **Sub-fA Off-State Leakage Current Characterization**:
   - Heat the thermal chuck to $85^\circ\text{C}$ and allow thermal stabilization ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Set wordline (gate) bias to $V_{WL} = 0\text{ V}$ (or $V_{BB}$ back-bias) to ensure access transistor off-state.
   - Apply bitline precharge voltage ($V_{DD} / 2$) or operational supply bias ($V_{DD}$) to the drain/shared bitline contact node, and measure total leakage current ($I_{off}$, including sub-threshold swing and reverse-biased junction leakage) flowing through the cell storage node.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Off-State Cell Leakage ($I_{off}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Electrometer / SMU triaxial guard measurement at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | $85 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated thermo-chuck closed-loop sensor |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Cross-sectional TEM / CD-SEM calibrated against TCAD profile |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 8$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline CD-SEM inspection |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline CD-SEM pitch verification |

---

### Context Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Confirms unit cell geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms leakage limit: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must remain below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required cell retention and refresh intervals.
  - Confirms shared bitline contact topology and $8F^2$ folded bitline layout.

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Confirms array geometry and bitline/wordline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms operating thermal retention condition benchmark of $85^\circ\text{C}$ for cell retention intervals $> 64\text{ ms}$.

- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Confirms bitline precharge/equalization level at $V_{DD} / 2$ prior to wordline assertion and the charge-sharing voltage dynamic.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Measuring sub-fA off-state leakage (I_off < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C) across an individual 180nm access transistor (W/L = 220nm/180nm) is constrained by direct triaxial probe parasitic capacitance and thermal noise floors. The metrology suite must execute parallel Kelvin triaxial guarded measurements on array test structures (e.g., 10,000-cell parallel test vehicle arrays normalized per cell) alongside isolated single-transistor structures, ensuring that system leakage does not mask junction band-to-band tunneling (BTBT) or trap-assisted gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Calibrating the n+/p-well junction doping profile requires high-resolution secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) and scanning spreading resistance microscopy (SSRM) to extract the metallurgical junction depth (Xj target <= 75 nm) and lateral straggle beneath the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide. High peak phosphorus/arsenic doping gradients risk severe electric field crowding at the drain junction corner, which exponentially accelerates junction leakage via Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) generation centers and phonon-assisted trap tunneling at 85°C operating specs.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: SIMS external metrology turnaround times and specialized cryo-shielded sub-femtoampere wafer probe cards (featuring triaxial guarding down to the chuck) represent critical path lead-time bottlenecks. Secondary sourcing for ultra-low noise probe tips and cleanroom-compatible thermal chuck chuck liners certified for <0.1 fA baseline floor must be locked in with local foundry and test partners prior to lot delivery.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Junction calibration cycles directly gate Milestone 2 (M2) device freeze. If SIMS calibration and sub-fA parameter verification slip past 7 business days, subsequent mask revisions for the access transistor LDD implant and Halo tilt angle optimization will be stalled, jeopardizing the 64ms DRAM refresh retention demonstration timeline.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Thermal chuck and probe-needle electrostatic/triboelectric leakage inducing a measurement noise floor > 10 fA, masking genuine junction leakage and corrupting the extracted activation energy.
1. Excessive phosphorus/boron lateral counter-doping straggle beneath the gate edge resulting in severe punch-through and elevated subthreshold swing (> 110 mV/dec at 85°C).
1. Point defect clustering from un-annealed end-of-range (EOR) implant damage precipitating deep-level traps within the depletion region, driving junction leakage orders of magnitude above the 1.0 fA/cell retention threshold.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-3-01` | **Sub-fA Off-State Leakage and GIDL Characterization at Elevated Temperature** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1517A High-Resolution SMU (HRSMU) equipped with triaxial guarded probe station and Temptronic ThermoChuck (ambient to 85°C ± 0.5°C). | 1. Land triaxial guarded probe needles on Gate, Source, Drain, and Bulk pads of the isolated 180nm access transistor test structure (W=220nm, L=180nm) and 10k-cell test array. 2. Set Bulk (p-well) to 0V (or -0.5V back-bias if applicable) and Source to 0V. 3. Apply V_DS = 1.2V and 1.8V to the Drain terminal. 4. Sweep V_GS from -0.5V to +1.8V in 20mV increments with integration time set to Long (64 PLC) and triaxial guard driven at terminal potentials. 5. Record I_DS, extract I_off at V_GS = 0V and V_DS = 1.2V at 85°C; normalize array current per unit cell. | `Off-state leakage current I_off at V_GS = 0V, V_DS = 1.2V, T = 85°C must be <= 0.85 fA/cell (specification ceiling: 1.0 fA/cell); Subthreshold swing SS <= 95 mV/dec at 85°C.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-1-2-1-3-02` | **Access Transistor Metallurgical Junction Depth and Dopant Profile Extraction via SIMS/SSRM** | Magnetic Sector Dynamic SIMS (Cameca IMS 7f-Auto) using Cs+ primary beam (impact energy 500 eV) for n-type profiling and O2+ beam for p-well profiling, cross-verified with Scanning Spreading Resistance Microscopy (Bruker Dimension Icon SSRM). | 1. Calibrate SIMS erosion rate using spectroscopic ellipsometry step-height measurement on SiO2/Si reference standard. 2. Raster Cs+ ion beam over 100 um x 100 um pad, collecting secondary negative cluster ions (31P + 28Si or 75As + 28Si) to profile n+ dopant concentration down to 1e16 atoms/cm3. 3. Raster O2+ ion beam to extract Boron p-well channel and halo background concentration. 4. Determine metallurgical junction depth Xj where active donor concentration equals p-well acceptor concentration (N_D = N_A = 2e17 atoms/cm3). 5. Perform SSRM scan on cleaved cross-section to verify 2D lateral junction underdiffusion under the gate oxide edge. | `Metallurgical junction depth Xj = 70 nm ± 5 nm; peak surface dopant concentration N_peak = 1.2e20 to 2.5e20 atoms/cm3; lateral underdiffusion delta_L <= 18 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles with ANSI Z87.1 side shields, Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene acid-resistant gloves over secondary nitrile gloves, PTFE cleanroom apron, Face shield (polycarbonate), Vapor-tight full-face respirator with multi-gas/P100 acid particulate cartridges during wet station chemical maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid skin exposure: Immediately flush affected skin area with continuous flowing water for 2 minutes while stripping contaminated gear. Instantly apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel liberally and massage continuously into affected skin until medical personnel arrive. In case of eye contact, flush with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye solution or copious isotonic saline for a minimum of 15 minutes. Call emergency hazmat response immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated dedicated laminar acid exhaust bench with face velocity maintained at 100 ± 10 LFPM (0.51 m/s), routed directly to a centralized wet acid scrubber system operating with automated continuous pH control and scrubbed exhaust monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid waste drain line routed to automated calcium hydroxide / lime precipitation reaction tanks to precipitate fluoride ions as insoluble CaF2; adjust effluent pH between 6.5 and 8.5 before discharge to industrial wastewater treatment.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Dilute 100:1)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 5 (VLSI) | `0.5% wt aqueous` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | SEMI Grade 4 | `30% wt aqueous` |
| **Sulfuric Acid** | `7664-93-9` | SEMI Grade 4 | `96% wt aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface following post-etch/implant clean and dilute HF oxide strip, free of organic or metallic residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stabilized passivation oxide or sealed in hermetic vacuum transfer pod (FOUP purge with clean dry nitrogen < 1 ppm O2/H2O).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (> 0.8 nm) and airborne molecular contamination (boron/phosphorus/organic siloxane vapor adsorption), causing severe SIMS depth-calibration shifts, interface trap degradation, and spurious surface leakage exceeding 5.0 fA/cell.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full metallurgical doping profile and sub-femtoampere off-state leakage characterization of the 180nm 8F² access transistor, confirming junction depth Xj <= 75nm, subthreshold swing <= 95 mV/dec, and normalized off-state leakage <= 0.85 fA/cell at 85°C.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SIMS_Doping_Profile_Calibration_180nm_AccessTr.csv`
- [ ] `Sub_fA_Leakage_Temperature_Verification_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `SSRM_CrossSection_LateralDiffusion_Mapping.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Off-state leakage current per 180nm DRAM access transistor at elevated retention test temperature** | `0.85 fA/cell` | +0.15 fA/cell (Upper limit: 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C, V_DS = 1.2V) | Keysight B1500A HRSMU triaxial guarded Kelvin measurement on 10k-cell parallel test array at 85.0°C |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Metallurgical junction depth (Xj) of the n+ bitline/storage node diffusion into p-well** | `70.0 nm` | ±5.0 nm | High-resolution Magnetic Sector Dynamic SIMS Cs+ profiling calibrated against spectroscopic ellipsometry step standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Subthreshold swing (SS) of the access transistor under operational DRAM cell bias conditions** | `90.0 mV/dec` | ±5.0 mV/dec (Maximum allowable: 95.0 mV/dec at 85°C) | Logarithmic I_DS - V_GS transfer curve extraction over 3 decades of subthreshold current |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Device Physics and Metrology Council signoff requiring 100% of probed wafer sites across 49-point wafer maps to exhibit normalized I_off <= 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C with no gate oxide soft-breakdown and SIMS-extracted Xj within 65-75 nm.
