# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Foundation DRC Deck Adaptation for Tight-Pitch Memory Array Rules
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-DRC-180NM-001`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m node)  
**Cell Topology:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor (Capacitor Over Bitline - COB)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP specifies the adaptation and customization of standard baseline 180nm foundry Design Rule Checking (DRC) decks (e.g., standard logic design rule sets) to accommodate tight-pitch DRAM memory core array rules. Baseline logic decks enforce relaxed spacing rules that inhibit the high-density footprint required by an $8F^2$ folded bitline DRAM array ($A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$). This procedure establishes array-specific rule waivers, conditional array marker layers, and exact geometric constraints for critical active area, wordline (gate), bitline, and tungsten contact/plug layers.

---

### 2. Workflow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: Array Boundary Marker Layer Definition & Boolean Conditioning             |
|   - Add `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER` to mask baseline logic pitch & spacing checks         |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: Active Area (OD/DIFF) & Access Transistor Rule Parameterization           |
|   - Set Access Transistor L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm                                  |
|   - Enforce shared bitline contact landing area geometries                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: Wordline (Poly/Gate) & Bitline (M1/W-Line) Tight-Pitch Adaptation         |
|   - Constrain Wordline (WL) pitch to 360 nm - 400 nm (Line = 180 nm, Space = 180 nm) |
|   - Constrain Bitline (BL) pitch to 360 nm - 400 nm (Line = 180 nm, Space = 180 nm) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 4: Storage Node & Shared Contact Plug Enclosure / Spacing Verification       |
|   - Shared Bitline Tungsten (W) Contact plug pitch & enclosure                    |
|   - Storage Node Contact (SNC) plug clearance to Wordline / Bitline               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 5: Regression Run, Violation Triage & Cell Footprint Sign-Off                |
|   - Ensure zero false violations inside array; confirm Area = 0.259 um^2 per cell |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Array Boundary Marker Layer Definition & Boolean Conditioning
1. Define a reserved layer: `LAYER DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER = <GDS_LAYER_NUMBER>`.
2. Wrap baseline foundry rules (e.g., standard logic poly-to-poly spacing $> 240\,\text{nm}$) with Boolean exclusion clauses:
   $$\text{CORE\_POLY} = \text{POLY} \ \mathbf{NOT}\ \text{DRAM\_ARRAY\_MARKER}$$
   $$\text{ARRAY\_POLY} = \text{POLY} \ \mathbf{AND}\ \text{DRAM\_ARRAY\_MARKER}$$
3. Direct all customized memory rules to evaluate strictly within `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER`.

#### Step 2: Access Transistor & Active Area (OD) Parameterization
1. Implement dimension verification for unit access NMOS transistors:
   - Channel Length: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$
   - Channel Width: $W = 220\,\text{nm}$
2. Allow merged active diffusion between pairs of adjacent memory cells to support shared bitline contacts.
3. Verify gate dielectric oxide thickness parameter tagging ($t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\,\text{nm}$).

#### Step 3: Wordline & Bitline Pitch/Spacing Rule Insertion
1. **Wordline Rule Set (`WL_RULE`):**
   - Minimum gate poly critical dimension (Line width): $180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Minimum poly-to-poly space in array: $180\,\text{nm}$ to $220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Target array Wordline pitch constraint: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.
2. **Bitline Rule Set (`BL_RULE`):**
   - Minimum bitline metal/plug width: $180\,\text{nm}$.
   - Minimum bitline-to-bitline space in array: $180\,\text{nm}$ to $220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Target array Bitline pitch constraint: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.

#### Step 4: Contact & Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) Rule Adaptation
1. Parameterize contact rules for shared bitline contacts between adjacent 1T1C cells.
2. Define storage node contact (SNC) tungsten plug (W-plug) vertical clearance and overlay enclosure targeting crown-type or cylinder-type stacked capacitor interfaces over bitline (COB).

#### Step 5: Full Array DRC Execution & Verification
1. Run physical verification across the full memory block (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
2. Confirm zero DRC syntax errors, zero spacing violations across array boundaries, and absence of false positive logic-rule violations inside `DRAM_ARRAY_MARKER`.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Minimum | Nominal / Target | Maximum | Units | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Footprint Area ($8F^2$ at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$) | — | `0.259` | `0.260` | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC Automated Area Extraction / GDS polygon query |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Gate Physical Dimensions ($L \times W$) | `180 × 220` | `180 × 220` | `180 × 220` | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Width & Length Rule Assertions |
| **AC-03** | Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Array Pitch | `360` | `380` | `400` | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Pitch/Spacing DRC Measurement |
| **AC-04** | Target Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget Verification | `25` | `28` | `30` | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) & capacitance rule checker |
| **AC-05** | Parasitic Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | `5.0 : 1` | `7.0 : 1` | `9.0 : 1` | ratio | Array RC Extraction (256/512 cells/BL block) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:**
  * Defined $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area at $F = 180\,\text{nm}$ ($0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$).
  * Defined $C_s$ budget: $\ge 25\,\text{fF}$ to $30\,\text{fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\,\text{fF}$).
  * Defined bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b = 150\,\text{fF}$ to $250\,\text{fF}$ per $256/512$-cell block) and constraint ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (not exceeding $10:1$).
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Unit access transistor channel dimensions: Length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, Width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  * Shared bitline contact layout between two adjacent memory cells.
  * Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) utilizing tungsten plug (W-plug) connection.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  * Wordline and bitline tight pitch requirement: $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$.
  * Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adapting standard logic 180nm foundry DRC rules to tight-pitch 8F² (0.259 µm²) memory array design creates severe systemic boundary hazards. Logic decks enforce relaxed active area (OD/DIFF) and poly gate (PO) pitches (typically >450 nm pitch), whereas the 8F² folded bitline array requires aggressive 180 nm feature size and 180 nm line/space (360 nm pitch) with shared bitline contacts. If the array DRC deck does not properly isolate array-to-periphery transition rules using explicit marker layers (e.g., DRAM_ARRAY_MARK), false violations will blind designers to genuine design rule violations or cause over-relaxation in periphery regions, leading to severe peripheral logic timing degradation and ESD/latch-up vulnerabilities.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In 180nm 1T1C COB (Capacitor-Over-Bitline) architecture, maintaining the C_b/C_s ratio between 5:1 and 9:1 is critical for sense amplifier differential development (>150 mV). Adapting the DRC deck for tight array pitches requires tailoring specific enclosure, end-cap, and overlap rules: wordline-to-bitline contact enclosure must tolerate mask overlay shifts (<30 nm) to avoid W-plug to gate shorting. Furthermore, active diffusion rounding and storage node contact (SNC) spacing of 180 nm must be verified against optical proximity effects (OPC) within the customized deck to prevent junction leakage exceeding the 1 fA/cell retention threshold at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Commercial open-source MPW shuttles and foundries (e.g., SkyWater 130nm or regional 180nm foundries) strictly reject non-standard DRC decks unless accompanied by dedicated qualification test vehicles and foundry waiver agreements. Implementing tight array spacing beyond nominal foundry logic baseline rules risks mask tape-out rejection by mask shop automated QA, as well as photolithography yield fallout if reticle inspection tools cannot resolve sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) on custom tight-pitch layers without proprietary PDK enhancements.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From an operational schedule standpoint, maintaining two divergent DRC rule sets (standard foundry periphery vs. customized dense array) requires rigid version control and multi-engine regression compatibility (KLayout DRC vs. Calibre nmDRC). Failure to freeze boundary layer definitions early risks a 4-to-6 week tape-out delay due to recurring false-positive triage across millions of unit cells in full-chip layout signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline contact (BLC) to wordline (WL) dielectric punchthrough and shorting caused by insufficient corner-to-corner enclosure and lithographic line-end pullback during 180nm pitch patterning.
1. Storage node contact (SNC) bridging to active diffusion edge due to uncompensated corner rounding in modified DRC spacing checks, resulting in elevated junction leakage (>10 fA/cell) and catastrophic retention failure (<1 ms).
1. Peripheral CMOS latch-up or gate-oxide breakdown caused by leakage of relaxed array DRC deck rules into high-voltage wordline booster driver circuitry outside the array marker boundary.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-01` | **Automated DRC Deck Pitch & Contact Enclosure Boundary Verification** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) / Siemens Calibre nmDRC automated batch regression suite with OASIS/GDSII geometry parser | 1. Execute customized DRC deck across the test array layout containing intentional boundary defects: OD space = 175 nm (-5 nm violation), Poly pitch = 355 nm (-5 nm violation), and W-plug BLC enclosure = 25 nm. 2. Verify DRC deck flags all injected defects within the DRAM_ARRAY_MARK region. 3. Execute regression on nominal 180nm array design (OD space = 180 nm, Poly space = 180 nm, BLC enclosure = 35 nm, SNC space = 180 nm). 4. Record error count, false positive markers, and run runtime log across 1M cells. | `Zero false positive errors in nominal array; exactly 100% of injected dimensional violations detected with location accuracy <= 1 nm; execution finishes in < 300 seconds for 1M cell block.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-02` | **Corner Rounding & Overlay Tolerance Extraction under Optical Proximity Emulation** | KLayout Morphological/Boolean Verification Script integrated with LithoSim/FastCap 3D parasitic extraction engine | 1. Run morphological sizing and inner-corner chamfering (45-degree corner rounding of 25 nm radius) on diffusion and gate layers to simulate post-etch physical silicon profile. 2. Apply customized DRC spacing rules to post-OPC contour representations. 3. Extract minimum physical clearance between BLC/SNC contacts and wordline edge under maximum cumulative overlay error (+30 nm X, +30 nm Y). 4. Evaluate physical spacing margin across all 4 quadrants of the unit cell. | `Minimum physical dielectric clearance between contact plug contour and adjacent wordline gate edge must remain >= 28.0 nm under worst-case 30 nm overlay misalignment; extracted net parasitic capacitance must confirm C_b <= 220 fF per 512-cell column.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (Class 100 compliant, double-gloved), UV-Blocking Safety Glasses (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Grounding Smock and Wrist Strap, Particulate Cleanroom Hood and Face Mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with solvent, flush immediately with copious cleanroom DI water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. In case of vapor inhalation, evacuate technician immediately to an outdoor fresh-air environment. In case of eye contact, rinse eyes at emergency eyewash station with low-pressure stream for 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Cadence/EDA workstation server lab must maintain clean HVAC air exchange >= 12 ACH (Air Changes per Hour); chemical handling benches for optical mask cleaning require dedicated laminar flow exhaust velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm) with dedicated VOC scrubbing duct.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent waste in dedicated, grounded, flame-proof stainless steel safety carboys labeled 'Hazardous Waste - Flammable Organic Solvents'; neutralize rinsate to pH 6.5-8.5 prior to hazardous waste disposal in compliance with EPA/local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) SiO2/BPSG layer planarized via CMP, post-megasonic DI rinse, dried under N2 marangoni dryer with surface particle count < 0.05 particles/cm² (>0.18 µm).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned contact plug photoresist developed, hard-baked at 115°C, surface clean with native moisture desorbed and zero organic hydrocarbon residue prior to dry contact reactive ion etching (RIE).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excess atmospheric air exposure leads to airborne moisture and amine chemisorption onto open dielectric, causing T-topping of photoresist patterns, contact hole footprint shrinkage below 180 nm, and catastrophic W-plug open contacts.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical signoff and validation of the foundation 180nm DRC deck adaptation specifically tailored for 8F² dense folded-bitline DRAM arrays. The rule deck cleanly isolates the tight 180 nm line/space array domain from standard CMOS periphery via marker layer booleans, accurately enforces contact overlay budgets, and eliminates false violations while guaranteeing 100% detection of critical physical dimension violations.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_foundation_array_180nm_rules.drc`
- [ ] `drc_verification_regression_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `tight_pitch_array_signoff_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum array active diffusion and poly line/space spacing rule resolution in DRC deck** | `180.0 nm` | ±0.5 nm | Automated regression execution of dram_foundation_array_180nm_rules.drc against calibrated GDSII test layout containing sub-nanometer dimension sweeps. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum allowable false-positive DRC violations over 1,048,576 nominal unit memory cells** | `0 violations` | +0 violations | Full-chip batch DRC run output log parsing and automated error classification script. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Minimum physical dielectric clearance between contact plug contour and wordline edge under worst-case 30 nm overlay shift** | `28.0 nm` | >= 28.0 nm | Parasitic 3D field solver extraction and Boolean morphological contour clearance verification. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition requires: (1) 100% clean DRC run with zero false positives on nominal 1-megabit array macro, (2) 100% capture of all injected physical boundary violations in verification suite, (3) Formal signoff document signed by Systems Engineer and Domain Expert confirming compliance with foundry manufacturing limits.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Foundation PDK DRC Rule Extraction & Memory Array Deviation Analysis
**Hierarchy Path:** `Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup > Foundation DRC Deck Adaptation for Tight-Pitch Memory Array Rules > Foundation PDK DRC Rule Extraction & Memory Array Deviation Analysis`  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Sequence

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Step 1: Ingest     │
│  Foundation Logic PDK  │
│       DRC Decks        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Parse Pitch   │
│      & Dimension       │
│       Envelopes        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: Overlay 8F2   │
│       DRAM Array       │
│       Topologies       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Step 4: Compute     │
│  Geometric Deviations  │
│    & Sizing Deltas     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Step 5: Synthesize   │
│  Memory Array Waiver   │
│    & Customized DRC    │
│         Rules          │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Ingest Standard Foundation Logic DRC Decks**:
   - Parse native foundry 180nm DRC runsets (standard logic rules for active area `DIFF`, polysilicon gate `POLY`, contact `CONT`, and metal 1 `M1`).
   - Extract baseline logic constraints: minimum gate channel length ($L_{\text{logic, min}}$), minimum active width ($W_{\text{logic, min}}$), standard contact-to-gate spacing, and standard interconnect metal pitch.

2. **Define 8F² Array Design Rules & Geometry Boundaries**:
   - Establish the target 8F² unit memory cell layout topology ($F = 180\text{ nm}$):
     - Access transistor gate channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Access transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Gate oxide thickness envelope: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxidation equivalent.
   - Configure shared bitline contact landing topology between two adjacent memory cells.

3. **Map Tight-Pitch Array Envelopes**:
   - Set dense periodic array pitch for Bitline (BL) and Wordline (WL) within the $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch window ($2F$ limit).
   - Ingest capacitor plug/drain landing area parameters designed for a stacked capacitor (Crown or Cylinder MIM/polysilicon structure contacting via tungsten plug).

4. **Perform Automated Rule Deviation & Delta Analysis**:
   - Run layout geometric comparison scripts to flag violations where array features deviate below standard logic design rules:
     - Compare standard logic metal/polysilicon pitch against array target ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
     - Check shared bitline contact enclosure and gate-to-contact spacing against standard peripheral logic DRC checks.
     - Isolate stacked capacitor tungsten contact (W-plug) landing pads from standard logic BEOL metallization checks.

5. **Generate Array-Specific DRC Deck Modification Layers**:
   - Create a dedicated array boundary marker layer (e.g., `MEM_ARRAY_PRBOUNDARY` / `DRAM_CORE_MARKER`).
   - Condition the DRC deck: inside the array marker, branch to adapted memory design rules ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $\text{pitch} = 360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$); retain standard logic spacing in the periphery and sense amplifier boundaries.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ deviation on drawn layout | Automated DRC deck geometric extraction |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0\text{ nm}$ deviation on drawn layout | Automated DRC deck geometric extraction |
| **Bitline & Wordline Array Pitch** | $360\text{ nm} \text{ to } 400\text{ nm}$ | Uniform bounded range ($[360, 400]\text{ nm}$) | Critical Dimension (CD) pitch check across array |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Profile** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ physical target equivalent | Process assumption / deck model verification |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *8F² and 6F² unit cell geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - *Contact topology*: Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells; stacked capacitor erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Array pitch*: Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - *Gate dielectric*: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Standard logic 180nm CMOS design rules enforce loose metal, contact, and poly pitches (e.g., poly pitch >= 460nm, contact-to-gate spacing >= 100nm) that render an 8F² folded bitline unit cell (0.259 µm²) physically unroutable. Relaxing standard DRC rules to accommodate dense memory array pitches requires extracting baseline foundry rules, formulating an array-specific deviation matrix, and setting up strict nested boundary tags (e.g., ARRAY_BOUNDARY marker layer) to prevent design rule relaxations from leaking into peripheral logic and sense amplifier domains.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline cell with F = 180nm, unit cell dimensions are 2F × 4F (360nm × 720nm) with active channel L = 180nm and W = 220nm. The shared bitline contact landing pad and storage node contact plugs operate at the extreme diffraction limit of KrF (248nm) lithography. Rule deviations must account for optical proximity effects (OPE), corner rounding, and line-end pullback, ensuring active-to-active isolation and gate-to-contact dielectric breakdown margins remain sufficient under maximum wordline boost voltage (VPP ~ 3.3V).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Because this work package is classified under 'Buy' for foundation PDK customization, commercial foundry IP vendors and open-source MPW aggregators often require signed waiver agreements or specialized memory-compiler PDK add-ons before accepting dense array rule violations. Failure to secure formal fab technical sign-off on memory-array DRC rule waivers introduces catastrophic tapeout rejection risks or uncommitted yield liability during pilot wafer fabrication.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The memory array DRC deviation specification must be finalized and translated into an automated DRC deck wrapper prior to completing the 1T1C bitline contact and access transistor GDS layout. Any delay or ambiguity in rule waiver boundary tagging directly blocks downstream LVS deck rule adaptation, parasitic extraction (PEX) calibration, and full array read-margin Monte Carlo sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. DRC Waiver Bleed: Array-pitch relaxed spacing rules unintentionally applied to periphery decoders and sense amplifiers due to missing or misaligned ARRAY_BOUNDARY marker layers, resulting in bridging faults outside the dense core.
1. Dielectric Breakdown and Gate Short: Contact-to-poly spacing deviation in the dense array violating minimum isolation distance (< 70nm post-etch), leading to catastrophic VPP wordline-to-bitline punchthrough or TDDB wearout during read cycling.
1. Corner Pullback Bridging: Photolithographic proximity effects causing active area (OD) corner bridging between adjacent diagonal cells, permanently shorting paired storage nodes to substrate or adjacent bitlines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-1-01` | **Automated Foundation vs. Array DRC Deck Deviation Extraction and Boundary Conformance Test** | Siemens Calibre nmDRC / KLayout DRC Engine, Python GDSII Parsing Script (gdstk/gdspy), High-Density Array Test Vehicle Layout GDS | 1. Ingest standard 180nm logic DRC deck and parse rule check statements for POLY.1 (width), POLY.2 (spacing), CONT.1 (contact size), CONT.2 (contact spacing), and CONT.4 (contact-to-gate spacing). 2. Apply the customized DRAM memory array DRC deck containing memory-specific waivers inside ARRAY_BOUNDARY. 3. Execute automated DRC comparison run on a 512x256 bitline-wordline memory core matrix embedded with perimeter sense amplifiers. 4. Extract violation report: parse DRC violations within ARRAY_BOUNDARY versus violations occurring outside ARRAY_BOUNDARY in peripheral regions. 5. Verify that all violations within the core are explicitly matched and accepted by the deviation dictionary, and zero violations exist in peripheral logic. | `Periphery DRC violation count must equal exactly 0. Memory array core violations matching designated deviation waivers must show 100% compliance with defined limits (Active pitch >= 360nm, Poly pitch >= 360nm, Poly-to-Contact spacing >= 70nm). Zero false-clean waivers outside Layer 99:0.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-1-02` | **Litho Process Window & Critical Dimension Spacing Tolerance Evaluation for Dense Contact Pads** | Calibre nmBIAS/OPC Simulator or PROLITH Lithography Simulation Engine, CD-SEM Measurement Station (Hitachi CG5000 or equivalent virtual metrology) | 1. Import array bitline contact (W-plug) and storage node contact layout geometry into the optical lithography simulation engine. 2. Apply dose variation of ±5% and focus exposure matrix (FEM) defocus variations of ±0.15 µm. 3. Compute aerial image intensity profiles and post-etch resist CD contours across 50 sample contact-to-gate edge sites. 4. Measure post-RET physical edge-to-edge spacing between bitline contact plug and access transistor poly wordline. 5. Correlate simulated minimum physical necking and bridging margins against the extracted DRC deviation lower boundary. | `Minimum post-etch contact-to-poly gate edge spacing across entire ±5% dose and ±0.15 µm defocus window must remain >= 65.0 nm with zero bridging (contact bridging probability P_bridge = 0.0 ppm across 10^6 simulated sites).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloved), UV-filtering safety spectacles (ANSI Z87.1 certified for 248nm/365nm optical inspection), ESD-safe dissipative lab coat / cleanroom bunny suit, Chemical splash apron and face shield during wet-bench qualification sampling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with TMAH: Immediately strip contaminated garments and flush affected area with copious amounts of tempered water for at least 15 minutes. TMAH acts as a neuromuscular toxin; seek urgent emergency medical attention even in the absence of visible burns. For solvent inhalation (PGMEA/IPA): Move subject to fresh air immediately, administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contamination: Rinse at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids open.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated lithography spin-coater and track local exhaust ventilation (LEV) maintaining face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous volatile organic compound (VOC) photoionization monitoring with automatic interlock alarm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate TMAH developer runoff into dedicated aqueous basic organic waste carboys; neutralize organic solvents (PGMEA/IPA) into flammable hazardous waste containment drums labeled per EPA RCRA standards. Never mix organic solvents with strong oxidizers or acidic solutions.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH Developer, 2.38%)** | `75-59-2` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `2.38% aqueous` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PGMEA Photoresist Solvent)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C12) | `99.5%` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Ultra-Pure SEMI Grade 5 | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-gate and pre-contact oxide etched, RCA-cleaned with hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon surface (water contact angle > 65°); native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Lithography resist baked, patterned, post-exposure baked (PEB at 110°C), developed, and hard-baked; surface free of scumming and airborne molecular contaminants (AMC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrows rapidly in ambient cleanroom air exceeding 0.5 nm thickness, inducing contact resistance spikes (Rc > 200 Ohm) at tight-pitch bitline contact plugs and leading to catastrophic contact lift-off or poly-gate TDDB failure.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed comprehensive 180nm foundation PDK DRC rule extraction and established a fully validated memory array DRC deviation deck. The deliverables provide a machine-enforceable rule deck wrapper that relaxes 8F² folded bitline pitches (360nm poly/active pitch, 70nm contact-to-poly clearance) specifically within qualified memory array boundary tags while preserving 100% standard foundry design rule enforcement in periphery logic.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_array_drc_deviation_spec_v2.pdf`
- [ ] `pdk_180nm_dram_array_drc_rules.drc`
- [ ] `drc_deviation_matrix_and_montecarlo_margin.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum Poly Pitch in Array Core** | `360.0` | ±0.0 nm (strict lower limit: 360.0 nm allowed in array, logic floor remains 460.0 nm) | Calibre nmDRC automated measurement rule check 'POLY_PITCH_ARRAY' executed on full 512x256 test layout |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Array Bitline Contact-to-Poly Gate Spacing** | `70.0` | +5.0 / -0.0 nm (waived down from standard logic rule of 100.0 nm) | Calibre nmDRC CONT_TO_POLY spacing extraction and CD-SEM metrology cross-validation |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Periphery DRC Deck Leakage Violation Count** | `0` | 0 (exact zero tolerance) | Full-chip automated DRC log parsing outside ARRAY_BOUNDARY marker layer |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal DRC Sign-Off achieved upon 100% clean execution of pdk_180nm_dram_array_drc_rules.drc across the 8F² array test vehicle with zero unmatched errors, verification that relaxed rules do not propagate beyond Layer 99:0, and unanimous sign-off approval recorded in dram_array_drc_deviation_spec_v2.pdf by Systems Engineer, Domain Expert, and Foundry Fab Operations.

## SOP-DRC-180-002: Tight-Pitch Array DRC Deck Rule Coding & Boundary Boolean Layer Customization

```text
             │

│                        │
│   Tight-Pitch Array    │

```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the exact coding methodology for customizing design rule checking (DRC) decks to support tight-pitch $8F^2$ memory array blocks alongside standard CMOS periphery logic on a 180nm open-source DRAM chip process.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layer Map Declaration & Array Boundary Extraction**:
   - Define dedicated marker layers in the layout environment and deck compiler: `ARRAY_BOUND` (Layer 99/0) to delineate repetitive 1T1C core cell matrices from periphery logic.
   - Synthesize Boolean operations in the DRC deck:
     ```text
     ARRAY_ZONE     = COPY ARRAY_BOUND
     PERI_ZONE      = NOT ALL_CHIP ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_DIFF     = DIFF AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_DIFF      = DIFF NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_POLY     = POLY AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_POLY      = POLY NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ARRAY_CONT     = CONT AND ARRAY_ZONE
     PERI_CONT      = CONT NOT ARRAY_ZONE
     ```

2. **Tight-Pitch Memory Array Spacing Rule Coding**:
   - Code tighter lithography-optimized pitch and spacing rules within `ARRAY_ZONE`:
     - Access Transistor channel dimension constraints: enforce gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (`ARRAY_POLY` width across `ARRAY_DIFF`) and active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ (`ARRAY_DIFF` width under gate).
     - Bitline and Wordline pitch validation: enforce minimum pitch across parallel wordline and bitline runs to $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
     - Shared Bitline contact check: verify enclosure and contact pitch of shared tungsten plug (W-plug) landing pads between adjacent 1T1C pairs within `ARRAY_ZONE`.

3. **Periphery Standard DRC Rules Isolation**:
   - Preserve default 180nm standard logic rules within `PERI_ZONE` (e.g., standard logic poly-to-poly spacing, standard active diffusion spacing, and periphery I/O contact enclosure rules) to prevent false DRC violations in the relaxed periphery circuitry.

4. **Array-to-Periphery Boundary Interface Rule Definition**:
   - Derive interface transition zone: `BOUNDARY_TRANSITION = SIZE ARRAY_ZONE BY 0.50 um AND PERI_ZONE`.
   - Implement boundary-crossing rules preventing abrupt discontinuation of wordlines, dummy poly line terminations, and gate oxide transition spacings between cell array thin gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) and thick peripheral I/O gate oxides.

5. **DRC Deck Compilation, Execution, and Verification**:
   - Compile the adapted deck using the physical verification tool engine (e.g., KLayout DRC / Magic / Calibre).
   - Execute batch verification over full-chip hierarchical GDSII/OASIS databases.
   - Inspect output error classes; verify zero false DRC flags along the `ARRAY_ZONE` boundary perimeter.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Width Check (`ARRAY_POLY` over `ARRAY_DIFF`) |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 5\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Width Check (`ARRAY_DIFF` under `ARRAY_POLY`) |
| **Bitline & Wordline Array Pitch** | $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ | Minimum $\ge 360\text{ nm}$, Maximum $\le 400\text{ nm}$ | Automated DRC Pitch/Spacing Rule Engine |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Verification** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | Nominal target at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Process Deck Variable |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  *(Citing access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline architecture with shared bitline contacts via W-plug).*
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  *(Citing bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, and $8F^2$ cell layout architecture).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Applying sub-standard logic design rules to dense 8F² DRAM core arrays forces massive chip area bloat, whereas relaxing rules globally causes severe yield collapse in peripheral CMOS logic; therefore, the physical verification deck must cleanly isolate memory core regions using strict Boolean boundary layers (e.g., DRAM_CORE_MARKER) without creating multi-layer clipping artifacts or boundary-abutment DRC false alarms at the array-to-periphery interface.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm lithography limits, folded bitline access transistors (L=180nm, W=220nm) push k1 optical proximity factors down to near-critical limits; custom deck rules must support tight 0.22µm poly pitch and staggered bitline contact spacing while enforcing transition rules across dummy cell rings, ensuring active area (OD) endcap pull-back and gate overhang rules are verified specifically inside vs outside the boundary marker.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source EDA tool compatibility (KLayout DRC / Magic) must be maintained alongside foundry sign-off decks (Calibre nmDRC / Pegasus); improper Boolean operations that rely on proprietary DRC engine primitives will stall physical tape-out handoffs and risk multi-week mask-data preparation (MDP) delays with open foundry partners.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule coding overhead and recursive Boolean layer derivations must be balanced against run-time performance; unoptimized topological AND/NOT operations across millions of repeating 8F² cells can explode memory consumption and verification turn-around time beyond scheduled nightly CI/CD regression targets.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Boundary layer false positives: Missing or misaligned DRAM_CORE_MARKER edge overlap causes thousands of spurious spacing violations at the core-periphery pitch-adapter interface.
1. Unintended rule relaxation in peripheral logic: Incorrect Boolean subtraction leaking tight DRAM array spacing tolerances into standard periphery CMOS, causing catastrophic poly-to-poly bridging in 1.8V logic circuits.
1. Array edge optical proximity failure: Failure of the DRC deck to enforce dummy row/column enclosure counts at array borders, leading to necking or pinch-off of edge cell bitline contacts under foundry OPC.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Compile custom DRC deck with derived layers: CORE_POLY = POLY AND DRAM_CORE; PERI_POLY = POLY NOT DRAM_CORE. 2. Execute full-chip flat DRC run over test layout. 3. Query violation report for rule CORE_POLY_SPACE (< 0.22 um) and PERI_POLY_SPACE (< 0.28 um). 4. Inject intentional 0.20 um spacing violation in PERI_POLY and verify detection. 5. Inject intentional 0.20 um spacing in CORE_POLY and verify proper core rule flagging. | `Zero false-positive spacing violations on valid 8F² array layout; exactly 100% detection rate for injected 0.20 um poly spacing errors in periphery; execution memory peak <= 4.0 GB and execution time <= 120 seconds.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-2-02` | **Staggered Bitline Contact & Node Contact Pitch Rule Orthogonal Checking** | Automated DRC Error Geometry Parser & Optical Metrology Rule Checker | 1. Run rule deck checks: CT_INSIDE_CORE_SPACE (diagonal >= 0.24 um, orthogonal >= 0.22 um) and CT_ENCLOSURE_BY_AA (>= 0.04 um endcap). 2. Verify dummy cell boundary transition zone ensures CT-to-dummy gate spacing meets optical line-end enclosure specs. 3. Parse output error database (.lyrdb / .rdb). | `Total DRC error count = 0 on golden array layout; diagonal contact spacing correctly measured via Euclidean distance rather than bounding box; boundary transition rule flags any layout lacking >= 2 dummy contact terminations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD-safe lab coat, Anti-glare UV/blue-light blocking safety glasses, Ergonomic wrist support
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with screen cleaning solvent: Flush eyes with potable water for 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move to fresh air in case of dizziness from cleaning aerosols. Repetitive strain injury: Implement 20-20-20 visual break protocol.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / CAD server room HVAC with positive pressure and HEPA filtration (minimum 8-10 air changes per hour).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free cleanroom wipes in designated sealed, flammables-rated hazardous solid waste bins.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| **Isopropyl Alcohol (Electronics/Display Cleaning Grade)** | `67-63-0` | USP/Electronic Grade | `70%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `1440 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `168 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Version-controlled OASIS/GDSII database checked out with verified cryptographic checksum (SHA-256) and syntax-clean hierarchy.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Signed-off DRC error database (.rdb / .lyrdb) with zero unfixed design rule errors and 100% boundary marker closure.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Production-ready open-source DRC rule deck written for KLayout and standard EDA platforms implementing tight-pitch 8F² DRAM cell array design rules, robust Boolean boundary isolation layers, dummy transition cell rules, and boundary overhang sanity checks.

| `ASSERT-03` | **DRC execution run-time scaling for 1Mb memory block** | `90` | <= 30 s | Automated CI benchmark execution timer on 16-core CAD server |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: DRC Deck Regression Validation & Pitch-Violation Metrology on $8F^2$ Matrix Layout
**Context Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) $\rightarrow$ 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) $\rightarrow$ DRC Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization $\rightarrow$ DRC Deck Regression Validation & Pitch-Violation Metrology on $8F^2$ Matrix Layout  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the formal regression validation procedure for customized physical verification (DRC) rule decks adapted to dense $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM array regions. The goal is to verify pitch-violation metrology algorithms, eliminate false-positive flags across sub-micron array topologies, and detect layout pitch regressions across wordline (WL), bitline (BL), and shared contact geometries.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Input Layout & Dense Array Boundary Definition       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Pitch Metrology Layer Boolean Derivations           |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Run DRC Deck Regression on 8F^2 Calibration Matrix  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Spacing Violation & Metrology Extraction Analysis    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Step 1: Input Layout & Dense Array Boundary Definition**
   - Import the calibrated $8F^2$ cell array GDSII/OASIS layout containing access transistors, bitline contact nodes, and wordlines.
   - Tag the dense memory core using the dedicated `DRAM_ARRAY_BOUND` boundary layer to instruct the DRC engine to selectively engage relaxed/adapted tight-pitch design rules rather than standard logic design rules.

2. **Step 2: Pitch Metrology Layer Boolean Derivations**
   - In the DRC deck script (e.g., KLayout `drc` or Calibre SVRF), define derived boolean layers for the access transistor active area and wordlines/bitlines.
   - Set up two-dimensional pitch-check operations across orthogonal directions:
     - Wordline pitch: Measure center-to-center distance along the bitline track.
     - Bitline pitch: Measure center-to-center distance along the wordline track.
     - Contact enclosure/spacing: Verify shared bitline contact (connecting adjacent cells) spacing to surrounding active boundaries.

3. **Step 3: Run DRC Deck Regression on $8F^2$ Calibration Matrix**
   - Execute the DRC regression suite against a synthetic defect-injection matrix containing intentional pitch offsets ($-20\text{ nm}$, nominal, $+20\text{ nm}$) and nominal design cells.
   - Confirm that standard dense features clear cleanly without reporting false positives on nominal cells, while injected violations trigger precise DRC metrology coordinate markers.

4. **Step 4: Spacing Violation & Metrology Extraction Analysis**
   - Parse the DRC results database (RDB).
   - Verify that the reported physical dimensions match target critical dimensions:
     - Access transistor channel length: $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
     - Access transistor channel width: $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Array pitch metrics across wordline/bitline tracks: within $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure clean execution with zero false-positive error flags on nominal $8F^2$ unit cells.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metrology Item | Physical Target / Nominal Metric | Allowable Tolerance / Criteria | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | Deck flag triggered if pitch $< 360$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | Deck flag triggered if length $< 180$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | Deck flag triggered if width $< 220$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Synthetic Defect Detection Rate** | $100$ | $0$ escape violations, $0$ false-positive flags | $\%$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Confirms unit cell geometry for 180nm access transistor: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Confirms shared bitline contact topology between two adjacent memory cells.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Establishes bitline and wordline pitch specifications of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ for $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ 1T1C memory arrays.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adapting standard CMOS 180nm foundry design rules to an 8F² dense memory matrix (cell area 0.259 µm² at F=180 nm) pushes lithographic and etch margins to their physical limits. The DRC deck customization must strictly decouple dense array pitch relaxation rules from standard peripheral CMOS rules without introducing edge-of-array parasitic crosstalk, false clean reports, or boundary continuity breaks that compromise bitline capacitance budgets (Cb nominal 150-250 fF) and sensing margins.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Folded bitline 8F² layouts utilize alternating active area tracks and interleaved polysilicon wordlines where 2F contact pitches (360 nm) and 180 nm spacing are mandatory. Standard open-source DRC decks (e.g. KLayout/Magic for SkyWater 180) natively flag 180 nm contact-to-gate spacing as violations. Deck regression must define rigorous geometric conditional exemptions for nested array layers, while metrology decks must compute 2D pitch variation and corner-rounding pull-back to ensure access transistor on/off ratio (Ion/Ioff > 10^7) and threshold stability (Vthn = 0.55 V ± 50 mV) are not degraded by optical proximity effects.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle inspection and 248nm KrF DUV photolithography mask fabrication costs escalate exponentially if non-standard sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) or unverified optical proximity correction (OPC) layers are introduced into the customized DRC deck without foundry-line alignment. Tape-out yield for Vietnamese semiconductor prototyping depends on using established open-source tooling (KLayout DRC/Python metrology) compatible with multi-project wafer (MPW) qualification runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Regression runtime and false-positive triage present major schedule risks. The 8F² cell array regression suite must execute deterministically across a 1024x1024 array block matrix in under 15 minutes per deck build. False DRC errors on array-to-periphery stitch boundaries will stall sign-off milestones and delay subsequent extraction (PEX) and tape-out schedules.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lithographic bridging or electrical shorts between adjacent bitline contacts (BLC) and passing wordlines due to permissive DRC array waiver rules.
1. Mask data preparation (MDP) rejection caused by grid snap errors or acute angle snapping (<90°) during automated pitch relaxation in tight-pitch memory matrix cells.
1. Extreme capacitive coupling (Cb/Cs exceeding 10:1) caused by unconstrained active area end-cap or metal bitline pitch variations escaping customized DRC validation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-3-01` | **Automated DRC Deck Array-Pitch & Spacing Regression Execution** | KLayout Batch Engine v0.28+ with customized Ruby/Python DRC Deck Runner and GDSII Hierarchy Stream Parser | 1. Ingest target GDSII layout into KLayout batch runner with target DRC deck. 2. Execute full hierarchy deck checking wordline pitch (minimum 360 nm), bitline pitch (minimum 360 nm), active-to-gate spacing (180 nm), and storage node contact enclosure. 3. Parse generated XML/RDB error marker database. 4. Filter markers between core array and boundary boundary transition zones. 5. Log total execution wall-clock time and error counts. | `Zero fatal DRC errors inside the 8F² core array; 100% detection rate of intentionally seeded test pitch violations (320 nm wordline pitch defect detected); total execution runtime < 600 seconds on a standard 8-core host.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-1-3-02` | **2D Pitch-Violation Metrology and Corner-Rounding Gauge Verification** | Python GDS-Metrology Engine utilizing GDSPY / KLayout Python API with automated 2D critical dimension (CD) edge-measurement calipers | 1. Load simulated contour geometry for poly wordline, active area diffusion, and contact layers into metrology script. 2. Place 1000 automated linear gauge cutlines across critical dense array coordinates (transistor gate lengths, contact-to-poly clearances, bitline pitch). 3. Extract CD distributions and calculate 3-sigma CD variations. 4. Measure corner pullback distance at storage node landing pads. | `Active transistor physical gate length L_g = 180 nm ± 9 nm (3-sigma <= 5%); wordline pitch = 360 nm ± 18 nm; contact-to-wordline edge spacing >= 135 nm post-pullback; zero detected short-circuit necking violations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe anti-static lab coat, ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Nitrile cleanroom gloves (powder-free) for handling media/workstations
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with cleaning IPA, flush immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, move individual to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard clean computing server environment / CAD room with HVAC positive pressure air exchange (minimum 15 air changes per hour) and particulate filtration (MERV 14 minimum).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked cleanroom wipes in dedicated sealed, flame-resistant flammable waste bins; transfer to licensed hazardous waste disposal contractor per environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation and media surface sanitization** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Digital GDSII/OASIS design database verified error-free from schematic-driven layout (SDL) generators with zero unplaced cell instances.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: DRC-clean, metrology-certified GDSII database certified ready for Parasitic Extraction (PEX) and Foundry Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) tape-out flow.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout sign-off Q-time stalls tape-out shuttle slots, causing MPW mask freeze cancellation and requiring complete baseline deck re-validation against updated foundry PDK releases.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Successful regression sign-off of the customized 180nm tight-pitch DRAM DRC deck against the 8F² matrix array layout, establishing automated zero-error compliance on 360 nm pitch targets, verified 2D CD metrology bounds, and zero unhandled boundary violations across 1Mbit array test vehicles.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `drc_regression_report_8f2_matrix.pdf`
- [ ] `pitch_metrology_caliper_measurements.csv`
- [ ] `klayout_verified_drc_markers.rdb`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Clean DRC sign-off on 8F² dense memory core array with customized tight-pitch ruleset** | `0` | 0 (exact zero violations allowed) | Automated KLayout batch regression execution against core array GDSII |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wordline and bitline nominal layout pitch across 8F² array** | `360 nm` | ± 0.5 nm (grid snap tolerance) | Automated polygon gauge edge-to-edge metrology script parsing GDSII coordinates |

critics.systems_engineer: Adapting standard CMOS 180nm foundry design rules to an 8F² dense memory matrix (cell area 0.259 µm² at F=180 nm) pushes lithographic and etch margins to their physical limits. The DRC deck customization must strictly decouple dense array pitch relaxation rules from standard peripheral CMOS rules without introducing edge-of-array parasitic crosstalk, false clean reports, or boundary continuity breaks that compromise bitline capacitance budgets (Cb nominal 150-250 fF) and sensing margins.
critics.domain_expert: Folded bitline 8F² layouts utilize alternating active area tracks and interleaved polysilicon wordlines where 2F contact pitches (360 nm) and 180 nm spacing are mandatory. Standard open-source DRC decks (e.g. KLayout/Magic for SkyWater 180) natively flag 180 nm contact-to-gate spacing as violations. Deck regression must define rigorous geometric conditional exemptions for nested array layers, while metrology decks must compute 2D pitch variation and corner-rounding pull-back to ensure access transistor on/off ratio (Ion/Ioff > 10^7) and threshold stability (Vthn = 0.55 V ± 50 mV) are not degraded by optical proximity effects.
critics.supply_chain: Reticle inspection and 248nm KrF DUV photolithography mask fabrication costs escalate exponentially if non-standard sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) or unverified optical proximity correction (OPC) layers are introduced into the customized DRC deck without foundry-line alignment. Tape-out yield for Vietnamese semiconductor prototyping depends on using established open-source tooling (KLayout DRC/Python metrology) compatible with multi-project wafer (MPW) qualification runs.
critics.laya_pm: Regression runtime and false-positive triage present major schedule risks. The 8F² cell array regression suite must execute deterministically across a 1024x1024 array block matrix in under 15 minutes per deck build. False DRC errors on array-to-periphery stitch boundaries will stall sign-off milestones and delay subsequent extraction (PEX) and tape-out schedules.
critical_failure_modes: Lithographic bridging or electrical shorts between adjacent bitline contacts (BLC) and passing wordlines due to permissive DRC array waiver rules.
Mask data preparation (MDP) rejection caused by grid snap errors or acute angle snapping (<90°) during automated pitch relaxation in tight-pitch memory matrix cells.
Extreme capacitive coupling (Cb/Cs exceeding 10:1) caused by unconstrained active area end-cap or metal bitline pitch variations escaping customized DRC validation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DRC-180-042: DRAM Array Spacing Rule Encoding & Shared Contact Enclosure Verification

- **Level / Hierarchy**: [Circuit Design] > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Target Cell Architecture**: 1T1C Folded Bitline ($8F^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$, Unit Cell Area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$)

---

### 1. Process & Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     DRC Rule Deck      │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Bitline Shared     │
│   Contact Enclosure    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Array Active-to-Gate  │
│   Spacing & Overlap    │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Physical Sign-Off &   │
│      LVS Netlist       │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **DRC Array Boundary & Grid Rule Encoding**:
   - Initialize the foundry/open-source DRC rule deck for the memory array block (`ARRAY_BLOCK` layer tag).
   - Encode the feature size base parameter $F = 0.180\ \mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the nominal wordline (poly gate) and bitline metal pitch rule constraint to **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$** ($2F$ pitch regime).
   - Define the cell footprint check ensuring total unit cell area does not exceed **$0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$** for folded bitline $8F^2$ geometry.

2. **Access Transistor Dimension & Active (OD) Spacing Checks**:
   - Enforce access NMOS channel length rule: $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.180\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Enforce access NMOS channel width rule: $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.220\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Encode isolation spacing (shallow trench isolation / STI between adjacent active lines) to match cell pitch constraints ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ array pitch).

3. **Bitline Shared Contact Enclosure Verification**:
   - Locate the shared bitline contact (connecting two adjacent symmetric 1T1C access transistors to the metal bitline via tungsten plug / W-plug).
   - Verify active area diffusion enclosure around the shared contact plug. Ensure contact center-to-edge alignment provides complete contact landing without boundary bridging.
   - Enforce minimum gate-to-contact spacing (poly gate to shared bitline contact landing plug) to eliminate gate-drain shorting risks during contact etch misalignments.

4. **Storage Node Contact (Capacitor Plug) Enclosure & Spacing**:
   - Validate drain/source storage node landing pads for the stacked capacitor (COB topology) tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Verify clearance between the storage node landing plug and passing wordlines.
   - Ensure the capacitor bottom plate boundary conforms to high-$k$ crown/cylinder MIM or poly boundary clearances above the bitlines.

5. **Physical Sign-Off & Array Parasitic Rule Extraction**:
   - Execute full DRC deck check on a $256 \times 256$ or $512 \times 512$ cell array block.
   - Run parasitic extraction (PEX) rule checks to verify that bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) remains strictly between **$150\text{ fF}$ and $250\text{ fF}$** per block segment, matching the storage capacitor target ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Footprint Area ($8F^2$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$) | $\le 0.259$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ | DRC Layout Geometry Check |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Dimensions ($L \times W$) | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | DRC Width/Length Assertion |
| **AC-03** | Array Wordline / Bitline Pitch | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | 2D Pitch Linearity DRC Rule |
| **AC-04** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) per Block | $150 \text{ to } 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | LVS / PEX Netlist Extraction |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

1. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Shared bitline contact between two adjacent memory cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
   - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
2. **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance limit ($C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ per 256/512 cell array block).
3. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - Array bitline and wordline pitch regime ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - 1T1C stacked capacitor integration rules.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline architecture at 180nm, relaxing shared bitline contact (BLC) enclosure by active diffusion (OD) directly degrades the array density budget, while over-tightening violates the lithographic overlay margin (3σ ≤ 25nm on ArF/KrF steppers). The layout DRC deck must explicitly segregate peripheral logic rules from dense array pitch rules; otherwise, parasitic bitline capacitance (Cb) will swell beyond the 220 fF threshold, collapsing the Cb/Cs sensing ratio past 8:1 and eroding the sense amplifier differential margin below 120 mV.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The shared bitline contact lands between two adjacent access transistors (W = 220 nm, L = 180 nm). Because of optical proximity effects (line-end pullback and corner rounding), nominal rectangular enclosures suffer severe asymmetrical clipping. If the active area enclosure over the tungsten contact plug drops below 35 nm under worst-case overlay error (Δx = ±20 nm, Δy = ±20 nm), source/drain junction punch-through to the p-well occurs during tungsten plug etch or silicidation, precipitating catastrophic junction leakage exceeding the 1.0 fA/cell refresh budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Customizing DRAM-specific DRC rules with tightened shared contact enclosures requires dedicated reticle inspection and high-resolution binary or Attenuated Phase Shift Masks (AttPSM 6% MoSi) at 248nm/193nm. Sourcing standard 180nm foundry shuttle runs often imposes rigid logic DRC decks; forcing custom array design rule exemptions requires formal fab sign-off and risk-wafer split runs, risking lead-time extension of 6-8 weeks if contact enclosure margin triggers fab waiver rejections.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Array rule encoding must be integrated cleanly into the open-source KLayout/Magic DRC decks without regression on standard cell DRC libraries. A failure to freeze the shared contact enclosure rule definition and verify it across Monte Carlo layout corner variations within Sprint 4 will delay the bitline metallization tape-out schedule and block layout sign-off for the full 1Mb prototype sub-array.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact unlanded on active diffusion (OD) due to cumulative lithographic overlay error (Δx, Δy) and line-end pullback, leading to deep substrate trenching, Ti/TiN barrier penetration, and unrecoverable p-well leakage shorts (>10 nA).
1. Insufficient poly-gate to contact-plug dielectric spacer enclosure causing catastrophic gate-to-bitline electrical bridge shorts during pre-metal dielectric (PMD) contact plug etch.
1. Excessive contact enclosure expansion causing contact-to-storage-node plug encroachment and parasitic capacitive coupling spikes (Cb elevation > 250 fF), triggering read-cycle sensing failure.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-01` | **Automated DRC Deck Execution and Shared Contact Enclosure Verification Across Corner Offsets** | KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) in batch CLI mode with 64-bit precision, GDSII layout stream, Calibre DRC equivalence engine | 1. Compile and mount the automated DRC runset specifying Rule BL.C.1 (minimum contact enclosure by OD >= 45 nm on all non-sharing edges, >= 35 nm on sharing edges). 2. Inject systematic corner misalignments into the GDSII test matrix with intentional overlay shifts of Δx = ±10 nm, ±20 nm, ±30 nm and Δy = ±10 nm, ±20 nm, ±30 nm. 3. Execute batch DRC evaluation across the 4x4 DRAM array matrix. 4. Extract polygon violation counts, exact residual edge-to-edge enclosure distances, and false-positive flag markers. | `Zero false violations reported on nominal 8F² cells. Enclosure measurement strictly reports nominal OD-over-contact enclosure = 50.0 nm (tolerance: ±0.0 nm digital layout). Violation flag must trigger deterministically when enclosure is manually forced to < 35.0 nm under overlay stress.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-02` | **Physical SEM Overlay and Cross-Sectional Contact Enclosure Profile Verification** | Hitachi S-9380 CD-SEM and FEI Helios NanoLab Focused Ion Beam DualBeam SEM (FIB-SEM) | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM and measure top-down contact diameter and relative displacement vector between Active (OD) boundary and Contact boundary across 50 measured array sites. 2. Prepare high-precision cross-sectional FIB cuts through the center of 5 adjacent shared bitline contacts along both the bitline axis (X) and wordline axis (Y). 3. Measure physical boundary enclosure of diffusion active area over tungsten plug base via high-resolution TEM/SEM imaging. 4. Correlate measured physical enclosure against extracted DRC model limits. | `Physical OD enclosure over tungsten contact plug base must be ≥ 30.0 nm across all 50 sample sites with 3σ overlay variation ≤ 18 nm. Contact diameter must measure 180 nm ± 12 nm with no visual signs of junction breach or unlanded oxide trenching.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A/B chemical resistant apron and neoprene/Viton dual-layer gloves, Full face shield with chemical splash goggles (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Acid-resistant composite safety boots, Continuous personal toxic gas monitor (calibrated for HF/fluorine/acid vapors)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5% USP) must be immediately accessible within 10 seconds of wet bench. For skin exposure: wash immediately with copious water for 2 minutes, apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel repeatedly into the affected area, and seek immediate emergency medical care. For ocular exposure: flush eyes at eyewash station for minimum 15 minutes with sterile saline or isotonic eyewash, hold eyelids open, and transfer to emergency ophthalmology.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench must maintain laminar downdraft exhaust with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) across all sash openings. Direct ducting to specialized acid fume scrubbers equipped with continuous pH neutralization monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All fluoride-bearing acid effluents must be segregated into dedicated PVDF/PP fluoride waste drains. Automatic neutralization via calcium chloride (CaCl2) or hydrated lime dosing to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2), adjusting final effluent to pH 6.5 - 8.5 before plant discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Buffered Oxide Etch 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI / Semiconductor Grade | `6.8% HF, 34.6% NH4F aqueous solution` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha clean component)** | `7664-93-9` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `96.0% H2SO4` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha clean component)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `30.0% H2O2` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-reactive-ion etch (RIE) contact hole patterned through BPSG/TEOS ILD dielectric, clean post-solvent residue strip with native chemical oxide < 1.0 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dip-etched native-oxide-free silicon surface (HF-last) terminated with hydrogen passivation, ready for immediate Ti/TiN atomic layer deposition (ALD) / PVD liner deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (SiO2) re-growth exceeding 1.2 nm in atmospheric ambient causes severe series contact resistance spike (Rc > 1.5 kΩ/contact), inducing bitline read-signal attenuation, sensing delay faults, and contact-interface peeling.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal delivery of the fully validated 180nm DRAM Array DRC rule deck file, verifying custom array spacing rules and robust active enclosure of the shared bitline contact (≥ 35 nm minimum allowable physical margin). Validated via 100% clean DRC run across unit cells, test arrays, and corner stress suites.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_array_rules_180nm_v1.0.drc`
- [ ] `shared_contact_enclosure_report.csv`
- [ ] `fib_cross_section_contact_overlay.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Minimum OD enclosure of shared bitline contact in core array under nominal design layout** | `50.0 nm` | ±0.5 nm | Automated KLayout DRC polygon boolean enclosure rule check (Rule ID: DRAM_ENC_BLC_OD) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Physical shared contact cross-sectional enclosure post-CMP on fabricated test wafer** | `35.0 nm` | ≥ 30.0 nm lower control limit | Cross-sectional FIB-SEM metrology calibrated against calibrated NIST magnification standard |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Contact hole to poly-wordline gate edge physical spacing clearance** | `65.0 nm` | ±5.0 nm | In-line CD-SEM top-down metrology and automated edge-to-edge DRC extraction |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC violations on the complete 1Mb DRAM array test vehicle using the custom array DRC deck, documented zero-leakage junction integrity (< 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C) across 100% of tested shared contacts on physical short-loop silicon, and formal joint sign-off by Domain Expert and Systems Engineer.
