# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): DRAM Array Design Rule Encoding for Dense Active and Poly Spacing

**Document ID:** SOP-DRC-180NM-ARY-001  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Hierarchy Level:** Circuit Design / Layout Verification (DRAM Array 8F² Cell Topology)

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the step-by-step procedure for encoding dense active area (OD/DIFF) and polysilicon gate (WORDLINE/POLY) physical design rules into an automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) runset (e.g., KLayout `drc`, Calibre SVRF, or Magic) for 180nm 8F² folded-bitline 1T1C DRAM core memory arrays. It guarantees physical manufacturability, avoids bridging/shorting at aggressive pitches, and protects shared contact enclosures.

---

## 2. Theoretical Background & Rule Hierarchy

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["180nm 8F² Unit Cell Array Boundary (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm)"] --> B["Layer Separation & Pitch Definition"]
    B --> C["Dense Poly/Wordline Spacing Encoding (Pitch: 360 - 400 nm)"]
    B --> D["Dense Active/OD Spacing & End-to-End Gap Encoding"]
    C & D --> E["Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Enclosure Checks"]
    E --> F["DRC Runset Compilation & Zero-Violation Sign-off"]
```

In an 8F² folded-bitline layout:
- Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ µm}$), active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ ($0.22\text{ µm}$).
- Array wordline pitch is tight ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), requiring customized array-specific design rules distinct from standard peripheral logic design rules.
- Bitline contacts are shared between two adjacent 1T1C memory cells.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Array Region Layer Definition & Boolean Isolation
1. Define the dedicated array boundary marker layer (e.g., `ARRAY_MK`, GDS layer 99/0) to isolate dense periodic memory cells from peripheral CMOS logic.
2. Form array-specific active and poly layers using boolean intersections:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}} = \text{DIFF} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}} = \text{POLY} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$

### Step 2: Dense Polysilicon (Wordline) Spacing & Width Rule Encoding
1. **Array Poly Width (`POLY.W.1`):** Encode nominal gate channel length constraint:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{width} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})$$
2. **Array Poly-to-Poly Spacing (`POLY.S.1`):** Encode dense wordline pitch boundary rule. For pitch range $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ at $L = 180\text{ nm}$:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{space} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})\quad [\text{yielding pitch } \ge 360\text{ nm}]$$
   Set maximum allowable unrelaxed array poly pitch to $0.40\text{ µm}$ ($400\text{ nm}$).

### Step 3: Dense Active Area (OD/DIFF) Spacing & Channel Width Encoding
1. **Array Active Width (`OD.W.1`):** Encode transistor access channel width:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{width} \ge 0.22\text{ µm}\ (220\text{ nm})$$
2. **Array Active-to-Active Spacing (`OD.S.1`):** Set parallel active-track spacing:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{space} \ge 0.18\text{ µm}\ (180\text{ nm})$$
3. **Active End-of-Line (EOL) Spacing (`OD.S.2`):** Set cut-to-cut spacing along active line ends isolating adjacent 2-cell active islands to $\ge 0.18\text{ µm}$.

### Step 4: Shared Bitline Contact (BLC) Enclosure Rule Encoding
1. Define shared bitline contact layer:
   $$\text{BLC}_{\text{array}} = \text{CONT} \cap \text{ARRAY\_MK}$$
2. Encode symmetric enclosure of shared BLC by active area on both sides along the bitline axis to prevent junction leakages and unlanded contact punchthrough:
   $$\text{OD}_{\text{array}}.\text{enclosure}(\text{BLC}_{\text{array}}) \ge 0.05\text{ µm}\ (50\text{ nm})$$
3. Verify gate-to-contact isolation clearance:
   $$\text{POLY}_{\text{array}}.\text{space}(\text{BLC}_{\text{array}}) \ge 0.07\text{ µm}\ (70\text{ nm})$$

### Step 5: Rule Deck Compilation & Verification Run
1. Format rules in standard deck syntax (e.g., KLayout DRC / Calibre format):
   ```ruby
   # KLayout DRC Snippet for 180nm Dense DRAM Array
   array_poly = poly.and(array_mk)
   array_od   = active.and(array_mk)
   array_blc  = contact.and(array_mk)

   array_poly.width(0.18, "@ Array Poly Gate Length < 180nm")
   array_poly.space(0.18, "@ Array Poly-to-Poly Spacing < 180nm (Pitch < 360nm)")
   array_od.width(0.22,   "@ Array Active Width < 220nm")
   array_od.space(0.18,   "@ Array Active-to-Active Spacing < 180nm")
   array_od.encloses(array_blc, 0.05, "@ Array Shared Bitline Contact Active Enclosure < 50nm")
   ```
2. Execute DRC deck on the full 8F² unit array macro block. Confirm 0 false positives across array boundaries.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Array Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$) | $180 \pm 0$ (Nominal: $0.18$) | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$) | Automated DRC Runset check (`POLY.W.1`) |
| **AC-02** | Array Access Transistor Active Width ($W$) | $220 \pm 0$ (Nominal: $0.22$) | $\text{nm}$ ($\mu\text{m}$) | Automated DRC Runset check (`OD.W.1`) |
| **AC-03** | Wordline Array Pitch ($P_{\text{WL}}$) | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated Pitch / Spacing DRC check (`POLY.S.1`) |
| **AC-04** | Array DRC Violation Count | $0$ | Violations / Array Tile | DRC Output Summary Log |

---

## 5. Context Sources & Citations
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Data utilized:* Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact topology between two adjacent memory cells.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Data utilized:* Wordline and bitline pitch specification of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; 8F² cell layout constraints.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Dense array design rule relaxation is prohibited because standard logic DRC decks (e.g., standard 180nm CMOS rules requiring >= 240nm active-to-active spacing and >= 220nm poly-to-poly spacing) will balloon the 8F² folded bitline cell area beyond the target 0.259 µm² (2F x 4F = 360nm x 720nm). The deck customization must explicitly carve out a DRAM_ARRAY recognition layer allowing aggressive 180nm active pitch and 180nm wordline poly spacing while strictly preserving sense amplifier pitch matching and boundary dummy cell transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm minimum active pitch (180nm line, 180nm space), optical proximity effects (OPE) and shallow trench isolation (STI) corner rounding drastically elevate inter-well leakage and gate oxide thinning at active edges. The rule deck must enforce dual-tier spacing: dense regular 1D periodic array rules (180nm poly pitch, 180nm OD space) conditioned on strict optical proximity correction (OPC) assist bars and dummy pattern insertion, versus peripheral CMOS standard rules (minimum 240nm OD spacing, 220nm poly spacing) to prevent catastrophic sub-threshold leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Customizing design rule decks for foundry fab-out on an open-source 180nm PDK (such as SkyWater 130/180 or generic regional 180nm CMOS/DRAM foundries) presents qualification bottlenecks. Deviation from standard base CMOS rules requires dedicated lithography calibration reticles (test shuttles) and foundry lithography module sign-off, which may introduce 6 to 8 weeks of reticle inspection delay if specialized sub-resolution assist features (SRAF) are improperly flagged by the mask shop.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Encoding custom array rules directly into the open-source KLayout/Magic DRC deck requires rigorous regression testing against both dense cell matrices and peripheral decoder blocks. Without strict versioning and automated CI/CD golden layout verification, rule false-positives at the array-periphery boundary will stall tape-out milestones and mask tape signoff timelines for the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 2 delivery.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-lithographic bridging or micro-bridging of adjacent poly wordlines across the 180nm space due to insufficient optical proximity correction (OPC) or uncharacterized line-end pull-back, shorting adjacent wordlines and disabling entire array pages.
1. Narrow-width STI stress and corner-parasitic conduction along the 220nm access transistor active channel edges, inducing off-state leakage exceeding the 1 fA/cell refresh budget and triggering retention failure within < 64 ms at 85°C.
1. Unenclosed or misaligned storage node contact (SN) and bitline contact (BLC) plugs to active diffusion causing junction spiking, cobalt silicide bridging to the substrate, or contact resistance spikes (> 500 ohms) that ruin read sensing margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-1-01` | **Automated DRC Rule Deck Verification for 8F² Array Active and Poly Minimum Spacing** | KLayout DRC Engine (Ruby/Python API) / Calibre nmDRC Batch Runner with automated GDSII geometry extraction and boundary edge-distance measurement | 1. Execute DRC rule deck 'dram_180nm_array.drc' against the test array GDSII in flat and hierarchical batch modes. 2. Measure all intra-array active-to-active (DIFF.SPACE.ARRAY) clearances along both parallel edges and line-ends. 3. Measure all intra-array wordline poly-to-poly (POLY.SPACE.ARRAY) parallel runs across the active island. 4. Measure boundary interface spacing between outer array dummy cells and standard peripheral logic active/poly shapes. 5. Log all DRC error markers, coordinate bounding boxes, and dimensional violation histograms into a structured report. | `Zero DRC rule violations inside the DRAM_ARRAY boundary for DIFF.SPACE.ARRAY >= 180.0 nm and POLY.SPACE.ARRAY >= 180.0 nm; 100% flag compliance on any intentional layout injection flaw < 178.0 nm.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-1-02` | **CD-SEM Physical Defect & Bridging Inspection on Dense Array Test Reticle** | Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscope (CD-SEM) calibrated at 500V landing energy, coupled with automated image analysis software | 1. Load wafer into CD-SEM chamber under high vacuum (< 1e-4 Pa). 2. Navigate to 20 pre-programmed sites across the center, mid-radius, and edge die across the dense array matrix. 3. Capture high-resolution top-down SEM micrographs at 150,000x magnification across 10 consecutive poly wordlines and 10 active fingers. 4. Extract critical dimensions for poly space (L_poly_space), active space (L_diff_space), and line-end pull-back distance. 5. Inspect for footing, micro-bridging, scumming, or line-edge roughness (LER) > 3 sigma. | `Measured poly space = 180 nm ± 9 nm (3-sigma <= 5.0%), measured active space = 180 nm ± 9 nm, with zero physical bridging, necking, or residual silicon/resist filaments detected across all 20 inspection sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A cleanroom particulate gowning with antistatic dissipative hood and boot covers, Chemical splash face shield complying with ANSI Z87.1, Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene outer gloves over nitrile examination gloves, Acid-resistant full-body fluoroelastomer apron for wet bench operations
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flood affected area with copious water for 2-3 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into the skin until pain subsides; seek emergency medical care immediately. For TMAH exposure: Flush skin/eyes with water for at least 15 minutes; monitor respiratory and cardiac function due to systemic neurotoxic threat. Safety shower and eyewash station within 10 seconds / 8 meters.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous wet chemical benches must operate under certified negative static pressure with face velocity maintained between 0.5 m/s and 0.6 m/s (100-120 fpm), venting directly to dedicated acid/alkaline wet scrubbers. Toxic gas enclosures (Cl2/HBr) require dedicated toxic gas monitoring with automated pneumatic shutdown interlocks triggered at >= 0.5 ppm Cl2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride-containing effluent into dedicated PVDF piping for calcium fluoride (CaF2) precipitation with hydrated lime (Ca(OH)2). Neutralize acidic Piranha and developer effluent via automated dual-stage pH adjustment (target pH 6.8 - 7.5) with aqueous NaOH before municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic / VLSI Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `49.0% wt aqueous` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 4) | `2.38% wt aqueous (developer)` |
| **Chlorine (gas for Poly RIE)** | `7782-50-5` | Ultra-High Purity 5N (99.999%) | `100.0% gas` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha etch component)** | `7664-93-9` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Tier 3) | `96.0% wt aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched STI trenches or gate oxide pre-clean active silicon surface, hydrophobic, hydrogen-terminated (HF-last) with native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Thermally grown gate dielectric or poly-Si gate stack deposition, hermetically capping active surface to eliminate dangling bond generation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (> 0.6 nm) and airborne molecular contamination (boron, moisture, organic siloxanes) leading to high interface trap density (Dit > 1e11 eV^-1 cm^-2), gate dielectric breakdown, and anomalous gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified and codified DRC runset (KLayout/Calibre) dedicated to DRAM 8F² array dense active and poly spacing rules (180nm pitch, 180nm spacing), validated via 100% passing automated regressions on 256x512 cell array test vehicles and physical CD-SEM cross-validation.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_array_spacing_deck.drc`
- [ ] `array_spacing_drc_regression_report.pdf`
- [ ] `cdsem_poly_diff_spacing_metrology.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-DRC-01` | **Minimum intra-array poly-to-poly clearance inside DRAM_ARRAY boundary** | `180.0 nm` | +0.0 nm / -0.0 nm (strict DRC cut-off) | Automated DRC execution on golden 256x512 8F² array test macro with zero reported violations |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-DRC-02` | **Minimum intra-array active-to-active spacing across isolation oxide** | `180.0 nm` | +0.0 nm / -0.0 nm (strict DRC cut-off) | Hierarchical boundary geometric clearance scan using KLayout automated Python engine |
| `ASSERT-DRAM-DRC-03` | **Physical post-etch wordline poly critical dimension space across wafer** | `180.0 nm` | ± 9.0 nm (3-sigma <= 5.0%) | Top-down CD-SEM metrology across 20 sample array locations per wafer |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC violations reported across the entire 8F² memory array matrix and perimeter boundary cells by dram_180nm_array_spacing_deck.drc, CD-SEM confirming zero bridging or footing across the 180nm poly/active lines, and written signoff approval from both Circuit Design and Integration Council leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Shared Bitline Contact Enclosure Rule Implementation and Deck Compilation
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Cell Architecture:** 8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB)  
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRC-180NM-BLC-001`

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Parse 180nm Design   │
│         Rules          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Define Active & Poly  │
│         Layers         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Implement Shared BL   │
│   Contact Enclosure    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Compile Magic /     │
│    KLayout DRC Deck    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Run Array DRC &     │
│    Verify Enclosure    │
│        Targets         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Geometry & Feature Sizing Overview

```text
                 180nm 8F2 Geometry Allocation (nm)     
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
```

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layer Hierarchy & Geometric Pre-conditions Setup**
   - Import the 180nm GDSII array cell layout containing active diffusion (`DIFF`/`OD`), polysilicon wordline gate (`POLY`), and shared bitline contact plug (`CONT`/`W-plug`).
   - Confirm active transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and transistor active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the wordline and bitline layout pitch constraints are defined within the range of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Shared Bitline Contact Boolean Derivation**
   - Extract the shared bitline contact landing region between adjacent pass transistors:
     $$\text{BLC\_SHARED} = \text{CONT} \cap \text{DIFF}$$
   - Derive the active boundary overhang and polysilicon gate spacing margins around `BLC_SHARED`.

3. **Rule Implementation in DRC Deck**
   - **Diffusion Enclosure Rule:** Encode the minimum diffusion boundary enclosure around `BLC_SHARED` across width and length directions to ensure reliable landing margin without punch-through or leakage.
   - **Poly Spacing Rule:** Encode the minimum clearance from `BLC_SHARED` edges to the adjacent wordline poly gate edges ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) to prevent gate dielectric breakdown and short circuits during tungsten plug (W-plug) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP).

4. **Deck Compilation & Syntax Verification**
   - Compile the rule definitions into the production DRC engine format (e.g., KLayout `drc` script or Magic tech format).
   - Validate rule compiler sanity and ensure rule flags execute without fatal syntax errors or false-positive edge interpretations.

5. **Full Array Execution and Violation Reporting**
   - Execute the compiled DRC deck across the multi-cell 8F² folded bitline array core.
   - Verify that all shared bitline contacts satisfy enclosure requirements with zero residual violations.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**DRC Verification Run and Shared Contact Alignment Metrology Sign-Off**

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP defines the engineering run for automated Design Rule Checking (DRC) verification and subsequent critical dimension / overlay metrology sign-off for the shared bitline contact in an $8F^2$ 1T1C DRAM cell array at the 180 nm node. The primary objective is to verify design rule compliance for access transistor geometries, bitline and wordline pitches, and shared contact enclosure tolerances to prevent junction shorting and ensure contact resistance stability.

---

### 2. Workflow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Layout Data Preparation & Rule Deck Compilation                           |
| - Stream in GDSII/OASIS hierarchical database for the 8F^2 1T1C array block.      |
| - Verify cell unit dimensions: Channel Length L = 180 nm, Active Width W = 220 nm.|
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: Automated Array DRC Execution                                            |
| - Run automated DRC deck across active (OD), poly wordline (WL), bitline contact  |
|   (CB/BLC), and metal bitline (BL) layers.                                        |
| - Check WL and BL wiring pitch within target range [360 nm - 400 nm].             |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Shared Bitline Contact Enclosure & Overlay Verification                   |
| - Verify shared contact enclosure by the active drain diffusion region between    |
|   the two adjacent memory access transistors.                                     |
| - Inspect edge-to-gate isolation and tungsten plug (W-plug) landing margins.       |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: In-Line Metrology Sign-Off & Defect Review                                |
| - Perform CD-SEM review of shared contact diameter and overlay error vector.      |
| - Validate sign-off criteria: 0 DRC violations and full enclosure compliance.     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Layout Ingestion & Hierarchy Initialization**:
   - Stream in the finalized 180 nm GDSII/OASIS hierarchical database for the $8F^2$ folded-bitline array block.
   - Confirm active area dimensions for the 1T1C access transistor: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

2. **DRC Engine Setup & Array Pitch Validation**:
   - Compile and initialize the tailored DRC ruleset targeting memory core array constraints.
   - Run design rule checks on dense array interconnects: verify wordline (gate) pitch and bitline wiring pitch within the critical window of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

3. **Shared Contact Enclosure & Spacing Verification**:
   - Execute specialized rule checks on the shared bitline contact (landing via tungsten plug / W-plug between the shared drains of two adjacent cells).
   - Check strict contact-to-active enclosure rules to eliminate active clipping or junction leakage paths.
   - Validate spacing between the shared bitline contact edge and the adjacent wordline polysilicon edge to prevent dielectric breakdown or micro-bridging.

4. **Metrology Correlation & Final Sign-Off**:
   - Cross-correlate optical/SEM alignment coordinates with DRC critical-marker coordinates.
   - Flag any soft-rule or hard-rule violations in the DRC error inspector; verify 0 DRC fatal errors in array core and periphery interfaces.
   - Issue metrology sign-off report for mask tape-out and optical proximity correction (OPC) handover.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Engine / In-line CD-SEM |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Engine / In-line CD-SEM |
| **Array Wordline & Bitline Pitch** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Deck Spatial Pitch Analyzer |
| **DRC Hard Violation Count (Array & Contact)** | $0$ | violations (count) | DRC Rule Engine Sign-Off Log |

---

### 4. Context References & Citations

- **Source 1: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Unit cell dimensions: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout topology: Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells using a tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Interconnect geometry: Bitline and wordline pitch specified at approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Architecture: Classic $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ 1T1C stacked capacitor memory cell configuration.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In Gen 2 8F² DRAM cell topologies, the shared bitline contact (BLC) spans active diffusion across adjacent wordlines. The critical risk during physical verification sign-off is discrepancy between GDSII/OASIS design rule deck extraction rules (DRC) and physical optical/contact aligner capabilities (e.g., Karl Suss MA6 overlay drift of up to ±5.0 µm in proximity mode or ±0.5 µm in vacuum contact). If contact enclosure by active diffusion does not budget for worst-case non-linear rotational stage runout and edge-bead induced wedge error, boundary cells will suffer catastrophic punch-through to p-well substrate.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm/Gen 2 scaling node, shared contact lithography using Shipley 1813 resist (~1.3 µm nominal thickness at 4000 RPM) exhibits optical proximity diffraction effects when resolving dense contact pitches. The DRC deck must strictly enforce asymmetric enclosure rules: active area end-of-line (EOL) enclosure of the shared contact plug must maintain a minimum safety margin > 1.2 µm under Gen 2 rules to prevent unlanded contact etching into shallow trench isolation (STI) or field oxide, which creates unrecoverable junction leakage in the 1T1C storage node.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Microposit MF-319 developer and Shipley 1813 resist have limited shelf life and sensitive supply chains in regional research fabs. Sourcing chrome-on-quartz or emulsion reticles for contact layer alignment requires qualification of mask grid placement tolerances (<0.15 µm). Using emulsion glass plates as a cost-saving measure will result in gelatin swelling and contact pitch distortion beyond the allowable ±0.5 µm budget, rendering the entire lot unserviceable.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical verification and metrology sign-off milestone directly gates the silicon dry etch lot release. The workflow must decouple CAD DRC deck validation (automated KLayout/Magic checks) from empirical overlay metrology (optical microscope vernier/split-field verification) on pilot test wafers to avoid wafer idle time exceeding downstream queue limits before post-exposure bake (PEB) or contact etch.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Unlanded shared bitline contact due to mask overlay error exceeding active diffusion enclosure margin, leading to junction short to substrate p-well.
1. Resist scumming/bridging at dense shared contact openings caused by diffraction under proximity gap exposure (>15 µm), resulting in open contacts after metal-1 deposition.
1. Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanical failure during Karl Suss MA6 alignment causing non-uniform resist contact across 100mm wafer and severe asymmetric overlay drift.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-3-01` | **Automated GDSII DRC Enclosure and Spacing Verification of Shared Bitline Contact** | KLayout DRC Engine / Custom Ruby-Python DRC Script Suite (180nm Design Deck) | 1. Execute automated hierarchical DRC deck on the active diffusion (DIFF), polysilicon wordline (POLY), and shared contact (CONT) layers. 2. Measure CONT-to-DIFF edge enclosure along the bitline parallel axis and perpendicular axis across 100% of array cells. 3. Extract minimum spacing between adjacent storage node contacts and shared bitline contacts. 4. Flag and compile all DRC violation coordinates into an automated RDB (Rule Database) file. | `Pass: Zero (0) DRC violations across the entire array; Active diffusion enclosure of shared contact >= 1.20 µm; Minimum contact-to-wordline spacing >= 1.50 µm; Fail: >= 1 violation in active cell array.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-2-3-02` | **Split-Field Optical Overlay Metrology Sign-Off for Shared Contact Reticle Alignment** | Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Split-Field Microscope (20x Objectives, CMOS 5MP Cameras) and Optical CD/Vernier Metrology Station | 1. Load wafer into Karl Suss MA6 chuck and engage Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) pneumatic bearing at 0.5 bar. 2. Locate left and right array box-in-box optical vernier alignment marks under 20x split-field microscope. 3. Manually and pneumatically align mask reticle fiducials to substrate verniers in Vacuum Contact mode. 4. Measure X-axis and Y-axis misalignment offsets across 5 field sites (Center, North, South, East, West). 5. Log overlay error vectors and calculate root-mean-square (RMS) alignment displacement. | `Pass: Absolute overlay displacement |dX| and |dY| <= 0.50 µm across all 5 die locations in vacuum contact mode (or <= 2.50 µm in proximity mode); Fail: Any site exhibiting overlay error > 0.50 µm (vacuum) or vernier asymmetry indicating angular theta error > 0.05 mrad.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles / UV-blocking face shield, Nitrile inner gloves paired with heavy-duty neoprene outer chemical gloves, Chemical-resistant polyoxymethylene/PTFE aprons, Full cleanroom bunny suit with integrated ESD booties and bonnet
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact with TMAH (MF-319): Immediate copious irrigation with clean emergency drench shower for minimum 15 minutes; TMAH is a systemic neurotoxin and dermal ganglionic blocker—seek immediate medical emergency attention even without visible skin redness. In case of 365nm UV exposure: evacuate beam path, irrigate eyes with sterile saline, consult ophthalmologist. Resist/PGMEA splash: flush affected area with soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Lithography spin-coater and automated developer wet bench require dedicated ducted laminar exhaust with face velocity of 0.45 to 0.55 m/s (100 FPM); developer drain plumbed to alkaline wastewater exhaust; yellow UV-filtered cleanroom lighting (500nm cutoff).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous alkaline developer (MF-319/TMAH) waste must be segregated into dedicated organic alkaline carboys, never mixed with acid piranha or solvent drains; neutralised via controlled pH adjustment (pH 6.5-8.5) and bio-treatment or offsite hazmat incineration. Solvents (EBR, resist remnants) collected into dedicated halogen-free organic solvent carboys.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Microposit MF-319 Developer (Tetramethylammonium hydroxide aqueous solution)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `2.2% - 2.5% in H2O` |
| **Shipley Microposit S1813 Photoresist (Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate, Diazo photoactive compound, Cresol novolak resin)** | `108-65-6` | Electronic Grade (EG) | `70% - 85% PGMEA base` |
| **1-Methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PGMEA / EBR)** | `108-65-6` | Reagent Grade >99.5% | `>= 99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dehydrated, HMDS-primed silicon wafer with dense 180nm Gen 2 8F² active/STI topography, zero organic contamination, particle count < 5 at >= 0.5 µm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Developed, pattern-resolved 1.3 µm S1813 resist stencil with open, scum-free shared bitline contact vias inspected under optical metrology ready for descum/hard bake.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture reabsorption onto unprotected resist causes boundary delamination and footing; airborne amine contamination induces resist skinning/T-topping in submicron contact vias leading to contact open circuits.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical DRC deck execution across 180nm Gen 2 8F² DRAM cell matrix verifying complete shared contact enclosure and minimum rule compliance, accompanied by empirical overlay metrology sign-off on Karl Suss MA6 aligner confirming sub-micron contact layer alignment.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `drc_shared_contact_signoff_report.rdb`
- [ ] `overlay_vernier_alignment_map.csv`
- [ ] `ma6_contact_metrology_overlay_signoff.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **DRC zero-violation clearance on shared bitline contact enclosure by active area** | `0 violations (Enclosure >= 1.20 µm)` | 0 absolute allowable violations | Automated KLayout DRC Engine hierarchical sign-off run |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Physical overlay registration error of contact layer relative to active diffusion fiducials** | `0.35 µm` | ±0.15 µm (Max limit <= 0.50 µm) | Split-field dual-objective optical microscope box-in-box vernier image analysis |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero unresolved DRC flags in active DRAM core array and peripheral decoder blocks, coupled with confirmed multi-point overlay error <= 0.50 µm across 100mm wafer field sites signed off by Lead Lithography Metrology Engineer.

The critical risk during physical verification sign-off is discrepancy between GDSII/OASIS design rule deck extraction rules (DRC) and physical optical/contact aligner capabilities (e.g., Karl Suss MA6 overlay drift of up to ±5.0 µm in proximity mode or ±0.5 µm in vacuum contact). If contact enclosure by active diffusion does not budget for worst-case non-linear rotational stage runout and edge-bead induced wedge error, boundary cells will suffer catastrophic punch-through to p-well substrate.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm/Gen 2 scaling node, shared contact lithography using Shipley 1813 resist (~1.3 µm nominal thickness at 4000 RPM) exhibits optical proximity diffraction effects when resolving dense contact pitches. The DRC deck must strictly enforce asymmetric enclosure rules: active area end-of-line (EOL) enclosure of the shared contact plug must maintain a minimum safety margin > 1.2 µm under Gen 2 rules to prevent unlanded contact etching into shallow trench isolation (STI) or field oxide, which creates unrecoverable junction leakage in the 1T1C storage node.
critics.supply_chain: Microposit MF-319 developer and Shipley 1813 resist have limited shelf life and sensitive supply chains in regional research fabs. Sourcing chrome-on-quartz or emulsion reticles for contact layer alignment requires qualification of mask grid placement tolerances (<0.15 µm). Using emulsion glass plates as a cost-saving measure will result in gelatin swelling and contact pitch distortion beyond the allowable ±0.5 µm budget, rendering the entire lot unserviceable.
critics.laya_pm: The physical verification and metrology sign-off milestone directly gates the silicon dry etch lot release. The workflow must decouple CAD DRC deck validation (automated KLayout/Magic checks) from empirical overlay metrology (optical microscope vernier/split-field verification) on pilot test wafers to avoid wafer idle time exceeding downstream queue limits before post-exposure bake (PEB) or contact etch.
critical_failure_modes: Unlanded shared bitline contact due to mask overlay error exceeding active diffusion enclosure margin, leading to junction short to substrate p-well.
Resist scumming/bridging at dense shared contact openings caused by diffraction under proximity gap exposure (>15 µm), resulting in open contacts after metal-1 deposition.
Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) mechanical failure during Karl Suss MA6 alignment causing non-uniform resist contact across 100mm wafer and severe asymmetric overlay drift.

testcases.title: Automated GDSII DRC Enclosure and Spacing Verification of Shared Bitline Contact
testcases.instrumentation: KLayout DRC Engine / Custom Ruby-Python DRC Script Suite (180nm Design Deck)
testcases.pre_conditions: Target layout GDSII/OASIS file generated for 8F² DRAM core array and peripheral ring; DRC runset ruledeck version v2.1-gen2 loaded; grid snap set to 0.005 µm.
testcases.procedure: 1. Execute automated hierarchical DRC deck on the active diffusion (DIFF), polysilicon wordline (POLY), and shared contact (CONT) layers. 2. Measure CONT-to-DIFF edge enclosure along the bitline parallel axis and perpendicular axis across 100% of array cells. 3. Extract minimum spacing between adjacent storage node contacts and shared bitline contacts. 4. Flag and compile all DRC violation coordinates into an automated RDB (Rule Database) file.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass: Zero (0) DRC violations across the entire array; Active diffusion enclosure of shared contact >= 1.20 µm; Minimum contact-to-wordline spacing >= 1.50 µm; Fail: >= 1 violation in active cell array.

testcases.title: Split-Field Optical Overlay Metrology Sign-Off for Shared Contact Reticle Alignment
testcases.instrumentation: Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Split-Field Microscope (20x Objectives, CMOS 5MP Cameras) and Optical CD/Vernier Metrology Station
testcases.pre_conditions: Test wafer patterned with Layer 1 (Zero/Active marks); Shipley 1813 resist coated at 4000 RPM (1.3 µm), soft-baked at 115°C for 60 s; WEC calibrated with chuck gap < 1.0 µm; Contact mask mounted.
testcases.procedure: 1. Load wafer into Karl Suss MA6 chuck and engage Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) pneumatic bearing at 0.5 bar. 2. Locate left and right array box-in-box optical vernier alignment marks under 20x split-field microscope. 3. Manually and pneumatically align mask reticle fiducials to substrate verniers in Vacuum Contact mode. 4. Measure X-axis and Y-axis misalignment offsets across 5 field sites (Center, North, South, East, West). 5. Log overlay error vectors and calculate root-mean-square (RMS) alignment displacement.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Pass: Absolute overlay displacement |dX| and |dY| <= 0.50 µm across all 5 die locations in vacuum contact mode (or <= 2.50 µm in proximity mode); Fail: Any site exhibiting overlay error > 0.50 µm (vacuum) or vernier asymmetry indicating angular theta error > 0.05 mrad.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Automated DRC Regression Suite Execution & Array Margin Metrology Sign-Off
**Hierarchy / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Design Rule Checking (DRC) Verification & Spacing Rule Optimization > DRC Deck Customization & DRAM Array Spacing Rule Setup > Automated DRC Regression Suite Execution & Array Margin Metrology Sign-Off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m / 180 nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Environment Setup & Runset Pre-Check**:
   - Initialize automated regression verification environment targeting the 180 nm open-source DRAM PDK.
   - Load customized hierarchical DRC rules for folded bitline $8F^2$ array blocks (differentiating dense memory array rules from peripheral logic rules).
   - Ensure cell layout dimensions conform to access NMOS channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with shared bitline contacts between adjacent memory cells.

2. **Automated Hierarchical DRC Regression Execution**:
   - Execute batch-mode DRC regression script across the full DRAM array block ($256$ to $512$ cells per bitline).
   - Run spacing rule checks on dense array patterns: active area pitch, wordline (gate poly) pitch, bitline spacing, and tungsten plug (W-plug) contact clearance.
   - Verify layout dimensions for Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) stacked capacitor / crown MIM structures and via contacts.

3. **Array Margin Metrology Extraction & Sign-Off**:
   - Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) and verify that it remains within the allowable budget across the 256–512 cells/BL segment ($150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$).
   - Extract storage node nominal capacitance ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$, nominal target $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Compute bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio ($C_b / C_s$) to ensure read sensing margin is maintained. Check that $C_b / C_s$ is strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (never exceeding $10:1$).
   - Confirm differential voltage read margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ yields an operational read window of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **DRC Error Logging & Sign-Off Reporting**:
   - Collate clean DRC run logs (`0 clean errors` across array and boundary transition regions).
   - Sign off the automated regression report and commit metrology records to the physical design database.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Sign-Off Target Value | Tolerance / Criteria | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Layout Footprint ($8F^2$)** | $0.259$ | Exactly $0.259$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$ | $\mu\text{m}^2$ |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($L / W$)** | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | Target nominal (Zero DRC violations) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28$ | Minimum $\ge 25$ to $30$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$)** | $150 \text{ -- } 250$ | Valid for 256 to 512 cells/BL block | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5.0 \text{ -- } 9.0$ | Strict upper bound $< 10.0$ | Ratio (dimensionless) |
| **Differential Voltage Read Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ -- } 150$ | Minimum $\ge 100$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 3. Literature Sources & Context Citations

- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Footprint metrics for folded bitline: $8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Bitline parasitic capacitance: $C_b = 150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline).
  - Bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio target: $5:1$ to $9:1$ ($C_b / C_s > 10:1$ degrades read margin severely).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Signal development formula $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Differential signal read margin: $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Layout features: shared bitline contact, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Minimum storage capacitance: $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The DRC regression environment must enforce strict topological checks between the dense 8F² folded bitline array core (cell area 0.259 µm² at F=180nm) and the peripheral CMOS pitch-matched sense amplifiers. Relying on default foundry logic DRC decks without specialized DRAM rule decks risks false negatives at the array border where wordline strapping contacts and bitline equalization pass-gates transition from sub-design-rule relaxed pitches to sub-lithographic optical proximity correction (OPC) array rules. Furthermore, bitline parasitic capacitance (C_b) extraction must be bound to 150-250 fF against a minimum storage capacitance (C_s) of 25-28 fF to prevent C_b/C_s exceeding 9:1, which would degrade differential sense margin ΔV below the 100 mV threshold.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node in an 8F² folded architecture, critical lithographic marginalities occur at the active area (OD) endcaps and poly-gate wordline (GC) cut lines inside the 256/512 cells-per-bitline array. Standard foundry edge-placement error (EPE) margins are inadequate for the contact-to-gate overlay. Automated metrology must run boolean space/enclosure checks on storage node contact (SN_CT) to wordline and bitline contact (BL_CT) to active junction margins, asserting a minimum dielectric overlay enclosure of 35nm post-OPC/RET to eliminate junction leakage that collapses cell retention time (t_RET) below 64 ms at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Custom array DRC rule decks require qualification against open-source EDA engines (KLayout / Magic) while maintaining parity with foundry Golden DRC engines (Calibre nmDRC / Pegasus) utilized by local commercial wafer fabrication partners in Southeast Asia. Divergent layer Boolean definitions or deck inconsistencies could cause tapeout rejections, mask redesigns costing $35,000 to $60,000 per mask set, and a 12-to-16 week delivery schedule slip for the DRAM multi-project wafer (MPW) run.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Automated regression execution cannot bottleneck the daily design cycle. The CI/CD array DRC pipeline for a 1Mb array block must achieve full regression runtime in under 45 minutes with zero false positives. Sign-off gates must produce deterministic, machine-parsable GDSII/OASIS error markers and an automated metrology delta report before layout freeze for tapeout sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node contact to wordline poly-gate dielectric bridging caused by sub-resolution optical line-end shortening, inducing permanent wordline-to-cell DC short circuits and destructive row leakage.
1. Array border active area spacing violation causing sub-surface punch-through leakage into adjacent bitline precharge equalizers, collapsing the differential read signal ΔV below 60 mV during sensing.
1. Corner rounding and enclosure erosion at the active-to-bitline contact landing pad, resulting in open bitline connections or excessive contact resistance (>1.5 kΩ/contact) causing read latency failure.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-3-01` | **Automated Hierarchical DRC Regression on 512x512 8F² Cell Array and Peripheral Boundaries** | Automated EDA DRC Runner (KLayout/Calibre integration) linked to Open-Source DRAM Foundation CI Engine with Boolean Layer Processing Unit | 1. Ingest 512x512 cell array block containing dummy edge cells and dummy wordline structures into the DRC regression engine. 2. Execute hierarchical rule checks across Array Core, Array Edge, and Core-to-Periphery interface decks. 3. Filter and parse rule check log for minimum gate-to-contact enclosure (Rule DR-DRAM-ACT-04), metal-1 bitline pitch (Rule DR-DRAM-M1-02), and storage node landing pad space (Rule DR-DRAM-SN-01). 4. Generate automated error marker report and overlay density heatmap. | `Total DRC violations must equal exactly 0. Maximum run time for 512x512 block regression must not exceed 1800 seconds. All array core internal spacing checks must conform to target 8F² pitch (wordline pitch <= 360nm, bitline pitch <= 360nm).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-3-02` | **Array Margin Metrology Extraction and Parasitic Capacitance Sign-Off Verification** | Calibrated Layout Parasitic Extraction (LPE) engine with 2.5D field solver metrology module and Critical Dimension (CD) optical boundary predictor | 1. Extract parasitic capacitance per bitline (C_b) across 512 cells per bitline column including overlap and fringe components. 2. Measure layout edge margins from Storage Node Contact (SNC) to neighboring wordline poly edges across 10,000 sampled array nodes. 3. Calculate C_b/C_s ratio assuming nominal stacked capacitor C_s = 28.0 fF. 4. Compile statistical margin distribution for contact-to-gate overlay. | `Total bitline capacitance C_b must be >= 150.0 fF and <= 250.0 fF (nominal target 200.0 fF). Capacitance ratio C_b/C_s must remain <= 8.93:1 (strictly < 9.0:1). Minimum extracted physical contact-to-gate margin across all sampled instances must be >= 35.0 nm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe lab coat, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/anti-glare safety spectacles, Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (powder-free) for handling media/wafers during physical metrology correlation
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA wipe-down solvent: Flush eyes immediately with sterile eyewash solution or copious water for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of concentrated vapors, remove casualty to fresh air. If irritation persists, seek medical consultation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating air handling unit (AHU) with HEPA filtration maintaining ISO Class 5 air cleanliness and continuous face velocity of 0.45 m/s; local exhaust ventilation (LEV) active at metrology coupon preparation benches.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and cleaning disposables must be collected in closed, vapor-rated hazardous waste bins, labelled per EPA/RCRA standards, and transferred to chemical waste incineration contractors.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade (for display/inspection station wipe-down)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (for wafer/inspection prep)** | `7732-18-5` | Type 1 Ultra-pure | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-DRC sign-off GDSII/OASIS design database verified against foundry technology PDK layer map; for correlated CD-SEM physical test coupons, incoming surface must be dry-etched, plasma-ashed, and post-SC1 cleaned wafer surface free of native oxide regrowth (>1.2 nm).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: DRC/LVS tapeout database frozen with verified zero-flag status; for correlation wafers, vacuum-sealed in nitrogen-purged FOUP/cassette with surface carbon contamination below 5.0x10^12 atoms/cm².
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout sign-off Q-time stalls tapeout shuttle reservation window; on physical calibration coupons, airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture condensation induce metal contact pad oxidation, distorting CD-SEM metrology by >6nm and corrupting DRC optical proximity correction ground truth.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full automated sign-off of the 180nm 8F² DRAM cell array and peripheral boundary layout via customized DRC regression suites, verifying zero design rule violations, robust contact-to-gate overlay spacing, and a validated bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio (C_b/C_s < 9:1) for reliable 100-150 mV sense amplifier signal development.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM_180NM_8F2_DRC_REGRESSION_REPORT.pdf`
- [ ] `ARRAY_MARGIN_METROLOGY_EXTRACTION.csv`
- [ ] `DRC_CLEAN_ARRAY_LAYOUT_SIGNOFF.oas`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Zero design rule violations across all hierarchical array core, array dummy edge, and sense amplifier pitch-matching rules** | `0 violations` | 0 (exact) | Automated DRC engine log verification with strict return code 0 validation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total bitline parasitic capacitance per 512-cell column maintaining folded bitline read margin** | `200.0 fF` | +/- 50.0 fF (150.0 fF to 250.0 fF) | 2.5D Field Solver Layout Parasitic Extraction (LPE) across extracted OASIS netlist |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Minimum physical dielectric spacing between Storage Node Contact (SN_CT) and Wordline Gate Conductor (GC)** | `45.0 nm` | -10.0 nm (minimum bound 35.0 nm) | Geometric point-to-point spatial metrology extraction on final GDSII post-retargeting |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unambiguous design sign-off requires: (1) 100% pass on all DRC regression rules with zero waivers on array core layers, (2) LPE extraction confirming C_b/C_s <= 8.93:1 ensuring >= 100 mV sense amplifier read differential, and (3) formal joint sign-off signature by the Lead Circuit Designer and Foundry Integration Engineer on DRAM_180NM_8F2_DRC_REGRESSION_REPORT.pdf.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: DRC Regression Testbench Harness Setup & Array Deck Integration
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & Layout Verification (DRAM Foundation VN)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     DRC Rule Deck     │
│       Ingestion       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Array Testbench    │
│    Harness Config     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Regression Suite    │
│       Execution       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Metrology & Spacing  │
│       Sign-Off        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **DRC Deck Initialization & Rule Parametrization**
   - Ingest baseline 180nm foundry design rules into the automated test harness.
   - Configure custom array spacing decks targeting the $8F^2$ folded bitline layout, explicitly binding access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Constrain bitline (BL) and wordline (WL) minimum pitch rules to the range $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.

2. **Array Testbench Harness Construction & Integration**
   - Instantiate the multi-cell memory matrix testbench with shared tungsten-plug (W-plug) bitline contacts placed between adjacent memory cells.
   - Integrate stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) geometries (crown/cylinder architecture) connected to access transistor drains.
   - Map complementary folded bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) connected to the cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier latch with precharge balance networks.

3. **Automated Regression Suite Execution**
   - Execute the headless DRC verification engine across parametric testbench corners (nominal, dense array boundaries, contact misalignments).
   - Evaluate boundary spacing, enclosure margins, and overlay rules between W-plug vias, storage nodes, and bitline metallization.

4. **Metrology Extraction & Sign-Off Reporting**
   - Parse error reports to verify zero false positives on customized dense array rules.
   - Confirm layout extraction parameters maintain physical gate oxide thickness targets of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation) and stacked capacitor equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$.

---

### 3. Dimensional Reference Summary

```text
                        180nm Cell Dimension Specs      
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■               │
  Transistor W (nm)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■               │
                   │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
     Channel L (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
   WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Dielectric EOT (nm)┤▓                                  │
                   │▓                                  │
    Gate Oxide (nm)┤█                                  │
                   │█                                  │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       100     200      300    400 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Citation Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180 \pm 0.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220 \pm 0.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch Spacing** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | $\sim 3.5$ (dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, shared bitline contact, stacked COB topology with tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Pitch limits for wordline/bitline of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$, thermal gate oxide physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, dielectric EOT $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Folded bitline $BL$ and $/BL$ routing with cross-coupled latch and equalization configuration.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The DRC regression testbench harness must decouple baseline CMOS foundry design rules from dense 8F² DRAM array-specific rules (COB stacked capacitor crowns, shared bitline contact pitches, and wordline-to-storage-node spacings) to avoid global rule corruption. Array deck integration must support hierarchical boundary checks, ensuring optical proximity correction (OPC) guardbands and halo dummy cell enclosures are properly handled without generating false positive edge violations at array-periphery interfaces.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm 8F² layout topologies with an access transistor L = 180 nm and W = 220 nm, standard design rule decks fail to enforce relaxed end-of-line enclosure and 28 fF MIM crown landing margins simultaneously. The custom array DRC deck must implement boolean derivation layers for bitline contact-to-storage node plugs (W-plugs) to catch sub-10nm lateral misalignment and verify ONO/Ta2O5 dielectric trench keep-out zones without bloating execution runtime on multi-megabit matrices.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Automated regression suites must target open-source EDA compatibility (e.g., KLayout pyclipper/DRC, Magic, OpenLane) while retaining exact rule translation parity with commercial foundry sign-off tools (Calibre, Pegasus). Any syntax divergence between the open-source array deck and commercial tape-out verification can trigger unrecoverable mask shop re-tooling delays and wafer-start aborts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Regression runtime scaling is the primary bottleneck. Running full-chip flat DRC across a full 1Mb/16Mb array instance during automated CI/CD runs will exceed test runner time-limits; the harness must implement array unit-cell, 3x3 kernel, and boundary-tile regression slicing to maintain CI iteration cycles under 15 minutes while reserving full-chip regression for weekly sign-off milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. False negative pitch violation sign-off on shared bitline contacts, causing lithographic bridging during 248nm DUV exposure and catastrophic bitline-to-substrate leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
1. Improper hierarchical array boundary extraction resulting in clipping of peripheral sense amplifier dummy poly gate enclosures and localized V_th shift.
1. DRC rule deck syntax mismatch between open-source engine (KLayout Python/Ruby DRC) and sign-off engine causing unflagged tungsten plug (W-plug) to storage node enclosure erosion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-3-1-01` | **Hierarchical DRAM Array Kernel DRC Regression Execution & Rule Accuracy** | Automated CI/CD Test Harness running KLayout DRC Engine (v0.28+) in batch mode with Open PDK 180nm ruleset and custom DRAM Array Deck extension. | 1. Launch automated DRC testbench harness targeting synthetic 8F² array defect layout. 2. Execute customized DRAM array DRC deck across all 15 injected boundary, contact-to-gate, and capacitor-crown spacing violations. 3. Parse generated XML/RDB error report and extract coordinate-based violation mapping. 4. Execute deck against nominal defect-free 32x32 array block to check false-positive generation rate. 5. Log memory consumption and execution runtime. | `100% detection rate of all 15 synthetic rule violations (15/15 caught); exactly 0 false positives reported on nominal array GDSII; regression execution runtime for 32x32 array block < 45.0 seconds.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-3-1-02` | **Shared Bitline Contact & Storage Node Tungsten Plug Overlap Metrology Sign-Off** | Calibre DRC / KLayout DRC geometric metrology engine with GDS-to-CIF polygon boolean extraction scripts. | 1. Run rule verification deck for rule DRAM_BLC_ENCL (Bitline Contact diffusion enclosure). 2. Run rule verification deck for rule DRAM_SNC_SPAC (Storage node contact to wordline gate spacing). 3. Extract minimum physical spacing and enclosure margins across 10,000 continuous cell instances. 4. Measure edge-to-edge spacing distribution across array perimeter boundary cells. | `Minimum bitline contact active enclosure >= 40.0 nm; minimum storage node contact to gate space >= 55.0 nm; zero edge-cell pitch violations across array-to-periphery transition interface.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Static dissipative ESD lab coat, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free, ASTM D3578), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-glare protective eyewear for terminal workstations
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA: Wash affected area with soap and clean water for 15 minutes. In case of vapor inhalation causing dizziness: Remove personnel to fresh air immediately. In case of eye contact: Flush thoroughly with eyewash station water for at least 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / EDA computing lab positive-pressure HVAC with HEPA filtration (Class 10,000 / ISO 7); localized fume extraction rated at >= 50 FPM face velocity for any solvent swab-cleaning benches.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked lint-free cleanroom wipes in sealed, dedicated, air-tight hazardous waste containers; handle software and data artifacts per institutional electronic data lifecycle policies.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) (Workstation Cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade / VLSI | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-DRC GDSII/OASIS layout stream validated against layer-map syntax; no dangling polygon nodes or unmerged cell boundaries.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: DRC clean layout database signed off with zero DRC/antenna violations, ready for tape-out mask synthesis and optical proximity correction (OPC).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time during mask tape-out sign-off freeze risks uncoordinated upstream peripheral logic revisions, leading to array-periphery floorplan pitch mismatch and unverified lithographic misalignment.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical sign-off and verification of the automated DRC regression testbench harness integrated with the custom 180nm 8F² DRAM array rule deck. Delivers a zero-violation regression status across core cell, boundary transition, and capacitor crown layers, with verifiable open-source EDA script reproducible in automated CI pipelines.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_array_drc_deck.lydrc`
- [ ] `drc_regression_summary_report.csv`
- [ ] `array_margin_metrology_signoff.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Synthetic defect regression capture rate in 8F² DRAM array verification** | `100.0%` | 0.0% | Automated regression suite execution comparing testbench injection log against parsed KLayout DRC error RDB database. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum regression suite runtime for 32x32 DRAM array block verification** | `35.0 s` | +10.0 s | CI execution timer profiling KLayout headless batch mode on standard 4-core Linux runner. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Residual DRC violation count on tape-out candidate 1Mb DRAM array GDSII** | `0` | 0 | Full-chip Calibre/KLayout flat DRC sign-off log audit. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit condition requires 100% pass on the synthetic defect suite, zero false positives and zero residual DRC violations on the integrated DRAM array deck, formal sign-off report generated and signed by the layout lead, and automated regression harness fully integrated into the CI/CD pipeline repository.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Full-Chip & Sub-Array DRC Regression Batch Execution
**Node / Generation**: Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture / 8F² Cell Layout)  
**Action Type**: Make / Verification Execution  
**Council Classification**: Circuit Design & Physical Verification

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Setup DRC Deck &    │
│       Rule Files       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Hierarchical      │
│  Sub-Array Regression  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Full-Chip Top-Level   │
│    Integration Run     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Array Margin      │
│  Metrology & Sign-Off  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environment Setup & Rule Deck Initialization**:
   - Source the 180nm DRAM verification suite environment.
   - Configure the customized hierarchical DRC run script specifying separate switch definitions for repetitive core array regions (`DRAM_ARRAY_EN=1`) versus peripheral CMOS logic (`PERI_STD_RULES=1`).
   - Define exclusion layers for crown/cylinder capacitor formations and tungsten plug contacts to enable dedicated array rule enforcement.

2. **Sub-Array Block-Level Regression**:
   - Execute batch DRC on the isolated 8F² sub-array layout block containing the active access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contacts, and crown/cylinder capacitor contact pads.
   - Verify wordline (gate) and bitline pitch spacing ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) across edge cells, dummy cells, and sub-array boundary interfaces.
   - Check gate oxide dielectric physical target limits ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) across the transistor channel zones.

3. **Sense Amplifier & Column Periphery Regression**:
   - Run batch DRC across the folded bitline sense amplifier interface block (CMOS cross-coupled inverter latches, equalization networks, and isolation gates).
   - Ensure matching pitch transition rules between dense array BL//BL pairs and sense amplifier equalization transistors.

4. **Full-Chip Top-Level Batch Execution**:
   - Launch multi-threaded full-chip hierarchical DRC batch execution across the assembled top-level GDSII/OASIS database.
   - Verify power distribution grids, sub-wordline drivers, column decoders, peripheral IO pads, and chip seal rings.
   - Generate full-chip error database and filter for array-periphery boundary violations.

5. **Array Margin Metrology & Sign-Off**:
   - Parse execution log files and rule report decks (`.rep` / `.drc_errors`).
   - Ensure zero false positives and zero hard design rule violations across both core memory sub-arrays and periphery.
   - Archive regression reports into the sign-off tracking repository.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Check Item | Target Metric | Unit | Physical Context / Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | nm | Target channel length across 8F² access transistors |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | nm | Target channel width across active array areas |
| **Wordline / Bitline Interconnect Pitch** | `360 to 400` | nm | Dense array repeating pitch limit |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | nm | Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric layer thickness |
| **Unwaived DRC Violation Count** | `0` | errors | Clean regression sign-off across array & full chip |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - *“Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.”*
  - *“Capacitance Budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.”*
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - *“Bitline and wordline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.”*
  - *“Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.”*
  - *“Storage capacitor must maintain a minimum capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.”*
- **`Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout`**:
  - *“Architecture: CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch connected between complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ in a folded-bitline topology.”*
  - *“Precharge Operation: Prior to wordline assertion, bitlines are equalized to $V_{DD} / 2$ using an equalization transistor network.”*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Batch automated DRC regression on 180nm dense DRAM arrays frequently fails to distinguish between core peripheral logic rules and tightened periodic memory array spacing rules. Running flat DRC across a full-chip 1T1C macro without hierarchical rule scoping leads to exponential runtime explosions (>14 hours) and generates thousands of false positive space/enclosure errors across sub-array cell abutment boundaries.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F² cell architecture under 180nm rules, VPP boosted wordlines (operating at 2.5V-2.8V) require extended gate oxide and larger junction-to-n-well spacings than standard 1.8V core CMOS. The DRC deck customization must strictly assert voltage-dependent spacing rules (e.g. minimum spacing between active diffusion driven by VPP and standard logic VDD/VSS contacts) to prevent dielectric breakdown and hot-carrier induced gate-oxide punchthrough.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Failure to synchronize DRC runset rule versions with the target commercial open foundry (e.g., SkyWater or TSMC 0.18µm HV/eDRAM compatible PDK) creates multi-week tapeout delays. Mask re-spins resulting from sub-array edge dummy-cell density violations or metal-1 array bitline contact un-enclosure cost upwards of $35,000 per reticle layer.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: DRC execution must be modularized into a continuous integration automated regression pipeline. Without automated pass/fail classification and triage separating benign array boundary seal-ring DRC flags from fatal internal storage capacitor landing pad bridging, layout engineering cycles will slip past tapeout freeze deadlines.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. VPP wordline-to-substrate dielectric spacing rule under-specification causing gate oxide breakdown at 2.8V overdrive.
1. Dense bitline contact (M1-to-poly/active) enclosure failure at sub-array array boundary terminations during cell abutment.
1. Computational DRC crash or false-positive explosion caused by non-hierarchical GDSII cell instancing across 1Mbit+ sub-arrays.

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

Parse output database to extract violations categorized by layer: active area (DIFF), poly wordline (POLY), contact (CONT), and metal-1 bitline (M1). Verify that VPP overdrive routing satisfies minimum 0.40 um spacing to 1.8V VDD logic nets. | `Total DRC violations within the internal 8F² sub-array matrix must be exactly 0; VPP high-voltage spacing violations must be exactly 0; runtime must complete in < 180 seconds.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-2-1-3-2-02` | **Full-Chip Array Boundary Dummy Cell & Bitline Contact Enclosure Regression** | Calibre DRC / Open-Source KLayout DRC Metrology Engine with Python Report Parser | Trigger regression suite script `python3 run_fullchip_drc_regression.py --gds fullchip_dram_180nm.gds --deck dram_fullchip_master.drc`. Scan array-to-periphery transition boundaries for metal-1 bitline contact overlap (minimum 0.06 um enclosure) and poly wordline end-cap extensions (minimum 0.18 um). Check pattern density metrology across all layers in 50 um x 50 um sliding windows. | `Array boundary contact enclosure violations must equal 0; full-chip critical errors must equal 0; active layer pattern density must remain strictly between 35.0% and 55.0% across all window frames.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Anti-static ESD wrist strap and grounding cord (for physical metrology workstation), Standard laboratory safety glasses with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (mil thickness 4 mil)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For eye or skin contact with cleaning solvents during metrology station maintenance, flush immediately with copious amounts of clean tempered water for a minimum of 15 minutes. In case of vapor inhalation, move personnel to fresh outdoor air immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA-filtered laminar flow workstation air exchange (Class 100/ISO 5) with minimum 60 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent isopropyl alcohol wipes in dedicated flame-retardant grounded solvent waste bins; dispose via authorized hazardous chemical waste management protocols.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Grade 99.99% | `100%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and planarized poly/contact test coupon surface post-CMP, dry and residue-free.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry, defect-free inspected mask or silicon verification coupon purged under continuous dry N2 environment.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowing and atmospheric particulate contamination causing pseudo-DRC bridging defects and false un-enclosure flags during physical SEM metrology correlation.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete zero-defect automated DRC sign-off for full-chip and 8F² sub-array layouts verifying VPP isolation, bitline contact enclosure, and active area spacing against 180nm open-source design rules.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Total DRC fatal design rule violations across sub-array core and peripheral sense amplifier blocks** | `0` | +0 violations (strictly zero-defect) | Automated XML/JSON parsing of KLayout lyrdb DRC report file |
