| **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ (at $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$) | Range: $100 - 150\text{ mV}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), shared bitline contact via W-plug, crown/MIM stacked capacitor topology.
  - Dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$) with $\kappa > 15$, minimum cell capacitance target $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and cell leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, yielding $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8\text{F}^2$ 1T1C stacked cell layout, wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$), dielectric $\text{EOT}$ of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, and cell storage capacitance $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The GDS layer-to-mask mapping table and Boolean derivation deck (e.g. KLayout/Magic/Calibre LVS rules) directly define physical connectivity and parasitic extraction for the 8F² DRAM cell. In an open-source 180nm flow with Gen 2 micro-scale lithography constraints (Karl Suss MA6 contact/proximity aligner, overlay error <= 0.5 um), defining active diffusion (OD/DIFF), gate poly (PO), deep/shallow n-well (DNW/NW), and contact/via layers must account for mask polarities (clear-field vs dark-field) and Boolean operations. Any mismatch between drawn GDS stream numbers/datatypes (e.g. 65:20 for active vs 65:0) and physical mask reticle generation or LVS netlist recognition will lead to catastrophic short/open misclassifications, parasitic capacitance underestimation (target storage node capacitance ~25-35 fF), or fatal misalignment of the 1T1C bitline/storage contacts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For the 1T1C access transistor (target L=0.18 um scaled or long-channel Gen 2 layout test vehicles W/L=2.0 um/0.18 um and 10 um/1.0 um), Boolean layer derivations are non-trivial: Gate = POLY AND DIFF; Access Source/Drain = DIFF NOT POLY; Storage Node Contact Region = Access Source/Drain AND SN_MARKER; Bitline Contact Region = Access Source/Drain AND BL_MARKER. Without strict Boolean distinction of cell implant doping and deep-trench or stacked capacitor landing pads, standard CMOS logic LVS extraction decks will flag illegal multiple-port sharing or falsely extract parasitic diodes. Threshold voltage extraction (target V_thn = +0.55 V +/- 50 mV, V_thp = -0.60 V +/- 50 mV) and leakage requirements (I_off <= 10 pA/um to guarantee DRAM retention > 64 ms) require rigorous substrate tap and well-tie Boolean recognition rules.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle generation and electron-beam mask writing for 5x/1x quartz/soda-lime photomasks depend on accurate GDSII layer and datatype assignment. Open-source PDKs frequently suffer from fragmented GDS layer maps across KLayout, OpenROAD, and commercial foundries. If data prep Boolean derivations (sizing, tone inversion, optical proximity correction/OPC rules, WEC alignment marks for Karl Suss MA6) are hardcoded into design layout instead of separate export decks, mask procurement costs surge due to re-spinning corrupted chrome-on-glass plates ($2,000-$5,000 per mask layer in VN fab partnerships). Standardizing on an automated, version-controlled GDS-to-mask translation deck is essential.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule risk is concentrated on the iteration loop between circuit layout designers and LVS physical verification sign-off. If the Boolean derivation rules for the 8F² cell array are ambiguous, manual DRC/LVS waiver injection will stall the tapeout reality gate. We must enforce an automated CI regression deck that compiles GDS layer definitions, generates test pattern layouts, extracts SPICE netlists, and validates connectivity against gold schematics in under 15 minutes before any layout freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. GDS datatype collision or omitted Boolean subtraction (e.g., POLY NOT DIFF) causing LVS deck to extract floating gate terminals or false shorts between adjacent bitline pass-gates.
1. Photomask tone reversal (clear-field vs dark-field polarity inversion) on contact or active layers due to ambiguous GDS layer definition, resulting in inverted photoresist exposure on Karl Suss MA6 and total wafer yield loss.
1. Mischaracterized parasitic substrate capacitance from missing Deep N-Well (DNW) Boolean enclosure rules, severely skewing 1T1C bitline sensing margin and write-recovery simulation.

- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 1000/100 compatible nitrile gloves (12-inch cuff, accelerator-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-blocking safety glasses (yellow/amber tint for lithography bay), Static-dissipative ESD cleanroom coat and conductive shoe covers, Half-face elastomeric respirator with organic vapor/P100 particulate cartridge (during photoresist spin and developer handling)

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Title: Access Transistor & Storage Capacitor Device Extraction Rule Implementation **Module Path**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²)` > `1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²)` > `Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off` > `GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction` > `GDS Layer Mapping and Device Extraction Rule Deck Setup` > `Access Transistor & Storage Capacitor Device Extraction Rule Implementation` **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type**: Make | **Target Architecture**: 8F² Folded Bitline Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB) --- ### 1. Workflow & Topology Diagram ```mermaid graph TD A["GDS II Stream Layers
(DIFF, POLY, CONT, M1/BL, SN_CONT, CROWN, TOP_PLT)"] --> B["Boolean Layer Operations
Active Gate = DIFF AND POLY
Cap Bottom Node = CROWN AND SN_CONT"] B --> C["Device Extraction: NMOS Access FET
Extract W = 220 nm, L = 180 nm
Gate: Wordline (POLY) | Source: Bitline Contact (CONT)"] B --> D["Device Extraction: Stacked Capacitor (Cs)
Dielectric: ONO / Ta2O5 Stack
Plate 1: Storage Node (SN) | Plate 2: VPLATE / Cell Plate"] C --> E["LVS Extracted SPICE Netlist
(.subckt dram_cell_1t1c BL WL VPLATE)"] D --> E E --> F["LVS Comparison & Metric Sign-off
Extract Cs >= 25 fF to 30 fF
Pin & Connectivity Verification"] ``` --- ### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure 1. **GDS Layer Definition & Logical Derivation**: - Map physical layout layers: Active Diffusion (`DIFF`), Wordline Conductor (`POLY`), Diffusion Contact (`CONT`), Bitline Metal (`M1`), Storage Node Contact Via (`SN_CONT`), Crown Bottom Electrode (`CROWN`), and Top Cell Plate (`TOP_PLT`). - Define boolean derived layers in the extraction deck: - `GATE_CHAN = DIFF AND POLY` - `SOURCE_DRAIN = DIFF NOT POLY` - `BL_NODE = SOURCE_DRAIN AND CONT` (shared contact between adjacent cells) - `SN_NODE = SOURCE_DRAIN AND SN_CONT` (storage node tungsten plug interface) - `CAP_ACTIVE = CROWN AND TOP_PLT` 2. **Access Transistor Device Extraction Rule Syntax**: - Implement parametric MOSFET extraction rule: - Recognize device terminal geometry: Gate = `POLY`, Source/Drain = `SOURCE_DRAIN`, Substrate = `PWELL/SUB`. - Set extraction parameter equations: Length $L = \text{perimeter}(\text{GATE\_CHAN} \cap \text{SOURCE\_DRAIN}) / 2 = 180\text{ nm}$; Width $W = \text{area}(\text{GATE\_CHAN}) / L = 220\text{ nm}$. - Pin assignment: Map shared node to `BL` and isolated node to internal storage terminal `SN`. 3. **Stacked Storage Capacitor ($C_s$) Device Extraction Rule Syntax**: - Implement custom 2-terminal capacitor extraction (`CAPACITOR` / subcircuit model): - Terminal 1 (Positive / Storage Node): `SN_NODE` connected upward through `CROWN`. - Terminal 2 (Negative / Common Plate): `TOP_PLT` (biased at cell plate voltage $V_{\text{PLATE}} = V_{DD}/2$). - Model formula: Compute extracted capacitance $C_s$ based on crown bottom area and 3D sidewall perimeter using equivalent oxide thickness (EOT = 3.0 nm – 4.0 nm) and high-$k$ dielectric constant ($\kappa > 15$). Ensure calculated unit cell capacitance defaults to $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$. 4. **Netlist Generation & LVS Verification**: - Compile extraction rules and run GDS-to-netlist extraction. - Cross-compare the extracted hierarchical SPICE netlist against the golden 1T1C schematic netlist (`BL`, `WL`, and common `VPLATE`). - Flag any soft-error susceptibility, layout mismatches, dangling storage nodes, or dimensional deviations outside physical specs. --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets | Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | `180` | nm | $\pm 0.0$ nm (Exact nominal drawn) | LVS parameter comparison vs. schematic | | **Access Transistor Gate Width ($W$)** | `220` | nm | $\pm 0.0$ nm (Exact nominal drawn) | LVS parameter comparison vs. schematic | | **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` (Min allowable: `25.0` to `30.0`) | fF | Minimum $\ge 25.0\text{ fF/cell}$ | Extracted SPICE netlist capacitive parasitics | | **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | nm | $\pm 0.2$ nm | Process deck & rule validation limit | | **Capacitor Dielectric EOT** | `3.0 to 4.0` | nm | [3.0, 4.0] nm range | Rule deck dielectric property sign-off | | **Cell Retention Leakage Target** | `< 1.0` | fA/cell | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell at 85°C}$ | Post-layout SPICE sub-threshold simulation | --- ### 4. Verified Literature Citations - **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: - *Transistor Geometry*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact between adjacent cells. - *Capacitor Structure & Dielectrics*: Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug); ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ dielectric stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$. - *Capacitance & Leakage Limits*: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. - **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: - *Cell Architecture*: 1T1C cell in $8F^2$ topology; storage capacitor maintained between $25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$ per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$. - *Physical Thicknesses*: $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$; capacitor dielectric equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) $\sim 3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$. - **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: - *Capacitive Ratios & Precharge*: Bitlines equalized to $V_{DD}/2$; typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ driving $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$. --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline DRAM architecture at 180nm, layout-versus-schematic (LVS) device extraction must accurately model the asymmetric boundary conditions between the shared bitline contact node and the isolated storage node plug (SN contact). If the rule deck fails to separate source/drain diffusion area (AS/AD) and perimeter (PS/PD) between the internal storage node and the shared bitline junction, the simulated bitline parasitic capacitance (Cb) and storage capacitance (Cs) will skew, masking critical Cb/Cs ratio violations (>9:1) that lead to read sense-amplifier sensing failure. - **Domain Physicist Critic**: Extraction rules for the stacked storage capacitor (Capacitor-Over-Bitline / COB) must strictly define Boolean layer derivations distinguishing the active plate (CP) from the bottom storage node electrode (SN) through the high-k/ONO dielectric interface. Extraction of the access NMOS (W=220nm, L=180nm) must incorporate substrate body-bias effects, gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL), and gate-to-drain overlap capacitance (Cgd), as miscalculating storage-node junction capacitance directly biases retention time calculations away from the <1 fA/cell leakage target at 85°C. - **Supply Chain Critic**: Rule deck implementations must maintain EDA vendor portability across open-source toolchains (Magic VLSI, KLayout with DRC/LVS engine, Netgen) and commercial PDK equivalents (Siemens Calibre, Synopsys IC Validator) used by manufacturing partners. Sourcing high-purity precursor materials for MIM/stacked capacitor dielectric deposition (such as Ta2O5 or Al2O3) requires precise matching between physical fabrication thickness variances (±5%) and extracted parasitic capacitance tables. - **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule alignment requires freeze of the device extraction rule deck within sprint cycle 1.3 before running full-chip sign-off on the 1Mb test array. Failure to decouple false LVS pin/terminal naming mismatches on the repetitive 8F² array matrix from genuine topological shorts creates significant verification drag, jeopardizing tape-out tapeout delivery for the multi-project wafer (MPW) run. **Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**: 1. Ambiguous Boolean extraction of stacked capacitor bottom node resulting in short-circuit recognition between storage node and adjacent wordline pass gates. 1. Misidentification of shared bitline contact diffusion region leading to double-counting of access transistor junction parasitics and an artificially suppressed Cb/Cs ratio. 1. Omission of 3D sidewall fringe capacitance equations for the cylindrical crown capacitor plate, causing overestimation of cell capacitance Cs by >20% relative to physical silicon. ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench) | Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-1-2-01` | **Access Transistor Geometry and Junction Extraction Validation** | KLayout LVS Engine / Netgen SPICE Netlist Comparer with automated extraction test bench suite | 1. Execute device extraction rule deck on 8F² test matrix GDSII containing nominal NMOS (drawn W=220nm, L=180nm). 2. Extract SPICE netlist including instance parameters W, L, AS, AD, PS, PD, and substrate connection tap. 3. Compare extracted netlist against golden schematic using Netgen netlist comparator. 4. Measure automated extraction logs for parameter deviations. | `Access transistor extracted gate length L = 180nm ± 0.5nm, width W = 220nm ± 0.5nm; source/drain node recognition correctly assigns shared diffusion to bitline net and isolated node to SN net with 0 topological mismatches and 0 false pin swapping errors.` | | `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-1-2-02` | **Stacked Storage Capacitor Extraction and Area/Perimeter Rule Sign-Off** | Calibre LVS / KLayout Deep Extraction Parser with FastCap/FastHenry parasitic interconnect field solver interface | 1. Run capacitor extraction deck across a 16x16 DRAM cell test block. 2. Calculate parallel-plate area capacitance and vertical sidewall perimeter capacitance components for each cell. 3. Extract resulting two-terminal capacitor instances (C_CELL) connected between node SN and common plate VPL (Vdd/2). 4. Correlate total extracted cell capacitance against numerical mesh field solver output across corners (TT, FF, SS). | `Extracted storage capacitance per cell Cs must evaluate to >= 28.0 fF (nominal 28.5 fF, tolerance within ±1.0 fF); parasitic coupling between storage node SN and bitline BL must remain below 1.5 fF.` | ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes - **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate` - **Mandatory PPE**: Level 100 cleanroom suit with conductive ESD grounding booties, Nitrile chemical-resistant gloves (double-gloving protocol), UV-absorbing safety spectacles with side shields (ANSI Z87.1), Vapor-trapping cleanroom face mask - **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure, immediately flush affected area with copious water for 2 minutes and apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously; seek emergency medical care. For TMAH contact, flush eyes/skin with water for 15 minutes minimum and initiate supportive respiratory care. - **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet bench exhaust with laminar velocity >= 0.5 m/s, equipped with real-time scrubbed exhaust duct monitoring and continuous differential pressure interlocks. - **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluoride waste drains routed to dedicated calcium fluoride precipitation neutralizing tank; organic solvent waste routed to dedicated flammable solvent collection drum. **Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**: | Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Hydrofluoric Acid (pre-deposition wet clean)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / SEMI Tier 3) | `0.5% aqueous solution` | | **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH developer)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic Grade (SEMI C8) | `2.38%` | | **Isopropyl Alcohol (wafer drying)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `99.9%` | ### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints - **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours` - **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dilute HF-cleaned, hydrogen-terminated silicon surface at storage node contact vias with native oxide thickness < 0.2 nm. - **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated bottom tungsten/polysilicon plug interface prior to stacked dielectric Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD). - **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth exceeding 0.5 nm introducing non-ohmic contact resistance (> 500 Ohms) and degrading access transistor drive current and capacitor write margin. ### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done) **Exit Objective Summary**: > Production-ready, dual-engine LVS device extraction rule deck covering access NMOS and stacked MIM/crown storage capacitor structures for an 8F² folded bitline cell at the 180nm node, verified clean against schematic topologies without false device attribution. **Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**: - [ ] `dram_180nm_cell_device_extraction.lvs.rule` - [ ] `extraction_validation_matrix_report.csv` - [ ] `parasitic_corner_extraction_signoff.pdf` **Quantitative Completion Assertions**: | Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `ASSERT-01` | **Storage node capacitance Cs extraction under nominal dielectric thickness** | `28.5 fF` | ±1.0 fF | Automated SPICE subcircuit extraction verified against 3D numerical electrostatic solver mesh | | `ASSERT-02` | **Extracted Bitline-to-Storage-Node capacitance ratio (Cb / Cs)** | `7.0` | +2.0 / -1.5 (Must remain between 5.5 and 9.0) | Full-column 512-cell array parasitic RC post-layout netlist back-annotation simulation | | `ASSERT-03` | **Access transistor geometric extraction accuracy (Channel Length L and Width W)** | `L = 180.0 nm, W = 220.0 nm` | ±0.5 nm | GDS-to-netlist geometric polygon edge dimension reconciliation across 10,000 array instances | **Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**: > Zero extraction syntax errors across target EDA platforms, zero LVS discrepancies (shorts, opens, or parameter mismatches) across 1Mb array test block, and formal sign-off approval from both Lead DRAM Circuit Architect and Device Modeling Lead.

# SOP: LVS Deck Golden Netlist Extraction & Pin Connectivity Verification Metrology

## 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  GDS II Layout and   │
│       Netlist        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Boolean Layer     │
│      Operations      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     1T1C Device      │
│      Extraction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Pin Connectivity   │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     LVS Netlist      │
│  Comparison Signoff  │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

```text
       180nm 1T1C LVS Extraction Geometric & Target Budgets     
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░                                  │
    Cell Cs (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Pitch WL/BL (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
   Access W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
   Access L (nm)┤███████████████████                   │

                 0       95        190      285     380
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDS II Layer Mapping & Boolean Pre-Processing**:
   - Ingest target layout GDS II stream file and parse layer-datatype mappings according to the 180nm open-source process design kit (PDK).
   - Execute geometric Boolean operations:
     - Form active diffusion regions via `ACTIVE = DIFF NOT NWELL`.
     - Form gate channels via `GATE = POLY AND ACTIVE`.
     - Derive capacitor contact via `SN_NODE = W_PLUG AND POLY_CROWN` and bitline node via `BL_NODE = W_PLUG AND METAL1`.
2. **Device Recognition & Parameter Extraction**:
   - Extract access NMOS transistors: identify terminal connectivity for Source (shared bitline contact `BL`), Drain (storage node `SN`), Gate (wordline `WL`), and Bulk (P-substrate `VBB`).
   - Extract physical dimensions from layout geometries: evaluate channel length $L$ and channel width $W$.
   - Extract stacked storage capacitor ($C_s$) topology (Crown/Cylinder MIM or Polysilicon) erected above the drain contact through the tungsten plug (W-plug).
3. **Pin & Port Connectivity Graph Generation**:
   - Extract pin text labels and boundary port shapes from metallization layers (`METAL1` for bitline, `POLY`/`METAL` for wordline, and plate voltage `V_CP`).
   - Run connectivity tracing from contacts up through tungsten plugs and metal interconnects to build the layout electrical graph.
   - Detect shorts, opens, floating gates, and uncontacted diffusion regions prior to netlist pairing.
4. **Golden Schematic Pairing & Isomorphism Comparison**:
   - Read Golden SPICE netlist defining the $8F^2$ folded bitline 1T1C DRAM cell matrix and complementary sense amplifier latch ($BL$ / $/BL$).
   - Perform graph isomorphism comparison: match instance names, terminal assignments, pin definitions, and device parameters ($W, L, C$).
   - Flag any discrepancies (device mismatches, net shorts/opens, or port naming differences) for corrective layout loop.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Specification | Tolerance / Window | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | $\pm 0.0$ (Exact grid matching) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | $\pm 0.0$ (Exact grid matching) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Bitline & Wordline Pitch** | `360` to `400` | $[360, 400]$ range | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Storage Node Extracted Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0$ (Target $\ge 28.0$) | Nominal target budget | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **LVS Netlist Comparison Discrepancies** | `0` (Zero shorts, opens, device mismatches) | Clean Sign-off (`0`) | Count |

---

## 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Unit cell architecture: $8F^2$ / $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with shared bitline contact between two adjacent cells.
  - Storage node structure: Crown-shaped polysilicon or MIM capacitor contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Target minimum storage capacitance: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring noise immunity and refresh retention.
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - Complementary bitline interconnect topology ($BL$ and $/BL$) connected to cross-coupled latch sense amplifier.
  - Typical cell storage capacitance benchmark: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Cell layout & retention requirements: $8F^2$ architecture requiring storage capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Interconnect geometry: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-1-3-01` | **Post-Clean Particle & Metallic Trace Contamination Assay** | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor / Surfscan) & TXRF Spectrometer | 1. Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-1-3-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade (< 1 ppb metals) | `49% conc. or 1:50 DHF` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (NH4F)** | `12125-01-8` | Electronic Grade | `40% aq (for BOE 6:1 buffer)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (unstabilized) | `30% aq (for SC-1 & SC-2)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | Electronic Grade | `37% aq (for SC-2 clean)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29% aq (for SC-1 clean)` |

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of LVS Deck Golden Netlist Extraction & Pin Connectivity Verification Metrology: Chemical cleaning and surface preparation verified with zero watermark defects, bare hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon, and calibrated oxide etch rate.

- [ ] `DHF_BOE_calibrated_etch_rate_sheet.csv`

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF bare silicon water contact angle** | `>= 75.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI water droplet) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface particulate defect density (> 0.1 um)** | `< 15 particles/wafer` | Max acceptable particle count on 100mm wafer | Darkfield Laser Surface Inspection (Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `< 1.0e10 atoms/cm²` | Max allowable contamination | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer surface exhibits 100% uniform dewetting / hydrophobicity with zero visible drying marks under bright light; residual native oxide Tox < 0.2 nm confirmed by spectroscopic ellipsometry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: GDS Layer Boolean Operations & Device Recognition Rule Formulation
**Discipline:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification (LVS)  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Topology:** 1T1C DRAM Cell ($8F^2$ Folded Bitline Architecture)

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Raw GDSII Mask     │
│         Stream         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Layer Boolean      │
│      Derivations       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Device Recognition &  │
│     Pin Derivation     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Connectivity      │
│    Extraction & LVS    │
│      Clean Match       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDS Layer Mapping & Primary Layer Ingestion:**
   - Ingest raw GDSII stream layers: Active/Diffusion (`DIFF`), Polysilicon Wordline (`POLY`), N-Well / P-Well implants (`NWEL`/`PWEL`), N+ / P+ Source-Drain implants (`NIMP`/`PIMP`), Bitline Contact / Contact Plug (`CONT`/`W-plug`), Bitline Metal (`M1`), Storage Node Contact Pad (`SNCP`), Crown/Cylinder Capacitor Bottom Plate (`SN_CAP`), Capacitor Top Plate/Plate Line (`PLATE`), and Via levels (`VIA1`).

2. **Formulate Geometric Boolean Operations:**
   - **Active Gate Conductor:** Derive access gate geometry by boolean AND of active diffusion and poly wordline:  
     $$\text{GATE\_1T} = \text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$$
   - **Access Transistor Source/Drain Regions:** Derive active diffusion diffusions outside gate poly:  
     $$\text{DIFF\_SD} = \text{DIFF} \setminus \text{POLY}$$
   - **1T1C Access Transistor Channel Identification:** Intersect gate with N-implant in P-well:  
     $$\text{CHAN\_1T} = \text{GATE\_1T} \cap \text{NIMP} \setminus \text{NWEL}$$
   - **Stacked Capacitor (Crown/Cylinder) Dielectric Overlap:** Derive capacitor recognition layer from bottom storage electrode and top plate intersection:  
     $$\text{CAP\_AREA} = \text{SN\_CAP} \cap \text{PLATE}$$

3. **Terminal Pin Derivation & Terminal Recognition:**
   - **Gate Terminal ($G$):** Poly wordline connected directly to $\text{CHAN\_1T}$ along the wordline track.
   - **Bitline Terminal ($D$ or $S_1$):** Formed by active diffusion $\text{DIFF\_SD}$ contacting the shared bitline contact tungsten plug:  
     $$\text{BL\_DIFF} = \text{DIFF\_SD} \cap \text{CONT} \cap \text{M1}$$
   - **Storage Node Terminal ($S$ or $S_2$):** Formed by active diffusion contacting the crown tungsten plug (W-plug):  
     $$\text{SN\_DIFF} = \text{DIFF\_SD} \cap \text{SNCP}$$
   - **Capacitor Storage ($C_s$) Node Pins:** Node 1 corresponds to $\text{SN\_CAP} \cap \text{SNCP}$; Node 2 connects to the common cell plate line $\text{PLATE}$ biased at $V_{DD}/2$.

4. **Device Property Extraction & Netlist Formulation:**
   - Extract drawn channel length $L = \text{Perpendicular\_Length}(\text{GATE\_1T})$ and drawn width $W = \text{Parallel\_Width}(\text{GATE\_1T})$.
   - Extract capacitor surface area and perimeter, scaling with high-$k$ dielectric equivalent thickness to yield storage node capacitance $C_s$.
   - Output extracted spice subcircuit for comparison against schematic netlist:
     ```spice
     * 1T1C Memory Cell Instance
     M_ACC BL WL SN VSS NMOS_1T W=220n L=180n
     C_CELL SN PLATE C=28fF
     ```

5. **LVS Connectivity & Ambiguity Resolution:**
   - Enforce shared bitline contact symmetry rules between adjacent 1T1C cells to resolve pin interchangeability between complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Run LVS geometric topology checking to confirm error-free pin connectivity and 1:1 schematic-to-layout isomorphism.

---

### Dimensional & Metric Parameters

```text
                                                        
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░                                  │
  Target Cs (fF)┤░░░░                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
     L Gate (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
     W Gate (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       90        180      270     360 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated LVS Boolean edge measurement on $\text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated LVS Boolean edge measurement on $\text{DIFF} \cap \text{POLY}$ |
| **Wordline / Bitline Interconnect Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | 2D DRC/LVS pitch and spacing measurement on $\text{POLY}$ & $\text{M1}$ |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28$ (Nominal range: $25 \text{ to } 30$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extraction netlist parameter check (assuring retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Parasitic device electrical parameter threshold evaluation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Citations
- **Source 1:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown-shaped structure with W-plug, dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$), capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — 1T1C $8F^2/6F^2$ architecture, cell capacitance range $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$ for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, high-$k$ dielectric EOT of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$, thermal dry gate oxide physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 3:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* — Folded-bitline cell charge distribution, precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, sensing signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-2-1-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Interleaved Sense Amp & Array Pin Connectivity Graph Extraction

### Workflow Architecture
```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   GDS Layout Input    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Layer Polygon Boolean │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Array Bitline     │
│    Contact Tracing    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Interleaved Pitch   │
│        Mapping        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     SA Latch Port     │
│       Matching        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Pin Graph & Netlist  │
│       LVS Clean       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **GDS Layout Ingestion & Layer Definition**:
   - Stream in the 180nm GDS-II database containing the 1T1C $8F^2$ DRAM array block and adjacent sense amplifier strip layouts.
   - Decompose polygon layers into active diffusion ($W = 220\text{ nm}$), poly gate ($L = 180\text{ nm}$), tungsten contact plugs (W-plug), bitline metallization, and storage-node capacitor connections.

2. **Array Bitline Contact Recognition**:
   - Run 2D geometric boolean operations to identify shared bitline contacts between adjacent access transistors.
   - Trace continuous bitline metal polygons traversing the memory core down to the boundary ring.

3. **Interleaved Pitch Mapping & Spatial Assignment**:
   - Due to the memory bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$), map alternating bitline pairs ($BL_{2k}$ to the top SA strip and $BL_{2k+1}$ to the bottom SA strip).
   - Trace complementary pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$) across the folded-bitline topology into the respective differential sense amplifier column boundaries.

4. **Sense Amplifier Port & Equalization Node Connectivity**:
   - Extract pin-to-node connectivity for the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch ports ($SAN$, $SAP$) and the bitline equalization/precharge network ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Verify that all physical metal-to-pin overlaps resolve without dangling open circuits or shorted complementary paths.

5. **Pin Connectivity Graph Construction & LVS Cross-Check**:
   - Construct a directed bipartite connectivity graph connecting array bitline terminals to sense amplifier I/O pins.
   - Compare the extracted layout connectivity graph against the schematic netlist to verify zero topological discrepancies.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                        Extraction Metric Thresholds    
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░                                │
Leakage Sign-off (fA)┤░                                │
                     │▒▒▒                              │
     Cell Target (fF)┤▒▒▒                              │
  BL Cap Tracing (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
  Pitch Matching (nm)┤█████████████████████████████████│
                     │█████████████████████████████████│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      90      180     270    360 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **$360$** | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC/GDS pitch measurement along array-to-SA boundary |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$\approx 250$** (sign-off target) | $\text{fF}$ | Parasitic Extraction (PEX) 2.5D/3D field solver |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 28$** | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted MIM/Stacked capacitor model integration |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Sign-Off** | **$\le 1$** at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SPICE post-layout sub-threshold/junction simulation |

---

### Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ in folded-bitline topology; precharge to $V_{DD}/2$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Pitch matching constraint: Sense amplifier pitch matches memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node), requiring interleaved layout.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; shared bitline contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

*Captured into knowledge base at [sop_interleaved_sense_amp_pin_graph_extraction.md](docs/sop_interleaved_sense_amp_pin_graph_extraction.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pitch-matching between the 180nm 8F² memory array bitlines (360 nm pitch) and standard CMOS sense amplifier strip layouts requires aggressive 2-way or 4-way vertical interleaving (top and bottom SA blocks). The extraction graph engine must correctly preserve hierarchical pin equivalences and folded bitline pairing (BL_even, /BL_even routed to top SA; BL_odd, /BL_odd routed to bottom SA) without introducing false short circuits across interleaved routing channels or misinterpreting shared equalization transistor nodes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, signal margin delta V is constrained to 100-150 mV (Cs = 25 fF, CBL = 250 fF). Symmetric pin connectivity extraction is paramount: any geometric offset, asymmetric contact via enclosure, or boundary pin misclassification during GDS-to-graph translation will corrupt parasitic extraction (PEX) symmetry, masking layout-induced systematic bitline-to-complement capacitance imbalances that trigger false differential latches during SAN/SAP pull-down/pull-up.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source EDA toolchain compatibility (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Netgen LVS scripts) must adhere strictly to standard foundry rule deck naming conventions for open 180nm CMOS/DRAM hybrid wafers (e.g., SkyWater 130 / standard 180nm mixed-signal MPW shuttles). Non-standard layer numbering or proprietary device-pin hierarchy extraction prevents drop-in MPW foundry tape-out sign-off.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Phase-gate milestone Gen 2 sign-off requires deterministic graph extraction runtime and 100% reproducible LVS connectivity graphs across array boundaries. Automated CI/CD regressions must validate array-to-sense-amp pitch boundary pin graphs across full 1024x1024 sub-arrays within 15 minutes before proceeding to full parasitic sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inversion or swapping of true/complement bitline pin assignments (BL and /BL) across interleaved top/bottom array boundaries causing 180-degree phase read failure.
1. False pin merges or phantom shorts at shared VDD/2 equalization and precharge rail pins due to missing layout boundary text/pin layer hierarchy.
1. Asymmetric via contact recognition across interleaved pitch transitions introducing artificial topological mismatches in automated netlist graph isomorphism checks.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-2-2-01` | **Interleaved Sense Amplifier Pin Topology and Isomorphism Verification** | KLayout DRC/LVS engine with Netgen graph isomorphism analyzer and custom Python-based NetworkX topological bipartite graph comparator | 1. Execute KLayout automated geometric layer boolean operations to extract M1/M2/Via1 array boundary connectivity ports. 2. Parse GDS pin labels and geometry polygons into an undirected connectivity graph G_layout(V, E). 3. Convert golden subcircuit netlist into G_schematic(V, E). 4. Perform VF2 subgraph isomorphism test comparing layout extracted pin network against schematic graph. 5. Inspect interleaved pairing: confirm all even columns terminate at top SA bank ports and odd columns terminate at bottom SA bank ports. | `Zero missing nodes, zero unmatched edges, 100% port isomorphism (isomorphic match = true), exactly 256 even pin pairs mapped to top SA boundary and 256 odd pin pairs mapped to bottom SA boundary.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-2-2-02` | **Bitline Pair Geometric Symmetry and Resistance/Capacitance Delta Extraction** | Open-source 2.5D field-solver / parasitic extraction engine (FasterCap / Magic PEX) coupled with layout pin connectivity netlist extractor | 1. Trace geometric pin paths from DRAM cell bitline contact boundary through interleaved pitch adapters to sense amplifier input nodes. 2. Extract total layout trace length and parasitic resistance R_BL, R_BLB for each pair. 3. Extract parasitic wire-to-wire capacitance C_BL, C_BLB including coupling capacitance to adjacent wordlines/rails. 4. Compute differential balance ratio: Delta_C = |C_BL - C_BLB| / C_BL. | `Geometric trace length delta |L_BL - L_BLB| <= 5 nm; extracted parasitic capacitance imbalance Delta_C <= 1.0% across all 512 interleaved bitline pairs; parasitic trace series resistance delta |R_BL - R_BLB| <= 0.5 Ohm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD wrist strap, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with IPA wipes, rinse thoroughly with copious amounts of water for at least 15 minutes. For vapor inhalation, move personnel to fresh outdoor air. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / CAD lab ISO Class 5 laminar airflow workstation with active HVAC air exchange >= 20 air changes per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of used IPA wipes in dedicated sealed solvent-waste containers for hazardous waste incineration per local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) cleanroom surface wipe** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade / Semiconductor (SEMI C1) | `70% v/v in DI water` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal clean / post-CMP planarized M1 oxide passivation with zero particulate contamination > 0.18 µm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Dry nitrogen purged sealed FOUP / wafer carrier prior to passivation deposition or next metallization step.

critics.systems_engineer: Pitch-matching between the 180nm 8F² memory array bitlines (360 nm pitch) and standard CMOS sense amplifier strip layouts requires aggressive 2-way or 4-way vertical interleaving (top and bottom SA blocks). The extraction graph engine must correctly preserve hierarchical pin equivalences and folded bitline pairing (BL_even, /BL_even routed to top SA; BL_odd, /BL_odd routed to bottom SA) without introducing false short circuits across interleaved routing channels or misinterpreting shared equalization transistor nodes.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm, signal margin delta V is constrained to 100-150 mV (Cs = 25 fF, CBL = 250 fF). Symmetric pin connectivity extraction is paramount: any geometric offset, asymmetric contact via enclosure, or boundary pin misclassification during GDS-to-graph translation will corrupt parasitic extraction (PEX) symmetry, masking layout-induced systematic bitline-to-complement capacitance imbalances that trigger false differential latches during SAN/SAP pull-down/pull-up.
critics.supply_chain: Open-source EDA toolchain compatibility (e.g., KLayout / Magic / Netgen LVS scripts) must adhere strictly to standard foundry rule deck naming conventions for open 180nm CMOS/DRAM hybrid wafers (e.g., SkyWater 130 / standard 180nm mixed-signal MPW shuttles). Automated CI/CD regressions must validate array-to-sense-amp pitch boundary pin graphs across full 1024x1024 sub-arrays within 15 minutes before proceeding to full parasitic sign-off.

False pin merges or phantom shorts at shared VDD/2 equalization and precharge rail pins due to missing layout boundary text/pin layer hierarchy.
Asymmetric via contact recognition across interleaved pitch transitions introducing artificial topological mismatches in automated netlist graph isomorphism checks.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Extracted Netlist Versus Schematic Topology & Node Equivalence Metrology

**Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — 1T1C Bitcell Array & Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Subsystems  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Verification

---

### 1. Metrology Architecture & Verification Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│    Layout GDSII Geometry & Golden SPICE/CDL   │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│   Device Layer Boolean & Pin LVS Extraction   │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│        Graph Isomorphism & Topology           │
│             Node Matching Matrix              │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                               │
│     Parametric Tolerance & Sign-off Check     │
│   (W/L Ratios, C_s, C_BL, Gate Tox, EOT)      │
│                                               │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Extraction Rule Deck & Netlist Ingestion**:
   - Compile the 180nm GDS-II database against the Golden Hierarchical SPICE / CDL netlist.
   - Run connectivity extraction across active diffusion, polysilicon wordline (WL), tungsten plug contacts (W-plug), bitline (BL, /BL), and capacitor over bitline (COB) metal/dielectric plates.

2. **Graph Isomorphism & Structural Topology Matching**:
   - Formulate bipartite connectivity graphs representing:
     - The schematic netlist (containing 1T1C storage cells, equalization networks, and cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier latches).
     - The GDS-extracted netlist.
   - Execute topological nodal matching to confirm zero net, pin, or port discrepancies:
     - Access transistor gate terminal $\rightarrow$ Wordline node (`WL`).
     - Transistor drain/source terminal $1 \rightarrow$ Shared bitline contact (`BL` or `/BL`).
     - Transistor drain/source terminal $2 \rightarrow$ Tungsten plug to bottom storage plate (`SN`).
     - Storage capacitor plate $\rightarrow$ Cell plate reference voltage (`V_PL` / `V_DD/2`).

3. **Parametric & Dimension Equivalence Evaluation**:
   - Extract physical gate geometry for the access transistors: evaluate effective channel length $L$ and channel width $W$.
   - Extract capacitor plate area and dielectric profile: verify stacked cell storage capacitance $C_s$ and bitline parasitic capacitance $C_\text{BL}$.
   - Ensure the thermal gate oxide thickness ($T_\text{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) corresponds to the intended electrical parameters.

4. **Sensing Signal Budget & Array Coupling Verification**:
   - Compute extracted signal swing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_\text{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_\text{cell} - \frac{V_\text{DD}}{2}\right)$ using extracted $C_s$ and $C_\text{BL}$.
   - Flag any bitcell node failing retention target capacitance or exceeding sub-threshold/junction leakage bounds.

5. **Sign-off Discrepancy Reporting & Archival**:
   - Export discrepancy report (`.rpt`) capturing unmatched instances, open nets, short circuits, or parameter delta outliers ($\Delta L$, $\Delta W$, $\Delta C$).
   - Output signed LVS-clean certificate upon satisfying all acceptance criteria.

---

### 3. Key Parameter Metrology Targets

```text
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░                               │
   Cap Cs (28 fF)┤░░░░░░                               │
                 │▒▒                                   │
Gate Tox (3.5 nm)┤▒▒                                   │
Access W (220 nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Access L (180 nm)┤██████████████████████████████       │
                 │██████████████████████████████       │
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0       55       110      165     220 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Verification Stage | Target Nominal Value | Machine Acceptance Tolerance | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | Extracted vs Schematic Geometry | $180\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.00\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid/dimension mismatch) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Gate Width ($W$)** | Extracted vs Schematic Geometry | $220\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.00\text{ nm}$ (Zero grid/dimension mismatch) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Stacked Capacitor Metrology | $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ (Nominal $\ge 28\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25.0\text{ fF}$ (Minimum cutoff) | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_\text{BL}$)** | Extracted BL Interconnect Net | $250\text{ fF}$ | $\le 275\text{ fF}$ ($+10\%$ ceiling) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | Readout Sensing Equivalence | $100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$ | $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ (Minimum signal margin) | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_\text{leak}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | Sub-threshold & Junction Extraction | $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ | $\le 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 5. Context & Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture via W-plug, storage capacitance minimum budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and cell leakage budget $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Folded-bitline differential topology, cross-coupled inverter latch, cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline parasitic $C_\text{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, precharge equalization to $V_\text{DD}/2$, and readout differential signal swing $\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C storage retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ maintained with storage capacitance $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$, thermal gate oxide dry oxidation thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, and pitch dimensions of $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Station exhaust and DI water loop (18.2 MOhm-cm, particle filter 0.1 um) must interlock prior to wafer boat immersion. Rinse cascade must terminate downstream acid carries before SC-2.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: BOE 6:1 (NH4F:HF) etch rate must be calibrated at 70-80 nm/min at 25°C. SC-1 (5:1:1 H2O:NH4OH:H2O2) must be maintained at 75°C +/- 2°C to eliminate light organics without pitting Si.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: Electronic-grade semiconductor reagents (VLSI/MOS grade) must be procured from certified chemical distributors; technical-grade chemicals will induce metallic surface poisoning (Fe, Cu, Ni > 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 24-32 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Chemical cross-contamination or incomplete dump rinse leaves watermark defects and micro-masking during subsequent etch).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Watermark defect formation during static pull-out from hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transition.
1. Exhaust face-velocity drop below 0.5 m/s causing acid vapor condensation on cleanroom tooling.
1. Over-etch in BOE undercut exceeding 50 nm, destroying contact via dimensional margins.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-2-3-01` | **Post-Clean Particle & Metallic Trace Contamination Assay** | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner (KLA-Tencor / Surfscan) & TXRF Spectrometer | 1. Load unpatterned witness silicon wafer into darkfield laser scatterometer. 2. Scan complete surface for light point defects (LPD) at size bin >= 180 nm. 3. Perform Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) for trace Fe, Cu, Ni surface concentrations. | `LPD count (>= 180 nm) < 10 defects/wafer (Pass); Transition metals (Fe, Ni, Cu) < 5e10 atoms/cm2 (Pass).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-1-2-3-02` | **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1) Step Height & Lateral Undercut Profilometry** | Stylus Profilometer (Veeco Dektak XT) / Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) | 1. Zero stylus force baseline at 3 mg on planar SiO2 field. 2. Scan 200 um profile across etched contact window step at 20 um/s scan speed. 3. Record step height h_step and lateral undercut under resist margin. | `Etch depth matches target +/- 5% (Pass); lateral undercut <= 35 nm (Pass); surface roughness Ra < 0.5 nm (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene gloves (0.7 mm thickness, tested for HF permeation), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield over ANSI Z87.1 safety goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeves (PVC/Neoprene), Acid gas vapor cartridge respirator (NIOSH approved for HF/HCl)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: MANDATORY ON-SITE ANTIDOTE: Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%). In case of HF skin contact: Flush immediately under emergency drench shower for 2-3 minutes, then vigorously massage Calcium Gluconate Gel into affected skin continuously until emergency medical response arrives. Never apply standard burn creams.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated polypropylene wet bench with vertical laminar exhaust face velocity >= 0.55 m/s. Interlocked with wet acid scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate fluoride effluent. Neutralize with Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2). Verify pH 7.0-8.5 before drain discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade (< 1 ppb metals) | `49% conc. or 1:50 DHF` |
| **Ammonium Fluoride (NH4F)** | `12125-01-8` | Electronic Grade | `40% aq (for BOE 6:1 buffer)` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade (unstabilized) | `30% aq (for SC-1 & SC-2)` |
| **Hydrochloric Acid (HCl)** | `7647-01-0` | Electronic Grade | `37% aq (for SC-2 clean)` |
| **Ammonium Hydroxide (NH4OH)** | `1336-21-6` | Electronic Grade | `29% aq (for SC-1 clean)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30.0 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4.0 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophilic with native chemical oxide (Tox ~1.0 nm) and organic particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic H-terminated bare silicon (water contact angle > 75°), zero watermarks, Tox < 0.2 nm.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native SiO2 spontaneously regrows in ambient air at ~0.1 nm/hr, degrading interface state density Dit and causing uncontrolled threshold voltage shift in downstream gate oxidation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Extracted Netlist Versus Schematic Topology & Node Equivalence Metrology: Chemical cleaning and surface preparation verified with zero watermark defects, bare hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon, and calibrated oxide etch rate.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `Surface_particle_laser_scan_Surfscan.pdf`
- [ ] `Sessile_drop_contact_angle_measurement.png`
- [ ] `DHF_BOE_calibrated_etch_rate_sheet.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-DHF bare silicon water contact angle** | `>= 75.0 deg` | +/- 5.0 deg | Automated Sessile Drop Goniometer (DI water droplet) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Surface particulate defect density (> 0.1 um)** | `< 15 particles/wafer` | Max acceptable particle count on 100mm wafer | Darkfield Laser Surface Inspection (Surfscan) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Surface metallic impurity concentration (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | `< 1.0e10 atoms/cm²` | Max allowable contamination | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Wafer surface exhibits 100% uniform dewetting / hydrophobicity with zero visible drying marks under bright light; residual native oxide Tox < 0.2 nm confirmed by spectroscopic ellipsometry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** LVS Pin-to-Port Discrepancy Debug and Clean Equivalence Sign-off  
**Document Track:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design ($8F^2$) > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off > GDS-to-Netlist Device & Pin LVS Clean Extraction > LVS Pin-to-Port Discrepancy Debug and Clean Equivalence Sign-off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$, $F = 180\text{ nm}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Layout Pin Extraction & Layer Binding Setup
1. Define the GDS pin identification layer table for the $180\text{ nm}$ ($F = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$) cell array ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
2. Bind layout text labels to their underlying conducting geometries:
   - Bitline true port: `BL` (Metal 1 routing layer).
   - Complementary bitline port: `/BL` (Metal 1 routing layer).
   - Wordline gate driver port: `WL` (Polysilicon / Poly-silicide gate strap layer).
   - Sense amplifier strobe control rails: `SAN` (N-sense pulldown) and `SAP` (P-sense pullup).
   - Array precharge/equalization control: `EQ` and precision reference rail `V_BLP` ($V_{DD} / 2$).
3. Ensure all label text origins are physically enclosed within the target pin boundary polygon without overlapping adjacent metal geometries or diffusion bounds.

### Step 2: Schematic Netlist Generation & Export
1. Export the golden transistor-level subcircuit netlist (`.cdl` / SPICE format) containing:
   - 1T1C storage matrix (256 or 512 cells per bitline).
   - Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch (NMOS pull-down pair, PMOS pull-up pair).
   - Equalization NMOS network tied to $V_{BLP}$.
2. Verify pin port ordering and naming syntax across subcircuit definitions:
   ```spice
   .SUBCKT SENSE_AMP_LATCH BL BL_BAR SAN SAP EQ VBLP VDD GND
   .SUBCKT CELL_1T1C WL BL SN
   ```

### Step 3: Automated LVS Netlist Comparison & Discrepancy Parsing
1. Execute the hierarchical LVS comparison engine between extracted layout devices and the schematic CDL.
2. Filter discrepancy report into three metrology categories:
   - **Port Name Mismatch / Unmatched Pins:** Unrecognized text labels or missing pin geometry declarations.
   - **Shorted Pins:** `BL` to `/BL` or `WL` to substrate/ground shorts via misalignment.
   - **Open/Floating Ports:** Polysilicon wordline segments broken across the array stitch boundary or contact vias unplaced.
3. Validate that storage capacitor node `SN` connects directly to the cell storage dielectric ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ nominal target $28\text{ fF}$) and remains internal to the sub-array block.

### Step 4: Corrective Layout Tuning & Equivalence Sign-off
1. Relocate misaligned pin label origins to the exact center coordinate of the corresponding metal contact/pad.
2. Eliminate false opens by adding missing redundant via arrays at the sense amplifier interfaces (`SAN`, `SAP`, `EQ`).
3. Re-run comparison until the report output certifies:
   ```text
   # LVS STATUS: CLEAN / EQUIVALENT
   # DEVICES MATCHED: 100%
   # NETS MATCHED: 100%
   # PORTS MATCHED: 100%
   ```

## 3. Literature Context Citations

1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Footprint standard: Folded-bitline $8F^2$ ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ cell area at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Capacitance specification: $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ per cell (nominal $28\text{ fF}$); $C_b$ parasitic capacitance of $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ across 256/512 cells per bitline.
   - Ratio requirement: $C_b / C_s$ maintained strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (severe degradation if exceeding $10:1$).
2. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Architecture & Signal development: Complementary folded bitlines `BL` and `/BL`, precharged to $V_{DD}/2$ via equalization network.
   - Charge transfer equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ generating $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ differential read signal margin for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
3. **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
   - Operational phases and control pin connections: Equalization control `EQ` tying bitlines to precision $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$; wordline overdrive pulse $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$; N-sense pulldown rail `SAN` (switching from $V_{DD}/2$ to $\text{GND}$); P-sense pullup rail `SAP` (activating 1–2 ns delay after `SAN` to pull high bitline to $V_{DD}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline DRAM architecture at 180nm, bitline pitch matching (360 nm) against interleaved sense amplifiers imposes extreme layout density. Pin-to-port discrepancies during GDS extraction frequently stem from missing text pin labels on boundary metal layers (Metal 1 bitlines, Poly/Metal 2 wordlines) or hierarchical port flattening ambiguities where cell pins (BL, BLB, WL, SN, PLATE) short across abutted cell boundaries. Clean equivalence sign-off must ensure zero unmapped logical ports and strict bidirectional 1-to-1 pin-to-port matching across array hierarchy before netlist export.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: LVS extraction tools (such as Netgen or Magic/KLayout LVS) fail equivalence if schematic subcircuit ports do not match extracted GDS pin geometries in both layer location and connectivity. In 8F² topologies, the storage node (SN) contact pin must remain distinct from the shared bitline contact (BL) diffusion region. Discrepancies often arise from text labels placed on drawn layers instead of pin purpose layers (e.g. M1:pin vs M1:drawing) or improper substrate/well tap tie-offs that float bulk terminals during netlist extraction.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Failure to achieve clean LVS sign-off halts mask tape-out and photomask fabrication schedules, resulting in costly direct tool downtime at the open-source foundry. All pin geometry layers and port naming conventions must adhere strictly to the foundry's standard PDK layer-map tables (GDS layer 68/20 for M1 pin, layer 69/20 for M2 pin) to avoid mask data prep (MDP) translation errors.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off must follow a rigorous gated sign-off checklist: zero pin discrepancies, zero net shorts/opens, zero unmatched devices across the 8F² 1T1C unit cell, 2x2 test matrix, and full 1Kb mini-array slice. Verification runtime must not bottleneck automated CI/CD flow, remaining under 180 seconds for unit blocks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Storage node diffusion accidentally merged or shorted to shared bitline plug due to incorrect active area contact layer extraction, causing catastrophic stuck-at-fault across the bitline.
1. Pin text label placed off-grid or on non-pin drawing layer, causing LVS engine to treat critical control ports (WL/PL) as floating nets and failing topological isomorphism.
1. Substrate bulk tap (VBB) port omitted in subcircuit hierarchy, leading to false bulk-source net mismatches across folded sense amplifier transfer gates.

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ESD-safe lab coat, Anti-static wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Nitrile gloves (Class 100 cleanroom compatible)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For vapor inhalation, move personnel immediately to fresh air. In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvents, flush thoroughly with copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA-filtered laminar flow bench (ISO Class 5) with general laboratory HVAC maintaining >15 air exchanges per hour.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-wetted lint-free cleanroom wipes in dedicated sealed, flame-resistant solvent waste bins; manage in compliance with local semiconductor solvent effluent regulations.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: DRC-clean verified GDSII stream file and validated SPICE schematic netlist with freeze-locked checksums.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: LVS-clean extracted post-layout netlist signed off and packaged for parasitic RC extraction (PEX).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Data desynchronization between schematic engineering change orders (ECO) and layout stream, resulting in stale pin binding and invalid mask compilation.
