| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for characterization lab workbench cleaning** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-PEX LVS clean extracted SPICE netlist with annotated 3D field solver parasitic capacitance and resistance matrices (Parasitics annotated and valid).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Signed-off transient differential margin verification dataset integrated into the master DRAM core timing and characterization database.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: PEX deck version skew or layout revision desynchronization; stale parasitic models invalidate transient signal development metrics, necessitating full re-extraction.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full transient SPICE characterization of the folded-bitline sense amplifier for the 180nm 8F² DRAM core confirms robust differential signal development (Delta_V >= 95 mV across PVT corners, nominal 110 mV) and zero-defect latching across 1,000 Monte Carlo statistical mismatch runs under adjacent-bitline cross-talk.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_sa_transient_deltav_pvt_characterization.csv`
- [ ] `dram_sa_monte_carlo_1000run_margin_analysis.pdf`
- [ ] `dram_sa_pex_extracted_readout_waveform.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Transient differential signal development Delta_V = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at t = 9.5 ns prior to latch activation under nominal conditions (TT, 27 degC, 1.8V)** | `110.5 mV` | +/- 10 mV | PEX-extracted transient SPICE simulation (.MEASURE TRAN deltav VAL='V(bl)-V(blb)' AT=9.5n) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Worst-case PVT corner differential signal development across SS/FF/SF/FS corners (-40 degC to 125 degC)** | `98.2 mV` | +/- 8 mV (must remain >= 90.0 mV minimum boundary) | Multi-corner corner automated transient SPICE batch sweep |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Sense amplifier latch resolution time from SAN/SAP assertion to 90% rail separation (|V(BL) - V(/BL)| >= 1.62 V)** | `4.2 ns` | +/- 0.8 ns | Transient SPICE waveform measurement (.MEASURE TRAN t_latch TRIG V(san) VAL=0.9 FALL=1 TARG VAL='ABS(V(bl)-V(blb))' VAL=1.62 RISE=1) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions validated; zero read latching errors in 1,000 Monte Carlo runs with worst-case degraded storage node charge; formal signoff report approved by Circuit Design Lead and Systems Engineer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Sense Amplifier Threshold Mismatch & Dynamic Latching Margin Monte Carlo Sign-off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Domain Council:** DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council — Circuit Design Group  

---

### 1. Process & Latching Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     PEX Parasitic      │
│        Netlist         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Bitline Equalization  │
│         V_DD/2         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Charge Sharing Delta  │
│           V            │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAN Activation Pull   │
│        to V_SS         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAP Activation Pull   │
│        to V_DD         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     1000-Point MC      │
│        Sign-Off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Extraction Setup & Netlist Conditioning:**
   - Import the post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) netlist of the folded bitline sense amplifier and 1T1C access transistor array ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ per access transistor).
   - Annotate extracted bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ and unit stacked cell capacitor $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$.
2. **Bitline Precharge & Equalization Initialization:**
   - Apply the precharge cycle across the equalization network to short complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$, stabilizing both lines precisely at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
3. **Signal Development (Charge Sharing Dynamic Phase):**
   - Assert the wordline ($WL$) on the target access transistor ($T = 85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Evaluate charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ and verify dynamic voltage differential:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
4. **Sense Amplifier Latching Strobe Execution:**
   - Fire the NMOS cross-coupled latch pull-down strobe ($\text{SAN}$ pulling toward $V_{\text{SS}}$), followed by the PMOS latch pull-up strobe ($\text{SAP}$ pulling toward $V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Track latching flip time and monitor differential rail amplification ($\text{BL}$ vs $\overline{\text{BL}}$) to prevent false sensing caused by threshold mismatch.
5. **Monte Carlo Mismatch & Dynamic Latching Sign-Off:**
   - Execute a 1,000-run Monte Carlo statistical analysis incorporating local threshold voltage mismatch ($\Delta V_{\text{th}}$) and access transistor sub-threshold/junction leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to verify dynamic latching margin yield across $3\sigma$ process variations.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                 │
 Temp Boundary┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                 │
              │▒                                       │
 Leakage Limit┤▒                                       │
    C_s Budget┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                                │
Signal Delta V┤████████████████████████████████████████│
              │████████████████████████████████████████│
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      37.5      75.0     112.5   150.0 
```

1. **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$):**  
   - **Target Metric:** $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ (for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$).
2. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$):**  
   - **Target Metric:** $\ge 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal) to $28\text{ fF}$ minimum per cell.
3. **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Current:**  
   - **Target Metric:** $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ boundary.
4. **Retention Window / Operating Thermal Boundary:**  
   - **Target Metric:** Data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at an operating temperature of $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]:**  
  Equalization to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$; differential signal generation equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$; cross-coupled inverter activation via $\text{SAN}$ pulling to $V_{\text{SS}}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**  
  Access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current requirement $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**  
  Minimum capacitance requirement of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ ensuring data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; stacked capacitor dielectric targets.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline architecture operating at V_DD = 1.8V with V_DD/2 (0.9V) bitline precharge, the net differential signal developed from a 25 fF cell onto a 250 fF parasitic bitline is Delta V = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_BL) = ~81.8 mV. If the statistical threshold voltage mismatch (sigma_Delta_Vth) of the cross-coupled NMOS latch pair exceeds 12 mV, the dynamic 3-sigma offset reaches 36 mV, consuming >44% of the signal margin before factoring in wordline capacitive coupling, precharge equalization imbalance, and array IR drop. A multi-corner Monte Carlo simulation must evaluate dynamic latching across 10,000 runs to guarantee a Bit Error Rate (BER) < 1e-9 during sense activation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Pelgrom's matching coefficient (A_Vth) in standard 180nm CMOS processes typically ranges from 4.5 mV*um to 6.5 mV*um for NMOS and 6.0 mV*um to 8.5 mV*um for PMOS. For high-density sense amplifiers constrained to W/L = 0.6 um / 0.18 um to pitch-match an 8F² cell array, sigma_Vth = A_Vth / sqrt(W * L) evaluates to ~5.29 mV, yielding a pair differential mismatch sigma_Delta_Vth = sqrt(2) * 5.29 mV = 7.48 mV. Dynamic activation rate (slew rate of SAN pulling down and SAP pulling up) critically determines latch resolution: activating SAN too abruptly induces common-mode to differential conversion via asymmetric drain-gate overlap capacitances (C_gd mismatch), while activating too slowly causes cell charge decay through subthreshold leakage.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Targeting an open-source 180nm CMOS foundry run requires verified Process Design Kit (PDK) statistical mismatch models (e.g., monte carlo distribution parameters for TOXE, VTH0, CJ, and CDSC). If the chosen shuttle foundry lacks validated dynamic mismatch card parameters for ultra-narrow sense amplifier pairs, wafer yield will deviate dramatically from SPICE predictions. Second-source tape-out compatibility requires defining guard-banded design rules for minimum active area (W*L >= 0.12 um²) to avoid anomalous random dopant fluctuation (RDF) outliers not covered by commercial compact models.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier Monte Carlo sign-off sits on the critical path bridging layout parasitic extraction (PEX) and full-chip array functional tape-out. Verification iterations must not delay physical GDSII handoff: 10,000-point Monte Carlo runs across 5 process corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) at 3 temperature corners (-40°C, 27°C, 125°C) require distributed SPICE compute nodes to complete within 36 hours. Milestone exit requires definitive parametric yield sign-off before committing to silicon mask fabrication.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Sense Amplifier Latch Reversal: NMOS latch threshold mismatch exceeds developed differential cell voltage (Delta V_BL < Delta V_th_pair), causing inverted data latching during read operations.
1. Destructive Read Flip due to Over-aggressive SAN Slew Rate: Rapid SAN pull-down causes excessive bitline droop before regenerative feedback establishes, pulling the storage node below the bistable trip point and corrupting cell data.
1. Stuck Equalization Offset: Residual differential charge on complementary bitlines prior to sensing caused by asymmetric gate-drain overlap parasitic capacitance (C_ov) in the precharge/equalizer transistors.

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 2 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (anti-static, chemical resistant), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and chemical splash safety goggles, Full electrostatic discharge (ESD) certified cleanroom coat with grounded wrist strap, Closed-toe ESD-dissipative safety shoes
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin exposure: Flush affected area immediately with Copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE. Eye exposure: Irrigate eyes continuously using cleanroom eye wash station for 15 minutes, holding eyelids apart; obtain immediate ophthalmologist evaluation. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to fresh air outdoor zone; administer oxygen if respiratory distress occurs.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom Class 100 laminar flow air recirculation (HEPA/ULPA filtration, face velocity 0.45 m/s +/- 0.05 m/s). Dedicated volatile organic chemical (VOC) acid/solvent point exhaust extraction velocity >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) at all solvent bench hoods.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Solvent waste (IPA, Acetone) collected separately into dedicated grounded stainless steel solvent carboys; do not combine with aqueous acid/peroxide streams. Peroxide-bearing rinses directed to hazardous acid neutralization tank with automated sodium bisulfite titration to reduce residual oxidizers prior to pH neutralization (target pH 6.8 - 7.5).

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-Silicide / Pre-Metal 1 Contact Open state, pristine chemical-clean surface free of organic residue and particulate contamination (defect density < 0.05/cm²).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Argon-passivated or ultra-thin chemically passivated native-oxide-controlled tungsten plug contacts ready for Metal 1 sputter barrier deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled ambient humidity exposure induces rapid native oxide (SiO_x) regrowth on poly/active contact landing areas, causing contact resistance variance (R_contact) to escalate by > 300%, destroying sense amplifier symmetrical conductance and invalidating Monte Carlo threshold mismatch margins.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## $C_{BL} / C_s$ Charge-Sharing Ratio & $\Delta V$ Metric Verification Sign-off

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX Netlist)│
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Storage Capacitance Verification (Cs)│
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: Bitline Parasitic Capacitance (C_BL) │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 4: Dynamic Readout Charge-Sharing & ΔV │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 5: Sign-off & Tolerance Pass/Fail Gate │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governs the post-layout metrological verification and sign-off for the **charge-sharing ratio ($C_{BL} / C_s$)** and **readout differential signal voltage ($\Delta V$)** on the open-source 180nm 1T1C $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM architecture.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Netlist Generation**:
   - Execute 3D field-solver / calibrated rule-based parasitic extraction on the verified LVS layout of the $8F^2$ unit cell matrix and folded bitline sense amplifier (BL / $\overline{\text{BL}}$) paths.
   - Include access transistor gate-overlap capacitances, bitline contact junction capacitance, and adjacent line-to-line coupling at the 360 nm to 400 nm bitline pitch.

2. **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Static & Dynamic Extraction**:
   - Extract the total capacitance of the crown/cylinder stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - Ensure cell capacitance $C_s$ satisfies the physical retention budget across the cell plate node at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$) Extraction**:
   - Calculate total parasitic loading $C_{BL}$ along the full folded bitline rail, summing bitline metal capacitance, shared contact parasitic junctions, and sense amplifier input node capacitances.
   - Compute the charge-sharing ratio:
     $$\text{Ratio} = \frac{C_{BL}}{C_s}$$

4. **Equalization & Charge-Sharing $\Delta V$ Simulation**:
   - Set initial precharge state: equalized bitlines at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Initialize cell storage voltage: logic high ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and logic low ($V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Assert the wordline ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) to trigger charge dumping:
     $$Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$$
   - Measure the developed differential voltage $\Delta V$ across the folded complementary bitlines prior to sense amplifier latch activation (SAN/SAP):
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$

5. **Sign-off Review & Quality Gate**:
   - Compare extracted $C_s$, $C_{BL}$, $\Delta V$, and junction leakage metrics against the sign-off criteria.
   - Log compliance data into metrology tracking and issue sign-off approval.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Unit | Measurement Method / Physical Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$\ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$** (Min. threshold: **$28\text{ fF}$**) | Post-layout PEX extraction of stacked crown/cylinder capacitor structure |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$\le 250\text{ fF}$** | Extracted distributed RC along full folded bitline pitch (360 nm – 400 nm) |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | Transient readout simulation before sense amplifier strobe activation |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Subthreshold & Junction)** | **$\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$** | DC leakage extraction at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; baseline values $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: $8F^2$ cell geometry with access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum storage capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 1T1C storage capacitor target $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² architecture at the 180nm node, bitline capacitance C_BL easily balloons beyond 250 fF if inter-metal dielectric (IMD) thickness and adjacent bitline-to-bitline coupling capacitances (C_BL-BL) are underestimated in 2.5D/3D field solver extraction. A C_BL/C_s ratio exceeding 8:1 severely compresses the sensing differential signal Delta V below 100 mV, reducing the noise margin against array substrate bounce, wordline coupling noise, and sense amplifier V_th mismatch.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 1.8 V core supply with mid-rail precharge (V_pre = 0.90 V), extracting parasitic drain-to-substrate junctions and metal fringe caps without accounting for sub-threshold leakage will overstate effective C_s and under-extract dynamic C_BL during sensing transitions. Accurate RC extraction must decouple plate-line bounce from storage node node-to-substrate capacitance, guaranteeing Delta V = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - 0.9 V) >= 110 mV across worst-case SS/125°C corners.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard open-source 180nm mixed-signal foundry PDKs utilize planar thick gate oxides and standard MIM or trench capacitor modules where dielectric thickness variation (T_ox/T_diel) tolerance can reach +/-10%. If high-K dielectric modules are unavailable and standard nitride/oxide stacks are used, maintaining C_s >= 25 fF within an 8F² cell footprint requires aggressive stacked capacitor aspect ratios that stress open-source reticle and etch availability.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off must not become a tape-out bottleneck; full-chip extracted spice-level netlists with distributed RCK models across a 512-cell bitline segment must converge within 24 hours of cluster run time. Deliverables must provide clear binary go/no-go boundaries for mask fabrication release without necessitating manual parasitic post-processing.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier differential signal starvation (Delta V < 80 mV) caused by elevated bitline parasitic fringe capacitance (C_BL > 300 fF) leading to read sensing inversion and high soft-error rates.
1. Plate-line voltage droop during wordline access coupling back into the complementary bitline (/BL), cancelling the charge-sharing delta.
1. Storage node node-to-substrate reverse junction leakage degrading stored V_cell below 1.5 V within retention refresh time prior to sense activation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-01` | **Post-Layout Parasitic Extraction of C_BL/C_s Ratio across 512-Bitline Segment** | Synopsys StarRC / Mentor Calibre xRC parasitic field solver integrated with Spectre/HSPICE circuit simulator | 1. Run 3D parasitic extraction on bitline BL0 and complementary /BL0 including all metal layers (M1 bitline, M2 wordline strapping, M3 power mesh), junction capacitance, and storage node MIM/stacked capacitor extraction. 2. Measure total lumped storage cell capacitance C_s at node SN. 3. Measure total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance C_BL along the 512-cell bitline segment. 4. Calculate ratio R = C_BL / C_s. 5. Perform transient simulation stepping wordline WL high (1.8 V + V_pump) with stored '1' (1.8 V) and stored '0' (0.0 V) under mid-rail precharge (0.90 V). | `Total storage capacitance C_s must be >= 25.0 fF and <= 32.0 fF. Total bitline capacitance C_BL must be <= 225.0 fF. The calculated ratio C_BL/C_s must be <= 9.0:1. The transient simulation must verify developed differential voltage |Delta V| >= 110 mV at SA strobe trigger time.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-02` | **Monte Carlo Mismatch & Dynamic Delta-V Noise Margin Verification** | Cadence Spectre Monte Carlo Mismatch Engine / 3-sigma Process Corner Simulator | 1. Set initial conditions: Cell(0,0) stores '1' (1.8 V), adjacent bitlines pattern alternating 1/0 data to simulate worst-case pattern-dependent capacitive crosstalk. 2. Precharge BL and /BL to 0.900 V +/- 5 mV offset. 3. Run a 1000-point Monte Carlo simulation varying transistor V_th (access transistor and SA latch pair) and MIM dielectric thickness across FF, SS, FS, SF corners at -40°C, 27°C, and 125°C. 4. Measure bitline separation (Delta V = V_BL - V_/BL) precisely 2.5 ns after WL assertion (prior to SAN/SAP latch activation). | `Minimum observed Delta V across all 1000 Monte Carlo runs and 3-sigma process corners must be >= 85 mV. Nominal Delta V must be >= 110 mV. Zero sensing latch resolution failures (flip to incorrect state) across all runs.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe cleanroom coat, Class 100 nitrile gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved UV/impact safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA cleaning solvent, flush immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes. For eye contact, flush at emergency eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical evaluation if irritation persists. For vapor inhalation, move personnel to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom ISO Class 5 recirculation with HEPA filtration; local exhaust ventilation (LEV) on manual wafer probe/metrology inspection stages maintaining face velocity >= 100 fpm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Dispose of solvent-soaked wipes in dedicated sealed, grounded flammable waste containers. Do not pour organic solvent residues into municipal or acid drains.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, for hardware metrology station cleaning)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-LVS clean GDSII/OASIS layout with completed dummy metal fill and passivated silicon test wafer (if physical metrology correlation probe is executed).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Signed-off extraction dataset archived; wafer surface sealed under dry N2 cassette awaiting subsequent packaging or physical electrical wafer sort.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air risks atmospheric moisture adsorption and surface native oxidation on unpassivated pad layers, leading to degraded probe contact resistance and false parasitic capacitance measurement artifacts during physical silicon correlation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Formal verification and sign-off of the C_BL/C_s charge-sharing capacitance budget and differential read voltage (Delta V) for the 180nm 8F² 1T1C DRAM cell, guaranteeing robust read sensing margins across all process-voltage-temperature (PVT) operating regimes.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_8f2_cbl_cs_signoff_report.pdf`
- [ ] `parasitic_charge_sharing_monte_carlo_data.csv`
- [ ] `transient_delta_v_sensing_waveform_plot.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance C_s must meet nominal charge-storage target** | `28.0 fF` | +/- 3.0 fF | 3D field solver parasitic RC extraction (Calibre xRC / StarRC) |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Charge-sharing ratio C_BL / C_s along 512-cell bitline segment** | `7.5:1` | <= 8.5:1 maximum limit | Post-layout extraction netlist summation of all bitline parasitic components |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Worst-case read differential signal Delta V prior to sense amplifier latch activation** | `115 mV` | >= 95 mV minimum under 3-sigma SS corner at 125 deg C | Spectre/HSPICE transient dynamic read simulation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 confirmed satisfied with zero DRC/LVS violations, zero Monte Carlo sensing latch failures across 1000 iterations, and formal sign-off approval documented in dram_180nm_8f2_cbl_cs_signoff_report.pdf.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Parasitic Extracted RC Netlist Generation for 8F² Folded Bitline & Storage Node

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) [DRAM Architecture] > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) [Circuit Design] > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off [Circuit Design] > C_BL/C_s Charge-Sharing Ratio & Delta-V Metric Verification Sign-off [Metrology] > Parasitic Extracted RC Netlist Generation for 8F² Folded Bitline & Storage Node [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The RC extraction of the 8F² folded bitline array must explicitly capture 3D inter-wire coupling capacitance (C_BL-BL) and wordline-to-bitline fringe capacitance (C_WL-BL) along 512 cells per bitline column. If total bitline capacitance C_b exceeds 250 fF against a 28 fF storage cell (C_s), the C_b/C_s ratio will breach the 9:1 threshold, degrading delta-V sense amplifier differential read margins below 100 mV and causing widespread sensing errors during fast cycle reads.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture, the storage node plug (W-plug) passes adjacent to the folded bitline metal line. Field solver extraction must account for dielectric constant variation of the ILD (SiO2 vs low-k SiOF) and barrier layers (Ti/TiN); underestimating the storage-node to bitline parasitic coupling (C_SN-BL) will cause severe read-disturb during sense amplifier strobing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tungsten chemical vapor deposition (WF6/SiH4 precursor chemistry) for the storage node and bitline contact plugs has tight vendor tolerances. Discrepancies between foundry nominal via contact resistance (Rc > 30 ohms/contact) and the simulated parasitic deck could invalidate RC corner models across TT, FF, and SS process splits.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The delivery of calibrated post-layout SPEF and DSPF netlists is on the critical path for the sense amp pitch-matching sign-off. Milestone gating requires automated extraction scripts integrated into open-source EDA flow (Magic/Netgen/KLayout or OpenRCX) with DRC clean verification before cell array sign-off freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-bitline coupling capacitance exceeds 35% of total C_b, causing adjacent bitline differential signal cancellation during read activation.
1. High contact resistance at the tungsten storage node plug (> 50 Ohm) creating excessive RC write-recovery delay, leading to incomplete cell data latching at 180nm cycle times.
1. Over-aggressive parasitic reduction filtering in the extraction rule deck pruning distributed RC segments into lumped models, disguising distributed delay and high-frequency sense amplifier bounce.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-01` | **Extraction Accuracy & Bitline Total Parasitic Capacitance Verification** | OpenRCX / FastCap 3D Field Solver / Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (on wafer kerf test structure) | 1. Execute 2.5D/3D parasitic field extraction on the bitline conductor path over a 512-cell column including shared bitline contacts, gate fringe caps, and adjacent floating bitlines. 2. Export extracted netlist in DSPF and SPEF format. 3. Integrate total lumped and distributed capacitance along BL and /BL paths. 4. Compare extracted total capacitance against TCAD calibrated model and test chip CV profile. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance (C_b) must be within 150 fF <= C_b <= 220 fF per 512-cell bitline, and the C_b/C_s ratio must satisfy 5.0 <= C_b/C_s <= 8.5 with C_s = 28.0 fF.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-02` | **Storage Node Parasitic Resistance & Dynamic Charge-Sharing Delta-V Evaluation** | SPICE/Spectre circuit simulator with BSIM4 180nm PDK models, automated Monte Carlo parasitic netlist runner | 1. Instantiate extracted 1T1C sub-circuit with parasitic RC network in transient SPICE simulation setup. 2. Initialize storage node to VDD (1.8V) for logic '1' and bitline pair precharged to VDD/2 (0.90V). 3. Assert wordline WL to 2.8V (boosted VPP) with 1.5ns rise time. 4. Measure bitline differential split delta-V = |V_BL - V_/BL| across the sense amplifier inputs prior to sense amplifier latch strobing. | `Differential voltage margin delta-V must be >= 135 mV at 85°C across TT, FF, and SS process corners; storage node path parasitic series resistance must not exceed 45 Ohms.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, chemical-resistant outer), ANSI Z87.1 certified splash-proof chemical safety goggles and full face shield, Acid-gas respirator (for wet-bench bypass maintenance), Static-dissipative cleanroom gown, hood, and conductive booties
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse affected skin with copious water for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until medical assistance arrives. For WF6 inhalation or contact: Move victim immediately to fresh air, provide 100% oxygen, and seek emergency specialized medical treatment for fluoride poisoning.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid and toxic gas scrubbers operating under continuous negative pressure (face velocity >= 0.5 m/s at fume hood sash) with point-of-use burn-wet thermal abatement for pyrophoric/toxic effluent gases.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous fluorinated waste streams must be routed to automated calcium fluoride precipitation tanks (lime slurry neutralization to pH 7.5 - 8.5) ensuring fluoride discharge concentrations stay below 10 ppm.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (99.999%) | `100%` |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## GDSII Layer Mapping & 2.5D Field Solver Extraction Rule Deck Setup for 8F² Layout

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) establishes the configuration, layer mapping, dielectric profile definitions, and boundary conditions required for 2.5D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) on a 180nm $8F^2$ folded-bitline DRAM cell architecture. It defines the setup parameters to accurately extract cell storage node capacitance ($C_s$) and bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$) to ensure the required sensing margin ($\Delta V$).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    GDSII Layer Map     │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Dielectric &      │
│   Conductor Profile    │
│         Setup          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boundary Extraction   │
│       & Meshing        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  2.5D Field Solver RC  │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      C_BL and C_s      │
│        Sign-off        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream Layer-to-Techfile Mapping**:
   - Parse the layout stream and map GDSII layer numbers and datatypes to extraction layer aliases:
     - Active Area / Diffusion: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Gate / Wordline (WL): Poly silicon gate, physical oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$.
     - Bitline Contact (BLC): Shared contact between adjacent cell pairs via tungsten plug (W-plug).
     - Bitline (BL): Metal/poly interconnect with pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
     - Storage Node Contact (SNC): W-plug landing onto access transistor drain.
     - Storage Node Capacitor (SN / Crown): Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/cylinder geometry.
     - Cell Plate / Top Plate: Common capacitor upper electrode.

2. **Conductor Material & Resistivity Deck Setup**:
   - Define bulk resistivities and sheet resistances for polysilicon wordlines ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch), tungsten plugs (W-plugs), metal bitlines, and crown/cylinder storage node electrodes.
   - Configure contact interface resistance boundaries at the shared bitline contact and storage node contact interfaces.

3. **Dielectric Stack & High-k Field Solver Profile Configuration**:
   - Parameterize the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) stack surrounding the bitline and wordlines.
   - Configure gate oxide properties ($SiO_2$, physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up the stacked capacitor high-k dielectric layer parameters:
     - Material: ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric or $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ stack.
     - Permittivity: Effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
     - Equivalent Oxide Thickness: $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.

4. **2.5D Boundary Condition & Discretization Setup**:
   - Define multi-conductor windowing and boundary conditions for folded-bitline complementary pairs ($BL$ and $/BL$).
   - Set conformal boundary meshing along the vertical crown/cylinder sidewalls and neighboring bitlines to capture lateral fringing capacitance ($C_{coupling}$) and ground plane capacitance accurately.

5. **RC Parasitic Extraction Execution & Netlist Formatting**:
   - Execute the 2.5D field solver rule deck over the extracted cell tile and neighboring array perimeter.
   - Generate the distributed DSPF/SPEF parasitic RC netlist including storage node lumped-equivalent capacitance ($C_s$), bitline line parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$), and mutual coupling components.

6. **Sign-Off Verification**:
   - Calculate the charge-sharing differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Validate that the extracted $C_s$, $C_{BL}$, and resulting $\Delta V$ satisfy circuit sensing constraints.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                       Extraction Metric Budgets        
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
Delta V Signal┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
 C_BL (Target)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_s (Target)┤█████                                   │
              │█████                                   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0      62.5      125.0    187.5   250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ (nominal $25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$) | $\ge 25\text{ fF/cell}$ minimum | 2.5D field solver lumped extraction |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250\text{ fF}$ | $\pm 10\%$ ($225\text{ to } 275\text{ fF}$) | PEX distributed netlist summation |
| **Signal Development Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ | $[100, 150]\text{ mV}$ | Post-layout charge-sharing readout evaluation |
| **Dielectric Effective Permittivity ($\kappa$) & EOT** | $\kappa > 15$; $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ | $\text{EOT} \in [3.0, 4.0]\text{ nm}$ | Dielectric rule deck specification check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node structure: Crown-shaped polysilicon / MIM structure erected via tungsten plug (W-plug) in a capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture.
  - Dielectric stack: ONO triple dielectric or $Ta_2O_5 / Al_2O_3$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Storage capacitance requirement: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Readout operation: Charge dumping $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto equalized bitline ($V_{DD}/2$).
  - Differential signal formulation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Extracted capacitance metrics: Typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, typical $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding expected $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Retention threshold: Storage capacitance maintained at $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Dielectric thickness: Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$ ($Si_3N_4$ or $Ta_2O_5$).
  - Interconnect geometry: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$; gate oxide dry oxidation thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline cell at 180nm, GDSII layer mapping often collapses distinct physical mask layers (e.g., bitline contact landing plug vs. storage node contact via) into standard metal/via numbers, destroying the 2.5D field solver's vertical mesh representation. The field solver boundary condition setup must account for fringe coupling from adjacent passing wordlines over shallow trench isolation (STI) to ensure the C_BL/C_s ratio maintains sensing margin ΔV > 150 mV into sense amplifiers.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Standard digital 2.5D extraction decks (such as basic OpenRCX tables) use lateral parallel plate assumptions that fail around the high aspect ratio storage node capacitor cylinder and landing pads. The field solver rule deck must model 3D fringe corner effects, non-planar interlayer dielectric (ILD) conformality, and bottom-plate cell-plate (CP) shield capacitance to avoid underestimating bitline parasitic capacitance C_BL by up to 35%.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Translating GDSII datatypes into open-source EDA extraction decks (e.g., Magic VLSI tech files, FasterCap/FastCap decks, OpenRCX) requires tight synchronization with the foundry 180nm PDK layer map. Discrepancies between multi-project wafer (MPW) reticle layer numbers and internal extraction decks risk fab mismatch or silicon discrepancy requiring an unplanned re-spin.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off verification for parasitic RC extraction rule decks must be gated prior to multi-megabit array simulations. If extraction rule calibration drifts past the scheduled sign-off date, cell design freeze will slip, causing schedule compression on the peripheral sense amplifier pitch matching and sense timing margin sign-off.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Layer mapping omission of Storage Node Contact (SNC) plug dielectric liner causing underestimation of bitline-to-storage-node coupling capacitance and resulting in false read-disturb pass margins.
1. Misconfigured dielectric constant (k-value) in 2.5D rule deck for high-density inter-metal dielectric (HDP-CVD oxide vs PECVD TEOS) leading to >20% parasitic skew in bitline capacitance C_BL.
1. Omission of folded bitline true/complement (BL/BL#) inter-wire lateral fringe extraction in dense 8F² pitch, resulting in sense amplifier sensing failure under worst-case pattern data stripes.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-1-01` | **GDSII Layer Map Integrity and Dielectric Stack Height Extraction Calibration** | KLayout GDSII Stream Parser, FasterCap 3D Electrostatic Field Solver, Python/SciPy verification harness | 1. Ingest 8F² cell GDSII layout and translate polygons to boundary-element mesh using the defined layer mapping file. 2. Instantiate a 3x3 array of 8F² cells to incorporate spatial boundary proximity effects. 3. Execute 2.5D/3D field solver extraction on the central cell storage node and bitline conductor structures. 4. Compare simulated extracted self-capacitance and mutual capacitances against analytical calibrated benchmark limits. | `All GDSII layers mapped 100% without unassigned polygon boundaries. Storage node parasitic capacitance C_sn_par extracted within 0.85 fF to 1.15 fF, and bitline unit-length capacitance C_bl_unit within 0.22 fF/um to 0.28 fF/um (discrepancy < 5% vs reference 3D field solver mesh).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-1-02` | **Folded Bitline Inter-wire Coupling and C_BL/C_s Ratio Extraction Sign-Off** | FastCap/FasterCap Boundary Element Solver, Ngspice 42+ Circuit Simulator | 1. Run rule deck extraction across the 128-cell folded bitline layout segment to extract lumped and distributed RC netlists. 2. Verify mutual coupling capacitance C_cross between adjacent BL and BL# conductors. 3. Back-annotate the extracted parasitic netlist into SPICE and simulate charge sharing with a nominal cell capacitance C_s = 25.0 fF initialized to V_DD = 1.8 V and BL precharged to V_DD/2 = 0.9 V. 4. Measure bitline sensing differential voltage ΔV = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_BL / C_s). | `Extracted total bitline capacitance C_BL must not exceed 175 fF per 128-cell bitline segment (yielding C_BL/C_s <= 7.0). Simulated bitline differential voltage signal ΔV must be >= 112.5 mV at sense amplifier strobe activation.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (Class 100 compatible), UV-blocking Safety Glasses (ANSI Z87.1+), Antistatic ESD-safe Lab Coat and Grounding Wrist Strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For inhalation: Move personnel immediately to fresh uncontaminated air. For skin contact: Flush skin thoroughly with copious water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse continuously at eye wash station for 15 minutes lifting eyelids. Seek medical assistance if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory chemical fume hood with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) and HEPA laminar air recirculation complying with ISO Class 5 / Class 100 cleanroom standards.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent wipes and volatile liquid waste in dedicated, grounded, explosion-proof, DOT-approved hazardous solvent waste drums for certified hazardous disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Tier 3 (VLSI Grade) | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone (Cleanroom surface wipe)** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) oxide post-CMP planarized, scrubbed, particle-free (<0.02 defects/cm2), desiccated at 22 deg C.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Pre-contact lithography surface dry, native oxide passivated under clean dry nitrogen purge prior to vacuum contact plug deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and native oxide regrowing exceeding 1.5 nm at contact interfaces, leading to contact resistance spikes (>500 Ohm per contact plug) and severe RC signal degradation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified GDSII layer mapping configuration and 2.5D field solver parasitic extraction rule deck calibrated against full 3D boundary element simulations for 180nm 8F² folded bitline DRAM cells.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_8f2_gds_layer_map.json`
- [ ] `dram_cell_8f2_field_solver_rules.ext`
- [ ] `dram_8f2_rc_extraction_validation_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total bitline parasitic capacitance per 128-cell column segment (C_BL) must remain bounded to sustain sense amplifier dynamic range.** | `160.0 fF` | +/- 10% | 2.5D Field Solver Boundary Element Method Netlist Extraction verified via FasterCap |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Field solver extraction accuracy vs. full 3D electrostatic solver gold-standard across inter-bitline coupling (C_cross).** | `0.042 fF/cell` | +/- 5% | Gold-standard 3D mesh boundary element solver comparison benchmark |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal sign-off requires 100% layer map matching with zero unmapped GDSII datatypes, an extracted C_BL/C_s ratio <= 7.0 for the 8F² array layout, and zero discrepancy flags between the field solver rule deck and the 180nm PDK design manual.

testcases.pre_conditions: 8F² DRAM cell layout streamed out to GDSII format; layer mapping file (tech.lyp / map) loaded; 180nm process technology file specifying oxide thicknesses (ILD0=600nm, ILD1=700nm, STI depth=350nm) and relative permittivity values (SiO2 eps_r=3.9, Si3N4 eps_r=7.5).
testcases.procedure: 1. Ingest 8F² cell GDSII layout and translate polygons to boundary-element mesh using the defined layer mapping file. 2. Instantiate a 3x3 array of 8F² cells to incorporate spatial boundary proximity effects. 3. Execute 2.5D/3D field solver extraction on the central cell storage node and bitline conductor structures. 4. Compare simulated extracted self-capacitance and mutual capacitances against analytical calibrated benchmark limits.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: All GDSII layers mapped 100% without unassigned polygon boundaries. Storage node parasitic capacitance C_sn_par extracted within 0.85 fF to 1.15 fF, and bitline unit-length capacitance C_bl_unit within 0.22 fF/um to 0.28 fF/um (discrepancy < 5% vs reference 3D field solver mesh).

testcases.title: Folded Bitline Inter-wire Coupling and C_BL/C_s Ratio Extraction Sign-Off
testcases.instrumentation: FastCap/FasterCap Boundary Element Solver, Ngspice 42+ Circuit Simulator
testcases.pre_conditions: Calibrated 2.5D RC rule deck compiled into OpenRCX/Magic extraction format; 8F² layout containing 128-cell folded bitline pair segment (BL and BL#) with tied storage nodes.
testcases.procedure: 1. Run rule deck extraction across the 128-cell folded bitline layout segment to extract lumped and distributed RC netlists. 2. Verify mutual coupling capacitance C_cross between adjacent BL and BL# conductors. 3. Back-annotate the extracted parasitic netlist into SPICE and simulate charge sharing with a nominal cell capacitance C_s = 25.0 fF initialized to V_DD = 1.8 V and BL precharged to V_DD/2 = 0.9 V. 4. Measure bitline sensing differential voltage ΔV = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_BL / C_s).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Extracted total bitline capacitance C_BL must not exceed 175 fF per 128-cell bitline segment (yielding C_BL/C_s <= 7.0). Simulated bitline differential voltage signal ΔV must be >= 112.5 mV at sense amplifier strobe activation.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (Class 100 compatible)
UV-blocking Safety Glasses (ANSI Z87.1+)
Antistatic ESD-safe Lab Coat and Grounding Wrist Strap
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For inhalation: Move personnel immediately to fresh uncontaminated air. For skin contact: Flush skin thoroughly with copious water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse continuously at eye wash station for 15 minutes lifting eyelids. Seek medical assistance if irritation persists.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Laboratory chemical fume hood with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) and HEPA laminar air recirculation complying with ISO Class 5 / Class 100 cleanroom standards.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Collect spent solvent wipes and volatile liquid waste in dedicated, grounded, explosion-proof, DOT-approved hazardous solvent waste drums for certified hazardous disposal.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) oxide post-CMP planarized, scrubbed, particle-free (<0.02 defects/cm2), desiccated at 22 deg C.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Pre-contact lithography surface dry, native oxide passivated under clean dry nitrogen purge prior to vacuum contact plug deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Moisture absorption and native oxide regrowing exceeding 1.5 nm at contact interfaces, leading to contact resistance spikes (>500 Ohm per contact plug) and severe RC signal degradation.

expected_result.summary: Verified GDSII layer mapping configuration and 2.5D field solver parasitic extraction rule deck calibrated against full 3D boundary element simulations for 180nm 8F² folded bitline DRAM cells.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Total bitline parasitic capacitance per 128-cell column segment (C_BL) must remain bounded to sustain sense amplifier dynamic range.
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 2.5D Field Solver Boundary Element Method Netlist Extraction verified via FasterCap

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Field solver extraction accuracy vs. full 3D electrostatic solver gold-standard across inter-bitline coupling (C_cross).
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Gold-standard 3D mesh boundary element solver comparison benchmark

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Formal sign-off requires 100% layer map matching with zero unmapped GDSII datatypes, an extracted C_BL/C_s ratio <= 7.0 for the 8F² array layout, and zero discrepancy flags between the field solver rule deck and the 180nm PDK design manual.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Parasitic RC Extraction of Folded Bitline & Storage Node Contacts with W-Plug Interconnects

**Discipline / Category**: Circuit Design  
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline layout at the 180nm node, parasitic RC extraction must accurately resolve bitline-to-wordline fringe capacitances, adjacent bitline mutual capacitance (C_BL-BL), and the storage node contact (SNC) to bitline coupling capacitance. An underestimation of C_BL by even 15% collapses the sensing margin: with a storage capacitance budget C_S = 28 fF, excessive bitline capacitance (C_BL > 250 fF) degrades the charge-sharing ratio (C_S / (C_S + C_BL)) and drops differential read signal Delta-V below 150 mV, inducing read disturb and false sensing at the sense amplifier latch.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The high aspect ratio (~3:1 to 4:1) of the tungsten (W) plug interconnects for both the shared bitline contact (BLC) and storage node contact (SNC) creates critical series resistance bottlenecks. Failure to model the Ti/TiN liner specific contact resistivity (rho_c > 5e-8 Ohm*cm^2 on n+ diffusion) and the tungsten core seam voiding will yield an optimistic parasitic resistance netlist. Distributed RC delay across the 512-cell folded bitline segment will cause severe RC skew, slowing down bitline precharge/equalization and write-recovery times.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The Ti/TiN barrier metal atomic layer deposition (ALD/PVD) targets and high-purity WF6/SiH4 precursors for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) W-plug fill represent significant lead-time vulnerabilities and cost escalations. If parasitic extraction mandates an overly aggressive plug contact diameter or dual-depth contact etch to compensate for contact resistance, foundry yields across local Southeast Asian packaging and fab facilities will plummet due to missing high-density chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries compatible with 180nm open-source design rules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off timelines for Milestone M2 layout freezing depend on an automated, verified parasitic extraction pipeline. Unsynchronized design rule checking (DRC) and layout-versus-schematic (LVS) rules for 3D field-solver parasitic netlists will bottleneck tapeout preparation. The parasitic extraction flow must produce standardized, back-annotated SPEF/DSPF netlists within a 48-hour turn-around cycle to prevent multi-week delays across adjacent digital peripheral integration teams.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-Storage-Node (BL-SN) capacitive crosstalk causing pattern-dependent data flip or charge loss during adjacent cell sense operations.
1. High contact resistance (R_c > 35 Ohm/contact) at the W-plug/n+ active area junction causing excessive RC time constant, leading to write-time failure during fast column cycle operations (t_WC < 10 ns).
1. W-plug CMP over-polishing (erosion and dishing) or TiN barrier breach causing open-circuit contact failure or junction spiking into p-well substrate.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-2-01` | **Parasitic Folded Bitline Capacitance (C_BL) and Coupling Extraction Sign-Off** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with Multi-frequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU, 1 kHz - 5 MHz) and semi-automated cryogenic/ambient probe station | 1. Connect high-force terminal of MFCMU to the selected folded bitline (BL_true) pad and low-force terminal to complementary bitline (BL_comp) and wordline (WL) shielding ground. 2. Apply a 100 kHz, 30 mV RMS AC oscillation overlaid on a 0.9 V DC bias (V_BL precharge level). 3. Measure total line capacitance C_BL_total across 512 access cell nodes. 4. Re-configure probes to measure adjacent bitline coupling capacitance (C_BL-BL) and storage node coupling capacitance (C_BL-SN) by biasing neighboring lines and grounding substrate. 5. Subtract de-embedding fixture parasitics (open-pad capacitance) and extract per-cell parasitic capacitance. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance per cell pitch must be <= 0.35 fF/cell (total bitline C_BL <= 180 fF for 512-cell column segment). Adjacent line coupling capacitance ratio C_BL-BL / C_BL_total must be <= 18.0%. Charge-sharing ratio C_S / (C_S + C_BL) must yield Delta-V >= 165 mV at C_S = 28 fF, V_DD = 1.8 V.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-1-2-02` | **Kelvin and TLM Specific Contact Resistivity Sign-Off for W-Plug Bitline and Storage Node Interconnects** | Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer with 4-point Kelvin nanoprobes and high-resolution automated wafer prober | 1. Place Kelvin 4-point probes on individual Kelvin contact structures (BLC and SNC) and force DC current sweep from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA while recording voltage drop V_c. 2. Extract individual contact resistance R_c from slope dV/dI at V = 0 V. 3. Measure total resistance R_T across TLM pad pairs with gaps d = 5, 10, 20, 40, and 80 um. 4. Perform linear regression of R_T versus d: extract slope (R_s / W), y-intercept (2 * R_c), and transfer length L_T. 5. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Single W-plug contact resistance R_c must be <= 25.0 Ohm per contact (diameter = 200 nm). Specific contact resistivity rho_c on n+ diffusion must be <= 4.0e-8 Ohm*cm^2. Total 1000-contact chain resistance must not exceed 28.0 kOhm with linear ohmic behavior (correlation coefficient R^2 >= 0.998).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A fully encapsulating chemical-resistant suit with positive-pressure self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) during CVD chamber maintenance and precursor changeout, Heavy-duty butyl rubber outer gloves over nitrile inner barrier gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles and full-face polycarbonate impact shield, Anti-static, ESD-safe cleanroom boots with chemical resistance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF and fluorinated precursor (WF6 hydrolysis) exposure: Immediately wash affected skin with copious flowing water for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into the skin until pain ceases. For ocular exposure, flush with sterile 1% Calcium Gluconate eye solution for 15 minutes. In case of inhalation of WF6/HF fumes, administer 100% oxygen and nebulized 2.5% Calcium Gluconate solution immediately; summon emergency medical transport.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative-pressure toxic gas containment enclosure with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). CVD exhaust piped through point-of-use thermal decomposition gas scrubbers coupled with multi-stage wet caustic scrubbing systems to capture toxic HF and TiCl4 acidic fumes prior to cleanroom atmospheric discharge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous fluoride-bearing effluents must be treated in a dedicated wastewater neutralization reactor with calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurries to precipitate non-hazardous calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge at pH 8.5 - 9.5. Solid tungsten-contaminated CMP slurries must be coagulated, separated, and containerized as heavy-metal hazardous industrial waste.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (6N, 99.9999%) | `100% Compressed Liquefied Gas` |
| **Silane (SiH4)** | `7803-62-5` | Semiconductor Grade (5N5, 99.9995%) | `100% Pyrophoric Compressed Gas` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Ultra-High Purity Grade (5N) | `>= 99.9% Liquid` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | Semiconductor Grade (SLSI) | `49% Aqueous Solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD/ILD-1) contact holes etched and cleaned down to n+ active area diffusion and polysilicon gates, verified residue-free with native oxide thickness <= 0.8 nm post-dilute HF (100:1) dip.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal Ti/TiN (10 nm / 15 nm) barrier/seed bilayer deposited via ALD/PVD, completely passivating active contact bottoms and sidewalls, sealed against atmospheric oxidation prior to blanket W-CVD fill.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding 30 minutes in ambient air results in rapid native silicon oxide (SiO2) re-growth (> 1.5 nm) at the contact bottom and titanium oxidation (TiO2 formation), causing contact resistance to spike by > 300% and triggering irreversible film delamination during CVD tungsten deposition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified, silicon-correlated parasitic RC extraction rule deck and back-annotated SPEF/DSPF netlists for the 8F² folded bitline cell matrix and tungsten-plug storage node contacts at the 180nm node, validating sufficient sensing margin (Delta-V >= 165 mV) and low contact resistance (R_c <= 25 Ohm).

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_8f2_folded_bl_parasitic_extracted.spef`
- [ ] `w_plug_blc_snc_kelvin_tlm_characterization_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dram_cell_rc_signoff_matrix_and_monte_carlo_distribution.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Folded bitline parasitic capacitance per cell segment (C_BL_cell)** | `0.32` | +/- 0.03 fF/cell | Multi-frequency C-V measurement at 100 kHz on 512-cell bitline test array with open-short de-embedding |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Single contact resistance for 200nm W-plug BLC and SNC contacts (R_c)** | `21.5` | +/- 3.5 Ohm | 4-point Kelvin contact nanoprobing DC sweep (-1 mA to +1 mA) on dedicated wafer scribe-line test keys |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) at W-plug/n+ Si diffusion interface** | `3.2e-8` | +/- 0.6e-8 Ohm*cm^2 | Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) structure linear regression across pad spacings d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full convergence of 3D field-solver RC extraction against physical Kelvin and TLM hardware measurements across nominal and corner dies, with C_BL <= 180 fF for a 512-cell column, single plug R_c <= 25 Ohm, and minimum calculated sense-amplifier differential read signal Delta-V >= 165 mV under worst-case 85°C junction temperature operating conditions.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Parasitic Netlist RC Reduction, Back-Annotation Verification & BL-WL Cross-Coupling Metrology Sign-off  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Circuit Design & Metrology Sign-off (8F² Folded Bitline Topology)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Full Layout       │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Parasitic RC      │
│       Reduction        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      DSPFC / SPEF      │
│    Back-Annotation     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Transient Simulation  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    BL-WL Metrology     │
│        Sign-off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Raw RC Parasitic Netlist Ingestion & Boundary Definition**
   - Import the 3D field-solver parasitic extraction netlist (DSPF/SPEF) for the 8F² folded bitline memory array, access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), tungsten plug (W-plug), and capacitor-over-bitline (COB) storage node.
   - Designate critical observation nodes: bitline true/complement ($BL$, $\overline{BL}$), wordline ($WL$), and storage node ($SN$).

2. **Parasitic Netlist RC Network Reduction**
   - Apply frequency-dependent pole-residue / selective $\pi$-model reduction algorithms to collapse distributed interconnect parasitic mesh networks along wordlines and bitlines with 360–400 nm pitch.
   - Filter parasitic sub-fF decoupling elements without collapsing inter-wire cross-coupling capacitors ($C_{WL-BL}$, $C_{BL-\overline{BL}}$) or gate-overlap capacitances ($C_{gd}$, $C_{gs}$).

3. **Schematic Back-Annotation & Structural Audit**
   - Back-annotate the reduced parasitic RC network into the 180nm CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier and 1T1C array transient simulation harness.
   - Perform a DC continuity and topology audit to ensure access transistor gate dielectric physical thickness (~3.5 nm thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$) and storage node connectivity remain uncompromised.

4. **Dynamic Transient Readout & Cross-Coupling Metrology Execution**
   - Equalize $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ to $V_{DD}/2$ using the equalization transistor network prior to wordline activation.
   - Assert $WL$ to turn on the access transistor, dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline.
   - Measure bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$, cell capacitance $C_s$, readout differential voltage $\Delta V$, and transient cross-coupling noise induced by wordline switching onto the adjacent bitline pairs.

5. **Sign-off Validation & Archive**
   - Verify that all electrical and physical parameters satisfy the required sign-off thresholds at 85°C.
   - Export back-annotated timing/voltage reports and freeze netlists into the design archive.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metrology Target | Acceptance Metric Target | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Extracted capacitor metrology / AC simulation |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Parasitic RC extraction back-annotation |
| **Differential Sensing Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ (millivolts) | Transient differential sense simulation at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Sub-threshold & Junction)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Static DC metrology at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Verified Context Citations

- **Storage Cell Capacitance ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) & Leakage ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$):**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Minimum 28 fF capacitance budget, sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C).
  - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Minimum capacitance of 25 to 30 fF per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C; gate dielectric $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
- **Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$) & Readout Margin ($\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$):**
  - *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$).
- **Geometry & Array Pitch ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Pitch = $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$):**
  - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: RC network reduction using order-reduction algorithms (e.g., TICER or PRIMA) must rigorously preserve wordline-to-bitline (WL-BL) transfer impedances and cross-coupling capacitance (C_c) up to the 5th harmonic of array operating frequency (minimum 500 MHz for 180nm DRAM Gen 2). Over-simplification of distributed gate-drain overlap or sidewall fringe parasitics risks hiding sense amplifier kickback and false sensing trips during folded-bitline read access.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline layout, wordline pass lines crossing over diffusion-to-bitline contact pads produce significant 3D fringe and parallel-plate coupling. When back-annotating extracted RC into SPICE, any parasitic reduction must not lump cross-coupling capacitances directly to ground; doing so skews the differential sense margin delta-V below the 150 mV requirement and obscures WL toggling noise on floating unselected bitlines.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology verification relies on on-wafer parametric Kelvin test structures, TLM pads, and high-bandwidth RF/C-V probing cards. Sourcing specialized low-leakage probe cards (fA and fF sensitivity) compatible with manual probe stations in a decentralized domestic pilot line introduces lead times of 8 to 12 weeks; design-for-test (DFT) test structures must accommodate standard 100 um pitch micro-pads.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off must not become a bottleneck between layout DRC/LVS closure and tapeout mask generation. The back-annotation flow and SPICE simulation regression across typical, fast-fast, and slow-slow parasitic corners must be automated with clear threshold gates to prevent infinite manual netlist tweaking.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Aggressive RC reduction truncates inter-line BL-WL coupling nodes, resulting in unmodeled capacitive injection during WL rise that leads to destructive read disturbs in adjacent cells.
1. Discrepancies between 3D field-solver extraction and TLM test-chip measurements due to contact plug resistance underestimation (exceeding specific contact resistivity limit rho_c > 1e-6 Ohm*cm^2), degrading sensing delay by >35%.
1. Improper ground-reference assignment during back-annotation causing phantom loop inductances or artificial DC offsets in bitline precharge leveling (VBLP = VDD/2).

Eye contact: Rinse cautiously with sterile eye-wash solution for at least 15 minutes lifting lower and upper eyelids; consult an ophthalmologist. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to fresh air immediately; administer artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
