An actionable Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been authored and documented in the project repository at [`docs/sop_pvt_corner_netlist_extraction_precharge_equalization_testbench.md`](docs/sop_pvt_corner_netlist_extraction_precharge_equalization_testbench.md).

### Summary of Authored SOP

#### 1. Workflow Architecture
The structural workflow rendered with `termaid` establishes four sequential phases:
```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  PVT Corner Netlist  │
│      Extraction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Testbench       │
│   Instantiation &    │
│        Sizing        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Precharge &      │
│     Equalization     │
│      Transient       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│       Sign-off       │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

#### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure
- **Step 1: Multi-Corner Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)**: Execute 3D field-solver PEX on DRC/LVS-clean layout to extract interconnect parasitics, metal sheet resistance, and inter-bitline cross-coupling. Generate back-annotated DSPF/SPEF netlists for TT, FF, and SS process corners spanning $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V} \pm 10\%$ ($1.62\text{ V to } 1.98\text{ V}$) and $T = -40^\circ\text{C to } +85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Step 2: Precharge Equalization Network & Cell Testbench Setup**: Instantiate the folded-bitline structure with lumped post-layout capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and cell storage capacitor $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$. Connect the 3-transistor NMOS equalization network to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ controlled by signal $EQ$. Connect the cross-coupled regenerative sense amplifier ($N$-sense pair to $SAN$, $P$-sense pair to $SAP$, initialized to $0.9\text{ V}$).
- **Step 3: Wordline Boost ($V_{PP}$) & Clock Driver Configuration**: Configure wordline overdrive rail $V_{PP} = 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$ (Dickson oscillator pump with non-overlapping clocks $\Phi_1, \Phi_2$ at $20\text{ MHz to } 50\text{ MHz}$) to prevent access transistor threshold loss ($V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$). Sequence phases: $EQ \to \text{LOW}$, $WL \to V_{PP}$ pulse, charge-sharing interval, followed by $SAN \to 0\text{ V}$ and delayed $SAP \to V_{DD}$.
- **Step 4: SPICE Simulation & Dynamic Metric Extraction**: Execute multi-corner transient simulations (`.tran 10ps 100ns`), verifying bitline precharge settling $|V(BL) - V(\overline{BL})| \le 1.0\text{ mV}$ and differential read signal $\Delta V$ prior to sensing strobe.

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target Metric | Unit | Physical Context / Verification Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Precharge Equalization Voltage ($V_{BL,eq}$)** | $0.90 \pm 0.01$ ($V_{DD}/2$) | $\text{V}$ | Nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, steady-state on $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ during $EQ = \text{HIGH}$ |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0\text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Signal development after WL assertion for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ across all PVT corners |
| **Wordline Boost Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.5\text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | Regulated Dickson charge pump overdrive rail ($V_{PP} \ge V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}}$) |
| **Sensing Strobe Activation Delay ($t_{SAP - SAN}$)** | $1.0\text{ to } 2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ | Inter-latch delay between $SAN \to \text{GND}$ pull-down and $SAP \to V_{DD}$ pull-up |

#### 4. Verified Literature Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Bitline equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; charge transfer relationship $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$; differential development equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF} \implies \Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**: Equalization reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$; wordline boost from $0\text{ V}$ to $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$); sequential latching with $SAN \to \text{GND}$ followed by $SAP \to V_{DD}$ after $1\text{ to } 2\text{ ns}$ delay.
- **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**: NMOS access transistor $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$; elimination of 33% threshold loss ($V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.2\text{ V}$) via $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$; clocking at $20\text{ MHz to } 50\text{ MHz}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The precharge and equalization circuit must maintain Bitline (BL) and Bitline-bar (/BL) pair symmetry across all 45 PVT extraction corners. An uncompensated parasitic resistance skew or capacitance mismatch Delta C_BL exceeding 1.5% between true and complement bitlines directly eats into the nominal 150 mV to 180 mV sense margin. Furthermore, the testbench must accurately couple the boosted wordline driver supply (V_PP = 2.6 V) parasitics into the precharge timing network to ensure the precharge equalization gate driver (BLEQ) does not suffer premature turn-off during fast corner (FF, 1.98 V, -40 deg C) sub-nanosecond switching.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm open-source node rules (8F2 cell footprint, cell capacitance C_s ~ 25 fF to 30 fF, bitline capacitance C_BL ~ 250 fF to 300 fF), the precharge voltage V_BLP must be held rigidly at V_DD/2 (0.900 V +/- 15 mV). In post-layout extraction (PEX) netlists, clock feedthrough and channel charge injection from the BLEQ NMOS pass gates inject an asymmetric offset charge onto BL and /BL unless balanced dummy cancellation structures or optimized gate transition times (t_fall ~ 200 ps to 350 ps) are enforced. The testbench setup must explicitly include transistor-level Monte Carlo mismatch models (V_th and W/L variations) in conjunction with extracted RCLK parasitic networks.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: EDA tooling interoperability between open-source PEX extractors (e.g., Magic VLSI / KLayout with open_pdks) and proprietary foundry sign-off corner decks (180nm CMOS mixed-signal / embedded DRAM option) presents significant PDK qualification overhead. Failure to standardize the SPICE subcircuit syntax and parasitic node name mapping between open-source Ngspice/Xyce and commercial simulator sign-off formats risks a 4 to 6 week tapeout slip and potential multi-project wafer (MPW) reticle submission rejection.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: This work package bridges the transition from physical DRC/LVS layout extraction to dynamic metrology sign-off. Milestone gate sign-off requires precharge equalization settling time t_EQ <= 2.5 ns across all extreme PVT corners (SS/FF/FS/SF, V_DD +/- 10%, -40 deg C to +125 deg C) with zero DC leakage path through the half-V_DD generator. A strict 5-day cycle time budget is allocated for 1,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch characterization before freezing the cell array boundary coordinates.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Equalization Residual Offset (> 12 mV): Asymmetric channel charge injection and parasitic drain/source capacitance mismatch between BL and /BL pull up one bitline prematurely, causing false sensing read flips during low-temperature fast corner (FF, -40 deg C) operations.
1. V_BLP Mid-Rail Droop / Crowbar Conduction: Simultaneous conduction of precharge driver pull-down/pull-up branches during slow corner (SS, 1.62 V, 125 deg C) transitions leads to excessive dynamic power draw (> 4.5 mW/bank) and local ground bounce collapsing the internal precharge reference level.

Assert precharge enable signal BLEQ from 0 V to 1.80 V with a 250 ps linear rise time at t = 1.0 ns. 2. Monitor transient voltage waveforms V(BL) and V(/BL) for 10 ns. 3. Measure settling time t_EQ defined as the duration from 50% BLEQ assertion until |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV. 4. ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety spectacles with side shields, Static-dissipative cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100 compatible, double-gloved, 6 mil thickness), Fully grounded ESD-safe lab coat / smock with continuous conductive carbon filament grid, Static-dissipative heel grounders and toe straps on calibrated conductive cleanroom flooring
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: IPA Skin/Eye Contact: Immediately flush with flowing deionized water for at least 15 minutes while holding eyelids open. Remove contaminated apparel. Inhalation of vapor/gas: Immediately remove subject to fresh, uncontaminated ambient air; supply artificial respiration or medical oxygen if breathing is labored. Accidental ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical direction; seek emergency medical care immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous cleanroom air recirculation through dedicated ceiling laminar-flow HEPA/ULPA filtration units maintaining minimum 90 ft/min face air velocity; dedicated local solvent exhaust ducting operating under continuous negative pressure (-0.05 in. w.g.) for workstation degreasing areas.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning rags and lint-free wipes must be deposited into spring-loaded, self-closing FM-approved flammables waste receptacles. Liquid IPA effluents must be segregated into clearly labeled UN-certified fluoropolymer carboys and transferred to hazardous chemical waste recycling according to regional EPA Title 40 CFR guidelines.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-CMP tungsten bitline contact (W-plug) and Metal-1 copper interconnect pads cleaned, planarized, and verified free of slurry micro-scratches and organic residue.

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified, fully sign-off compliant PVT extraction netlist and comprehensive SPICE equalization testbench demonstrating sub-2.5 ns bitline precharge recovery, under 3.5 mV residual post-equalization offset, and guaranteed minimum 110 mV read sense differential across 45 PVT corners and 3-sigma Monte Carlo mismatch.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Monte Carlo & PVT Corner Simulation for C_BL/C_s Ratio & Delta-V Development

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) [DRAM Architecture] > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) [Circuit Design] > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off [Circuit Design] > C_BL/C_s Charge-Sharing Ratio & Delta-V Metric Verification Sign-off [Metrology] > C_BL/C_s Ratio & Sense Margin Sign-off Verification across PVT & Mismatch Corners [Metrology] > Monte Carlo & PVT Corner Simulation for C_BL/C_s Ratio & Delta-V Development [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm 8F² architecture, parasitic capacitance extraction (PEX) for bitline capacitance (C_BL) must account for wire-to-wire sidewall coupling between adjacent metal bitlines and bitline-to-substrate fringing capacitance across dense memory arrays. Assuming nominal lumped capacitance without 3D field-solver validation risks underpredicting C_BL by 25-35%. The charge-sharing ratio C_BL/C_s directly throttles bitline sense amplifier differential voltage (Delta-V = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_BL / C_s)). For a 1.8V V_DD, V_BL_precharge = 0.90V, and storage capacitance C_s = 25 fF, keeping C_BL under 250 fF (ratio C_BL/C_s <= 10) is mandatory to guarantee a nominal Delta-V >= 82 mV, preventing signal collapse at worst-case PVT corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Sense amplifier offset voltage (V_os) induced by threshold voltage mismatch (Delta-V_th) and geometric mismatch in cross-coupled NMOS/PMOS pairs can reach 25-35 mV at 3-sigma in standard 180nm planar CMOS. If Monte Carlo process-voltage-temperature (PVT) analysis reveals that C_BL/C_s degrades beyond 12:1 at slow-NMOS/slow-PMOS (SS) and high-temperature (125°C) corners, the sensing signal Delta-V drops below 70 mV. Accounting for dynamic noise, wordline-to-bitline capacitive kick, and bitline-to-bitline crosstalk (Delta-V_noise ~ 30 mV), the effective net sensing margin collapses below 15 mV, leading to destructive read failures and non-recoverable retention loss.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: EDA compute licensing and PDK model maturity represent primary supply chain bottlenecks for open-source 180nm MPW runs. Accurate Monte Carlo statistical mismatch characterization requires calibrated Pelgrom coefficients (A_Vth, A_beta) within the open PDK. If fab-calibrated statistical models for deep sub-micron MOS capacitances and metal dielectric thickness variations (ILD inter-layer dielectric CMP dishing +/-15%) are unverified or omitted from the PDK model deck, simulation margins must be artificially widened, forfeiting die density and requiring additional revision tape-out cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sign-off schedule risk is elevated by the combinatorial explosion of full-array parasitic extraction combined with 5,000-run Monte Carlo PVT simulations across 5 process corners (TT, FF, SS, SF, FS), 3 voltage points (1.62V, 1.80V, 1.98V), and 3 temperature steps (-40°C, 27°C, 125°C). The metrology team must freeze layout freeze boundaries, instantiate reduced-order RC macro-models for the 512-cell bitline segment, and automate regression scripts to prevent project timeline slippage past the multi-project wafer (MPW) shuttle tape-out deadline.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline signal collapse (Delta-V < 45 mV) under SS/125°C/1.62V corner due to C_BL expansion (> 280 fF) and C_s depletion capacitance degradation, causing sense amplifier decision inversion.
1. Dynamic bitline-to-bitline coupling crosstalk exceeding 35 mV during simultaneous adjacent bitline transitions, causing false sensing read flip on floating half-V_DD bitlines.
1. Sense amplifier strobe timing failure where wordline turn-on to sense amplifier enable (t_RCD margin) is violated because increased RC bitline delay delays differential voltage development.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

critics.systems_engineer: In a 180nm 8F² architecture, parasitic capacitance extraction (PEX) for bitline capacitance (C_BL) must account for wire-to-wire sidewall coupling between adjacent metal bitlines and bitline-to-substrate fringing capacitance across dense memory arrays. Assuming nominal lumped capacitance without 3D field-solver validation risks underpredicting C_BL by 25-35%. The charge-sharing ratio C_BL/C_s directly throttles bitline sense amplifier differential voltage (Delta-V = (V_DD / 2) / (1 + C_BL / C_s)). For a 1.8V V_DD, V_BL_precharge = 0.90V, and storage capacitance C_s = 25 fF, keeping C_BL under 250 fF (ratio C_BL/C_s <= 10) is mandatory to guarantee a nominal Delta-V >= 82 mV, preventing signal collapse at worst-case PVT corners.
critics.domain_expert: Sense amplifier offset voltage (V_os) induced by threshold voltage mismatch (Delta-V_th) and geometric mismatch in cross-coupled NMOS/PMOS pairs can reach 25-35 mV at 3-sigma in standard 180nm planar CMOS. If Monte Carlo process-voltage-temperature (PVT) analysis reveals that C_BL/C_s degrades beyond 12:1 at slow-NMOS/slow-PMOS (SS) and high-temperature (125°C) corners, the sensing signal Delta-V drops below 70 mV. Accounting for dynamic noise, wordline-to-bitline capacitive kick, and bitline-to-bitline crosstalk (Delta-V_noise ~ 30 mV), the effective net sensing margin collapses below 15 mV, leading to destructive read failures and non-recoverable retention loss.
critics.supply_chain: EDA compute licensing and PDK model maturity represent primary supply chain bottlenecks for open-source 180nm MPW runs. Accurate Monte Carlo statistical mismatch characterization requires calibrated Pelgrom coefficients (A_Vth, A_beta) within the open PDK. If fab-calibrated statistical models for deep sub-micron MOS capacitances and metal dielectric thickness variations (ILD inter-layer dielectric CMP dishing +/-15%) are unverified or omitted from the PDK model deck, simulation margins must be artificially widened, forfeiting die density and requiring additional revision tape-out cycles.
critics.laya_pm: Sign-off schedule risk is elevated by the combinatorial explosion of full-array parasitic extraction combined with 5,000-run Monte Carlo PVT simulations across 5 process corners (TT, FF, SS, SF, FS), 3 voltage points (1.62V, 1.80V, 1.98V), and 3 temperature steps (-40°C, 27°C, 125°C). The metrology team must freeze layout freeze boundaries, instantiate reduced-order RC macro-models for the 512-cell bitline segment, and automate regression scripts to prevent project timeline slippage past the multi-project wafer (MPW) shuttle tape-out deadline.
critical_failure_modes: Bitline signal collapse (Delta-V < 45 mV) under SS/125°C/1.62V corner due to C_BL expansion (> 280 fF) and C_s depletion capacitance degradation, causing sense amplifier decision inversion.
Dynamic bitline-to-bitline coupling crosstalk exceeding 35 mV during simultaneous adjacent bitline transitions, causing false sensing read flip on floating half-V_DD bitlines.
Sense amplifier strobe timing failure where wordline turn-on to sense amplifier enable (t_RCD margin) is violated because increased RC bitline delay delays differential voltage development.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: Sense Amplifier Offset & Sensing Margin Sign-off Metric Validation
- **Hierarchy Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > 1T1C Access Transistor & Bitline Contact Layout DRC/LVS Design (8F²) > Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) Extraction & Parasitic Metric Sign-off > C_BL/C_s Charge-Sharing Ratio & Delta-V Metric Verification Sign-off > C_BL/C_s Ratio & Sense Margin Sign-off Verification across PVT & Mismatch Corners > Sense Amplifier Offset & Sensing Margin Sign-off Metric Validation
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)

---

## 1. Operational Flowchart & Phase Progression

```text
│                        │
│      Precharge &       │
│  Equalization BL, /BL  │
│        = VDD/2         │
│                        │

             │

             ▼

│                        │
│   WL Boost Pulse to    │
│          VPP           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Signal Development   │
│  Delta V: 100-150 mV   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   SAN Pull-down NMOS   │
│       Activation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    SAP Pull-up PMOS    │
│       Activation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Full Rail Signal    │
│  Restoration & Offset  │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Precharge and Bitline Equalization Verification
- Equalize complementary bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ using the equalization NMOS transistor network gated by signal `EQ`.
- Force precharge voltage to $V_{\text{BLP}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$. Verify both $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ stabilize at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ prior to wordline activation.
- Ensure the equalization switch shuts off cleanly (`EQ` transitions low) before wordline transition.

### Step 2: Boosted Wordline Pulsing & Charge Transfer
- Apply boosted wordline drive voltage $V_{\text{PP}}$ between **$2.6\text{ V}$ and $2.8\text{ V}$** to overdrive the NMOS access gate without threshold loss ($V_{\text{DD}} + V_{\text{th}}$).
- Transfer storage charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$ onto the active bitline for cell capacitance $C_s \in [25\text{ fF}, 30\text{ fF}]$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$) across a bitline parasitic load $C_{\text{BL}} \in [150\text{ fF}, 250\text{ fF}]$ (for 256/512 cells per bitline).
- Maintain folded bitline array layout footprint at **$8F^2$** ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).

### Step 3: Differential Read Signal ($\Delta V$) Extraction
- Measure differential voltage swing developed across the cross-coupled nodes:
  $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
- Confirm that nominal differential signal development achieves $\Delta V \in [100\text{ mV}, 150\text{ mV}]$.
- Verify that bitline-to-cell capacitance ratio $C_{\text{BL}} / C_s$ resides strictly between **$5:1$ and $9:1$** (rejection threshold $> 10:1$).

### Step 4: Sense Amplifier Sequential Regeneration & Latch Offset Sign-off
- **Phase A (N-Sense Activation)**: Pull common source node `SAN` (initially at $V_{\text{DD}}/2$) rapidly to $\text{GND}$ via NMOS pulldown switch. The higher gate voltage NMOS conducts harder, driving the lower potential bitline toward $0\text{ V}$.
- **Phase B (P-Sense Activation)**: Trigger PMOS pull-up switch driving `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$ with an intentional **$1\text{ ns}$ to $2\text{ ns}$ sequential delay** post-`SAN` assertion.
- Measure regenerative latch threshold mismatch (dynamic and static input-referred offset voltage $V_{\text{os}}$) across folded bitline pairs under PVT corners. Verify differential sensing margin:
  $$\text{Margin} = \Delta V - V_{\text{os}} > 0\text{ mV}$$
  ensuring full restoration to rails ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$) without flipping or meta-stability.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter ID | Parameter Description | Target / Specification Limit | Unit | Validation Mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AC-SA-01** | Differential Read Signal ($\Delta V$) | **$100\text{ to }150$** | $\text{mV}$ | Transient Simulation / LVS Parasitic Sign-off |
| **AC-SA-02** | Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) | **$25.0\text{ to }30.0$** (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | LVS / Parasitic Extraction ($C$-Matrix) |
| **AC-SA-03** | Parasitic Capacitance Ratio ($C_{\text{BL}} / C_s$) | **$5.0:1\text{ to }9.0:1$** (Hard limit: $< 10.0:1$) | ratio | Netlist Extraction Ratio Sign-off |
| **AC-SA-04** | Boosted Wordline Voltage ($V_{\text{PP}}$) | **$2.6\text{ to }2.8$** | $\text{V}$ | Bias Metric / Corner Validation |
| **AC-SA-05** | Sense Delay ($\tau_{\text{SAN-to-SAP}}$) | **$1.0\text{ to }2.0$** | $\text{ns}$ | SA Timing Sign-off |

---

## 5. Literature Citations & Traceability

1. **"Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout"**:
   - Folded-bitline cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch architecture.
   - Precharge and equalization to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Differential signal formula: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}} / 2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
2. **"1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets"**:
   - $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Cell storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ per $256/512$-cell array block.
   - Ratio $C_b / C_s$ budget of $5:1$ to $9:1$ (severe degradation if $> 10:1$).
3. **"Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration"**:
   - $V_{\text{BLP}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ precision reference equalization.
   - Wordline boosted overdrive $V_{\text{PP}} \in [2.6\text{ V}, 2.8\text{ V}]$.
   - Sequential two-stage sensing: `SAN` NMOS pull-down followed by `SAP` PMOS pull-up after a $1\text{ ns to } 2\text{ ns}$ delay.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded-bitline architecture with a 360nm bitline pitch (8F² cell topology), the differential sense amplifier cross-coupled latch must reliably resolve signal margins where ΔV = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_DD/2). With nominal C_s = 25 fF and parasitic C_BL = 250 fF at V_DD = 1.8V, the ideal ΔV is approximately 81.8 mV. If the cross-coupled pair's input-referred threshold mismatch (3σ V_offset) exceeds 35 mV, the worst-case sensing margin collapses to <46.8 mV before bitline-to-bitline inter-wire coupling noise (C_BL-BL) and equalization offset are accounted for. The latch timing sequence—specifically the slew rate and skew between SAN pull-down and SAP pull-up—must be co-optimized with the parasitic RC network to avoid false sensing flips during early amplification.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Sense amplifier transistor matching in 180nm node requires strict adherence to Pelgrom's scaling law (σ_Vth = A_Vth / sqrt(W * L)). Because pitch-matching constraints enforce interleaved layout architectures within a 360nm array pitch, the NMOS and PMOS pair layout must implement common-centroid interdigitated geometries to nullify spatial doping gradients and shallow trench isolation (STI) stress-induced threshold voltage shifts. Equalization transistors (EQ/BLEQ) must also have negligible channel charge injection and clock feedthrough skew between BL and /BL (<1.5 mV residual imbalance), otherwise initial differential pre-charge skew directly erodes the available signal ΔV.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Parametric test and scribe-line test vehicle evaluation for sense amplifier offset and sensing margin require sub-picoampere parametric measurement units (SMU/PMU) and high-frequency automated probe cards compatible with 200mm foundry multi-project wafer (MPW) runs. Specialized probe cards with low contact resistance variation (<0.1 Ω across temperature excursions from -40°C to 125°C) are bottlenecked with 10-14 week procurement lead times. Validating this metrology on MPW test structures requires early booking of foundry wafer-level reliability (WLR) and parametric automated test equipment (ATE) time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier offset validation sits directly on the critical path between parasitic extraction sign-off and final silicon tape-out. Interleaved layout DRC/LVS rule verification and Monte Carlo post-layout extraction take significant compute cycles. Tape-out schedule milestone M2 requires frozen sign-off metrics for sense margin across all 5 PVT corners (FF, SS, TT, FS, SF at -40°C to 125°C with ±10% V_DD) within 3 weeks; any delay in settling the sign-off criteria cascades into late foundry photomask generation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier false latching inversion caused by 3σ V_th mismatch and pre-charge equalization charge injection exceeding the cell readout differential signal (ΔV_read < V_offset_total).
1. Bitline-to-bitline adjacent capacitive crosstalk coupling during SAN latch activation inducing destructive noise spikes (>25 mV) on the quiescent sensing node.
1. Destructive read / incomplete restore where degraded SAP pull-up current fails to restore full 1.8V rail into high-leakage C_s within the active wordline pulse width (t_RAS).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Force common-mode voltage V_CM = 0.900V on complementary sense amplifier nodes BL and /BL via external SMUs. 2. Sweep a quasi-static differential voltage ΔV_in from -100 mV to +100 mV in 0.5 mV steps across BL and /BL. 3. For each voltage step, activate the sense amplifier latch by pulsing SAN to 0V and SAP to 1.8V with 1.2 ns edge rates. 4. Monitor latch output states to detect the transition flip threshold voltage. 5. Repeat binary search iteration across 500 site instances across center, middle, and edge wafer dies to construct statistical offset voltage histogram. | `Mean offset voltage |μ_VOS| ≤ 2.5 mV; 3-sigma offset distribution 3σ_VOS ≤ 22.0 mV; maximum observed single-instance outlier offset |V_OS,max| ≤ 32.0 mV across all sampled dies.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-1-3-3-3-3-02` | **Dynamic Sensing Margin & Latch Resolution Limit vs. PVT Corner Sign-off** | Tektronix AWG70002A Arbitrary Waveform Generator (10 GSa/s), Keysight Infiniium UXR-Series Real-Time Oscilloscope with active differential high-impedance probes (<0.1 pF loading), Temptronic ThermoStream thermal chuck (-40°C to +125°C). | 1. Set thermal chuck temperature to -40°C, 25°C, 85°C, and 125°C sequentially. 2. Program AWG to generate simulated charge-sharing bitline step profiles with controlled ΔV ranging from 150 mV down to 10 mV in decrements of 2 mV to mimic varied C_BL/C_s degradation. 3. Measure bitline differential rail development time t_latch (time to reach 90% rail-to-rail differential). 5. Identify minimum differential input ΔV_min that results in 100% correct latch decisions over 10,000 continuous readout cycles. | `Minimum functional sensing resolution ΔV_min ≤ 35.0 mV across all operating temperatures (-40°C to 125°C) and supply variations (1.8V ± 10%); full-rail differential restore time t_restore ≤ 14.5 ns at worst-case corner (SS, 1.62V, 125°C).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical/impact splash safety glasses, ESD-safe dissipative lab coat, Closed-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye Contact: Immediately flush eyes with clean eyewash water for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical attention if irritation persists. Skin Contact: Wash affected area with mild soap and copious water; remove contaminated clothing. Inhalation: Move subject immediately to fresh air; provide artificial respiration or oxygen if breathing becomes labored. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical guidance; rinse mouth with water and seek immediate medical assistance.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operate within ISO Class 5 laminar flow cleanroom enclosure; dedicated solvent point-of-use local exhaust ventilation (LEV) operating with face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm); continuous ambient oxygen level monitoring (>19.5% O2) in test bay where N2 gas lines operate.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and solvent wipes must be segregated into designated, grounded, flame-proof hazardous waste receptacles labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'; do not drain into municipal or acidic wastewater streams; dispose via licensed hazardous chemical disposal contractor.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched and chemical-mechanical planarized (CMP) Al-Cu/SiO2 top metallization pads, clean and free of organic residues, moisture, or aluminum hydroxide passivation.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probe-tested wafer surfaces with micro-scrub contact witness marks on bonding pads; nitrogen-purged and desiccated to prevent atmospheric galvanic pad corrosion.

critics.systems_engineer: In a 180nm folded-bitline architecture with a 360nm bitline pitch (8F² cell topology), the differential sense amplifier cross-coupled latch must reliably resolve signal margins where ΔV = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_DD/2). With nominal C_s = 25 fF and parasitic C_BL = 250 fF at V_DD = 1.8V, the ideal ΔV is approximately 81.8 mV. If the cross-coupled pair's input-referred threshold mismatch (3σ V_offset) exceeds 35 mV, the worst-case sensing margin collapses to <46.8 mV before bitline-to-bitline inter-wire coupling noise (C_BL-BL) and equalization offset are accounted for. The latch timing sequence—specifically the slew rate and skew between SAN pull-down and SAP pull-up—must be co-optimized with the parasitic RC network to avoid false sensing flips during early amplification.
critics.domain_expert: Sense amplifier transistor matching in 180nm node requires strict adherence to Pelgrom's scaling law (σ_Vth = A_Vth / sqrt(W * L)). Because pitch-matching constraints enforce interleaved layout architectures within a 360nm array pitch, the NMOS and PMOS pair layout must implement common-centroid interdigitated geometries to nullify spatial doping gradients and shallow trench isolation (STI) stress-induced threshold voltage shifts. Equalization transistors (EQ/BLEQ) must also have negligible channel charge injection and clock feedthrough skew between BL and /BL (<1.5 mV residual imbalance), otherwise initial differential pre-charge skew directly erodes the available signal ΔV.
critics.supply_chain: Parametric test and scribe-line test vehicle evaluation for sense amplifier offset and sensing margin require sub-picoampere parametric measurement units (SMU/PMU) and high-frequency automated probe cards compatible with 200mm foundry multi-project wafer (MPW) runs. Specialized probe cards with low contact resistance variation (<0.1 Ω across temperature excursions from -40°C to 125°C) are bottlenecked with 10-14 week procurement lead times. Validating this metrology on MPW test structures requires early booking of foundry wafer-level reliability (WLR) and parametric automated test equipment (ATE) time.
critics.laya_pm: Sense amplifier offset validation sits directly on the critical path between parasitic extraction sign-off and final silicon tape-out. Interleaved layout DRC/LVS rule verification and Monte Carlo post-layout extraction take significant compute cycles. Tape-out schedule milestone M2 requires frozen sign-off metrics for sense margin across all 5 PVT corners (FF, SS, TT, FS, SF at -40°C to 125°C with ±10% V_DD) within 3 weeks; any delay in settling the sign-off criteria cascades into late foundry photomask generation.
critical_failure_modes: Sense amplifier false latching inversion caused by 3σ V_th mismatch and pre-charge equalization charge injection exceeding the cell readout differential signal (ΔV_read < V_offset_total).
Bitline-to-bitline adjacent capacitive crosstalk coupling during SAN latch activation inducing destructive noise spikes (>25 mV) on the quiescent sensing node.
Destructive read / incomplete restore where degraded SAP pull-up current fails to restore full 1.8V rail into high-leakage C_s within the active wordline pulse width (t_RAS).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-COB-180-001: Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Classification**: Circuit Design / DRAM Architecture (8F² Folded Bitline)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process & Modeling Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline & Access    │
│       Passivated       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Bitline Formation    │
│        Embedded        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Storage Node Contact  │
│         W-Plug         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  MIM / Crown Storage   │
│     Node Formation     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   High-k Dielectric    │
│      ONO / Ta2O5       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Top Plate Common    │
│       Cell Plate       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Footprint & Access Node Initialization**:
   - Establish an 8F² folded bitline unit cell with footprint area $A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ using feature size $F = 180\ \text{nm}$.
   - Define access NMOS dimensions with channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.
   - Configure wordline (WL) and bitline (BL) pitches to nominal $360\ \text{nm}\text{ to }400\ \text{nm}$.

2. **Buried Bitline & Contact Plug Modeling**:
   - Model the shared bitline contact between adjacent dual cells beneath the storage level.
   - Construct the vertical storage node contact (SNC) via a Tungsten plug (W-plug) landing directly on the access transistor drain region.

3. **Crown 3D Storage Node (Bottom Plate) Synthesis**:
   - Erect the 3D crown/cylinder capacitor structure over the bitline (Capacitor Over Bitline - COB topology).
   - Define cylindrical outer/inner electrode surfaces using polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) metallization to maximize effective surface area ($A_{\text{eff}}$) within the sub-$0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ pitch.

4. **Dielectric Stack & EOT Specification**:
   - Apply conformal high-k capacitor dielectric: Oxide-Nitride-Oxide (ONO) triple stack or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Target an Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) of $3.0\ \text{nm}\text{ to }4.0\ \text{nm}$ to ensure low defect density and suppress tunneling leakage.

5. **Top Plate & Parasitic Ratio Verification**:
   - Form the continuous common cell plate (top electrode) biased at $V_{\text{CP}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Extract bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ ($150\ \text{fF}\text{ to }250\ \text{fF}$ across a 256/512 cell array block) and verify cell storage capacitance $C_s$ to maintain $C_b / C_s$ strictly within $5 : 1\text{ to }9 : 1$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░                                  │
     Leakage @ 85C┤░░                                  │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
   C_b / C_s Ratio┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
               EOT┤▓▓▓▓▓                               │
                  │▓▓▓▓▓                               │
C_s (Storage Node)┤████████████████████████████████████│
                  │████████████████████████████████████│
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Evaluation / Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 25.0\text{ to }30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | SPICE/TCAD Small-Signal C-V Extraction |
| **Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry / High-Frequency C-V Profiling |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $5 : 1\text{ to }9 : 1$ ($\le 10 : 1$ max) | dimensionless | Array Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Subthreshold + Junction I-V at retention target ($> 64\ \text{ms}$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  *(Unit Cell Geometry $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, W-plug COB crown/MIM topology, ONO and $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$, minimum $C_s = 28\ \text{fF}$, leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).*
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  *($8\text{F}^2$ cell footprint, $C_s \ge 25\text{ to }30\ \text{fF}$, data retention time $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, Crown/Cylinder EOT $3\text{ to }4\ \text{nm}$, WL/BL pitch $360\text{ to }400\ \text{nm}$).*
- **Source 3**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*  
  *($8\text{F}^2$ folded bitline area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, nominal $C_s = 28\ \text{fF}$, bitline parasitic $C_b = 150\text{ to }250\ \text{fF}$, capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s = 5 : 1\text{ to }9 : 1$, strict limit $< 10 : 1$).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline layout at 180nm, placing a crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) increases vertical topography drastically (>0.8 µm step height), exacerbating depth-of-focus (DoF) limits on subsequent Metal 1 lithography. Inter-layer dielectric (ILD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) must achieve planarization within ±15 nm across dense and iso array boundaries to prevent metal shorts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Achieving the mandatory 28 fF/cell storage capacitance within a 0.26 µm² unit cell area necessitates an aspect ratio of >5:1 for the bottom electrode crown cylinder if using conventional ONO (κ~5-6). To constrain cylinder height under 0.6 µm, transitioning to an atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) Ta2O5 (κ~25) or Al2O3/Ta2O5 nanolaminate stack with EOT ≤ 3.5 nm is required, while keeping leakage below 1 fA/cell at 1.0V/85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursors for Ta2O5 ALD, specifically Tantalum Ethoxide (PET) or tert-Butylimido-tris(diethylamido)tantalum (TBTDET), face long lead times and require specialized bubbler delivery lines; standard SiH4/NH3 LPCVD ONO provides a safer fallback, though it risks insufficient capacitance budget unless hemispherical grained silicon (HSG) texture is integrated.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Fabricating the sacrificial oxide core, crown etch-back, and wet chemical core-dip etch without toppling tall, thin polysilicon/TiN crown cylinders requires strict capillary-force-free isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor drying, threatening overall yield and wafer cycle time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Crown cylinder mechanical collapse or micro-stiction during sacrificial oxide wet etch stripping caused by surface tension capillary forces, resulting in wordline-to-wordline storage shorts.
1. Dielectric pinhole punch-through or grain-boundary leakage in Ta2O5 film exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C due to inadequate post-deposition high-temperature O2/N2O annealing.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-01` | **Storage Node Capacitance & Dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Measurement** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (CMU) and Cascade Microtech 200mm semi-automated probe station. | 1. Ground bitline contact and substrate/well terminals. 2. Apply a DC bias sweep from -1.5V to +1.5V to top plate (plate electrode) of the 10k-cell capacitor macro. 3. Acquire high-frequency C-V curve at 100 kHz. 4. Extract total parallel capacitance C_total at operating bias V_cell = 0.9V (Vdd/2). 5. Compute single-cell capacitance C_cell = C_total / 10,000. 6. Calculate EOT from cell physical area and known relative permittivity of standard SiO2 reference. | `Single-cell capacitance C_cell must be ≥ 28.0 fF and EOT must be ≤ 3.8 nm. Test fails if C_cell < 25.0 fF.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-02` | **Storage Dielectric Leakage Current and Breakdown Electric Field at Elevated Temperature** | Keithley 4200A-SCS Parameter Analyzer with 4210-PA High-Purity Pre-Amp units and Temptronic ThermoStream thermal chuck. | 1. Connect high-side SMU to common top plate and low-side SMU to storage node contact test array (1,000 cells). 2. Force constant DC bias of V_stress = +1.0V for 10 seconds dwell time. 3. Measure steady-state leakage current I_leak across the 1,000-cell array and normalize per cell (I_leak / 1000). 4. Ramp voltage from 1.0V to 6.0V at 0.1 V/s ramp rate to record destructive dielectric breakdown voltage (V_bd). | `Normalized leakage current at 85°C and 1.0V must be ≤ 1.0 fA/cell. Dielectric hard breakdown voltage V_bd must exceed 4.5V (breakdown field E_bd > 7.0 MV/cm equivalent).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A acid-resistant double Neoprene gloves, Full face shield (polycarbonate) with chemical splash goggles, Acid-resistant chemical apron with sleeve protectors, Cleanroom positive-pressure supplied-air respirator during wet bench bath maintenance
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of HF contact, immediately flush area with copious water for 2 minutes, then generously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until pain ceases; call EMS immediately. For eye exposure, rinse with saline/water for 15 minutes and instill 1% calcium gluconate eye drops.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical etch benches require dedicated acid scrubber exhaust with a continuous face velocity ≥ 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) and differential pressure interlock. ALD precursor deliver cabinet requires toxic gas exhaust with pyrophoric/organic abatement burn-box.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: HF effluent must be isolated into dedicated fluoride waste drains, routed to an automatic calcium chloride (CaCl2) or lime slurry treatment system to precipitate calcium fluoride (CaF2) sludge, followed by pH neutralization to 6.5-8.5 prior to municipal sewer discharge.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched bottom crown electrode surface after sacrificial SiO2 core strip, thoroughly IPA vapor-dried, native-oxide free.

testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (CMU) and Cascade Microtech 200mm semi-automated probe station.
testcases.pre_conditions: 200mm test wafer at post-Metal 1 sinter; 10,000-cell parallel test macro connected via Kelvin 4-point probe pads; chuck temperature stabilized at 25°C ± 0.5°C; CV measurement frequency set to 100 kHz with 30 mV AC oscillation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling
**Council**: DRAM Foundation VN — Multi-Agent Council  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Cell Architecture**: 1T1C Folded Bitline (8F², Cell Area = $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$)  
**Action Type**: Make | **Subsystem**: Architecture & Integration / Circuit Design  

---

### Process & TCAD Simulation Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Access Transistor   │
│      Drain Node      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Ti/TiN Barrier    │
│      Deposition      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  W-Plug Deposition   │
│       and CMP        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Crown Bottom     │
│  Electrode Contact   │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  TCAD RC Extraction  │
│   and Verification   │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **TCAD Grid Setup & Active Transistor Definition**:
   - Construct the 3D TCAD cell domain with unit cell dimensions matching an $8F^2$ folded bitline layout ($A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Define access NMOS channel dimensions with physical gate length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.
   - Define gate oxide insulator as thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with a physical thickness of $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\ \text{nm}$.
   - Set bitline and wordline pitch to $360\ \text{nm}\text{--}400\ \text{nm}$.

2. **Storage Node Contact (SNC) Via Etch & Liner Barrier TCAD Modeling**:
   - Model the anisotropic reactive ion etching (RIE) of the ILD stack down to the active transistor drain node (shared bitline contact is reserved for adjacent cell pairing).
   - Deposit conformal $\text{Ti/TiN}$ adhesion and barrier liner along the SNC sidewalls and bottom interface.
   - Calibrate the metal-semiconductor contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) at the silicon drain interface considering post-implant annealing activation.

3. **W-Plug Deposition & CMP Planarization**:
   - Perform CVD tungsten ($\text{W}$) fill to form the vertical conductive plug connecting the drain diffusion to the Crown Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) bottom electrode.
   - Simulate Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) targeting zero recess at the top ILD plane.
   - Extract lumped and distributed contact resistance $R_{\text{cont}}$ across the $\text{W}$-plug and interfaces.

4. **Crown Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack Boundary Integration**:
   - Place the crown-type capacitor bottom electrode directly atop the planarized W-plug.
   - Configure the capacitor dielectric stack using either:
     - ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) triple dielectric stack, or
     - High-$\kappa$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\ \text{nm}\text{--}4\ \text{nm}$.
   - Model the 3D crown structure to deliver nominal cell storage capacitance $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$.

5. **TCAD Electrical Characterization & Transient RC Extraction**:
   - Solve coupled Poisson, drift-diffusion, and thermal transport equations at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Verify that sub-threshold and reverse-biased junction leakage current does not exceed $1\ \text{fA/cell}$.
   - Sweep bitline parasitic loading $C_b$ across $150\ \text{fF}\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$ (256/512 cells per bitline) to extract the coupled charge transfer time $\tau_{\text{transfer}} \approx R_{\text{cont}} \cdot C_s$.
   - Confirm capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ remains within $5:1$ to $9:1$.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                   DRAM 180nm Cell Extraction Benchmarks
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░░░░                              │
Gate Oxide EOT (nm)┤░░░░░                              │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
  C_b/C_s Ratio Max┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                       │
   Max Leakage (fA)┤▓▓                                 │
                   │▓▓                                 │
    C_s Target (fF)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0        7      14       21      28 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ -- } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | TCAD small-signal C-V extraction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Steady-state I-V leakage integration ($t_{\text{retention}} > 64\ \text{ms}$) |
| **Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $7.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \text{ -- } 9.0 : 1$ ($< 10.0 : 1$ strict limit) | Ratio | Array parasitics extraction with $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Physical / EOT Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ -- } 4.0$ (EOT for high-$\kappa$) | $\text{nm}$ | 1D/2D structural profile verification |

---

### Literature Context References
- **Source 1**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  *(Geometry: $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$; W-plug drain contact to crown structure; high-$\kappa$ $\kappa > 15$; $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$; leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)*.
- **Source 2**: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  *(1T1C $8\text{F}^2/6\text{F}^2$ architecture; $C_s = 25\text{--}30\ \text{fF}$; retention $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; $\text{EOT} = 3\text{--}4\ \text{nm}$ for $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$; dry oxidation $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ with $3.5\ \text{nm}$; pitch $360\text{--}400\ \text{nm}$)*.
- **Source 3**: *1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets*  
  *($8\text{F}^2$ folded bitline area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$; nominal $C_s = 28\ \text{fF}$; array block $C_b = 150\text{--}250\ \text{fF}$; $C_b / C_s$ bound between $5:1$ and $9:1$, strictly $< 10:1$)*.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline COB architecture, the high aspect ratio (>10:1) storage node contact (SNC) plug connects the drain junction of the pass transistor to the bottom crown electrode. Parasitic contact resistance (R_c) in the W-plug network contributes directly to RC charging and discharging latency of the cell node during active restore. If specific contact resistivity (rho_c) exceeds 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm², the restore time constant expands by >12%, degrading tWR (write recovery time) beyond the JEDEC SDR/DDR-180nm specification window under high-temperature (85°C) corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node (contact CD ~200nm, depth ~2.0 µm), W-CVD deposition requires a robust Ti/TiN barrier bilayer. Sub-optimal pre-clean or native oxide regrowth prior to collimated/ionized PVD Ti or ALD TiN leads to non-uniform TiSi2 silicidation at the Si/Ti interface, creating high localized Schottky barriers rather than ohmic conduction. TCAD mesh refinement must resolve the <5 nm interface reaction layer and field-emission tunneling currents across n+ junction doping profiles (>=1e20 cm⁻³) to accurately capture non-linear contact resistance variations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4/H2 reduction chemistries present significant fab lead-time dependencies and supply volatility. High-purity metal-organic precursor availability for ALD TiN liner conformality (TDMAT or TiCl4) is limited in secondary foundry ecosystems. The process TCAD modeling must evaluate whether a conventional PVD Ti/CVD TiN barrier can be sustained to avoid expensive specialized ALD reactor capex on legacy 200mm tooling.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: W-plug contact resistance modeling and physical TLM calibration must gate the upcoming Tapeout Milestone M3. Failure to calibrate simulated R_c against empirical Kelvin and cross-bridge test structures by week 14 risks forcing an unscheduled re-spin of the storage node mask set, introducing an estimated 6-week delay and $45,000 in additional reticle fabrication charges.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Keyhole/void formation inside the high-aspect-ratio SNC via during CVD tungsten seam closure, creating a discontinuous open-circuit or anomalous series resistance peak (>500 Ohm/plug).
1. TiSi2 agglomeration and fluorine penetration from WF6 precursors through defective TiN barrier layers into the active n+ diffusion, causing silicon substrate gouging and junction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.
1. Native SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (>1.2 nm) during excessive air queue time between post-contact etch dip and Ti/TiN deposition, increasing specific contact resistivity rho_c by more than one order of magnitude.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-01` | **Specific Contact Resistivity Extraction via Kelvin and TLM Test Structures** | Automated DC parametric probe station (Keysight B1500A or Keithley 4200-SCS) with 4-wire Kelvin micro-probes, triaxial cabling, and thermal chuck regulated at 25°C and 85°C. | 1. Load wafer onto chuck at 25°C and align 4-wire Kelvin probe configuration across isolated 200nm W-plug contact structures. 2. Force DC current sweep from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 µA increments; measure differential voltage across the Si/TiSi2/TiN/W interface. 3. Verify linearity of I-V curve to confirm purely ohmic behavior and extract single-contact R_c. 4. Measure total resistance R_T between adjacent pads on the TLM test strip for each gap spacing d (5 to 80 µm) with 10 mA forced current. 5. Perform linear regression of R_T vs. d to extract slope (R_s/W), y-intercept (2*R_c), transfer length L_T, and calculate rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. 6. Repeat steps 1-5 across 25 sites per wafer at 85°C. | `Single W-plug contact resistance R_c <= 65 Ohm (mean) with 3-sigma variation <= 15 Ohm across wafer; specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 3.5e-7 Ohm*cm²; I-V correlation coefficient R² >= 0.9995.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-02` | **SNC W-Plug Step Coverage and Void Defect Inspection via Cross-Sectional SEM/TEM** | Dual-beam Focused Ion Beam (FIB) system (FEI Helios NanoLab) integrated with High-Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (HR-STEM) equipped with EDX detector. | 1. Deposit protective carbon/Pt strip over target 8F² dense storage node contact array. 2. Perform Ga+ ion beam milling to extract a <60 nm thick lamella centered precisely through the vertical axis of the 200nm diameter, 2.0 µm deep SNC vias. 3. Transfer lamella to TEM grid and image under 200 kV accelerating voltage in high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) STEM mode. 4. Measure Ti/TiN barrier thickness at top, midpoint sidewall, and contact bottom. 5. Inspect the tungsten core seam for micro-voids or keyholes along the 10:1 aspect ratio column. 6. Run EDX linescan across the silicon/TiSi2/TiN boundary to verify absence of fluorine (F) accumulation (<0.5 atomic %). | `Ti/TiN bottom barrier coverage >= 8.0 nm with continuous sidewall coverage >= 3.5 nm; seam void width <= 5 nm with zero keyhole voids spanning >10% of via height; fluorine concentration at Si interface below EDX detection limit (<0.1 at%).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Chemical Suit (Tychem 2000 or equivalent), Double Heavy-Duty Nitrile/Butyl Rubber Gloves with Viton over-gloves, Full-face positive-pressure SCBA respirator during gas bottle changeout, ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical impact face shield, Static-dissipative cleanroom safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF / WF6 hydrolysis dermal exposure: Immediately flush skin with Copious water for 2 minutes; aggressively massage Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%) into the exposed area; apply continuous calcium re-application until emergency medical services arrive. For WF6 / HF inhalation: Administer 100% humidified medical oxygen and nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate solution under qualified medical supervision.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous toxic gas monitoring with electrochemical and optical infrared sensor heads calibrated for WF6/HF (<0.1 ppm detection limit) and SiH4 (<1 ppm). Process chamber exhaust ducted directly to point-of-use thermal/wet gas scrubbers with minimum face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) and automatic N2 purge interlock triggered on gas box cabinet negative pressure drop (< -0.15 in. w.g.).
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: W-CVD effluent gases must pass through heated burn box (thermal oxidizer >= 800°C) followed by alkaline wet scrubber utilizing recirculating KOH/NaOH solution (pH maintained 9.5 - 11.5) to neutralize HF and precipitate potassium fluorotungstate / silica sludge before discharge to industrial wastewater treatment plant.

| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Semiconductor Grade (99.99%) | `Liquid (High Vapor Pressure)` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) Dilute** | `7664-39-3` | Cleanroom VLSI Grade | `0.5% - 1.0% aqueous solution (pre-metal dip)` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly opened contact via holes following anisotropic dielectric reactive ion etch (RIE), wet post-etch polymer strip, and 100:1 DHF clean; native oxide thickness < 0.3 nm, surface hydrogen-terminated (Si-H).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal 10 nm PVD/CVD Ti/TiN barrier bilayer deposited over bottom contact and sidewalls, fully encapsulating silicon substrate before ambient air exposure.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth exceeding 1.2 nm thickness at the exposed n+ silicon contact bottom induces severe contact unpinning, causing non-ohmic tunnel barriers, non-uniform silicidation, and catastrophic W-plug contact resistance excursions (>1000 Ohm).

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated 3D TCAD process-and-device model and physical validation report for the 180nm COB storage node contact (SNC) W-plug, establishing specific contact resistivity boundaries, barrier step coverage parameters, and parasitic RC impact on DRAM write recovery margins.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `SNC_Specific_Contact_Resistivity_TLM_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `TEM_EDX_SNC_Step_Coverage_Micrograph.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F² folded bitline COB architecture, the high aspect ratio (>10:1) storage node contact (SNC) plug connects the drain junction of the pass transistor to the bottom crown electrode. Parasitic contact resistance (R_c) in the W-plug network contributes directly to RC charging and discharging latency of the cell node during active restore. If specific contact resistivity (rho_c) exceeds 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm², the restore time constant expands by >12%, degrading tWR (write recovery time) beyond the JEDEC SDR/DDR-180nm specification window under high-temperature (85°C) corners.
critics.domain_expert: At the 180nm node (contact CD ~200nm, depth ~2.0 µm), W-CVD deposition requires a robust Ti/TiN barrier bilayer. Sub-optimal pre-clean or native oxide regrowth prior to collimated/ionized PVD Ti or ALD TiN leads to non-uniform TiSi2 silicidation at the Si/Ti interface, creating high localized Schottky barriers rather than ohmic conduction. TCAD mesh refinement must resolve the <5 nm interface reaction layer and field-emission tunneling currents across n+ junction doping profiles (>=1e20 cm⁻³) to accurately capture non-linear contact resistance variations.
critics.supply_chain: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4/H2 reduction chemistries present significant fab lead-time dependencies and supply volatility. High-purity metal-organic precursor availability for ALD TiN liner conformality (TDMAT or TiCl4) is limited in secondary foundry ecosystems. The process TCAD modeling must evaluate whether a conventional PVD Ti/CVD TiN barrier can be sustained to avoid expensive specialized ALD reactor capex on legacy 200mm tooling.
critics.laya_pm: W-plug contact resistance modeling and physical TLM calibration must gate the upcoming Tapeout Milestone M3. Failure to calibrate simulated R_c against empirical Kelvin and cross-bridge test structures by week 14 risks forcing an unscheduled re-spin of the storage node mask set, introducing an estimated 6-week delay and $45,000 in additional reticle fabrication charges.
critical_failure_modes: Keyhole/void formation inside the high-aspect-ratio SNC via during CVD tungsten seam closure, creating a discontinuous open-circuit or anomalous series resistance peak (>500 Ohm/plug).

TiSi2 agglomeration and fluorine penetration from WF6 precursors through defective TiN barrier layers into the active n+ diffusion, causing silicon substrate gouging and junction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell.

Native SiO2 interfacial layer regrowth (>1.2 nm) during excessive air queue time between post-contact etch dip and Ti/TiN deposition, increasing specific contact resistivity rho_c by more than one order of magnitude.

testcases.title: Specific Contact Resistivity Extraction via Kelvin and TLM Test Structures
testcases.instrumentation: Automated DC parametric probe station (Keysight B1500A or Keithley 4200-SCS) with 4-wire Kelvin micro-probes, triaxial cabling, and thermal chuck regulated at 25°C and 85°C.
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm test vehicle wafer completed through Metal-1 CMP; unpassivated test pads containing Kelvin contact arrays (CD 200nm) and linear TLM structures (pad width W = 100 µm, pad length = 50 µm, gaps d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 µm).
testcases.procedure:
1. Load wafer onto chuck at 25°C and align 4-wire Kelvin probe configuration across isolated 200nm W-plug contact structures.
2. Force DC current sweep from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 µA increments; measure differential voltage across the Si/TiSi2/TiN/W interface.
3. Verify linearity of I-V curve to confirm purely ohmic behavior and extract single-contact R_c.
4. Measure total resistance R_T between adjacent pads on the TLM test strip for each gap spacing d (5 to 80 µm) with 10 mA forced current.
5. Perform linear regression of R_T vs. d to extract slope (R_s/W), y-intercept (2*R_c), transfer length L_T, and calculate rho_c = R_c * W * L_T.
6. Repeat steps 1-5 across 25 sites per wafer at 85°C.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Single W-plug contact resistance R_c <= 65 Ohm (mean) with 3-sigma variation <= 15 Ohm across wafer; specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 3.5e-7 Ohm*cm²; I-V correlation coefficient R² >= 0.9995.

testcases.title: SNC W-Plug Step Coverage and Void Defect Inspection via Cross-Sectional SEM/TEM
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-beam Focused Ion Beam (FIB) system (FEI Helios NanoLab) integrated with High-Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscope (HR-STEM) equipped with EDX detector.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer cleaved post-W CMP polishing across designated dense 8F² COB memory cell array test macros.
testcases.procedure:
1. Deposit protective carbon/Pt strip over target 8F² dense storage node contact array.
2. Perform Ga+ ion beam milling to extract a <60 nm thick lamella centered precisely through the vertical axis of the 200nm diameter, 2.0 µm deep SNC vias.
3. Transfer lamella to TEM grid and image under 200 kV accelerating voltage in high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) STEM mode.
4. Measure Ti/TiN barrier thickness at top, midpoint sidewall, and contact bottom.
5. Inspect the tungsten core seam for micro-voids or keyholes along the 10:1 aspect ratio column.
6. Run EDX linescan across the silicon/TiSi2/TiN boundary to verify absence of fluorine (F) accumulation (<0.5 atomic %).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Ti/TiN bottom barrier coverage >= 8.0 nm with continuous sidewall coverage >= 3.5 nm; seam void width <= 5 nm with zero keyhole voids spanning >10% of via height; fluorine concentration at Si interface below EDX detection limit (<0.1 at%).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Storage Node Contact Trench & Ti/TiN Liner CVD TCAD Process Emulation

**Discipline / Category**: Circuit Design  
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Optical Inspection / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The Storage Node Contact (SNC) trench aspect ratio in 180nm 8F² architecture reaches ~4:1 to 5:1. Ti/TiN liner step coverage via CVD must guarantee conformal bottom coverage (>50%) to prevent excessive contact resistance (Rc) and asymmetry across the memory array. If TCAD process emulation does not properly couple physical trench topography with realistic CVD TiCl4/TDMAT surface reaction kinetics, parasitics extracted for the SPICE bitline/storage node discharge network will underestimate sensing latency and signal margin degradation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Ti silicidation at the SNC bottom requires strict thermal budget management. Using CVD TiCl4/NH3 or MOCVD TiN requires post-dep rapid thermal anneal (RTA) to form low-resistivity C54 TiSi2 without spiking into shallow N+/P junction diodes. Emulation must capture Si consumption during silicidation (~2.2 nm Si per nm Ti), dopant redistribution (P/As segregation), and unreacted Ti removal or conversion to prevent leakage paths exceeding 1 fA/cell.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor selection between TiCl4 (inorganic CVD) and TDMAT/TEMAT (metal-organic CVD) defines fab CAPEX and operational supply-chain stability. TiCl4 requires dedicated high-temperature corrosive chlorine abatement systems and ultra-pure NH3 gas, whereas TDMAT produces high-carbon-content TiN films unless plasma-treated. TCAD calibration must account for available precursor chemistries in the local pilot fab line.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule risk is concentrated in the cross-tool calibration loop between TCAD calibrated profiles (Victory Process/Suprem-IV/Sentaurus) and physical cross-sectional TEM/FIB metrology. Milestone exit requires freeze of the contact trench profile and barrier liner recipe by Milestone M2 to avoid blocking downstream W-plug CMP and crown dielectric ALD development.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Contact punch-through or junction spiking caused by excessive Ti-Si interdiffusion and C49/C54 phase transition during silicidation RTA, collapsing junction breakdown voltage below 1.8V.
1. Liner pinch-off at the top trench neck causing incomplete Ti/TiN wetting layer at the bottom, producing keyhole voids during CVD-W fill and catastrophic open-circuit storage node contacts.
1. High contact resistivity (> 5e-7 Ohm-cm²) resulting from native oxide regrowth at the silicon-trench interface prior to CVD Ti deposition due to Q-time violations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-1-01` | **Specific Contact Resistivity Extraction via Kelvin & TLM TCAD Emulation** | Synopsys Sentaurus Device / Silvaco Atlas 3D TCAD Device Simulator & Automated TLM Scripting Engine | 1. Import simulated 3D meshed structure of the SNC trench and adjacent diffusion into TCAD device solver. 2. Apply voltage sweep from -0.2 V to +0.2 V between top W-plug terminal and N+ diffusion tap. 3. Extract dV/dI slope to calculate contact resistance Rc. 4. Run parametric variation across contact pad spacing d = [5, 10, 20, 40, 80] um in TLM structure model. 5. Plot total resistance R_T vs d and extract transfer length L_T and specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. | `Specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 3.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2 at 300K, and total single-contact resistance Rc <= 45 Ohm per plug.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-1-02` | **Trench Bottom Liner Step Coverage & Thickness Uniformity Verification** | TCAD Process Topography Simulator (Victory Process / Sentaurus Process) calibrated against Cross-Sectional TEM | 1. Run simulated Ti deposition targeting 10 nm nominal planar thickness. 2. Run sequential in-situ TiN barrier deposition targeting 15 nm planar thickness. 3. Measure film thickness at top field (T_top), sidewall at 50% depth (T_mid), and bottom center (T_bot). 4. Calculate bottom step coverage percentage = (T_bot / T_top) * 100. 5. Inspect simulated profile for overhang ratio (T_neck / T_mid). | `Bottom step coverage >= 55% for both Ti and TiN; sidewall step coverage >= 35%; maximum necking overhang ratio <= 1.15 with zero overhang-induced voiding.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A fully encapsulating chemical protective suit for line intervention, Supplied-air respirator (SCBA) with positive-pressure full facepiece, Butyl rubber inner gloves with heavy neoprene outer gloves, Steel-toe chemical-resistant neoprene safety boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TiCl4/HCl acid vapor: Evacuate immediately to fresh air; flush eyes/skin with copious water for >= 15 min. For HF pre-clean exposure: Apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously to affected areas with repeated massage until medical personnel arrive. Oxygen inhalation for pulmonary edema signs.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated corrosive-gas toxic scrubbed exhaust (TSE) maintaining negative duct static pressure >= 2.5 in. w.g. Dedicated point-of-use (POU) combustion-wet scrubber installed at CVD chamber foreline to neutralize unreacted TiCl4, NH3, and HCl byproducts before municipal exhaust tie-in.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous effluent routed to dedicated fluoride/heavy-metal neutralization plant. Precipitation using calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) to form insoluble CaF2, followed by flocculation and clarification. Neutralization of acidic scrubber liquors to pH 6.5 - 8.5 before discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Semiconductor Grade (99.999% trace metals basis) | `100% liquid/vapor` |
| **Anhydrous Ammonia (NH3)** | `7664-41-7` | Electronic Grade (VLSI / 99.9995%) | `100% gas` |
| **Hydrogen Fluoride (Dilute DHF 100:1 for pre-clean)** | `7664-39-3` | Ultra-Pure Microelectronics Grade | `0.5% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched contact trench post-dry etch ash, wet polymer strip, and 100:1 DHF native oxide strip; pristine hydrogen-terminated silicon surface at trench base with zero residual fluorocarbon polymer.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sealed conformal Ti/TiN bilayer (nominal 10nm/15nm) ready for immediate tungsten (W) nucleation and bulk CVD fill; passivated against ambient oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Regrowth of native silicon oxide (SiO2 > 0.8 nm) at trench bottom causing non-ohmic tunneling barrier, elevating contact resistance by 300-500% and causing silicide agglomeration during RTA.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified TCAD process and device emulation package defining the optimal CVD Ti/TiN liner deposition profile, silicidation thermal budget, and contact resistance extraction for the 180nm 8F² crown DRAM storage node contact trench, demonstrating compliance with tight cell sensing timing constraints.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `snc_trench_titin_profile_tcad.csv`
- [ ] `snc_contact_tlm_extraction_report.pdf`
- [ ] `snc_trench_liner_cross_section_mesh.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage Node Contact specific contact resistivity (rho_c) at W/TiN/TiSi2/N+ Si interface** | `3.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2` | +/- 0.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2 | TCAD simulated 5-point TLM structure I-V extraction using linear regression y-intercept and transfer length. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Ti/TiN bottom-to-top trench liner step coverage percentage** | `58.0%` | +/- 3.0% | Geometric mesh node analysis along trench centerline comparing bottom floor thickness against field oxide surface thickness. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Maximum silicon consumption depth into active junction during silicidation anneal** | `18.5 nm` | <= 2.5 nm | 1D dopant and phase boundary depth profile tracking across the metallurgical junction in TCAD process emulator. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Successful simulated convergence of the complete SNC module fulfilling specific contact resistivity <= 3.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2, step coverage >= 55%, and junction leakage <= 0.8 fA at V_cell = 1.8V, with signed approval from Device TCAD Lead and Fab Process Integration Engineer.
