# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-TCAD-WPLUG-001
**Title:** $WF_6$ Silane/Hydrogen Reduction Nucleation & Growth TCAD Kinetic Solver Setup  
**Module:** COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm / $\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP configures the finite-volume/surface-reaction kinetic solver in TCAD for tungsten plug (W-plug) chemical vapor deposition (CVD) filling high-aspect-ratio contacts for 180nm 1T1C Crown-type Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture. The simulation models two-step kinetics on Ti/TiN liner stacks:
1. **$SiH_4$-assisted nucleation:** $2WF_6 + 3SiH_4 \rightarrow 2W + 3SiF_4\uparrow + 6H_2\uparrow$ (rapid initial seed coverage preventing fluorine attack/volcano formation).
2. **$H_2$-driven bulk deposition:** $WF_6 + 3H_2 \rightarrow W + 6HF\uparrow$ (conformal bulk plug fill without keyhole voids).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. Grid & Domain Setup                                                           |
|     - Contact CD: 180 nm, Depth: 720 nm (AR 4:1)                                  |
|     - Mesh density: 1.5 nm on TiN liner interface, 5 nm in bulk contact           |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  2. Nucleation Kinetic Solver Phase (WF6 / SiH4)                                  |
|     - Pre-condition: TiN surface sites initialized                                 |
|     - Surface reaction: 2 WF6 + 3 SiH4 -> 2 W(s) + 3 SiF4 + 6 H2                  |
|     - Target seed layer: 15 nm to 20 nm continuous boundary                       |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  3. Bulk Growth Kinetic Solver Phase (WF6 / H2)                                   |
|     - Transition solver: R_bulk = k0 * exp(-Ea/kT) * P(WF6)^0 * P(H2)^0.5         |
|     - Gas phase Knudsen diffusion + Langmuir-Hinshelwood surface reaction         |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  4. Convergence & Void Analysis Extraction                                        |
|     - Level-set interface tracking to seam pinch-off                             |
|     - Extract seam width, step coverage, and contact plug resistance              |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Computational Domain & Geometry Setup
- Initialize the 2D/3D cylindrical TCAD geometry representing the storage node contact hole reaching the access transistor drain contact ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
- Define the contact diameter as $180\text{ nm}$ nominal at the bottom, flared to $200\text{ nm}$ at top, with physical depth corresponding to the bitline and ILD stack stack-height (~$720\text{ nm}$, Aspect Ratio ~4:1).
- Apply boundary conformal mesh over the pre-deposited Ti/TiN barrier liner layer with adaptive mesh refinement ($\Delta x \le 1.5\text{ nm}$) along the reactive wall interface.

#### Step 2: Boundary Species & Kinetic Solver Setup: Silane Nucleation Step
- Define surface reaction species: $WF_6(g)$, $SiH_4(g)$, $SiF_4(g)$, $H_2(g)$, and solid deposit $W(s)$.
- Specify the $SiH_4$ reduction reaction:
  $$2WF_6(g) + 3SiH_4(g) \rightarrow 2W(s) + 3SiF_4(g) + 6H_2(g)$$
- Set inlet partial pressures: $P(SiH_4) = 0.5\text{ Torr}$, $P(WF_6) = 1.0\text{ Torr}$, carrier $N_2$ or $Ar$ buffer flow, substrate temperature = $400^\circ\text{C}$ to $430^\circ\text{C}$.
- Configure sticking coefficient solver until a uniform nucleation layer of $15\text{ nm}$ thickness coats the TiN liner sidewalls and base.

#### Step 3: Kinetic Solver Setup: Bulk Hydrogen Reduction Step
- Switch boundary gas conditions to $H_2$-reduction regime:
  $$WF_6(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightarrow W(s) + 6HF(g)$$
- Set partial pressures: $P(WF_6) = 2.0\text{ Torr}$, $P(H_2) = 30.0\text{ Torr}$, total pressure = $40\text{ Torr}$, wafer temperature = $430^\circ\text{C}$ to $450^\circ\text{C}$.
- Set growth rate equation modeling half-order hydrogen dependence and zero-order $WF_6$ dependence:
  $$R_{\text{growth}} = k_0 \exp\left(-\frac{E_a}{k_B T}\right) P_{H_2}^{0.5} P_{WF_6}^0$$
- Couple with Knudsen diffusion equation inside the high-aspect-ratio contact hole to account for reactant starvation at the bottom of the contact.

#### Step 4: Profile Tracking, Pinch-Off & Extraction
- Execute the front-tracking level-set kinetic solver until the tungsten growth interfaces merge at the contact center (pinch-off).
- Output cross-sectional profile: extract seam/void volume fraction, residual stress boundary conditions, and contact resistance $R_c$ profile into the access transistor drain junction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Contact Dimension (Bottom CD)** | $180$ | $\pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Nucleation Layer Thickness** | $18.0$ | $15.0 - 20.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Deposition Step Coverage (Bottom/Top)** | $\ge 95.0$ | $95.0 - 100.0$ | $\%$ |
| **Simulated Seam / Micro-Void Width** | $\le 4.0$ | $0.0 - 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Transition to stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) configuration erected above the drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug).
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ cell layout and bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Storage contact connects to crown/cylinder type stacked capacitor requiring cell capacitance of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$.
3. **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**:
   - Multi-zone temperature regulation principles and carrier gas laminar flow dynamics via mass flow controllers (MFC).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Coupling the Level-Set surface evolution solver with a two-step kinetic regime (SiH4 nucleation followed by H2 bulk reduction) requires rigorous flux boundary matching; any discrepancy between Knudsen diffusion in high-aspect-ratio (AR > 4:1) 180nm storage node contacts and local WF6/SiH4 partial pressures will induce unphysical void formation or premature necking in the TCAD mesh.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The kinetic rate model must accurately distinguish between the initial self-limiting silane reduction (2WF6 + 3SiH4 -> 2W + 3SiF4 + 6H2) at 380°C-420°C and the subsequent hydrogen reduction (WF6 + 3H2 -> W + 6HF). Neglecting the Langmuir-Hinshelwood adsorption competition between HF byproducts and WF6 on the TiN barrier layer will underestimate the incubation delay and falsely predict seamless tungsten gap-fill.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Electronic-grade WF6 and SiH4 supply chains require ultra-high purity point-of-use gas delivery panels with heated delivery lines (WF6 boils at 17.1°C at atmospheric pressure) and dedicated pyrophoric/toxic gas scrubber integration to avoid supply disruptions during physical wafer validation runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The TCAD kinetic solver calibration milestone must lock model kinetic parameters against empirical cross-sectional SEM data from short-loop test structures before committing full 8F² DRAM cell lot runs, preventing costly schedule slips in the COB bitline/storage node integration line.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Volcano defect formation: WF6 gas penetration through sub-stoichiometric TiN pinholes reacting violently with underlying Ti/Si to form TiF3/SiF4 gas blisters and peeling contacts.
1. Keyhole/seam void entrapment: Excessive deposition rate at the contact aperture due to SiH4 oversupply relative to mass transport limits, pinch-off occurring prior to bottom-up volumetric fill.
1. Excessive incubation delay: Inadequate silane pre-exposure causing localized non-nucleation on fluorine-poisoned TiN sidewalls.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-1-2-01` | **Storage Node Contact W-Plug Seam Void Ratio & Step Coverage Verification** | Synopsys Sentaurus Topography 3D / Silvaco Victory Process TCAD, Cross-sectional In-lens High-Resolution SEM (FEI Helios G4) | 1. Execute transient Level-Set simulation of 15-second SiH4 nucleation step at 400°C, 4.5 Torr, 30 sccm SiH4, 10 sccm WF6, Ar carrier. 2. Transition kinetic solver boundary to H2 bulk reduction step at 430°C, 300 Torr, 700 sccm H2, 40 sccm WF6 for 60 seconds. 3. Extract volumetric tungsten density profile across the central contact axis and compute cross-sectional void area at pinch-off. | `W-plug step coverage >= 98.5% at the lower contact knee; central seam void width <= 8.0 nm along the vertical contact axis; zero volcanic encroachment into the underlying Ti/Si substrate.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-1-2-02` | **Specific Contact Resistivity (Rc) Calibration & Incubation Time Solver Extraction** | TCAD Sentaurus Device Interconnect Simulator & Point-Contact 4-Wire Kelvin Test Structure Probe Station (Keithley 4200-SCS) | 1. Run 3D TCAD electrical drift-diffusion simulation across simulated W-plug geometry extracting theoretical Kelvin contact resistance Rc. 2. Measure empirical Kelvin structures with forced 100 uA current sweeps from -1.0V to +1.0V. 3. Correlate TCAD extracted contact resistivity against physical electrical measurements. | `Specific contact resistance Rc must fall within (1.5 - 3.2) x 10^-8 Ohm-cm2; TCAD model deviation from physical Kelvin test data must not exceed +/- 8.5% across all 5 test sites.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level B / Level C emergency response HazMat gear for toxic gas response, Supplied-air respirator (SCBA) for cylinder change-outs, Double-layered butyl/fluoroelastomer chemical gloves (Silver Shield/4H), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield with ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses, Static-dissipative, fire-retardant Nomex/aramid cleanroom lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF/WF6 inhalation or skin exposure: Immediately evacuate victim to fresh air. Flush affected skin with copiously flowing water for 5 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into exposed areas until medical personnel arrive. For eye exposure, continuously irrigate with sterile 1% calcium gluconate eye wash or normal saline for 15+ minutes. Administer 100% humidified oxygen for inhalation; initiate emergency medical evacuation immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative-pressure exhaust gas box (EGB) dedicated to CVD chamber with minimum duct face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm). Coaxial double-contained stainless steel 316L VIM/VAR electropolished piping with N2 purge jacket. Dedicated point-of-use thermal-wet toxic gas abatement system capable of handling 50 slm SiH4 pyrophoric combustion and water scrubbing for WF6/HF decomposition.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Thermal oxidizer oxidation of unreacted SiH4 and H2 to SiO2 and H2O, followed by secondary counter-current caustic scrubber (NaOH/Ca(OH)2 solution at pH 9.5-11.0) to precipitate fluoride ions as insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) sludge prior to wastewater discharge meeting municipal F- limits (< 10 ppm).

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade (6N, 99.9999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Silane** | `7803-62-5` | Ultra-Pure VLSI Grade (5N5, 99.9995%) | `100.0% (or 2% in Ar/H2 balance)` |
| **Hydrogen** | `1333-74-0` | Purified Electronic Grade (7N, 99.99999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (ALD TiN precursor)** | `7550-45-0` | Electronic Grade (5N, 99.999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Byproduct / Etch)** | `7664-39-3` | TraceMetal Grade | `49.0% aqueous solution` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited ALD TiN liner (10nm) on Ti contact layer, free from surface oxide (TiO2 < 0.2 nm) and organic airborne molecular contamination (AMC).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Continuous conformal tungsten nucleation seed layer (15-20 nm) capping TiN sidewalls without blistering, ready for high-rate H2 bulk W-CVD reduction.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes native oxidation of TiN to TiO2 and moisture adsorption, resulting in WF6 attack on the barrier, non-uniform nucleation incubation time (> 45s delay), and extensive volcano defects leading to open-circuit contact failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated 3D TCAD multi-step kinetic model reproducing surface topography evolution, incubation kinetics, and seam formation for 180nm DRAM storage node tungsten contact plug metallization under combined silane nucleation and hydrogen reduction regimes.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `WF6_SiH4_H2_Kinetic_Parameters_Calibration_Matrix.csv`
- [ ] `TCAD_StorageNode_WPlug_Topography_CrossSection_Profile.tiff`
- [ ] `Storage_Node_Contact_Fill_Kinetic_Validation_Report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |

critics.systems_engineer: Coupling the Level-Set surface evolution solver with a two-step kinetic regime (SiH4 nucleation followed by H2 bulk reduction) requires rigorous flux boundary matching; any discrepancy between Knudsen diffusion in high-aspect-ratio (AR > 4:1) 180nm storage node contacts and local WF6/SiH4 partial pressures will induce unphysical void formation or premature necking in the TCAD mesh.
critics.domain_expert: The kinetic rate model must accurately distinguish between the initial self-limiting silane reduction (2WF6 + 3SiH4 -> 2W + 3SiF4 + 6H2) at 380°C-420°C and the subsequent hydrogen reduction (WF6 + 3H2 -> W + 6HF). Neglecting the Langmuir-Hinshelwood adsorption competition between HF byproducts and WF6 on the TiN barrier layer will underestimate the incubation delay and falsely predict seamless tungsten gap-fill.
critics.supply_chain: Electronic-grade WF6 and SiH4 supply chains require ultra-high purity point-of-use gas delivery panels with heated delivery lines (WF6 boils at 17.1°C at atmospheric pressure) and dedicated pyrophoric/toxic gas scrubber integration to avoid supply disruptions during physical wafer validation runs.
critics.laya_pm: The TCAD kinetic solver calibration milestone must lock model kinetic parameters against empirical cross-sectional SEM data from short-loop test structures before committing full 8F² DRAM cell lot runs, preventing costly schedule slips in the COB bitline/storage node integration line.
critical_failure_modes: Volcano defect formation: WF6 gas penetration through sub-stoichiometric TiN pinholes reacting violently with underlying Ti/Si to form TiF3/SiF4 gas blisters and peeling contacts.
Keyhole/seam void entrapment: Excessive deposition rate at the contact aperture due to SiH4 oversupply relative to mass transport limits, pinch-off occurring prior to bottom-up volumetric fill.
Excessive incubation delay: Inadequate silane pre-exposure causing localized non-nucleation on fluorine-poisoned TiN sidewalls.

testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm contact hole profile defined with depth 800nm (AR 4.4:1), bottom diameter 180nm, lined with 10nm PVD Ti / 10nm ALD TiN. Kinetic mesh resolution initialized to 1.5nm isotropic grid.
testcases.procedure: 1. Execute transient Level-Set simulation of 15-second SiH4 nucleation step at 400°C, 4.5 Torr, 30 sccm SiH4, 10 sccm WF6, Ar carrier. 2. Transition kinetic solver boundary to H2 bulk reduction step at 430°C, 300 Torr, 700 sccm H2, 40 sccm WF6 for 60 seconds. 3. Extract volumetric tungsten density profile across the central contact axis and compute cross-sectional void area at pinch-off.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: W-plug step coverage >= 98.5% at the lower contact knee; central seam void width <= 8.0 nm along the vertical contact axis; zero volcanic encroachment into the underlying Ti/Si substrate.

Measure empirical Kelvin structures with forced 100 uA current sweeps from -1.0V to +1.0V. 3. Correlate TCAD extracted contact resistivity against physical electrical measurements.

Flush affected skin with copiously flowing water for 5 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into exposed areas until medical personnel arrive. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Aspect-Ratio Via Step Coverage & Seam Void TEM/EDX Metrology Calibration

### Document Metadata
- **Module**: Metrology & Failure Analysis / Advanced Thin-Film Characterization
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Crown-Type COB Topology)
- **Action Type**: Buy / Vendor Tool Calibration & Acceptance Procedure
- **Target Structure**: Storage Node Contact (SNC) / Bitline W-Plug Contact Via with Ti/TiN Liner Stack

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────────┐
│                           │
│       Sample Prep:        │
│       Dual-Beam FIB       │
│         Lift-out          │
│                           │
└─────────────┬─────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌───────────────────────────┐
│                           │
│    TEM Imaging: 200kV     │
│  Bright-Field/HAADF-STEM  │
│                           │
└─────────────┬─────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌───────────────────────────┐
│                           │
│      EDX Metrology:       │
│     Ti/TiN Liner & W      │
│       Seam Profile        │
│                           │
└─────────────┬─────────────┘
              │
              │
              ▼
┌───────────────────────────┐
│                           │
│       Quantitative        │
│         Pass/Fail         │
│        Calibration        │
│                           │
└───────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Dual-Beam FIB Precision Cross-Section Lift-Out**:
   - Transfer wafer coupon containing the 180nm cell array (360 nm to 400 nm pitch) into a Dual-Beam FIB-SEM chamber.
   - Deposit an in-situ electron-beam Pt/C protection strap (0.5 µm) followed by Ga⁺ ion-beam Pt deposition (1.5 µm) over the target 8F² contact via array.
   - Perform trench milling at 30 kV beam voltage, extract the lamella via omniprobe micromanipulator, attach to a Cu TEM half-grid, and thin using low-kV Ga⁺ polish (5 kV down to 1–2 kV) to reach final electron transparency thickness ($\le 50\text{ nm}$) without amorphous curtaining.

2. **STEM/TEM Spatial & Magnification Calibration**:
   - Load lamella into an analytical TEM/STEM operated at 200 kV accelerating voltage.
   - Verify spatial magnification against standard single-crystal Si (111) lattice fringes ($d = 0.3135\text{ nm}$).
   - Align high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF-STEM) detector camera length ($100\text{--}150\text{ mm}$) to optimize Z-contrast between the W-plug core, Ti/TiN liner, and SiO₂ inter-layer dielectric (ILD).

3. **Liner Step Coverage & Profile Extraction**:
   - Acquire cross-sectional high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) and HAADF micrographs across the entire via height from top aperture down to the drain contact interface.
   - Measure physical thickness of the Ti/TiN liner at:
     - Top field surface ($t_{\text{top}}$)
     - Via sidewall midpoint ($t_{\text{mid}}$)
     - Bottom corner and bottom contact floor ($t_{\text{bottom}}$)
   - Calculate step coverage ratio: $\text{Step Coverage (\%)} = (t_{\text{bottom}} / t_{\text{top}}) \times 100$.

4. **Seam Void & WF₆ Reduction Encroachment Inspection**:
   - Inspect the central axis of the W-plug for keyhole seam voids resulting from chemical vapor deposition (CVD) pinch-off.
   - Measure the maximum lateral seam gap width ($\Delta w_{\text{seam}}$) and void vertical continuity along the plug height.

5. **Analytical Energy-Dispersive X-Ray Spectroscopy (EDX) Line-Scan**:
   - Set up an EDX drift-corrected line scan (0.5 nm step size, $\ge 100\text{ ms}$ live dwell time per point) perpendicularly crossing the `SiO₂ | Ti | TiN | W` boundary.
   - Profile the Ti-$K\alpha$, N-$K\alpha$, W-$L\alpha$, and O-$K\alpha$ transitions to verify complete barrier integrity and ensure zero oxygen/fluorine penetration into the active silicon contact interface.

---

### Calibration Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
Key Calibration Targets (Physical Units / %)
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │░░                                 │
  Max Seam Void Gap┤░░                                 │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒                              │
 Min Liner Step Cov┤▒▒▒▒▒                              │
Aspect Ratio Target┤▓▓                                 │
                   │▓▓                                 │
       Via CD (Top)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0       45      90       135    180 
```

1. **Via Critical Dimension (CD) & Alignment**:
   - Nominal top critical dimension: $180\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ conforming to 180nm lithography ground rules and access channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Aspect ratio: $\ge 4.5:1$ (nominal $5:1$) across the bitline and storage node stack.

2. **Ti/TiN Liner Step Coverage Metric**:
   - Bottom-to-top liner step coverage: $\ge 20\%$ at via bottom corners; bottom floor thickness: $\ge 10\text{ nm} \pm 1.5\text{ nm}$ continuous barrier without pinholes.

3. **W-Plug Core Seam Void Tolerance**:
   - Central volumetric seam width: $\le 5\text{ nm}$ max discontinuous seam width along the via core; continuous open keyholes $> 10\text{ nm}$ across $> 20\%$ of via height are strictly rejectable.

4. **TEM Lamella Specimen Thickness & Beam Energy**:
   - Final specimen foil thickness at contact center: $\le 50\text{ nm} \pm 5\text{ nm}$ measured by EELS zero-loss peak ratio ($t/\lambda \le 0.4$); operating accelerating voltage: $200\text{ kV} \pm 0.1\%$.

---

### Contextual Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Cites*: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) erected above drain contact via tungsten plug (W-plug); 8F² folded bitline cell layout architecture.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Cites*: 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture, bitline and wordline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$, establishing geometric layout limits for cross-section array sampling.
- **Source: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects**:
  - *Cites*: Interconnect metallization constraints and metal-1 thickness targets ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$) bounding the upper planarization interface of the via plug contacts.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In high-aspect-ratio (HAR) contacts (~4:1 to 6:1 AR in 180nm 8F² DRAM cell nodes), inaccurate physical metrology calibration creates a compounding error in TCAD kinetic boundary conditions. If TEM cross-sectional calibration fails to isolate local thickness variations from sample tilt artifacts, the WF6 reduction kinetic model will mispredict premature via-mouth pinch-off and underestimate seam void volume. This directly corrupts RC extraction for the bitline contact (BLC) and storage node contact (SNC), distorting downstream sense amplifier timing simulations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) sample preparation via focused ion beam (FIB) dual-beam milling frequently induces curtaining and gallium ion beam redeposition artifacts along high-aspect-ratio oxide trenches. A 30kV Ga+ rough mill followed by an inadequate low-kV (2-5kV) Polish step causes amorphous re-amorphization layers (~5-8nm) on sidewall Ti/TiN liners, which skews calibrated EDX line profiles and falsely broadens the Ti/W interdiffusion interface. Energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) mapping requires drift-corrected spectrum imaging (DCSI) with dwell times calibrated to prevent carbon beam-induced contamination from masking sub-3nm liner discontinuity.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Contract TEM/FIB analytical turnaround represents a critical bottleneck for fast TCAD calibration loops in low-budget semiconductor initiatives. Standard external dual-beam FIB-TEM characterization runs cost $450-$850 per lamella with a typical 5-10 business day transit and queue delay. We must enforce standardized 3mm Omniprobe copper or molybdenum half-grid protocols, batching test dies with standardized scribe-line TEM test structures (nested HAR contact chains) to minimize FIB extraction time and negotiate volume-based analytical runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology calibration is an enabling gate for signoff on the W-plug CMP planarization and contact resistance modeling modules. Delays in TEM sample turnaround propagate a 2-week slip into TCAD parameter extraction and mask rule freeze. The analytical protocol must specify exact cross-section coordinates and automated EDX line-scan quantification templates so that raw images can be immediately ingested into the kinetic simulator parameter extraction pipeline within 24 hours of data delivery.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. FIB lamella over-thinning or Ga+ beam amorphization destroying the ultrathin (3-5nm) Ti/TiN liner interface, rendering step coverage quantification invalid.
1. Sample tilt-induced projection artifact in TEM imaging resulting in artificial narrowing of high-aspect-ratio contact bottoms and misidentification of conformal ALD coverage as pinch-off voids.
1. EDX spot-drift and signal overlap between Ti-Kα (4.51 keV) and Ba/Sc/Ti lines or W-Mα (1.77 keV) and Si-Kα (1.74 keV), yielding false stoichiometric interpretations of the barrier seed layer.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-1-3-01` | **TEM High-Aspect-Ratio Contact Sidewall & Bottom Step Coverage Ratio Metrology** | Dual-Beam Ga+ FIB/SEM (FEI Helios NanoLab or equivalent) with 2kV final polish; 200kV Field Emission TEM (JEOL JEM-2100F or FEI Tecnai F20) equipped with high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) detector. | 1. Prepare cross-sectional lamella across 180nm HAR storage node contact arrays (nominal depth 1.0µm, CD 220nm) using 30kV Ga+ bulk milling, 5kV clean-up, and 2kV low-energy polish to achieve lamella thickness <50nm without curtaining. 2. Mount on Mo half-grid and insert into 200kV TEM holder; tilt specimen along the zone axis to eliminate projected interface broadening (verify lattice fringes in substrate Si). 3. Acquire HAADF-STEM high-resolution images at the contact mouth, 50% depth (sidewall), and contact bottom corner (cusp). 4. Measure physical layer thickness of TiN liner at top horizontal surface (T_top), middle sidewall (T_side), and bottom center (T_bottom) using calibrated line-profile intensity analysis (FWHM). 5. Calculate sidewall step coverage ratio (T_side / T_top * 100%) and bottom step coverage ratio (T_bottom / T_top * 100%). | `Sidewall step coverage ratio must be >= 35.0% for ALD/CVD TiN liner at 50% contact depth; bottom step coverage must be >= 20.0%; lamella amorphous damage layer must measure <= 2.0nm verified by Si lattice fringe inspection.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-1-3-02` | **W-Plug Seam Void Volume & EDX Elemental Line-Scan Metrology Calibration** | 200kV Analytical TEM/STEM equipped with Super-X 4-quadrant Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) EDX system and STEM dark-field detector. | 1. Align contact plug center-line in HAADF-STEM mode to identify tungsten grain boundary seams and central keyhole/seam voids. 2. Perform drift-corrected spectrum imaging (DCSI) EDX line-scan perpendicular to the contact sidewall across the Si/TiSi2/Ti/TiN/W interface with 0.5nm step size and 100ms per-pixel dwell time. 3. Deconvolve overlapping W-M series (1.774 keV) and Si-K series (1.740 keV) using calibrated Cliff-Lorimer k-factors. 4. Profile fluorine (F-Kα at 0.677 keV) accumulation at the TiN/W barrier interface. 5. In HAADF mode, segment the seam void along the contact axis and calculate maximum void width and total void area percentage relative to total via cross-sectional area. | `Maximum central seam void width must be <= 25.0nm; total cross-sectional void area must not exceed 4.0% of total via area; peak fluorine atomic concentration at the TiN/W liner interface must remain <= 1.5 at%.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving required), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering chemical splash goggles and full face shield, Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD-safe safety footwear, Cryogenic thermal gloves and face shield during liquid nitrogen handling for EDX/FIB cold traps
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with Ga or coupon cleavage shards, flush immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. In case of suspected HF/fluoride residue exposure from WF6 hydrolyzed coupon surfaces: immediately wash with water, apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel repeatedly to affected area, massage continuously, and seek immediate medical attention. For cryogenic liquid nitrogen burns, flush area with lukewarm water (never hot); do not rub frozen tissue.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: FIB and TEM sample prep workstations must operate within certified Class 100 laminar flow hoods with dedicated localized exhaust ventilation (minimum face velocity 100 FPM). Vacuum pump exhaust lines from FIB chamber roughing pumps must be ducted through dedicated toxic chemical exhaust scrubbers to capture volatile fluorine or solvent outgassing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used FIB Mo/Cu grids, carbon-taped stubs, and Ga-contaminated cleaning wipes must be collected in sealed, labeled solid hazardous waste bins. Cleaved wafer shards contaminated with metal silicides and fluorinated residues must be treated as solid toxic waste. Spent solvent rinses (IPA/acetone) must be sequestered in grounded flammable solvent waste drums for chemical recovery.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gallium (Liquid Metal Ion Source - FIB)** | `7440-55-3` | 99.9999% (6N Electronic Grade) | `100%` |
| **Liquid Nitrogen (Cryogenic Metrology Traps)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) | `100%` |
| **Isopropanol (Solvent Clean/Lamella Rinse)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI Class 1) | `99.9%` |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (Precursor Byproduct Residue on Coupon)** | `7783-82-6` | Trace post-reaction residue | `<0.1% surface adsorbed` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly deposited Ti/TiN/W-plug layer on patterned BPSG/oxide dielectric; post-cleave coupon stored in hermetic desiccant pod; zero native oxide re-growth or airborne hydrocarbon contamination on cleavage cross-section.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Lamella mounted on Mo TEM grid, thinned to electron transparency (<50nm), low-kV Ar/Ga polished, vacuum-sealed or loaded into high-vacuum TEM column (<1e-7 Torr).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air Q-time causes native oxidation of the exposed TiN barrier layer (forming TiO2 and Ti-oxynitrides) and hydrolysis of residual fluorides, generating false interfacial oxidation signals in EDX and causing delamination during FIB ion-beam thinning.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete TEM/EDX physical metrology calibration dataset establishing ground-truth step coverage metrics, sidewall film conformality, and central seam void dimensions for HAR contacts in the 180nm 8F² DRAM cell architecture. Delivered data provides direct validation coordinates to parameterize the WF6 reduction kinetic surface reaction model and contact resistance TCAD pipeline.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `HAR_Via_Step_Coverage_TEM_Analysis_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `W_Plug_Seam_Void_Morphology_Dataset.csv`
- [ ] `STEM_HAADF_EDX_Elemental_LineProfiles.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **CVD/ALD TiN barrier layer bottom step coverage in 4:1 aspect ratio contact** | `22.5%` | +/- 2.5% | Calibrated HR-TEM cross-sectional line profile intensity measurement relative to field thickness |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum central W-plug seam void width along via vertical center axis** | `18.0 nm` | +/- 4.0 nm | High-Angle Annular Dark-Field STEM (HAADF-STEM) calibrated contrast thresholding |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Interfacial fluorine atomic concentration at TiN liner / W boundary** | `0.8 at%` | <= 1.5 at% | Drift-corrected STEM-EDX line-scan spectrum deconvolution using Cliff-Lorimer quantification |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires signoff from both the Integration Metrologist and TCAD Modeling Lead certifying that cross-sectional TEM magnification is calibrated to within ±1.0% using Si single-crystal lattice fringe standards, FIB preparation artifacts (curtaining and amorphization) do not exceed 2.0nm, and extracted step coverage values match boundary parameters within TCAD kinetic error margins of <= 5%.

testcases.title: TEM High-Aspect-Ratio Contact Sidewall & Bottom Step Coverage Ratio Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Dual-Beam Ga+ FIB/SEM (FEI Helios NanoLab or equivalent) with 2kV final polish; 200kV Field Emission TEM (JEOL JEM-2100F or FEI Tecnai F20) equipped with high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) detector.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer coupon cleaved from lot post-Ti/TiN liner deposition and CVD-W seed deposition; top protective organoplatinum/carbon strap deposited via GIS (>1.5µm thickness) to prevent contact mouth sputtering during FIB lamella milling.
testcases.procedure: 1. Prepare cross-sectional lamella across 180nm HAR storage node contact arrays (nominal depth 1.0µm, CD 220nm) using 30kV Ga+ bulk milling, 5kV clean-up, and 2kV low-energy polish to achieve lamella thickness <50nm without curtaining. 2. Mount on Mo half-grid and insert into 200kV TEM holder; tilt specimen along the zone axis to eliminate projected interface broadening (verify lattice fringes in substrate Si). 3. Acquire HAADF-STEM high-resolution images at the contact mouth, 50% depth (sidewall), and contact bottom corner (cusp). 4. Measure physical layer thickness of TiN liner at top horizontal surface (T_top), middle sidewall (T_side), and bottom center (T_bottom) using calibrated line-profile intensity analysis (FWHM). 5. Calculate sidewall step coverage ratio (T_side / T_top * 100%) and bottom step coverage ratio (T_bottom / T_top * 100%).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Sidewall step coverage ratio must be >= 35.0% for ALD/CVD TiN liner at 50% contact depth; bottom step coverage must be >= 20.0%; lamella amorphous damage layer must measure <= 2.0nm verified by Si lattice fringe inspection.

testcases.title: W-Plug Seam Void Volume & EDX Elemental Line-Scan Metrology Calibration
testcases.instrumentation: 200kV Analytical TEM/STEM equipped with Super-X 4-quadrant Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) EDX system and STEM dark-field detector.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer coupon cleaved post-WF6 reduction W-plug fill and prior to tungsten chemical mechanical planarization (post-deposition anneal completed); FIB lamella thickness <= 60nm across plug core.
testcases.procedure: 1. Align contact plug center-line in HAADF-STEM mode to identify tungsten grain boundary seams and central keyhole/seam voids. 2. Perform drift-corrected spectrum imaging (DCSI) EDX line-scan perpendicular to the contact sidewall across the Si/TiSi2/Ti/TiN/W interface with 0.5nm step size and 100ms per-pixel dwell time. 3. Deconvolve overlapping W-M series (1.774 keV) and Si-K series (1.740 keV) using calibrated Cliff-Lorimer k-factors. 4. Profile fluorine (F-Kα at 0.677 keV) accumulation at the TiN/W barrier interface. 5. In HAADF mode, segment the seam void along the contact axis and calculate maximum void width and total void area percentage relative to total via cross-sectional area.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Maximum central seam void width must be <= 25.0nm; total cross-sectional void area must not exceed 4.0% of total via area; peak fluorine atomic concentration at the TiN/W liner interface must remain <= 1.5 at%.

ppe_required: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving required)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering chemical splash goggles and full face shield
Static-dissipative cleanroom gown and ESD-safe safety footwear
Cryogenic thermal gloves and face shield during liquid nitrogen handling for EDX/FIB cold traps

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with Ga or coupon cleavage shards, flush immediately with copious clean water for 15 minutes and remove contaminated garments. In case of suspected HF/fluoride residue exposure from WF6 hydrolyzed coupon surfaces: immediately wash with water, apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel repeatedly to affected area, massage continuously, and seek immediate medical attention. For cryogenic liquid nitrogen burns, flush area with lukewarm water (never hot); do not rub frozen tissue.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: FIB and TEM sample prep workstations must operate within certified Class 100 laminar flow hoods with dedicated localized exhaust ventilation (minimum face velocity 100 FPM). Vacuum pump exhaust lines from FIB chamber roughing pumps must be ducted through dedicated toxic chemical exhaust scrubbers to capture volatile fluorine or solvent outgassing.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Used FIB Mo/Cu grids, carbon-taped stubs, and Ga-contaminated cleaning wipes must be collected in sealed, labeled solid hazardous waste bins. Cleaved wafer shards contaminated with metal silicides and fluorinated residues must be treated as solid toxic waste. Spent solvent rinses (IPA/acetone) must be sequestered in grounded flammable solvent waste drums for chemical recovery.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly deposited Ti/TiN/W-plug layer on patterned BPSG/oxide dielectric; post-cleave coupon stored in hermetic desiccant pod; zero native oxide re-growth or airborne hydrocarbon contamination on cleavage cross-section.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Lamella mounted on Mo TEM grid, thinned to electron transparency (<50nm), low-kV Ar/Ga polished, vacuum-sealed or loaded into high-vacuum TEM column (<1e-7 Torr).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding air Q-time causes native oxidation of the exposed TiN barrier layer (forming TiO2 and Ti-oxynitrides) and hydrolysis of residual fluorides, generating false interfacial oxidation signals in EDX and causing delamination during FIB ion-beam thinning.

expected_result.summary: Complete TEM/EDX physical metrology calibration dataset establishing ground-truth step coverage metrics, sidewall film conformality, and central seam void dimensions for HAR contacts in the 180nm 8F² DRAM cell architecture. Delivered data provides direct validation coordinates to parameterize the WF6 reduction kinetic surface reaction model and contact resistance TCAD pipeline.

nodes.primary_metric: Sub-milestone of W-Plug WF6 Reduction & CMP Planarization Contact Module Simulation
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## WF6-SiH4/H2 CVD Bulk Tungsten Plug Deposition & Void Minimization Simulation ### Context & Module Hierarchy * **Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) * **Module Path**: [Architecture & Integration] > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout (8F²) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling > COB Storage Node Contact & W-Plug Contact Resistance TCAD Modeling > W-Plug WF6 Reduction & CMP Planarization Contact Module Simulation > **WF6-SiH4/H2 CVD Bulk Tungsten Plug Deposition & Void Minimization Simulation** * **Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Action Type**: Make --- ### Process Flow & Structural Sequence ```mermaid flowchart TD A["1. Surface Prep & Ti/TiN Liner Barrier Definition
(Ti/TiN Bilayer in Storage Node Contact Hole)"] --> B["2. Silane Seed Layer Nucleation Stage
(WF6 + SiH4 Reduction at 390°C - 410°C, 30 Torr)"] B --> C["3. Bulk Hydrogen Reduction CVD Fill
(WF6 + H2 Reaction at 400°C - 430°C, 80 Torr)"] C --> D["4. TCAD Topography & Seam Void Minimization Modeling
(Knudsen Diffusion & Sticking Coefficient Optimization)"] D --> E["5. CMP Overburden Planarization & Contact Resistance Verification"] ``` --- ### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure 1. **Substrate & Contact Hole Initialization**: - Import the 180nm access transistor drain/storage node contact geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, contact critical dimension $\text{CD} \approx 180\text{ nm}$ to $200\text{ nm}$, aspect ratio $\text{AR} \approx 4:1$ to $5:1$ in BPSG/TEOS dielectric pre-metal layer). - Verify conformal barrier/glue liner deposition: $10\text{ nm}$ ALD/PVD Ti followed by $15\text{ nm}$ MOCVD/ALD TiN to prevent $WF_6$ encroachment/volatilization into active silicon. 2. **Stage 1: Silane ($SiH_4$) Seed / Nucleation Layer Deposition**: - **Reaction Mechanism**: Direct silane reduction: $$2WF_6 + 3SiH_4 \rightarrow 2W\downarrow + 3SiF_4\uparrow + 6H_2\uparrow$$ - **Chamber Conditions**: - Substrate temperature: $390^\circ\text{C} - 410^\circ\text{C}$. - Total chamber pressure: $30\text{ Torr}$. - Gas flow rates: $WF_6 = 15\text{ sccm}$, $SiH_4 = 10\text{ sccm}$, $Ar\text{ carrier} = 2500\text{ sccm}$. - Target seed thickness: $25\text{ nm} - 35\text{ nm}$ conformal nucleation layer along contact sidewalls to establish a low-resistivity, uniform nucleation density. 3. **Stage 2: Bulk Hydrogen ($H_2$) Reduction Tungsten Growth**: - **Reaction Mechanism**: Hydrogen-dominated surface reduction: $$WF_6 + 3H_2 \rightarrow W\downarrow + 6HF\uparrow$$ - **Process Conditions**: - Substrate temperature: $425^\circ\text{C} \pm 5^\circ\text{C}$. - Chamber pressure: $80\text{ Torr}$ (high-pressure regime suppresses gas-phase mean free path issues and boosts conformal step coverage). - Gas flow rates: $WF_6 = 80\text{ sccm}$, $H_2 = 1200\text{ sccm}$, $N_2/\text{Ar} = 1500\text{ sccm}$. - Target bulk growth rate: $380\text{ nm/min}$. Continue until nominal overfill of $150\text{ nm}$ above contact field plane is achieved. 4. **Void Minimization & Transport TCAD Simulation**: - Solve 3D Level-Set surface evolution coupled with Knudsen molecular diffusion: $$D_K = \frac{2}{3} r \bar{v} = \frac{4}{3} r \sqrt{\frac{2 k_B T}{\pi M}}$$ - Constrain reactant sticking coefficient $\gamma(WF_6) \le 0.005$ by maintaining excess hydrogen partial pressure ($H_2 / WF_6 > 15$). - Monitor center seam closure dynamics to prevent early top pinch-off, ensuring bottom-up and lateral void-free seam fusion. 5. **Post-Deposition CMP & Defect Inspection**: - Model Tungsten Chemical Mechanical Planarization (W-CMP) using silica/alumina slurry with $H_2O_2$ oxidizer at downward force of $3.5\text{ psi}$. - Polish bulk overburden to stop on TiN/dielectric plane, eliminating micro-coring and dishing. --- ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets ```text ┌──────────────────────────────┐ │░░░░░░░░ │ Step Coverage (%)┤░░░░░░░░ │ │▓▓ │ Rc Contact (Ω/plug)┤▓▓ │ Seam Void Ratio (%)┤▒ │ │▒ │ Deposition Rate (nm/min)┤██████████████████████████████│ │██████████████████████████████│ └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘ 0 95 190 285 380 ``` 1. **Step Coverage**: $\ge 98.0\%$ at the contact hole base prior to pinch-off. 2. **Bulk Deposition Rate**: $380\text{ nm/min} \pm 20\text{ nm/min}$ under $80\text{ Torr}$ at $425^\circ\text{C}$. 3. **Core Seam Void Cross-Sectional Area Ratio**: $\le 3.0\%$ of total plug volume via cross-sectional TEM/FIB TCAD inspection. 4. **Specific Contact Resistance ($R_c$)**: $\le 15.0\ \Omega/\text{plug}$ between the storage node contact plug and active access drain ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$). --- ### Context Citations * **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry parameters (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and storage node tungsten plug [W-plug] contact routing under stacked capacitor topology with cell capacitance requirement $\ge 28\text{ fF}$). * **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Interconnect pitch constraints ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch) defining contact aspect ratios and thermal limits ($\le 450^\circ\text{C}$ post-front-end thermal budget). --- ### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA) - **Systems Engineer Critic**: In the 180nm 8F² COB cell architecture, storage node contact (SNC) plug resistance (Rc) directly governs write-recovery and sense margin. The trade-off between SiH4-reduced nucleation layer thickness (which limits contact resistivity due to β-W phase formation and Si incorporation) and H2-reduced bulk tungsten fill (which controls seam/void keyholing) must be strictly balanced against the overall thermal budget (≤400°C) to prevent dopant deactivation in the underlying active transistor drain junction. - **Domain Physicist Critic**: Bulk CVD tungsten fill in high-aspect-ratio (AR ~4:1 to 6:1, critical dimension ~180nm) contacts is prone to premature neck pinch-off due to high Knudsen diffusion resistance inside the contact hole. The ratio of WF6:H2 along with process pressure (typically 30-80 Torr) and temperature (~380-420°C) must be simulated with surface reaction kinetics to prevent volumetric center keyhole voids larger than 5nm, which can trap polishing slurry or cause severe CMP plug pull-out. - **Supply Chain Critic**: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4 (Silane) require dedicated double-walled stainless-steel orbital-welded gas delivery lines, point-of-use gas cabinets with toxic gas monitoring, and certified scrubbers. Global supply disruptions in high-purity electronic-grade WF6 (6N) and Ti/TiN precursor delivery modules demand strict process run-to-run material yield optimization and minimum chamber overhead purging cycles. - **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical simulation deliverables for bulk W-plug CVD and subsequent CMP defectivity modeling must be validated against cross-sectional TEM and four-point probe contact resistance metrics before committing to silicon mask tape-out, avoiding costly pilot-line requalification delays across Gen 2 DRAM fab schedules. **Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**: 1. Keyhole/center-seam void formation within the 180nm contact core leading to CMP slurry entrapment, corrosion, and open-circuit storage node contact. 1. WF6 penetration through defective TiN barrier into underlying silicon or Ti-silicide (volcano effect) causing violent localized contact pitting and junction leakage >1 fA/cell. 1. High β-W phase ratio or excessive silicon contamination from the SiH4 nucleation stage causing elevated specific contact resistance (>15 Ω/contact). ### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench) | Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-2-01` | **Cross-Sectional W-Plug Center Seam Void Dimension & Aspect Ratio Verification** | Dual-Beam Focused Ion Beam (FIB) with High-Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy (HR-STEM / HAADF detector) and Automated Image Analysis Software | 1. Load lamella into HR-STEM at 200kV accelerating voltage. 2. Capture high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) images across 50 contiguous storage node contact vias. 3. Apply automated image edge-detection to measure the maximum diameter and vertical extent of any center-seam keyhole void along the plug axis. 4. Calculate volumetric void fraction per contact plug. | `Maximum keyhole void width must be ≤ 5.0 nm across all inspected plugs; zero continuous vertical voids exceeding 15 nm in length; bulk W filling conformality ≥ 98.0%.` | | `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-2-02` | **Storage Node Contact W-Plug Chain Resistance and Volcano Defect Leakage** | Automated Parametric Wafer Prober (Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer) with 10k-contact Kelvin test structure | 1. Contact probe needles onto the force/sense pads of the 10,000 W-plug Kelvin chain. 2. Sweep bias voltage from -0.5V to +0.5V and record I-V characteristics to determine contact chain resistance. 3. Measure reverse-bias junction leakage current at V_drain = 1.2V on adjacent storage node junctions to detect fluorine/WF6 volcano-induced junction shorting. | `Mean single-plug contact resistance R_contact ≤ 12.0 Ω (chain resistance ≤ 120 kΩ); 3-sigma variation ≤ 1.5 Ω; junction leakage current ≤ 0.5 fA/cell at 25°C and ≤ 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.` | ### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes - **Hazard Classification**: `Critical` - **Mandatory PPE**: Level B Chemical Hazard Suit with self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) ready for gas bottle changes, Butyl rubber inner gloves with heavy Neoprene/Viton outer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 full-face chemical splash shield and safety glasses, Static-dissipative cleanroom steel-toe safety boots - **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Immediately drench skin with water for 5 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical personnel arrive. In case of inhalation, administer oxygen immediately and nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate solution under physician guidance. For eye exposure, irrigate eyes with 1% calcium gluconate saline wash or sterile water for at least 15 minutes. - **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Negative-pressure gas cabinets with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) at cabinet exhaust port; point-of-use thermal-wet toxic gas burn-box/scrubber directly attached to vacuum pump exhaust; continuous electrochemical and optical toxic gas monitoring calibrated for WF6/HF (<0.1 ppm threshold alarm) and SiH4 (<5 ppm threshold alarm) with automatic pneumatic cylinder shutoff valves. - **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Exhaust gases routed through combustion decomposition chamber followed by multi-stage caustic aqueous scrubbing (20% KOH/NaOH solution) to convert WF6 and HF into insoluble CaF2 and sodium tungstate. Solid calcium fluoride precipitation is filtered, neutralized to pH 6.5-8.5, and disposed of as regulated heavy-metal/fluoride hazardous solid cake. **Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**: | Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade 6N (99.9999%) | `100% Compressed Liquefied Gas` | | **Silane (SiH4)** | `7803-62-5` | VLSI Grade 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100% Pyrophoric Compressed Gas` | | **Hydrogen (H2)** | `1333-74-0` | Ultra-High Purity 6N (99.9999%) | `100% Flammable Gas` | | **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF, reaction by-product)** | `7664-39-3` | Aqueous / Anhydrous Gas By-Product | `Formed in exhaust: ~10-30%` | ### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints - **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours` - **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Atomically clean, unoxidized TiN (titanium nitride) barrier layer (freshly degassed under vacuum, native oxide < 0.2 nm) deposited over titanium silicide contact interfaces. - **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully encapsulated, dense CVD α-phase bulk tungsten film overlying contact vias with minimal surface roughness (RMS < 8.0 nm) ready for oxide-stop CMP planarization. - **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture and atmospheric oxygen absorption onto the fresh TiN barrier creates TiO2 / TiON interfaces, causing catastrophic interfacial delamination of tungsten, localized nucleation failure, severe contact resistance escalation (>50 Ω), and WF6-induced fluorine attack (volcano defect) on the underlying substrate. ### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done) **Exit Objective Summary**: > Verified numerical simulation and physical TCAD calibration model for 180nm DRAM cell storage node contact bulk CVD tungsten deposition using SiH4 nucleation and H2 reduction, achieving seam-free fill (void < 5nm) and R_contact ≤ 12 Ω with robust TiN barrier integrity. **Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**: - [ ] `W_CVD_Deposition_Void_Distribution_Analysis.csv` - [ ] `Storage_Node_W_Plug_TEM_HAADF_Morphology.tiff` - [ ] `TCAD_CVD_Kinetics_and_Contact_Resistance_Report.pdf` **Quantitative Completion Assertions**: | Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum bulk tungsten keyhole void diameter along the central seam of 180nm contact via** | `0.0 nm` | +5.0 nm | HR-STEM HAADF cross-sectional analysis across 50 randomly sampled storage node plugs | | `ASSERT-02` | **Specific storage node single-plug contact resistance R_contact** | `9.5 Ω` | ±2.5 Ω | Four-point Kelvin resistor probe measurement across 10,000-via test chains at 25°C | | `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node junction leakage current under reverse bias (V_dd = 1.2V) at 85°C** | `0.6 fA/cell` | +0.4 fA/cell | Keysight B1500A automated parametric pA-meter leakage sweep on 1M-cell array blocks | **Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**: > All 50 sampled contact vias demonstrate zero continuous seam defects > 5nm, measured single-plug contact resistance is confirmed ≤ 12.0 Ω across 3 consecutive wafer lots, and reverse junction leakage remains strictly ≤ 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C with 100% engineering council consensus.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-TCAD-W08: $\text{SiH}_4$-Reduction $\text{WF}_6$ Nucleation Layer Kinetics & Surface Adhesion TCAD Calibration

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Ti/TiN Liner      │
│       Substrate        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    SiH4 Pre-flow &     │
│    Surface Soaking     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   SiH4-Reduction WF6   │
│       Nucleation       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Surface Adhesion &   │
│    TCAD Calibration    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Bulk H2-WF6 CVD Fill  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Geometry Initialization**:
   - Construct the contact via/plug 3D domain in the TCAD environment for the 180nm node Storage Node Contact (contact pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Define the conformal adhesion/barrier bilayer (PVD/CVD $\text{Ti}/\text{TiN}$) lining the contact hole over the access transistor drain junction.

2. **Pre-treatment / Silane Soak Calibration**:
   - Model the pulsed $\text{SiH}_4$ pre-soak step on the $\text{TiN}$ liner surface at low pressure ($\sim 300\text{ mTorr}$ to $400\text{ mTorr}$ chamber regime) and moderate temperature ($390^\circ\text{C}$ to $420^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Set surface adsorption site density $\theta_{\text{Si}}$ on $\text{TiN}$ to prevent uncontrolled incubation delay and eliminate fluorine wormhole encroachment into the underlying junction.

3. **$\text{SiH}_4$-Reduction $\text{WF}_6$ Nucleation Surface Kinetics**:
   - Calibrate the transient nucleation surface reaction rate:
     $$2\text{WF}_6(g) + 3\text{SiH}_4(g) \longrightarrow 2\text{W}(s) + 3\text{SiF}_4(g) + 6\text{H}_2(g)$$
   - Define sticking coefficients ($\gamma_{\text{WF6}} \approx 0.05 - 0.1$, $\gamma_{\text{SiH4}} \approx 0.01 - 0.03$) and tune the pre-exponential factor and surface reaction activation energy ($E_a \approx 0.18 - 0.25\text{ eV}$) in the Level-Set/Monte Carlo CVD surface model.
   - Restrict nucleation layer target thickness to $15\text{ nm} - 25\text{ nm}$ to ensure smooth, non-agglomerated crystallite seeding before bulk deposition.

4. **Surface Adhesion & Film Stress Calibration**:
   - Solve interfacial shear stress and adhesion energy across the $\text{W}/\text{TiN}$ interface. Incorporate intrinsic film stress parameters (managing tensile stress states up to $\sim 1\text{ GPa}$) to verify that peeling, delamination, and blister formation are prevented under thermal cycling.

5. **Transition to Bulk Plug Growth Verification**:
   - Hand off the calibrated nucleation surface profile to the bulk $\text{WF}_6 / \text{H}_2$ reduction CVD step:
     $$\text{WF}_6(g) + 3\text{H}_2(g) \longrightarrow \text{W}(s) + 6\text{HF}(g)$$
   - Confirm step coverage $> 95\%$ inside the high-aspect-ratio contact hole with zero micro-void pinch-off, ensuring contact resistance targets for the crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) node are fulfilled.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Exact Physical Units | Verification Method / Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nucleation Layer Thickness Uniformity** | $20.0 \pm 2.5\text{ nm}$ across via sidewall & bottom | In-line High-Resolution TEM / Ellipsometry |
| **Residual Interfacial Tensile Stress** | $\le 1.0\text{ GPa}$ | Wafer Curvature / XRD Stress Gauge |
| **Contact Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Automated Parametric Analyzer / Source Measure Unit (SMU) |
| **Minimum Storage Node Capacitance** | $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF per cell}$ (target $\ge 28\text{ fF}$) | C-V LCR Meter at $100\text{ kHz}$ |

---

### 4. Relevant Source Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Cell geometry dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, folded bitline stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ soft-error and coupling margin.
  - Leakage requirement: Junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Cell layout pitch: Bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage capacitor capacitance baseline: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF/cell}$ for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
  - Vacuum operating envelope: $200\text{ mTorr}$ to $400\text{ mTorr}$ pressure control.
  - Mechanical integrity & stress budget: Intrinsic tensile stress bound of $\sim 1\text{ GPa}$ to prevent wafer bowing and film peeling.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-2-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-2-2-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of SiH4-Reduction WF6 Nucleation Layer Kinetics & Surface Adhesion TCAD Calibration: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).
