# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## W-Plug & Contact Subcircuit SPICE Model Calibration & Monte Carlo Validation

**Document ID:** `SOP-CKT-180-WPLUG-MC-001`  
**Classification:** Technical / Circuit Design & Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (8F² Crown-Type COB Topology)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Metrology    │
│  Extraction (Specific Contact Resistivity)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Subcircuit Netlist Synthesis (Distributed   │
│  W-Plug Bulk R_plug + Interface R_c Network) │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  SPICE Nominal Fitting & Model Calibration   │
│  Against 180nm Crown COB Storage Node Specs  │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│  Statistical Monte Carlo Simulation (N=1000) │
│  & Yield Sign-Off (Delta V & Retention Valid)│
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Four-Point Kelvin Cross-Bridge Data Import & De-embedding**
   - Import I-V metrology curves obtained from four-point Kelvin cross-bridge test structures fabricated on the 180nm wafer.
   - De-embed current-crowding effects and parasitic series resistance from the metal lead lines to isolate the intrinsic specific contact resistivity ($\rho_c$) and Kelvin contact resistance ($R_{\text{Kelvin}}$) at the tungsten plug (W-plug) to silicon/silicide interface.

2. **Hierarchical Subcircuit SPICE Netlist Construction**
   - Formulate the distributed subcircuit model (`.subckt WPLUG_CONTACT`) representing the COB storage node contact and bitline shared contact:
     - **Plug Bulk Resistance ($R_{\text{plug}}$)**: Calculated using the high-aspect-ratio cylinder resistivity of CVD Tungsten ($W$) across the dielectric thickness over the access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).
     - **Interface Resistance ($R_{\text{interface}}$)**: Multi-element ladder or barrier resistance modeling the Ti/TiN adhesion layer and silicide boundary.
     - **Parasitic Contact Capacitance ($C_{\text{contact}}$)**: Extracted sidewall-to-interlayer-dielectric parasitic coupling.

3. **SPICE Parameter Optimization & Calibration**
   - Parameterize nominal resistances and parasitic capacitances into the 180nm 1T1C DRAM macro model.
   - Run nominal transient DC/AC simulations under standard DRAM operation conditions:
     - Wordline access gate: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - Precharge voltage: equalized to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
     - Cell storage node capacitance: $C_s \ge 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
     - Bitline load capacitance: $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Calibrate the model so signal development voltage yields $\Delta V \ge 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ within the active sense amplifier activation strobe window.

4. **Statistical Monte Carlo Distribution Assignment**
   - Assign Gaussian statistical variations to the W-plug model parameters accounting for fab process variations:
     - Critical dimension variation of contact diameter ($\pm 3\sigma$ on $180\text{ nm}$ litho/etch).
     - Barrier thickness variation (Ti/TiN layer deposition uniformity).
     - Specific contact resistivity variation based on cross-wafer Kelvin cross-bridge spreads.
   - Execute $N = 1{,}000$ to $10{,}000$ run Monte Carlo transient simulation sweeps at operating temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.

5. **Readout Margin, Retention, and Soft-Error Yield Sign-Off**
   - Evaluate differential read sensing voltage distribution: ensure $\Delta V > 100\text{ mV}$ at $-3\sigma$.
   - Verify junction and sub-threshold leakage currents through the contact remain $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention intervals $> 64\text{ ms}$.
   - Export calibrated BSIM/SPICE subcircuit cards into the PDK release repository.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Minimum $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | SPICE AC Parameter Extraction / Crown Stack Metrology |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ (at $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) | $\text{mV}$ | SPICE Transient Monte Carlo ($-3\sigma$ tail) |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ (at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC Leakage Simulation / Parameter Sign-Off |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | Length $L = 180 \pm 10$, Width $W = 220 \pm 15$ | $\text{nm}$ | Inline In-Die Metrology & Model Instance Netlist |
| **Refresh Retention Target** | $> 64.0$ (at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\text{ms}$ | Macro Timing & Retention Circuit Verification |

---

### 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Transition toward 8F² folded bitline layouts with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Unit cell geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring soft-error noise immunity.
  - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - 1T1C architecture with crown/cylinder capacitor requiring $C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Retention time requirement $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Equalization network to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
  - Charge sharing equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$.
  - Nominal signal development $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The lumped contact resistance model is insufficient for high-speed DRAM sensing margins; the SPICE subcircuit must explicitly decompose the W-plug into bulk plug resistance (R_bulk_plug), TiN/Ti barrier liner resistance, interfacial specific contact resistance (rho_c) to the n+/p+ diffusion junction, and current-crowding distributed ladder networks. Failure to account for bitline RC delay variations and voltage drops during the 1T1C charge sharing phase (t_RCD window) will lead to sense amplifier sensing failure or false latching under worst-case 3-sigma slow corners.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node unit cell dimensions (F = 180 nm, bitline contact CD approx 200 nm, aspect ratio approx 3.5:1), tungsten CVD step coverage and WF6 precursor reduction can form keyhole voids or unreacted WF6/fluorine pileup at the Ti/TiN-silicon interface. Calibration against Kelvin cross-bridge and TLM test vehicle data must extract transfer length L_T and specific contact resistivity rho_c (< 5e-7 Ohm*cm^2). The SPICE Monte Carlo distribution must be parameterized using non-Gaussian log-normal distributions rather than symmetric Gaussians to accurately capture high-resistance void tailing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4/H2 precursors along with organometallic CVD TiN precursors (TDMAT or TiCl4/NH3) are subject to stringent global supply quotas and hazardous specialty gas containment protocols. Metrology verification tools—specifically automated cryogenic/hot wafer probers with low-level parameter analyzers (Keysight B1500A/Keithley 4200-SCS)—require certified calibration standards to ensure SPICE card parameter interchangeability across multi-foundry open-source PDKs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Model extraction and signoff gate require physical wafer correlation against minimum 5 split lots across wafer center, middle, and edge dice. If the Monte Carlo variance engine is released without rigorous hardware matching against TLM/Kelvin cross structures, downstream 64Mb/128Mb full-chip layout verification will suffer severe write-time degradation (t_WR) and yield loss, triggering costly mask respins on the contact and storage-node plug levels.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial titanium silicide (TiSi2) agglomeration and high specific contact resistivity (> 1.2e-6 Ohm*cm^2) causing charge transfer time constant (tau = R_plug * C_cell) to exceed 8ns, violating the write recovery time (t_WR) spec.
1. WF6 volcano reaction breaching thin TiN barrier layer during CVD W-plug deposition, causing severe silicon pit gouging, high junction leakage (> 10 fA/cell at 85°C), and catastrophic DRAM cell data retention degradation below 64ms.
1. Keyhole seam voiding within high-aspect-ratio (3.5:1) contact vias inducing multimodal / fat-tail contact resistance distribution, leading to Monte Carlo 6-sigma tail underestimation and functional bit failures during low-Vdd (1.6V) read operations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-3-3-3-01` | **Four-Point Kelvin W-Plug Resistance Extraction and Temperature Coefficient Calibration** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1511B Medium Power SMU, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with thermal chuck (-40°C to 125°C), Triaxial Low-Noise Cabling. | 1. Land 4-point triaxial probe tips onto the Kelvin test pads (Force+, Sense+, Force-, Sense-) dedicated to the 180nm W-plug storage node contact test structure. 2. Force DC current sweep from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 uA increments via Force terminals while measuring differential voltage (V_sense+ - V_sense-) via high-impedance (> 10 T-Ohm) Sense terminals. 3. Extract contact resistance R_c from the slope dV/dI over the linear regime (-0.5 mA to +0.5 mA) to isolate pure contact resistance from bulk metal lead parasitics. 4. Ramp thermal chuck temperature to 85.0°C and 125.0°C, repeating the I-V sweep to extract TCR (Temperature Coefficient of Resistance: alpha_T = (1/R0)*(dR/dT)). 5. Back-calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c utilizing known mask contact area (A = 3.1416 * (90nm)^2 = 2.54e-10 cm^2). | `Kelvin contact resistance R_c at 25°C must be between 18.0 Ohm and 35.0 Ohm per single plug (nominal target 25.0 Ohm); extracted specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2; I-V curve linearity must exhibit R^2 >= 0.9995 across [-0.5 mA, +0.5 mA]; temperature coefficient TCR must remain within +0.0035 to +0.0045 /°C.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-1-3-3-3-02` | **SPICE Subcircuit Monte Carlo Statistical Calibration against 10,000-Point Array Fluctuation** | HSPICE / Ngspice Open-Source Simulator (v2024.1+) executing BSIM3v3.3 / BSIM4 calibrated core model card with distributed W-plug subcircuit netlist; Automated Python/Octave validation harness with SciPy statistical processing suite. | 1. Configure SPICE netlist with 1T1C cell configuration: 180nm NMOS access transistor (W=220nm, L=180nm), crown capacitor C_cell = 30 fF, bitline capacitor C_BL = 200 fF, and the calibrated distributed contact model `X_WPLUG`. 2. Define statistical variation block for W-plug parameters: R_bulk_plug, R_barrier, and R_interface with correlated log-normal distribution matching measured physical wafer dispersion. 3. Execute 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo transient simulation running standard DRAM active-read cycle: Precharge BL to VDD/2 (0.90V), assert Wordline (WL=2.8V boosted), execute charge sharing for 5.0 ns, and evaluate bitline differential signal delta_V_BL across sense amplifier input nodes. 4. Extract simulated delta_V_BL distribution and effective RC discharge delay (t_discharge = 2.2 * R_plug_effective * C_cell) across all 10,000 runs. 5. Perform Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) two-sample goodness-of-fit test between experimental physical R_c distribution and SPICE Monte Carlo R_c synthetic output. | `Monte Carlo simulated contact resistance distribution must match physical distribution with Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value > 0.05; nominal bitline differential sensing voltage delta_V_BL must be >= 180 mV; 3-sigma worst-case minimum delta_V_BL must remain >= 120 mV; maximum write recovery charge-transfer delay t_WR_delay (95% charge transfer into C_cell) must remain <= 4.5 ns under all 3-sigma slow corner Monte Carlo instances.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible double nitrile gloves (8 mil minimum thickness underlayer, puncture-resistant outer), Chemical-resistant neoprene apron and sleeves (ANSI/ISEA 107), Full-face polycarbonate splash shield conforming to ANSI Z87.1, Acid-gas certified full-face respirator with multi-gas/vapor P100 particulate cartridge (during precursor canister exchange or abatement maintenance), Static-dissipative cleanroom safety shoes with integrated steel toe protection
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) / hydrolyzed WF6 exposure: Immediately flush skin with emergency eyewash/deluge shower for 5 minutes. Apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel generously using gloved hands to the affected area; massage continuously into skin until medical help arrives. For eye contact, flush with sterile 1.0% Calcium Gluconate ophthalmic solution or isotonic saline for minimum 15 minutes. For WF6 or SiH4 inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, administer 100% humidified supplemental oxygen, maintain patient resting and warm, and transport immediately to emergency medical care for acute pulmonary edema observation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous negative pressure dedicated acid/toxic gas scrubbed exhaust system operating at minimum 1,500 CFM; local exhaust face velocity at chemical dispense boxes and CVD load locks must maintain >= 100 FPM (0.51 m/s); dual-sensor toxic gas monitoring (TGMS) for WF6/HF and pyrophoric SiH4 equipped with electrochemical and infrared optical detectors interlocked to auto-shutoff emergency isolation valves (EIV) at < 0.5 ppm threshold.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous fluorine-bearing and acidic effluents routed to dedicated industrial wastewater neutralization facility; neutralized via two-stage calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) precipitation reactor to form insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake at pH 8.5 - 9.5; slurry filtered through recessed chamber filter press; supernatant passed through continuous automated ion-selective fluoride probe verifying discharge effluent fluorine concentration < 10 ppm before municipal discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)** | `7783-82-1` | Electronic Grade 5N5 (99.9995%) | `100.0% compressed liquefied gas` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI / Semiconductor Grade | `49.0% aqueous solution (diluted to 0.5% - 1.0% for pre-metal clean)` |
| **Silane (SiH4)** | `7803-62-5` | Electronic Grade 6N (99.9999%) | `100.0% compressed pyrophoric gas` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride (TiCl4)** | `7550-45-0` | Semiconductor Grade (99.999%) | `99.9% liquid precursor` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly opened silicon contact vias following post-etch plasma ash, wet polymer strip, and 100:1 dilute HF (DHF) native oxide removal; surface terminating in pristine Si-H bonds with native oxide thickness <= 0.3 nm as measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal atomic layer deposition (ALD/CVD) Ti/TiN barrier liner (10 nm Ti / 15 nm TiN) fully covering contact sidewalls and bottom, hermetically sealing active n+/p+ silicon diffusions prior to CVD tungsten nucleation and bulk fill.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding clean-to-barrier Q-time triggers native silicon dioxide (SiO2) regrowth exceeding 1.2 nm along via bottoms; causes non-ohmic rectifying tunnel barrier behavior, elevates Kelvin contact resistance by > 300% (exceeding 100 Ohm/plug), and induces severe Ti/Si interfacial blistering during post-metal annealing.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery of fully calibrated, silicon-verified SPICE compact subcircuit models for 180nm W-plug and contact structures, incorporating distributed ladder networks for current crowding, temperature dependency, and correlated Monte Carlo statistical variation cards that precisely reproduce 10,000-point physical Kelvin and TLM wafer-level distributions.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `wplug_contact_spice_model_v1.0.subckt`
- [ ] `wplug_monte_carlo_distribution_calibration_report.pdf`
- [ ] `kelvin_tlm_physical_vs_simulated_resistance_correlation.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Single-contact W-plug nominal resistance in calibrated SPICE subcircuit model under nominal operating conditions (25°C, VDD=1.8V)** | `25.0 Ohm` | +/- 2.5 Ohm (+/- 10%) | Automated SPICE DC operating point simulation benchmarked against mean Kelvin cross-bridge resistance extracted from 10,000 physical test dice. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Statistical Monte Carlo standard deviation (1-sigma) for contact resistance across process corners in 10,000-iteration transient simulation** | `3.2 Ohm` | +/- 0.5 Ohm | Statistical variance analysis of 10,000-run Monte Carlo transient simulation executing `wplug_contact_mc.subckt` verified via Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against wafer-level inline electrical test (E-test) parametric logs. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Worst-case 3-sigma slow corner DRAM cell write recovery charge-transfer delay time constant (tau = R_eff * C_cell, C_cell = 30 fF)** | `1.05 ps` | <= 1.50 ps | SPICE transient analysis of write pulse 0V-to-VDD transition into 30 fF storage node crown capacitor measuring 10%-to-90% rise time at T = 85°C. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires 100% convergence across 10,000 Monte Carlo simulation runs with zero non-physical negative resistance instances; synthetic SPICE distribution must achieve Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value > 0.05 against empirical 180nm silicon wafer data; peer signoff approval by Lead Systems Engineer and Circuit Design Technical Director confirming zero write-recovery (t_WR) or read sense timing margin violations.

critics.systems_engineer: The lumped contact resistance model is insufficient for high-speed DRAM sensing margins; the SPICE subcircuit must explicitly decompose the W-plug into bulk plug resistance (R_bulk_plug), TiN/Ti barrier liner resistance, interfacial specific contact resistance (rho_c) to the n+/p+ diffusion junction, and current-crowding distributed ladder networks. Failure to account for bitline RC delay variations and voltage drops during the 1T1C charge sharing phase (t_RCD window) will lead to sense amplifier sensing failure or false latching under worst-case 3-sigma slow corners.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm node unit cell dimensions (F = 180 nm, bitline contact CD approx 200 nm, aspect ratio approx 3.5:1), tungsten CVD step coverage and WF6 precursor reduction can form keyhole voids or unreacted WF6/fluorine pileup at the Ti/TiN-silicon interface. Calibration against Kelvin cross-bridge and TLM test vehicle data must extract transfer length L_T and specific contact resistivity rho_c (< 5e-7 Ohm*cm^2). The SPICE Monte Carlo distribution must be parameterized using non-Gaussian log-normal distributions rather than symmetric Gaussians to accurately capture high-resistance void tailing.
critics.supply_chain: WF6 (Tungsten Hexafluoride) and SiH4/H2 precursors along with organometallic CVD TiN precursors (TDMAT or TiCl4/NH3) are subject to stringent global supply quotas and hazardous specialty gas containment protocols. Metrology verification tools—specifically automated cryogenic/hot wafer probers with low-level parameter analyzers (Keysight B1500A/Keithley 4200-SCS)—require certified calibration standards to ensure SPICE card parameter interchangeability across multi-foundry open-source PDKs.
critics.laya_pm: Model extraction and signoff gate require physical wafer correlation against minimum 5 split lots across wafer center, middle, and edge dice. If the Monte Carlo variance engine is released without rigorous hardware matching against TLM/Kelvin cross structures, downstream 64Mb/128Mb full-chip layout verification will suffer severe write-time degradation (t_WR) and yield loss, triggering costly mask respins on the contact and storage-node plug levels.
critical_failure_modes: Interfacial titanium silicide (TiSi2) agglomeration and high specific contact resistivity (> 1.2e-6 Ohm*cm^2) causing charge transfer time constant (tau = R_plug * C_cell) to exceed 8ns, violating the write recovery time (t_WR) spec.

WF6 volcano reaction breaching thin TiN barrier layer during CVD W-plug deposition, causing severe silicon pit gouging, high junction leakage (> 10 fA/cell at 85°C), and catastrophic DRAM cell data retention degradation below 64ms.

Keyhole seam voiding within high-aspect-ratio (3.5:1) contact vias inducing multimodal / fat-tail contact resistance distribution, leading to Monte Carlo 6-sigma tail underestimation and functional bit failures during low-Vdd (1.6V) read operations.

testcases.title: Four-Point Kelvin W-Plug Resistance Extraction and Temperature Coefficient Calibration
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1511B Medium Power SMU, Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with thermal chuck (-40°C to 125°C), Triaxial Low-Noise Cabling.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer prober ambient chuck temperature stabilized at 25.0°C +/- 0.5°C; Kelvin cross-bridge contact test structure verified with leakage isolation current < 100 fA at 1.8V VDD; SMU open/short calibration and path resistance zeroing executed within 24 hours.
testcases.procedure: 1. Land 4-point triaxial probe tips onto the Kelvin test pads (Force+, Sense+, Force-, Sense-) dedicated to the 180nm W-plug storage node contact test structure. 2. Force DC current sweep from -1.0 mA to +1.0 mA in 50 uA increments via Force terminals while measuring differential voltage (V_sense+ - V_sense-) via high-impedance (> 10 T-Ohm) Sense terminals. 3. Extract contact resistance R_c from the slope dV/dI over the linear regime (-0.5 mA to +0.5 mA) to isolate pure contact resistance from bulk metal lead parasitics. 4. Ramp thermal chuck temperature to 85.0°C and 125.0°C, repeating the I-V sweep to extract TCR (Temperature Coefficient of Resistance: alpha_T = (1/R0)*(dR/dT)). 5. Back-calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c utilizing known mask contact area (A = 3.1416 * (90nm)^2 = 2.54e-10 cm^2).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Kelvin contact resistance R_c at 25°C must be between 18.0 Ohm and 35.0 Ohm per single plug (nominal target 25.0 Ohm); extracted specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2; I-V curve linearity must exhibit R^2 >= 0.9995 across [-0.5 mA, +0.5 mA]; temperature coefficient TCR must remain within +0.0035 to +0.0045 /°C.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-DRAM180-COB-001`  
**Title:** Crown-Type 3D Cylinder Geometry & High-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO Dielectric Stack Optimization  
**Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Crown-Type Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) 3D Stack & Dielectric Modeling  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($180\,\text{nm}$) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture Scope
This SOP defines the fabrication, dimensional verification, and thin-film dielectric deposition flow for erecting stacked crown-type storage nodes positioned over bitlines (COB) contacting the access transistor ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) through tungsten plugs (W-plug). The process engineers high-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or engineered ONO triple-dielectric stacks on 3D cylindrical bottom electrodes to achieve sufficient capacitance per cell within an $8F^2$ footprint (bitline/wordline pitch $\sim 360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Crown Cylinder Fabrication Flow:                                                                  |
|                                                                                                   |
| [1. Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) & W-Plug Polish]                                                  |
|   |--> Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) of tungsten plug over access transistor drain     |
|                                                                                                   |
| [2. Mold Oxide Deposition & Deep Cylinder Etch]                                                   |
|   |--> PECVD sacrificial oxide mold; reactive ion etch (RIE) to open storage node cylinder hole   |
|                                                                                                   |
| [3. Bottom Electrode Formation (Crown Shell)]                                                     |
|   |--> Conformal polysilicon / TiN deposition inside cylinder hole; CMP/etchback to isolate crowns|
|   |--> Sacrificial mold wet-strip (HF etch) exposing inner & outer cylinder surfaces              |
|                                                                                                   |
| [4. High-k Dielectric Stack Deposition]                                                           |
|   |--> Conformal ALD/LPCVD ONO or Ta2O5 / Al2O3 high-k layer (EOT = 3.0 nm - 4.0 nm, kappa > 15)  |
|                                                                                                   |
| [5. Top Plate (Cell Plate) Counter-Electrode Deposition]                                          |
|   |--> In-situ doped poly-Si / metal top plate CVD encapsulation across 3D cylinders              |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Plug Planarization
1. Verify access transistor drain contacts with tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects planarized via tungsten chemical mechanical planarization (CMP).
2. Ensure underlying bitline layers and inter-metal dielectric (IMD) pass surface topology inspection prior to capacitor mold deposition.

#### Step 2: Sacrificial Mold Oxide Deposition & Cylinder Patterning
1. Deposit sacrificial phosphosilicate glass (PSG) or $\text{SiO}_2$ mold oxide via PECVD.
2. Apply deep-UV lithography to define the storage capacitor cylinder holes aligned to the underlying W-plugs within the $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$ pitch grid.
3. Perform anisotropic reactive ion etching (RIE) down to the landing W-plug, establishing vertical cylinder side-walls.

#### Step 3: Crown Bottom Electrode Formation
1. Deposit conformal polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) barrier layer (e.g., TiN/doped poly-Si) along the inner side-walls and bottom of the cylinder cavities.
2. Polish/etch back the top surface using node-separation CMP to isolate adjacent bottom electrodes.
3. Perform a timed selective wet etch (dilute HF dip) of the sacrificial mold oxide to expose both inner and outer cylindrical surfaces, completing the free-standing crown-type 3D cylinder.

#### Step 4: High-$k$ / ONO Dielectric Stack Deposition
1. Clean bottom electrode surfaces using native-oxide-free dilute chemistry.
2. Deposit the thin-film capacitor dielectric stack:
   - **Option A (High-$k$ Stack):** Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) or CVD of $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ (optionally with an $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ interfacial layer) targeting an effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and an Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.
   - **Option B (ONO Stack):** Thermally controlled LPCVD Oxide-Nitride-Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2 / \text{Si}_3\text{N}_4 / \text{SiO}_2$) triple-dielectric sequence yielding $\text{EOT} = 3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.

#### Step 5: Cell Plate Top Electrode Deposition & Anneal
1. Conformal chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of in-situ doped polysilicon or metal counter-electrode to fully envelop the 3D crown dielectric surfaces.
2. Execute post-deposition thermal treatment (rapid thermal anneal) to stabilize the dielectric crystal phase and eliminate interface trap states while preventing thermal degradation of underlying structures.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Minimum Target | Maximum Target | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 25.0$ (nominal target $\ge 28.0$) | $30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated probe station $C$-$V$ meter ($100\,\text{kHz} - 1\,\text{MHz}$) |
| **AC-02** | Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | — | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Low-current femtoampere parameter analyzer ($V_{\text{plate}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$) |
| **AC-03** | Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) | $3.0$ | $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / multi-frequency $C$-$V$ extraction |
| **AC-04** | Dielectric Relative Permittivity ($\kappa_{\text{eff}}$) | $> 15.0$ | — | Dimensionless | Extracted from physical thickness vs. accumulation capacitance |
| **AC-05** | Minimum Data Retention Time ($t_{\text{ret}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | $\ge 64$ | — | $\text{ms}$ | Automated memory array test pattern (disturbed refresh cycle) |

---

### 4. Context References
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Unit cell footprint: $8F^2$ / $6F^2$; access transistor channel $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
  - Crown-shaped stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: $\ge 28\,\text{fF/cell}$ for soft-error noise immunity.
  - Dielectric stack options: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack providing $\kappa > 15$.
  - Leakage budget: $\le 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - 1T1C stacked capacitor (Crown or Cylinder type) using $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$.
  - Target capacitance range: $25\,\text{fF} - 30\,\text{fF/cell}$ to maintain retention $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $3.0\,\text{nm} - 4.0\,\text{nm}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch: $360\,\text{nm} - 400\,\text{nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: While shifting from an ONO stack (k ~ 7) to Ta2O5 (k ~ 22-25) allows reducing crown cylinder height from 1.0 um to ~0.45 um at the 180nm node (8F^2 footprint of 0.259 um^2), the post-deposition annealing budget (>700°C in O2/N2O for Ta2O5 crystallization) risks unacceptable dopant deactivation and junction diffusion in the underlying W-plug to N+ drain contact. Thermal integration requires a strictly controlled RTP budget <= 650°C with TiN or Ru bottom electrodes to prevent interface oxidation and parasitic series resistance spikes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: CVD/ALD Ta2O5 deposited over high-aspect-ratio (AR > 4:1) 3D polysilicon or TiN cylinders exhibits micro-crack formation and step coverage loss at the bottom inner corners. Without an ultra-thin (1.0-1.5 nm) Si3N4 or Al2O3 interfacial barrier, oxygen out-diffusion oxidizes the bottom electrode, generating a low-k interfacial SiO2 layer (k ~ 3.9) that degrades the effective capacitance below the mandatory 28 fF budget and induces Poole-Frenkel conduction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Tantalum ethoxide (Ta(OC2H5)5) precursor and high-purity TiCl4/TDMAT for TiN barrier layers require high-integrity temperature-controlled bubblers and dedicated exhaust scrubbers that are absent in generic open-source university fabs. Sourcing semiconductor-grade Ta precursors in SEA involves long lead times (>16 weeks); maintaining an ONO triple-stack oxidation/nitridation furnace line as an operational dual-path fallback is essential to mitigate tapeout halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dual-dielectric optimization (Ta2O5 vs. ONO) expands the mask and wafer split lot by 6 runs, stretching the inline metrology turnaround by 3.5 weeks. The project critical path cannot accommodate sequential development; wet cylinder chemical etchback and dielectric atomic layer deposition must be modularly qualified on 8-inch coupon arrays before committing full device lots.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interfacial low-k oxide growth (SiOx/TiOx) at the bottom electrode interface reducing equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) scaling and collapsing cell capacitance below 25 fF.
1. Mechanical crown cylinder stiction, tilting, or pattern collapse during sacrificial BPSG wet oxide strip caused by capillary forces of deionized water rinse.
1. Excessive Poole-Frenkel and trap-assisted tunneling leakage current (>1.5 fA/cell at 1.0V, 85°C) across un-annealed Ta2O5 grain boundaries, degrading retention time below 64 ms.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-2-01` | **Cryogenic/Room-Temp CV Cell Capacitance & EOT Metrology on 1M-Array** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR Meter and Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station | 1. Connect high-force terminal to common top plate pad (VPL) and low-force terminal to bitline contact column pad with access wordlines biased to VDD + Vth (2.5V) to fully turn on access transistors. 2. Perform 100 kHz AC impedance sweep with 30 mV RMS oscillation level. 3. Sweep DC bias voltage from -1.5V to +1.5V in 50 mV steps. 4. Extract total array capacitance at operating point (VPL = VDD/2 = 0.9V). 5. Compute per-cell capacitance C_cell = C_total / 1048576 and derive EOT from parallel plate + cylinder sidewall surface area model. | `Cell capacitance C_cell must be >= 28.0 fF/cell (array total >= 29.36 nF); effective EOT <= 3.8 nm; variation across wafer (sigma/mean) <= 4.5%.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-2-02` | **Cell Dielectric Leakage & Pause Refresh Time Verification at 85°C** | Keysight B1500A with High-Resolution SMU (B1501A, 1 fA resolution) connected to Temptronic ThermoChuck thermal controller | 1. Set common capacitor top plate VPL to 0.9V. 2. Ground the substrate and source/well contacts. 3. Bias selected bitline pad to 0.0V (representing worst-case full storage charge difference across cell). 4. Apply 2.2V to gate wordline to write '1', then drop wordline to -0.5V (standby off-state). 5. Measure static leakage current through storage node over 10 seconds sampling window at 100 ms intervals. 6. Execute pause-test retention sweep by delaying sense amplifier read cycle from 10 ms to 256 ms in doubling increments. | `Leakage current per cell I_leak <= 0.85 fA/cell at 85°C and Vbias = 0.9V; retention pause time before first single-bit failure > 128 ms (100% pass at target specification >= 64 ms).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A/B chemical splash apron with full arm sleeves (Neoprene/Butyl blend), North Silver Shield 4H chemical-resistant inner gloves under Ansell Barrier heavy outer nitrile gloves (double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 full-face impact and chemical splash shield with chin guard, Full-seal indirect-vent chemical splash goggles, Continuous personal toxic gas monitoring badge for chlorine and volatile organometallics
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flush affected skin area with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then generously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate Gel into skin using gloved hands until pain subsides; seek emergency medical care immediately. For Ta(OC2H5)5 or TiCl4 vapor inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, administer medical-grade humidified oxygen via mask, and keep patient at complete rest; do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous ALD/CVD process tool exhaust connected to dedicated point-of-use thermal/wet gas scrubber line with minimum face velocity of 0.55 m/s (110 FPM) at load-lock and cabinet interlocks. Exhaust ducting must be 316L stainless steel or PTFE-lined with continuous automated pressure differential interlocks set to shut down precursor delivery if vacuum falls below -250 Pa.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent organometallic Ta/Ti effluents collected into dedicated fluoropolymer-lined waste drums; quench unreacted precursors via slow, chilled controlled hydrolysis in alkaline calcium carbonate/sodium hydroxide slurry under nitrogen purge. Acidic HF/BOE waste streams routed exclusively to dedicated automated Fluoride Waste Neutralization System using CaCl2 precipitation to yield insoluble CaF2 cake (residual fluoride < 10 ppm before discharge).

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tantalum(V) Ethoxide [Ta(OC2H5)5]** | `6074-84-6` | VLSI / Optoelectronic Grade (>= 99.999% trace metals basis) | `>= 99.95%` |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (Buffer HF 7:1 BOE)** | `7664-39-3` | Electronic Grade (Cleanroom Class 10) | `12.5% NH4F : 4.5% HF aqueous` |
| **Titanium Tetrachloride [TiCl4]** | `7550-45-0` | Semiconductor Grade | `>= 99.99%` |
| **Nitrous Oxide [N2O]** | `10024-97-2` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.5 | `>= 99.9995%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pristine dry sacrificial BPSG-etched crown bottom electrode (TiN or in-situ doped poly-Si) free of native oxide, organic residue, and fluoride particles following 100:1 DHF/BOE dip, megasonic rinse, and isopropyl alcohol (IPA) Marangoni dry.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stoichiometric, pinhole-free amorphous or micro-crystalline Ta2O5 (or ONO) dielectric film with physical thickness of 8.0-10.0 nm, sealed under in-situ vacuum or purged with N2O/O2 anneal cap, ready for top-plate TiN/polysilicon electrode deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time in ambient cleanroom air causes uncontrolled native oxide (SiOx) growth (>0.8 nm) and moisture/hydrocarbon adsorption onto the inner cylinder walls. This results in severe dielectric film delamination, non-uniform nucleation, unrecoverable EOT degradation (>4.5 nm), and a 10x surge in trap-assisted capacitor leakage current.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

The process achieves >= 28 fF/cell storage capacitance, leakage current < 1 fA/cell at 85°C, zero structural cylinder stiction, and a confirmed retention pause time > 64 ms across an 8-inch test wafer.

critics.systems_engineer: While shifting from an ONO stack (k ~ 7) to Ta2O5 (k ~ 22-25) allows reducing crown cylinder height from 1.0 um to ~0.45 um at the 180nm node (8F^2 footprint of 0.259 um^2), the post-deposition annealing budget (>700°C in O2/N2O for Ta2O5 crystallization) risks unacceptable dopant deactivation and junction diffusion in the underlying W-plug to N+ drain contact. Thermal integration requires a strictly controlled RTP budget <= 650°C with TiN or Ru bottom electrodes to prevent interface oxidation and parasitic series resistance spikes.
critics.domain_expert: CVD/ALD Ta2O5 deposited over high-aspect-ratio (AR > 4:1) 3D polysilicon or TiN cylinders exhibits micro-crack formation and step coverage loss at the bottom inner corners. Without an ultra-thin (1.0-1.5 nm) Si3N4 or Al2O3 interfacial barrier, oxygen out-diffusion oxidizes the bottom electrode, generating a low-k interfacial SiO2 layer (k ~ 3.9) that degrades the effective capacitance below the mandatory 28 fF budget and induces Poole-Frenkel conduction leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.
critics.supply_chain: Tantalum ethoxide (Ta(OC2H5)5) precursor and high-purity TiCl4/TDMAT for TiN barrier layers require high-integrity temperature-controlled bubblers and dedicated exhaust scrubbers that are absent in generic open-source university fabs. Sourcing semiconductor-grade Ta precursors in SEA involves long lead times (>16 weeks); maintaining an ONO triple-stack oxidation/nitridation furnace line as an operational dual-path fallback is essential to mitigate tapeout halts.
critics.laya_pm: Dual-dielectric optimization (Ta2O5 vs. ONO) expands the mask and wafer split lot by 6 runs, stretching the inline metrology turnaround by 3.5 weeks. The project critical path cannot accommodate sequential development; wet cylinder chemical etchback and dielectric atomic layer deposition must be modularly qualified on 8-inch coupon arrays before committing full device lots.
critical_failure_modes: Interfacial low-k oxide growth (SiOx/TiOx) at the bottom electrode interface reducing equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) scaling and collapsing cell capacitance below 25 fF.
Mechanical crown cylinder stiction, tilting, or pattern collapse during sacrificial BPSG wet oxide strip caused by capillary forces of deionized water rinse.
Excessive Poole-Frenkel and trap-assisted tunneling leakage current (>1.5 fA/cell at 1.0V, 85°C) across un-annealed Ta2O5 grain boundaries, degrading retention time below 64 ms.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM180-CIRC-042`
**Title:** Crown Cylinder 3D Aspect Ratio & Surface Area Analytical Parametrization  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu$m)  
**Layout Architecture:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB)  
**Target Structure:** Polysilicon / MIM Crown Cylinder Storage Node  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Determine Storage    │
│      Node Budget       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Formulate Analytical  │
│          Area          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Parametrize Aspect   │
│         Ratio          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Verification Against  │
│  Differential Margin   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Analytical Parametrization Procedure

#### Step 1: Establish Cell Capacitance and Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) Targets
1. Set the target storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (acceptable operational design window: $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$) to ensure data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and protect against alpha-particle soft errors.
2. Select the high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or ONO) with an effective relative dielectric permittivity $\kappa > 15$ and target Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ ($t_{\text{ox,eq}} = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$ to $4.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$).

#### Step 2: Formulate Required Effective Surface Area ($A_{\text{eff}}$)
1. Apply the parallel-plate electrostatic approximation for thin conformal dielectric films:
   $$C_s = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} \cdot A_{\text{eff}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\text{EOT}} \cdot A_{\text{eff}}$$
   Where:
   - $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}$
   - $\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.9$
   - Permittivity ratio: $\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}$
2. Calculate the required effective active area for nominal $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ with $\text{EOT} = 3.5\text{ nm}$:
   $$A_{\text{eff}} = \frac{C_s \cdot \text{EOT}}{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}} = \frac{28 \times 10^{-15}\text{ F} \times 3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}}{3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}} \approx 0.284\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$$

#### Step 3: Parametrize 3D Crown Cylinder Geometry & Aspect Ratio ($AR$)
1. **Footprint & Diameter:**  
   In the $8F^2$ cell pitch ($F = 180\text{ nm}$, wordline and bitline pitch $P = 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), define the cylinder outer diameter $D_{\text{out}} \approx 200\text{ nm}$ to $220\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and crown shell wall thickness $t_{\text{wall}} \approx 25\text{ nm}$ to $30\text{ nm}$. Inner diameter $D_{\text{in}} = D_{\text{out}} - 2t_{\text{wall}} \approx 150\text{ nm}$ to $160\text{ nm}$.
2. **Surface Area Formulation:**  
   The crown cylinder dual-surface provides capacitive area from both outer and inner sidewalls plus bottom surfaces:
   $$A_{\text{eff}} \approx \pi \cdot (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) \cdot H_{\text{cyl}} + \frac{\pi}{4}(D_{\text{in}}^2)$$
   With mean diameter $D_{\text{mean}} = \frac{D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}}{2} \approx 185\text{ nm} = 0.185\text{ }\mu\text{m}$:
   $$A_{\text{sidewall}} \approx 2\pi D_{\text{mean}} H_{\text{cyl}} \approx 1.162 \cdot H_{\text{cyl}}$$
3. **Solve Cylinder Height & Aspect Ratio:**  
   - Base area contribution: $A_{\text{base}} \approx \frac{\pi}{4}(0.16)^2 \approx 0.020\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Required sidewall area: $A_{\text{sidewall}} = 0.284 - 0.020 = 0.264\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Required height: $H_{\text{cyl}} = \frac{0.264}{1.162} \approx 0.227\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $0.350\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ (accounting for taper angles and non-idealities).
   - Aspect Ratio ($AR = H_{\text{cyl}} / D_{\text{out}}$): Target $AR$ range is parametrized between $1.2:1$ and $1.8:1$, preventing high-aspect-ratio cylinder collapse while achieving capacitance.

#### Step 4: Validate Readout Signal Differential Voltage ($\Delta V$)
1. Evaluate signal margin dumped onto the folded bitline via access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$):
   $$\Delta V = \left( \frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s} \right) \cdot \left( V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2} \right)$$
2. Confirm that with $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ and nominal bitline parasitic $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V$ falls strictly within the required $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ differential sensing window for the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Target Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Direct LCR CV-profiling at $1\text{ MHz}$ ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry & MOS Capacitor CV extraction |
| **Capacitor Leakage Current Density** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Precision picoammeter test at $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ ($85^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Sense Amp Differential Readout ($\Delta V$)** | $125$ | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Oscilloscope picoprobe / SPICE transient readout |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**  
  - Confirms unit cell geometry access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in an $8F^2$ folded bitline layout with capacitor erected over W-plug drain contact.  
  - Sets the high-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/ONO) permittivity target $\kappa > 15$, minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and maximum leakage ceiling of $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
  - Confirms 1T1C storage capacitor allowable range of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$ to guarantee retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.  
  - Specifies $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ high-$k$ equivalent oxide thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, with bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**  
  - Supplies the differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.  
  - Confirms nominal bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, defining the required differential signal development window of $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² cell at the 180nm node (F=180nm, cell area ~0.259 µm²), achieving the required storage capacitance (Cs >= 25 fF/cell) within a 0.54 µm x 0.48 µm footprint necessitates a 3D crown cylinder height of 0.8 µm to 1.2 µm, pushing the physical aspect ratio to 5:1 - 7:1. The analytical parametrization must rigorously account for the mechanical beam-bending limits of thin-wall polysilicon/TiN bottom electrodes under capillary drying forces, otherwise stiction and crown collapsing will cause catastrophic bitline-to-cell shorts.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Analytical surface area calculations cannot assume an idealized right-circular cylinder; they must incorporate taper angles (88° to 89.5°) resulting from high-density plasma dry etch (RIE/ICP) of sacrificial oxide molds, inner versus outer effective surface areas, and bottom corner rounding. Furthermore, when mapping the effective dielectric constant of Ta2O5 (k ~ 22-25) or ONO stacks (k_eff ~ 5.5-6.5), the physical thickness must be constrained to avoid quantum mechanical direct tunneling leakage while fitting into the crown inner diameter (> 120nm clear space) without premature pinch-off during top-plate polysilicon/CVD-TiN refill.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor availability for Ta2O5 atomic layer deposition (such as tantalum ethoxide Ta(OC2H5)5 or tertiary amyl imido tris(dimethylamido) tantalum) in open-source pilot runs in Vietnam faces strict chemical import logistics and shelf-life constraints. If precursor purity drops below 99.999% or delivery is delayed, an engineered ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) thermal LPCVD dielectric stack must be pre-parametrized as a drop-in analytical alternative to prevent pilot line fabrication halts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Crown capacitor height directly dictates the depth-of-focus (DOF) and topography step budget for subsequent M1 metal layers. If the crown cylinder height exceeds 1.1 µm, the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) process window degrades, resulting in residual metal stringers and schedule delays. Parametric limits must be frozen with clear bounds for design signoff before mask tape-out.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Capillary force-induced pattern collapse (stiction) of adjacent 3D crown storage nodes during wet sacrificial mold stripping and DI water rinse.
1. Incomplete core fill and void formation in the crown cavity during top electrode (TiN/poly-Si) CVD deposition due to re-entrant sidewall tapers.
1. Severe dielectric leakage and breakdown due to native oxide interfacial formation (SiOx) and carbon residue at the bottom electrode interface prior to Ta2O5 ALD deposition.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F² cell at the 180nm node (F=180nm, cell area ~0.259 µm²), achieving the required storage capacitance (Cs >= 25 fF/cell) within a 0.54 µm x 0.48 µm footprint necessitates a 3D crown cylinder height of 0.8 µm to 1.2 µm, pushing the physical aspect ratio to 5:1 - 7:1. The analytical parametrization must rigorously account for the mechanical beam-bending limits of thin-wall polysilicon/TiN bottom electrodes under capillary drying forces, otherwise stiction and crown collapsing will cause catastrophic bitline-to-cell shorts.
critics.domain_expert: Analytical surface area calculations cannot assume an idealized right-circular cylinder; they must incorporate taper angles (88° to 89.5°) resulting from high-density plasma dry etch (RIE/ICP) of sacrificial oxide molds, inner versus outer effective surface areas, and bottom corner rounding. Furthermore, when mapping the effective dielectric constant of Ta2O5 (k ~ 22-25) or ONO stacks (k_eff ~ 5.5-6.5), the physical thickness must be constrained to avoid quantum mechanical direct tunneling leakage while fitting into the crown inner diameter (> 120nm clear space) without premature pinch-off during top-plate polysilicon/CVD-TiN refill.
critics.supply_chain: Precursor availability for Ta2O5 atomic layer deposition (such as tantalum ethoxide Ta(OC2H5)5 or tertiary amyl imido tris(dimethylamido) tantalum) in open-source pilot runs in Vietnam faces strict chemical import logistics and shelf-life constraints. If precursor purity drops below 99.999% or delivery is delayed, an engineered ONO (Oxide-Nitride-Oxide) thermal LPCVD dielectric stack must be pre-parametrized as a drop-in analytical alternative to prevent pilot line fabrication halts.
critics.laya_pm: Crown capacitor height directly dictates the depth-of-focus (DOF) and topography step budget for subsequent M1 metal layers. If the crown cylinder height exceeds 1.1 µm, the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) process window degrades, resulting in residual metal stringers and schedule delays. Parametric limits must be frozen with clear bounds for design signoff before mask tape-out.
critical_failure_modes: Capillary force-induced pattern collapse (stiction) of adjacent 3D crown storage nodes during wet sacrificial mold stripping and DI water rinse.
Incomplete core fill and void formation in the crown cavity during top electrode (TiN/poly-Si) CVD deposition due to re-entrant sidewall tapers.
Severe dielectric leakage and breakdown due to native oxide interfacial formation (SiOx) and carbon residue at the bottom electrode interface prior to Ta2O5 ALD deposition.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Crown Cylinder 3D Geometric Envelope & Aspect Ratio Formulation

### 1. Scope & Objective
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the analytical formulation, geometric budgeting, and step-by-step physical parametrization for the 3D Crown Cylinder storage node capacitor in an $8F^2$ Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture at the 180 nm node ($F = 180\text{ nm} = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$). The goal is to formulate an exact 3D geometric envelope meeting the target capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$) within layout envelope constraints while maintaining mechanical stability.

---

### 2. Physical Layout & Geometric Constraints

```
       |<------------- Outer Diameter D_out ------------->|
       |     |<--------- Inner Diameter D_in --------->|   |
       +-----+                                         +-----+  ^
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       |     |        Storage Dielectric Stack         |     |  |
       |     |       (ONO or Ta2O5 / Al2O3)            |     |  |
       |     |                                         |     |  Cylinder
       |     |                                         |     |  Height H
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       |     |                                         |     |  |
       +-----+-----------------------------------------+-----+  v
       |================ Tungsten Plug (W-Plug) =============|
       +-----------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Unit Cell Footprint ($8F^2$ Layout):**
   - Feature size: $F = 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ ($180\text{ nm}$).
   - Cell Area: $A_{\text{cell}} = 8F^2 = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.2592\ \mu\text{m}^2$.
   - Bitline and Wordline Pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
2. **Capacitor Envelope Limits:**
   - Maximum allowable outer diameter: $D_{\text{out}} \le 220\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ and respecting inter-crown spacing margins at $360\text{ nm}$ pitch).
   - Bottom electrode wall thickness: $t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 30\text{ nm}$.
   - Inner diameter: $D_{\text{in}} = D_{\text{out}} - 2 \cdot t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 220\text{ nm} - 60\text{ nm} = 160\text{ nm}$.
3. **Dielectric Stack Specification:**
   - Stack: ONO triple dielectric or high-$k$ $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack.
   - Effective Dielectric Constant: $\kappa \ge 15$.
   - Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT): $t_{\text{ox,eq}} = 3.0\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ ($3.0 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$ to $4.0 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$).

---

### 3. Analytical Formulation & Calculation Steps

#### Step 1: Effective Capacitance per Unit Area ($C''$)
Using parallel-plate equivalence for thin dielectrics across the 3D surface:
$$C'' = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \kappa_{\text{eff}}}{t_{\text{phys}}} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \cdot \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2}}{\text{EOT}} = \frac{(8.854 \times 10^{-14}\text{ F/cm}) \times 3.9}{\text{EOT}}$$

For target $\text{EOT} = 3.5\text{ nm} = 3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}$:
$$C'' \approx \frac{3.453 \times 10^{-13}\text{ F/cm}}{3.5 \times 10^{-7}\text{ cm}} \approx 9.866 \times 10^{-7}\text{ F/cm}^2 \approx 9.87\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2$$

*(At $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm}$, $C'' \approx 11.51\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2$)*

#### Step 2: Total Effective Surface Area Budget ($A_{\text{eff}}$)
To achieve the minimum target capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (within the $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ window for data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$):
$$A_{\text{eff,req}} = \frac{C_{\text{target}}}{C''} = \frac{28\text{ fF}}{9.87\text{ fF}/\mu\text{m}^2} \approx 2.837\ \mu\text{m}^2$$

#### Step 3: 3D Crown Cylinder Surface Area Formulation
A 3D crown cylinder capacitor utilizes both the outer vertical wall, inner vertical wall, and top/bottom rim/base surfaces:
$$A_{\text{crown}} \approx \pi D_{\text{out}} H + \pi D_{\text{in}} H + \frac{\pi}{4}(D_{\text{in}}^2) = \pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) H + \frac{\pi}{4} D_{\text{in}}^2$$

Substituting nominal dimensions ($D_{\text{out}} = 0.22\ \mu\text{m}$, $D_{\text{in}} = 0.16\ \mu\text{m}$):
$$\pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}}) = \pi (0.22 + 0.16)\ \mu\text{m} \approx 1.194\ \mu\text{m}$$
$$\text{Base Area } A_{\text{base}} = \frac{\pi}{4}(0.16\ \mu\text{m})^2 \approx 0.0201\ \mu\text{m}^2$$

Solving for cylinder height $H$:
$$H = \frac{A_{\text{eff,req}} - A_{\text{base}}}{\pi (D_{\text{out}} + D_{\text{in}})} = \frac{2.837 - 0.0201}{1.194} \approx 2.36\ \mu\text{m}$$

With process margin and dielectric variation ($\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$), define the cylinder height envelope as:
$$H_{\text{crown}} = 2.0\ \mu\text{m} \text{ to } 2.4\ \mu\text{m}$$

#### Step 4: Aspect Ratio (AR) Formulation
Aspect ratio is formulated as the ratio of cylinder vertical depth/height to the inner/outer critical dimension:
$$\text{AR}_{\text{outer}} = \frac{H}{D_{\text{out}}} = \frac{2.36\ \mu\text{m}}{0.22\ \mu\text{m}} \approx 10.7 : 1$$
$$\text{AR}_{\text{etch}} = \frac{H}{D_{\text{in}}} = \frac{2.36\ \mu\text{m}}{0.16\ \mu\text{m}} \approx 14.8 : 1$$

Both values remain within the etch and mechanical collapse boundaries ($\text{AR} \le 15:1$) for Gen 2 ($180\text{ nm}$) oxide-mold deep reactive-ion etching (DRIE).

---

### 4. Step-by-Step Implementation Procedure

1. **Mold Oxide Deposition:**
   - Deposit sacrificial PECVD $\text{SiO}_2$ mold layer to target thickness $H = 2.36\ \mu\text{m} \pm 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$ directly above the inter-layer dielectric (ILD) containing the tungsten storage node plug (W-plug).
2. **Storage Node Contact Alignment & Deep Trench/Hole Dry Etch:**
   - Pattern cylinder hole array via photolithography aligned to underlying W-plug at pitch $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$.
   - Perform high-aspect-ratio reactive-ion etch (HAR-RIE) through the sacrificial oxide mold to create openings with top diameter $D_{\text{out}} \le 220\text{ nm}$.
3. **Bottom Electrode Deposition & Node Separation:**
   - Conformally deposit doped polysilicon or metal-insulator-metal (MIM) liner ($t_{\text{poly/metal}} = 30\text{ nm}$) over the inner sidewalls and bottom of the cylindrical oxide cavities.
   - Perform chemical-mechanical polishing (CMP) or etch-back to isolate individual storage nodes at the mold surface.
4. **Sacrificial Mold Wet Strip (Crown Release):**
   - Perform dilute HF/buffered oxide etch (BOE) to strip the sacrificial $\text{SiO}_2$ mold, exposing both inner and outer cylinder sidewalls to form freestanding crowns.
5. **High-$k$ Dielectric & Top Plate Deposition:**
   - Conformally deposit the high-$k$ dielectric layer (ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\ /\ \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective $\kappa \ge 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$).
   - Deposit upper plate counter-electrode (poly-Si or metal plate) filling the cylinder cavities and common plate plane.

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Engineering Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.0 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Crown Cylinder Height ($H$)** | $2.36$ | $2.00 \text{ to } 2.45$ | $\mu\text{m}$ |
| **Cylinder Etch Aspect Ratio ($\text{AR}$)** | $14.8 : 1$ | $\le 15.0 : 1$ | ratio (dimensionless) |
| **Cell Retention Leakage Current ($85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 6. Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 
  - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), $8F^2$ folded bitline topology, W-plug contact, ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5/\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$), target capacitance minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ stacked crown/cylinder capacitor, retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF/cell}$, dielectric EOT $3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² cell architecture at Gen 2 (1.0 µm to 0.5 µm design rules scaling down towards 180nm), defining the 3D crown cylinder geometric envelope requires strict co-optimization between storage node contact (SNC) plug landing alignment and bitline parasitic capacitance (Cbl). Setting a crown height exceeding 1.2 µm with garage-grade contact aligners (±5 µm Gen 2 overlay tolerance) risks pattern toppling or severe inter-cell bridging across adjacent bitline spaces, directly degrading the retention signal-to-noise margin (Cs/Cbl ratio < 0.15).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: To achieve the required cell capacitance of >25 fF per cell using a high-k Ta2O5 (dielectric constant k ~ 25) or ONO stack (effective oxide thickness EOT ~ 3.5 nm) within an 8F² footprint (0.259 µm² at 180nm, or scaled up to ~1.0 µm² in Gen 2 prototyping), inner and outer sidewall utilization of a hollow 3D cylinder is mandatory. The aspect ratio must be capped between 2.5:1 and 4:1; higher ratios cause severe capillary-force collapse during DI water dry-down or wet chemical etching of the sacrificial core oxide (BPSG/TEOS).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Precursor and chemical accessibility in Vietnam poses constraints: analytical grade HMDS (CAS 999-97-3), Shipley 1813 / AZ 1512 resists, and semiconductor-grade tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH) or MF-319 developer are restricted or have long import lead times (8-12 weeks). Sacrificial mold removal using buffered oxide etch (BOE) requires electronic grade NH4F and concentrated HF, which are strictly regulated hazardous materials requiring verified local vendor permits.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule risk is driven by iterative lithography-etch-clean calibration cycles. If the cylinder mold lithography requires more than 3 exposure-focus matrix (FEM) runs due to non-planar resist buildup over deep topography (>1.3 µm Shipley 1813 over contact steps), the wafer turnaround time will slip by 14 working days, jeopardizing the Q4 tapeout milestone for the 180nm cell matrix prototype.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Capillary stiction and mechanical pattern collapse of adjacent crown cylinders during post-sacrificial wet etch rinse and drying.
1. Bottom-corner thinning or keyhole voiding of the bottom storage node electrode (doped poly-Si or TiN) causing open contacts or high contact resistance (>10 kOhm/cell).
1. Severe resist line-edge roughness (LER > 25 nm) and exposure defocus over 1.2 µm topography, leading to cylinder outer wall shorting to neighboring bitlines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-2-1-1-01` | **Cross-Sectional SEM Critical Dimension & Aspect Ratio Verification** | Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM, Hitachi S-4800 or equivalent) with calibrated secondary electron detector; Focused Ion Beam (FIB) for cross-sectioning. | 1. Mount wafer coupon into FIB-SEM dual-beam chamber and locate 8F² 3D crown array test macro. 2. Deposit protective Pt strap (1.5 µm thick) over region of interest. 3. Mill cross-sectional trench normal to wordline orientation using 30 kV Ga+ ion beam. 4. Polish cross-section face at 5 kV, 48 pA beam current. 5. Acquire high-magnification SEM micrographs (80,000x at 5.0 kV). 6. Measure outer diameter (OD), inner diameter (ID), wall thickness (Tw), and cylinder height (H) across 15 distinct cells. | `Cylinder height H must measure 1.20 µm ± 0.08 µm; outer wall thickness Tw must be >= 65 nm; cylinder verticality (sidewall angle) must be between 88.0° and 91.5°; aspect ratio (H/OD) must measure between 2.8:1 and 3.2:1 with zero observed pattern collapse or bridge defects.` |

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F² cell architecture at Gen 2 (1.0 µm to 0.5 µm design rules scaling down towards 180nm), defining the 3D crown cylinder geometric envelope requires strict co-optimization between storage node contact (SNC) plug landing alignment and bitline parasitic capacitance (Cbl). Setting a crown height exceeding 1.2 µm with garage-grade contact aligners (±5 µm Gen 2 overlay tolerance) risks pattern toppling or severe inter-cell bridging across adjacent bitline spaces, directly degrading the retention signal-to-noise margin (Cs/Cbl ratio < 0.15).
critics.domain_expert: To achieve the required cell capacitance of >25 fF per cell using a high-k Ta2O5 (dielectric constant k ~ 25) or ONO stack (effective oxide thickness EOT ~ 3.5 nm) within an 8F² footprint (0.259 µm² at 180nm, or scaled up to ~1.0 µm² in Gen 2 prototyping), inner and outer sidewall utilization of a hollow 3D cylinder is mandatory. The aspect ratio must be capped between 2.5:1 and 4:1; higher ratios cause severe capillary-force collapse during DI water dry-down or wet chemical etching of the sacrificial core oxide (BPSG/TEOS).
