# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Controlled Vacuum Alpha Flux Exposure & Real-Time In-Situ Bit-Flip Logging

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. Mount DUT & Hermetic Feedthrough Docking │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. Chamber Pumpdown (<1e-4 Torr) & Thermal  │
│     Stabilization (85°C Chuck Baseline)      │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. Pattern Pre-Fill & Precharge Init        │
│     (BL/nBL to V_DD / 2, Solid '1'/'0')      │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. Actuate Shutter & Alpha Flux Exposure    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. In-Situ Real-Time Bit-Flip Interrogation │
│     & Critical Charge (Qcrit) Mapping        │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the vacuum-chamber exposure of 180nm 1T1C Crown-type Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) open-source DRAM dies to calibrated alpha radiation flux. The test interrogates dynamic bit retention in situ, measuring Single Event Upset (SEU) rates and soft-error bit-flip onset across variable refresh intervals.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **DUT Preparation & Vacuum Docking:**
   - Mount the decapsulated 180nm DRAM test vehicle (8F² cell array with crown-type stacked capacitors) onto the zero-insertion-force (ZIF) ceramic socket within the irradiation test fixture.
   - Connect high-speed signal lines via low-capacitance feedthroughs to the automated tester interface.
   - Close chamber and pump down to high vacuum ($\le 10^{-4}\text{ Torr}$) to eliminate atmospheric alpha attenuation and scattering.

2. **Thermal & Electrical Initialization:**
   - Regulate chuck thermal stage to the reference retention testing temperature of **85°C**.
   - Power up the chip core; initialize the folded-bitline sense amplifier sub-system with bitline equalization configured to **$\mathbf{V_{DD}/2}$**.
   - Perform initial baseline read/write retention screening at a refresh interval of **64 ms** to verify non-irradiated yield.

3. **Storage Node Pattern Initialization:**
   - Write defined calibration data patterns (Solid '1', Solid '0', and Checkerboard) into target subarrays.
   - For cells holding logic '1', store charge corresponding to target cell capacitance **$C_s = 25\text{ to }28\text{ fF}$** with bitline capacitance **$C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$** delivering a readout differential $\Delta V$ of **$100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$**.

4. **Alpha Particle Shutter Control & Flux Exposure:**
   - Position calibrated alpha source (collimated ${}^{241}\text{Am}$ / alpha foil) directly above the exposed active array crown capacitor stack.
   - Actuate pneumatic shutter mechanism to commence controlled alpha flux exposure onto the unshielded silicon surface.

5. **In-Situ Readout & Real-Time Bit-Flip Logging:**
   - Execute continuous paused-refresh retention loops (stepping retention pause from baseline 64 ms upward and downward).
   - Log bit-flip timestamps, fail bit coordinates ($X, Y$), logical polarity ($1 \to 0$ discharge vs. $0 \to 1$ collector coupling), and cumulative flux in real time.
   - Cross-correlate soft errors with cell junction leakage and assess critical charge $Q_{\text{crit}}$ margin against the baseline leakage threshold.

6. **Post-Exposure Shut-off:**
   - Close alpha source shutter.
   - Vent vacuum chamber with dry nitrogen ($N_2$) purge and power down the DUT stage safely.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Context Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **25 to 28** (Min $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology*, *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |
| **Sense Amp Signal Differential ($\Delta V$)** | **100 to 150** | $\text{mV}$ | *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design* |
| **Baseline Leakage Current (@ 85°C)** | **$< 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* |
| **Chamber Test Temperature** | **85** | $\text{°C}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture*, *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* |
| **Baseline Non-Irradiated Data Retention Time** | **$> 64$** | $\text{ms}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations
- **Capacitance & Noise Immunity:** Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors (*180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*); storage capacitor maintains $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell (*Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Leakage & Retention Baseline:** Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85\text{°C}$ (*180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology*); data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85\text{°C}$ (*Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture*).
- **Sense Amplifier Differential:** Folded bitline sense amp with precharge to $V_{DD}/2$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding differential signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ to }150\text{ mV}$ (*Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In-situ real-time bit-flip monitoring inside a moderate vacuum chamber (<200 mbar absolute) introduces signal integrity trade-offs across high-density probe feedthroughs. The coaxial/triaxial feedthrough harness exhibits parasitic capacitance and inductive ringing that can distort DRAM write/read timing (t_RCD, t_RP) at 180nm CMOS operational frequencies. Dynamic pattern logging must decouple the physical interface noise from radiation-induced soft error rate (SER) upsets, necessitating active signal conditioning or buffer ICs rated for vacuum and mild radiation directly within the chamber payload.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm with an 8F² crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, the design targets 28 fF per cell, yielding a nominal critical charge Qcrit of ~25-30 fC at 1.8V VDD. Operating the Am-241 alpha exposure under rough-to-medium vacuum eliminates air-gap energy straggling (Bragg peak distortion), ensuring that monoenergetic ~5.48 MeV alpha particles impinge cleanly on the crown capacitor and pass-transistor drain junction. Unwanted secondary effects such as micro-channeling through unshielded ILD/passivation layers and alpha-induced latchup in surrounding peripheral sense amplifiers must be monitored via per-bank supply current tracking.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Sealed Americium-241 or Polonium-210 alpha foil radiation sources (activity ranging 0.1 to 1.0 µCi / 3.7 to 37 kBq) require strict nuclear regulatory licensing (e.g., Vietnam VARANS or equivalent Form 5 radioactive material acquisition compliance). Radiation-hardened hermetic vacuum electrical feedthroughs (such as 50-pin Sub-D ceramic-to-metal vacuum flanges rated for 10^-6 mbar) have lead times exceeding 12-16 weeks; procuring secondary source spares and certified check sources must precede chamber assembly.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The vacuum-SER testbench schedule directly bottlenecks Gen 2 cell reliability validation. Total cycle time per run is dominated by chamber pump-down, in-situ pattern verification across solid/checkerboard/marching patterns, and controlled venting with dry N2. To preserve the project timeline, throughput must be enhanced by standardizing rapid-mount carrier fixtures that enable quick insertion without risking source surface flaking or breaking fragile 28 fF crown nanostructures.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Alpha source foil degradation or particulate spallation due to pressure shock during chamber evacuation/venting, leading to radiological contamination of the wafer stage and unstable flux calibration.
1. Parasitic thermal drift of peripheral access transistors under vacuum conduction limits, inducing thermal leakage false positives that mask alpha-generated electron-hole pair collection.
1. Chamber feedthrough impedance mismatch causing cross-talk and timing violations on wordline/bitline pulses, misinterpreted as soft-error bit-flips.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-3-3-3-2-01` | **Vacuum Alpha Flux Calibration & Static Pattern Retention Soft-Error Rate Profiling** | Vacuum Chamber (<200 mbar) with Calibrated Am-241 Alpha Surface Source (37 kBq), Silicon Charged-Particle Surface Barrier Detector (Ortec/Canberra), Keithley 2636B SourceMeter, FPGA-Based Real-Time DRAM Tester Interface. | 1. Position alpha source directly normal to the unpassivated die surface at a calibrated mechanical distance of 10.0 mm. 2. Verify incident alpha flux using the surface barrier detector at 1.2e4 alphas/cm²-min. 3. Write physical 'ALL-1s' and 'ALL-0s' patterns across a 1 Mb test block at VDD = 1.80 V. 4. Expose array for 3600 seconds with refresh cycles suspended for intervals equal to retention margin (100 ms). 5. Continuously log bit-flip addresses, cell coordinates, and cumulative upset counts via high-speed FPGA burst reads. | `Total single-bit upset (SBU) rate must be ≤ 4.5e-3 upsets/hour/Mb under a calibrated flux of 1.2e4 alphas/cm²-min at 25°C. Zero multi-cell upsets (MCU) exceeding 2 adjacent cells. Source flux variance across 3600 s must remain within ±5%.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-3-3-3-2-02` | **Dynamic Marching/Checkerboard In-Situ SER & Critical Charge (Qcrit) Voltage Sensitivity Mapping** | Vacuum Probe Chamber with Sub-D Feedthrough, Precision Agilent/Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer, Fast Arbitrary Waveform Generator (AWG), FPGA Bit-Flip Real-Time Logger. | 1. Apply continuous March C- algorithmic test pattern to the active 1 Mb sector under steady alpha flux exposure (1.2e4 alphas/cm²-min). 2. Step bitline precharge / cell core voltage (VDD_CORE) from 1.80 V down to 1.20 V in 50 mV decrements, holding each plateau for 600 seconds. 3. Record real-time upset counts, bit addresses, and VDD_CORE threshold where SER accelerates exponentially. 4. Derive Qcrit = C_cell * (VDD_CORE_threshold - V_BL_sense) and extract charge collection efficiency. | `Extracted critical charge Qcrit must be ≥ 22.4 fC at nominal VDD = 1.80 V (corresponding to C_cell ≥ 28 fF). Exponential knee of SER onset must occur at VDD_CORE < 1.35 V. Bit-flip logging must register zero buffer overflows or corrupted frame packets across all voltage steps.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Nitrile cleanroom gloves (double-gloving protocol), ANSI Z87.1 certified radiation/laser impact safety glasses, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) grounded cleanroom smock and hood, Personal optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) radiation dosimeter badge, Calibrated handheld alpha/beta survey meter (Ludlum Model 3 with 44-9 probe) on standby
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Alpha radiation is an internal contamination hazard. In case of suspected source foil rupture or contact, immediately evacuate personnel, cordon area, and remove outer PPE peeling inward. For skin contact, wash thoroughly with lukewarm water and mild non-abrasive detergent for 15 minutes; do not abrade skin. If inhalation/ingestion of dislodged particulate occurs, contact Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and emergency poison control immediately for chelation therapy assessment (e.g., Ca-DTPA / Zn-DTPA administration under physician supervision).
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Chamber vacuum roughing pump exhaust must be connected to an active scrubbed HEPA-filtered cleanroom exhaust duct. Chamber venting must pass through a 0.02 µm particulate arrestance filter. Minimum cleanroom ventilation rate of 30 air changes per hour with continuous negative pressure differential in the radioisotope metrology bay.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent wipes, contaminated swab test tools, and damaged source holders must be segregated in yellow hazardous radioactive waste containers labeled with Class 7 Radioactive Material placards. Wipes must be checked for loose counts via wipe test (< 0.005 µCi / 200 Bq per 100 cm² threshold). Dispose of exclusively via licensed national radiological waste repositories; no general drain or cleanroom disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Americium-241 (Sealed electrodeposited alpha source foil)** | `14596-10-2` | Radioisotope Standard (Calibrated sealed source) | `37 kBq (1.0 µCi) total activity` |
| **Dry Compressed Nitrogen (Chamber vent and purge gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Grade 5.0 (Ultra-High Purity 99.999%) | `100.0%` |
| **Isopropanol (Chamber wiper/degreaser)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly stripped unpassivated or thin-passivated die surface, post-crown metallization and anneal, free from native oxide build-up, organic residue (<0.5 nm by XPS), or moisture condensation.

critics.systems_engineer: In-situ real-time bit-flip monitoring inside a moderate vacuum chamber (<200 mbar absolute) introduces signal integrity trade-offs across high-density probe feedthroughs. The coaxial/triaxial feedthrough harness exhibits parasitic capacitance and inductive ringing that can distort DRAM write/read timing (t_RCD, t_RP) at 180nm CMOS operational frequencies. Dynamic pattern logging must decouple the physical interface noise from radiation-induced soft error rate (SER) upsets, necessitating active signal conditioning or buffer ICs rated for vacuum and mild radiation directly within the chamber payload.
critics.domain_expert: At 180nm with an 8F² crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, the design targets 28 fF per cell, yielding a nominal critical charge Qcrit of ~25-30 fC at 1.8V VDD. Operating the Am-241 alpha exposure under rough-to-medium vacuum eliminates air-gap energy straggling (Bragg peak distortion), ensuring that monoenergetic ~5.48 MeV alpha particles impinge cleanly on the crown capacitor and pass-transistor drain junction. Unwanted secondary effects such as micro-channeling through unshielded ILD/passivation layers and alpha-induced latchup in surrounding peripheral sense amplifiers must be monitored via per-bank supply current tracking.
critics.supply_chain: Sealed Americium-241 or Polonium-210 alpha foil radiation sources (activity ranging 0.1 to 1.0 µCi / 3.7 to 37 kBq) require strict nuclear regulatory licensing (e.g., Vietnam VARANS or equivalent Form 5 radioactive material acquisition compliance). Radiation-hardened hermetic vacuum electrical feedthroughs (such as 50-pin Sub-D ceramic-to-metal vacuum flanges rated for 10^-6 mbar) have lead times exceeding 12-16 weeks; procuring secondary source spares and certified check sources must precede chamber assembly.
critics.laya_pm: The vacuum-SER testbench schedule directly bottlenecks Gen 2 cell reliability validation. Total cycle time per run is dominated by chamber pump-down, in-situ pattern verification across solid/checkerboard/marching patterns, and controlled venting with dry N2. To preserve the project timeline, throughput must be enhanced by standardizing rapid-mount carrier fixtures that enable quick insertion without risking source surface flaking or breaking fragile 28 fF crown nanostructures.
critical_failure_modes: Alpha source foil degradation or particulate spallation due to pressure shock during chamber evacuation/venting, leading to radiological contamination of the wafer stage and unstable flux calibration.
Parasitic thermal drift of peripheral access transistors under vacuum conduction limits, inducing thermal leakage false positives that mask alpha-generated electron-hole pair collection.
Chamber feedthrough impedance mismatch causing cross-talk and timing violations on wordline/bitline pulses, misinterpreted as soft-error bit-flips.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-SER-004`
**Title:** Critical Charge ($Q_{\text{crit}}$) vs. Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) Extraction & Weibull Soft-Error Rate (SER) Modeling  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 1T1C DRAM Cell Topology & Layout ($8F^2$) > Crown-Type COB Stack & Dielectric Modeling > Cell Retention & Soft-Error Immunity Metrology ($28\text{ fF}$ / $<1\text{ fA}$ Leakage Verification) > Elevated Temperature Retention & Alpha-Source SER Profiling > Alpha-Particle Irradiation Exposure & SER $Q_{\text{crit}}$ Profiling > Critical Charge ($Q_{\text{crit}}$) vs Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) Extraction & Weibull SER Modeling  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 1: Wafer Test   │
│     Setup & Alpha      │
│      Irradiation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 2: Voltage     │
│    Stepping & Qcrit    │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 3: Storage Node  │
│  Cs Direct Metrology   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 4: Weibull     │
│  Cumulative Failure &  │
│      SER Modeling      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Environmental & Test Bench Stabilization:**
   - Mount the 180nm $8F^2$ wafer or packaged test vehicle onto the automated probe station thermal chuck.
   - Adjust and lock the chuck temperature at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to replicate worst-case leakage and sensing drift conditions.
   - Position an uncollimated/collimated calibrated low-energy alpha-particle emitter ($\text{Am}^{241}$ or standard thorium foil source) over the exposed test-array die area.

2. **Array Initialization & Pattern Programming:**
   - Precharge the complementary folded-bitline pairs ($BL$, $/BL$) to $\frac{V_{DD}}{2}$ via the bitline equalization network.
   - Assert wordlines ($WL$) to write solid logical data states ('1' with cell node charged to $V_{DD}$ and '0' with cell node pulled to $0\text{ V}$) across target memory blocks ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ access transistors).
   - De-assert wordlines and hold cell refresh idle over intervals up to $64\text{ ms}$ under continuous alpha irradiation.

3. **Voltage Stepping & Signal Margin Determination:**
   - Step the operating core supply voltage $V_{DD}$ downward incrementally while performing periodic array readouts via the cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier latches.
   - Monitor the differential bitline readout margin:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     (verifying nominal signal window within $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ across nominal $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Identify the marginal threshold voltage $V_{\text{fail}}$ at which bit flipping onset occurs due to ionizing alpha-track charge deposition.

4. **Direct Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) & $Q_{\text{crit}}$ Extraction:**
   - Perform precision LCR/C-V metrology on dedicated kerf macro test structures (crown-type MIM or polysilicon-insulator-polysilicon capacitors with $\text{ONO}$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric, target $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) to extract effective cell capacitance $C_s$.
   - Calculate critical charge:
     $$Q_{\text{crit}} = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{trip}}) \approx C_s \cdot \Delta V_{\text{margin}}$$
     for both data state '1' to '0' and '0' to '1' single-event upsets (SEU).
   - Verify junction and sub-threshold leakage stays within specs ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

5. **Weibull SER Modeling & Lifetime Projection:**
   - Collate bit error counts as a function of incident alpha fluence and critical charge.
   - Fit cumulative bit upset probability $F(Q)$ to the 2-parameter Weibull distribution:
     $$F(Q) = 1 - \exp\left[ - \left(\frac{Q}{\eta}\right)^\beta \right]$$
     where $\eta$ is the characteristic scale parameter (charge tolerance at $63.2\%$ failure) and $\beta$ is the Weibull shape parameter.
   - Project overall Soft-Error Rate ($\text{SER}$) expressed in Failure-in-Time ($\text{FIT} = 10^9\text{ device-hours}$) to ensure system-level alpha-induced immunity compliance.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ (Nominal: $\ge 28$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Automated C-V / LCR extraction on crown test array |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Sub-threshold & junction leakage electrometer at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Sense Amp Differential Readout Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Sense amplifier signal development readout at $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **Retention Interval Threshold** | $> 64$ | $\text{ms}$ | Retention time pause-refresh test at $T_{\text{chuck}} = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### Literature Context Citations

1. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in an $8F^2$ folded bitline topology.
   - Crown-type capacitor over bitline (COB) utilizing $\text{ONO}$, $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$, or $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric with effective constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Capacitance budget target of $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ ensuring alpha-particle soft-error immunity; leakage requirement $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - 1T1C stacked cell requiring $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell to ensure retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($\text{EOT}$) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ to }400\text{ nm}$.

3. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
   - Equalization of bitlines to $\frac{V_{DD}}{2}$.
   - Charge dump signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
   - Readout differential signal development yields $100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF}$ against $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline cell at 180nm, bitline parasitic capacitance (Cb) spans 150-250 fF while storage capacitance (Cs) targets 28 fF nominal (ratio Cb/Cs ~ 5.4:1 to 8.9:1). Critical charge Qcrit is governed by delta_V * Cs = (V_BL_high - V_BL_precharge) * Cs or the sense amplifier threshold differential delta_V_SA * (Cs + Cb). If alpha-particle ionizing radiation tracks deposit linear energy transfer (LET) generating charge Qcoll > Qcrit, bit-flip upsets occur. The system budget must ensure Qcrit >= 25 fC at nominal operating voltage VDD = 1.8V (Vplate = 0.9V) to guarantee soft-error failure in time (SER) < 500 FIT/Mb under terrestrial alpha fluxes (0.001 alpha/cm²/hr packaging baseline).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Weibull SER fitting requires decoupling electron-hole pair funneling collection efficiency from storage node collection versus bitline diffusion collection. At 180nm with high-k Al2O3/Ta2O5 crown-over-bitline MIM/poly structures, the tungsten storage node contact plug (W-plug) to p-well junction presents an electric field funnel that collects up to 60% of track ionization charge within 1.5 um depth. The 2-parameter or 3-parameter Weibull distribution parameters (slope parameter beta and characteristic threshold charge Q0) must be parameterized specifically against extracted physical Cs across wafer splits (22 fF, 25 fF, 28 fF, 32 fF) using calibrated Am-241 (5.48 MeV) or Th-230 alpha sources.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Alpha radiation metrology standards demand calibrated Americium-241 (Am-241) or Thorium-230 planar foil alpha sources with sealed source encapsulation (ISO 2919 class 43232) and active activity traceable to NIST/PTB standards (nominally 1.0 to 10.0 kBq/cm²). Secondary lead-shielded test chambers and Keithley 4200-SCS / Keysight B1500A SMU instruments with low-leakage probe cards (leakage floor < 50 aA) face long calibration turnaround times (8-12 weeks) and stringent transport licensing for radioisotopes into Vietnamese university/research cleanrooms.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Execution gating requires non-destructive CV profiling and radiation exposure to be performed on diced test vehicle array coupons (128kb/512kb macro test chips) prior to final mold packaging. The multi-wafer split schedule must isolate crown CMP height variation (driving Cs variance +/- 3 fF) within 14 calendar days of W-plug metallization to prevent queue-time-induced junction interface trap drift from confounding sub-1 fA leakage and alpha SER Weibull slope parameters.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Funneling collection saturation: Deep sub-surface alpha ionizing tracks traversing the p-well / n-substrate junction induce transient shorting, bypassing the storage node capacitance barrier and depositing Qcoll >> Qcrit regardless of Cs boost.
1. Dielectric soft breakdown under alpha strike: Localized microdosimetric displacement damage and high electric field stress across the 28 fF crown ultra-thin dielectric (EOT < 2.5 nm) causing irreversible stress-induced leakage current (SILC) exceeding 1 fA/cell.
1. Sense-amplifier differential unbalance during bitline hit: Direct alpha strike onto adjacent bitline diffusion node generating false differential delta_V during sense strobe, masquerading as storage node charge loss.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Connect high-force/sense triaxial leads to cell plate line (Vplate = 0.9V) and low-force/sense to bitline test structure with access wordline asserted to VPP = 3.3V. 2. Perform 100 kHz to 1 MHz multi-frequency C-V sweep from -0.9V to +0.9V across storage node to extract physical storage capacitance Cs at operating bias. 3. Apply dynamic write '1' (VDD = 1.8V) followed by controlled step-wise charge extraction via high-speed pulsed SMU (pulse width 5 ns, varying current sink from 0.1 uA to 10 uA in 50 nA increments). 4. Monitor sense amplifier read latch output after variable retention hold (10 ms) to identify marginal flip voltage delta_V_flip. 5. Compute critical charge Qcrit = Cs * delta_V_flip across 500 test cells. | `Nominal Cs must measure 28.0 fF +/- 2.5 fF across 95% of tested cells. Extracted critical charge Qcrit must be >= 25.2 fC (corresponding to delta_V_flip >= 0.90V at nominal 28 fF). Cell leakage current at 25°C must be < 0.1 fA/cell.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-2-3-3-3-3-02` | **Alpha-Particle Irradiation Exposure & Weibull SER Parameter Fitting** | Calibrated Am-241 Planar Alpha Source (Activity: 3.7 kBq/cm², 5.48 MeV), Vacuum/Air Radiation Exposure Fixture (source-to-die spacing 1.50 mm +/- 0.05 mm), Advantest T5588 Memory Test System with high-speed pattern generator. | 1. Position calibrated Am-241 alpha source directly above unencapsulated die aperture for fixed integration intervals (t = 60s, 120s, 300s, 600s, 1800s). 3. Read out bit error counts at each interval without intermediate rewrite, logging physical address bit coordinates and error accumulation. 4. Repeat for write solid '0' data pattern to separate storage node collection errors from bitline differential errors. 5. Fit bit-failure cumulative distribution F(Q) against charge collection spectrum using 2-parameter Weibull CDF: F(Q) = 1 - exp(-((Q - Q0)/eta)^beta). 6. Derive soft error rate SER (FIT/Mb) normalized to terrestrial alpha background flux of 0.001 alpha/cm²/hr. | `Weibull threshold parameter Q0 must exceed 22.0 fC. Shape parameter beta must reside between 1.2 and 2.5. Total accelerated soft-error rate under Am-241 exposure, when extrapolated to terrestrial flux (0.001 alpha/cm²/hr) at 85°C, must be <= 450 FIT/Mb.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Critical`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Lead-lined ionizing radiation handling apron (0.5 mm Pb equivalence), Double-layer disposable nitrile gloves (EN 374-1 / ASTM D6319), Thermo-luminescent dosimeter (TLD) body badge and extremity finger ring dosimeter, ANSI Z87.1 approved radiation-shielding polycarbonate safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom clean-suit (Tyvek) with conductive ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Radioactive alpha contamination: Cease operations immediately. In case of skin contact, gently wash skin with lukewarm water and mild pH-neutral chelating soap; do not abrade skin. For inhalation or internal contamination, immediately notify Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and administer DTPA (Diethylenetriaminepentaacetic acid) decorporation therapy under licensed medical supervision. For external lead exposure, wash skin thoroughly; seek medical attention if lead dust is inhaled.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Irradiation enclosure must operate inside an ISO Class 5 negative-pressure laminar flow station equipped with active continuous airborne alpha particulate radiation monitors (CAM) and dual-stage HEPA filtration (99.997% capture at 0.3 um). Exhaust line dedicated and monitored prior to facility discharge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: All radioactive wipe swipes, contaminated gloves, and expired sources must be categorized as Class A Low-Level Radioactive Waste (LLRW), sealed in double-walled high-density polyethylene (HDPE) containers within secondary lead-shielded drums, and surrendered to the national nuclear regulatory agency (VARANS) for disposal. No drain disposal permitted.

| **Lead (Shielding Bricks and Collimators)** | `7439-92-1` | High Purity Radiation Shielding Grade (>99.9%) | `100% solid element` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Open bondpad/microprobe aluminum-copper metallization exposed post-passivation etch, clean of polyimide residues, moisture-free.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Alpha-irradiated test coupon post-radiation wipe-test verified zero removable alpha activity (< 0.01 Bq/cm²), desiccated, nitrogen-purged ESD container.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air queue time causes native alumina oxide thickening and moisture adsorption on microprobe pads, increasing contact resistance (> 5 ohms) and introducing false RC delays in ns-scale critical charge pulsed extraction; airborne moisture also promotes surface leakage across unpassivated crown test structures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete metrological validation and Weibull SER parameterization for the 180nm 1T1C 8F² DRAM cell. Establishes the empirical relationship between crown storage node capacitance (target 28 fF) and critical charge Qcrit (target >= 25 fC), validating soft error immunity < 500 FIT/Mb under 0.001 alpha/cm²/hr terrestrial flux at 85°C.

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit approval requires verified calibration certificate of Am-241 alpha source, 100% completion of 500-cell Cs and Qcrit distributions demonstrating Cs >= 25.5 fF and Qcrit >= 23.2 fC (worst-case -3 sigma), confirmed Weibull shape parameter beta >= 1.2, terrestrial SER projection <= 500 FIT/Mb, and cleanroom wipe-test clearance confirming zero alpha radiation leakage.

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F² folded bitline cell at 180nm, bitline parasitic capacitance (Cb) spans 150-250 fF while storage capacitance (Cs) targets 28 fF nominal (ratio Cb/Cs ~ 5.4:1 to 8.9:1). Critical charge Qcrit is governed by delta_V * Cs = (V_BL_high - V_BL_precharge) * Cs or the sense amplifier threshold differential delta_V_SA * (Cs + Cb). If alpha-particle ionizing radiation tracks deposit linear energy transfer (LET) generating charge Qcoll > Qcrit, bit-flip upsets occur. The system budget must ensure Qcrit >= 25 fC at nominal operating voltage VDD = 1.8V (Vplate = 0.9V) to guarantee soft-error failure in time (SER) < 500 FIT/Mb under terrestrial alpha fluxes (0.001 alpha/cm²/hr packaging baseline).
critics.domain_expert: Weibull SER fitting requires decoupling electron-hole pair funneling collection efficiency from storage node collection versus bitline diffusion collection. At 180nm with high-k Al2O3/Ta2O5 crown-over-bitline MIM/poly structures, the tungsten storage node contact plug (W-plug) to p-well junction presents an electric field funnel that collects up to 60% of track ionization charge within 1.5 um depth. The 2-parameter or 3-parameter Weibull distribution parameters (slope parameter beta and characteristic threshold charge Q0) must be parameterized specifically against extracted physical Cs across wafer splits (22 fF, 25 fF, 28 fF, 32 fF) using calibrated Am-241 (5.48 MeV) or Th-230 alpha sources.
critics.supply_chain: Alpha radiation metrology standards demand calibrated Americium-241 (Am-241) or Thorium-230 planar foil alpha sources with sealed source encapsulation (ISO 2919 class 43232) and active activity traceable to NIST/PTB standards (nominally 1.0 to 10.0 kBq/cm²). Secondary lead-shielded test chambers and Keithley 4200-SCS / Keysight B1500A SMU instruments with low-leakage probe cards (leakage floor < 50 aA) face long calibration turnaround times (8-12 weeks) and stringent transport licensing for radioisotopes into Vietnamese university/research cleanrooms.
critics.laya_pm: Execution gating requires non-destructive CV profiling and radiation exposure to be performed on diced test vehicle array coupons (128kb/512kb macro test chips) prior to final mold packaging. The multi-wafer split schedule must isolate crown CMP height variation (driving Cs variance +/- 3 fF) within 14 calendar days of W-plug metallization to prevent queue-time-induced junction interface trap drift from confounding sub-1 fA leakage and alpha SER Weibull slope parameters.
critical_failure_modes: Funneling collection saturation: Deep sub-surface alpha ionizing tracks traversing the p-well / n-substrate junction induce transient shorting, bypassing the storage node capacitance barrier and depositing Qcoll >> Qcrit regardless of Cs boost.

Dielectric soft breakdown under alpha strike: Localized microdosimetric displacement damage and high electric field stress across the 28 fF crown ultra-thin dielectric (EOT < 2.5 nm) causing irreversible stress-induced leakage current (SILC) exceeding 1 fA/cell.

Sense-amplifier differential unbalance during bitline hit: Direct alpha strike onto adjacent bitline diffusion node generating false differential delta_V during sense strobe, masquerading as storage node charge loss.

testcases.title: Quasi-Static Storage Node Capacitance (Cs) & Critical Charge (Qcrit) Boundary Extraction
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with B1520A Multifrequency LCR meter, MPI TS200-SE semi-automated shielded probe station with Triaxial Low-Noise Kelvin Chuck, B1517A High-Resolution SMU (0.1 fA resolution).
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm 1T1C test array macro coupon diced, de-processed to crown plate/bitline test pads; chuck temperature stabilized at 25.0°C +/- 0.5°C; background chamber dark shield closed; chuck leakage baseline verified < 100 aA at 1.8V.
testcases.procedure:
1. Connect high-force/sense triaxial leads to cell plate line (Vplate = 0.9V) and low-force/sense to bitline test structure with access wordline asserted to VPP = 3.3V.
2. Perform 100 kHz to 1 MHz multi-frequency C-V sweep from -0.9V to +0.9V across storage node to extract physical storage capacitance Cs at operating bias.
3. Apply dynamic write '1' (VDD = 1.8V) followed by controlled step-wise charge extraction via high-speed pulsed SMU (pulse width 5 ns, varying current sink from 0.1 uA to 10 uA in 50 nA increments).
4. Monitor sense amplifier read latch output after variable retention hold (10 ms) to identify marginal flip voltage delta_V_flip.
5. Compute critical charge Qcrit = Cs * delta_V_flip across 500 test cells.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Nominal Cs must measure 28.0 fF +/- 2.5 fF across 95% of tested cells. Extracted critical charge Qcrit must be >= 25.2 fC (corresponding to delta_V_flip >= 0.90V at nominal 28 fF). Cell leakage current at 25°C must be < 0.1 fA/cell.

testcases.title: Alpha-Particle Irradiation Exposure & Weibull SER Parameter Fitting
testcases.instrumentation: Calibrated Am-241 Planar Alpha Source (Activity: 3.7 kBq/cm², 5.48 MeV), Vacuum/Air Radiation Exposure Fixture (source-to-die spacing 1.50 mm +/- 0.05 mm), Advantest T5588 Memory Test System with high-speed pattern generator.
testcases.pre_conditions: 128 kbit 1T1C array macro functional with 100% initial yield; refresh disabled during irradiation exposure windows; chamber shielded with 5 mm lead housing; ambient temperature stabilized at 85.0°C +/- 1.0°C.
testcases.procedure:
1. Write solid '1' data pattern across all 128 kbit memory addresses at VDD = 1.8V, Vplate = 0.9V.
2. Position calibrated Am-241 alpha source directly above unencapsulated die aperture for fixed integration intervals (t = 60s, 120s, 300s, 600s, 1800s).
3. Read out bit error counts at each interval without intermediate rewrite, logging physical address bit coordinates and error accumulation.
4. Repeat for write solid '0' data pattern to separate storage node collection errors from bitline differential errors.
5. Fit bit-failure cumulative distribution F(Q) against charge collection spectrum using 2-parameter Weibull CDF: F(Q) = 1 - exp(-((Q - Q0)/eta)^beta).
6. Derive soft error rate SER (FIT/Mb) normalized to terrestrial alpha background flux of 0.001 alpha/cm²/hr.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Weibull threshold parameter Q0 must exceed 22.0 fC. Shape parameter beta must reside between 1.2 and 2.5. Total accelerated soft-error rate under Am-241 exposure, when extrapolated to terrestrial flux (0.001 alpha/cm²/hr) at 85°C, must be <= 450 FIT/Mb.

ppe_required: Lead-lined ionizing radiation handling apron (0.5 mm Pb equivalence)
Double-layer disposable nitrile gloves (EN 374-1 / ASTM D6319)

ANSI Z87.1 approved radiation-shielding polycarbonate safety glasses

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: Radioactive alpha contamination: Cease operations immediately. In case of skin contact, gently wash skin with lukewarm water and mild pH-neutral chelating soap; do not abrade skin. For inhalation or internal contamination, immediately notify Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and administer DTPA (Diethylenetriaminepentaacetic acid) decorporation therapy under licensed medical supervision. For external lead exposure, wash skin thoroughly; seek medical attention if lead dust is inhaled.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Irradiation enclosure must operate inside an ISO Class 5 negative-pressure laminar flow station equipped with active continuous airborne alpha particulate radiation monitors (CAM) and dual-stage HEPA filtration (99.997% capture at 0.3 um). ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: All radioactive wipe swipes, contaminated gloves, and expired sources must be categorized as Class A Low-Level Radioactive Waste (LLRW), sealed in double-walled high-density polyethylene (HDPE) containers within secondary lead-shielded drums, and surrendered to the national nuclear regulatory agency (VARANS) for disposal. No drain disposal permitted.

q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Alpha-irradiated test coupon post-radiation wipe-test verified zero removable alpha activity (< 0.01 Bq/cm²), desiccated, nitrogen-purged ESD container.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM-180NM-MET-004`
**Title:** Cell Parasitic Extraction, Retention Leakage & Soft-Error Metrology Simulation  
**Level / Scope:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | 1T1C DRAM 8F² Folded Bitline Architecture | Metrology & TCAD/SPICE Simulation  
**Classification:** Technical Standard / Industrial Metrology SOP  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the quantitative verification methodology for parasitic extraction, storage node retention leakage profiling, bitline-to-cell coupling evaluation, and alpha-particle soft-error rate (SER) metrology simulation for a 180 nm 8F² folded bitline stacked-capacitor-over-bitline (COB) 1T1C DRAM cell.

---

### 2. Physical Layout & Model Setup Parameters
*Based strictly on 180 nm verified technical parameters:*
- **Feature Size ($F$):** $180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Cell Layout Footprint:** $8F^2$ Folded Bitline topology ($A_{\text{cell}} = 8 \times (0.18\ \mu\text{m})^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$).
- **Wordline (WL) & Bitline (BL) Pitch:** $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
- **Access Transistor Dimensions:** Gate Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Gate Dielectric:** Dry thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ with $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
- **Capacitor Architecture:** Crown/cylinder stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) contacted via tungsten plug (W-plug).
- **Capacitor Dielectric:** ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ stack ($\kappa > 15$, Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\text{ to } 4\text{ nm}$).
- **Array Size Baseline:** Array block of 256 or 512 cells per bitline.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 1: 3D Layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX)                                      |
| - Extract Storage Node Capacitance (C_s) >= 28 fF                                 |
| - Extract Bitline Parasitic Capacitance (C_b) [150 fF - 250 fF]                   |
| - Verify Coupling Ratio C_b / C_s <= 9:1                                          |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 2: Retention Leakage & Thermal Sweep                                         |
| - Bias storage node at V_INT (Logic '1')                                          |
| - Characterize subthreshold + junction leakage at 85 deg C (Target < 1.0 fA/cell) |
| - Compute static retention time window > 64 ms                                    |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STEP 3: Soft-Error Rate (SER) & Charge Collection Simulation                      |
| - Inject alpha-particle strike ion track (linear charge deposition)               |
| - Confirm critical charge Q_crit >= 28 fF * (V_INT / 2) maintains noise margin    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 3.1: 3D Field Solver & Parasitic Extraction (PEX)
1. Import the verified $8F^2$ GDSII cell layout ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$) into the 3D capacitance solver with dielectric stack permittivity profiles ($\kappa_{\text{high-k}} > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$).
2. Extract the lump storage node capacitance ($C_s$), accounting for crown sidewall area, bottom area, and W-plug parasitic contributions. Ensure $C_s$ meets the target budget of $28\text{ fF}$ (nominal range $25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$).
3. Extract bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) along the shared contact bitline across 256 to 512 cells/column (including bitline-to-substrate, bitline-to-wordline, and adjacent bitline coupling). Verify $C_b$ is within $150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$.
4. Compute the capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$. Flag any design iteration where $C_b / C_s > 9:1$ (degrading read signal margin).

#### Step 3.2: High-Temperature Retention Leakage Metrology
1. Construct the SPICE sub-circuit including the access transistor ($W/L = 220\text{ nm} / 180\text{ nm}$, $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$), storage capacitor $C_s$, and shared contact junction diodes.
2. Initialize storage node node voltage to $V_{\text{DD}} / V_{\text{INT}}$ (Data '1' state); bias wordline to unselected level ($V_{\text{WL\_OFF}} \le 0\text{ V}$); bitline to precharge level ($V_{\text{BL}} = V_{\text{INT}} / 2$).
3. Ramp junction temperature to $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$.
4. Run transient analysis over $t = 0\text{ to } 128\text{ ms}$. Extract total leakage current ($I_{\text{leak}} = I_{\text{sub-threshold}} + I_{\text{junction}} + I_{\text{dielectric}}$) at the storage node.
5. Verify that the retention threshold drop $\Delta V_{\text{cell}}$ maintains signal margin over the minimum refresh period $t_{\text{refresh}} = 64\text{ ms}$.

#### Step 3.3: Alpha-Particle Induced Soft-Error Metrology
1. Configure mixed-mode TCAD/device simulation with an electron-hole generation column representing an alpha-particle strike (5 MeV energy deposition track) intersecting:
   - Case A: Storage node diffusion junction.
   - Case B: Adjacent bitline diffusions during sensing.
2. Quantify collected charge ($Q_{\text{coll}}$). Calculate critical charge margin:
   $$Q_{\text{crit}} = C_s \times \Delta V_{\text{margin}}$$
3. Verify that with $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, $Q_{\text{crit}}$ exceeds worst-case $Q_{\text{coll}}$ to guarantee noise immunity against single-event upsets (SEU).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter / Physical Observable | Acceptance Threshold | Unit | Verification Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | **$25.0 \le C_s \le 30.0$** (Nominal: $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | 3D Field Solver extraction @ 180 nm, $\kappa > 15$, $\text{EOT} = 3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$ |
| **AC-02** | Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | **$5.0 \le C_b / C_s \le 9.0$** (Max: $< 10.0$) | Dimensionless (ratio) | Array size of 256–512 cells/BL, $C_b \in [150, 250]\text{ fF}$ |
| **AC-03** | Total Cell Retention Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$) | **$< 1.0$** | $\text{fA/cell}$ | $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$, $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{INT}}$ (Data '1'), WL unselected |
| **AC-04** | Data Retention Interval ($t_{\text{retention}}$) | **$\ge 64.0$** | $\text{ms}$ | At $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ prior to cell sensing margin collapse |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **[1] 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), COB crown MIM/poly capacitor, dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ noise immunity against alpha particles, and $I_{\text{leak}} < 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[2] 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets:** $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), nominal storage capacitance $C_s \in [25, 30]\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_b \in [150, 250]\text{ fF}$ across 256–512 cells, and acceptable $C_b / C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (failure boundary $> 10:1$).
- **[3] Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Retention time specification $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, stacked crown/cylinder $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$ or $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ $\text{EOT} = 3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$, WL/BL pitch of $360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$, and $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded or open bitline architecture at 180nm, bitline-to-wordline coupling (C_bl_wl) and adjacent bitline coupling (C_bl_bl) directly erode the sensing margin, which is already constrained by a cell capacitance C_s around 25-30 fF. Parasitic extraction must incorporate 3D field-solver modeling of the contact plug to wordline fringing capacitance rather than 2D approximations, otherwise the simulated transfer ratio (V_sig = V_dd/2 * C_s / (C_s + C_bl)) will overestimate signal margin by >18%, risking sense amplifier read failures.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: DRAM retention leakage at room temperature and 85°C is governed by junction leakage (trap-assisted tunneling and band-to-band tunneling at the storage node n+/p-well junction), subthreshold leakage through the access pass-transistor, and dielectric leakage through the cell capacitor. For soft-error rate (SER) metrology simulation, alpha-particle and cosmic neutron track ionization creates electron-hole pairs along the silicon substrate; a critical charge Q_crit = C_s * (V_dd / 2) ~ 27 fC requires robust funneled carrier collection cross-section modeling to guarantee SER < 1000 FIT/Mb.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: While TCAD and SPICE extraction are purely computational, metrology calibration depends on physical test structures (TLM and split CV capacitor arrays). Commercial device simulator licenses (e.g., Synopsys Sentaurus or Silvaco Atlas) represent high recurring OpEx; we must validate and benchmark an open-source toolchain (ngspice, FastCap2/FasterCap, and open-source TCAD like Genius/DevSim) against standard 180nm PDK parametric data to ensure sovereign reproducibility without commercial supply bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Simulation milestones must deliver parameterized netlists that feed directly into the top-level 1T1C array layout verification deck by Sprint 4. If parasitic RC extraction decks for the 8F² layout are delayed, sense amplifier timing closure and write-recovery (t_WR) verification cannot proceed, threatening the tapeout tape-in window for the MPW run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sub-threshold leakage elevation due to drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) or junction trap density causing retention time degradation below 64 ms at 85°C.
1. Excessive bitline parasitic capacitance (C_bl > 250 fF) degrading sensing delta voltage below the 100 mV sense amplifier latch resolution threshold.
1. Underestimation of soft-error funneled charge collection length causing silent bit-flip susceptibility under package radioactive trace alpha emission (>0.001 alpha/cm²/hr).

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-3-01` | **3D Parasitic Extraction of 8F² Cell Storage Node & Bitline Capacitance** | 3D Electrostatic Field Solver (FasterCap / FastCap2 v2.0+) and SPICE Circuit Simulator (ngspice v38+) | 1. Discretize the layout boundary element mesh for a 3x3 DRAM cell matrix with boundary condition set to periodic Dirichlet on outer perimeter. 2. Apply unit potentials (1.0 V) on victim bitline BL[0] with adjacent BL[-1], BL[+1], and crossing wordlines WL[0], WL[1] grounded to compute coupling capacitance matrix. 3. Extract storage node node capacitance C_sn to substrate, adjacent wordlines, and bitline. 4. Export extracted parasitic netlist (.subckt 1T1C_extracted) into ngspice. 5. Run transient read cycle simulation with stored data '1' (V_sn = 1.8 V) and precharged bitline (V_bl = 0.9 V) to measure active sense delta voltage V_sig across sense amplifier differential nodes. | `Cell storage capacitance C_s >= 25.0 fF, bitline parasitic capacitance per cell C_bl_cell <= 0.65 fF (total bitline C_bl <= 180 fF for 256 cells/bitline), and differential sensing margin V_sig >= 110 mV at t_sense = 2.5 ns.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-3-02` | **Retention Leakage & Alpha-Induced Soft-Error Dynamic Charge Collection Simulation** | Mixed-Mode Transient Device/Circuit Simulator (Genius TCAD / DevSim v2.6+ with ngspice coupled engine) | 1. Initialize cell storage node to V_dd (1.8 V) and wordline off (V_wl = -0.2 V negative wordline bias). 2. Run 100 ms transient simulation without external particle strike; record storage node voltage decay V_sn(t) to extract total static leakage current I_leak = C_s * (dV_sn/dt). 3. Re-initialize cell at t = 10 ms; inject an ionizing particle track modeling a 5.0 MeV alpha particle with Linear Energy Transfer (LET) of 0.25 pC/um incident perpendicularly at the n+/p-well storage junction. 4. Measure dynamic charge collection waveform Q_coll(t) integrated over 5.0 ns. 5. Evaluate whether storage node voltage maintains V_sn > V_ref_read (1.2 V) without triggering a cell state flip. | `Total retention leakage current I_leak <= 15.0 fA/cell at 85°C, corresponding to t_retention (V_sn >= 1.2 V) >= 64 ms; critical charge Q_crit >= 22.5 fC with peak prompt funneled charge collection Q_prompt <= 18.0 fC (no state flip observed under 5 MeV alpha strike).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard Cleanroom/Computational Lab Anti-Static ESD Lab Coat (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant), ESD Grounding Wrist Strap with 1 Megohm series resistor (for workstations interfacing with wafer probers), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields (during wafer prober electrical validation), Class 100 Cleanroom Nitrile Gloves (accelerator-free, 4 mil thickness)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with IPA solvent, flush affected area with copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes at the eyewash station. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. For cryogenic or high-pressure N2 gas exposure, ensure immediate ventilation to prevent asphyxiation in confined prober enclosures.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory fume hood or localized laminar flow snorkel exhaust operating at face velocity of 80-100 fpm for solvent wipe station; continuous oxygen depletion monitoring system (setpoint alarm at <19.5% O2) in wafer test enclosure utilizing compressed N2 purge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and IPA residues must be collected in closed, grounded FM-approved flammable waste containers and disposed of via certified hazardous chemical waste contractors. No chemical drain discharge permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) (used strictly for manual probe tip and wafer surface wipe-down)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Nitrogen (compressed gas for dry wafer blow and purge)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP 99.999%) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-dielectric deposition / contact-plug etch wafer state with pristine surface passivation; native oxide growth on exposed contact interfaces must remain < 0.8 nm.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean, dry, and electrically characterized wafer ready for post-metallization forming gas anneal (FGA) or passivation encapsulation without moisture condensation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding air exposure queue time causes native oxide regrowing on storage node contact plugs, spiking contact resistance rho_c > 1e-6 Ohm*cm² (causing transfer length L_T collapse) and introducing interface trap density (D_it > 1e11 eV^-1*cm^-2) that elevates junction leakage by >300%, completely invalidating simulation-to-silicon retention correlation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete 3D field-solver parasitic netlists, calibrated retention leakage temperature models, and SER alpha-strike dynamic TCAD simulation reports establishing an 8F² DRAM cell retention time >= 64 ms at 85°C and soft-error critical charge headroom > 20%.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_8f2_cell_parasitic_rc_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `dram_cell_retention_leakage_temp_profile_report.pdf`
- [ ] `dram_alpha_track_ser_charge_collection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

critics.systems_engineer: In an 8F² folded or open bitline architecture at 180nm, bitline-to-wordline coupling (C_bl_wl) and adjacent bitline coupling (C_bl_bl) directly erode the sensing margin, which is already constrained by a cell capacitance C_s around 25-30 fF. Parasitic extraction must incorporate 3D field-solver modeling of the contact plug to wordline fringing capacitance rather than 2D approximations, otherwise the simulated transfer ratio (V_sig = V_dd/2 * C_s / (C_s + C_bl)) will overestimate signal margin by >18%, risking sense amplifier read failures.
critics.domain_expert: DRAM retention leakage at room temperature and 85°C is governed by junction leakage (trap-assisted tunneling and band-to-band tunneling at the storage node n+/p-well junction), subthreshold leakage through the access pass-transistor, and dielectric leakage through the cell capacitor. For soft-error rate (SER) metrology simulation, alpha-particle and cosmic neutron track ionization creates electron-hole pairs along the silicon substrate; a critical charge Q_crit = C_s * (V_dd / 2) ~ 27 fC requires robust funneled carrier collection cross-section modeling to guarantee SER < 1000 FIT/Mb.
critics.supply_chain: While TCAD and SPICE extraction are purely computational, metrology calibration depends on physical test structures (TLM and split CV capacitor arrays). Commercial device simulator licenses (e.g., Synopsys Sentaurus or Silvaco Atlas) represent high recurring OpEx; we must validate and benchmark an open-source toolchain (ngspice, FastCap2/FasterCap, and open-source TCAD like Genius/DevSim) against standard 180nm PDK parametric data to ensure sovereign reproducibility without commercial supply bottlenecks.
critics.laya_pm: Simulation milestones must deliver parameterized netlists that feed directly into the top-level 1T1C array layout verification deck by Sprint 4. If parasitic RC extraction decks for the 8F² layout are delayed, sense amplifier timing closure and write-recovery (t_WR) verification cannot proceed, threatening the tapeout tape-in window for the MPW run.
critical_failure_modes: Sub-threshold leakage elevation due to drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL) or junction trap density causing retention time degradation below 64 ms at 85°C.
Excessive bitline parasitic capacitance (C_bl > 250 fF) degrading sensing delta voltage below the 100 mV sense amplifier latch resolution threshold.
Underestimation of soft-error funneled charge collection length causing silent bit-flip susceptibility under package radioactive trace alpha emission (>0.001 alpha/cm²/hr).

testcases.title: 3D Parasitic Extraction of 8F² Cell Storage Node & Bitline Capacitance
testcases.instrumentation: 3D Electrostatic Field Solver (FasterCap / FastCap2 v2.0+) and SPICE Circuit Simulator (ngspice v38+)
testcases.pre_conditions: 180nm 8F² GDSII layout stream loaded with layer stack definition: diffusion (n+), poly gate/wordline (180nm), isolation STI oxide (350nm), ILD0 (SiO2, 400nm), tungsten contact plug (W), bitline metal 1 (AlCu/TiN, 240nm pitch), and MIM/crown cell capacitor dielectric (Si3N4/Al2O3 equivalent oxide thickness EOT = 4.5nm).
testcases.procedure:
1. Discretize the layout boundary element mesh for a 3x3 DRAM cell matrix with boundary condition set to periodic Dirichlet on outer perimeter.
2. Apply unit potentials (1.0 V) on victim bitline BL[0] with adjacent BL[-1], BL[+1], and crossing wordlines WL[0], WL[1] grounded to compute coupling capacitance matrix.
3. Extract storage node node capacitance C_sn to substrate, adjacent wordlines, and bitline.
4. Export extracted parasitic netlist (.subckt 1T1C_extracted) into ngspice.
5. Run transient read cycle simulation with stored data '1' (V_sn = 1.8 V) and precharged bitline (V_bl = 0.9 V) to measure active sense delta voltage V_sig across sense amplifier differential nodes.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Cell storage capacitance C_s >= 25.0 fF, bitline parasitic capacitance per cell C_bl_cell <= 0.65 fF (total bitline C_bl <= 180 fF for 256 cells/bitline), and differential sensing margin V_sig >= 110 mV at t_sense = 2.5 ns.

testcases.title: Retention Leakage & Alpha-Induced Soft-Error Dynamic Charge Collection Simulation
testcases.instrumentation: Mixed-Mode Transient Device/Circuit Simulator (Genius TCAD / DevSim v2.6+ with ngspice coupled engine)
testcases.pre_conditions: Calibrated 180nm NMOS access transistor doping profile (channel boron p-well 3e17 cm^-3, L_eff = 180nm, W = 180nm) coupled to extracted storage node capacitor C_s = 25 fF charged to 1.8 V at junction temperature T = 85°C (358 K).
testcases.procedure:
1. Initialize cell storage node to V_dd (1.8 V) and wordline off (V_wl = -0.2 V negative wordline bias).
2. Run 100 ms transient simulation without external particle strike; record storage node voltage decay V_sn(t) to extract total static leakage current I_leak = C_s * (dV_sn/dt).
3. Re-initialize cell at t = 10 ms; inject an ionizing particle track modeling a 5.0 MeV alpha particle with Linear Energy Transfer (LET) of 0.25 pC/um incident perpendicularly at the n+/p-well storage junction.
4. Measure dynamic charge collection waveform Q_coll(t) integrated over 5.0 ns.
5. Evaluate whether storage node voltage maintains V_sn > V_ref_read (1.2 V) without triggering a cell state flip.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total retention leakage current I_leak <= 15.0 fA/cell at 85°C, corresponding to t_retention (V_sn >= 1.2 V) >= 64 ms; critical charge Q_crit >= 22.5 fC with peak prompt funneled charge collection Q_prompt <= 18.0 fC (no state flip observed under 5 MeV alpha strike).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 8F² 1T1C Cell 3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (RC Extraction)

**Project / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Gen 2 (µm) | Generation: 180nm | Action Type: Make  
**Documentation:** [8F2_1T1C_cell_3D_field_solver_parasitic_extraction.md](docs/knowledge/8F2_1T1C_cell_3D_field_solver_parasitic_extraction.md)

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII / OASIS Layout  │
│        8F2 1T1C        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      3D Meshing &      │
│     Boundary Setup     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Electrostatic &     │
│   Magnetoquasistatic   │
│      Field Solver      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Parasitic RC      │
│  Extraction & Netlist  │
│    Back-Annotation     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│   Verification: Cs,    │
│    Cb, Cb/Cs, Rline    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Geometry Ingestion & 3D Layer Profile Setup
1. Ingest the physical layout (GDSII/OASIS) of the 8F² folded bitline unit cell (cell area = $0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$, $F = 180\ \text{nm}$) and a representative $3 \times 3$ mini-array core tile with shared bitline contacts.
2. Define access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$.
3. Set interconnect pitches: Bitline (BL) and Wordline (WL) pitch between $360\ \text{nm}$ and $400\ \text{nm}$.
4. Construct vertical stack:
   - Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\ \text{nm}$.
   - Shared bitline drain contact and storage node via Tungsten plugs (W-plugs).
   - Crown-shaped polysilicon or Metal-Insulator-Metal (MIM) Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) architecture.
   - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ stack or ONO triple dielectric) with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3\ \text{nm} - 4\ \text{nm}$.

#### Step 2: 3D Meshing & Boundary Condition Configuration
1. Configure adaptive tetrahedral/hexahedral conformal meshing around critical high-gradient regions:
   - High mesh density across the crown capacitor dielectric interface ($\le 0.5\ \text{nm}$ refinement).
   - W-plug to bitline/wordline dielectric spacing ($SiO_2$/low-$\kappa$ ILD).
2. Set periodic boundary conditions (Floquet / Periodic) on array boundaries along X and Y axes to accurately capture fringe fields from adjacent cells.
3. Establish Dirichlet and Neumann electrostatic boundaries at the substrate backplane and top passivation layers.

#### Step 3: 3D Field Solver Solution & Parasitic Matrix Formulation
1. Run Poisson's electrostatic field solver ($\nabla \cdot (\epsilon \nabla V) = -\rho$) to calculate the multi-conductor capacitance matrix:
   - Storage node capacitance ($C_s$).
   - Bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) per bitline segment.
   - Inter-bitline coupling capacitance ($C_{BL-BL}$) and bitline-to-wordline coupling ($C_{BL-WL}$).
2. Run magnetoquasistatic/conduction field solver to extract parasitic series resistance ($R$) of:
   - Access transistor source/drain W-plugs.
   - Crown storage node bottom electrode.
   - Wordline and bitline sheet and contact resistances.

#### Step 4: Netlist Back-Annotation & Signal Ratio Verification
1. Stitch extracted 3D distributed R-C elements into an array-level SPICE/Spectre subcircuit.
2. Calculate total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_b$) for typical array blocks of 256 and 512 cells per bitline.
3. Verify the capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ and ensure noise margins against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics


| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-1** | Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 25.0$ to $30.0$ (Nominal: $\ge 28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Extracted across crown/MIM capacitor with $\text{EOT} = 3 - 4\ \text{nm}$, $\kappa > 15$ |
| **AC-2** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_b$) | $150.0$ to $250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | Integrated across an array block of $256$ to $512$ cells per bitline |
| **AC-3** | Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1$ to $9.0 : 1$ (Hard ceiling $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless ratio | Required to maintain sensing read margin and prevent read degradation |
| **AC-4** | Retention Leakage Budget | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Total sub-threshold and junction leakage evaluated at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($\text{refresh interval} \ge 64\ \text{ms}$) |

---

### Source Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), shared bitline contact, crown/MIM COB topology, W-plug drain contact, dielectric stack $\kappa > 15$, minimum $C_s \ge 28\ \text{fF}$, and leakage $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: 8F² folded bitline footprint, storage capacitance $C_s \in [25, 30]\ \text{fF}$, retention time $> 64\ \text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $\text{EOT} = 3 - 4\ \text{nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360 - 400\ \text{nm}$, gate $\text{SiO}_2$ thickness $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: 8F² folded bitline cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$), nominal $C_s = 28\ \text{fF}$, bitline parasitic $C_b = 150 - 250\ \text{fF}$ for $256/512$ cells/BL, and required $C_b / C_s$ ratio between $5:1$ and $9:1$ ($< 10:1$ threshold).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In an 8F² folded bitline layout at the 180nm node (F=0.18 µm, cell area ~0.259 µm²), boundary conditions and fringing field lines to adjacent wordlines (WL) and bitlines (BL) dominate total cell parasitics. 2.5D empirical rule-based extraction engines underestimate bitline-to-storage-node (C_BL-SN) and bitline-to-bitline (C_BL-BL) cross-coupling capacitance by up to 35% due to non-planar crown/trench capacitor topologies and pass-transistor contact landing pads. The full 3x3 array 3D field solver mesh must explicitly model the elevated V_PP wordline drive (2.5V-2.8V) to extract dynamic Miller capacitance and parasitic voltage pushout onto unselected storage nodes during wordline transitions.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, the pass transistor threshold voltage V_th is 0.5V to 0.7V, necessitating a V_PP boosted wordline overdrive of >= 2.5V to avoid losing 33% of the stored charge. 3D Poisson-Laplace field solving must properly handle conformal dielectric layers, spacer profiles (Si3N4/SiO2), and finite aspect ratio storage-node contact plugs (SNC/BC). Discretization error along the thin capacitor dielectric interface and contact plug sidewall must be bounded below 0.05 fF. Overlooking the non-linear depletion capacitance at the access transistor source/drain junction under 2.8V V_PP overdrive will distort retention-time modeling and sense amplifier signal margin.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Full-wave 3D electrostatic/capacitance solver tool licenses (such as Ansys Maxwell, Synopsys Raphael, or FastCap/open-source boundary element engines) represent high-performance compute bottlenecks. Mesh refinement over multi-cell arrays demands >64 GB RAM and substantial workstation runtime. PDK open-source release formats (OpenROAD / Magic / KLayout / FastCap mesh definitions) must be strictly standardized to avoid vendor lock-in while maintaining deterministic extraction netlist outputs for the open-source community.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The cell parasitic RC netlist is on the critical milestone path for peripheral sense amplifier sizing, Dickson charge pump clock loading (Phi1/Phi2), and read/write cycle timing validation. Mesh convergence failure or delayed extraction netlist sign-off risks slipping the subsequent soft-error metrology and retention leakage characterization tape-out gates by multiple sprint iterations.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Coarse boundary mesh truncation causing >20% underestimation of bitline-to-storage-node coupling capacitance (C_BL-SN), resulting in false sense-amplifier read flips during wordline activation.
1. Omission of dielectric constant dispersion or conformal thickness variation in high-aspect-ratio storage contact plug spacers, leading to unmodeled parasitic RC delay and wordline rise-time degradation exceeding Dickson charge pump current limits.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-3-1-01` | **3D Field Solver Parasitic Capacitance Extraction Convergence Test** | 3D Electrostatic Boundary Element Method (BEM) / Finite Element Mesh (FEM) Field Solver with Adaptive Octree Mesh Generator and Double-Precision Floating-Point Matrix Engine | 1. Import GDSII layout and assign dielectric permittivities: SiO2 (eps_r=3.9), Si3N4 spacers (eps_r=7.0), ILD (eps_r=3.9). 2. Define terminal conductors: target cell Storage Node (SN), Wordline (WL), Bitline (BL), substrate, and 8 adjacent cell neighborhood conductors. 3. Execute adaptive mesh refinement starting at nominal 15nm element size down to 2nm along conductor corners and dielectric interfaces until consecutive iterations differ by <0.5%. 4. Solve the 3D electrostatic matrix equation [Q]=[C][V] across all defined conductor nets. 5. Extract lump and distributed parasitic capacitance netlist components: C_BL_total, C_SN_total, and mutual coupling C_BL-SN. | `Total Bitline capacitance C_BL_total must be <= 120 fF per 256-cell bitline segment; parasitic storage node coupling capacitance C_BL-SN must not exceed 0.25 fF per cell; mesh convergence delta must be <= 0.5% across two consecutive refinement passes.` |
| `TC-DRAM-CELL-LAYOUT-3-1-02` | **Wordline Contact Plug & Poly Distributed Resistance/Capacitance (RC) Delay Extraction** | 3D Conductor Surface and Volume Field Solver with Coupled Parasitic RC Network Reducer (AWE/PRIMIC Model Order Reduction) | 1. Discretize wordline runner across 64 continuous 8F² cell pitches. 2. Apply 3D volume mesh to poly-silicon runner and tungsten contact interfaces. 3. Solve Laplace current continuity equation under 2.8V V_PP overdrive boundary potential. 4. Extract distributed per-segment resistance (R_WL_unit) and ground capacitance (C_WL_unit). 5. Generate distributed RC netlist and compute total RC propagation delay tau = R_total * C_total over the array block. | `Distributed wordline resistance per cell pitch must be <= 12.5 Ohm; unit wordline segment capacitance must be <= 0.45 fF/cell; total 64-cell wordline RC time constant tau must be < 1.2 ns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD-safe lab coat, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/anti-glare safety glasses, Powder-free nitrile cleanroom gloves (Class 100 compatible)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA: wash thoroughly with soap and copious clean water. In case of eye contact: flush immediately with tepid eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes and seek medical evaluation. If vapor inhaled: move individual to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom HEPA/ULPA filtered laminar airflow workstation with minimum 45 CFM air exchange rate; zero hazardous exhaust requirements for pure simulation work packages.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA-impregnated cleanroom wipes must be sealed in airtight flammable waste bins and collected in accordance with EPA RCRA hazardous solvent protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Completed DRC/LVS-clean GDSII layout database of the 8F² 1T1C DRAM cell block with validated connectivity labels and calibrated stack dielectric thickness tables.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Signed-off 3D field-extracted DSPF/SPEF parasitic RC netlist delivered to transient SPICE circuit simulator and sense amplifier timing verification queue.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Layout stream version drift or uncoordinated ECO updates between circuit design and extraction teams leading to outdated parasitic models used in peripheral Dickson charge pump regulator verification.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Delivery of fully converged 3D electrostatic and magnetostatic/resistive RC parasitic extraction models for the 180nm open-source 8F² 1T1C DRAM cell array. Models accurately capture multi-conductor coupling capacitances, contact plug aspect ratio effects, and elevated 2.8V V_PP wordline overdrive capacitive loading.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_1t1c_8f2_cell_3d_parasitics.spef`
- [ ] `cell_rc_extraction_convergence_report.pdf`
- [ ] `parasitic_capacitance_matrix_summary.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage Node parasitic capacitance to adjacent lines (C_SN_parasitic) excluding intended cell storage capacitance** | `0.35 fF` | +/- 10% | 3D BEM/FEM field solver electrostatic matrix extraction at 100 kHz reference frequency |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Adjacent Bitline-to-Bitline cross-coupling capacitance ratio (C_BL-BL / C_BL_total)** | `0.15` | <= 0.18 max | Field solver mutual multi-conductor capacitance matrix post-processing |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> The 3D field solver mesh achieves <=0.5% convergence across 3 successive iterations; all extracted capacitance and resistance values pass SPICE transient simulation without non-passive network warnings; unanimous approval by DRAM Foundation VN Architecture Review Council.
