- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) planarized via chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) with post-CMP megasonic scrub; native oxide thickness <= 1.2nm on exposed contact pads; zero organic slurry residues (defect density < 0.05 defects/cm²).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered Ti/TiN barrier liner and tungsten (W) contact plug fill deposited; surface cleaned via Ar plasma etch and passivated with ultra-high purity nitrogen cap to prevent copper/aluminum diffusion pad galvanic corrosion.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time induces ambient moisture absorption and uncontrolled native oxide growth (>2.5nm) on silicon/polysilicon contact interfaces, causing contact resistance spikes (>50 Ohms/via), excessive contact resistance asymmetry across the differential pair, and unrecoverable sense amplifier V_th latch offset (>25mV).

**Exit Objective Summary**:

critics.laya_pm: Sense amplifier layout pitch is strictly bounded by the 2x metal-bitline pitch (column pitch <= 1.6µm for folded architectures in 180nm). Oversizing W to suppress V_th mismatch forces folded interdigitated finger topologies (e.g., multi-finger cross-coupled layouts with shared source/drain nodes), impacting total silicon die footprint and routing congestion on Metal 1/Metal 2. Failure to freeze latch aspect ratios by Milestone Gen 2 Gate-3 will stall pitch-matched layout generation and schedule-critical parasitic extraction (PEX) signoffs for the entire 64kb test array.
critical_failure_modes: Metastability-induced sensing failure / latch inversion caused by threshold voltage mismatch (delta_V_th > delta_V_BL / 2) between cross-coupled NMOS pull-down pairs.
Crowbar current thermal degradation and common-mode bitline collapse caused by premature P-sense amplifier (SAP) activation prior to sufficient differential split (>300mV) on BL and /BL.
Equalization failure and residual bitline charge memory effect resulting from insufficient conductance in the V_DD/2 balancing pass-gates, leading to pattern-dependent read disturbs.

testcases.title: Quasi-Static Voltage Transfer Curve (VTC) & Latch Offset Measurement
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with high-resolution SMU modules (B1517A), cryogenic/thermal probe station with micromanipulators, shielded triaxial cabling.
testcases.pre_conditions: Sense amplifier test macro powered at V_DD = 1.800V +/- 1mV, substrate bulk V_SS = 0.000V, temperature stabilized at 25.0°C and 85.0°C. Bitline load capacitors calibrated to 250fF +/- 5fF using external on-chip metal-insulator-metal (MIM) test loads.
testcases.procedure: 1. Force common-mode voltage V_BLP = 0.900V onto BL and /BL via EQ transmission gate; assert EQ switch low. 2. Apply a differential static voltage offset delta_V_in swept from -100mV to +100mV in 1mV increments between BL and /BL. 3. Activate SAN pull-down switch with 200ps fall time to GND; capture output branch latching state (0 or 1). 4. Extract switching trip-point threshold V_M and calculate total input-referred offset voltage V_os over 1,000 statistical sample acquisitions. 5. Measure static noise margins NM_H and NM_L across VTC butterflies.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Input-referred offset voltage |V_os| <= 8.0 mV (3-sigma); switching threshold V_M = 0.900V +/- 25.0 mV; High Noise Margin NM_H >= 0.650V; Low Noise Margin NM_L >= 0.650V.

testcases.title: Transient Sensing Delay and Full-Rail Charge Restoration Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Tektronix DPO73304SX 33 GHz Real-Time Oscilloscope, active differential probes (P7720), pulse pattern generator (Agilent 81134A) with 100ps transition times.
testcases.pre_conditions: Bitline loads pre-charged to V_DD / 2 = 0.900V. Cell signal charge injection configured to generate an initial split delta_V_BL = 100mV (BL = 0.950V, /BL = 0.850V). V_DD = 1.80V, V_PP = 2.80V.
testcases.procedure: 1. De-assert EQ control signal (fall time <= 150ps). 2. Fire boosted wordline pulse WL to 2.80V for 10ns to inject 100mV differential across 250fF bitline load. 3. Trigger SAN control signal low at t = 0ns; monitor time to achieve 90% rail split on lower bitline (/BL <= 0.18V). 4. Trigger SAP control signal high at t = 1.5ns; monitor time for BL to restore to 95% of full rail (BL >= 1.71V). 5. Compute total sense and restore cycle latency t_SENSE = t_restore - t_SAN_assert.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Differential latching delay t_latch (to 300mV split) <= 450 ps; Full low-rail pull-down t_low <= 1.20 ns; Full high-rail restoration t_restore <= 2.80 ns; Total sense and restore cycle t_SENSE <= 3.20 ns.

ppe_required: EN 374-compliant Nitrile cleanroom gloves (double-gloved, 6-mil minimum thickness)
ANSI Z87.1-compliant UV/splash-resistant safety goggles
Class 100 anti-static ESD cleanroom coat with conductive carbon yarn grid
ESD dissipative safety footwear with static grounding heel straps

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin contact with solvent/acid traces: Immediately strip contaminated garments and flush skin under emergency deluge shower for 15 minutes. For HF contact suspicion, apply 2.5% calcium gluconate gel continuously onto affected area with gloved hands until medical rescue arrives. Eye exposure: Flush at plumbed eyewash station for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open. Inhalation: Relocate victim immediately to fresh uncontaminated air; administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: All solvent and chemical surface preparations must occur inside dedicated stainless-steel laminar chemical fume hoods with constant face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM), connected to dedicated acid/solvent scrubbed exhaust.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Segregate solvent effluent (IPA, Acetone) into certified fluoropolymer non-halogenated waste carboys for hazardous chemical incineration. Neutralize dilute acidic wash waters in a continuous automated limestone neutralization tank maintaining effluent pH between 6.5 and 8.5 before permitted municipal drain discharge.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) planarized via chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) with post-CMP megasonic scrub; native oxide thickness <= 1.2nm on exposed contact pads; zero organic slurry residues (defect density < 0.05 defects/cm²).
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Sputtered Ti/TiN barrier liner and tungsten (W) contact plug fill deposited; surface cleaned via Ar plasma etch and passivated with ultra-high purity nitrogen cap to prevent copper/aluminum diffusion pad galvanic corrosion.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding Q-time induces ambient moisture absorption and uncontrolled native oxide growth (>2.5nm) on silicon/polysilicon contact interfaces, causing contact resistance spikes (>50 Ohms/via), excessive contact resistance asymmetry across the differential pair, and unrecoverable sense amplifier V_th latch offset (>25mV).

expected_result.summary: Completed parasitic-extracted schematic and physical aspect-ratio sizing for the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch and folded bitline load assembly in 180nm open-source DRAM architecture. The work package provides silicon-verified transistor gate widths and channel lengths that achieve balanced noise margins (NM_H, NM_L >= 0.65V), mid-rail switching threshold (V_M = 0.90V +/- 25mV), input offset voltage under 8mV (3-sigma), and full bitline charge restoration in under 3.2ns against a 250fF bitline load capacitance.

quantitative_assertions.verification_method: DC voltage transfer curve (VTC) sweep from 0V to 1.8V with 1mV step resolution using post-layout extracted SPICE netlist and BSIM4 models.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: 3-Sigma Input-Referred Latch Threshold Voltage Offset (sigma_Vos)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 1,000-point Monte Carlo mismatch and process variation transient simulation incorporating Pelgrom RDF coefficients and line-edge roughness.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Full-Rail Bitline Signal Sensing and Charge Restoration Cycle Time (t_SENSE)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Transient SPICE corner analysis (FF, TT, SS) at 85°C across 250fF MIM bitline parasitic loading with SAN/SAP staggered pulse triggers.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Researcher exit signoff requires 100% compliance across all 1,000 Monte Carlo process/mismatch iterations with zero sensing inversion errors at delta_V_BL = 100mV, formal verification of layout-versus-schematic (LVS) cleanliness without DRC violations on column pitch, and signed engineering approval from both Systems Architecture and Lead Analog Designer.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-042: Bitline Parasitic RC Network & Cell Charge-Sharing Load Extraction

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
│                       │

            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Cell Node C_s &    │

│                       │

            │
            │
            ▼

```

```text
WL/BL Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Cell Array & Interconnect Geometry Definition**:
   - Establish the 180nm folded bitline memory array layout topology using $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ unit cells with access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Constrain the bitline (BL, $\overline{\text{BL}}$) and wordline (WL) pitches to the range of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ in the extraction technology file.
   - Configure Capacitor Over Bitline (COB) layered interconnect definitions, routing tungsten plug (W-plug) drain-to-capacitor connections and shared bitline contacts.

2. **Distributed Parasitic RC Network Extraction**:
   - Perform 2.5D/3D field-solver parasitic extraction across the folded bitline metal lines including line-to-substrate, line-to-line adjacent coupling, and cross-coupling to orthogonal wordlines.
   - Output a distributed $\Pi$ or T-mesh RC netlist representing the lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{\text{BL}}$ targeting the nominal extraction ceiling of $250\text{ fF}$.

3. **Storage Node ($C_s$) Modeling**:
   - Model the stacked capacitor (Crown / MIM structure) with ONO triple dielectric or high-$\kappa$ ($\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$, $\kappa > 15$) stack having an equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the extracted cell storage capacitance $C_s$ satisfies the nominal budget of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (minimum $28\text{ fF}$ for noise immunity).

4. **Charge-Sharing Readout Simulation**:
   - Precharge complementary bitlines (BL and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ using the equalization transistor network.
   - Assert the wordline to fully bias the access transistor and dump storage charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Calculate and simulate the differential signal development voltage across BL and $\overline{\text{BL}}$:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right|$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Min: $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout extraction (PEX) & small-signal C-V simulation |
| **Lumped Bitline Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | $\le 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Distributed 3D field solver parasitic extraction |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient charge-sharing simulation at SA node prior to SAN/SAP latching |
| **Bitline / Wordline Wire Pitch** | $360.0 \text{ to } 400.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC pitch verification on layout metal layers |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded bitline precharge to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ via equalization network.
  - Signal charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
  - Differential voltage formula: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.
  - Baseline values: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ folded bitline layout with Capacitor Over Bitline (COB).
  - Unit cell dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Tungsten plug (W-plug) contacts with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$).
  - Storage capacitance budget: minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Storage capacitor retention target: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell (data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric EOT: $3\text{ nm to } 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Array pitch constraints: Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline architecture with cell capacitance Cs = 25 fF and target bitline capacitance C_BL ~ 250 fF (yielding C_BL/Cs ratio <= 10:1), distributed RC delays along Metal1/Metal2 bitlines significantly impact sensing margin and access latency. A lumped capacitor extraction severely underestimates wordline-to-bitline capacitive coupling and inter-bitline crosstalk (C_BL-BLb), which induces differential sensing offsets. The extraction methodology must capture segmented distributed π-RC networks per memory block, incorporating dynamic fringe capacitance from adjacent unselected bitlines held at VDD/2 (0.9 V), to guarantee differential voltage development ΔV >= 120 mV across extreme temperature corners (-40°C to 125°C).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Signal development relies on pure charge sharing: ΔV = (Cs / (C_BL + Cs)) * (V_cell - V_BL_precharge). With precharge at VDD/2 = 0.9 V and full VPP overdrive (>= 2.5 V) eliminating NMOS pass-transistor threshold losses during write-back, any extraction error exceeding 5% in C_BL directly compromises sense amplifier latching dynamics. Special attention must be paid to source/drain junction capacitance non-linearity (Cj, Cjsw) of the 512 access transistors tied to each bitline segment under reverse bias variations (0 V to 1.8 V), as well as equalizer transistor overlap capacitances (Cov) causing charge injection during ISO/EQ deassertion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: For open-source 180nm multi-project wafer (MPW) runs (e.g., SkyWater S180 or generic commercial 180nm 1P6M CMOS foundries), metal thickness, inter-metal dielectric (IMD) permitivity variations, and chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) dishing can introduce ±15% to ±20% sheet resistance and parasitic capacitance excursions across lot-to-lot runs. Sizing guidelines must define robust margins against minimum metal spacing violations and ensure back-end-of-line (BEOL) extraction models are calibrated against validated foundry fab test structures to avoid respin cycles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: To maintain schedule integrity for Gen 2 silicon delivery, the layout extraction workflow must bridge schematic sizing to full-chip PEX without iteration stalls. Deliverables must freeze parasitic netlists and cell load models prior to tape-out freeze, ensuring that simulation runs for worst-case corners (Slow-Slow, 1.62V, 125°C) meet the 5ns signal development timing window without requiring post-extraction transistor up-sizing that violates the pitch-matched memory column footprint.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-Bitline Cross-Coupling Signal Inversion: Inter-bitline parasitic coupling (C_c > 15% of total C_BL) causing opposite-polarity dynamic kickback during simultaneous read access, driving differential voltage ΔV below the sense amplifier offset voltage (Vos > 20 mV) and producing read bit flips.
1. Pass-Gate Capacitive Over-Damping: Excessive distributed series resistance (R_BL > 1.2 kΩ) along the bitline causing an RC propagation delay that exceeds the allocated wordline pulse timing (t_RAS_min), preventing full charge transfer from the storage capacitor before sense amplifier latch strobe activation (SAN/SAP).
1. Equalizer Imbalance and Differential Offset: Asymmetric junction or wire parasitic extraction between true (BL) and complementary (/BL) bitline paths introducing a static pre-sensing offset (ΔV_offset > 30 mV), resulting in systematic failure during read '0' operations.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-1-01` | **Parasitic RC Network Distributed Extraction and Bitline Capacitance Quantification** | Calibre xRC / StarRC Parasitic Extraction Engine, Synopsys PrimeSim HSPICE, Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with Multi-Frequency CMU (1 kHz - 5 MHz) on silicon test bench / TEG structure. | 1. Run rule-based 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) on the 512-row folded bitline column pair (BL and /BL) extracting coupled distributed R-L-C-C network down to 0.01 fF threshold. 2. Measure total lumped and distributed segment capacitance across BL to ground (substrate + well + unselected wordlines) and cross-coupling capacitance between BL and /BL. 3. Connect test bench AC small-signal source (10 mV amplitude, 1 MHz) to bitline pad with access transistors in cutoff (V_WL = 0 V) and equalizer off (V_EQ = 0 V). 4. Record cumulative bitline capacitance C_BL and loop resistance R_BL from the near end (sense amp interface) to the far end (dummy cell boundary). | `Total bitline capacitance C_BL must measure between 225 fF and 275 fF (nominal 250 fF ± 10%); BL-to-/BL cross-coupling capacitance C_c must not exceed 25 fF (<= 10% of C_BL); total end-to-end bitline line resistance R_BL must be <= 850 Ω.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-1-02` | **Dynamic Cell-to-Bitline Charge-Sharing Differential Voltage Signal Development** | Transient SPICE Mixed-Signal Simulator (HSPICE / Spectre), High-Bandwidth Sub-Femtoamp Waveform Prober / Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope (Keysight Infiniium UXR 33 GHz with high-impedance active probe). | 1. Assert precharge/equalize signal to 1.8 V, stabilizing BL and /BL to 0.900 V ± 2 mV; deassert equalize signal at t = 5.0 ns. 2. At t = 7.0 ns, drive selected wordline (WL) from 0 V to VPP = 2.8 V with a 1.0 ns rise time (10%-90%). 3. Monitor differential signal development ΔV = V(BL) - V(/BL) at the sense amplifier input terminals over a 5.0 ns signal development window before latch strobe activation. 4. Repeat transient sweep across Fast-Fast (1.98V, -40°C) and Slow-Slow (1.62V, 125°C) PVT corners. | `Peak differential voltage ΔV at t = 12.0 ns must be >= +120 mV for Data '1' read and <= -120 mV for Data '0' read; dynamic charge sharing settling time to reach 90% of asymptotic ΔV must be <= 3.2 ns across all PVT corners.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (chemical-resistant double gloving), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) safe lab coat and conductive footwear, Face shield when handling solvent replenishment containers
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin Exposure: Immediately wash affected area with mild soap and copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes; remove contaminated clothing. Eye Exposure: Flush eyes with sterile eye-wash saline or running water for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open; seek prompt medical evaluation. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh outdoor air immediately; provide artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous chemical fume hood operation with face velocity certified between 0.45 m/s and 0.60 m/s (90-120 FPM); laminar clean bench exhaust with local scrubbed VOC exhaust extraction; continuous ambient LEL (lower explosive limit) hydrocarbon gas sensor monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent solvent and organic wafer-cleaning effluent into dedicated grounded polypropylene flammable solvent waste carboys; seal container tightly with vapor-trapping quick-disconnect caps; do not mix with aqueous or acid waste; transfer to licensed hazardous chemical recycling facility.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Semiconductor Grade** | `67-63-0` | SEMI Grade 1 (VLSI / ULSI purity) | `99.9% min` |
| **Acetone Analytical Reagent Grade** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade (EG) | `99.5% min` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metallization dielectric planarized with post-CMP surface roughness Ra < 0.3 nm, completely degreased and free of organic residues or fluoride particulates.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Metal1/Metal2 bitline interconnects etched, passivated, and stored under ultra-pure N2 (< 1 ppm H2O, < 1 ppm O2) with contact pads protected against native oxidation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Atmospheric moisture adsorption and room-air native oxide growth on aluminum/copper metal vias leading to contact resistance degradation (> 50 Ω increase per via), dielectric moisture absorption increasing inter-metal fringe capacitance by > 12%, and galvanic corrosion causing bitline continuity failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Comprehensive signoff deliverable establishing the fully extracted distributed π-RC parasitic network for the 180nm folded bitline architecture, confirming that total parasitic bitline capacitance satisfies the target C_BL = 250 fF ± 10%, line resistance remains below 850 Ω, and differential signal development ΔV exceeds 120 mV under worst-case PVT corners with wordline overdrive VPP = 2.8 V.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `bitline_parasitic_rc_extracted_netlist_512cells.sp`
- [ ] `charge_sharing_signal_margin_pvt_sweep_report.pdf`
- [ ] `bitline_capacitance_crosscoupling_summary_matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Extracted Bitline Capacitance (C_BL) per 512-cell column segment** | `250.0 fF` | ±25.0 fF (±10%) | 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) integrated with small-signal AC capacitance extraction at 1 MHz |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Differential Read Signal Voltage Development (ΔV) at Sense Amp Terminals** | `138.0 mV` | >= 120.0 mV minimum at Slow-Slow 125°C corner | Transient SPICE circuit simulation of 1T1C charge sharing with V_cell = 1.8V, V_EQ = 0.9V, V_WL = 2.8V at t = 5.0ns post-wordline activation |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Adjacent Bitline-to-Bitline Cross-Coupling Capacitance Ratio (C_c / C_BL)** | `7.5%` | <= 10.0% maximum | Coupled interconnect parasitic extraction matrix across adjacent active and reference bitlines |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires 100% passage of PEX DRC/LVS clean checks on the 512-cell bitline array, Monte Carlo transient analysis (1000 runs) demonstrating zero bit-decision errors (3-sigma margin ΔV > 80 mV across all mismatch corners), and technical lead approval on the deliverable artifacts.

Equalizer Imbalance and Differential Offset: Asymmetric junction or wire parasitic extraction between true (BL) and complementary (/BL) bitline paths introducing a static pre-sensing offset (ΔV_offset > 30 mV), resulting in systematic failure during read '0' operations.

testcases.title: Parasitic RC Network Distributed Extraction and Bitline Capacitance Quantification
testcases.instrumentation: Calibre xRC / StarRC Parasitic Extraction Engine, Synopsys PrimeSim HSPICE, Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer with Multi-Frequency CMU (1 kHz - 5 MHz) on silicon test bench / TEG structure.
testcases.pre_conditions: Full pitch-matched layout of 512-cell folded bitline segment completed in 180nm 1P6M design rules; Metal1 bitline pitch at 0.56 µm; 3D field-solver BEOL extraction profiles loaded; VDD = 1.8 V, VSS = 0.0 V, T = 27°C.
testcases.procedure: 1. Run rule-based 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) on the 512-row folded bitline column pair (BL and /BL) extracting coupled distributed R-L-C-C network down to 0.01 fF threshold. 2. Measure total lumped and distributed segment capacitance across BL to ground (substrate + well + unselected wordlines) and cross-coupling capacitance between BL and /BL. 3. Connect test bench AC small-signal source (10 mV amplitude, 1 MHz) to bitline pad with access transistors in cutoff (V_WL = 0 V) and equalizer off (V_EQ = 0 V). 4. Record cumulative bitline capacitance C_BL and loop resistance R_BL from the near end (sense amp interface) to the far end (dummy cell boundary).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total bitline capacitance C_BL must measure between 225 fF and 275 fF (nominal 250 fF ± 10%); BL-to-/BL cross-coupling capacitance C_c must not exceed 25 fF (<= 10% of C_BL); total end-to-end bitline line resistance R_BL must be <= 850 Ω.

testcases.title: Dynamic Cell-to-Bitline Charge-Sharing Differential Voltage Signal Development
testcases.instrumentation: Transient SPICE Mixed-Signal Simulator (HSPICE / Spectre), High-Bandwidth Sub-Femtoamp Waveform Prober / Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope (Keysight Infiniium UXR 33 GHz with high-impedance active probe).
testcases.pre_conditions: Extracted distributed π-RC bitline netlist from TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-1-01 instantiated with 1T1C storage node Cs = 25 fF; Storage node initialized to Data '1' (V_cell = 1.80 V) and Data '0' (V_cell = 0.00 V); VDD = 1.8 V; VPP wordline overdrive = 2.8 V; precharge set to VDD/2 = 0.90 V.
testcases.procedure: 1. Assert precharge/equalize signal to 1.8 V, stabilizing BL and /BL to 0.900 V ± 2 mV; deassert equalize signal at t = 5.0 ns. 2. At t = 7.0 ns, drive selected wordline (WL) from 0 V to VPP = 2.8 V with a 1.0 ns rise time (10%-90%). 3. Monitor differential signal development ΔV = V(BL) - V(/BL) at the sense amplifier input terminals over a 5.0 ns signal development window before latch strobe activation. 4. Repeat transient sweep across Fast-Fast (1.98V, -40°C) and Slow-Slow (1.62V, 125°C) PVT corners.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Peak differential voltage ΔV at t = 12.0 ns must be >= +120 mV for Data '1' read and <= -120 mV for Data '0' read; dynamic charge sharing settling time to reach 90% of asymptotic ΔV must be <= 3.2 ns across all PVT corners.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (chemical-resistant double gloving)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact-resistant safety glasses with side shields
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) safe lab coat and conductive footwear
Face shield when handling solvent replenishment containers

Eye Exposure: Flush eyes with sterile eye-wash saline or running water for minimum 15 minutes holding eyelids wide open; seek prompt medical evaluation. Inhalation: Relocate victim to fresh outdoor air immediately; provide artificial respiration or supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Continuous chemical fume hood operation with face velocity certified between 0.45 m/s and 0.60 m/s (90-120 FPM); laminar clean bench exhaust with local scrubbed VOC exhaust extraction; continuous ambient LEL (lower explosive limit) hydrocarbon gas sensor monitoring.

q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Metal1/Metal2 bitline interconnects etched, passivated, and stored under ultra-pure N2 (< 1 ppm H2O, < 1 ppm O2) with contact pads protected against native oxidation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Cross-Coupled NMOS/PMOS Latch W/L Aspect Ratio & Pull-Down Optimization
**Hierarchy Path:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch & VDD/2 Equalizer Schematic Sizing > CMOS Cross-Coupled Inverter Latch W/L Aspect Ratio & Bitline Load Sizing > Cross-Coupled NMOS/PMOS Latch W/L Aspect Ratio & Pull-Down Optimization  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
This SOP defines the schematic sizing, aspect ratio optimization ($W/L$), and pull-down activation sequencing for the cross-coupled NMOS latch pair ($N_1, N_2$) and cross-coupled PMOS restore pair ($P_1, P_2$) in a folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier. Sizing balances rapid signal latching against bitline capacitive load ($C_{BL}$), prevents sensing destruction of small differential voltage signals ($\Delta V$), and controls peak displacement currents during the pull-down phase.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       SENSE AMPLIFIER TIMING & SIZING FLOW                      |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
 [Step 1: Cell & Bitline Boundary Load Setup]
   C_s = 25 fF - 30 fF  |  C_BL = 250 fF  |  Bitline Precharge V_BL = V_DD / 2
                               │
                               ▼
 [Step 2: Signal Development Phase]
   WL Assert -> Charge Redistribution -> Signal Development Delta V = 100 mV - 150 mV
                               │
                               ▼
 [Step 3: NMOS Cross-Coupled Latch Sizing & Pull-Down (SAN)]
   Gate Length L = 180 nm | Initial NMOS Pull-down to V_SS
                               │
                               ▼
 [Step 4: PMOS Cross-Coupled Latch Sizing & Pull-Up (SAP)]
   Gate Length L = 180 nm | Full Rail Restoration to V_DD
                               │
                               ▼
 [Step 5: Dynamic Latch Simulation & Differential Margin Verification]
   Monte Carlo / Mismatch check -> Latch stability verified against noise margins
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Establish Capacitive Load & Precharge Operating Point
1. Configure schematic bitline load capacitance at $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ per bitline branch ($BL, \overline{BL}$) to account for unit cell access nodes and parasitic wiring across the folded topology.
2. Fix unit cell storage capacitance model within $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ (nominal 28 fF stacked capacitor design).
3. Set the precharge equalization voltage rail to $V_{pre} = V_{DD}/2$.

#### Step 2: Calculate Signal Development Differential Margin
1. Verify signal development following wordline assertion:
   $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$
2. Ensure schematic operating conditions present a developed differential input $\Delta V$ between $100\text{ mV}$ and $150\text{ mV}$ at the complementary bitlines prior to latch enablement.

#### Step 3: NMOS Latch Pair Sizing & Pull-Down Sequencing (SAN Optimization)
1. Set the gate channel length for cross-coupled NMOS latch transistors to minimum physical gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (with gate oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
2. Scale NMOS width $W_N$ relative to access transistor sizing ($W = 220\text{ nm}, L = 180\text{ nm}$) to achieve sufficient transconductance ($g_m$) without causing asymmetric bitline capacitive loading or premature signal flipping due to device mismatch.
3. Configure the pull-down signal ($\text{SAN}$) driver with a two-stage or ramped slew-rate control to pull the common source line to $V_{SS}$ smoothly, minimizing bitline coupling and bounce during initial differential separation.

#### Step 4: PMOS Restore Latch Sizing & Pull-Up Sequencing (SAP Optimization)
1. Fix cross-coupled PMOS gate channel length to $L = 180\text{ nm}$.
2. Size PMOS width $W_P \approx (2.0 - 2.5) \times W_N$ to balance hole vs. electron mobility, ensuring symmetric restoration of the high bitline toward $V_{DD}$ following the initial NMOS amplification phase.
3. Ensure latch activation timing delay: trigger pull-up signal ($\text{SAP}$) activation only after the NMOS pull-down has enlarged the differential separation beyond device threshold offsets.

#### Step 5: SPICE Transient Verification & Corner Analysis
1. Execute transient sensing simulations over process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corners up to $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. Validate that bitline leakage across unselected cells remains below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain signal integrity throughout sensing.
3. Ensure full bitline rail-to-rail swing ($0\text{ V}$ to $V_{DD}$) is achieved without signal inversion.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | Minimum feature design rule ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) | $\text{nm}$ | Schematic GDS / DRC Rule Check |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28$ | $25 \text{ to } 30$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE / Extraction Parameter Check |
| **Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250$ | Baseline load model | $\text{fF}$ | Parasitic Extraction (PEX) |
| **Developed Differential Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | Minimum required before latch pull-down | $\text{mV}$ | Transient Simulation (Probe $BL - \overline{BL}$) |
| **Cell Leakage Current (Retention Limit)** | $< 1$ | Upper limit at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC Sub-threshold / Junction Leakage Sim |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Architecture of CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch in folded-bitline topology; bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$; differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$; baseline $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and initial signal differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$; latch activation via pull-down signal SAN.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: 180nm technology node parameters ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, access transistor $W = 220\text{ nm}$); minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$; leakage current constraint $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Storage capacitor specification of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell for retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The common source pull-down line (SAN) driver resistance must be decoupled from bitline pitch-matching limits. In a folded bitline architecture across a 180nm process (VDD = 1.8V, V_BLP = 0.9V), inadequate NMOS pull-down conductance (g_m_n) elongates the regenerative sensing time beyond 2.5 ns. Conversely, an oversized pull-down switch creates an abrupt ground bounce (>150 mV on VSS_SAN) during simultaneous sensing of 512 sense amplifier blocks, which risks flipping unselected or marginal bitline pairs via capacitive coupling.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: For 180nm CMOS DRAM sense amplifiers, the latch aspect ratios must be calibrated to balance differential offset voltage against layout pitch. NMOS latch pull-down pair (NL1/NL2) should be sized at W/L = 1.2 um / 0.18 um to 1.8 um / 0.18 um (targeting g_m >= 450 uS/um at saturation) to guarantee fast latching during Phase 3 (SAN pulled to GND), while the PMOS pull-up pair (PL1/PL2) should maintain W/L = 2.0 um / 0.18 um to 2.4 um / 0.18 um to achieve symmetrical restoration. Sizing must avoid Pelgrom threshold mismatch (sigma_Vth > 12 mV) which exceeds the minimum signal margin (delta_V_BL = 120-180 mV).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The physical implementation of the sense amp strip requires TSMC/SCL 180nm mixed-signal/RF or embedded DRAM-compatible reticle sets with tight polysilicon critical dimension (CD) control. Non-standard finger geometries or asymmetric source/drain contact configurations will cause yield attrition due to optical proximity correction (OPC) failures at the dense array pitch boundary (poly pitch < 500 nm).
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier layout must fit precisely within a dual-column bitline pitch (e.g., pitch <= 2.8 um per folded BL pair). If NMOS pull-down and PMOS pull-up aspect ratios require multi-finger folding exceeding the horizontal pitch budget, the design team must implement a staggered / interleaved sense-amp strip architecture, which increases routing metal layers from M2 to M3 and extends the tape-out milestone by 3 weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Regenerative Inversion / False Read: Vth mismatch (delta_Vth > 18 mV) in the cross-coupled NMOS pair exceeding initial charge-sharing differential voltage (delta_V_BL < 150 mV), causing the latch to flip to the opposite data state.
1. SAN Ground Bounce Induced Latch-Up or Stall: High dI/dt on the SAN node (> 40 mA/ns per bank) collapsing the internal VSS reference, leading to partial pull-down where bitline low stays above 350 mV.
1. Incomplete Charge Restoration: PMOS pull-up ratio undersized relative to bitline parasitic capacitance (C_BL >= 250 fF), leaving the restored high bitline below 0.95*VDD (1.71V) within the RAS-to-CAS precharge window t_RP.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-2-01` | **Differential Sensing Speed and Regenerative Delay Verification** | Cadence Spectre / Synopsys FineSim SPICE engine, transient simulation with BSIM4 model cards for 180nm NMOS/PMOS, 50 GHz mixed-signal virtual probe on BL, /BL, and SAN nodes with extracted RCLK parasitic network. | 1. Initialize circuit with bitline equalization at V_BLP = 0.9 V. 2. Inject charge delta on BLB to establish delta_V_BL = 150 mV. 3. Transition SAN driver gate to 1.8 V with 200 ps rise time. 4. Measure t_sense defined as time from SAN = 0.8*VDD until V(/BL) reaches 0.1*VDD (180 mV). 5. Measure ground bounce peak on internal SAN node. | `t_sense <= 2.20 ns; Peak SAN bounce <= 120 mV; Final low bitline voltage <= 45 mV.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-2-02` | **Monte Carlo Mismatch Offset and Sensitivity Yield Assessment** | Cadence Spectre Monte Carlo engine, 1000-run statistical analysis combining process (inter-die) and mismatch (intra-die Pelgrom) BSIM4 parameters, automated waveform post-processor. | 1. Run 1000 Monte Carlo iterations for each delta_V_in step. 2. Apply differential voltage delta_V_in between BL and /BL. 3. Fire SAN at t = 1.0 ns and SAP at t = 2.5 ns. 4. Record binary output state of BL and /BL at t = 6.0 ns. 5. Calculate input offset voltage standard deviation (sigma_Vos) and identify zero-crossing threshold. | `3-sigma offset voltage (3*sigma_Vos) <= 38.0 mV; Sense amplifier decision yield >= 99.9% at delta_V_in = 60 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level C chemical-resistant neoprene/butyl apron and sleeves, Dual-cartridge full-face respirator with acid gas/P100 filter, Heavy-duty double-layered nitrile over fluoroelastomer gloves (ASTM F739 tested), Chemical splash impact-resistant face shield and polycarbonate safety goggles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical arrival. For eye contact: Irrigate eyes with 1% Calcium Gluconate isotonic solution or clean water for 15 minutes. Administer 100% medical oxygen if vapors are inhaled.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet bench exhaust plenum maintaining face velocity between 100 and 120 FPM (0.51 to 0.61 m/s), monitored by differential magnehelic pressure gauges tied to automatic tool interlocks. Effluent ducted directly to centralized polypropylene acid wet scrubber.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid waste stream; treat with automated calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) precipitation system to form insoluble CaF2 precipitate, maintaining effluent neutralization between pH 6.5 and 8.5 prior to industrial wastewater release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha Clean component)** | `7664-93-9` | MOS Grade | `96% aqueous` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30% aqueous` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-HF clean (DHF 100:1), bare silicon substrate with native oxide thickness <= 1.2 Angstroms and water contact angle >= 75 deg (hydrophobic Si-H termination).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Gate dielectric growth complete; thermal oxynitride / SiO2 interface with physical thickness 3.2 +/- 0.1 nm, surface roughness RMS <= 0.15 nm via AFM.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled native oxide regrowth (> 3.5 Angstroms) and airborne molecular contamination (boron/organics) inducing gate oxide thickness variation (delta_Tox > 4%), driving severe Vth mismatch in cross-coupled NMOS pairs.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified schematic sizing and parasitic-extracted layout review for the Gen 2 180nm DRAM folded sense amplifier NMOS/PMOS cross-coupled latch and SAN pull-down switch. The latch achieves symmetrical restoration, sub-2.2 ns sensing delay at the slow corner, and a 3-sigma offset voltage under 38 mV within a 2.8 um cell pitch constraint.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `TC_FOLDED_SENSE_AMP_1_1_2_MONTE_CARLO_OFFSET.csv`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Cross-coupled NMOS latch input-referred random offset standard deviation (sigma_Vos)** | `11.2 mV` | <= 12.5 mV | 1000-run Monte Carlo mismatch analysis using BSIM4 Pelgrom coefficient parameters |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Restored high bitline voltage (V_BL_high) level after P-sense activation** | `1.78 V` | +0.02V / -0.05V | Analog transient waveform measurement at t = 10 ns post-wordline activation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full formal signoff requires: 100% passing across all 1000 Monte Carlo runs at 60 mV input differential; post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) confirming total BL/BLB capacitance balance within 1.5%; zero DRC/LVS violations in 180nm mixed-signal PDK ruleset; and joint approval from Circuit Design and Integration Leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Sense Amplifier Sensing Margin, Latch Delay & Monte Carlo Mismatch Verification

**Module**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`)  
**Sub-System**: Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer — CMOS Cross-Coupled Inverter Latch  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (180nm / µm) | **Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Sensing & Verification Lifecycle

```text
Min Signal dV (mV)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                     │
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Precharge & Equalization Setup**:
   - Initialize folded bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ to precisely $V_{DD}/2$ using the equalization transistor network prior to wordline assertion.
   - Verify that the access transistor geometry is set to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ on the shared bitline contact cell layout.

2. **Charge-Sharing & Differential Signal ($\Delta V$) Development**:
   - Assert the wordline to switch on the 1T1C access transistor, dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline with cell storage capacitance $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal $25\text{ fF}$, minimum design target $28\text{ fF}$) against a bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Measure the developed differential voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ across $BL$ and $/BL$ before strobe activation.

3. **Strobe Timing & Full-Rail Regeneration**:
   - Trigger the latch activation signals sequentially: strobe SAN to pull low toward $\text{GND}$, followed by SAP pulling high toward $V_{DD}$.
   - Measure the regenerative latch delay required to amplify $\Delta V$ to full-rail CMOS voltage levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) while restoring $100\%$ charge back to the storage capacitor.

4. **Monte Carlo Mismatch & Pitch Verification**:
   - Run 1000-run Monte Carlo mismatch simulations accounting for threshold voltage ($\Delta V_{th}$) and $W/L$ channel variations in the cross-coupled inverter pairs.
   - Confirm that the sensing margin remains positive (zero read-flips) across process variations and that layout pitch matches the $360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch using an interleaved sense amplifier architecture.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Exact Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100$ to $150$ | Minimum $\ge 100$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25$ (nominal) / $28$ (stacked min) | Minimum $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250$ | Baseline nominal | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Layout Pitch** | $360$ | Pitch-matched (interleaved) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $< 1$ | Maximum allowable at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary folded bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$; equalization network precharging to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Charge-sharing equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, yielding $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Sensing activation sequence: SAN pulls to $\text{GND}$, SAP pulls to $V_{DD}$, driving rails to $0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$ with $100\%$ restore.
  - Sense amplifier interleaved layout matching array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ at the 180nm node.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error and bitline noise immunity.
  - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

> [!NOTE]
> Micro-knowledge extracted and documented in [docs/knowledge/sense_amp_sensing_margin_sop.md](docs/knowledge/sense_amp_sensing_margin_sop.md).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: From an architectural integration perspective, the differential signal development budget of Delta V = 110 mV (based on Cs = 28 fF and Cb = 200 fF at Vcore = 1.8 V) leaves virtually zero headroom if bitline parasitic coupling (inter-bitline capacitance C_c) exceeds 15% of total bitline capacitance. In a folded bitline topology, adjacent bitline pairs experience differential crosstalk during cell charge sharing. Furthermore, array-wide IR drop on the sense-amplifier power supply rail (SAP) and ground rail (SAN) during concurrent activation of 512 sense amps per mat will degrade latching slew rates, widening the effective sense decision window and risking destructive read flips if equalization skew across the mat exceeds 25 ps.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Pelgrom mismatch modeling (sigma_Vth = A_Vth / sqrt(W * L)) in standard 180nm mixed-signal CMOS processes typically yields A_Vthn ~ 4.5 mV*um and A_Vthp ~ 5.5 mV*um. For an NMOS cross-coupled pair sized aggressively to minimize area pitch (e.g., W/L = 0.6 um / 0.18 um), 3-sigma Vth mismatch alone exceeds 3 * (4.5 / sqrt(0.108)) = 41 mV. When convolved with wordline-to-bitline feedthrough charge injection asymmetries (~15 mV) and equalization residual offsets (~10 mV), total dynamic input-referred offset voltage reaches 66 mV. This consumes over 60% of the available 110 mV sensing margin. NMOS and PMOS cross-coupled latch transistors must be co-optimized with intentional differential channel sizing and staged activation (staged NMOS SAN pull-down before PMOS SAP pull-up) to suppress common-mode bouncing.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standard 180nm open-source foundry PDKs (e.g., SkyWater 130nm / generic 180nm CMOS platforms) exhibit substantial lot-to-lot and across-wafer transistor threshold variations (+/- 12% across slow-slow and fast-fast process corners). Over-sizing sense amp transistors to tame mismatch widens the bitline pitch beyond the 1T1C memory array layout cell pitch, necessitating complex multi-tier sense amplifier staggering and metal-4/metal-5 strapping layers that increase mask count from 24 to 28 masks and elevate wafer fab NRE and cycle time.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier layout pitch matching represents the most critical schedule bottleneck in the physical implementation cycle. If the schematic sizing dictates an active latch width requiring a 4-row staggered architecture, layout routing congestion between Metal-1 BL/BL_bar rails and poly-silicon cross-coupling connections will delay the design tapeout review gate by 4 weeks. Layout parasitic extraction (LPE) must be back-annotated into Monte Carlo transient runs by Milestone M2 to avoid redesign loops.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Sense Inversion: Random Vth and beta mismatch in the cross-coupled NMOS latch exceeding developed bitline differential voltage (Delta V < V_offset_dyn), causing inverted latch resolution and hard data corruption during read/refresh.
1. Equalization Residual Imbalance: Asymmetric turn-off charge injection from the VDD/2 equalization NMOS gate dumping unequal net charges onto BL vs /BL, eroding initial pre-sensing differential margin prior to wordline activation.
1. Supply Bounce Induced Metastability: Abrupt SAN pulldown transient causing localized ground bounce on array ground busses exceeding 150 mV, stalling regeneration and pushing latch resolution delay beyond the allocated tRCD spec limit.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-3-01` | **Monte Carlo Dynamic Input-Referred Offset Voltage and Sensing Yield Verification** | Cadence Spectre / Synopsys FineSim SPICE simulator executing 1,000-point Monte Carlo runs with statistical mismatch and process corner models (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) at -40°C, 27°C, and 85°C with precision numerical integration (trap/gear hybrid, reltol=1e-5). | 1. Assert equalization disable (EQ = 0 V) at t = 2.0 ns. 2. Pulse WL to 2.8 V (boosted WL) at t = 3.0 ns for 8.0 ns to share charge between cell and BL, developing Delta V = +/- 110 mV. 3. Activate SAN pull-down signal via staged current sink at t = 5.0 ns. 4. Activate SAP pull-up signal to 1.8 V at t = 5.8 ns. 5. Measure differential voltage V(BL) - V(/BL) at t = 10.0 ns across 1,000 Monte Carlo runs per corner. 6. Sweep input differential test offset Delta V_in from -120 mV to +120 mV in 5 mV steps to extract 3-sigma dynamic input offset distribution. | `The mean input-referred dynamic offset |mu_Vos| must be <= 5.0 mV with standard deviation sigma_Vos <= 18.0 mV. 3-sigma offset (3 * sigma_Vos) must not exceed 54.0 mV (retaining >= 56 mV margin against 110 mV nominal signal). Sensing yield across 1,000 Monte Carlo iterations at worst-case SS corner (85°C, VDD = 1.62 V) must be >= 99.87% (3.0-sigma defect-free resolution).` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-1-3-02` | **Sense Amplifier Latch Regeneration Delay and Bitline Restoration Slew Verification** | High-bandwidth automated SPICE transient extraction engine coupled with automated waveform measurement scripts measuring 10% to 90% rail transitions on BL and /BL net nodes. | 1. Initialize BL and /BL at VDD/2 (0.900 V). 2. Inject forced differential step Delta V_in = 75 mV (worst-case degraded signal margin) across BL and /BL. 3. Assert sense amp activation clock SAN with a slew rate of 0.2 V/ns. 4. Record timestamp t_act where SAN crosses 0.90 V. 5. Measure timestamp t_split where |V(BL) - V(/BL)| reaches 1.0 V. 6. Measure timestamp t_restore where full-rail level (V(BL) >= 1.70 V or V(/BL) <= 0.10 V) is achieved across bitline array terminal. | `Latch regeneration sensing delay (t_split - t_act) must be <= 2.20 ns at typical corner (27°C, 1.8 V) and <= 3.80 ns at worst-case corner (SS, 85°C, 1.62 V). Full bitline cell restoration time (t_restore - t_act) must not exceed 6.50 ns. Maximum instantaneous ground bounce on SAN virtual node must remain < 120 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Antistatic dissipative ESD lab coat / cleanroom bunny suit, Conductive heel-strap footwear tested to < 35 MOhm
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Isopropyl Alcohol eye or skin contact: Flush immediately with continuous eyewash or deluge stream for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, immediately evacuate victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored. For Nitrogen asphyxiant risk: Move personnel to well-ventilated open area; apply CPR if pulse is absent.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory and wafer characterization bench must maintain continuous negative-pressure wet exhaust ducting with minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.51 m/s) at chemical station hood. Continuous ambient oxygen deficiency monitoring sensors calibrated with alarm trigger at < 19.5% O2.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipe rags and IPA rinse effluent must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-proof polyethylene carboys dedicated to non-halogenated organic solvents. No drain disposal allowed; route to licensed hazardous waste disposal contractor per EPA Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) standards.

| **Gaseous Dry Nitrogen** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity Grade 5.0 (99.999%) | `100% gas` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-probe test wafer: Silicon nitride passivated top metal (Metal-5 aluminum/copper pad metallization) free of organic residue, particulates (particle count < 10 per 200mm wafer @ > 0.2 um size), and native moisture adsorption.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-parametric wafer test: Bondpad contact scrub marks limited to < 15% of pad area; zero metallic needle smear bridging adjacent 1.8 V VDD and equalization probe pins; dry nitrogen blown dry surface.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding cleanroom air Q-time (> 240 minutes) induces airborne molecular contamination (AMC) and moisture adsorption on open aluminum test pads, causing galvanic micro-corrosion, contact resistance escalation from < 0.5 Ohm to > 25 Ohm on external power probes, and measurement-induced sensing delay skew.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full design closure and verification signoff for the 180nm CMOS folded bitline cross-coupled sense amplifier and VDD/2 equalizer schematic. The design guarantees robust differential readout under +/- 110 mV nominal charge-sharing margins with 3-sigma mismatch offset <= 54 mV and regeneration latency <= 3.80 ns across all extreme voltage, temperature, and transistor process corners.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_SA_MONTE_CARLO_OFFSET_REPORT.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_SA_SENSING_TIMING_MARGIN_SIGN_OFF.pdf`

| `ASSERT-02` | **Sense amplifier regeneration latch delay (t_split - t_act) under minimum 75 mV differential input** | `1.85 ns` | +/- 0.35 ns (typical), max <= 3.80 ns (SS corner) | Post-layout extracted SPICE transient simulation measuring delay from SAN assertion (0.9V) to |V(BL)-V(/BL)|=1.0V |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Bitline precharge equalization voltage balance |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at wordline fire boundary** | `0.0 mV` | <= 1.5 mV | SPICE transient analysis of equalization transistor gate turn-off charge injection residual on BL and /BL nodes |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal signoff requires 1,000-run Monte Carlo transient simulation across TT, SS, FF, SF, and FS corners with zero latch decision errors under Delta V = 75 mV signal input, worst-case 3-sigma offset <= 54.0 mV, restoration delay <= 6.50 ns, and unanimous approval by the Multi-Agent Circuit Design Review Council.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Three-Transistor $V_{DD}/2$ Bitline Equalizer & Precharge Switch Sizing

- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy**: [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch & $V_{DD}/2$ Equalizer Schematic Sizing > Three-Transistor $V_{DD}/2$ Bitline Equalizer & Precharge Switch Sizing
- **Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$) | **Action Type**: Make
- **Persisted SOP Artifact**: [`sop_3t_bitline_equalizer_sizing.md`](docs/knowledge/sop_3t_bitline_equalizer_sizing.md)

---

### 1. Circuit Architecture & Equalizer Topology

The three-transistor (3T) NMOS equalization network operates across each folded bitline pair ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$):
- **Differential Equalizer Switch ($M_{EQ}$)**: Bridges $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ directly. Provides instantaneous differential charge neutralization without loading the internal $V_{BLP}$ supply rail.
- **Precharge Centering Switches ($M_{PR1}, M_{PR2}$)**: Pulls $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ to the mid-rail reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.90\text{ V}$ to re-establish exact common-mode baseline and compensate for asymmetric leakage.
- **Control**: Gated by the equalize strobe $BLEQ$ ($0\text{ V} \rightarrow 1.8\text{ V}$).

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   BLEQ Assert High    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ├────────────────────────────╮
            ▼                            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐    ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │    │                       │
│  M_EQ Bridges BL and  │    │    M_PR1 and M_PR2    │
│          BLB          │    │    Connect to VBLP    │
│                       │    │                       │
└──────────┬────────────┘    └───────────┬───────────┘
           │                             │
           │ ╭───────────────────────────╯
           ▼ ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Rapid Differential   │
│     Equalization      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Bitlines Settle to   │
│     VDD/2 (0.9V)      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Physical & Electrical Constraints Context

From verified literature parameters:
- **Core Supply**: $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$
- **Precharge Reference**: $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2 = 0.90\text{ V}$
- **Access Transistor Threshold**: $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$ (Nominal access device $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)
- **Capacitive Loading**: Cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (Target $\ge 28\text{ fF}$), folded bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$
- **Developed Signal Margin**: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$

```text
                 Critical Equalizer Electrical Baseline 
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │████████████████                      │
Delta V min (mV)┤████████████████                      │
                │░░                                    │
 V_BLP (x100 mV)┤░░                                    │
  V_DD (x100 mV)┤▒▒▒▒                                  │
                │▒▒▒▒                                  │
        C_s (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓                                 │
                │▓▓▓▓▓                                 │
       C_BL (fF)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Step 1: Set Device Channel Length Bounds**
   - Fix channel lengths for all 3 devices ($M_{EQ}, M_{PR1}, M_{PR2}$) strictly to $L = 180\text{ nm}$ ($0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) to minimize channel on-state resistance $R_{on}$ and reduce gate overlap parasitic capacitance ($C_{gd}, C_{gs}$).

2. **Step 2: Size Differential Shunt Equalizer ($M_{EQ}$)**
   - Target an on-resistance $R_{on,EQ} \le 1.2\text{ k}\Omega$ across $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ to ensure equalization RC time constant $\tau_{EQ} \approx R_{on,EQ} \cdot (C_{BL}/2) \le 150\text{ ps}$.
   - Set width $W_{EQ} = 1.00\text{ }\mu\text{m} - 1.20\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($W/L \approx 5.5 - 6.7$).

3. **Step 3: Size Precharge Centering Switches ($M_{PR1}, M_{PR2}$)**
   - Because $M_{EQ}$ neutralizes $>90\%$ of differential voltage between $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$, size $M_{PR1}$ and $M_{PR2}$ primarily for common-mode centering and leakage replenishment.
   - Set width $W_{PR1} = W_{PR2} = 0.50\text{ }\mu\text{m} - 0.60\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ ($W/L \approx 2.8 - 3.3$).
   - Layout constraint: Match $M_{PR1}$ and $M_{PR2}$ in a common-centroid/interdigitated geometry to maintain threshold symmetry ($\Delta V_{th} < 2\text{ mV}$) and eliminate differential charge injection mismatch.

4. **Step 4: Transient Equalization Verification**
   - Simulate post-read/post-write cycle with initial state $BL = 1.8\text{ V}$, $\overline{BL} = 0\text{ V}$.
   - Strobe $BLEQ$ high ($1.8\text{ V}$) and verify settlement within the row precharge window $t_{RP}$.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Precharge Time ($t_{RP}$)** | $\le 4.5$ | $\text{ns}$ | Time from $BLEQ \ge 0.9\text{ V}$ to $\|V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}\| \le 5\text{ mV}$ ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$) |
| **Common-Mode Precharge Offset** | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Common-mode error $\|V_{BL} - 0.900\text{ V}\|$ after $5\text{ ns}$ |
| **Differential Charge Injection Skew ($\Delta Q_{inj}$)** | $\le 0.15$ | $\text{fC}$ | Skew between $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ charge displacement upon $BLEQ$ falling edge |
| **Maximum Standby Equalizer Leakage ($I_{leak}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Total bitline leakage to sub-threshold/junction at $85^\circ\text{C}$, $V_{BL} = 0.90\text{ V}$ |

---

### 5. Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Folded bitline topology, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge scheme, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, storage node capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, developed signal margin $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: 180nm design rules ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$ access transistor), minimum capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage ceiling $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture]**: Supply rail $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, NMOS access device threshold $V_{th} \approx 0.5\text{ V} - 0.7\text{ V}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline architecture operating with VDD=1.8V and precharge voltage VBLP=VDD/2=0.9V, the three-transistor (3T) equalizer/precharge network must guarantee that the bitline true (BL) and bitline complement (/BL) pair equilibrate within < 2.5 ns to support cycle times under 15 ns. If the gate drive for the equalization transistors (EQ signal) is driven only to VDD (1.8V), the overdrive voltage (Vgs - Vth) for NMOS pass switches sitting at VBLP=0.9V is reduced to 1.8V - 0.9V - Vth ~ 0.3V - 0.4V due to substrate body effect (source at 0.9V with p-well at 0V). An unboosted EQ signal degrades conductance (gds) exponentially under slow-slow process corners, causing tail equilibration currents that violate minimum tRP (Row Precharge time).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The bridging equalizer transistor directly connecting BL and /BL is paramount because charge redistribution between complementary bitlines is inherently conservative and does not demand current sourcing from the VBLP internal generator. To prevent offset injection into the cross-coupled CMOS sense amplifier, the two pull-up/pull-down precharge transistors connecting BL and /BL to VBLP must exhibit identical threshold voltage matching (delta Vth < 5 mV) and symmetric channel layout. Mismatch between the two VBLP-connecting branches yields a residual differential offset Delta V_diff across BL and /BL that directly erodes the 28 fF storage cell read sense signal (Delta V_sig ~ 120-180 mV for C_BL ~ 200 fF), leading to destructive sensing errors on weak retention cells.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Targeting an open-source 180nm CMOS mixed-signal / embedded DRAM baseline process (e.g., TSMC 0.18um or generic 180nm 1P6M foundry PDK), we must ensure that the 3T equalizer utilizes standard thick-oxide or medium-voltage IO NMOS devices if boosted EQ driving (e.g., VPP=2.8V or boosted EQ=2.2V) is deployed to prevent gate-oxide TDDB failure over a 10-year operating life. If core 1.8V thin-oxide transistors (tox ~ 4.0 nm) are selected for layout compactness within the tight 220nm active pitch boundary, gate over-voltage must be clamped below 1.98V (VDD + 10%) across all operating modes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The physical layout of the 3T equalizer must integrate within the folded bitline pitch matched directly to two unit cell widths (2 x 2F = 720 nm total bitline pair pitch in 180nm Gen 2 lithography). Failure to achieve layout pitch matching forces layout fanning (jogging) of metal bitline tracks, which dramatically increases bitline-to-substrate parasitic capacitance C_BL, drops sense margin below the 100 mV spec, and creates critical tapeout milestone delays for the sense amplifier macro.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete Bitline Equalization: Insufficient W/L or degraded gate overdrive on the bridging transistor leaves a differential voltage |V_BL - V_/BL| > 15 mV at the de-assertion of the EQ control signal, flipping the regenerative cross-coupled latch during wordline activation.
1. VBLP Generator Transient Collapse: High simultaneous current drain through precharge switches across 512 bitline pairs drags the unbuffered on-chip VBLP generator voltage down by > 100 mV, creating dynamic baseline drift and cell disturb across adjacent array mats.
1. Charge Injection & Clock-Feedthrough Asymmetry: Mismatched overlap capacitance (Cgd, Cgs) between the two precharge switches injects uneven capacitive charge packets into BL versus /BL when EQ goes low, inducing a false differential offset.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-2-01` | **SPICE Transient Simulation of Bitline Pair Differential Equalization Time and Residual Offset** | Cadence Spectre / Synopsys HSPICE / Ngspice engine running BSIM4 device models with Monte Carlo mismatch parameters and temperature set to 85°C and 125°C. | 1. Assert EQ signal from 0V to 1.8V at t = 5.0 ns for duration of 3.0 ns. 2. Measure instantaneous voltage V(BL) and V(/BL) across a 1000-run Monte Carlo mismatch simulation across TT, SS, and FF corners at 85°C. 3. Record equalization settling time t_EQ required for |V(BL) - V(/BL)| to drop below 2.0 mV. 4. Record steady-state residual differential voltage Delta V_res = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at t = 7.9 ns immediately prior to EQ falling edge. | `Settling time t_EQ <= 2.20 ns under worst-case SS corner (1.62V VDD, 125°C); residual offset Delta V_res <= 3.0 mV at 3-sigma across all 1000 Monte Carlo runs.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-2-02` | **Direct Physical Wafer Microprobe Characterization of VBLP Precharge Current Sourcing & Charge Injection Asymmetry** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Analyzer connected to Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 semi-automated probe station with low-leakage GSG coaxial microprobes, Agilent 81110A Pulse Generator, and high-impedance active differential probes (Tektronix TDP1500). | 1. Set VBLP SMU to 0.900 V. 2. Force bitline BL to 1.80 V and /BL to 0.00 V via test multiplexer. 3. Apply a 100 MHz periodic pulse train to pin EQ (0V to 1.8V, 50% duty cycle). 4. Measure transient differential settling waveform using high-bandwidth oscilloscope. 5. Integrate dynamic precharge current I_VBLP to calculate net coulombs supplied per cycle. 6. Inspect post-turn-off voltage step induced by clock feedthrough on BL and /BL. | `Peak transient current per bitline pair <= 120 uA; clock feedthrough induced differential mismatch |Delta V_feedthrough| <= 5.0 mV; DC leakage on VBLP pin with EQ=0V <= 10 pA per bitline pair at 85°C.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, ESD-safe), ANSI Z87.1 certified safety glasses with side shields, Full static-dissipative cleanroom gown with hood and conductive booties, Wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor for ESD grounding
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Skin contact: Immediately flush skin with copious amounts of deionized water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated cleanroom clothing. Eye exposure: Rinse cautiously with sterile eye wash solution for 15 minutes, holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. Inhalation of organic vapors: Evacuate personnel to fresh air area; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All solvent cleaning of probe cards and wafer stages must occur under dedicated laminar flow exhaust benches with certified face velocity between 80 and 100 FPM (0.4 to 0.5 m/s) vented to an approved VOC abatement system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wastes (IPA, Acetone) must be collected in closed, grounded, flame-arrested stainless steel or polyethylene carboys labeled as hazardous flammable solvent waste. Under no circumstances should solvents be discharged into cleanroom acid drains or municipal wastewater.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen Gas** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-probe wafer surface cleaned of organic contaminants and airborne molecular contamination (AMC); aluminum/copper probe pads passivated with minimal native oxide.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed bond pads cleaned under dry N2 blow-off; scrub marks inspected and documented to verify scrub depth < 20% of pad metal thickness without dielectric cracking.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient cleanroom air exposure causes moisture condensation and copper/aluminum pad galvanic corrosion, resulting in non-ohmic microprobe contact resistance, false test case failures, and probe needle pitting.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed layout and sizing verification of the Three-Transistor (3T) VDD/2 Bitline Equalizer and Precharge switch network in 180nm open-source CMOS DRAM rules. The design achieves sub-2.2 ns bitline equilibration, balances bridging conductance with VBLP charging current, and restricts clock-feedthrough mismatch to under 3 mV to preserve the 28 fF cell sensing margin.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `eq_3t_schematic_sizing_report.pdf`
- [ ] `monte_carlo_equalization_offset_distribution.csv`
- [ ] `post_layout_extracted_transient_sim.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Total bitline equalization settling time to achieve |V_BL - V_/BL| <= 2 mV from full rail state** | `2.05 ns` | +/- 0.15 ns | BSIM4 transient SPICE post-layout simulation across SS/TT/FF process corners at 1.8V VDD and 85°C |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Precharge switch turn-off clock-feedthrough and charge injection induced differential bitline offset Delta V_diff** | `1.80 mV` | +/- 1.00 mV | 1000-point Monte Carlo mismatch transient analysis including parasitic gate-drain/gate-source overlap capacitances |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Equalizer switch channel width matching layout area constraint within folded bitline pitch** | `720 nm` | +/- 0.00 nm | Calibre/Magic DRC/LVS physical design rule pitch check across array edge interface |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full DRC and LVS clean sign-off with zero layout pitch violations, post-extraction simulation confirming differential offset Delta V_res < 3.0 mV under worst-case PVT corners, and formal approval by both Circuit Design and Layout integration team leads.
