# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 3-T Bitline Equalizer and $V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Schematic Sizing

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM180-CKT-EQ-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch & $V_{DD}/2$ Equalizer Schematic Sizing > Three-Transistor $V_{DD}/2$ Bitline Equalizer & Precharge Switch Sizing  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Operational Workflow

The 3-transistor (3-T) bitline equalizer circuit consists of:
- **Transistor $M_{EQ}$ (Bridging Switch):** Connected directly across complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$).
- **Transistors $M_{PRE1}, M_{PRE2}$ (Precharge Clamping Switches):** Connected between the precharge reference rail ($V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$) and $BL$, $\overline{BL}$ respectively.
- All three gates are driven concurrently by the equalization enable signal ($EQ$).

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Start: Bitline     │
│   Precharge Command    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Assert EQ Signal    │
│          High          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Turn On 3-T       │
│   Equalizer Network    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Short BL to /BL &    │
│      Supply VDD/2      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  BL and /BL Equalized  │
│        to VDD/2        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Sizing Procedure

1. **Topological Setup & Device Selection:**
   - Instantiate three matched NMOS switching transistors ($M_{EQ}$, $M_{PRE1}$, $M_{PRE2}$) in folded-bitline symmetry.
   - Set the minimum channel length to technology gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ to maximize switch conductance and minimize layout area.

2. **Equalization Transistor ($M_{EQ}$) Sizing:**
   - Set the bridging transistor width $W_{EQ}$ to handle rapid passive charge sharing directly between $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ across the total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Size $W_{EQ} \ge 220\text{ nm}$ (matching or exceeding memory unit cell access transistor width $W = 220\text{ nm}$) to minimize channel on-resistance ($R_{on}$) and suppress offset before the next cycle.

3. **$V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Clamp Transistors ($M_{PRE1}, M_{PRE2}$) Sizing:**
   - Size the dual precharge switches with identical channel widths ($W_{PRE1} = W_{PRE2}$) matching within layout layout symmetry to prevent systematic voltage imbalance on the bitline pair.
   - Connect the source/drain terminals directly to the low-impedance internal $V_{DD}/2$ distribution grid with gate oxide thickness engineered at $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ (dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).

4. **Transient Simulation & Offset Verification:**
   - Perform post-layout transient SPICE simulation charging $BL$ to $V_{DD}$ and discharging $\overline{BL}$ to $0\text{ V}$.
   - Pulse $EQ$ active-high and measure bitline settling to $V_{DD}/2$ reference, ensuring the residual differential voltage $|V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}|$ settles well below the operational sensing signal margin ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$).

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
               180nm DRAM Cell and Bitline Capacitive Targets
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │██                                     │
  EOT Gate SiO2┤██                                     │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
 Delta V Signal┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
C_bitline (CBL)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    C_cell (Cs)┤░░░░░                                  │
               │░░░░░                                  │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      62.5     125.0     187.5  250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Machine-Measurable Specification | Relevant Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250\text{ fF}$ | Extracted post-layout line capacitance per bitline column | *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$) | Integrated capacitor C-V parametric test | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |
| **Readout Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ | Differential voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)(V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$ | *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* |
| **Transistor Gate Length ($L$) & Oxide ($t_{ox}$)** | $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM channel length; Ellipsometric dry oxide thickness | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**  
   - Bitline equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ prior to wordline assertion using an equalization transistor network.
   - Capacitive loading parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)(V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**  
   - Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Folded bitline topology with shared contact pitch and minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$.

3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
   - Capacitor target range of $25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 3-T equalizer network (comprising one bridging pass transistor between BL and /BL and two pull-up/pull-down transistors tied to the internal VDD/2 / VBLP generator) must maintain strict low-impedance balancing without causing significant current surges on the VBLP distribution bus during simultaneous array precharge. With a bitline capacitance C_BL of 250 fF per line, activating thousands of equalizers concurrently risks inductive bounce (L*di/dt) on the on-chip half-rail reference grid. Total equalization settling time must be constrained strictly under 3.5 ns to comply with the 100 MHz array cycle budget while isolating substrate noise coupling into adjacent inactive bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an open-source 180nm mixed-signal CMOS process (1.8V VDD, VBLP = 0.9V), NMOS-only 3-T networks suffer from body effect and reduced gate overdrive (Vgs - Vth = 1.8V - 0.9V - Vth ~ 0.4V), which sharply increases channel on-resistance near the 0.9V target. Sizing the bridging transistor W/L must prioritize low Ron to rapidly suppress differential residual skew (Delta V_res < 2 mV) before wordline firing, while matching the dual VBLP clamp switches symmetrically to prevent injection of asymmetric clock-feedthrough charge onto BL versus /BL upon EQ control line deassertion.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The schematic sizing must utilize standardized foundry PDK core NMOS device primitive cells (e.g., standard 1.8V regular-Vt nfet) without relying on specialized low-Vt or native zero-Vt mask layers that require premium non-standard multi-project wafer (MPW) options. Ensuring standard gate oxide (tox ~ 4.0 nm) and standard mask-set compatibility guarantees portability across regional open PDK foundries (such as SkyWater 130/180nm or TSMC 0.18um open variants) without escalating mask NRE costs or extending fabrication turn-around lead times.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier and equalizer layout area is rigorously pitch-matched to the memory array column pitch (typically 2 * cell metal pitch). Sizing transistor widths too large will blow past the allowed 180nm bitline pitch allocation, forcing costly multi-stage or staggered SA layout architectures. Delivery of the SPICE schematic sizing netlist, monte-carlo mismatch characterization, and preliminary layout pitch feasibility study must close within Sprint 2 to avoid gating the full sense-amplifier latch freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Clock feedthrough and gate-to-diffusion overlap capacitance asymmetry injecting net differential charge onto BL and /BL during equalizer shutoff, creating a systematic residual offset Delta V > 15 mV that degrades read sensing margin for weak storage cells (100 mV delta V budget).
1. Insufficient gate overdrive causing long RC equalization tails where BL and /BL fail to converge to within 2 mV of each other within the allocated 3.5 ns precharge window under slow-slow (SS) 125°C corner conditions.
1. VBLP generator rail sag and ground bounce during array-wide equalization due to undersized VBLP decoupling and excessively low instantaneous on-resistance across all 3-T clamps simultaneously, inducing substrate noise coupling into unselected latch nodes.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-2-1-01` | **Equalization Residual Differential Skew and Settling Time Verification** | HSPICE / Ngspice transient analog simulator with 180nm BSIM4 device models, calibrated 1 fs numerical integration time step, parasitic netlist extractor, automated measurement scripts (.measure tran). | 1. Run transient simulation from t = 0 to t = 10 ns with EQ gate signal held low (0V). 2. At t = 2.0 ns, step EQ control signal from 0V to 1.8V with a 100 ps linear transition edge. 3. Monitor transient voltages V(BL), V(/BL), and differential absolute magnitude |V(BL) - V(/BL)|. 4. Measure t_eq as the time delta from 50% EQ assertion to when |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV. 5. Measure the absolute settled midpoint voltage V_mid = (V(BL) + V(/BL)) / 2 at t = 2.0 ns + 3.5 ns. | `Equalization settling time t_eq <= 3.5 ns across all PVT corners; absolute residual differential voltage |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV at t = 5.5 ns; midpoint settled voltage must remain within 0.900V +/- 15.0 mV.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-2-1-02` | **Equalizer Turn-Off Charge Injection and Dynamic Clock Feedthrough Mismatch** | Monte Carlo transient circuit simulator (2000 runs, local transistor Pelgrom mismatch and global process parameter distribution), automated differential charge integration monitor. | 1. Initialize simulation at steady state with EQ = 1.8V for 5 ns. 2. Ramp EQ signal from 1.8V down to 0V with a 100 ps falling slew rate at t = 5.0 ns. 3. Allow bitline nodes to float for 5.0 ns after shutoff. 4. Capture post-shutoff differential offset Delta V_offset = V(BL) - V(/BL) at t = 10.0 ns for each Monte Carlo run. 5. Extract statistical mean (mu) and standard deviation (sigma) of Delta V_offset across all iterations. | `Systematic dynamic shutoff offset mean |mu| <= 1.0 mV; 3-sigma offset variation 3*sigma(Delta V_offset) <= 5.0 mV across 2000 Monte Carlo iterations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard ESD-safe lab coat, Static-dissipative nitrile gloves (ANSI/ESD S20.20 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 approved safety glasses with side shields
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Inhalation: Move personnel to fresh air immediately. Eye contact: Flush opened eyes with copious isotonic saline or running water for at least 15 minutes; seek ophthalmological attention if irritation persists. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and water. Ingestion: Do not induce vomiting without medical guidance; rinse mouth with clean water and seek emergency medical care.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom / test laboratory HVAC with minimum 15 air changes per hour (ACH); dedicated local exhaust canopy or fume extraction rated at 100 linear feet per minute (FPM) face velocity for chemical wipe dispense and wafer coupon cleaning stations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA wipes and solvent effluents into clearly labeled, grounded, sealed hazardous organic waste containers compliant with local environmental regulations. No direct sink or drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation and silicon test probe cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic / VLSI Grade (SEMI C12) | `>= 99.8% wt` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) contact plug tungsten CMP planarized surface, solvent-cleaned and degreased, free of slurry micro-scratches or metallic residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered Metal-1 (Ti/TiN/AlCu/TiN stack) vacuum-sealed or continuous inert dry N2 blanket passivation ready for photolithography patterning.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide growth and atmospheric moisture chemisorption on exposed tungsten/barrier vias leading to high contact interface resistance (> 15 Ohm/via) and contact peeling/voiding during bitline metallization, inducing catastrophic bitline RC imbalance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete schematic design, device sizing calculation report, and SPICE verification netlist for the 3-T NMOS bitline equalizer and VDD/2 precharge network in 180nm CMOS technology, achieving sub-3.5 ns settling time and sub-2.0 mV differential balance offset under 250 fF bitline loading.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `eq_3t_schematic_sizing_report.pdf`
- [ ] `eq_3t_transient_montecarlo_results.csv`
- [ ] `eq_3t_folded_bitline_subcircuit.sp`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Maximum bitline equalization settling time (t_eq) to achieve |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2 mV from full rail separation** | `3.0 ns` | +0.5 ns / -0.8 ns | HSPICE transient corner simulation across FF, TT, SS corners at -40°C, 27°C, 125°C with C_BL = 250 fF |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Worst-case steady-state post-equalization midpoint bias voltage deviation from ideal VDD/2 (0.900V)** | `0.900 V` | +/- 15.0 mV | Transient terminal probe measurement at t = 6.0 ns with nominal VBLP = 0.900V |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Three-sigma shutoff differential offset voltage induced by clock feedthrough and channel charge injection mismatch** | `3.2 mV` | <= 5.0 mV max | 2000-point Monte Carlo mismatch and process transient simulation analysis (.mc 2000) |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Full schematic SPICE simulation validation achieving zero assertion violations across all PVT corners, signed off by lead circuit designer and systems engineer, with transistor gate width pitch confirmed compliant with array bitline pitch constraints.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Equalization Transient Simulation and Precharge Timing Verification

**Discipline / Category**: Circuit Design  
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Optical Inspection / Profilometer.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Bitline precharge/equalization timing (t_RP) directly dictates random cycle latency (t_RC). In a 180nm folded bitline architecture operating at VDD = 1.8V with VBL = VDD/2 = 0.9V, any residual differential skew Delta_V_BL between BL and /BL prior to wordline activation degrades sensing margin Delta_V_sense = (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) * (V_cell - VBL). If equalization is terminated prematurely, differential offset voltages exceeding 5 mV cause false latching during subsequent sense amplifier strobing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The three-transistor equalizer must balance equalization speed against gate-drain capacitive feedthrough. The bridging NMOS pass transistor shunts BL and /BL directly, while the two precharge NMOS devices clamp each line to VBL (0.9V). Because VBL is 0.9V and V_thn is ~0.55V, driving EQ high to 1.8V provides an effective V_GS - V_thn of only ~0.35V in linear clamp mode, severely limiting transconductance. Sizing must guarantee ON-resistance R_eq < 450 ohms across worst-case SS/0.9*VDD/125C corners without excessive gate capacitance loading the EQ driver.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Simulated device models must strictly adhere to the foundry-validated Open-Source 180nm PDK (e.g. SCL/SkyWater 180nm) device parameters (NMOS target V_thn = 0.55V +/- 50 mV, PMOS V_thp = -0.60V +/- 50 mV, tox = 4.1 nm). Sourcing multi-project wafer (MPW) runs requires verification against statistical Monte Carlo mismatch cards to avoid uncalibrated corner deviations that delay physical tapeout windows.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transient simulation signoff for the 3-T equalizer schematic must be completed and frozen prior to cell-array pitch-matched layout routing. Delays in validating the precharge recovery window (< 4.5 ns under 250 fF bitline parasitic capacitance) directly block the Sense Amplifier Layout Freeze milestone and risk missing the targeted quarterly foundry MPW shuttle run.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete Bitline Equalization Residual Skew: Bitline differential voltage |V_BL - V_/BL| exceeds 5 mV after t_RP precharge pulse due to insufficient R_eq conductance at slow-slow (SS) 125C corner, resulting in read bit-inversion during latch activation.
1. Equalization Gate Feedthrough Dynamic Offset: Asymmetrical capacitive coupling (C_gd mismatch) from the high-to-low transition of the EQ control line into BL vs. /BL induces a systematic differential voltage pedestal Delta_V > 10 mV, overwhelming the ~100-150 mV cell read signal.
1. VBL Supply Rail Bouncing and Collapse: High-concurrency precharge current surges across 1024 sense amplifier blocks simultaneously pulling BL or /BL to 0.9V induce inductive/IR droop on the on-chip VBL generator rail, extending equalization recovery time beyond specification.

Assert EQ control signal with 10% to 90% rise time of 200 ps from 0V to VDD at t = 2.0 ns. 2. Execute transient simulation from t = 0 to t = 10.0 ns with max timestep <= 1 ps. 3. Measure differential bitline voltage |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at t = 2.0 ns + 3.5 ns (t = 5.5 ns). 4. Measure common-mode voltage offset |((V(BL) + V(/BL))/2) - 0.900V| at t = 5.5 ns. 5. Repeat across TT (1.80V, 27C) and FF (1.98V, -40C) corners, and run 500-iteration Monte Carlo mismatch analysis. | `Differential residual voltage |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV at t_settle = 3.5 ns post-EQ assertion across all PVT corners. Absolute common-mode deviation from VDD/2 (0.9V) <= 15.0 mV. 3-sigma Monte Carlo residual differential skew <= 4.5 mV.` |

Ramp EQ control signal down from VDD to 0.0V with fall time t_f = 250 ps starting at t = 5.0 ns. 2. Monitor dynamic transient voltage coupling on node BL and node /BL from t = 4.8 ns to t = 8.0 ns. 3. Peak differential feedthrough offset Delta_V_feedthrough = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 3.0 mV (<= 5.0 mV at 3-sigma Monte Carlo limit) after EQ is deasserted to 0V.` |

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles, Cleanroom-compatible double nitrile protective gloves (minimum 6 mil thickness), Static-dissipative ESD/cleanroom lab coat, Full closed-toe ESD dissipative cleanroom shoes

Skin contact: Wash affected area thoroughly with mild soap and water; remove contaminated garments. Inhalation of nitrogen gas / oxygen displacement: Immediately evacuate personnel to fresh air; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored; initiate CPR if breathing halts.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Laboratory test benches and optical probing stations must operate under certified cleanroom laminar flow hoods maintaining continuous air exchange rate >= 30 ACH. Solvent cleaning benches require chemical fume extraction with certified face velocity between 80 and 100 FPM (0.4 - 0.5 m/s).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Equalizer Residual Offset Metrology and PVT Corner Sensitivity Characterization
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-MET-180NM-EQ01`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Technology Class:** Open-Source DRAM Architecture  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Pre-Test Chamber    │
│  Setup & Thermocouple  │
│          Cal           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Three-Transistor    │
│  Equalizer Precharge   │
│     Initialization     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Bitline Residual    │
│  Differential Offset   │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Corner PVT    │
│      Sweep Matrix      │
│       Execution        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Statistical Mismatch  │
│     & Latch Margin     │
│       Evaluation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Environment & Chamber Conditioning:**
   - Mount the test coupon / wafer on the thermal chuck. Connect high-bandwidth active pico-probes to complementary bitline sense nodes ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) before wordline assertion.
   - Stabilize the chuck at room temperature ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) under dry $\text{N}_2$ purge before initiating electrical characterization.

2. **Equilibration Baseline & Precharge Cycling:**
   - Pulse the three-transistor equalization gate control ($EQ$) to bias both complementary bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$ (mid-rail precharge).
   - Verify that the precharge driver drives bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ symmetrically on both arms.
   - De-assert $EQ$ and capture the floating steady-state bitline voltages $V_{BL}$ and $V_{\overline{BL}}$ across a high-impedance ($> 10\text{ T}\Omega$) acquisition buffer prior to access transistor turn-on.

3. **Residual Voltage Offset Acquisition:**
   - Measure the residual differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V_{offset} = |V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}|$$
   - Perform $N = 10{,}000$ cycles per bitline pair to separate systematic threshold mismatch ($\Delta V_{th}$) from clock-feedthrough and charge-injection asymmetries caused by the equalization transistor gates ($W/L = 220\text{ nm} / 180\text{ nm}$).

4. **Multi-Corner PVT Matrix Characterization:**
   - **Process Corner Verification:** Sample dice across slow-slow (SS), typical-typical (TT), and fast-fast (FF) wafer splits.
   - **Voltage Sensitivity:** Step core $V_{DD}$ across $\pm 10\%$ operational boundaries.
   - **Temperature Sensitivity:** Ramp thermal chuck to the extreme specification limit of $85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate channel sub-threshold leakage, gate oxide leakage (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ equivalent), and junction leakage on the precharged node.

5. **Signal Margin Integrity Verification:**
   - Trigger access transistor readout dumping storage cell charge ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ stack capacitor) onto $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Ensure residual offset $\Delta V_{offset}$ does not degrade developing readout differential $\Delta V$ below sensing latch margin.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics (PVT Characterization)

               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
Retention t_ret┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░                   │
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Delta V Sense┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Equ Time t_EQ┤▓▓                                     │
               │▓▓                                     │
    Offset V_os┤███                                    │
               │███                                    │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      31.2     62.5      93.8   125.0 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Lower Limit | Target | Upper Limit | Unit | Verification Tool / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Offset Voltage ($\Delta V_{offset}$)** | $0.0$ | $\le 5.0$ | $15.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Automated Mixed-Signal ATE / High-Z probe across all PVT corners |
| **Bitline Readout Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0$ | $125.0$ | $150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Oscilloscopic differential sense probe ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$) |
| **Bitline Cell Leakage at High Temperature** | — | $\le 0.5$ | $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | SMU current integration @ $85^\circ\text{C}$ chuck temperature |
| **Retention Time ($t_{ret}$)** | $64.0$ | $> 128.0$ | — | $\text{ms}$ | Memory pattern pause test @ $85^\circ\text{C}$ operating condition |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]:**  
  *Context applied:* Complementary bitlines $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ precharged to $V_{DD}/2$; cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ developing readout differential signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ across the cross-coupled inverter latch.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:**  
  *Context applied:* Transistor channel geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; minimum stacked capacitor capacitance budget $28\text{ fF}$ per cell; junction and sub-threshold leakage threshold $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**  
  *Context applied:* Storage capacitance target of $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; 180nm dry oxidation gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Residual offset between bitline (BL) and bitline-bar (/BL) after VDD/2 equalization directly erodes the sensing margin. At 180nm node operating with VDD = 1.8V, VBL_EQ is nominally 0.900V. Any systematic or random residual voltage offset Delta_V_EQ exceeding 5mV severely degrades read reliability, leading to false latch decisions during signal development where the cell signal Delta_V_cell is typically only 100mV to 150mV across a 250fF bitline capacitance.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The three-transistor bitline equalizer topology incorporates a bridging equalizer transistor (MN_EQ) and two pull-up/pull-down tracking switches connected to the half-VDD bias generator (VBLP). Non-quasi-static channel charge injection and capacitive clock feedthrough via gate-to-source/drain overlap capacitance (Cgd, Cgs) during the high-to-low transition of EQ generate asymmetrical residual differential offsets if source/drain diffusion contacts exhibit asymmetric sheet resistance or contact resistivity (rho_c > 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2). Metrology must resolve sub-millivolt offsets across full PVT corners (-40°C to 125°C, 1.62V to 1.98V, and TT/FF/SS/FS/SF process corners).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Parametric test equipment for high-precision sub-millivolt differential sensing at high wafer temperatures requires specialized probe cards with tungsten-rhenium (WRe) needle tips to minimize thermal emf drift and Kelvin contact resistance errors. Lead times for custom heated chuck environmental probe assemblies (e.g., FormFactor/MPI thermal chucks rated up to 125°C) exceed 16 weeks; test socket parasitics must not exceed 2pF BL-to-BL mismatch to avoid corrupting picosecond-scale transient equalization measurements.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Execution timeline requires tape-out signoff in Q3; test plan characterization on wafer-level test structures (e.g., kerf test arrays) must be completed within 10 operational shifts. Probe card wear and tip reconditioning schedules must be aligned with high-temperature stress cycles to prevent false yield alarms on equalizer mismatch.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Clock feedthrough-induced differential BL-/BL offset exceeding 8mV due to gate-drain/gate-source overlap capacitance asymmetry in the 3-transistor equalizer layout under fast EQ signal slew rates (>1.5V/ns).
1. Threshold voltage (Vth) mismatch between the two half-VDD precharge pass gates causing asymmetric leakage under extreme slow-fast (SF) corner and 125°C, shifting quiescent VBLP beyond the ±15mV stability window.
1. Parasitic series resistance imbalance at the bitline equalizer contact vias (rho_c > 5.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2) causing differential RC settling delay differentials >250ps during the precharge phase.

critics.systems_engineer: Residual offset between bitline (BL) and bitline-bar (/BL) after VDD/2 equalization directly erodes the sensing margin. At 180nm node operating with VDD = 1.8V, VBL_EQ is nominally 0.900V. Any systematic or random residual voltage offset Delta_V_EQ exceeding 5mV severely degrades read reliability, leading to false latch decisions during signal development where the cell signal Delta_V_cell is typically only 100mV to 150mV across a 250fF bitline capacitance.
critics.domain_expert: The three-transistor bitline equalizer topology incorporates a bridging equalizer transistor (MN_EQ) and two pull-up/pull-down tracking switches connected to the half-VDD bias generator (VBLP). Non-quasi-static channel charge injection and capacitive clock feedthrough via gate-to-source/drain overlap capacitance (Cgd, Cgs) during the high-to-low transition of EQ generate asymmetrical residual differential offsets if source/drain diffusion contacts exhibit asymmetric sheet resistance or contact resistivity (rho_c > 1.0e-6 Ohm*cm^2). Metrology must resolve sub-millivolt offsets across full PVT corners (-40°C to 125°C, 1.62V to 1.98V, and TT/FF/SS/FS/SF process corners).

Probe card wear and tip reconditioning schedules must be aligned with high-temperature stress cycles to prevent false yield alarms on equalizer mismatch.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Differential Sensing Margin & Equalization Recovery SPICE Transient Verification
**Context Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > CMOS Cross-Coupled Latch & $V_{DD}/2$ Equalizer Schematic Sizing > Differential Sensing Margin & Equalization Recovery SPICE Transient Verification  
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu$m / 180 nm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Equalization Phase:   │
│        EQ High,        │
│      BL=/BL=VDD/2      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     WL Assertion:      │
│      Boosted VPP       │
│       2.6V-2.8V        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Signal Development:   │
│  Charge Sharing Delta  │
│           V            │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  N-Sense Activation:   │
│   SAN Pulled to GND    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  P-Sense Activation:   │
│   SAP Pulled to VDD    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Equalization      │
│      Recovery: EQ      │
│        Asserted        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Verification Procedure

1. **Testbench & Netlist Setup**:
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitline pair ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) with nominal parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ (acceptable design window: $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$).
   - Connect a single 1T1C storage cell on $BL$ with storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ (ensuring capacitance ratio $C_{BL}/C_s$ is maintained between $5:1$ and $9:1$, and strictly below $10:1$).
   - Set supply rails to nominal $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, precharge reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$, and boosted wordline rail $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}\text{ to }2.8\text{ V}$.

2. **Phase 1: Bitline Equalization & Precharge Initialization**:
   - Drive the equalization signal $EQ$ high to turn on the equalization NMOS network, shorting $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ and clamping both nodes to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$.
   - Initialize the cell storage node to represent worst-case Data '0' ($V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$) and worst-case Data '1' ($V_{cell} = V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$).
   - Set common sense lines $SAN$ and $SAP$ to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$.

3. **Phase 2: Wordline Assertion & Charge Sharing**:
   - De-assert equalization ($EQ \to 0\text{ V}$).
   - Pulse Wordline ($WL$) from $0\text{ V}$ to boosted $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$) to overdrive the access gate without $V_{th}$ loss.
   - Measure the developed differential voltage $\Delta V = |V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}|$ resulting from charge redistribution:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$

4. **Phase 3: Regenerative Sensing & Full Rail Latching**:
   - Assert N-sense amplifier enable ($SAN$ pulled rapidly from $V_{DD}/2$ to $0\text{ V}$ / GND via pulldown NMOS).
   - After a staggered delay of $1\text{ ns}\text{ to }2\text{ ns}$, assert P-sense amplifier enable ($SAP$ pulled rapidly from $V_{DD}/2$ to $V_{DD}$ via pullup PMOS).
   - Verify regenerative amplification driving $BL$ and $\overline{BL}$ to full CMOS rail levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$).

5. **Phase 4: Equalization Recovery Verification**:
   - De-assert Wordline ($WL \to 0\text{ V}$) to isolate the restored cell.
   - Return $SAN$ and $SAP$ drivers to high impedance / tri-state, then re-assert $EQ$ high.
   - Measure equalization recovery time $t_{EQ}$ required for $|V_{BL} - V_{\overline{BL}}|$ to collapse back to $< 5\text{ mV}$ around $V_{DD}/2$.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Target Metric | Parameter | Acceptance Limit | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | Developed bitline voltage prior to latching | $\ge 100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Capacitance Budget Ratio ($C_{BL}/C_s$)** | Ratio of bitline capacitance to cell capacitance | $5.0:1 \le \text{Ratio} \le 9.0:1$ ($< 10.0:1$) | Dimensionless |
| **Sense Activation Stagger Delay ($t_{delay}$)** | Inter-sense timing between $SAN$ fall and $SAP$ rise | $1.0\text{ to }2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |
| **Equalization Center Point ($V_{BL,EQ}$)** | Equilibrated bitline voltage after recovery | $0.90 \pm 0.02$ ($V_{DD}/2 \pm 20\text{ mV}$) | $\text{V}$ |

---

### Literature Citations & Traceability
- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, folded-bitline topology, $V_{DD}/2$ equalization, differential signal formulation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, and developed signal target ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).
- **[Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration]**: Equalization phase timing with precision reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$, wordline overdrive pulse $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V to }2.8\text{ V}$, sequential $SAN$ pull-down followed by $1\text{ to }2\text{ ns}$ delayed $SAP$ pull-up.
- **[1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets]**: 180nm folded bitline area ($8F^2 = 0.259\,\mu\text{m}^2$), cell capacitance range ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to }30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$), array bitline parasitics ($C_b = 150\text{ fF to }250\text{ fF}$), and capacitance budget bounds ($5:1 \le C_b/C_s \le 9:1$, degradation ceiling $< 10:1$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: From an architectural perspective, the 180nm folded bitline sense amplifier requires strict transient timing synchronization between the wordline de-assertion, sense strobe signals (SAN/SAP), and the bitline equalization trigger (EQ). Sizing must account for power-grid IR drops across the dense memory array; if transient current during simultaneous latching of 512 sense amplifiers pulls VDD down or pushes GND up by more than 80 mV, the effective differential sensing margin ΔV collapses, increasing cycle-to-cycle sensing latency and causing write-back restoration failures.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: With target C_s = 25 fF and C_BL = 250 fF, the theoretical charge-sharing signal margin ΔV is merely 136 mV at VDD = 1.8V (VDD/2 = 0.9V). At the 180nm node (0.36 µm pitch), threshold voltage mismatch (ΔVth) due to Pelgrom's scaling in the cross-coupled pair can easily exceed 25–35 mV across 3-sigma process corners. If the equalization circuit fails to reset BL and /BL to within ±5 mV of VDD/2, residual historical charge causes catastrophic bit-flipping during read '0' or read '1' evaluation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source 180nm bulk CMOS wafer foundry lines exhibit significant lot-to-lot oxide thickness (Tox) and implant variations. Device models must be constrained to standard commercial PDK device tiers without requiring exotic thin-oxide options. Overdesigning sense amplifier transistor active areas to beat Pelgrom mismatch directly consumes silicon real estate and reduces net good die per 200mm wafer, severely threatening target open-source cost structures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier pitch matching dictates an interleaved physical layout constrained to 720 nm across dual pitches in 180nm lithography. Layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX) corner simulations must close timing before the tapeout freeze milestone. Schematics sized in SPICE without direct consideration of layout parasitic capacitance (C_poly and C_metal1 to substrate) will fail transient closure during post-layout validation, introducing unacceptable multi-week tapeout delays.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Incomplete equalization residual offset (>10 mV) prior to wordline firing causing wrong-state latching.
1. Threshold voltage (Vth) mismatch in NMOS cross-coupled pair exceeding charge-sharing developed margin ΔV.
1. Ground bounce and substrate injection during SAN pull-down causing coupled adjacent bitline flip.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-01` | **Differential Sensing Margin & Latch Resolution Time Across PVT Corners** | ngspice / Cadence Spectre SPICE transient analysis engine with 180nm BSIM4 PDK models, parameterized Monte Carlo mismatch generator, and 10 fs internal timestep resolution. | 1. Assert Wordline (WL) to 2.4V (boosted) at t = 5.0 ns. 2. Allow charge sharing signal development across BL and /BL for 3.0 ns. 3. Measure developed differential voltage ΔV at t = 7.9 ns immediately before strobe. 4. Strobe SAN to 0V and SAP to 1.8V at t = 8.0 ns with 500 ps slew. 5. Record transient voltage trajectories of BL and /BL until rails reach 90% (1.62 V) and 10% (0.18 V). 6. Repeat for 1000-run Monte Carlo mismatch distribution across TT, FF, SS, FS, SF corners. | `Developed differential voltage |ΔV| >= 100 mV across all PVT corners. Latch resolution time from strobe activation (t = 8.0 ns) to 90%/10% rail separation must be <= 2.2 ns. Zero bit-flip failures allowed over 1000 Monte Carlo runs.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-02` | **Equalization Recovery Time & Precharge Voltage Centering Verification** | SPICE transient simulator with dynamic energy integration meter and high-precision differential node probes. | 1. Deactivate SAN and SAP to high-impedance state at t = 15.0 ns. 2. Assert Equalization signal (EQ) to 1.8 V with 200 ps rise time at t = 15.5 ns. 3. Monitor discharge of BL and charging of /BL toward VDD/2 (900 mV). 4. Measure time required for |V(BL) - V(/BL)| to drop below 5 mV. 5. Record steady-state equalized voltage offset relative to ideal VDD/2 (0.900 V). | `Equalization settling time (|V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 5 mV) must be <= 2.5 ns. Absolute offset |V_equalized - (VDD/2)| must remain <= 8 mV under worst-case asymmetric parasitic loading.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloving protocol), ANSI Z87.1 approved chemical splash goggles, Antistatic flame-resistant cleanroom smock, Closed-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with HF: Immediately flush with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then massage 2.5% calcium gluconate gel continuously into affected area until medical personnel arrive. | `ASSERT-02` | **Bitline latch resolution latency from strobe edge to 90% rail restoration** | `1.80 ns` | +/- 0.40 ns | Transient delay calculation between 50% SAN/SAP trigger and 90% VDD output rail crossing |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

critics.systems_engineer: From an architectural perspective, the 180nm folded bitline sense amplifier requires strict transient timing synchronization between the wordline de-assertion, sense strobe signals (SAN/SAP), and the bitline equalization trigger (EQ). Sizing must account for power-grid IR drops across the dense memory array; if transient current during simultaneous latching of 512 sense amplifiers pulls VDD down or pushes GND up by more than 80 mV, the effective differential sensing margin ΔV collapses, increasing cycle-to-cycle sensing latency and causing write-back restoration failures.
critics.domain_expert: With target C_s = 25 fF and C_BL = 250 fF, the theoretical charge-sharing signal margin ΔV is merely 136 mV at VDD = 1.8V (VDD/2 = 0.9V). At the 180nm node (0.36 µm pitch), threshold voltage mismatch (ΔVth) due to Pelgrom's scaling in the cross-coupled pair can easily exceed 25–35 mV across 3-sigma process corners. If the equalization circuit fails to reset BL and /BL to within ±5 mV of VDD/2, residual historical charge causes catastrophic bit-flipping during read '0' or read '1' evaluation.
critics.supply_chain: Open-source 180nm bulk CMOS wafer foundry lines exhibit significant lot-to-lot oxide thickness (Tox) and implant variations. Device models must be constrained to standard commercial PDK device tiers without requiring exotic thin-oxide options. Overdesigning sense amplifier transistor active areas to beat Pelgrom mismatch directly consumes silicon real estate and reduces net good die per 200mm wafer, severely threatening target open-source cost structures.
critics.laya_pm: Sense amplifier pitch matching dictates an interleaved physical layout constrained to 720 nm across dual pitches in 180nm lithography. Layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX) corner simulations must close timing before the tapeout freeze milestone. Schematics sized in SPICE without direct consideration of layout parasitic capacitance (C_poly and C_metal1 to substrate) will fail transient closure during post-layout validation, introducing unacceptable multi-week tapeout delays.
critical_failure_modes: Incomplete equalization residual offset (>10 mV) prior to wordline firing causing wrong-state latching.
Threshold voltage (Vth) mismatch in NMOS cross-coupled pair exceeding charge-sharing developed margin ΔV.
Ground bounce and substrate injection during SAN pull-down causing coupled adjacent bitline flip.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-042: Testbench Setup & Worst-Case Bitline/Cell Parasitic Load Modeling

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│      Testbench      │
│   Initialization    │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Bitline Parasitic  │
│       Loading       │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  1T1C Memory Cell   │
│     Attachment      │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Precharge and WL   │
│       Pulsing       │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│  Transient Margin   │
│     Extraction      │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the setup, netlisting, and transient verification of folded-bitline SPICE testbenches under worst-case parasitic loading for the 180nm open-source DRAM architecture (DRAM Foundation VN). It guarantees accurate simulation of charge sharing, equalization recovery, and differential sensing margins before physical layout tape-out.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Testbench Architecture Initialization**:
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitlines (`BL` and `/BL`) alongside the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch and $V_{DD}/2$ equalization transistor network.
   - Configure thermal simulation environment at nominal elevated temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate worst-case leakage conditions.

2. **Worst-Case Bitline Parasitic Network Insertion**:
   - Model the full-column parasitic capacitance along both `BL` and `/BL` by connecting lumped/distributed capacitive elements sized to total bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Include adjacent wire-to-wire coupling and contact parasitics corresponding to the $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch.

3. **1T1C Memory Cell Parametric Instantiation**:
   - Instantiate the unit cell access transistor at channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with gate oxide physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the storage node to the stacked capacitor model configured with storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (nominal evaluation) and $28\text{ fF}$ (minimum noise-immunity corner).
   - Set cell leakage current limiters ensuring junction and sub-threshold leakage remain $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

4. **Precharge & Timing Sequence Execution**:
   - Assert the equalization signal to precharge and equilibrate both `BL` and `/BL` exactly to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - De-assert equalization, introduce settling dead-time, and apply Wordline (WL) pulse to activate the access transistor, transferring stored charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto `BL`.

5. **Transient Differential Margin Extraction**:
   - Measure the developed differential bitline voltage $\Delta V$ immediately prior to sense amplifier activation:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Activate latching strobes (`SAN` pull-down and `SAP` pull-up) and verify full rail-to-rail differential signal restoration without latch failure or meta-stability.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition / Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | `250` | $\text{fF}$ | Total column parasitic load per bitline branch |
| **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `25 to 28` | $\text{fF}$ | Minimum budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | `100 to 150` | $\text{mV}$ | Signal development after charge-sharing on $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current** | $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum junction/sub-threshold leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($> 64\text{ ms}$ retention) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Governs the folded-bitline topology, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge scheme, charge transfer equation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$, nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and signal margin $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Dictates access transistor sizing ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and junction/sub-threshold leakage limit $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ storage requirement for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate oxide thickness $t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$, and bitline/wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Testbench Setup & Worst-Case Bitline/Cell Parasitic Load Modeling: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).

```text
│  Wordline Deassertion  │
│     & Equalization     │
│        Recovery        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Schematic & Parasitic Netlist Setup:**
   - Instantiate the 1T1C cell with access transistor geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the access transistor drain to the storage node capacitor $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (or minimum capacitance budget $28\text{ fF}$) implemented as a stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
   - Configure complementary folded bitlines $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ with distributed lumped parasitic load $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Enforce layout pitch matching constraint to the memory array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ with interleaved sense amplifier placement.

2. **Precharge & DC Initialization Phase:**
   - Enable the equalization transistor network to precharge and equilibrate both bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$) to exactly $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Initialize cell storage voltage: condition $V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$ (Data '1') and $V_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$ (Data '0'). Set initial simulation temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ to capture sub-threshold leakage effects.

3. **Wordline Assertion & Signal Development ($\Delta V$):**
   - De-assert the equalization signal to isolate $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$.
   - Assert the wordline ($\text{WL}$) pulse driving the access transistor ON, discharging/charging cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto the bitline.
   - Run transient analysis (`.tran`) and measure open-loop differential signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$$

4. **Sense Amplifier Strobe & Full-Rail Latching:**
   - Trigger the sense amplifier control clocks: pull the N-sense latch strobe ($\text{SAN}$) to $\text{GND}$ and the P-sense latch strobe ($\text{SAP}$) to $V_{DD}$.
   - Verify differential latching speed and signal resolution driving bitlines to full rail CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$).
   - Measure 100% cell charge restoration before closing the access transistor.

5. **Wordline Deassertion & Equalization Recovery:**
   - De-assert wordline ($\text{WL}$) back to $0\text{ V}$.
   - Re-activate the equalization transistor network across $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$.
   - Measure equalization recovery time $t_{\text{EQR}}$ for $\text{BL}$ and $\text{/BL}$ to converge back to $V_{DD}/2$ within steady-state error tolerance.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
               DRAM 180nm Sense Amp & Bitline Parameters
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    Pitch Match┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
    Delta V_sig┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
C_bitline (CBL)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓            │
    C_cell (Cs)┤████                                   │
```

| **Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | SPICE `.MEAS` differential peak voltage $(\vert V_{BL} - V_{/BL}\vert)$ at end of charge sharing |
| **Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget** | **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$** (nominal $25\text{ fF}$) | Soft error immunity / noise budget verification |
| **Total Cell Leakage Current** | **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** | Sub-threshold & junction leakage under $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **$360\text{ nm}$** | Interleaved layout DRC spacing matching memory array bitlines |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations
- **Source 1: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout***
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; charge sharing model $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ with $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$; nominal $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$; latching via $\text{SAN} \to \text{GND}$ and $\text{SAP} \to V_{DD}$ to full rail ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$); pitch matching constraint of $360\text{ nm}$.
- **Source 2: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***
  - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture; minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$; maximum leakage current limit $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

*Micro-knowledge record persisted to [transient_spice_signal_development_sop.md](docs/knowledge/transient_spice_signal_development_sop.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The bitline parasitic extraction netlist must incorporate explicit 3D interconnect coupling capacitances (C_BL-to-BL, C_BL-to-Substrate) reflecting the 360 nm interleaved folded layout pitch in the 180nm CMOS node. Neglecting adjacent line inter-wire capacitance in the transient SPICE deck leads to an overly optimistic estimate of differential signal development (delta V_BL) and masks pattern-dependent crosstalk during wordline activation and sensing amplification phases.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Signal development margin (delta V_BL = (C_cell / (C_cell + C_BL)) * (V_cell - V_BL_precharge)) must be evaluated under worst-case 180nm foundry corners (SS/FS/SF/FF) at 1.8V nominal VDD, operating across -40°C to +125°C. Sense amplifier latch activation strobe timings (SAN pulling to GND, SAP pulling to VDD) require a precisely sized multi-stage delay line to avoid premature regenerative latching prior to achieving >= 120 mV differential signal, which prevents destructive read flipping.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Model parameters must strictly align with open-source/commercial PDK transistor SPICE BSIM4 model cards for foundry-qualified 180nm mixed-signal DRAM peripheral and array devices. Utilizing uncalibrated or generic transistor models will cause severe threshold voltage (Vth) mismatch discrepancies and drive costly post-silicon physical re-spins due to unrecovered bitline offsets during multi-wafer manufacturing.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The verification suite must deliver reproducible SPICE decks, Monte Carlo mismatch distributions (>= 1,000 runs for Vth/W/L intra-die variation), and fully automated waveform metric extraction scripts without blocking downstream column decoder layout freeze deadlines; all simulation artifacts must adhere strictly to repository milestone sign-off criteria.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier decision inversion resulting from excessive threshold voltage mismatch (delta Vth) in the cross-coupled NMOS/PMOS regenerative latch exceeding the pre-sensing differential signal margin (delta V_BL < 80 mV).
1. Incomplete bitline precharge and equalization recovery (V_BL != V_BL_bar != VDD/2 within nominal timing budget), yielding residual charge offsets that cause systematic read errors on subsequent memory cycles.
1. Destructive read corruption caused by premature column select line (CSL) activation or slow PMOS pull-up (SAP) restoration, leaving the storage capacitor incompletely restored (< 95% of nominal VDD) prior to wordline de-assertion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |

Assert Wordline (WL) to 2.4V (boosted VPP) at t = 5.0 ns with 0.5 ns rise time to initiate charge sharing for a stored Logic 0 (V_cell = 0V). 2. Measure passive differential signal delta V_BL = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| across t = 5.5 ns to t = 9.0 ns. 3. Assert SAN (pull to GND) at t = 9.0 ns and SAP (pull to VDD) at t = 9.5 ns to trigger regenerative latching. 4. Measure transient time t_sense required for differential voltage to reach 90% of rail-to-rail levels (|V(BL) - V(/BL)| >= 1.62 V). 5. Measure restored voltage across C_cell at t = 20.0 ns prior to WL de-assertion. | `Passive differential voltage delta V_BL prior to sensing >= 120 mV; full rail amplification time t_sense <= 4.5 ns from SAN assertion; cell restoration voltage <= 0.05 V for Logic 0 and >= 1.72 V (>= 95.5% VDD) for Logic 1 across all process corners.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-2-02` | **Bitline Equalization and VDD/2 Precharge Recovery Transient Margin** | Transient SPICE Simulator with dynamic operating point tracker and transient power/voltage differential probes across bitline pair nodes. | 1. De-assert sensing control signals (SAN floating/precharged to VDD/2, SAP floating/precharged to VDD/2) at t = 10.0 ns. 2. Assert Equalize signal (EQ) to 1.8V with 0.4 ns rise time at t = 11.0 ns. 3. Monitor transient trajectories of V(BL) and V(/BL), and measure recovery settling time t_rec until |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV. 4. Measure the steady-state equalized voltage offset relative to ideal VDD/2 (0.900 V) at t = 20.0 ns. | `Settling recovery time t_rec <= 3.2 ns following EQ assertion; steady-state bitline voltage V_eq within 0.900 V +/- 15 mV; differential residue |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV at t = 15.0 ns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard Cleanroom/Laboratory Class 100 Nitrile Gloves, ANSI Z87.1 Approved UV/Laser Radiation Safety Glasses, ESD Dissipative Lab Coat and Grounding Wrist Strap
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For solvent inhalation: Evacuate individual to fresh uncontaminated air. For eye contact: Flush thoroughly with eyewash station water for minimum 15 minutes. For skin contact: Wash affected region with mild soap and copious amounts of water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard computational hardware and electronic characterization station with minimum 8 air changes per hour (ACH) and local exhaust ventilation over solvent cleaning benches.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent electronic cleaning solvents in designated closed, grounded flammable solvent waste carboys; dispose via certified hazardous material chemical recycling contractor in compliance with local environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (Electronics Cleaning Solvent)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/MOS Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Compressed Nitrogen (Workstation Inert Gas)** | `7727-37-9` | Ultra-High Purity (UHP) Grade 5.0 | `99.999%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-simulation physical design database with clean DRC/LVS sign-off and extracted parasitic RC netlists (SPEF/DSPF) stored under revision-controlled environment.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Verified transient simulation data decks, extracted timing/margin tables, and updated layout constraints pushed to central repository.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Netlist stale branching and synchronization drift between circuit schematic revisions and physical cell layout pitch matching, causing obsolete parasitic parameters to invalidate simulation results.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full transient SPICE verification report demonstrating robust bitline differential signal development, rapid regenerative sensing restoration (>= 95% full-rail cell charge), and fast equalization recovery (<= 3.2 ns) across all PVT corners and 1,000-point Monte Carlo mismatch distributions for 180nm folded bitline sense amplifiers.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `folded_sense_amp_transient_pvt_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `sense_amp_signal_development_equalization_report.pdf`
- [ ] `folded_bitline_sensing_monte_carlo_distribution.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Pre-sensing differential bitline voltage margin (delta V_BL) prior to latch strobe** | `145 mV` | +/- 25 mV (Minimum >= 120 mV across all PVT corners) | Transient SPICE voltage difference measurement between BL and /BL at t = 9.0 ns (prior to SAN strobe) with 250 fF bitline parasitic load. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Equalization recovery time to reach balanced VDD/2 precharge** | `2.5 ns` | +0.7 ns / -0.5 ns (Maximum allowable <= 3.2 ns) | Transient measure script calculating elapsed time from EQ assertion (50% VDD) to |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Storage node cell voltage charge restoration completeness** | `98.5%` | +1.5% / -3.0% (Minimum >= 95.5% of nominal 1.8V VDD) | Analog node voltage measurement at internal cell capacitor plate at t = 20.0 ns prior to WL turn-off. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Unanimous sign-off achieved when all PVT corner simulations (SS, TT, FF at -40°C, 27°C, 125°C, VDD = 1.8V +/- 10%) and 1,000 Monte Carlo statistical mismatch trials confirm delta V_BL >= 120 mV, t_rec <= 3.2 ns, cell restoration >= 95.5%, and zero latch decision flips.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Mismatch Sensing Margin Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-MET-004`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & Metrology / Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│      Step 1: Setup 180nm Parasitics          │
│        (Cs = 25-28 fF, CBL = 250 fF)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 2: Bitline Precharge/Equalization   │
│                 (V_BL = VDD/2)               │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 3: WL Assertion & Signal Readout    │
│            (Access L=180nm, W=220nm)         │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│     Step 4: Differential Sense & Latch       │
│           (Activate SAN/SAP Clocks)          │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                              │
│    Step 5: PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Sweep    │
│     (-40°C to 85°C, Vth/W/L Mismatch Runs)   │
│                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Initialization**:
   - Construct the folded-bitline SPICE testbench with complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Instantiate the 1T1C stacked storage capacitor with nominal capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$ and total bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Size the unit access transistor using nominal 180nm parameters: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}\text{ SiO}_2$.

2. **Precharge & Equalization Stabilization**:
   - Apply bitline equalization clock signal ($EQ$) to bias both complementary bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Verify differential bitline offset before wordline firing is settled to zero ($|V_{BL} - V_{/BL}| \approx 0\text{ mV}$).

3. **Wordline Assertion & Differential Signal Development**:
   - De-assert equalization ($EQ \to \text{GND}$) and assert the wordline ($WL$).
   - Execute cell charge transfer onto $BL$ based on $Q_s = C_s \times (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$.
   - Measure developed signal $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \times |V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2|$ immediately prior to sense amplifier latch activation.

4. **Latch Activation & Transient Latching**:
   - Assert sense amplifier strobe signals: trigger pull-down sense strobe $SAN$ toward GND and pull-up sense strobe $SAP$ toward $V_{DD}$.
   - Record differential resolution time and verify full rail-to-rail latching without state inversion.

5. **PVT Corner & Monte Carlo Statistical Sweep**:
   - Execute transient simulations across process corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) and operational temperatures spanning $-40^\circ\text{C}$ to $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Perform a 1,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch sweep incorporating $V_{th}$, channel length ($L$), and channel width ($W$) variations on the cross-coupled sense amplifier transistor pairs.
   - Extract the $3\sigma$ worst-case differential sensing margin $\Delta V$.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Measurement Condition | Specification Target | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | Stacked crown/cylinder capacitor metrology | $25.0 \le C_s \le 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | Extracted folded-bitline wire & drain parasitics | $250.0 \pm 10\%$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | Nominal charge share prior to latching ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{DD}$) | $100.0 \le \Delta V \le 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target** | Storage node junction & subthreshold leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |
| **Data Retention Time Target** | Array cell retention window at $85^\circ\text{C}$ junction temp | $> 64.0$ | $\text{ms}$ |

---

### 4. Process Corner Margin Evaluation

```text
                Differential Sensing Margin Delta V (mV)
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
```
