```text
                 0.0     37.5     75.0     112.5  150.0 
```

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Reference Context

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, and signal development equation $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
  - Baseline nominal parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, resulting in $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ stacked capacitor over bitline (COB).
  - Cell leakage constraint: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - 1T1C architecture data retention specification: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Gate oxide dielectric thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}\text{ SiO}_2$ dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm open-source DRAM architecture with Gen 2 (micron-scale) lithography tolerances, threshold voltage mismatch (delta-Vth) and channel length variation in the cross-coupled inverter pairs directly reduce the effective differential sensing margin. At a cell capacitance of ~30 fF and bitline capacitance of ~200-300 fF, the initial signal delta-V is only 100-150 mV. If Pelgrom mismatch coefficients (Avth ~ 4-6 mV*um) yield an unmitigated 3-sigma offset exceeding 35 mV under worst-case slow-NMOS/fast-PMOS corners at 85 deg C, false latching and destructive read operations occur systematically.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Sensing margin metrology requires exact co-design of the VDD/2 equalizer and the sense amplifier cross-coupled latch. The differential sensing transient trajectory depends critically on the timing skew between equalization deassertion (EQ low) and the activation of the sense amplifier pull-down (SAN) and pull-up (SAP) strobes. The metrology suite must sweep full PVT envelopes (FF, SS, FS, SF, TT at 1.62V-1.98V, -40 deg C to 125 deg C) combined with 1,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch runs to ensure bitline separation rate (dV/dt) achieves 90% rail within 2.5 ns without kickback noise triggering adjacent column false flips.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Physical silicon verification of sense amplifier margins relies on wafer-level parametric test structures (scribeline Keithley 4200-SCS probe pads) and spectroscopic reflectometry/ellipsometry to track gate oxide thickness uniformity across 150mm/200mm wafers. Sourcing specialized probe needles (sub-50 um pitch) and certified calibration standards (NIST-traceable SiO2 reference wafers) introduces a 6-to-8 week procurement lead time that must be buffered before tapeout MPW runs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Metrology execution must align with the open-source silicon delivery schedule and compute budget. Executing comprehensive 1,000-point Monte Carlo sweeps across 45 PVT corner permutations in open-source SPICE (Ngspice / Xyce) creates a multi-hour simulation bottleneck per iteration. Clear pass/fail gating criteria and automated parsing scripts are required to prevent design blockages prior to post-layout extraction signoff.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic regenerative latch meta-stability caused by Vth offset exceeding differential bitline voltage (delta-V_BL < V_offset_3sigma), resulting in persistent read inversion errors.
1. Equalizer charge injection imbalance leading to systematic pre-charge bias away from exact VDD/2 (180nm nominal 0.90V), cutting single-ended sensing margin by >25 mV.
1. Coupling noise and parasitic routing asymmetry between BL and /BL causing asymmetric bitline capacitive discharge rates and mid-rail sensing stall.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-3-01` | **Monte Carlo Offset Voltage and Statistical Sensing Margin Extraction** | Xyce / Ngspice BSIM4 Monte Carlo Engine, Python SciPy automated waveform feature extractor, Keithley 4200A-SCS Semiconductor Characterization System (post-silicon correlation) | 1. Initialize bitlines to VDD/2 (0.900 V) via equalizer pulse of 5.0 ns duration. 2. Deassert EQ and assert wordline (WL) to transfer charge onto true bitline (BL). 3. Wait 1.2 ns for differential voltage development. 4. Trigger SAN pulldown and SAP pullup sensing strobes with a 150 ps staggered delay. 5. Run a 1,000-iteration Monte Carlo transient simulation applying statistical process variations (delvto, u0, tox) and Pelgrom mismatch models across TT, SS, FF, SF, and FS process corners. 6. Extract differential latching offset voltage distribution and calculate mean and standard deviation. | `3-sigma input-referred offset voltage must be <= 28.0 mV; minimum differential signal development delta-V_BL prior to strobe must be >= 65.0 mV across all Monte Carlo runs; zero false-latch read inversions observed across 1,000 iterations.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-1-3-3-02` | **PVT Corner Equalization Recovery and Charge Injection Metrology** | High-accuracy SPICE Transient Simulator (.TRAN step <= 10 ps), Automated PVT Grid Orchestrator, Keysight Infiniium 10 GHz Oscilloscope with active differential probes (post-silicon) | 1. Drive BL to 1.8V and /BL to 0.0V to emulate completed read/write cycle. 2. Deassert column select and assert EQ signal (high) to restore bitline levels. 3. Monitor transient trajectories of V(BL) and V(/BL) until convergence. 4. Measure t_eq (time to settle within ±2% of VDD/2). 5. Deassert EQ and measure steady-state residual differential voltage (delta-V_precharge = |V(BL) - V(/BL)|) caused by clock-feedthrough and channel charge injection asymmetry. | `Equalization recovery time t_eq <= 2.2 ns across all extreme PVT corners (worst-case SS, 1.62V, 125 deg C); residual post-equalization differential voltage delta-V_precharge <= 4.5 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles with side shields, Mil-spec 8 mil Nitrile cleanroom gloves (double gloving required during chemical handling), Anti-static dissipative ESD cleanroom lab coat / smock, Closed-toe ESD protective footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For TMAH/MF-319 contact: Immediately drench affected skin or eyes under safety shower/eyewash station with copious flowing water for a minimum of 15 minutes. TMAH penetrates skin rapidly and acts as a severe neurotoxin and alkali chemical burn agent; call emergency services immediately. For solvent inhalation (S1813/IPA): Remove victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: All wet-bench wafer processing, spin coating, and developing must be conducted in a dedicated ISO Class 5 laminar flow hood exhausting through a dedicated VOC/alkali scrubber system with face velocity maintained at 100 ± 10 LFPM.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Aqueous TMAH developer waste must be segregated into dedicated labeled alkali waste carboys and neutralized to pH 6-9 using dilute citric acid prior to certified hazardous waste disposal. Spent photoresist and IPA rinse solvents must be collected in grounded UN-rated flammable solvent containers; zero drain disposal permitted.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Microposit MF-319 Developer (Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide)** | `75-59-2` | Electronic / VLSI Grade | `2.2% aqueous` |
| **Shipley Microposit S1813 Positive Photoresist (Propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate based)** | `108-65-6` | Semiconductor Grade | `70-85% solvent carrier` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for Stage & Lens Cleaning** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (MOS) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Dry post-gate-etch wafer cleaned via piranha/SC1/SC2 sequence with native chemical oxide passivated surface (<0.3 nm roughness).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Stabilized gate stack with patterned poly-silicon runners sealed under conformal PECVD SiO2/Si3N4 cap, completely dry and room-temperature stabilized.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes uncontrolled airborne organic contamination and moisture chemisorption onto bare poly/gate edges, shifting gate oxide equivalent thickness (EOT) and causing >15 mV drift in NMOS/PMOS threshold mismatch.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete metrology and verification package validating folded bitline sense amplifier differential sensing margins and VDD/2 equalization recovery across full PVT corners and 1,000-run Monte Carlo mismatch distributions. The design demonstrates robust regenerative latching without read inversion down to delta-V_BL = 50 mV, satisfying all 180nm DRAM Gen 2 operational reliability goals.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_sense_amp_pvt_monte_carlo_report.pdf`
- [ ] `pvt_corner_mismatch_metrics_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `spectroscopic_gate_oxide_wafer_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Three-sigma input-referred latch offset voltage under Pelgrom mismatch model** | `24.5` | ±3.5 mV | 1,000-run Monte Carlo transient simulation using Xyce with BSIM4 mismatch parameters |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Equalizer recovery time t_eq to settle bitlines within 2% of VDD/2** | `1.85` | +0.35 ns, -0.20 ns | Corner transient analysis across 45 PVT corners (FF, SS, SF, FS, TT at 1.62-1.98V, -40 to 125 deg C) |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Differential sensing margin development speed dV/dt post-strobe** | `1.20` | ±0.15 V/ns | SPICE derivative transient measurement of (V(BL) - V(/BL)) between 10% and 90% rail transitions |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher signoff requires 100% of Monte Carlo runs (1,000/1,000) to complete with zero latching polarity inversion errors at worst-case SS corner (1.62V, 125 deg C) with 3-sigma offset <= 28.0 mV, accompanied by clean automated checksum signoff on the generated CSV metrics and PDF verification report.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation

**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm Open-Source CMOS DRAM)  
**Classification:** DRAM Circuit Design / Architecture & Integration  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Transient Sensing & Activation Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Equalization      │
│      V_BLP=V_DD/2      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline Assertion   │
│     V_PP=2.6V-2.8V     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Signal Development   │
│   Delta V=100-150mV    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     SAN Activation     │
│    Pulldown to GND     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SAP Activation Delay  │
│     1-2ns to V_DD      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Full Rail        │
│  Restoration & Latch   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Array & Parasitic Parameter Setup**:
   - Configure the 1T1C storage node cell capacitor with nominal capacitance $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (valid window: $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$) mapped onto an $8F^2$ folded bitline footprint ($\text{Area} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b$ (or $C_{BL}$) in the range of $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$ for a 256/512 cells-per-bitline sub-array block, enforcing a capacitance ratio $C_b / C_s$ strictly between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (never exceeding $10:1$).

2. **Phase 1 – Precharge & Equalization Phase (`EQ` High)**:
   - Assert equalization control signal `EQ` to activate the equalization NMOS transistor network.
   - Short complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ together and bias them to the precision precharge voltage reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Initialize sense amplifier common source nodes $SAN$ and $SAP$ to $V_{DD} / 2$.

3. **Phase 2 – Wordline Overdrive & Signal Development (`WL` Assertion)**:
   - De-assert `EQ` to high-impedance isolate $BL$ and $/BL$.
   - Assert wordline ($WL$) from $0\text{ V}$ to boosted overdrive voltage $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$) to overcome threshold voltage loss ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$) across the NMOS access transistor.
   - Allow charge sharing between cell storage node $C_s$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$, generating differential read signal:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     Verify that developed nominal differential signal $\Delta V$ reaches $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.

4. **Phase 3 – Staged Regenerative Sensing & Latching (`SAN` then `SAP`)**:
   - **N-Sense Activation**: Pull the common source node $SAN$ rapidly from $V_{DD} / 2$ to $\text{GND}$ via the NMOS pulldown switch. The NMOS transistor whose gate is connected to the higher bitline conducts harder, discharging the lower bitline toward $0\text{ V}$.
   - **P-Sense Activation**: After an intentional delay of $1\text{ ns}$ to $2\text{ ns}$ post-$SAN$ turn-on, assert the PMOS pullup switch to pull $SAP$ from $V_{DD} / 2$ to $V_{DD}$, amplifying the higher bitline toward full-rail $V_{DD}$.
   - Confirm active full-rail latching and non-destructive charge restoration into the storage cell.

5. **Phase 4 – Monte Carlo Statistical Mismatch Simulation**:
   - Execute transient Monte Carlo runs (Gaussian statistical transistor mismatch, $\Delta V_{th}$, and geometric variation across the cross-coupled inverter pairs).
   - Sweep corner temperatures and process spreads while logging differential sensing margin $\Delta V$, sensing delay, and latch yield under worst-case '0' and '1' readout states.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Description | Target Value / Boundary | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Differential Bitline Read Signal ($\Delta V$) | $100$ to $150$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **AC-02** | Capacitance Ratio Budget ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 \le \text{Ratio} \le 9.0 : 1$ ($< 10.0 : 1$ max) | Dimensionless ratio |
| **AC-03** | Boosted Wordline Voltage ($V_{PP}$) | $2.6$ to $2.8$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **AC-04** | Staged Sensing Activation Delay ($t_{SAN \to SAP}$) | $1.0$ to $2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |

---

### Verified Local Literature Sources

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Differential signal development: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right) \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}, C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - CMOS cross-coupled latch and equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$.
2. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Folded bitline $8F^2$ footprint ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Storage node capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ (nominal $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$, ratio $C_b / C_s$ between $5:1$ and $9:1$ (hard degradation ceiling at $10:1$).
3. **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
   - Wordline overdrive voltage $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$.
   - Precharge reference $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$.
   - Staged latching: $SAN$ pulled to $\text{GND}$ followed by $SAP$ pulled to $V_{DD}$ with a $1\text{ ns} - 2\text{ ns}$ delay.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline scheme, bitline capacitance C_BL (~250 fF) dominates signal development relative to cell storage capacitance C_s (~25 fF), generating an initial delta V of barely 136 mV at V_DD = 1.8 V. The latching dynamics of SAN (NMOS cross-coupled pull-down) and SAP (PMOS cross-coupled pull-up) must be precisely phase-separated; premature or overly aggressive SAN slew rates induce rail-bounce and parasitic coupling back through C_gd onto the floating reference bitline, eroding common-mode rejection and collapsing the dynamic sensing margin below 50 mV.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Pelgrom mismatch coefficients (A_Vth) in 180nm CMOS processes typically reach 5-7 mV*um. For sub-micron sensing transistors sized near W/L = 2.0 um / 0.18 um, local standard deviation sigma(V_th) exceeds 10-12 mV. In a 5000-point Monte Carlo run spanning global corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) and temperature extremes (-40°C to 125°C), the 3-sigma offset voltage of the cross-coupled pair directly eats into the ~100-150 mV signal development, creating severe bit-flip probabilities during 'read-1' and 'read-0' cycles if equalization to V_DD/2 is skewed by threshold variations.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Cadence Spectre / Synopsys HSPICE PDK mismatch models for open-source 180nm foundry nodes frequently omit high-temperature reverse bias (HTRB) thermal drift or substrate-noise injection from nearby peripheral charge pumps. Silicon validation through multi-project wafer (MPW) runs requires test-die inclusion of discrete sense-amplifier pairs with kelvin pads to correlate extracted Monte Carlo yield against physical fab yield without incurring multi-month respins.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transient simulation with 5000+ Monte Carlo iterations across 5 PVT corners consumes significant cluster compute time. The team must freeze the netlist, parasitics (PEX), and netlist stimulus hierarchy before commencing runs to avoid iterating on uncalibrated models, which would derail the Gen-2 tapeout milestone.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Sense Amplifier Offset Inversion: Local V_th mismatch and parasitic capacitance asymmetry between BL and /BL exceed signal development delta V, causing the latch to flip to the incorrect rail and corrupting cell data during read-refresh.
1. Equalizer Charge Injection Skew: Unequal channel charge injection and clock feedthrough from the V_DD/2 equalization NMOS/PMOS transmission network create an initial pre-sensing differential voltage greater than 20 mV across BL and /BL.
1. Common-Mode Latch Hangup: Sub-optimal SAN/SAP activation timing or excessive source impedance stalls transconductance amplification in the subthreshold region, stretching sensing delay beyond the 15 ns system clock boundary.

| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-02` | **Sensing Latch Delay and Rail-to-Rail Restoration Timing Characterization** | Transient SPICE transient waveform analyzer with .MEASURE post-processing scripts | 1. - **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact with IPA: Flush eyes immediately with copious clean water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. Inhalation of nitrogen asphyxiant: Move subject to fresh air immediately; administer CPR if breathing has stopped. Skin contact: Wash thoroughly with mild soap and water.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard computational server room HVAC with 15-20 air changes per hour; local chemical exhaust snorkel (>100 FPM capture velocity) for benchtop solvent cleaning stations during physical validation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent collected in designated hazardous solvent waste carboys (halogen-free organic waste); no direct drain disposal.

nodes.sop_content:
# SOP: 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup

**Task Level:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Equalization Phase:  │
│  EQ High, VBLP=0.9V   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      WL Boosted       │
│      Assertion:       │
│     VPP=2.6V-2.8V     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Charge Sharing:    │
│  Delta V Develops on  │
│          BL           │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  N-Sense Activation:  │
│   SAN pulls to GND    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  P-Sense Activation:  │
│   SAP pulls to VDD    │
│         1.8V          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full Rail       │
│  Restoration & Latch  │
│       Complete        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Topology & SPICE Netlist Construction**:
   - Instantiate a folded-bitline pair (`BL` and `/BL`) representing an array block column of 256 to 512 cells per bitline.
   - Configure the 1T1C cell footprint under the $8F^2$ architecture (area $= 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the storage node capacitor to $C_s = 28\text{ fF}$ (within the target specification window of $25\text{ fF} \le C_s \le 30\text{ fF}$).
   - Connect the CMOS sense amplifier comprising cross-coupled NMOS pull-down transistors (N-sense) and cross-coupled PMOS pull-up transistors (P-sense) connected across `BL` and `/BL`.
   - Implement the equalization transistor network across `BL` and `/BL` driven by control signal `EQ` and referenced to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$).

2. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Lumped Array Modeling**:
   - Extract distributed bitline wire parasitics across the 256/512-cell column metal tracks and access junction diffusions.
   - Constrain total lumped bitline capacitance $C_{BL}$ (or $C_b$) within $150\text{ fF}$ to $250\text{ fF}$.
   - Ensure the bitline-to-cell capacitance budget ratio satisfies $5:1 \le C_b / C_s \le 9:1$ (strictly $< 10:1$ to avert signal margin degradation).

3. **Bias Supplies & Control Stimulus Setup**:
   - Set bitline precharge reference $V_{BLP} = 0.9\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Configure wordline overdrive pulse `WL` switching from $0\text{ V}$ up to boosted voltage $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$ (exceeding $V_{DD} + V_{th}$) to prevent threshold drop during cell charge transfer.
   - Pre-charge SAN and SAP latch common source nodes to $V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$ during equalization.

4. **Transient Sensing Timing Sequencer**:
   - **Phase 1 (Equalization)**: Assert `EQ` high to short `BL` and `/BL` to $0.9\text{ V}$; de-assert `EQ` to $0\text{ V}$.
   - **Phase 2 (Wordline Pulse & Charge Sharing)**: Assert `WL` to $V_{PP}$ ($2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$). Evaluate differential voltage development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - **Phase 3 (N-Sense Latching)**: Assert pull-down switch on common source node `SAN` to rapidly discharge to $\text{GND}$ ($0\text{ V}$), amplifying the bitline with the lower potential toward $0\text{ V}$.
   - **Phase 4 (P-Sense Latching)**: Following a timing delay of $1\text{ ns}$ to $2\text{ ns}$ after `SAN` activation, drive common source node `SAP` to $V_{DD}$ ($1.8\text{ V}$) via the PMOS pull-up switch to restore the companion bitline to full rail $V_{DD}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Nominal Target / Range | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Storage Node Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-02** | Total Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$ / $C_b$) | $150.0 \text{ to } 250.0$ | $\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-03** | Bitline-to-Cell Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$) | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (Max: $< 10.0 : 1$) | Ratio |
| **AC-04** | Read Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$) | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **AC-05** | Wordline Boosted Amplitude ($V_{PP}$) | $2.6 \text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ |
| **AC-06** | N-to-P Sense Activation Stagger Delay ($t_{SAN \to SAP}$) | $1.0 \text{ to } 2.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines in folded-bitline topology; equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; charge sharing equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; nominal parameters $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
- **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**: $8F^2$ folded bitline cell area ($0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $180\text{ nm}$); storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$); bitline parasitic budget $C_b = 150\text{ fF} - 250\text{ fF}$ for 256/512 cells per bitline; capacitance ratio constraint $5:1 \le C_b/C_s \le 9:1$ (degradation threshold $> 10:1$).
- **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**: Equalization phase to $V_{BLP} = V_{DD}/2$; wordline assertion to boosted level $V_{PP} = 2.6\text{ V} - 2.8\text{ V}$ ($V_{DD} + V_{th}$ overdrive); SAN activation pulling to $\text{GND}$; staggered SAP pull-up to $V_{DD}$ with a $1\text{ ns} - 2\text{ ns}$ delay.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The 1T1C testbench must account for parasitic wire resistance (R_BL) and inter-bitline coupling capacitance (C_c) across adjacent bitlines in the folded architecture, rather than treating C_b as a pure lumped 200-250 fF capacitor. Neglecting distributed RC network effects on bitline settling dynamics will cause optimistic sensing delay predictions and underestimate ground-bounce during latch activation (SAN/SAP).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm CMOS with V_DD = 1.8 V, an input differential signal Delta V of 100 mV to 110 mV requires tight matching of the cross-coupled inverter pairs (NMOS pulldown and PMOS pullup). Transistor mismatch (Pelgrom Pelgrom-coefficient-induced Delta V_th) and offset voltage (V_os) exceeding 25 mV can flip the sensing outcome during Monte Carlo corner analysis. The testbench netlist must explicitly include post-PEX 3D extraction with dummy cell loads and balanced equalize transistor gate capacitance to prevent precharge charge injection offset.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source 180nm PDKs often lack verified 3D field solver technology rule decks for high-density MIM capacitor cells (28 fF target). Sourcing calibrated RC extraction runsets and maintaining PDK design kit parity between local ngspice/Xyce netlists and foundry sign-off decks is critical to avoid respin costs on MPW shuttles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Simulation coverage must complete within the allocated compute budget; running 10,000-point Monte Carlo across all 4 process corners (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS) with full extracted RLC parasitic netlists risks stalling tapeout milestones unless hierarchical netlist reduction is applied to non-critical bitline segments.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier false latching (read inversion) caused by threshold mismatch (Delta V_th > Delta V_signal) in cross-coupled latch transistors.
1. Equalization offset skew resulting from asymmetric charge injection and clock feedthrough on BL and /BL during precharge transistor shut-off.
1. Excessive bitline RC delay preventing full signal development (Delta V < 80 mV) within the allocated access window prior to SAN strobe assertion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-01` | **Post-PEX Differential Signal Development & Sensing Margin Verification** | SPICE/Spectre/Xyce transient simulation engine with post-layout RC extracted netlist (.pex.netlist), 0.1 ps maximum transient timestep, measurement probes on BL, /BL, WL, SAN, SAP nodes. | 1. Assert equalization signal EQ high to stabilize BL and /BL at 0.9 V, then deassert EQ at t = 2.0 ns. 2. Pulse Wordline (WL) to 1.8 V at t = 3.0 ns with 200 ps rise time to dump cell charge onto BL. 3. Measure developed differential voltage Delta V = V(BL) - V(/BL) at t = 5.0 ns prior to sense strobe. 4. Assert sense amplifier enable (SAN to GND, SAP to V_DD) at t = 5.5 ns with 150 ps transition time. 5. Record latching trajectory and time required for BL to reach >= 1.62 V (90% of V_DD) and /BL to reach <= 0.18 V (10% of V_DD). | `PASS if developed differential voltage Delta V is between +100 mV and +125 mV at t = 5.0 ns, and sense amplifier resolves full rail-to-rail levels (BL >= 1.71 V, /BL <= 0.09 V) within 2.5 ns after SAN/SAP activation without latch reversal.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-02` | **Monte Carlo Transistor Mismatch & Precharge Offset Yield Assessment** | Monte Carlo mismatch and process variation engine (N = 1000 iterations), Gaussian distribution truncated at 3-sigma for threshold voltage (V_th) and geometric tolerances (W, L, Tox). | 1. Run 1000 Monte Carlo runs with independent random seed generation for Pelgrom parameter variations across all differential pair transistors. 2. Execute transient read cycle for each iteration: precharge to 0.90 V, release EQ, pulse WL, activate SAN/SAP. 3. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** 1T1C Bitline and Folded Sense Amp Schematic Netlisting with $V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Equalizer  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip / DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Discipline:** DRAM Circuit Design / 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup

---

## 1. Process Workflow

```text
│                        │
│      1. Parameter      │
│     Definition and     │
│     Topology Setup     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      2. Equalizer      │
│       Subcircuit       │
│    Netlisting VDD/2    │
│       Precharge        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3. Folded CMOS Sense  │
│     Amp Subcircuit     │
│       Netlisting       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. 1T1C Memory Cell   │
│   and Complementary    │
│  Bitline Integration   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      5. Transient      │
│  Simulation and Latch  │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Parameter Definition & Global Node Configuration
1. Define supply rails and common bias nodes: $V_{DD}$, $GND$, and $V_{BLP} = V_{DD} / 2$ (precharge reference voltage).
2. Instantiate access transistor dimension parameters: channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
3. Define lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ on both complementary lines (`BL` and `/BL`).
4. Set minimum storage cell capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (nominal baseline $25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).

### Step 2: Netlist the $V_{DD}/2$ Precharge Equalizer Subcircuit
1. Create subcircuit `.subckt EQUALIZER BL BL_B EQ VBLP`:
   - Instantiate NMOS equalization transistor across the bitline pair between `BL` and `/BL` gated by `EQ`.
   - Instantiate two NMOS pull-up transistors connecting `BL` to `VBLP` and `/BL` to `VBLP`, both gated by control line `EQ`.
2. Configure layout pitch constraint targeting memory array pitch matching ($360\text{ nm}$ per bitline pair pitch).

### Step 3: Netlist the Folded CMOS Cross-Coupled Sense Amplifier Latch
1. Create subcircuit `.subckt SENSE_AMP BL BL_B SAP SAN`:
   - **N-Latch (SAN pull-down):** Two cross-coupled NMOS transistors where NMOS1 drain is tied to `BL` and gate to `/BL`, and NMOS2 drain is tied to `/BL` and gate to `BL`. Common source is tied to control line `SAN`.
   - **P-Latch (SAP pull-up):** Two cross-coupled PMOS transistors where PMOS1 drain is tied to `BL` and gate to `/BL`, and PMOS2 drain is tied to `/BL` and gate to `BL`. Common source is tied to control line `SAP`.
2. Implement interleaved layout pin pitch matching the $360\text{ nm}$ array bitline pitch.

### Step 4: Netlist the 1T1C Memory Unit Cell and Array Connection
1. Netlist 1T1C unit cell `.subckt CELL_1T1C BL WL VPL`:
   - NMOS access transistor ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$) connected between bitline `BL` and storage node `SN`, gated by `WL`.
   - Storage capacitor $C_s$ ($28\text{ fF}$, stacked capacitor over bitline architecture) connected between `SN` and cell plate line `VPL` ($V_{DD} / 2$).
2. Connect complementary dummy cell or reference line on `/BL` for folded bitline differential operation.

### Step 5: Transient Operating Sequence & Testbench Verification
1. **Precharge Phase:** Assert `EQ` high while `SAN` and `SAP` are held at $V_{DD} / 2$. Verify `BL` and `/BL` settle precisely to $V_{DD} / 2$. Deassert `EQ`.
2. **Charge Sharing Phase:** Assert `WL` high. Access transistor dumps charge onto `BL`, developing differential voltage:
   $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
3. **Sensing & Restoration Phase:** Activate `SAN` (pulls to $GND$) and `SAP` (pulls to $V_{DD}$). Verify rails diverge rapidly to full CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$), restoring storage cell charge to 100%.

---

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |

| **AC-01** | Unit Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE `.measure` capacitance at storage node |
| **AC-02** | Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$) | $250.0 \pm 10.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Lumped interconnect RC extraction report |
| **AC-03** | Developed Read Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$) | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage delta $\|\text{V(BL)} - \text{V(/BL)}\|$ at latch trigger |

---

## 5. Literature Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture, equalization network to $V_{DD}/2$, and sense signal development equation: $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
   - Baseline capacitances ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$).
   - Strobe sequence: `SAN` to $GND$, `SAP` to $V_{DD}$ for differential sensing and full restoration.
   - Array-to-sense amplifier pitch matching constraint: $360\text{ nm}$.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Minimum cell storage capacitance threshold: $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity.
   - Access transistor junction and sub-threshold leakage limit: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The folded bitline sense amplifier and VDD/2 equalizer schematic netlist must account for common-mode rejection and parasitic coupling asymmetry between true bitline (BL) and complementary bitline (/BL). At 180nm CMOS operating at 1.8V nominal VDD, an equalized level of 0.9V requires balanced impedance on both branches during the sensing latch phase; otherwise, systemic offsets will degrade the nominal 100-150 mV signal development margin generated by the 25 fF cell and 250 fF bitline capacitance ratio.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The VDD/2 precharge network requires a transmission-gate or matched NMOS equalizer structure with active gate overdrive during precharge (EQ active-high) to suppress threshold voltage drops. The cross-coupled inverter latch must incorporate sequential activation—driving the NMOS sense amplifier pull-down line (SAN) to VSS prior to driving the PMOS sense amplifier pull-up line (SAP) to VDD—to prevent shoot-through crowbar currents and minimize read-disturb during the non-destructive write-back restoration phase.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The 180nm PDK device primitives for 1T1C storage cell capacitors (deep trench or MIM capacitor) and standard thin-oxide 1.8V core transistors must strictly align with foundry open-source physical design rules to avoid non-standard mask layers that inflate MPW shuttle tapeout costs and manufacturing lead times.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The SPICE netlisting and parasitic testbench delivery must pass milestone verification within the 180nm open-source shuttle freeze window, verifying that netlist subcircuits export standardized pinouts (BL, BLB, WL, VDD, VSS, VBLP, EQ, SAN, SAP, CSL) without syntax warnings in open-source EDA engines like Ngspice and Xyce.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Threshold mismatch (delta-Vth) and parasitic layout capacitance imbalance exceeding differential developed margin (delta-V < 80 mV), causing latching inversion and unrecoverable destructive data corruption during read.
1. Incomplete bitline equilibration caused by excessive precharge equalizer on-resistance or clock-feedthrough charge injection from the EQ signal, leaving residual voltage offsets between BL and /BL before wordline firing.
1. Timing skew between SAN (pull-down) and SAP (pull-up) strobe controls triggering excessive transient rail droop or premature PMOS turn-on that flips the sensing node before signal resolution.

critics.systems_engineer: The folded bitline sense amplifier and VDD/2 equalizer schematic netlist must account for common-mode rejection and parasitic coupling asymmetry between true bitline (BL) and complementary bitline (/BL). At 180nm CMOS operating at 1.8V nominal VDD, an equalized level of 0.9V requires balanced impedance on both branches during the sensing latch phase; otherwise, systemic offsets will degrade the nominal 100-150 mV signal development margin generated by the 25 fF cell and 250 fF bitline capacitance ratio.
critics.domain_expert: The VDD/2 precharge network requires a transmission-gate or matched NMOS equalizer structure with active gate overdrive during precharge (EQ active-high) to suppress threshold voltage drops. The cross-coupled inverter latch must incorporate sequential activation—driving the NMOS sense amplifier pull-down line (SAN) to VSS prior to driving the PMOS sense amplifier pull-up line (SAP) to VDD—to prevent shoot-through crowbar currents and minimize read-disturb during the non-destructive write-back restoration phase.
critics.supply_chain: The 180nm PDK device primitives for 1T1C storage cell capacitors (deep trench or MIM capacitor) and standard thin-oxide 1.8V core transistors must strictly align with foundry open-source physical design rules to avoid non-standard mask layers that inflate MPW shuttle tapeout costs and manufacturing lead times.
critics.laya_pm: The SPICE netlisting and parasitic testbench delivery must pass milestone verification within the 180nm open-source shuttle freeze window, verifying that netlist subcircuits export standardized pinouts (BL, BLB, WL, VDD, VSS, VBLP, EQ, SAN, SAP, CSL) without syntax warnings in open-source EDA engines like Ngspice and Xyce.
critical_failure_modes: Threshold mismatch (delta-Vth) and parasitic layout capacitance imbalance exceeding differential developed margin (delta-V < 80 mV), causing latching inversion and unrecoverable destructive data corruption during read.

Incomplete bitline equilibration caused by excessive precharge equalizer on-resistance or clock-feedthrough charge injection from the EQ signal, leaving residual voltage offsets between BL and /BL before wordline firing.
Timing skew between SAN (pull-down) and SAP (pull-up) strobe controls triggering excessive transient rail droop or premature PMOS turn-on that flips the sensing node before signal resolution.

testcases.title: Bitline Equalizer Precharge Level and Balance Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Transient SPICE Analysis (Ngspice / Xyce) with High-Precision Strobe Monitor (.tran 10ps 50ns) and DC operating point probing on nodes BL and /BL.
testcases.pre_conditions: Nominal VDD = 1.8V, VBLP = 0.90V (VDD/2), initial node voltages BL = 1.8V, /BL = 0.0V (worst-case opposite polarity from previous cycle), T = 27 deg C, TT corner.
testcases.procedure: 1. Assert equalizer control signal EQ from 0V to 1.8V at t = 2.0ns with rise time tr = 100ps. 2. Maintain EQ high for t_precharge = 10.0ns. 3. De-assert EQ to 0V at t = 12.0ns with fall time tf = 100ps. 4. Measure final settling voltages V(BL) and V(/BL) at t = 15.0ns (post-feedthrough).
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Settling voltage |V(BL) - VBLP| <= 15 mV, |V(/BL) - VBLP| <= 15 mV, and differential offset |V(BL) - V(/BL)| <= 2.0 mV at t = 15.0 ns.

testcases.title: 1T1C Differential Signal Development and Full-Rail Latching Restoration
testcases.instrumentation: Mixed-mode transient SPICE simulation tracking storage cell node V(SN), BL, /BL, SAN, and SAP over an access-sense-restore cycle.
testcases.pre_conditions: Cell storage capacitor Cs = 25 fF initialized to Logic 0 (V_cell = 0.0V), bitline parasitic capacitance C_BL = 250 fF precharged to VBLP = 0.90V, WL = 0V, EQ = 0V.
testcases.procedure: 1. Assert Wordline WL to 1.8V (or boosted 2.2V) at t = 2.0ns to dump cell charge onto BL. 2. Measure developed differential voltage delta_V = V(/BL) - V(BL) at t = 6.0ns. 3. Strobe SAN pull-down line to 0V at t = 6.5ns. 4. Strobe SAP pull-up line to 1.8V at t = 7.5ns. 5. Monitor restoration voltage on V(SN) through t = 20.0ns.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Developed delta_V at t = 6.0ns must be between 80 mV and 160 mV; after latch strobe activation (t = 20.0ns), V(BL) <= 50 mV, V(/BL) >= 1.75 V, and cell restored node V(SN) <= 50 mV (100% full-rail restoration).

ESD-safe antistatic lab coat

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Multi-Metal Stack and Inter-Bitline Parasitic Extraction (PEX) Rule Setup
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation [Circuit Design] > 1T1C Bitline-Sense Amp Testbench Netlist & Parasitic Extraction Setup [Circuit Design] > Multi-Metal Stack and Inter-Bitline Parasitic Extraction (PEX) Rule Setup [Circuit Design]  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Establish an accurate 2.5D/3D Parasitic Extraction (PEX) deck and rule deck definition for the multi-metal interconnect stack (Tungsten bitline/local interconnect through upper routing metals) of the folded bitline array and sense amplifier network. This ensures exact extraction of inter-bitline coupling capacitance ($C_{c}$), total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$), and plate ground return parasitics to validate sensing signal margin ($\Delta V$) during transient read operations.

```text
       Bitline Interconnect Topology & Field Boundary Setup
       ----------------------------------------------------
       BL_i-1             BL_i (True)        /BL_i (Bar)        BL_i+1
        [M1]   <--Cc-->   [M1 / W]   <--Cc-->   [M1 / W]   <--Cc-->   [M1]
         |                   |                     |                   |
      -------             -------               -------             -------
     | C_sub |           | C_sub |             | C_sub |           | C_sub |
      -------             -------               -------             -------
    ========================================================================
                                Substrate Ground
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Process Stackup & Dielectric Constant Definition**
   - Import the 180nm back-end-of-line (BEOL) and Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) interconnect stack profile into the extraction rule compiler.
   - Configure the inter-layer dielectrics (ILD) and high-$k$ capacitor dielectric boundary models:
     - Set the stacked capacitor dielectric layer to ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective relative permittivity $\kappa > 15$ (EOT: $3.0\text{ nm} - 4.0\text{ nm}$).
     - Define gate dielectric oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) physical thickness at $3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Define tungsten plug (W-plug) contact resistivity and metal aspect ratios for access transistor drain-to-capacitor node and bitline contact interfaces.

2. **Array Pitch & Boundary Extraction Window Setup**
   - Set the nominal lithographic bitline pitch and wordline pitch extraction grid to $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ corresponding to the $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline cell geometry.
   - Constrain access transistor drawn gate parameters to channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Establish extraction lateral halo window extending at least 5 pitches ($>2.0\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) laterally to capture adjacent inter-bitline fringing fields ($BL$ to $/BL$ and $BL_i$ to $BL_{i+1}$).

3. **Field Solver Calibration for Inter-Bitline Coupling Capacitance**
   - Run a deterministic 3D field solver on a calibrated $3\times3$ array slice with Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) geometry to extract the multi-conductor capacitance matrix ($C_{ij}$).
   - Decompose total bitline capacitance into:
     $$C_{BL} = C_{area} + C_{fringe} + C_{overlap} + 2 \cdot C_{c}$$
     where $C_c$ is the lateral coupling capacitance between adjacent folded bitlines.
   - Tune the calibrated PEX lookup table (LUT) / corner decks so that the nominal total bitline parasitic capacitance satisfies the $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ baseline target for a standard sub-array column length.

4. **1T1C Node Isolation & Netlist Stitching Verification**
   - Ensure the PEX extraction rules cleanly distinguish between:
     - Distributed bitline wiring parasitics ($R_{BL}$, $C_{BL}$).
     - Storage node capacitor target ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ nominal, budget target range $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$).
   - Check that sub-threshold and junction leakage parameters are back-annotated into BSIM models with targets $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to support $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention time at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Generate the stitched DSPF/SPEF back-annotated netlist for the sense amplifier testbench.

5. **Transient Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Extraction Sanity Check**
   - Run an automated netlist testbench step with wordline assertion dumping cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto the precharged bitlines ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Verify that the extracted differential read voltage meets:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     yielding a nominal differential signal margin of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ into the cross-coupled sense amplifier latch inputs ($SAN$ / $SAP$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Criteria | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | `250` | `fF` | $\pm 10\%$ ($225 - 275\text{ fF}$) | 3D PEX netlist extraction / SPICE `.measure` |
| **Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | `28.0` | `fF` | Minimum $\ge 25.0\text{ fF}$ (Range: $25 - 30\text{ fF}$) | PEX LVS extraction across cell storage node |
| **Developed Read Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | `100 - 150` | `mV` | Minimum $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ | Transient SPICE differential probe $(V_{BL} - V_{/BL})$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current Budget (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | `fA/cell` | Maximum $\le 1.0\text{ fA}$ | Quiescent DC bias leakage extraction at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | `nm` | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | PEX techfile stackup deck rule check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
  - High-$k$ dielectric stack ($\text{ONO}$ or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with $\kappa > 15$).
  - Minimum storage capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$).
  - Leakage requirement ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ for target refresh retention).
  - Tungsten plug (W-plug) stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$.
  - Bitline load capacitance reference ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).
  - Cell capacitance reference ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$).
  - Differential signal development equation $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ yielding $100\text{ mV} - 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ and $6F^2$ cell topology, $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ bitline/wordline pitch.
  - Storage capacitance budget range of $25\text{ fF} - 30\text{ fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ nm} - 4\text{ nm}$.
  - Thermally grown gate oxide thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline architecture with stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), parasitic extraction (PEX) must accurately distinguish between inter-pair and intra-pair mutual bitline capacitances (C_BL-BL, C_BL-BLB). At a 28 fF cell capacitance budget, an uncalibrated extraction deck misestimating lateral fringe capacitance by even 15% will distort differential sensing margins (Delta V = (C_s / (C_s + C_BL)) * (V_DD / 2)) and lead to false sense amplifier latching during transient Monte Carlo simulations.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Extraction rules must capture the 3D multi-metal dielectric stack precisely—specifically M1 bitlines running under tungsten contact plugs and MIM capacitor bottom plates. A standard 2.5D corner extraction model fails to compute the vertical fringe coupling from adjacent passing wordlines (poly) and overlying M2 column select lines, introducing systematic underestimation of common-mode bitline capacitance (C_BL) by 18-25 fF per 512-cell column.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source foundry PDK multi-layer interconnect parameters (e.g., thickness, inter-metal dielectric permittivity, and line edge roughness) frequently lack proprietary BEOL corner guardbands; relying on unvalidated extraction techfiles introduces severe tapeout yield risks across fab runs in local Southeast Asian foundry shuttles.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PEX deck setup, field solver 3D boundary calibration, and DRC/LVS-to-PEX rule mapping must be finalized and frozen within Sprint 2. Any slip in calibrated parasitics directly blocks transient sense margin signoff and layout tapeout for the 180nm DRAM test vehicle.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Inter-bitline crosstalk inversion: Inaccurate fringe capacitance extraction leading to differential sensing voltage drop below 80 mV during worst-case solid-1/solid-0 read patterns.
1. Field solver boundary condition error: Failure to capture periodic boundary floating nodes in dense 8F^2 arrays, resulting in netlist extraction runtime divergence or node collapsing.
1. Capacitive imbalance between true and complement bitlines: Asymmetric extraction deck generation causing artificial offset voltages >15 mV across the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier pairs.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-2-01` | **Inter-Bitline Lateral and Fringe Capacitance PEX Accuracy Validation against 3D Field Solver** | Synopsys Raphael / FastCap 3D Poisson Solver, Open-source Calibre xACT/Magic PEX engine, Precision capacitance extraction script | 1. Extract parasitic capacitance matrix of adjacent bitline tracks (BL_0, BLB_0, BL_1) across 64 unit cells using the synthesized PEX deck. 2. Build equivalent 3D field-solver mesh model of the exact metal-dielectric stack (SiO2 IMD, Ta2O5/Al2O3 cap boundary, M1 Al-Cu lines). 3. Compute static mutual capacitance C_c and ground capacitance C_g via electrostatic charge integration under 1.0 V stimulus. 4. Correlate PEX extraction values against 3D field solver baseline. | `Total bitline capacitance C_BL must fall within 220 fF ± 5% per 512-cell segment; mutual inter-bitline coupling C_c/C_BL must not deviate from 3D field solver reference by more than ±3.0%.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-2-02` | **Post-PEX Transient Sensing Margin Monte Carlo Simulation with VPP Overdrive** | Cadence Spectre / Ngspice Monte Carlo simulator with 1000-run statistical mismatch, VPP charge pump subcircuit (2.8 V overdrive) | 1. Initialize cell storage node to V_DD - V_th (1.2 V unboosted) and V_DD (1.8 V boosted via 2.8 V V_PP). 2. Equilibrate BL/BLB to 0.9 V (V_DD/2) using equalizer switch. 3. Assert WL with 1.5 ns rise time to 2.8 V. 4. Execute 1000-run Monte Carlo transient run across process corners (TT, SS, FF) at 85°C. 5. Measure differential voltage Delta V at sense amplifier activation (t = 2.5 ns) and sense decision time. | `Differential sense voltage Delta V_sense >= 110 mV across 3-sigma Monte Carlo variations; zero read failure / bit inversion events in 1000 statistical iterations; sense latch resolution time <= 1.8 ns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles with ANSI Z87.1 certification, Heavy-duty butyl/neoprene multi-layer gloves over nitrile cleanroom gloves, PTFE chemical apron with full arm gauntlets, Full-face respiratory shield fitted with acid gas/fluoride vapor filter cartridges
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with HF/acid solutions: immediately flush area with copious cold water under emergency deluge shower for 2 minutes; vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into exposed skin continuously until medical assistance arrives. For eye contact: rinse continuously at eye wash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For inhalation: remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, do not induce vomiting.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical benches dedicated to metal clean and dielectric etching must operate under certified vertical laminar downflow hood with continuous wet scrubber exhaust maintaining face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) and negative static plenum pressure >= 0.25 in. w.g.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fluoride-bearing and heavy metal waste streams must be segregated into dedicated PVDF carboys; neutralize HF waste using 10% calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) slurry to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2), filtering cake before pH adjustment to 6.5-8.5 prior to monitored effluent release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE 6:1)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `49 wt% aqueous stock diluted 6:1 with NH4F` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha constituent)** | `7664-93-9` | Semiconductor Grade Puranal | `96.0% - 98.0%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (Piranha constituent)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30 wt% in H2O` |
| **Tantalum Pentoxide precursor (Ta(OC2H5)5)** | `6074-84-6` | High Purity 99.999% Metal Basis | `>= 99.95%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) polished with native oxide stripped via dilute BOE dip; surface particle density < 0.05 particles/cm2 at >= 0.18 um.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered Ti/TiN barrier and tungsten contact plug filled, planarized, and sealed under inert vacuum ready for M1 aluminum deposition.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure causes native oxidation on open W-plugs and uncontrolled moisture absorption into porous inter-layer dielectrics, resulting in >30% contact resistance spikes (R_c > 15 Ohm/via) and severe inter-metal dielectric leakage causing bitline precharge droop.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated multi-metal and folded-bitline parasitic extraction (PEX) rule deck and validated post-layout extraction testbench for 180nm DRAM sensing path, achieving <3% correlation with 3D field solver calculations and demonstrating robust 110 mV sensing margins across 1000 Monte Carlo runs.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram180_folded_bl_pex_rules.tech`
- [ ] `bitline_pair_3d_capacitance_matrix.csv`
- [ ] `mc_1000_sensing_margin_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Total single-ended bitline capacitance for 512-cell column segment** | `220 fF` | ±11 fF (±5.0%) | Post-layout extraction netlist summation against FastCap 3D field-solver reference extraction. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Inter-bitline coupling capacitance ratio (C_coupling / C_total_BL)** | `18.5%` | ±1.5% | Multi-conductor electrostatic matrix extraction across 3 adjacent parallel folded bitline pairs. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Worst-case 3-sigma differential sensing voltage (Delta V_sense) at sense amp strobe** | `115 mV` | +20 mV / -5 mV | 1000-run Monte Carlo transient simulation at 85°C with transistor mismatch and back-annotated PEX parasitics. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Complete signoff requires zero DRC/LVS violations on the folded bitline cell array, calibrated PEX deck producing 100% convergence across all Monte Carlo corners, 1000 consecutive passing read operations without data inversion under solid-1/solid-0 patterns, and formal signoff endorsement by the Lead DRAM Circuit Architect.

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with HF/acid solutions: immediately flush area with copious cold water under emergency deluge shower for 2 minutes; vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into exposed skin continuously until medical assistance arrives. For eye contact: rinse continuously at eye wash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. For inhalation: remove victim to fresh air, administer 100% humidified oxygen, do not induce vomiting.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Wet chemical benches dedicated to metal clean and dielectric etching must operate under certified vertical laminar downflow hood with continuous wet scrubber exhaust maintaining face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) and negative static plenum pressure >= 0.25 in. w.g.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Fluoride-bearing and heavy metal waste streams must be segregated into dedicated PVDF carboys; neutralize HF waste using 10% calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) slurry to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2), filtering cake before pH adjustment to 6.5-8.5 prior to monitored effluent release.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) polished with native oxide stripped via dilute BOE dip; surface particle density < 0.05 particles/cm2 at >= 0.18 um.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Sputtered Ti/TiN barrier and tungsten contact plug filled, planarized, and sealed under inert vacuum ready for M1 aluminum deposition.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Excessive atmospheric exposure causes native oxidation on open W-plugs and uncontrolled moisture absorption into porous inter-layer dielectrics, resulting in >30% contact resistance spikes (R_c > 15 Ohm/via) and severe inter-metal dielectric leakage causing bitline precharge droop.

expected_result.summary: Calibrated multi-metal and folded-bitline parasitic extraction (PEX) rule deck and validated post-layout extraction testbench for 180nm DRAM sensing path, achieving <3% correlation with 3D field solver calculations and demonstrating robust 110 mV sensing margins across 1000 Monte Carlo runs.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Total single-ended bitline capacitance for 512-cell column segment
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Post-layout extraction netlist summation against FastCap 3D field-solver reference extraction.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Inter-bitline coupling capacitance ratio (C_coupling / C_total_BL)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-conductor electrostatic matrix extraction across 3 adjacent parallel folded bitline pairs.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Worst-case 3-sigma differential sensing voltage (Delta V_sense) at sense amp strobe
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: 1000-run Monte Carlo transient simulation at 85°C with transistor mismatch and back-annotated PEX parasitics.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: Complete signoff requires zero DRC/LVS violations on the folded bitline cell array, calibrated PEX deck producing 100% convergence across all Monte Carlo corners, 1000 consecutive passing read operations without data inversion under solid-1/solid-0 patterns, and formal signoff endorsement by the Lead DRAM Circuit Architect.
