# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-CKT-DRAM-180NM-042`
**Title:** Pre-Layout vs Post-PEX Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$) Verification Testbench  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm CMOS DRAM Process)  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design & Layout Verification (Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier)  
**Action Type:** Make / Verification  

---

### 1. Architectural & Verification Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Precharge BL/BLB to   │
│         VDD/2          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline Assertion   │
│         WL ON          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Charge Sharing Delta  │
│     V Development      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sense Amp Activation  │
│        SAN/SAP         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Full Rail CMOS     │
│      Restoration       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Layout Schematic Testbench Formulation (`TB_PRE_SENSE`):**
   - Instantiate the complementary folded bitline pair (`BL`, `/BL`) paired with the cross-coupled CMOS inverter latch sense amplifier and equalization network.
   - Configure unit access transistor geometry to gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Tie 1T1C storage cell node with nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ (evaluation limit down to minimum $28\text{ fF}$ budget) and bitline lump capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Initialize precharge equalization transistors to set $V_{\text{BL}} = V_{/\text{BL}} = V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

2. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX Netlist Generation - `TB_POST_PEX`):**
   - Run full 3D/2.5D field solver parasitic extraction (R + C + CC coupled bitline parasitics) on the physical layout across the interleaved sense amplifier pitch matching array ($360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch).
   - Extract distributed parasitic resistance and capacitance networks for bitline metal tracks, contact tungsten plugs (W-plugs), and cross-coupled latch routing into a post-PEX DSPF/SPEF netlist.

3. **Transient Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$) Simulation:**
   - De-assert bitline equalization signal to float `BL` and `/BL` at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - Assert wordline ($WL$) to turn on access transistor, initiating charge sharing:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Probe bitline differential margin $\Delta V = |V_{\text{BL}} - V_{/\text{BL}}|$ at the precise instant directly before latch strobe activation (`SAN` pulling to GND, `SAP` pulling to $V_{\text{DD}}$).
   - Evaluate read '1' ($V_{\text{cell}} = V_{\text{DD}}$) and read '0' ($V_{\text{cell}} = 0\text{ V}$) conditions across both pre-layout schematic and post-PEX netlists.

4. **Differential Degradation Comparison & Latch Margin Sign-Off:**
   - Calculate parasitic degradation percentage:
     $$\text{Degradation} (\%) = \frac{\Delta V_{\text{pre}} - \Delta V_{\text{post}}}{\Delta V_{\text{pre}}} \times 100$$
   - Run transient sensing to verify successful rail-to-rail latching ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$) and 100% cell charge restoration without sensing failure or latch metastability under thermal corner conditions ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Pre-Layout Differential Voltage ($\Delta V_{\text{pre}}$) | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage probe at charge-sharing equilibrium |
| **AC-02** | Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$) Budget | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF}$ | Small-signal capacitance extraction ($C\text{-}V$) |
| **AC-03** | Unit Access Transistor Dimensions ($L \times W$) | $180 \times 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Netlist instance parameter check & DRC audit |
| **AC-04** | Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage ($I_{\text{leak}}$) | $\le 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC operating point / transient leakage integration |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**: Folded bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture; precharge equalization to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; charge dumping relation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$; differential voltage formulation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding nominal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$; strobe signal activation (`SAN` to GND, `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$) driving rails to $0\text{ V}$ and $V_{\text{DD}}$ with 100% cell restoration; interleaved pitch matching at $360\text{ nm}$ bitline pitch for the 180nm node.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Unit access transistor gate geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture connected via tungsten plug (W-plug); minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error and bitline noise immunity; leakage current ceiling target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-PEX parasitic extraction must accurately model distributed RC extraction on matched bitline pairs (BL and /BL) rather than lumped capacitances. At the 180nm node with a 360nm bitline pitch, line-to-line coupling capacitance (C_c) to adjacent quiet and switching lines severely degrades the effective signal margin (Delta V = (C_cell / (C_cell + C_BL)) * (V_cell - V_BL_eq)). If cross-coupling imbalances or asymmetric contact resistances from interleaved sense-amplifier routing are omitted, post-PEX Monte Carlo runs will overestimate differential signal margins and fail to reveal sensing dead zones during asynchronous wordline activation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The folded bitline topology relies on tight common-mode noise rejection. In pre-layout schematic simulations, Delta V typically reaches 150mV to 180mV under nominal 1.8V VDD. However, post-PEX simulations incorporating 3D extraction of Metal 1 to Metal 3 strap resistances and sense amplifier cross-coupled pair diffusion parasitic capacitance exhibit significant Delta V attenuation (typically 20% to 35% reduction). Furthermore, offset voltage (V_os) induced by threshold voltage mismatch (Delta V_th) and geometric asymmetric parasitics in the latch pull-down (SAN) and pull-up (SAP) nodes must be strictly bounded below 15mV (3-sigma) to prevent read-disturb or flip inversion on weak '0' or '1' states.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Testbench automation must maintain PDK parity across open-source 180nm toolchains (e.g., SkyWater 130/180nm or open-source foundry equivalents) and proprietary foundry tapeout kits. Multi-corner parasitic extraction (PEX) decks often depend on proprietary tech-files (e.g., StarRC or Quantus); lack of open-source extraction calibration (e.g., Magic/OpenPEX) causes critical timing discrepancies. Failure to standardize the PEX netlist format delays physical verification and prototype multi-project wafer (MPW) lot tapeout deadlines.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Schedule risk is driven by long extraction runtimes and SPICE-level Monte Carlo convergence failures on high-density cell arrays. The team must decouple full-array parasitic extraction from the core 1T1C+Sense Amp critical path testbench by implementing hierarchical boundary-cell extractions. Verification milestones require signed-off comparison scripts between pre-layout and post-layout Delta V distributions within sprint deadlines without blocking silicon fabrication commit.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Latch Inversion: Parasitic cross-coupling capacitance (C_cross) between adjacent non-shielded bitlines exceeds cell readout charge, forcing the sense amplifier to resolve in the inverse direction during aggressive wordline slew.
1. Sense Margin Collapse: Post-PEX distributed RC parasitics along interleaved bitlines attenuate differential signal margin (Delta V) below the 3-sigma offset voltage (V_os) of the sense amplifier, causing read failures at nominal refresh cycles.
1. Equalization Voltage Drift: Post-PEX leakage and asymmetrical parasitic capacitances on the equalizing transistor network prevent BL and /BL from settling to exact VDD/2 before sensing, causing systemic common-mode to differential-mode noise conversion.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-3-01` | **Nominal Pre-Layout vs Post-PEX Differential Voltage (Delta V) Degradation and Delay Test** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre / Ngspice batch engine with high-precision transient analysis (reltol=1e-5, gmin=1e-15), 0.1fF calibrated parasitics, internal measurement vectors probing V(BL) and V(/BL). | 1. Initialize bitline equalization by asserting EQ=1.8V for 10ns to force V(BL)=V(/BL)=0.900V. 2. Deassert EQ at t=10ns. 3. At t=12ns, assert Wordline (WL) to 2.8V (boosted VPP) with a 1.0ns rise time. 4. Measure pre-layout Delta V_pre = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at t=14.5ns (immediately prior to sense amplifier activation). 5. Repeat identical transient sequence on the post-PEX distributed RC netlist and measure Delta V_post at t=14.5ns. 6. Assert Sense Amp Enable (SAN falling to 0V, SAP rising to 1.8V) at t=15.0ns and measure sensing latency t_sense to achieve 90% rail-to-rail voltage. | `Delta V_post must be >= 120 mV for both Data '1' and Data '0' readout states. Total signal margin attenuation ratio (Delta V_pre - Delta V_post) / Delta V_pre must not exceed 28.0%. Full-rail sensing delay degradation (t_sense_post - t_sense_pre) must be <= 1.2 ns.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-1-3-02` | **Post-PEX 1000-Point Monte Carlo Bitline Margin and Latch Offset Yield Verification** | Automated Monte Carlo SPICE simulation harness running 1000 iterations combining foundry process variations (Pelgrom Pelgrom parameter Delta V_th, tox, W, L) and extracted distributed 3D parasitic mismatch (R+C). | 1. Configure the Monte Carlo engine to execute 1000 statistical iterations under Gaussian mismatch parameters. 2. For each iteration, set cell data to weak '0' (stored voltage = 0.25V due to junction leakage). 3. Apply standard sensing cycle: deassert EQ, activate WL, allow 2.5ns charge sharing, assert SAN/SAP. 4. Probe differential node margin Delta V immediately before latching and evaluate resolved state at t = 20ns. 5. Log all flip inversions (incorrect latching to VDD instead of GND) and compute the 3-sigma offset voltage V_os. | `Zero incorrect read resolutions across 1000 Monte Carlo runs (0% bit error rate at worst-case corner). Computed 3-sigma input-referred offset voltage V_os must be <= 14.5 mV. Minimum observed post-PEX dynamic margin (Delta V_min) across all runs must be >= 65 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/glare protection safety glasses, ESD-safe conductive wrist strap and grounding cord (1 Megohm series resistor), Static-dissipative nitrile gloves (ESD/cleanroom compliant), Static-dissipative lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush immediately with copious amounts of clean deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. In case of accidental ingestion, do not induce vomiting; contact local poison control center and seek emergency medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard electronics lab / simulation data center HVAC with localized chemical bench laminar fume hood providing minimum face velocity of 100 FPM (0.5 m/s) for solvent-based package and wafer inspection cleaning stations.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent wipes and IPA residues in tightly sealed, labeled flammable-waste containers. Dispose of hazardous solvent waste via authorized hazardous waste handling contractors in compliance with regional environmental EPA/industrial discharge standards; never pour into municipal wastewater.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Electronic Grade** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-PEX GDSII physical layout DRC/LVS clean; wafer test structures (TLM and contact arrays) post-metallization annealed and surface-degreased.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlists (DSP/SPEF/Calibre view) verified against LVS golden schematic; wafer pads passivated and sealed under dry nitrogen containment.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive environmental exposure (>120 mins in ambient air) of unpassivated aluminum/copper contact pads leads to surface native oxidation, inflating measured TLM specific contact resistance (rho_c) and corrupting empirical-to-simulation PEX correlation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed and signed-off differential signal margin verification testbench establishing rigorous quantitative equivalence between pre-layout and post-PEX folded bitline sense amplifier circuits. Validates that parasitic line capacitance, contact resistances, and layout interleaving in 180nm open-source DRAM preserve adequate sensing margin and eliminate latch flip risks across all PVT corners.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `pre_vs_post_pex_deltav_margin_report.pdf`
- [ ] `monte_carlo_1000pt_offset_distribution.csv`
- [ ] `pex_coupling_capacitance_matrix_extracted.spef`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Post-PEX differential readout voltage margin (Delta V) under nominal 1.8V VDD with 25fF cell capacitance** | `135 mV` | +/- 15 mV | Automated SPICE transient analysis measuring differential node voltage V(BL) - V(/BL) 500ps prior to SAN assertion |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Sense amplifier 3-sigma dynamic offset voltage (V_os) across 1000-point Monte Carlo mismatch and parasitic runs** | `12.0 mV` | <= 14.5 mV maximum | Statistical Gaussian distribution fitting of input-referred decision thresholds across 1000 Monte Carlo transient iterations |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Bitline-to-Bitline parasitic cross-coupling capacitance ratio (C_cross / C_BL_total) in folded interleaved layout** | `14.0%` | <= 18.0% maximum | Parasitic extraction SPEF capacitive matrix decomposition of extracted Metal 1 / Metal 2 bitline runs over 256 memory cells |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions (ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03) achieved; post-PEX Monte Carlo simulations achieve 100% correct latch sensing across 1000 iterations at -40C, 27C, and 85C under 1.62V worst-case VDD rail; physical LVS clean with zero floating net extraction warnings.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Transient Sensing Dynamics & Bitline Equalization SPICE Simulation

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation [Circuit Design] > Transient Sensing Dynamics & Bitline Equalization SPICE Simulation [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm mixed-signal DRAM architecture with a 1.8V nominal core, the folded-bitline sensing latency and signal development window are directly dictated by wordline overdrive boosted rail (V_PP at 2.6V to 2.8V) and power distribution network (PDN) parasitic inductance. The transient pulse timing between SAN (NMOS pulldown) and SAP (PMOS pullup) must enforce a strict non-overlapping 1.2 ns to 1.8 ns delay to avoid instantaneous shoot-through current spikes exceeding 45 mA per subarray block, which induces local bitline reference (V_BLP) rail bounce and severe common-mode rejection degradation.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node dimensions, cell storage capacitance C_s typically achieves 25 fF against a parasitic bitline capacitance C_BL of ~250 fF, yielding a raw differential signal delta V of only 80 mV to 135 mV for worst-case '0' and '1' readout states. The equalization circuit must incorporate both complementary shorting NMOS transistors and dual half-V_DD clamp switches to suppress residual differential offset to under 1.5 mV within a 3.5 ns equalization window. Any threshold mismatch Delta V_th between the cross-coupled latch NMOS pair exceeding 8 mV will result in destructive flip/read-inversion during latch activation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Model deck portability across commercial open-source 180nm CMOS/eDRAM foundries (such as SkyWater 130/180nm or TSMC 0.18um BCD/HV eDRAM processes) demands that all BSIM3v3/BSIM4 model cards include validated temperature coefficients (-40°C to +125°C) and corner extraction (TT, FF, SS, FS, SF). Foundry multi-project wafer (MPW) tapeout schedules have strict PDK signoff windows, making unvalidated PDK parameter discrepancies on V_PP tolerant thick-oxide gates a severe risk to manufacturing line reservation.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transient simulation milestones must reconcile full post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX R+C+CC) runtimes with the tapeout timeline. Monte Carlo 1000-point statistical runs across supply margins (1.62V to 1.98V) and temperature variations must converge within 72 compute-hours to prevent blocking layout freeze and mask fabrication scheduling for the DRAM Foundation VN Gen 2 prototyping vehicle.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Read Inversion / Destructive Latch Flip caused by excessive threshold mismatch (Delta V_th > 12 mV) in the cross-coupled NMOS pair prior to signal development exceeding latch input offset voltage.
1. V_BLP Mid-Rail Offset Drift due to subthreshold leakage or unequal charge injection from EQ pass-gate control switches, shrinking differential readout margin below 50 mV.
1. Crowbar Overcurrent and Internal Rail Collapse triggered by premature PMOS latch activation (SAP asserted simultaneously with SAN pulldown switch).

Initialize full-rail bitline conditions: BL = 1.8V, /BL = 0.0V, SAN = 0.0V, SAP = 1.8V. 2. De-assert SAN/SAP latch drive switches to high-impedance state at t = 1.0 ns. 3. | `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-02` | **Signal Development and Regenerative Sensing Latency SPICE Verification** | Monte Carlo SPICE engine executing 1000 runs with process and mismatch Gaussian distributions, extracting transient node waveforms V(BL), V(/BL), V(SAN), and V(SAP). | 1. De-assert EQ (1.8V to 0V) at t = 1.0 ns. 2. Fire wordline WL (0V to 2.8V at t = 1.5 ns) to dump cell charge onto BL. 3. Measure signal development voltage Delta V_sig = V(/BL) - V(BL) at t = 3.5 ns (2.0 ns charge-sharing window). 4. Fire SAN pulldown switch at t = 3.5 ns. 5. Fire SAP pullup switch at t = 4.8 ns (1.3 ns inter-latch delay). 6. Measure 90% full-rail regeneration time t_restore. | `Signal development Delta V_sig must reach >= 85.0 mV at t = 3.5 ns across all 3-sigma Monte Carlo corners. Regenerative sensing must achieve |V(/BL) - V(BL)| >= 1.62 V (90% of V_DD) within <= 4.20 ns from SAN activation with zero read-inversion errors.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: ANSI Z87.1 certified ESD safety glasses, Class 100 cleanroom compliant antistatic nitrile gloves, Static dissipative lab coat with continuous wrist-strap ground connection
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Eye contact: Flush with sterile isotonic eyewash solution for at least 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Skin contact: Wash immediately with soap and water; remove contaminated clothing. Inhalation: Relocate personnel to well-ventilated fresh air area; administer supplemental oxygen if breathing becomes labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Standard cleanroom recirculating HEPA filtration operating at 0.45 m/s laminar flow velocity with supplemental dedicated local solvent exhaust duct (minimum face velocity 0.5 m/s) for cleaning simulation bench equipment and terminal fixtures.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent wiping materials and solvent residues into dedicated, conductive, closed-top flammables containers with flame arrestor caps; dispose of via certified hazardous chemical waste handlers complying with environmental regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `240 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: PDK BSIM4 compact models extracted, validated against foundry parametric test PCM structures, and calibrated for post-layout parasitic extraction DRC/LVS cleanliness.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Fully signed-off SPICE netlists with annotated R+C back-annotation, transient waveform databases, and Monte Carlo statistical distribution archives ready for subarray layout pitch-matching.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout-to-simulation iteration cycle times leads to architectural specification drift between peripheral column decoders and sense amplifier arrays, invalidating timing margin assumptions and causing timing closure failure.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified transient sensing dynamics and bitline equalization deck confirming stable half-V_DD reference equilibration, robust differential signal development (Delta V >= 85 mV), and regenerative latching without crowbar overcurrent under PVT corners (SS/TT/FF, 1.62V-1.98V, -40°C to 125°C).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1T1C Bitline Parasitics & Equalizer SPICE Netlist Preparation

**Task Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Transient Sensing & Bitline Margin Monte Carlo Simulation > Transient Sensing Dynamics & Bitline Equalization SPICE Simulation > **1T1C Bitline Parasitics & Equalizer SPICE Netlist Preparation**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Architecture Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Unit Cell Geometry   │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Folded Bitline RC    │
│   Parasitic Netlist    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Bitline Equalizer    │
│   Network Subcircuit   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Simulation Transient  │
│     Control Setup      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Delta V    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Parameter Extraction & 1T1C Subcircuit Definition**
   - Define the subcircuit for the 180nm access MOSFET with nominal channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate oxide physical thickness is set to $T_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Parameterize cell storage capacitance $C_s$ to nominal $25\text{ fF}$ (stack/trench budget range: $25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$, minimum requirement $28\text{ fF}$).
   - Set cell leakage current to $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across junction/subthreshold leakage paths.

2. **Folded Bitline RC Parasitic Netlist Generation**
   - Establish complementary folded bitline tracks (`BL` and `/BL`) modeled with bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Partition total lumped bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ into a multi-stage distributed $\pi$-ladder subcircuit representing contact sharing (shared bitline contact per 2 adjacent cells) and wire inter-line coupling parasitics.

3. **Bitline Equalizer & Precharge Subcircuit Implementation**
   - Synthesize the equalization transistor network across complementary nodes `BL` and `/BL`:
     - Cross-equalizer bridging transistor connected between `BL` and `/BL` driven by control signal `EQ`.
     - Dual precharge pull-up/pull-down transistors routing the precharge reference level $V_{EQ} = V_{DD} / 2$ to both `BL` and `/BL` simultaneously.
   - Size equalizer switches to guarantee rapid, symmetric voltage collapse toward $V_{DD}/2$ during the precharge phase prior to wordline activation.

4. **Transient Simulation Control & Signal Development Deck Setup**
   - Instantiate precharge conditioning pulse: assert `EQ` high to precharge both bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$, then de-assert `EQ` prior to wordline assertion.
   - Apply wordline assertion pulse ($V_{WL}$) to access transistor gate to initiate charge dump:
     $$Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$$
   - Formulate transient `.tran` directive and monitor signal development:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Condition | Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0$ to $28.0$ | Min $25\text{ fF}$, typical $28\text{ fF}$ ($\ge 25\text{ fF}$ retention budget) | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250.0$ | $\pm 10\%$ target extraction budget | $\text{fF}$ |
| **Access Transistor Dimensions ($W / L$)** | $220 / 180$ | Drawn geometry: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0$ to $150.0$ | Evaluated across bitline pairs after cell dump | $\text{mV}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage Target** | $< 1.0$ | At operating temperature of $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Folded bitline precharge to $V_{DD}/2$ using an equalization network.
  - Charge sharing model $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ and differential voltage formula $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Reference parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}\text{--}150\text{ mV}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between two adjacent memory cells.
  - Storage capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ folded bitline cell layout with storage capacitor maintaining $25\text{ fF}\text{--}30\text{ fF}$.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$.
  - Gate dielectric physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\text{SiO}_2$ thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The netlist architecture must rigorously integrate distributed RC segments (at least 32 to 64 π-rungs per bitline pair) rather than lumped C_BL models to capture propagation delay, cross-coupling capacitance (C_c) between adjacent folded lines, and wire resistance across 512 cells per column. Without distributed modeling, equalization settling times and signal development margins (target Delta V >= 100 mV from C_s = 28 fF against C_BL ~ 250 fF) will be severely optimistic, masking potential sense amplifier read disturb and kickback noise into the V_DD/2 precharge generation plane.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The bitline equalizer subcircuit requires careful sizing of the shorting switch (equalizer NMOS) and half-VDD precharge pass gates. Channel length must stay at 180nm while matching threshold voltage profiles to prevent differential offset during precharge release. Leakage through unselected 1T1C access transistors (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm) over 511 unselected wordlines must be accounted for across PVT corners (FF/SS/TT at -40°C to 125°C), ensuring sub-threshold and junction leakages below 1 fA/cell do not introduce static offset before sense amplification strobe (SAN/SAP).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Model card parameters must strictly adhere to the open-source 180nm foundry PDK (e.g., SkyWater/TSMC-compatible 180nm generic rules) using qualified BSIM4/BSIM3v3.2 parameters for both standard VT and low-leakage thick-oxide or high-k stacked MIM/ONO capacitor layers. Sourcing proprietary foundry parameters without open redistributable licensing risks stalling tape-out verification and community silicon shuttle qualification.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery of this SPICE deck directly gates the transient sensing Monte Carlo simulations and array floorplan sign-off. The netlist generation script must be fully automated, parametrically sweepable across array depth (128, 256, 512 cells), and version-controlled with automated regression tests before the planned tape-out freeze to ensure layout-vs-schematic (LVS) consistency.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline equalization residual offset: Incomplete precharge or charge injection mismatch from the EQ gate turning off creates Delta V_offset > 15 mV, leading to false read evaluation during cell charge sharing.
1. Adjacent bitline capacitive cross-coupling failure: Inadequate folded-bitline routing shielding induces > 30 mV cross-talk voltage bounce from switching neighbor lines, overriding the 100-150 mV signal development margin.
1. Parasitic RC netlist convergence breakdown: Stiff numerical matrices arising from floating node stacked capacitor models (C_s = 28 fF) combined with distributed R_BL lines trigger transient simulation timestep reduction (timestep too small) in open-source SPICE engines.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-1-01` | **Bitline Equalization Residual Offset and Settling Transient Verification** | Ngspice / Xyce Transient Simulation Engine with .TRAN 10ps 20ns, internal differential voltmeter across BL and /BL nodes. | Assert EQ control signal to 1.8V with 100ps rise time. Measure node voltages V(BL) and V(/BL) from t = 0 to t = 5ns. De-assert EQ to 0.0V at t = 5ns with 100ps fall time. Record final settled differential offset Delta V_diff = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at t = 6ns. | `Settling time to |V(BL) - 0.9V| <= 5 mV and |V(/BL) - 0.9V| <= 5 mV must be <= 1.8 ns. Differential residual offset |V(BL) - V(/BL)| after EQ shutoff at t = 6ns must be <= 3.0 mV.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-1-02` | **1T1C Signal Development Differential Voltage and Margin Validation** | SPICE Monte Carlo Analysis Engine (N=500 runs) executing transient simulation measuring Delta V_signal = V(BL) - V(/BL) post wordline assertion. | Assert Wordline (WL) from 0V to boosted V_PP (2.8V) with 200ps slew. Allow charge sharing between cell capacitor and BL for 2.0 ns prior to sense amplifier strobe (SAN/SAP activation). Evaluate V(BL) - V(/BL) across TT, FF, and SS process corners at 27°C and 85°C. | `Differential signal development |V(BL) - V(/BL)| must measure >= 95.0 mV across all process corners and >= 85.0 mV across 3-sigma Monte Carlo variations.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`

critics.systems_engineer: The netlist architecture must rigorously integrate distributed RC segments (at least 32 to 64 π-rungs per bitline pair) rather than lumped C_BL models to capture propagation delay, cross-coupling capacitance (C_c) between adjacent folded lines, and wire resistance across 512 cells per column. Without distributed modeling, equalization settling times and signal development margins (target Delta V >= 100 mV from C_s = 28 fF against C_BL ~ 250 fF) will be severely optimistic, masking potential sense amplifier read disturb and kickback noise into the V_DD/2 precharge generation plane.
critics.domain_expert: The bitline equalizer subcircuit requires careful sizing of the shorting switch (equalizer NMOS) and half-VDD precharge pass gates. Channel length must stay at 180nm while matching threshold voltage profiles to prevent differential offset during precharge release. Leakage through unselected 1T1C access transistors (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm) over 511 unselected wordlines must be accounted for across PVT corners (FF/SS/TT at -40°C to 125°C), ensuring sub-threshold and junction leakages below 1 fA/cell do not introduce static offset before sense amplification strobe (SAN/SAP).
critics.supply_chain: Model card parameters must strictly adhere to the open-source 180nm foundry PDK (e.g., SkyWater/TSMC-compatible 180nm generic rules) using qualified BSIM4/BSIM3v3.2 parameters for both standard VT and low-leakage thick-oxide or high-k stacked MIM/ONO capacitor layers. Sourcing proprietary foundry parameters without open redistributable licensing risks stalling tape-out verification and community silicon shuttle qualification.
critics.laya_pm: Delivery of this SPICE deck directly gates the transient sensing Monte Carlo simulations and array floorplan sign-off. The netlist generation script must be fully automated, parametrically sweepable across array depth (128, 256, 512 cells), and version-controlled with automated regression tests before the planned tape-out freeze to ensure layout-vs-schematic (LVS) consistency.
critical_failure_modes: Bitline equalization residual offset: Incomplete precharge or charge injection mismatch from the EQ gate turning off creates Delta V_offset > 15 mV, leading to false read evaluation during cell charge sharing.

Adjacent bitline capacitive cross-coupling failure: Inadequate folded-bitline routing shielding induces > 30 mV cross-talk voltage bounce from switching neighbor lines, overriding the 100-150 mV signal development margin.

Parasitic RC netlist convergence breakdown: Stiff numerical matrices arising from floating node stacked capacitor models (C_s = 28 fF) combined with distributed R_BL lines trigger transient simulation timestep reduction (timestep too small) in open-source SPICE engines.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Transient Equalization & Charge-Sharing Sense Dynamics Simulation

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Simulation Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  BL/NBL Equalization  │
│         VDD/2         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Wordline Assertion   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Charge-Sharing     │
│  Signal Development   │
│        Delta V        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Sense Amplifier    │
│  Activation SAN/SAP   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full-Rail       │
│     Restoration &     │
│        Readout        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Precharge & Equalization Phase Setup**:
   - Instantiate the complementary bitline pair ($BL$ and $/BL$) with lump parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ and an interleaved layout pitch matching $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Configure the equalization transistor network to short $BL$ and $/BL$ and bias them to $V_{DD}/2$ prior to wordline activation.
   - Run a transient initialization sweep to verify equalization settle to $V_{DD}/2$.

2. **Access Transistor & Storage Cell Model Configuration**:
   - Netlist the 1T1C unit cell with an access transistor of channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Connect the access transistor drain terminal via a tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) model to a stacked capacitor ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, nominal $25\text{ fF} - 28\text{ fF}$) employing high-$\kappa$ dielectric ($\kappa > 15$, such as ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
   - Set cell sub-threshold and junction leakage models to enforce $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Wordline Assertion & Differential Charge-Sharing Dynamic Analysis**:
   - Initialize cell pre-stored voltage levels for both Data '1' ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$) and Data '0' ($V_{cell} = 0\text{ V}$).
   - Turn off the equalization network, then assert the wordline ($WL$) high to turn on the access transistor.
   - Dump cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto $BL$ while maintaining $/BL$ at reference level $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Monitor dynamic charge sharing and quantify the developed differential voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$

4. **Sense Amplifier Latch Activation & Full-Rail Restoration**:
   - Trigger the CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch via differential strobe drivers: assert $SAN$ pulling to $\text{GND}$ and $SAP$ pulling to $V_{DD}$.
   - Record transient waveforms driving $BL$ and $/BL$ to rail CMOS levels ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) to confirm $100\%$ cell charge restoration and readout latching integrity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Stacked MIM/Crown capacitor extraction |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Measured at end of charge-sharing window ($C_s = 25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$) |
| **Cell Junction & Sub-threshold Leakage** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Transient leakage current measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Sense Amplifier Pitch Constraint** | $360.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical pitch match to memory array bitlines (180nm node) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ via equalization transistor network.
  - Charge-sharing equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Parasitic and signal metrics: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, leading to $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV} \text{ to } 150\text{ mV}$.
  - Latch activation: $SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$, driving full-rail $0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$ levels and restoring charge to $100\%$.
  - Interleaved layout pitch matching array bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit access transistor dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Connection: Tungsten plug ($W\text{-plug}$) to stacked capacitor (crown/MIM) over bitline (COB).
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric layer: ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$.
  - Minimum cell capacitance budget: $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.
  - Leakage current budget: $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm standard CMOS node, operating at V_DD = 1.8V with boosted V_PP = 2.8V introduces extreme reliability hazards across access device thin-oxide gates. Furthermore, parasitic substrate coupling and bitline-to-bitline inter-wire capacitive crosstalk (C_c) during simultaneous 512-column sensing can inject over 35mV of common-mode and differential noise into adjacent unselected bitlines. The transient simulation setup must comprehensively extract 3D field-solver bitline parasitics and couple common-source latch distribution rails (SAN/SAP) across the bank rather than treating them as ideal zero-impedance lumped voltage sources.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Signal development margin is governed by Delta_V = (C_s / (C_BL + C_s)) * (V_cell - V_BLP). For typical 180nm planar/recessed capacitors with C_s = 25 fF and folded bitline capacitance C_BL = 250 fF (ratio ~ 10:1), reading cell data '0' from an under-refreshed storage node (degraded to 0.3V) yields a Delta_V under 120mV. The critical danger is timing skew between NMOS pull-down activation (SAN) and PMOS pull-up (SAP). Triggering SAN prematurely before the differential bitline voltage exceeds the 3-sigma mismatch offset voltage of the cross-coupled pair (V_os > 25mV due to threshold and layout asymmetry) causes catastrophic latch reversal and cell corruption.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source wafer fabrication at 180nm requires strict adherence to open-access PDK device parameter models (e.g., SkyWater 180nm or open commercial equivalents). Access to high-voltage thick-oxide transistors (5V dual-gate oxide) for boosted wordline driver circuits (V_PP generation) must be preserved without invoking proprietary custom implant layers. Using standard foundry core 1.8V NMOS devices for cell access risks dielectric breakdown under accelerated testing unless the PDK's native medium-voltage device options are certified in the open MPW run schedule.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Design signoff for the folded sense amplifier and bitline equalizer block must strictly demonstrate layout pitch-matching to the DRAM bitline pair grid (pitch <= 0.56 µm per column in 180nm). Failure to model layout parasitic resistance along the bitline equalization line (BLEQ) will lead to incomplete charge sharing within the specified 3.5 ns precharge window, causing yield loss across edge columns during row-cycle testing (t_RP). SPICE simulations must pass full post-layout corner analysis before mask taped-out milestones.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Dynamic Sense Inversion: Asymmetric V_th mismatch (>28 mV) in the cross-coupled pair combined with common-mode noise during early SAN pull-down causes the latch to regenerate in reverse, flipping the stored bit during restore.
1. Incomplete Bitline Equalization: Insufficient gate overdrive or excessive RC delay on the BLEQ equalization transistor network leaves a residual offset |V_BL - V_BLB| > 15 mV prior to wordline activation, eliminating differential sensing margin.
1. Substrate Injection & Latch-Up: Rapid transient pulling of SAN below V_SS due to inductive bond-wire ringing (L_SAN * di/dt) forward-biases the n+/p-well junctions of sense amplifier NMOS pairs, causing destructive substrate current injection.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-2-01` | **Transient Charge-Sharing and Read Latch Margin Verification** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre / Ngspice Transient Engine with 0.1 ps maximum timestep, high-precision matrix solver (reltol=1e-5), and automated post-processing waveform measurement script. | 1. Assert BLEQ high (1.8V) for 5.0 ns to establish equilibrium V_BL = V_BLB = 0.810V. 2. De-assert BLEQ to 0V at t = 5.0 ns with 200 ps fall time. 3. Assert Wordline (WL) to boosted V_PP = 2.8V at t = 6.0 ns with 500 ps rise time. 4. Allow charge-sharing development for exactly 2.5 ns. 5. Measure differential signal Delta_V = V_BLB - V_BL at t = 8.5 ns. 6. Fire SAN pulldown switch at t = 8.5 ns (100 ps transition to 0V). 7. Fire SAP pullup switch at t = 10.0 ns (100 ps transition to 1.62V). 8. Measure final restored levels on BL and BLB at t = 18.0 ns. | `Delta_V at t = 8.5 ns must be >= 95 mV. Differential latching must regenerate correctly without inversion: V_BL at t = 18.0 ns must be <= 50 mV (restored '0') and V_BLB must be >= 1.57 V (restored '1'). Latch decision time to 90% rail separation must be <= 4.2 ns.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-2-02` | **Equalization Dynamic Settling and Residual Bitline Offset Test** | SPICE Transient Simulation with Monte Carlo mismatch engine (2000 runs, local transistor Delta_Vth and Delta_W/L mismatch enabled), transient waveform differential integrator. | 1. Hold SAN at 0V and SAP at V_DD until t = 2.0 ns. 2. Disconnect SAN/SAP drivers (float latch rails to high impedance) at t = 2.0 ns. 3. Pulse equalization control signal BLEQ from 0V to 1.8V with 150 ps edge rate at t = 2.5 ns. 4. Monitor transient convergence of V_BL and V_BLB toward V_BLP (0.99V) across a 3.5 ns equalization window. 5. Sample instantaneous voltage difference Delta_V_eq = |V_BL - V_BLB| at t = 6.0 ns across all 2000 Monte Carlo runs. | `Nominal residual equalization offset Delta_V_eq at t = 6.0 ns must be <= 3.0 mV. 3-sigma worst-case residual offset across 2000 Monte Carlo mismatch iterations must be <= 8.5 mV. Net current drawn from V_BLP supply during steady-state post-equalization must be <= 150 nA per bitline pair.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level A chemical splash suit with dual-sealed butyl rubber gloves, Full-face respirator with multi-gas/vapor and HF-rated P100 particulate cartridge, Chemical-resistant neoprene safety boots with steel toe compliance, Polycarbonate wrap-around impact-resistant safety goggles over prescription eyewear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately flush affected cutaneous area with cold copious water for exactly 2 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into the skin until pain subsides; seek emergency medical support. For ocular exposure: Flush with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate eye wash solution for 15 minutes. For inhalation: Relocate to fresh air and administer 100% oxygen with nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate under physician direction.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Continuous point-of-use scrubbed wet-exhaust ventilation operating at negative face velocity >= 120 FPM (0.61 m/s) with real-time HF electrochemical gas leak monitoring calibrated to trigger automated interlocks at 0.5 ppm threshold.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Fluoride-bearing acidic effluents must be segregated into dedicated PVDF piping, treated with Calcium Hydroxide (Slaked Lime, Ca(OH)2) to precipitate insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2), followed by mechanical clarifier settling, secondary filtration, and pH adjustment (6.5 to 8.5) before municipal sewer discharge.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `8 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, hydrogen-passivated silicon surface post-DHF (0.5% HF) dip, free of particulate contamination (>0.18 µm particle count <= 12 defects/wafer) and organic residue.

For typical 180nm planar/recessed capacitors with C_s = 25 fF and folded bitline capacitance C_BL = 250 fF (ratio ~ 10:1), reading cell data '0' from an under-refreshed storage node (degraded to 0.3V) yields a Delta_V under 120mV. The critical danger is timing skew between NMOS pull-down activation (SAN) and PMOS pull-up (SAP). Triggering SAN prematurely before the differential bitline voltage exceeds the 3-sigma mismatch offset voltage of the cross-coupled pair (V_os > 25mV due to threshold and layout asymmetry) causes catastrophic latch reversal and cell corruption.
critics.supply_chain: Open-source wafer fabrication at 180nm requires strict adherence to open-access PDK device parameter models (e.g., SkyWater 180nm or open commercial equivalents). Access to high-voltage thick-oxide transistors (5V dual-gate oxide) for boosted wordline driver circuits (V_PP generation) must be preserved without invoking proprietary custom implant layers. Using standard foundry core 1.8V NMOS devices for cell access risks dielectric breakdown under accelerated testing unless the PDK's native medium-voltage device options are certified in the open MPW run schedule.
critics.laya_pm: Design signoff for the folded sense amplifier and bitline equalizer block must strictly demonstrate layout pitch-matching to the DRAM bitline pair grid (pitch <= 0.56 µm per column in 180nm). Failure to model layout parasitic resistance along the bitline equalization line (BLEQ) will lead to incomplete charge sharing within the specified 3.5 ns precharge window, causing yield loss across edge columns during row-cycle testing (t_RP). SPICE simulations must pass full post-layout corner analysis before mask taped-out milestones.
critical_failure_modes: Dynamic Sense Inversion: Asymmetric V_th mismatch (>28 mV) in the cross-coupled pair combined with common-mode noise during early SAN pull-down causes the latch to regenerate in reverse, flipping the stored bit during restore.

Incomplete Bitline Equalization: Insufficient gate overdrive or excessive RC delay on the BLEQ equalization transistor network leaves a residual offset |V_BL - V_BLB| > 15 mV prior to wordline activation, eliminating differential sensing margin.

Substrate Injection & Latch-Up: Rapid transient pulling of SAN below V_SS due to inductive bond-wire ringing (L_SAN * di/dt) forward-biases the n+/p-well junctions of sense amplifier NMOS pairs, causing destructive substrate current injection.

testcases.title: Transient Charge-Sharing and Read Latch Margin Verification
testcases.instrumentation: Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre / Ngspice Transient Engine with 0.1 ps maximum timestep, high-precision matrix solver (reltol=1e-5), and automated post-processing waveform measurement script.
testcases.pre_conditions: PDK BSIM4 corner models loaded at Slow-Slow (SS) corner, T = 85°C, V_DD = 1.62V (-10%), V_BLP = 0.81V, C_BL = 275 fF (nominal + 10%), C_s = 22.5 fF (nominal - 10%), V_cell initialized to 0.2V (degraded Data '0').
testcases.procedure: 1. Assert BLEQ high (1.8V) for 5.0 ns to establish equilibrium V_BL = V_BLB = 0.810V. 2. De-assert BLEQ to 0V at t = 5.0 ns with 200 ps fall time. 3. Assert Wordline (WL) to boosted V_PP = 2.8V at t = 6.0 ns with 500 ps rise time. 4. Allow charge-sharing development for exactly 2.5 ns. 5. Measure differential signal Delta_V = V_BLB - V_BL at t = 8.5 ns. 6. Fire SAN pulldown switch at t = 8.5 ns (100 ps transition to 0V). 7. Fire SAP pullup switch at t = 10.0 ns (100 ps transition to 1.62V). 8. Measure final restored levels on BL and BLB at t = 18.0 ns.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Delta_V at t = 8.5 ns must be >= 95 mV. Differential latching must regenerate correctly without inversion: V_BL at t = 18.0 ns must be <= 50 mV (restored '0') and V_BLB must be >= 1.57 V (restored '1'). Latch decision time to 90% rail separation must be <= 4.2 ns.

testcases.title: Equalization Dynamic Settling and Residual Bitline Offset Test
testcases.instrumentation: SPICE Transient Simulation with Monte Carlo mismatch engine (2000 runs, local transistor Delta_Vth and Delta_W/L mismatch enabled), transient waveform differential integrator.
testcases.pre_conditions: PDK corner Fast-Fast (FF) and Typical-Typical (TT), T = 25°C and -40°C, V_DD = 1.98V (+10%), BL initialized to full V_DD (1.98V) and BLB initialized to GND (0.0V) simulating worst-case post-restore precharge state.
testcases.procedure: 1. Hold SAN at 0V and SAP at V_DD until t = 2.0 ns. 2. Disconnect SAN/SAP drivers (float latch rails to high impedance) at t = 2.0 ns. 3. Pulse equalization control signal BLEQ from 0V to 1.8V with 150 ps edge rate at t = 2.5 ns. 4. Monitor transient convergence of V_BL and V_BLB toward V_BLP (0.99V) across a 3.5 ns equalization window. 5. Sample instantaneous voltage difference Delta_V_eq = |V_BL - V_BLB| at t = 6.0 ns across all 2000 Monte Carlo runs.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Nominal residual equalization offset Delta_V_eq at t = 6.0 ns must be <= 3.0 mV. 3-sigma worst-case residual offset across 2000 Monte Carlo mismatch iterations must be <= 8.5 mV. Net current drawn from V_BLP supply during steady-state post-equalization must be <= 150 nA per bitline pair.

ppe_required: Level A chemical splash suit with dual-sealed butyl rubber gloves
Full-face respirator with multi-gas/vapor and HF-rated P100 particulate cartridge
Chemical-resistant neoprene safety boots with steel toe compliance
Polycarbonate wrap-around impact-resistant safety goggles over prescription eyewear

cas_chemicals.name: Hydrofluoric Acid (for pre-gate/pre-capacitor native oxide strip)
cas_chemicals.concentration: 49% aq. diluted to 0.5% for DHF clean

ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately flush affected cutaneous area with cold copious water for exactly 2 minutes, then aggressively massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into the skin until pain subsides; seek emergency medical support. For ocular exposure: Flush with sterile isotonic saline or 1% calcium gluconate eye wash solution for 15 minutes. For inhalation: Relocate to fresh air and administer 100% oxygen with nebulized 2.5% calcium gluconate under physician direction.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-DES-180-042: Differential Sensing Margin & Latch Timing Characterization Analysis
**Discipline:** DRAM Circuit Design / 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) CMOS Folded Bitline Architecture  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Sensing Sequence

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Bitline Precharge   │
│         VDD/2         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Wordline Activation  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Signal Development   │
│        Delta V        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Sense Amp Latch    │
│        SAN/SAP        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Full Rail       │
│      Restoration      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Transient Netlist Parameter Setup**:
   - Instantiate the 1T1C unit cell with access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ connected to the folded bitline pair ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$).
   - Configure the storage cell capacitance $C_s$ to nominal $25\text{ fF}$ (budgeted $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) and lumped bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$.
   - Set operating junction temperature to $85^\circ\text{C}$ with cell sub-threshold/junction leakage modeled below $1\text{ fA/cell}$.

2. **Bitline Equalization & Precharge Phase**:
   - Drive the bitline equalization transistor network gate control to active high prior to wordline assertion.
   - Precharge and equalize both $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ precisely to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.
   - De-assert the equalization signal, leaving bitlines floating in high-impedance mode at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

3. **Wordline Activation & Signal Development ($\Delta V$)**:
   - Assert the wordline ($\text{WL}$) to turn on the access transistor, transferring cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Allow bitline signal development across the folded bitline pair according to:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Probe the developed differential voltage between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ prior to sense amplifier latch triggering.

4. **Latch Timing Assertion & Full-Rail Restoration**:
   - Trigger the sense amplifier control clock: pull the NMOS common pull-down signal ($\text{SAN}$) down toward $V_{\text{SS}}$, followed by driving the PMOS common pull-up signal ($\text{SAP}$) toward $V_{\text{DD}}$.
   - Characterize the latch delay margin between WL assertion and SAN/SAP activation to ensure sensing occurs only after signal development stabilizes above noise margins.
   - Verify differential amplification drives the evaluated bitline to full supply rail ($V_{\text{DD}}$ for Read-1, $V_{\text{SS}}$ for Read-0) to accomplish active cell charge restoration.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Parameter | Minimum | Nominal / Target | Maximum | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0$ | $28.0$ | $30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | SPICE extracted netlist parameter check |
| **Differential Sensing Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0$ | $125.0$ | $150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient voltage delta measurement at $t_{\text{SAN}}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180.0$ | $180.0$ | $180.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Mask geometry / schematic DRC parameter check |
| **Cell Leakage Current (@ $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | — | — | $1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | DC/Transient leakage current integration at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing equation $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{\text{BL}} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$; precharge level $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$; bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$; differential sensing signal range $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to }150\text{ mV}$; latch activation sequence via $\text{SAN}$ and $\text{SAP}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$; folded bitline COB layout; minimum capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell; maximum leakage threshold of $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Storage capacitance spec $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell; retention constraint $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm open-source DRAM architecture (VDD = 1.8V, VBLP = 0.9V, boosted VPP = 2.8V), the folded bitline differential sensing margin is critically bottlenecked by bitline parasitics and latch activation skew. For Cs = 25 fF and CBL = 250 fF, the nominal differential development Delta V is ~81.8 mV for Cell-0 and Cell-1 readout. If SAN pulldown occurs prior to achieving the minimum regenerative threshold (Delta V > 60 mV under 3-sigma offset), premature latching triggers false state inversion. Furthermore, power grid IR-drop and ground bounce on the common source lines (SAN/SAP) across the multi-bank array attenuate regenerative drive strength, stretching tRCD beyond the targeted 15.0 ns budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: CMOS cross-coupled latch matching in 180nm planar bulk CMOS exhibits significant threshold voltage mismatch (sigma_Vth ~ 8-12 mV) dominated by Pelgrom's scaling parameter (Avt ~ 4.5 mV*um) in the NMOS pull-down pair. To ensure robust sensing margin without write-back disturbance, the equalization NMOS network must achieve residual bitline differential mismatch Delta V_offset < 2.0 mV prior to wordline firing. Staggered two-stage latching (SAN fast pulldown followed by SAP activation after a 1.2 ns delay) is required to suppress short-circuit crowbar current and eliminate transient shoot-through charges that degrade cell capacitor full-rail restoration (V_cell = 1.80V).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Implementation relies on standard 180nm 1P6M generic bulk CMOS foundry design kits (such as SkyWater or TSMC 0.18um equivalents). The test silicon characterization requires active picoprobe picosecond-contact wedges, 40 GHz mixed-signal automated test equipment (ATE), and precision sub-picoampere parameter analyzers. Lead times for custom multi-die high-frequency probe cards and cryogenic/thermal chuck adapters (-40C to 125C) exceed 16 weeks; therefore, tape-out GDSII signoff must align strictly with MPW wafer shuttle schedules to avoid multi-quarter schedule slip.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: From a layout and project management perspective, bitline pitch matching to the 180nm memory array demands strict symmetrical layout of the cross-coupled pairs using dummy polysilicon bars and identical diffusion orientations to cancel out shallow trench isolation (STI) stress and lithographic proximity effects. Mask misalignment between poly and active contacts could induce asymmetric parasitic capacitance (Delta C_par > 1.5 fF) on complementary BL//BL lines, degrading effective sensing yield. Deliverables and Monte Carlo SPICE signoff must close before physical mask generation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature SAN latch activation prior to adequate charge development causing state flipping and destructive read inversion on weak cells (Delta V < 50 mV).
1. Bitline equalization offset leakage resulting in precharge skew (|V_BL - V_/BL| > 5 mV), consuming more than 10% of total differential signal margin before wordline assertion.
1. VPP overdrive droop or slow slew rate at the access gate preventing full transfer of cell charge Qs within the t_WL_pulse allocation, causing incomplete restore.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-3-01` | **Differential Bitline Signal Development and Pre-Latch Margin Verification** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre SPICE transient simulator with 10,000-run Monte Carlo (process + mismatch) engine; on-wafer picoprobe station coupled to a Keysight Infiniium 33 GHz oscilloscope and B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer. | 1. Assert equalization signal EQ = 1.8V for 10.0 ns; measure residual offset between BL and /BL. 2. De-assert EQ to 0.0V; wait 1.0 ns. 3. Assert Wordline WL to VPP = 2.8V with 0.8 ns rise time. 4. Monitor bitline differential voltage development Delta V(t) = |V(BL) - V(/BL)| at 1.5 ns, 2.0 ns, and 2.5 ns post-WL firing before SAN activation. 5. Record 3-sigma worst-case Delta V across corner variations (TT, SS, FF, SF, FS). | `Equalization residual offset |V_BL - V_/BL| <= 2.0 mV at t = 10.0 ns. Signal development Delta V >= 75.0 mV at t = 2.0 ns post-WL assertion across all corners and 3-sigma mismatch.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-2-2-3-02` | **Two-Stage Regenerative Latch Timing and Full-Rail Charge Restoration Characterization** | Mixed-signal mixed-domain oscilloscope (Teledyne LeCroy 65 GHz LabMaster), fast-switching pulse generator (< 100 ps edge rates), and SPICE transient sensitivity simulator. | 1. Drive SAN enable pulse with variable delay t_SAN (1.5 ns to 3.5 ns relative to WL assertion). 2. Sweep inter-stage latch delay Delta t_SAN_SAP from 0.4 ns to 2.5 ns before asserting SAP (active low PMOS switch). 3. Measure dV/dt slew rate on BL and /BL during regenerative phase. 4. Measure bitline restore levels V(BL_high) and V(BL_low) at t = 15.0 ns. 5. Monitor peak supply transient current I_peak(VDD) and ground bounce amplitude V_bounce(VSS). | `Regenerative rail separation t_sep (time to reach 10% to 90% full swing: 0.18V to 1.62V) <= 3.2 ns. Restored high rail V(BL_high) >= 1.76V (>= 98% VDD), restored low rail V(BL_low) <= 0.04V. Peak ground bounce <= 65 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash apron and Nitrile double-gloves over chemical-resistant butyl gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved full-face shield and impact-resistant safety goggles, Flame-resistant anti-static cleanroom coveralls with conductive ESD footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately rinse contact zone with copious flowing water for 5 minutes, followed by continuous massage of 2.5% Calcium Gluconate topical gel into the skin until medical emergency responders arrive. For eye contact: Irrigate eyes with sterile 1.0% calcium gluconate eye wash solution for a minimum of 15 minutes. Inhalation: Move victim immediately to fresh air, administer 100% oxygen, and monitor for pulmonary edema.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated acid wet-bench exhaust hoods with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM), routed directly to dynamic packed-bed wet scrubbers utilizing caustic (NaOH) dosing for fluoride and sulfur oxide neutralization.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent fluoride effluents into dedicated PVDF carboys; neutralize using saturated calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry to precipitate insoluble calcium fluoride (CaF2) cake; filter solid sludge and adjust final supernatant liquid pH between 6.5 and 8.5 prior to industrial wastewater discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (aqueous buffered oxide etch for pre-metallization clean)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `6.0% HF / 30.0% NH4F buffer` |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (rinse and wafer dry agent)** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (SEMI-C1) | `99.9%` |
| **Sulfuric Acid (Piranha wafer surface decontamination)** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI Grade | `96.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-clean post-CMP planarized oxide surface, hydrophobic and free of native oxide regrowth, organic particulates, and metallic contaminants (surface Cu/Fe < 1e10 atoms/cm2).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated contact vias or silicon metallization layers under dry nitrogen seal, surface moisture < 5 ppm, zero moisture condensation on bond-pad metal interfaces.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Uncontrolled ambient humidity induces galvanic corrosion on exposed aluminum/tungsten contact plugs and promotes uncontrolled native oxide growth on polysilicon/silicide gates, shifting sense amplifier transistor Vth by > 15 mV and destroying matched differential balance.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Comprehensive transient sensing margin, equalization stability, and regenerative latch timing characterization signoff report for the 180nm folded bitline DRAM sense amplifier across all PVT corners and statistical Monte Carlo runs.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `DRAM180_SenseAmp_Transient_Margin_Analysis.pdf`
- [ ] `DRAM180_MonteCarlo_Offset_Distribution_Data.csv`
- [ ] `DRAM180_Latch_Timing_Waveforms_EyeDiagram.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Pre-sensing bitline differential voltage development at 2.0 ns post-wordline activation across 10,000 Monte Carlo iterations** | `81.8 mV` | +/- 12.0 mV | Transient SPICE Monte Carlo simulation with Pelgrom mismatch models and on-silicon micro-probing validation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Total sense amplifier regenerative latch restoration time to reach 95% full VDD (1.71V) rail** | `4.8 ns` | +/- 0.6 ns | SPICE transient analysis calibrated against ATE high-speed digital oscilloscope transition timestamps |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Bitline precharge equalization residual voltage offset prior to wordline assertion** | `0.0 mV` | +/- 1.8 mV | DC and transient high-impedance differential voltage probing at bitline pair test structures |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero read errors across 10,000 Monte Carlo runs under extreme corners (SS/FF/SF/FS at -40C to 125C, VDD +/- 10%), measured Delta V >= 65 mV under 3-sigma worst-case mismatch, bitline restored high level >= 1.76V, and formal approval by Systems Architecture and Layout Council Leads.
