**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Frozen, pitch-matched (360 nm bitline grid) folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier and precharge/equalization layout cell block, fully verified against 180nm DRC, LVS, and parasitic RC symmetry extraction, demonstrating dynamic input offset under 12 mV (3-sigma) and sensing delay under 1.85 ns across PVT corners.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Interleaved Sense Amp & Precharge Pitch-Matched Layout Floorplanning

**Project**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Node / Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Task Classification**: Circuit Design & Physical Layout (`Make`)  

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the physical floorplanning, pitch matching, and layout methodology for the CMOS folded-bitline regenerative sense amplifier (N-Sense/P-Sense) and precharge/equalization circuitry. 

In the 180nm process node, the memory array bitline pitch is **360 nm**. To fit the complex multi-transistor sense amplifier and precharge networks within this tightly constrained pitch without DRC violations, an **interleaved layout architecture** (alternating pitch matching across both sides of the memory sub-array) must be floorplanned and routed.

---

## 2. Layout Architecture & Floorplan Topology

```text
    +--------------------------------------------------------+
    |        Top Interleaved Sense Amp / Precharge Bank      |
    |   (Services Even Bitline Pairs: BL0//BL0, BL2//BL2)    |
    +========================================================+
    |                                                        |
    |                   DRAM Cell Array                      |
    |            Bitline Pitch: 360 nm (0.36 µm)             |
    |                                                        |
    +========================================================+
    |       Bottom Interleaved Sense Amp / Precharge Bank    |
    |    (Services Odd Bitline Pairs: BL1//BL1, BL3//BL3)    |
    +--------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pitch Matching via Dual-Bank Interleaving**:
   - Local array bitline pair spacing: $2 \times 360\text{ nm} = 720\text{ nm}$.
   - Interleaving splits alternating bitline pairs between the top and bottom of the subarray, expanding the effective layout allocation per sense amp strip to **$720\text{ nm}$ pitch width**.
2. **Circuit Strip Organization**:
   - **Section A (Equalizer / Precharge Network)**: 3-transistor NMOS precharge block connecting to $V_{\text{BLP}} = V_{\text{DD}}/2$ and gate controlled by signal `EQ`.
   - **Section B (N-Sense Amplifier - NSA)**: Cross-coupled NMOS latch pair tied to common source pull-down line `SAN` (switching from $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ to $\text{GND}$).
   - **Section C (P-Sense Amplifier - PSA)**: Cross-coupled PMOS latch pair tied to common source pull-up line `SAP` (switching from $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ to $V_{\text{DD}}$).

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

### Step 1: Sub-Array Boundary & Pitch Frame Definition
1. Set the physical grid pitch reference: Place active column rails on a strict **360 nm** bitline center-to-center pitch.
2. Route even column pairs ($\text{BL}_0, \overline{\text{BL}}_0$) through the top boundary and odd column pairs ($\text{BL}_1, \overline{\text{BL}}_1$) through the bottom boundary to create the **720 nm** physical window per sense amplifier block.
3. Align metal-1 (M1) or metal-2 (M2) bitline tracks symmetrically to maintain strictly identical parasitic capacitance on true and complementary bitlines ($C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).

### Step 2: Equalization & Precharge Transistor Layout
1. Place three NMOS equalization transistors at the array boundary entrance:
   - One transistor bridging $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
   - Two transistors connecting $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to the precision $V_{\text{BLP}}$ supply line ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
2. Connect gates of all three equalization transistors to the common `EQ` control signal rail.
3. Ensure contact and diffusion symmetrical matching between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to minimize differential offset voltage during turn-off.

### Step 3: N-Sense Amp (NSA) Cross-Coupled Core Placement
1. Lay out the cross-coupled NMOS pair inside the 720 nm boundary envelope.
2. Cross-couple the poly gates and drain diffusions symmetrically using cross-over routing in Metal 1 / Contact plugs.
3. Tie the NMOS source diffusions directly to the horizontal common pulldown bus `SAN`.
4. Ensure the `SAN` line is sized with low resistance to support rapid discharge during N-sense latching.

### Step 4: P-Sense Amp (PSA) Core Placement & N-Well Isolation
1. Lay out the cross-coupled PMOS pair in an adjacent dedicated N-well strip.
2. Maintain design rule spacing between the NMOS array substrate and the PMOS N-well.
3. Cross-couple the PMOS gates and drains identically matching the NSA topology.
4. Route PMOS sources to the common horizontal pullup bus `SAP`.
5. Maintain parasitic capacitance symmetry between $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ tracks spanning across the NSA and PSA blocks.

### Step 5: Power Supply & Signal Bus Distribution
1. Route global activation rails (`SAN`, `SAP`, `EQ`, and $V_{\text{BLP}}$) horizontally across all interleaved sense amplifiers using low-resistivity upper metal layers (e.g., M3/M4).
2. Insert decoupling tap cells along $V_{\text{BLP}}$ ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$) to absorb transient charge injection during bitline equalization.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | **Memory Array Bitline Pitch** | **$360\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$** (grid strict) | Physical DRC check on bitline metal line center-to-center spacing |
| **AC-02** | **Interleaved Sense Amp Slot Pitch** | **$720\text{ nm} \pm 0\text{ nm}$** | DRC boundary measurement per interleaved sense amp cell pitch |
| **AC-03** | **Nominal Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$)** | **$250\text{ fF} \pm 10\%$** | Post-layout RC parasitic extraction (PEX) across nominal line length |
| **AC-04** | **Differential Voltage Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | SPICE transient read simulation ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$) |

---

## 5. Literature & Context Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  * Array bitline pitch constraint: *360 nm in 180nm node*, requiring interleaved layout.
  * Bitline equalization to $V_{\text{DD}}/2$ via equalization transistor network.
  * Typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, and differential signal $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  * Full-rail restore via latching signals: `SAN` to $\text{GND}$, `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$.
* **Cross-Coupled Regenerative Sense Amplifier Timing & Charge Restoration**:
  * Equalization Phase: `EQ` high shorting $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$ to precision $V_{\text{BLP}}$ ($V_{\text{DD}}/2$).
  * Wordline boosted overdrive transition ($V_{\text{PP}} = 2.6\text{ V}$ to $2.8\text{ V}$).
  * Phased latching: NMOS pulldown switch pulls `SAN` to $\text{GND}$, followed by PMOS pullup switch pulling `SAP` to $V_{\text{DD}}$ with 1–2 ns delay.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of Interleaved Sense Amp & Precharge Pitch-Matched Layout Floorplanning: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Interleaved Sense Amplifier & Equalizer Pitch Boundary & Cell-to-Core Floorplan Definition

### 1. Document Context & Architecture Scope
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Hierarchy Level**: Generation 2 ($\mu$m) — Circuit Design / Layout Floorplanning
- **Scope**: Pitch boundary matching, bitline interleaving scheme, and cell-to-core interface definition for folded bitline CMOS sense amplifiers and equalization networks.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Start: Cell Array    │
│          Edge          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Boundary Pitch     │
│   Definition: 360 nm   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Interleaving Split:   │
│     Even/Odd Banks     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Pitch Expansion: 720  │
│      nm per Side       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Floorplan        │
│  Integration: SA & EQ  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Cell Array Bitline Pitch Boundary Alignment**:
   - Establish the primary memory cell array boundary at the contact edge of the access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Set the raw cell array bitline pair grid pitch to exactly $360\text{ nm}$ per adjacent complementary bitline line pair ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) following the 180nm folded bitline architecture.

2. **Interleaved Pitch Expansion Configuration**:
   - Split alternating complementary bitline pairs into an interleaved top/bottom floorplan:
     - **Even Bitline Pairs ($BL_0, \overline{BL_0}, BL_2, \overline{BL_2}, \dots$)**: Route toward the upper boundary Sense Amplifier/Equalizer bank.
     - **Odd Bitline Pairs ($BL_1, \overline{BL_1}, BL_3, \overline{BL_3}, \dots$)**: Route toward the lower boundary Sense Amplifier/Equalizer bank.
   - Expand the effective layout pitch allocated for each CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch and equalization circuit from $360\text{ nm}$ to $720\text{ nm}$ ($2 \times$ pitch relaxation), accommodating PMOS/NMOS active diffusion, well taps, and cross-coupling contacts.

3. **Equalizer & Precharge Cell-to-Core Transition Placement**:
   - Place the bitline equalization transistor network directly adjacent to the cell array boundary before the main sense amplifier latch.
   - Route the equalization control rail ($EQ$) and intermediate precharge reference voltage rail ($V_{DD}/2$) orthogonally across the $720\text{ nm}$ interleaved channels.

4. **Sense Amplifier Core Floorplan & Control Rail Routing**:
   - Align the CMOS cross-coupled latch stages downstream of the equalization network.
   - Lay out the bottom NMOS pulldown latch with common node $SAN$ (pulling down to $\text{GND}$) and the top PMOS pullup latch with common node $SAP$ (pulling up to $V_{DD}$).
   - Verify continuous shielding and pitch clearance to keep bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{BL} \le 250\text{ fF}$ against the cell storage node budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$–$28\text{ fF}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline Pitch Boundary** | $360$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC Grid / Pitch Check |
| **Interleaved SA / Equalizer Layout Pitch** | $720$ | $\text{nm}$ | Physical DRC Boundary Dimension Check |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance Budget ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-Layout RC Extraction (PEX / LVS) |
| **Nominal Differential Readout Signal ($\Delta V$)** | $100 \text{ to } 150$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient SPICE Simulation ($\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2})$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Memory array bitline pitch: $360\text{ nm}$ in the 180nm node requiring interleaved layout.
  - Signal development parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Sensing control signals: $SAN$ pulling to $\text{GND}$, $SAP$ pulling to $V_{DD}$, and precharge equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Unit cell transistor geometry: Gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Storage node capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for soft-error immunity and signal integrity.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pitch-matching standard CMOS cross-coupled inverters to the 360 nm 1T1C bitline pitch in a planar 180nm process is physically unachievable within a single-pitch boundary. An interleaved top/bottom floorplan relaxes the active pitch per sense amp to 720 nm (2x bitline pitch), but introduces severe parasitic imbalance between BL and /BL paths due to asymmetric metal routing through the equalizer and isolation gates. The boundary transition between dense memory array bitline capacitance (Cb = 200 fF) and peripheral core routing must be tightly controlled to prevent common-mode noise injection from degrading the nominal 110 mV signal differential.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm, device mismatch (Pelgrom coefficient Avth approx 4.5 mV*um) in the cross-coupled nMOS (SAN) and pMOS (SAP) pairs must not exceed 15 mV standard deviation, or random offset will cause read inversion on worst-case -110 mV sensing margins. The equalizer layout must ensure symmetric VDD/2 (0.9 V) precharge tracking; any threshold skew or layout asymmetry generating >5 mV precharge offset between true and complement bitlines directly erodes 4.5% of the sensing budget. The floorplan boundary must enforce common-centroid layout with dummy poly rings to suppress proximity-induced stress effects.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Implementing interleaved sense amps requires tight lithographic metal-1 and metal-2 pitches (360 nm pitch = 180 nm line/space), pushing the resolution limits of standard 248 nm KrF dry lithography available in open-source MPW shuttles. Overly aggressive poly-to-diffusion overlap or tight contact-to-gate design rules in the boundary region will crater yield or fail DRC waivers at local foundry partners. Standard 0.18 um design kits require relaxed contact enclosures at array pitch edges.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The floorplan boundary definition determines the core-to-cell overhead and die aspect ratio for the 180nm DRAM test vehicle. Failure to freeze the interleaved pitch boundary and equalization strap routing within the current tapeout milestone will cascade into column decoder bus pitch mismatches and delay LVS signoff across the entire memory macro.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Vth mismatch exceeding 25 mV in cross-coupled NMOS latch pairs due to asymmetric lithographic optical proximity effects (OPE) at the pitch transition boundary, causing systematic read data flip.
1. Parasitic capacitance unbalance (Delta C_b > 6 fF) between BL and /BL through asymmetric equalizer routing, reducing the effective sensing margin below the thermal and flicker noise floor.
1. Equalizer leakage or precharge turn-off charge injection skew creating >10 mV differential DC offset prior to wordline activation.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-1-01` | **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance & Layout Symmetry Extraction Test** | Calibre xRC / StarRC Parasitic Extraction Engine, Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer, Cascade Microtech 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station | 1. Run 3D field solver extraction on layout slice including M1 bitlines, equalization NMOS bridges, and top/bottom interleaved sense amp nodes. 2. Measure extracted lump capacitance of BL (even) and /BL (odd) nodes with equalization switch OFF. 3. Simulate equalization switch turn-off transient at T = 25 deg C and 85 deg C with 1.8 V core supply. 4. Measure residual differential offset voltage (V_BL - V_/BL) across 1000 Monte Carlo runs combining Pelgrom mismatch and parasitic imbalance. | `Capacitance unbalance |C_BL - C_/BL| <= 2.0 fF (< 1% of nominal 200 fF bitline capacitance); Precharge equalized level = 0.900 V +/- 5.0 mV; Worst-case differential offset before sensing <= 8.0 mV (3-sigma).` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-1-02` | **Dynamic Sensing Margin & Latch Slew Rate Verification** | Synopsys PrimeSim HSPICE / Cadence Spectre RF with Transient Noise Analysis, Tektronix MSO64B 4 GHz Oscilloscope on micro-probed test structure | 1. Initialize cell to stored '0' (0.0 V) and alternate cell to stored '1' (1.8 V). 2. Assert precharge EQ to 1.8 V to equalize bitlines to 0.9 V, then deassert EQ. 3. Fire wordline (WL = 2.8 V boosted) to dump cell charge onto BL, creating nominal +/- 110 mV delta. 4. Fire SAN (pull to 0V) and SAP (pull to 1.8V) after 2.5 ns delay. 5. Measure time from SAN assert to 90% rail separation (t_LATCH) and verify cell voltage restore level. | `Successful differential rail-to-rail resolution for input delta V >= +/- 35 mV across -40 deg C to 125 deg C; Sensing latch delay t_LATCH <= 4.2 ns; Full charge restore level >= 98.5% of VDD (stored '1') and <= 1.5% of VDD (stored '0').` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374-3 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact splash safety goggles, Class 100 cleanroom anti-static ESD-dissipative polyester lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact, immediately flush skin with copius amounts of water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. In case of vapor inhalation, move victim to fresh air immediately; provide supplemental oxygen if breathing is labored. For eye contact, rinse immediately under eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Seek emergency medical evaluation if irritation persists.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop chemical laminar flow exhaust hood with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 fpm) operating under continuous negative pressure ducting.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent solvent wipes and cleaning rinses into designated sealed, grounded, fire-rated stainless steel flammable solvent waste containers. Segregate completely from halogenated or aqueous acid waste streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropanol (IPA, semiconductor wafer/probe cleaning grade)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI / SEMI Grade 1 | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone (probe tip and surface degreasing)** | `67-64-1` | SEMI Grade 1 | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Passivated, cleanroom-prepped silicon wafer surface or post-M1/M2 unpassivated probe pad metallization free of particulate contamination and organic residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Freshly degreased, dry nitrogen purged Al/Cu metallization contact interface ready for micro-probing parameteric extraction.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide formation (Al2O3 > 3.5 nm) and atmospheric organic moisture adsorption causing non-ohmic probe contact resistance (> 50 ohms), invalidating bitline equalization settling and offset characterization.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Verified pitch-matched layout, extracted schematic, and boundary floorplan DRC/LVS database for the Gen 2 180nm folded bitline interleaved sense amplifier and precharge/equalizer block, establishing a symmetric 720 nm physical block width matching the 360 nm dual-bitline array pitch.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `interleaved_sense_amp_pitch_boundary_floorplan.gds`
- [ ] `folded_sa_equalizer_pex_postlayout_extracted.cir`
- [ ] `cell_to_core_boundary_drc_lvs_signoff_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Physical interleaved layout block pitch per dual-bitline sense amp cell** | `720` | +/- 0 nm | Automated physical DRC and pitch measurement across GDS-II boundary coordinate markers |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Post-layout extracted BL to /BL parasitic capacitance mismatch** | `0.0` | <= 1.5 fF | 3D field solver parasitic extraction (StarRC / Calibre xRC) on full interleaved boundary macro |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Precharge equalization differential DC offset voltage** | `0.0` | <= 5.0 mV | Post-layout transient Monte Carlo SPICE simulation across 1000 runs at 1.8V VDD and 85 deg C |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC violations in Open-Source 180nm rule deck, zero LVS mismatches against golden folded sense amp and equalizer schematic, and 100% pass on ASSERT-01 through ASSERT-03 confirmed by lead IC layout and circuit design signoff engineers.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Pitch-Matched Cross-Coupled Latch & Precharge Pass-Gate Cell Layout Routing

- **Module**: Circuit Design & Physical Layout
- **Node / Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node
- **Specification Document**: [`docs/sop_pitch_matched_cross_coupled_latch_precharge_cell_routing.md`](docs/sop_pitch_matched_cross_coupled_latch_precharge_cell_routing.md)

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  1. Bitline Pitch & Interleave Grid Setup    │
│     (360 nm array pitch boundary alignment)  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  2. Precharge & Equalizer Transistor Layout  │
│     (V_DD/2 precharge pass-gate placement)   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  3. Cross-Coupled Latch Device Placement     │
│     (NMOS SAN to GND, PMOS SAP to V_DD)      │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  4. Symmetric Differential Metal Routing     │
│     (BL and /BL parasitic capacitance match) │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  5. Extraction & Sign-Off Verification       │
│     (DRC/LVS, Delta V: 100-150 mV check)     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Interleaved Pitch Grid & Boundary Definition**:
   - Establish the column pitch boundary locked to the memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$).
   - Set up an interleaved sense amplifier architecture (alternating odd/even column banks) so that each sense amplifier physical layout slot has an expanded pitch boundary ($720\text{ nm}$) to accommodate wide cross-coupled CMOS transistors while matching the $360\text{ nm}$ array line pitch.
2. **Precharge & Equalizer Pass-Gate Network Layout**:
   - Place the equalization pass transistors bridging complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$) and connecting to the $V_{DD}/2$ precharge rail.
   - Route the equalization gate control signal ($EQ$) orthogonal to the bitlines using M1/Poly with minimal RC skew to ensure simultaneous charge equalization across all bitline pairs prior to wordline assertion.
3. **Cross-Coupled Latch Placement & Cross-Under Routing**:
   - Place the cross-coupled NMOS inverter pair connected to the $SAN$ latching node (pulling to GND) and the PMOS inverter pair connected to the $SAP$ latching node (pulling to $V_{DD}$).
   - Route symmetric cross-under gate-drain interconnects using identical metal trace lengths, layer transitions, and via counts to eliminate parasitic imbalance between $BL$ and $/BL$.
4. **Symmetric Folded Bitline Interconnect Routing**:
   - Route complementary bitlines through the sensing strip on parallel metal tracks with identical spacing and boundary shielding.
   - Match parasitic capacitance budgets so total column bitline capacitance sits at $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$ against the cell storage capacitance ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$).
5. **DRC, LVS, and Differential Margin Extraction**:
   - Execute DRC on active diffusion, gate poly, tungsten contact plugs (W-plugs), and lower metal interconnects.
   - Run LVS extraction verifying 1:1 netlist equivalence against the schematic.
   - Perform post-layout Parasitic Extraction (PEX) and transient readout simulation to verify that the signal development margin $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right)\left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ achieves $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ before latching.

---

| **Array Bitline Pitch Matching** | **360** | **nm** | GDS Layout Coordinate & DRC Pitch Rule Check |

| **Minimum Unit Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **25 to 28** | **fF** | Stacked Capacitor 3D Extraction / C-V Metrology |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **100 to 150** | **mV** | Post-Layout SPICE Transient Read Simulation |
| **DRC / LVS Violation Count** | **0** | **Count** | Batch Verification Sign-Off Summary Report |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Local Context

- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Validates folded-bitline CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $/BL$).
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$ prior to wordline assertion.
  - Differential signal development equation: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Defines nominal parameters: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
  - Sensing activation pulling $SAN$ to GND and $SAP$ to $V_{DD}$, driving full CMOS rail levels and restoring cell charge.
  - Array bitline pitch matching of $360\text{ nm}$ in the 180nm node requiring interleaved layout.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Specifies unit cell access transistor dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Defines stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture with tungsten plug (W-plug) interconnects.
  - Establishes minimum storage capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell and leakage budget $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Sense Amp Stripe DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Bitline Imbalance Extraction

- **Context / Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction > Interleaved Sense Amp & Precharge Pitch-Matched Layout Floorplanning > Sense Amp Stripe DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Bitline Imbalance Extraction [Metrology]
- **Document Path**: [sop_sense_amp_stripe_drc_lvs_rc_imbalance_extraction.md](docs/sop/sop_sense_amp_stripe_drc_lvs_rc_imbalance_extraction.md)

---

### Process Flow

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     Interleaved Sense Amp GDS Layout In       │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: DRC Pitch & Geometry Verification    │
│  - 360 nm Array Bitline Pitch                 │
│  - Access Gate L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm         │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Hierarchical LVS Netlist Matching    │
│  - Cross-Coupled Inverter Latch (SAN / SAP)   │
│  - Equalizer / Precharge (VDD / 2) Switches   │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: 2.5D/3D PEX Parasitic RC Extraction  │
│  - True BL and Complementary /BL Parasitics   │
│  - Neighbor Lateral Coupling & Substrate C    │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 4: BL / /BL Imbalance Screen & Readout  │
│  - Delta C_BL Imbalance Screen (< 2.5 fF)     │
│  - Dynamic Delta V Margin: 100 mV to 150 mV   │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Stripe Layout Ingestion & DRC Verification**:
   - Stream in the completed GDSII/OASIS layout of the pitch-matched sense amplifier stripe (including equalizer pass-gates, isolation switches, and boundary cell arrays).
   - Execute the 180nm design rule deck to confirm that bitline metal/poly layout conforms strictly to the $360\text{ nm}$ array pitch.
   - Verify unit access transistor dimensions enforce gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
2. **Hierarchical LVS Netlist Equivalence Extraction**:
   - Extract device connectivity across NMOS pull-down cross-coupled pairs, PMOS pull-up cross-coupled pairs, and equalization networks.
   - Run layout-versus-schematic (LVS) comparison against the golden folded-bitline SPICE schematic, verifying $0$ unmatched nets, $0$ device parameter mismatches, and proper well-tap biasing.
3. **2.5D/3D Parasitic Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Run multi-layer field solver extraction on true ($BL$) and complement ($\overline{BL}$) conductor routes, extracting distributed line resistance ($R$) and ground/mutual capacitance ($C + CC$).
   - Export full parasitic netlists in SPEF/DSPF formats.
4. **Parasitic RC Imbalance Screening & Readout Margin Verification**:
   - Compute bitline capacitive asymmetry $\Delta C_{BL} = |C_{BL} - C_{\overline{BL}}|$ relative to the nominal bitline budget ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).
   - Run transient SPICE simulations injecting stored cell charge ($C_s \ge 25\text{ to } 28\text{ fF}$) with bitlines equalized at $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Confirm differential sensing voltage $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left|V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right|$ develops cleanly within the $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ window before latch actuation to full rail ($0\text{V}$ and $V_{DD}$).

---

### Target Metrics & Acceptance Criteria

```text
            Sense Amp Stripe Verification Metric Targets
            ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐
            │●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●                           │
Delta V (mV)┤●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●                           │
            │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■             │
   C_BL (fF)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■             │
            │░░░░                                      │
    C_s (fF)┤░░░░                                      │
  W_act (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
            │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                │
 L_gate (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
            │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                    │
  Pitch (nm)┤██████████████████████████████████████████│
            │██████████████████████████████████████████│
            └┬─────────┬──────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0        90         180       270      360 
```

1. **Array Bitline Pitch**: **$360\text{ nm}$** (Automated DRC pitch rule check).
2. **Access Transistor Channel Geometry**: **$L = 180\text{ nm}$**, **$W = 220\text{ nm}$** (Automated DRC gate/active check).
3. **Nominal Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)**: **$250\text{ fF}$** (3D PEX extraction).
4. **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)**: **$25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$** (PEX/LVS device extraction).
5. **Differential Readout Voltage ($\Delta V$)**: **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** (Post-layout transient SPICE simulation).
6. **Bitline Capacitive Imbalance ($\Delta C_{BL}$)**: **$\le 2.5\text{ fF}$** ($< 1\%$ mismatch of nominal $C_{BL}$).
7. **Cell Leakage Current Target**: **$< 1\text{ fA/cell}$** at $85^\circ\text{C}$ junction temperature.

---

### Source Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Differential sensing and refresh of 1T1C memory cell, $V_{DD}/2$ precharge equalization, full-rail latching ($0\text{V}$ and $V_{DD}$), cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, differential voltage $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$, and interleaved layout with pitch matching array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, minimum $28\text{ fF}$ cell capacitance budget, and leakage current kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 180nm folded bitline scheme, the differential sense margin delta V is bounded at 100 mV to 150 mV (derived from C_s ~ 28 fF and C_BL ~ 200-250 fF). A parasitic capacitance imbalance delta C_BL between true BL and complementary /BL exceeding 2.5% erodes up to 25 mV of the sensing window, dangerously elevating the bit error rate during low-temperature worst-case corner latching. DRC/LVS decks must incorporate accurate boundary fill cells and dummy poly/metal fingers to prevent parasitic boundary mismatches along the perimeter of the sense amplifier stripe.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: The pitch matching of interleaved sense amplifier latches across the 180nm pitch requires dense multi-layer routing (Metal 1 to Metal 3). Line-end proximity effects and 3D corner fringing capacitance between the cross-coupled inverter pairs (SAN pull-down and SAP pull-up nodes) dominate the systematic offset. 2.5D/3D field solver extraction (PEX) must accurately capture intra-stripe coupling capacitance (C_cross) between adjacent bitline pairs, not merely lumped ground capacitance, to prevent dynamic read-disturb during simultaneous array activation.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Metrology verification relying on specialized open-source PDK rule decks (such as SkyWater 130nm or generic 180nm node extensions) faces variability in foundry-calibrated optical and e-beam metrology correlations. Sourcing dedicated CD-SEM run-time and e-beam defect inspection tools within domestic pilot foundries requires frozen DRC runset revisions to avoid multi-week re-tapeout delays in wafer fab slot bookings.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier layout iterations must freeze parasitic RC extraction within milestone MS-2 to allow cell library timing signoff. Any late-breaking DRC density DRC violations or antenna rule non-compliances discovered post-LVS extraction can trigger costly stripe re-pitching and slip the multi-project wafer (MPW) fabrication shuttle schedule by 6 to 8 weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic bitline capacitance skew (|C_BL - C_/BL| > 5 fF) causing catastrophic differential sense amplifier latch inversion during weak '1' readout.
1. LVS soft-check / substrate contact spacing violations causing localized substrate latch-up or excessive body-effect mismatch across NMOS cross-coupled pairs.
1. Inter-bitline capacitive crosstalk exceeding 8% of total C_BL leading to pattern-dependent adjacent-cell data corruption during burst refresh.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-3-01` | **Automated DRC/LVS Signoff & Antenna Rule Verification for Pitch-Matched SA Stripe** | Calibre DRC/LVS / KLayout Open-Source DRC Rule Deck Engine with Automated Calibre Query/ERC Log Analyzers | 1. Ingest GDSII stream file of the sense amplifier stripe into KLayout/Calibre. 2. Execute full DRC verification deck encompassing minimum width, spacing, enclosure, and antenna rules. 3. Run hierarchical LVS comparison between extracted netlist and schematic netlist. 4. Parse output report logs for ERC errors, floating wells, unstrapped diffusion, and soft-check substrate tap violations. | `Total DRC violations = 0; Total LVS comparison errors = 0; ERC substrate/well soft-check errors = 0; Net and instance count exact 1:1 match across all 512 interleaved sense amplifier columns.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-1-3-02` | **Parasitic RC Extraction and Systematic Bitline Imbalance (Delta C_BL & Delta R_BL) Characterization** | Synopsys StarRC / FastCap 3D Field Solver Extraction Tool & Precision SPICE Simulation Harness | 1. Run multi-corner PEX (typical, min-C/max-R, max-C/min-R) down to transistor terminal pins (BL, /BL, SAN, SAP, EQ, BLEQ). 2. Extract coupled parasitic capacitance matrix and distributed RC network for 64 contiguous folded bitline pairs. 3. Compute parasitic capacitance delta Delta C_BL = |C(BL) - C(/BL)| and series resistance delta Delta R_BL = |R(BL) - R(/BL)| for each pair. 4. Export netlist to transient SPICE simulator and evaluate offset voltage V_os under nominal 0.9V precharge. | `Capacitive imbalance Delta C_BL <= 2.0 fF (<= 1.0% of nominal 200 fF C_BL); Series resistance imbalance Delta R_BL <= 1.5 Ohm; Systematic layout-induced offset voltage V_os <= 8.0 mV across all columns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves, ESD wrist strap and anti-static heel grounders, ANSI Z87.1 certified clear impact safety glasses, Lint-free cleanroom frock
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin or eye contact with cleaning solvent (IPA), flush immediately with clean DI water eye-wash station for a minimum of 15 minutes. In case of inhalation in confined layout-server or cleanroom enclosure, remove individual to fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Cleanroom air circulation maintained at 90 FPM laminar flow with HEPA/ULPA filtration; solvent bench exhaust airflow >= 100 FPM face velocity for offline probe station degreasing.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA wipes in dedicated sealed, conductive red-can solvent waste containers; dispose via certified hazardous solvent incineration stream.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Post-metal etch and passivated inter-metal dielectric (SiO2/SiN), dry and free of organic residues or moisture contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Clean dry passivation surface ready for test pad wirebonding or automated prober docking without native oxide growth on aluminum/copper test pads.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive environmental moisture absorption in unsealed inter-metal dielectric cracks leading to localized dielectric breakdown and skewed parasitic line-to-line capacitance extraction measurements.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical signoff and parasitic RC characterization of the 180nm folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier stripe, verifying zero DRC/LVS defects, validated antenna rules, and parasitic capacitance bitline mismatch constrained within 1.0% (<= 2.0 fF) to guarantee >= 100 mV sensing margin.

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| `ASSERT-01` | **Zero design rule violations across SA pitch-matched array and stripe boundaries** | `0` | +0 violations | Calibre DRC full-chip signoff batch run against 180nm open-source PDK rule deck |

> Unanimous pass signoff verified: zero DRC/LVS/ERC errors in signoff logs, maximum bitline parasitic capacitance imbalance <= 2.0 fF across all 512 sense amplifier columns, and formal engineering approval documented in SA_STRIPE_180NM_DRC_LVS_SIGNOFF_REPORT.pdf.

critics.systems_engineer: In a 180nm folded bitline scheme, the differential sense margin delta V is bounded at 100 mV to 150 mV (derived from C_s ~ 28 fF and C_BL ~ 200-250 fF). A parasitic capacitance imbalance delta C_BL between true BL and complementary /BL exceeding 2.5% erodes up to 25 mV of the sensing window, dangerously elevating the bit error rate during low-temperature worst-case corner latching. DRC/LVS decks must incorporate accurate boundary fill cells and dummy poly/metal fingers to prevent parasitic boundary mismatches along the perimeter of the sense amplifier stripe.
critics.domain_expert: The pitch matching of interleaved sense amplifier latches across the 180nm pitch requires dense multi-layer routing (Metal 1 to Metal 3). Line-end proximity effects and 3D corner fringing capacitance between the cross-coupled inverter pairs (SAN pull-down and SAP pull-up nodes) dominate the systematic offset. 2.5D/3D field solver extraction (PEX) must accurately capture intra-stripe coupling capacitance (C_cross) between adjacent bitline pairs, not merely lumped ground capacitance, to prevent dynamic read-disturb during simultaneous array activation.
critics.supply_chain: Metrology verification relying on specialized open-source PDK rule decks (such as SkyWater 130nm or generic 180nm node extensions) faces variability in foundry-calibrated optical and e-beam metrology correlations. Sourcing dedicated CD-SEM run-time and e-beam defect inspection tools within domestic pilot foundries requires frozen DRC runset revisions to avoid multi-week re-tapeout delays in wafer fab slot bookings.
critics.laya_pm: Sense amplifier layout iterations must freeze parasitic RC extraction within milestone MS-2 to allow cell library timing signoff. Any late-breaking DRC density DRC violations or antenna rule non-compliances discovered post-LVS extraction can trigger costly stripe re-pitching and slip the multi-project wafer (MPW) fabrication shuttle schedule by 6 to 8 weeks.
critical_failure_modes: Parasitic bitline capacitance skew (|C_BL - C_/BL| > 5 fF) causing catastrophic differential sense amplifier latch inversion during weak '1' readout.
LVS soft-check / substrate contact spacing violations causing localized substrate latch-up or excessive body-effect mismatch across NMOS cross-coupled pairs.
Inter-bitline capacitive crosstalk exceeding 8% of total C_BL leading to pattern-dependent adjacent-cell data corruption during burst refresh.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction [Circuit Design] > Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion [Circuit Design]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In folded bitline sense amplifiers, boundary routing and dummy metal fill insertion must strictly preserve parasitic symmetry between bitline true (BL) and bitline complement (/BL). Even a 0.2 fF differential parasitic capacitance imbalance induced by asymmetric dummy metal tiling or fringe coupling to boundary guard rings degrades the sensing margin below the 28 fF cell signal threshold, inducing catastrophic read-disturb bit flips.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node, chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) requires metal density between 20% and 75% with strict windowing rules (e.g., 50x50 um windows). Metal-1 (M1) sense amp pitch-matching leaves minimal clearance for dummy fills; floating dummy shapes near high-swing equalization signals (EQ, CSL) introduce dynamic cross-talk. All dummy fills within the sense amp pitch-matched perimeter must either be tied to quiet DC supplies (VSS or VBLP/2) or blocked completely using dedicated density exclusion zones, reserving pattern fill to non-critical peripheral boundaries.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Reticle optical proximity correction (OPC) and mask data preparation (MDP) for dummy metal tiles significantly increase mask fracturing vertex counts and e-beam write times. Open-source 180nm MPW runs (such as SkyWater 130/180nm or TSMC 0.18um analog/embedded DRAM compatible runs) penalize overly fragmented dummy fill patterns with high mask inspection costs and delayed tape-out signoff schedules.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Dummy fill automated insertion must be locked prior to full-chip parasitic extraction (PEX) and tapeout milestone M4. Failure to run iterative post-fill DRC/LVS introduces layout signoff bottlenecks, as manual ECO fixes to resolve dummy-to-signal line spacing violations or antenna rule checks directly jeopardize the multi-project wafer schedule.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic differential capacitance imbalance (>0.5% delta C_BL) across sense amplifier pairs caused by asymmetric dummy metal placement, causing sense failure on minimum 28 fF cell charge transfers.
1. Oxide/metal dishing or dielectric erosion during post-M1/M2 tungsten/aluminum CMP due to metal density gradient violations across the sense amp array-to-periphery boundary.
1. Plasma-induced gate oxide damage (antenna rule violation) on high-impedance sense amplifier differential pair gates caused by routing long boundary shield nets without protective reverse-biased diode tap insertions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-2-01` | **Post-Fill Bitline Pair Parasitic Capacitance Symmetry and Interconnect Resistance Verification** | Synopsys StarRC / Cadence Quantus PEX engine coupled with 4-point probe Kelvin/TLM micro-pad test structures on wafer boundary scribe lines | 1. Extract post-fill netlist with 3D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) for all BL and /BL net pairs within the sense amplifier array boundary. 2. Calculate differential capacitance delta C = |C_BL - C_/BL| and inter-wire fringe capacitance to adjacent shield lines. 3. Measure physical contact and sheet resistance using boundary TLM contact test structures (W = 100 um, L_pad = 50 um, spacings d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um). 4. Perform transient SPICE simulation of sensing delay (t_SENSE) with initial differential voltage delta V_in = 100 mV across worst-case corner models. | `Parasitic capacitance mismatch delta C <= 0.15 fF between paired BL and /BL nets; total metal pattern density across every 50x50 um window strictly within 25.0% to 70.0%; specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 5.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-2-02` | **Boundary Shielding Isolation and CMP Planarity Profiling** | KLA-Tencor HRP-220 High Resolution Surface Profiler / AFM coupled with Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer | 1. Scan surface across array-to-boundary transition zone (200 um linear trace) using AFM/surface profiler to quantify oxide dishing and metal thickness loss. 2. Apply a 1.8V 100 MHz clock disturbance on outer boundary routing lines. 3. Measure induced peak-to-peak coupled crosstalk noise voltage on adjacent internal sensing control nodes (CSL, EQ) via high-bandwidth micro-probing. | `Surface dishing step height delta h < 25 nm across the boundary boundary metal; coupled dynamic crosstalk noise on shielded sense amplifier control lines <= 15 mV peak-to-peak.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved, EN 374 compliant), ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash safety goggles with side shields, Acid/solvent resistant chemical apron (neoprene/heavy nitrile), Viton chemical face shield during wet bench bath sampling
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For acid/piranha contact: immediately flush skin or eyes with copious eyewash/emergency shower water for at least 15 minutes while removing contaminated PPE; seek immediate emergency medical care. For TMAH contact: flush skin with continuous low-pressure water for at least 15 minutes; monitor for central nervous system and respiratory depression; administer supplemental oxygen if required.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated dedicated corrosive exhaust wet bench with laminar face velocity maintained at 100 +/- 10 LFM (0.5 m/s); duct tied to active wet scrubber with continuous negative pressure differential monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate acidic and solvent effluents. Neutralize Piranha/acid waste via automated two-stage acid-base neutralization system dosing 20% Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH) until pH reaches 6.5 to 8.5 prior to industrial wastewater release. Do not mix peroxide with organic solvents.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sulfuric Acid** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `96.0%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide** | `7722-84-1` | VLSI/Semiconductor Grade | `30.0%` |
| **Aluminum Etchant (Phosphoric/Nitric/Acetic Acid Blend)** | `7664-38-2` | Electronic Grade | `80% H3PO4 / 5% HNO3 / 5% CH3COOH` |
| **Tetramethylammonium Hydroxide (TMAH)** | `75-59-2` | Semiconductor Grade | `2.38%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) / Inter-metal dielectric (IMD) dry etched, photoresist ash verified, post-solvent clean surface free of organic residue and native oxide (water contact angle < 10 deg).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Post-metal deposition and CMP barrier clean; passivated surface with total residual particulates < 15 defects per 200mm wafer (KLA defect inspection >= 0.18 um).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Galvanic corrosion and native oxide regrowth (>1.5 nm) on exposed tungsten/aluminum contacts and dummy fill metal edges, causing contact resistance spike (>100 Ohm per via) and catastrophic CMP peeling/delamination.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Boundary routing, bitline shield trace integration, and automated dummy metal fill layout completed and signed off for the 180nm Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer block, satisfying all density, matching, and physical DRC/LVS/PEX requirements.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `sense_amp_boundary_fill_drc_lvs_clean.gds`
- [ ] `post_fill_pex_capacitance_symmetry_report.csv`
- [ ] `boundary_cmp_density_verification_summary.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Differential parasitic capacitance between adjacent paired BL and /BL lines post-fill** | `0.10 fF` | +/- 0.05 fF | Post-layout 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) across all sensing pairs |
| `ASSERT-02` | **M1/M2/M3 boundary window metal pattern density across every 50 um x 50 um tile** | `45.0%` | +/- 15.0% | Automated DRC layer density mapping engine run on final streamed GDSII |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Bitline shield line cross-talk attenuation against 1.8V switching boundary lines** | `-40.0 dB` | +/- 3.0 dB | S-parameter / transient corner simulation on extracted post-fill SPICE netlist |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Zero DRC violations, zero LVS discrepancies (including substrate and dummy pin connections), PEX-verified delta C_BL <= 0.15 fF, and unanimous signoff approval from physical design and circuit design leads.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Inter-Array Boundary Routing & VSS/VDD Ground Plane Shielding Implementation

**Module**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 µm)  
**Discipline**: Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer / Layout DRC/LVS  
**Knowledge Record**: [inter_array_boundary_routing_shielding.md](docs/knowledge/inter_array_boundary_routing_shielding.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Inter-Array Boundary  │
│     Pitch Matching     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Boundary Guard-Ring   │
│  & Well Tap Strapping  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Co-axial        │
│  Ground/Supply Plane   │
│       Shielding        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Parasitic RC      │
│      Extraction &      │
│  Differential Signal   │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Boundary Pitch Transition & Geometric Alignment**:
   - Route memory sub-array complementary bitlines ($BL$ and $\overline{BL}$) across the array-to-periphery boundary maintaining an interconnect pitch between **$360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$**.
   - Ensure the boundary transition preserves the access transistor channel length dimension ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) design ground rules without lithographic line-end shortening.

2. **Substrate Tap & Well-Boundary Guard Ring Strapping**:
   - Place continuous N-well and P-substrate tap guard rings along the boundary edge between the array core and the sense amplifier region to clamp minority carrier injection.
   - Tie guard rings directly to quiet external ground rails ($V_{SS}$) and array precharge references ($V_{DD}/2$) using low-resistance contact arrays.

3. **Co-planar / Sandwich Ground Plane ($V_{SS}/V_{DD}$) Shielding**:
   - Implement co-planar lateral metal shielding lines flanking each folded bitline pair on the bitline interconnect layer.
   - Place continuous $V_{SS}$ and $V_{DD}$ metal plane grids (Metal-2 / Metal-3) over and under the boundary interconnect routing to create a pseudo-coaxial shielded cage, isolating sensitive differential sensing nodes from external wordline toggle noise.

4. **Parasitic RC Extraction & Signal Integrity Verification**:
   - Execute 3D parasitic extraction (PEX) across the entire boundary interface.
   - Verify that complementary line capacitance mismatch does not exceed the sensing tolerance budget and total bitline capacitance ($C_{BL}$) complies with readout development requirements.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Boundary Routing Interconnect Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Automated DRC pitch gauge / CD-SEM |
| **Total Bitline Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $\le 250$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout 3D field solver parasitic extraction (PEX) |

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context applied*: Specifies the bitline and wordline pitch constraint of **$360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$**, and minimum cell capacitance $C_s$ of **$25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$** for retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Source 2: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - *Context applied*: Directly provides nominal bitline parasitic capacitance target **$C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$**, precharge level of $V_{DD}/2$, and signal development differential margin **$\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$** derived from $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{DD}/2)$.
- **Source 3: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Context applied*: Specifies access transistor dimensions **$L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$**, minimum capacitance requirement of **$28\text{ fF}$**, and sub-threshold leakage limit **$< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$**.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Routing dense supply rails (VDD, VSS, VBLP=0.9V) at the array-to-periphery boundary creates severe inductive bounce (L*di/dt) during simultaneous activation of sense amplifier banks (up to 4096 latch pairs firing within 2 ns). The boundary routing must implement interdigitated VSS/VDD mesh meshes with dedicated decoupling metal-insulator-metal (MIM) bypass caps under the spine to clamp ground plane bounce below 45 mV, or reference bitline sensing margins will collapse.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm folded bitline interface, unshielded bitlines running from the last 8F^2 cell column into the sense amplifier pitch-adapter suffer fringe capacitive coupling (Cc) to peripheral control buses (EQ, CSL, SAP, SAN). Boundary pitch-transition routing must enforce co-planar VSS/ground shield tracks at a strict 1:1 shield-to-signal ratio on Metal 2 and Metal 3, ensuring inter-array crosstalk remains under -42 dB and capacitive delta is kept below 1.2 fF against the 28 fF cell budget.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Boundary metal density balancing requires strict adherence to commercial 180nm foundry DRC fill rules (min 30%, max 70% per metal layer). Oversized solid ground planes risk CMP dishing and dielectric erosion, delaying reticle tape-out cycles and necessitating non-standard dummy slotting rules that must match standard foundry open-source MPW run schedules without yield surcharge.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier boundary pitch adapters sit on the critical path for silicon area tape-out; non-convergent LVS caused by substrate tap isolation and multi-power ground tie-offs can create schedule slip of 2-3 weeks. Automated LVS extraction scripts and RC corner rule files must be pre-certified before finalizing boundary metal freeze.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Substrate injection and minority carrier latch-up at the array perimeter due to inadequate guard ring grounding during high-current bitline restore phase.
1. Capacitive crosstalk feedthrough exceeding 15 mV from peripheral column select lines (CSL) into boundary dummy/edge bitlines, triggering sense amplifier false flips.
1. CMP dishing and local metal thickness variation on wide solid VDD/VSS power buses leading to electromigration voids and open circuits under continuous refresh cycling.

Rail recovery settling time must be <= 1.80 ns. Total boundary DC power mesh resistance must be <= 0.35 Ohms.` |

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: EN 374 certified chemical nitrile gloves under heavy-duty neoprene outer gloves, ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-splash face shield with UV protection, Full acid-resistant chemical apron with sealed arm sleeves, Cleanroom-compatible respiratory mask with acid-gas/organic vapor HEPA cartridge
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with HF, immediately flush with copious cold water for 2 minutes, then vigorously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel continuously into affected zone until medical response arrives. In case of inhalation, relocate victim immediately to fresh air, administer 100% medical oxygen, and provide Calcium Gluconate 2.5% nebulized aerosol if trained. Transport to trauma center immediately.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench dedicated laminar downward exhaust with face velocity >= 0.55 m/s (110 FPM). Exhaust duct tied into dedicated wet acid-gas scrubber with continuous differential pressure monitoring.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregated fluorinated acid waste drainage directly into dedicated closed-loop fluoride precipitation tank; treat with calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) slurry to precipitate insoluble CaF2; neutralize pH to 6.8-7.8 before municipal release.

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) oxide layer chemical-mechanical polished, degreased, and RCA-cleaned; tungsten (W) boundary contact plugs planarized with zero recess and zero slurry residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Sputtered Ti/TiN/Al-Cu barrier/seed and core metallization etched, post-strip solvent cleaned, with passivated native oxide free of unreacted chlorine residues.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture exposure beyond Q-time causes galvanic corrosion and micro-voiding at boundary tungsten-plug to aluminum-copper interface, causing contact resistance spikes > 150% and latent bitline sense failures.

### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Automated Rule-Based Dummy Metal Fill Synthesis & Insertion

**Module / Task:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `Boundary Routing, Shielding & Dummy Metal Fill Insertion` > `Automated Rule-Based Dummy Metal Fill Synthesis & Insertion`  
**Process Technology:** 180nm CMOS DRAM Generation (Gen 2, $\mu$m)  
**Action Type:** Make / Circuit Layout Implementation  

---

#### 1. Workflow Architecture & Synthesis Lifecycle

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Read GDSII/OASIS   │
│        Layout        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Generate Exclusion  │
│   Halos & Density    │
│       Windows        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Synthesize Dummy   │
│     Metal Tiles      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   DRC & Parasitic    │
│      Extraction      │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Database Ingestion & Layout Hierarchy Freezing:**
   - Ingest target layout (GDSII/OASIS) covering the sense amplifier boundary, equalizer circuits, bitline twists, and pitch-matched memory array boundary.
   - Lock critical functional layers: Active/OD ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$ access transistor footprint), Polysilicon/Wordline, Stacked Capacitor/Crown regions, Bitline contacts, and Signal Metal-1/Metal-2 interconnects.
2. **Exclusion Halo & Density Window Setup:**
   - Define keep-out (exclusion) halos around sensitive differential folded bitlines ($\text{BL}/\overline{\text{BL}}$) and high-impedance sense amplifier nodes to prevent parasitic capacitance imbalance.
   - Set up sliding density analysis windows across boundary routing regions to scan local metal density gradients.
3. **Automated Dummy Tile Synthesis:**
   - Generate staggered, floating or grounded dummy metal patterns (Metal-1: target thickness calibrated to $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$) conforming to the 180nm minimum interconnect pitch rules ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Fill low-density micro-zones while maintaining design rule clearances from signal tracks to prevent CMP dishing/erosion during chemical-mechanical planarization.
4. **Physical DRC & Density Check:**
   - Execute DRC deck verifying metal area density limits, minimum dummy-to-signal space, and dummy-to-dummy spacing across all sliding windows.
5. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX) & Budget Verification:**
   - Run parasitic RC extraction on folded bitlines and equalizer interconnects.
   - Ensure the incremental coupling capacitance introduced by dummy fill does not degrade the storage cell capacitor operating budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$, minimum $25 - 30\text{ fF}$ retention margin).

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
W-L Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
              │▒▒▒▒                                    │
  Cap Min (fF)┤▒▒▒▒                                    │
  Rs (mOhm/sq)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                               │

              │█████████████████████████████████████   │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        95        190      285      380 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Constraint | Unit | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Metal-1 Physical Thickness** | `350` | `±5%` (`332.5` to `367.5`) | $\text{nm}$ | Inline PVD / Ellipsometry / TEM Cross-section |
| **Interconnect Sheet Resistance ($R_s$)** | `< 0.08` | Upper bound ($80\text{ m}\Omega/\text{sq}$) post-anneal | $\Omega/\text{sq}$ | 4-Point Probe Kelvin Structure |

| **Minimum Cell Storage Capacitance Budget** | `28` (range: `25` to `30`) | Absolute lower limit $\ge 25$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Post-fill 3D Field Solver PEX / LCR Meter |

---

#### 4. Context & Source Citations

- **Interconnect Thickness & Sheet Resistance ($350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\text{sq}$):**  
  *Source:* [Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects]  
  - Sputtered Al-0.5% Cu or pure Al interconnect metallization targets $350\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$ thickness with post-metal anneal sheet resistance $R_s < 0.08\ \Omega/\text{sq}$.
- **Wiring Pitch Range ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$):**  
  *Source:* [Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]  
  - Defines the baseline bitline and wordline grid pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ in 180nm 1T1C layouts.
- **Capacitance Budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$, $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$):**  
  *Sources:* [180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench] & [Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]  
  - Defines cell capacitance boundary of $28\text{ fF}$ (minimum $25 - 30\text{ fF}$) required to guarantee noise immunity against soft errors and maintain $> 64\text{ ms}$ data retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Automated dummy metal fill insertion across the folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier layout must satisfy global metal density rules (35% to 60%) to prevent chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) dishing and erosion without introducing parasitic cross-coupling capacitance between the true (BL) and complementary (BLB) differential bitlines. An unconstrained fill algorithm that drops floating dummy tiles adjacent to sub-micron bitline pairs will degrade sensing margin, increase bitline RC delay skew beyond the allowable 2.5%, and degrade common-mode noise rejection during equalization.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dummy metal tiles on Metal-1 (350 nm Al-0.5% Cu, Rs < 0.08 Ohm/sq) and Metal-2 must maintain strict spacing (>= 1.2 um keep-out distance) from sensitive high-impedance sense amplifier differential nodes (SAN/SAP restore lines and BL/BLB pairs). Floating dummy metals can accumulate charge during subsequent plasma-enhanced dielectric depositions, creating antenna effect gate oxide degradation or capacitive feedthrough during sense amplifier latch activation; grounded or tied-off patterns should be strictly verified via parasitic extraction (PEX).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Standardizing automated dummy fill scripts within open-source EDA toolchains (e.g., KLayout / Magic / OpenROAD) eliminates reliance on proprietary foundry Calibre DRC/fill runsets. However, mask fabrication vendors impose strict fracture rules and E-beam write time constraints; generating excessive non-orthogonal or overly small sub-micron dummy tiles increases mask write time by up to 40% and raises reticle inspection costs.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Rule-based dummy metal fill synthesis must be verified through automated regression within the physical verification pipeline. Milestones require automated fill insertion, GDSII post-fill generation, and full DRC/LVS/PEX sign-off within 48 hours of schematic-to-layout tapeout freeze without necessitating manual manual polygon clean-up in the sense amplifier core.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Parasitic differential bitline capacitance unbalance (delta C_BL > 1.5 fF) caused by asymmetric dummy metal tiling adjacent to folded bitline pitches, leading to sensing inversion or read failure during small signal development.
1. Interconnect open or short defects during subsequent DC magnetron PVD aluminum sputtering and CMP caused by fill density violations outside the 35%-60% window, inducing dielectric dishing or metal peeling.
1. Plasma-induced gate oxide damage (antenna rule violation) on thin-oxide sense amplifier input pass transistors due to excessive floating dummy metal tile area connected through inadvertent routing overlaps.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)
