# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Post-Fill DRC Density Compliance Verification & Full Parasitic Extraction (PEX)

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180NM-DES-005`  
**Classification:** Circuit Design & Layout Verification — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Target:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Sense Amplifier & Boundary Routing Verification  

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: Merge Layout  │
│    & GDS Stream-In     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Automated    │
│  Metal & Poly Density  │
│       Rule Check       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Step 3:         │
│   Pattern-Dependent    │
│      CMP Optical       │
│       Simulation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 4: 3D Field    │
│    Solver Parasitic    │
│     Extraction PEX     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 5: Post-Extract  │
│   Signal & RC Delay    │
│        Sign-off        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream-In & Hierarchy Flattening / Merge**:
   - Merge the boundary routing, shielding traces, and dummy metal fill layers (Metal 1–Metal 3, Poly, and Contact/Via plugs) into the top-level folded bitline sense amplifier block.
   - Verify layout connectivity, pin placements, and layer mapping consistency.

2. **Automated Design Rule Check (DRC) Density Verification**:
   - Execute DRC density verification across moving inspection windows (typically $20\,\mu\text{m} \times 20\,\mu\text{m}$ to $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ stepped at $50\%$ overlap) on active routing layers and fill regions.
   - Check local metal density against design manual window constraints (preventing dielectric dishing and metal erosion during CMP). Ensure wordline and bitline pitches remain strictly within $360\,\text{nm}$ to $400\,\text{nm}$ bounds.

3. **Pattern-Dependent Chemical-Mechanical Planarization (CMP) Modeling**:
   - Perform post-fill surface topography and thickness variation analysis to confirm dielectric/metal planarity prior to ILD/IMD deposition.
   - Flag any density gradient spikes along array boundaries and sense amplifier pitch-matching interfaces.

4. **3D Field Solver Parasitic Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Run calibrated field solver PEX on the post-fill layout extracting coupled distributed RC networks ($R$, $C_{\text{coupled}}$, $C_{\text{ground}}$).
   - Characterize coupling capacitance between complementary bitlines ($\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$) and dummy metal shielding lines, accounting for the stacked capacitor (COB crown/cylinder) over the bitline contact.

5. **Back-Annotated Post-Layout Signal Development Sign-off**:
   - Back-annotate extracted parasitics into the folded bitline sense amplifier testbench.
   - Simulate charge sharing and signal development upon wordline activation:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{\text{DD}}}{2}\right)$$
   - Confirm differential voltage $\Delta V$ and sub-threshold leakage margins under high-temperature corner conditions ($85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░                                     │
Max Leakage (fA)┤░                                     │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Delta V (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  C_BL / 10 (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                              │
        C_s (fF)┤█████████                             │
                │█████████                             │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     31.2      62.5     93.8   125.0 
```

| Metric # | Parameter / Acceptance Criteria | Target Value & Unit | Physical Tolerance / Boundary |
|:---:|:---|:---:|:---|
| **AC-1** | Minimum Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$) | $\ge 25.0\text{ to }28.0\,\text{fF}$ | Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ budget for alpha-particle soft error immunity; must not drop below $25\,\text{fF}$ |
| **AC-2** | Extracted Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{\text{BL}}$) | $\le 250.0\,\text{fF}$ | Post-fill lumped distributed $C_{\text{BL}}$ baseline |
| **AC-3** | Post-Extract Differential Signal Development ($\Delta V$) | $100.0\text{ to }150.0\,\text{mV}$ | Minimum sense margin developed on $\text{BL}/\overline{\text{BL}}$ differential pair |
| **AC-4** | Access Transistor Sub-threshold / Junction Leakage | $\le 1.0\,\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured/simulated at $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain $>64\,\text{ms}$ retention interval |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
   - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$.
   - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\,\text{fF/cell}$ ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.
   - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **[Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
   - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary $\text{BL}$ and $\overline{\text{BL}}$.
   - Precharge to $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$; cell charge dump $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Differential signal development formula: $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{\text{BL}} + C_s}\right) \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{DD}}/2)$.
   - Parametric baseline: $C_s = 25\,\text{fF}$, $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\,\text{fF}$, yielding signal $\Delta V \approx 100\,\text{mV}\text{ to }150\,\text{mV}$.

3. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
   - 1T1C architecture with $8F^2$ or $6F^2$ layout; minimum cell capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\,\text{fF}$ ensuring retention time $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Array bitline and wordline pitch constrained to approximately $360\,\text{nm}\text{ to }400\,\text{nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Adding dummy metal fill to meet foundry local density rules (typically 20% to 75% per 50x50 um window) directly threatens the bitline-to-cell capacitance budget. For an 8F^2 folded bitline cell with Cs = 28 fF, total bitline capacitance Cb must remain under 224 fF to maintain a Cb/Cs ratio <= 8:1 (upper design ceiling 9:1). Unshielded dummy metal near the bitline boundary can inject 20-40 fF of unwanted coupling capacitance, degrading the differential sensing voltage delta-V = (Vdd/2) / (1 + Cb/Cs) below the 120 mV threshold needed for reliable sense amplifier latching under VT mismatch.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Dummy metal placement must respect strict exclusion keep-out zones around the differential folded bitline pair (BL and /BL) and equalization pass gates. Any asymmetric fill insertion disrupts the mutual common-mode noise rejection of the folded architecture. Parasitic extraction must employ a calibrated 3D field-solver engine (or qualified rule-based PEX with corner tables) to capture multi-dielectric fringing capacitance across high-k stacked capacitor crown steps (ONO or Ta2O5/Al2O3 kappa > 15) and tungsten plug (W-plug) interfaces.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source 180nm shuttle MPW tapeout runs (e.g., SkyWater 130/180nm or open commercial foundry runs) enforce automated design-rule check (DRC) density decks at mask data prep (MDP). Any manual or rule-based fill violation results in hard fab rejections, pausing the tapeout queue by 4 to 6 weeks and causing mask reticle generation penalty fees. Validating density compliance pre-tapeout on full GDSII/OASIS files is mandatory.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Post-fill PEX runtime scales non-linearly with full dummy fill arrays. Running full 3D PEX on the complete sense amplifier and equalizer slice can bottleneck schedule signoff if hierarchical extraction strategies are not set up. The verification milestone must freeze boundary fill geometries, lock PEX netlists, and confirm simulation margins across FF/SS/TT corners at 85°C without exceeding the 72-hour physical verification window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Asymmetric dummy metal fill coupling capacitance causing differential BL//BL offset exceeding 15 mV, leading to sense amplifier false latching during read operations.
1. Excessive cumulative bitline parasitic capacitance (Cb > 250 fF), pushing Cb/Cs > 9:1 and attenuating the read signal margin below sense amplifier resolution.
1. Local metal density rule violations in boundary transition windows triggering automated tapeout mask freeze at foundry intake.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-2-3-01` | **Post-Fill Metal Layer Density Compliance Verification** | Calibre DRC / KLayout DRC Engine with 180nm Open PDK Density Rule Decks (50x50 um stepping window, 50% step overlap) | 1. Ingest merged post-fill GDSII/OASIS stream into the DRC verification environment. 2. Execute automated density extraction deck checking Metal 1 to Metal 5 density against min (20.0%) and max (75.0%) bounds over a 50 um x 50 um sliding inspection window. 3. Parse generated DRC violation database and generate density heatmaps. | `Zero density violations across all metal layers (M1-M5). Local metal density strictly between 20.0% and 75.0% for all 50 um x 50 um windows; global metal density between 30.0% and 65.0%.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-2-3-02` | **Post-Fill Full Parasitic Extraction (RC PEX) and Differential Bitline Capacitance Balance Verification** | Calibre xRC / StarRC / open-source Magic-PEX extraction tool coupled with SPICE / Ngspice / Xyce circuit simulator | 1. Run distributed coupled RC extraction (C-coupled + R-lumped) on the sense amplifier block including dummy metal fill floating nets. 2. Extract total lumped capacitance C_BL and C_BLB for 512-cell bitline pair. 3. Calculate bitline capacitance ratio Cb / Cs assuming Cs = 28.0 fF. 4. Run transient simulation at 85°C, VDD = 1.8V to evaluate sense amplifier differential read delta-V margin. | `Total bitline capacitance Cb <= 224 fF (Cb/Cs <= 8.0:1); capacitance mismatch |C_BL - C_BLB| <= 1.5 fF (< 0.75% imbalance); differential sense signal delta-V >= 120 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves, ANSI Z87.1 certified UV-filtering safety glasses, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) safe lab coat and conductive footwear, Half-mask respirator with multi-gas/vapor cartridge for physical wafer handling areas
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact, flush exposed area immediately with copious deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For eye splash, rinse at dedicated eye-wash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek medical attention. If inhaled, evacuate to clean fresh air.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated chemical solvent exhaust hood with continuous face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) linked to VOC thermal oxidizer scrubber system.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect solvent effluent in grounded, sealed stainless-steel carboys labeled for halogen-free flammable solvents; do not mix with acidic or aqueous waste streams.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Grade VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal CMP planarized dielectric surface, post-clean dried with zero particulate contamination.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Passivated, post-dummy fill dry-etched and verified metal surface sealed under TEOS capping layer.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide regrowth, atmospheric moisture absorption causing dielectric k-value drift, and corrosion pitting on exposed copper/aluminum metal lines prior to dielectric encapsulation.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete DRC metal density signoff across all mask layers and validated post-fill RC parasitic netlist demonstrating Cb/Cs ratio <= 8:1 with symmetric bitline coupling matching within 1.5 fF.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `sense_amp_post_fill_pex_extracted_netlist.spice`
- [ ] `bitline_parasitic_capacitance_balance_matrix.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

critics.systems_engineer: Adding dummy metal fill to meet foundry local density rules (typically 20% to 75% per 50x50 um window) directly threatens the bitline-to-cell capacitance budget. For an 8F^2 folded bitline cell with Cs = 28 fF, total bitline capacitance Cb must remain under 224 fF to maintain a Cb/Cs ratio <= 8:1 (upper design ceiling 9:1). Unshielded dummy metal near the bitline boundary can inject 20-40 fF of unwanted coupling capacitance, degrading the differential sensing voltage delta-V = (Vdd/2) / (1 + Cb/Cs) below the 120 mV threshold needed for reliable sense amplifier latching under VT mismatch.
critics.domain_expert: Dummy metal placement must respect strict exclusion keep-out zones around the differential folded bitline pair (BL and /BL) and equalization pass gates. Any asymmetric fill insertion disrupts the mutual common-mode noise rejection of the folded architecture. Parasitic extraction must employ a calibrated 3D field-solver engine (or qualified rule-based PEX with corner tables) to capture multi-dielectric fringing capacitance across high-k stacked capacitor crown steps (ONO or Ta2O5/Al2O3 kappa > 15) and tungsten plug (W-plug) interfaces.
critics.supply_chain: Open-source 180nm shuttle MPW tapeout runs (e.g., SkyWater 130/180nm or open commercial foundry runs) enforce automated design-rule check (DRC) density decks at mask data prep (MDP). Any manual or rule-based fill violation results in hard fab rejections, pausing the tapeout queue by 4 to 6 weeks and causing mask reticle generation penalty fees. Validating density compliance pre-tapeout on full GDSII/OASIS files is mandatory.
critics.laya_pm: Post-fill PEX runtime scales non-linearly with full dummy fill arrays. Running full 3D PEX on the complete sense amplifier and equalizer slice can bottleneck schedule signoff if hierarchical extraction strategies are not set up. The verification milestone must freeze boundary fill geometries, lock PEX netlists, and confirm simulation margins across FF/SS/TT corners at 85°C without exceeding the 72-hour physical verification window.
critical_failure_modes: Asymmetric dummy metal fill coupling capacitance causing differential BL//BL offset exceeding 15 mV, leading to sense amplifier false latching during read operations.
Excessive cumulative bitline parasitic capacitance (Cb > 250 fF), pushing Cb/Cs > 9:1 and attenuating the read signal margin below sense amplifier resolution.
Local metal density rule violations in boundary transition windows triggering automated tapeout mask freeze at foundry intake.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)
**Node / Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Hierarchy**: [Architecture & Integration] > Folded Bitline CMOS Sense Amplifier & Equalizer [DRAM Circuit Design] > Folded Bitline Pitch-Matched Layout & DRC/LVS Extraction [Circuit Design] > DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) [Metrology]  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│      Layout GDSII / OASIS       │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        DRC Verification         │
│   (Width, Spacing, Density)     │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        LVS Extraction &         │
│         Netlist Compare         │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│        PEX Parasitic RC         │
│      Extraction (BL & /BL)      │
│                                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────┘
                 │
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 │
│    Back-Annotated Post-Layout   │
│      Read Margin Simulation     │
│                                 │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **GDSII Ingestion & DRC Verification**:
   - Stream in the pitch-matched folded bitline sense amplifier array layout database (GDSII / OASIS format).
   - Execute DRC deck enforcing 180nm foundry design rules, specifically validating:
     - Access transistor gate dimension checks: Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Active Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
     - 8F² folded bitline cell area constraint: Unit cell pitch footprint must equal $0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$ ($8 \times (0.18\text{ }\mu\text{m})^2$).
     - Stacked capacitor crown/MIM layer enclosure and tungsten contact plug (W-plug) alignment rules over the drain contact.
   - Ensure clean DRC rule log with `0` violations before proceeding.

2. **Device Recognition & LVS Netlist Extraction**:
   - Run layout device extraction to extract:
     - 1T1C storage cells, equalization NMOS networks, and CMOS cross-coupled inverter sense amplifier latches.
     - Stacked capacitor nodes ($C_s$) utilizing high-$\kappa$ dielectric layer / ONO stacks ($\kappa > 15$).
   - Execute LVS comparison between extracted netlist and schematic netlist.
   - Verify 1-to-1 pin and topological match for complementary bitline pairs (`BL` and `/BL`), wordlines (`WL`), sense enable lines (`SAN`, `SAP`), and bitline equalization precharge rails ($V_{DD}/2$).

3. **Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Extract full parasitic resistance ($R$) and parasitic capacitance ($C$) across bitline tracks (`BL`, `/BL`) for blocks containing 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
   - Extract coupling capacitance ($C_{c}$) between adjacent folded bitline pairs and ground capacitance ($C_g$).
   - Extract storage node capacitance $C_s$ and verify dielectric parameters.
   - Export DSPF/SPEF back-annotated parasitic netlist.

4. **Post-Layout Signal Development & Margin Validation**:
   - Instantiate back-annotated netlist in SPICE transient simulation.
   - Precharge `BL` and `/BL` to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Assert wordline to dump storage charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ onto `BL`.
   - Calculate developed differential read voltage:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Confirm sensing margin and sense amplifier activation prior to latching.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
  Margin dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                  │
 C_BL (Limit fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
C_s (Nominal fF)┤█████                                 │
                │█████                                 │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0     62.5      125.0    187.5  250.0 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ (Nominal: $28.0$) | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Extracted PEX Netlist |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $150.0 \text{ to } 250.0$ (Max $\le 250.0$) | $\text{fF}$ (for 256–512 cells/BL) | PEX Bitline Trace Extraction |
| **Capacitance Ratio ($C_{BL} / C_s$)** | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (Hard Limit $< 10.0 : 1$) | Dimensionless ratio | PEX Parameter Calculation |
| **Differential Voltage Read Margin ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Back-Annotated SPICE Simulation |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch between complementary bitlines `BL` and `/BL`.
  - Bitline precharge / equalization to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Charge dump formulation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{BL})$ and differential voltage swing $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$.
  - Baseline nominal target: $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, delivering developed differential $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.
- **Source: 1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
  - Folded bitline $8F^2$ unit footprint ($0.259\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
  - Storage node capacitance budget $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF to } 30\text{ fF}$ (nominally $28\text{ fF}$).
  - Array block bitline capacitance $C_b = 150\text{ fF to } 250\text{ fF}$ for 256 or 512 cells per bitline.
  - Strict capacitance budget constraint $C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$; hard degradation boundary at $C_b / C_s > 10:1$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) crown/MIM structure with W-plug over drain contact.
  - High-$\kappa$ dielectric / ONO layer effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, maintaining $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-3-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-3-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of DRC/LVS Verification & Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX): Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `SPICE_transient_simulation_deck.sp`
- [ ] `Keysight_B1500A_retention_margin_plot.csv`
- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).

```text
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Environment & Rule Deck Initialization**:
   - Ingest GDSII/OASIS design database containing the folded-bitline array core, equalizers, and sense amplifier strips.
   - Load foundry-certified 180nm open-source DRC rules (Diffusion, Poly, Contact/Via, Metal 1–3).
   - Configure hierarchical partitioning to isolate cell abutment borders and pitch transition regions.

2. **Pitch-Matched Sense Amplifier Alignment & Boundary Checks**:
   - Inspect the sense amplifier boundary against the memory array bitline pitch; verify cell pitch equals exactly **360 nm**.
   - Validate interleaved staggered layout placements ($2\times$ or $4\times$ array pitch) allowing cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS pairs to fit within lateral physical design rules.
   - Verify access transistor boundary dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and contact enclosures.

3. **DRC Rule Deck Execution**:
   - Run the full batch DRC engine over the sense amp macros and adjacent bitline routing.
   - Categorize output violations into minimum spacing (Metal 1 BL/BLB tracks), poly gate extensions, and contact overlap enclosures.

4. **Geometry Clean-up & Differential Symmetry Preservation**:
   - Push/pull violating polygons to satisfy clearance margins while maintaining strictly identical path lengths and geometries for `BL` and `/BL` to prevent offset voltages.
   - Center precharge/equalization ($V_{DD}/2$) transistor source/drain taps.
   - Perform incremental DRC runs until **0 violations** remain.

5. **Sign-Off & Layout Freezing**:
   - Verify layout database integrity and export frozen DRC-clean GDSII to subsequent LVS and Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) workflows.

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *"Sense amplifier pitch must match memory array bitline pitch (360 nm in 180nm node), requiring interleaved layout."*
  - Precharge equalization to $V_{DD}/2$; differential voltage $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$; with typical $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Minimum storage capacitance budget: $28\text{ fF}$ per cell for alpha-particle soft error immunity; leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pitch-matching the cross-coupled inverter latch directly into the 180nm folded bitline memory array pitch (360 nm minimum pitch, relaxed to 720 nm using a 2-sided alternating interleaved scheme) creates extreme lateral routing congestion between Metal 1 bitline pairs (BL, /BL) and Metal 2 power rails (SAN, SAP, VDD, GND). The DRC rule deck execution must explicitly account for density gradient rules and poly gate extension over active area boundaries to avoid corner rounding that degrades latch gain and increases input offset voltage beyond the allowable 10 mV budget.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm with cell capacitance Cs = 25 fF and bitline capacitance CBL = 250 fF, developed differential voltage Delta V is only 100 mV to 150 mV. Layout geometry clean-up in the sense amplifier must eliminate sub-wavelength optical proximity effect (OPE) line-end pullbacks and asymmetric parasitic capacitance between BL and /BL. A parasitic imbalance exceeding 1.2 fF (0.5% of CBL) across the latch nodes causes false reads and destructive sensing during the initial SAN/SAP pull-down phase.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: The open-source 180nm CMOS/DRAM mixed-signal PDK relies on multi-project wafer (MPW) reticle sharing. Any DRC clean-up violating strict multi-layer density dummy fill rules (particularly for Contact, Metal 1, and Poly) will trigger rejection by open fab DRC QA gates, causing tapeout queue slips of 8 to 12 weeks and incurring non-recurring engineering (NRE) mask resubmission fees.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier layout clean-up must lock within a 3-day sprint; failure to converge on zero DRC violations across the interleaved pitch boundary blocks extraction for full-bank Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) and corner timing signoff, directly impacting Milestone 3.3 delivery.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Lithographic line-end pullback on interleaved Metal 1 /BL connections causing open bitlines or sub-nominal contact overlap (< 40 nm enclosure), resulting in contact resistance exceeding 150 ohms and sensing latency timeout.
1. Asymmetric poly gate necking on matched NMOS pull-down cross-coupled pair due to dense-to-isolated pitch transition, causing threshold voltage mismatch delta-Vth > 18 mV and sensing flipping error.
1. Antenna DRC violation during metal fill insertion on high-impedance bitline nodes causing gate oxide punchthrough during plasma-enhanced dielectric deposition.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DRAM-180NM-LVS-004`
**Title:** LVS Netlist Extraction & Folded Bitline Topology Cross-Check  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip)  
**Council Classification:** Circuit Design / Metrology & Verification  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Layout GDSII &     │
│    Schematic SPICE     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  DRC Clean Rule Deck   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LVS Extraction & Pin  │
│        Mapping         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Folded BL Symmetry &  │
│     Topology Audit     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       LVS Clean        │
│   Verification Pass    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Prerequisite GDSII & Connectivity Preparation:**
   - Confirm DRC clean sign-off on the folded bitline memory array block and pitch-matched sense amplifier latch bank.
   - Verify layout text pin attachments (`BL`, `/BL`, `WL<0:N>`, `EQ`, `SAN`, `SAP`, `V_DD`, `V_SS`, `V_BL_EQ` / $V_{DD}/2$) on their corresponding routing metal/poly layers with strict hierarchy port preservation.

2. **Rule Deck Compilation & Device Extraction:**
   - Execute LVS extraction rule deck (e.g., open-source Magic / Netgen or KLayout DRC/LVS).
   - Recognize 1T1C access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) sharing tungsten bitline plugs (W-plugs), stacked storage capacitor terminals ($C_s$), and CMOS cross-coupled inverter pairs (NMOS pulldowns and PMOS pullups).
   - Generate layout-extracted netlist (`layout_extracted.spice`) retaining geometric parameters ($W$, $L$, and parasitic port assignments).

3. **Topology Equivalence Comparison (LVS Netlist Match):**
   - Run two-way graph isomorphism comparison between golden schematic SPICE (`schematic.spice`) and `layout_extracted.spice`.
   - Cross-check port labeling, transistor finger splitting, dummy devices, and shared drain/source junction topologies.
   - Resolve any topological discrepancies (e.g., node swap, pin mismatch, floating wells, or soft substrate ties).

4. **Folded Bitline Differential Topology & Symmetry Cross-Check:**
   - Audit the pitch-matched sense amplifier cross-coupling connections ensuring complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ intersect the differential latch nodes with mirrored parasitic parity.
   - Inspect the equalization transistor network to verify true symmetric connection across $BL$ and $/BL$ tied to the precharge bias line ($V_{DD}/2$).
   - Confirm storage node connectivity through the W-plug stacked capacitor layer to substrate/plate nodes without shorting adjacent bitline metal tracks.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Parameter | Metric / Bound | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Access Transistor Gate Geometry** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | $\Delta L = 0\text{ nm}$, $\Delta W = 0\text{ nm}$ (Zero netlist mismatch) |
| **Bitline & Wordline Layout Pitch** | $360 \text{ to } 400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Measured metallization/poly pitch must fall within $[360, 400]\text{ nm}$ |
| **Cell Storage Node Target Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25 \text{ to } 30$ (Minimum: $28$) | $\text{fF}$ | Extracted $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$ |
| **Topological Netlist Discrepancy Count** | $0$ | $\text{errors}$ | Netgen/LVS report: Unmatched nets $= 0$, unmatched devices $= 0$ |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact shared between adjacent cells via tungsten plug (W-plug).
  - Capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell (dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$).
- **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - $1\text{T}1\text{C}$ cell storage capacitor nominal baseline: $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$ per cell.
  - Bitline and wordline pitch budget: $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$.
- **[Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout]**:
  - CMOS cross-coupled inverter latch architecture connected between complementary bitlines $BL$ and $/BL$ with precharge equalization network to $V_{DD}/2$.
  - Nominal cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ yielding signal development $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier architecture, parasitic differential capacitance imbalance (Delta_C_BL) between true Bitline (BL) and complementary Bitline (/BL) must remain under 1.5% across the entire pitch-matched layout boundary. During LVS netlist extraction, extracting only 2D pin-to-pin connectivity without multi-finger 3D proximity, substrate tap resistance cross-coupling, and inter-metal coupling to column select (CSL) and sense clock lines (SAN/SAP) will mask severe common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) degradation. If the extracted netlist fails to map layout sub-nodes back to the schematic folded bitline pairing exactly, dynamic sensing margins will collapse during the regenerative latching phase.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Folded bitline topologies rely fundamentally on matched differential common-mode noise cancellation from wordline (WL) passing transients. The netlist extraction engine (Netgen / Magic / KLayout) must rigorously verify gate symmetry, dummy device terminations, and common-centroid dummy diffusion rings on the cross-coupled PMOS pull-up (SAP) and NMOS pull-down (SAN) pairs. At the 180nm node (target sub-micron transistor W/L = 2.0 um / 0.18 um with V_thn = +0.55 V +/- 50 mV and V_thp = -0.60 V +/- 50 mV), asymmetric metal enclosure over contacts or misaligned guard rings creates threshold mismatch (Delta_V_th > 8 mV), driving sensing offset higher than the 60 mV cell signal margin.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Open-source 180nm PDK device decks (e.g., SkyWater 180nm or open foundry equivalent) exhibit device model version drifting between KLayout extraction rule files, Magic techfiles, and SPICE schematics. A mismatch in extracted transistor device model naming (e.g., sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 vs discrete submicron 180nm core FET) or layer property definitions halts tapeout signoff and causes physical mask layer mismatch, stranding wafer lot starts and extending MPW fab lead time by 14 to 20 weeks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Sense amplifier layout pitch matching represents the most constrained critical path in memory physical design. Failing to enforce automated, regression-driven LVS netlist extraction and topology cross-check on git commit allows hidden layout net swaps (e.g., swapping BL and /BL on adjacent equalizer gates or misrouting CSL mux differential legs) to propagate downstream into full-chip assembly, causing complete array readout failure and unrecoverable mask write re-spins.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Extracted topological pin swap between BL and /BL on the precharge/equalizer pass transistors, inducing rail-to-rail dynamic latchup inversion and persistent destructive readout state.
1. Unextracted parasitic series resistance on the SAN/SAP pulldown/pullup activation lines causing sensing strobe skew exceeding 120 ps, resulting in destructive cell read before full sense amp latching.
1. Differential capacitive mismatch (Delta_C_BL > 2.0 fF) arising from asymmetrical Metal 2 routing around sense amplifier column pass-gates, exceeding the maximum allowable delta and flipping sensing polarity on weak memory cells.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Execute 2.5D hierarchical geometry extraction on GDSII layout via Netgen rule deck extracting all diffusion areas, perimeter metrics, source/drain parasitic diodes, and gate poly widths/lengths. 2. critics.systems_engineer: In a folded bitline CMOS sense amplifier architecture, parasitic differential capacitance imbalance (Delta_C_BL) between true Bitline (BL) and complementary Bitline (/BL) must remain under 1.5% across the entire pitch-matched layout boundary. During LVS netlist extraction, extracting only 2D pin-to-pin connectivity without multi-finger 3D proximity, substrate tap resistance cross-coupling, and inter-metal coupling to column select (CSL) and sense clock lines (SAN/SAP) will mask severe common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) degradation. If the extracted netlist fails to map layout sub-nodes back to the schematic folded bitline pairing exactly, dynamic sensing margins will collapse during the regenerative latching phase.
critics.domain_expert: Folded bitline topologies rely fundamentally on matched differential common-mode noise cancellation from wordline (WL) passing transients. The netlist extraction engine (Netgen / Magic / KLayout) must rigorously verify gate symmetry, dummy device terminations, and common-centroid dummy diffusion rings on the cross-coupled PMOS pull-up (SAP) and NMOS pull-down (SAN) pairs. At the 180nm node (target sub-micron transistor W/L = 2.0 um / 0.18 um with V_thn = +0.55 V +/- 50 mV and V_thp = -0.60 V +/- 50 mV), asymmetric metal enclosure over contacts or misaligned guard rings creates threshold mismatch (Delta_V_th > 8 mV), driving sensing offset higher than the 60 mV cell signal margin.
critics.supply_chain: Open-source 180nm PDK device decks (e.g., SkyWater 180nm or open foundry equivalent) exhibit device model version drifting between KLayout extraction rule files, Magic techfiles, and SPICE schematics. A mismatch in extracted transistor device model naming (e.g., sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 vs discrete submicron 180nm core FET) or layer property definitions halts tapeout signoff and causes physical mask layer mismatch, stranding wafer lot starts and extending MPW fab lead time by 14 to 20 weeks.
critics.laya_pm: Sense amplifier layout pitch matching represents the most constrained critical path in memory physical design. Failing to enforce automated, regression-driven LVS netlist extraction and topology cross-check on git commit allows hidden layout net swaps (e.g., swapping BL and /BL on adjacent equalizer gates or misrouting CSL mux differential legs) to propagate downstream into full-chip assembly, causing complete array readout failure and unrecoverable mask write re-spins.
critical_failure_modes: Extracted topological pin swap between BL and /BL on the precharge/equalizer pass transistors, inducing rail-to-rail dynamic latchup inversion and persistent destructive readout state.

Unextracted parasitic series resistance on the SAN/SAP pulldown/pullup activation lines causing sensing strobe skew exceeding 120 ps, resulting in destructive cell read before full sense amp latching.

Differential capacitive mismatch (Delta_C_BL > 2.0 fF) arising from asymmetrical Metal 2 routing around sense amplifier column pass-gates, exceeding the maximum allowable delta and flipping sensing polarity on weak memory cells.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX) & Differential Bitline Signal-Margin Metrology

- **Location**: [docs/sop/sop_pex_bitline_signal_margin_metrology.md](docs/sop/sop_pex_bitline_signal_margin_metrology.md)
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) | Gen 2 ($\mu$m)
- **Action Type**: Make | Metrology

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Layout & Layer  │
│      Stack Input       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       LVS Clean        │
│      Connectivity      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3D Field Solver PEX   │
│    & RC Extraction     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Back-Annotated     │
│    Transistor-Level    │
│   Netlist Generation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Bitline    │
│     Signal-Margin      │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Full-Rail        │
│  Restoration & Noise   │
│       Validation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layout Connectivity & Physical Ingestion**:
   - Ingest physical GDSII/OASIS design database containing the memory cell array and folded bitline sense amplifiers.
   - Verify array pitch matches the 180nm standard: Access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, and pitch-matched array bitline pitch at exactly $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Run Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) to establish verified device and net connectivity across $BL$, $/BL$, and storage nodes.

2. **3D/2.5D Field Solver Parasitic RC Extraction (PEX)**:
   - Load calibrated 180nm BEOL/FEOL layer profiles with tungsten plug ($W$-plug) contacts.
   - Extract lumped and distributed wire resistance ($R_{BL}$) and total bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL}$), accounting for intra-pair and inter-pair coupling capacitance ($C_c$).
   - Back-annotate cell storage capacitance $C_s$ into the extracted DSPF/SPEF netlist.

3. **Precharge & Signal Development Setup**:
   - Establish initial conditions with complementary bitlines equalized to $V_{DD}/2$.
   - Assert wordline ($V_{WL} = V_{PP}$) across access transistors to dump cell charge $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ onto $BL$.

4. **Transient Differential Signal-Margin Metrology & Sense Latching**:
   - Probe dynamic differential voltage development $\Delta V = |V_{BL} - V_{/BL}|$ prior to sense amplifier latching:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
   - Activate regenerative latching strobes ($SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$).
   - Verify full-rail CMOS level swing ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) and $100\%$ charge restoration back into the 1T1C storage cell.
   - Characterize access transistor leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to confirm refresh retention margin.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Metrics

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
Signal Margin dV (mV)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                     │
 Bitline Cap CBL (fF)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓          │
     Cell Cap Cs (fF)┤███                              │
                     │███                              │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      90      180     270    360 
```

| Acceptance Metric | Target Specification | Metrology Mode | Physical Significance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bitline Pitch** | **$360\text{ nm}$** | Automated DRC GDSII Measurement | Interleaved sense amp pitch-matching |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | **$250\text{ fF}$** nominal | PEX 3D Field Extraction | Total parasitics per column net |
| **Cell Storage Capacitance ($C_s$)** | **$25\text{ fF}$** (nominal) / **$\ge 28\text{ fF}$** (budget) | PEX & C-V Extraction | Alpha-particle & coupling immunity |
| **Differential Signal Margin ($\Delta V$)** | **$100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$** | Transient Differential Probe | Sensing window before $SAN$/$SAP$ |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | **$\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$** | DC Off-State Leakage Metrology | Retention interval & refresh integrity |

---

### Verified Local Literature Citations
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
  - Signal split relationship: $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$.
  - Differential signal range: $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$ for $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.
  - Sensing sequence: Precharge to $V_{DD}/2$, strobe activation ($SAN \to \text{GND}$, $SAP \to V_{DD}$) driving full rails ($0\text{ V}$ and $V_{DD}$) with $100\%$ charge restore.
  - Pitch constraints: Sense amplifier layout pitch-matched to array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node).
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor parameters: Gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Capacitor requirement: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget for noise immunity.
  - Leakage constraint: Sub-threshold and junction leakage kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In folded-bitline DRAM at 180nm, 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) must capture intra-layer and inter-layer fringe capacitances between adjacent true/complement bitline pairs (BL and /BL) and overlying wordlines/metal shields. If the post-layout extracted bitline parasitic capacitance C_b exceeds 225 fF against a nominal 28 fF storage cell (C_s), the C_b/C_s capacitance attenuation ratio will surpass 8:1, collapsing the single-ended differential read voltage margin delta_V_BL below 100 mV (nominally delta_V_BL = (V_DD/2) / (1 + C_b/C_s) ≈ 100 mV at V_DD = 1.8V). RC mismatch between complementary lines exceeding 1.5% will cause false latching during sense amplifier fire.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical contact resistivity rho_c extracted via inline Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) structures directly influences access latency and sense amplifier equalization. At the 180nm node, tungsten plug contact resistance to n+ bitline diffusion must maintain rho_c < 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2. When extracting parasitic resistance (R_b), distributed RC transmission-line delay along a 512-cell folded column cannot exceed 450 ps; excessive bitline resistance attenuates developing differential signal before the cross-coupled CMOS latch senses, causing catastrophic bit flip or destructive readouts.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Inline automated parametric wafer probers (e.g., Keysight 4080/Keithley S530) and high-frequency S-parameter vector network analyzers / LCR meters required for femtofarad-level C-V extraction are bottlenecked in open-source 200mm fab test bays. Test structures must feature standardized pad cages (100 um x 50 um pads, 100 um pitch) compatible with multi-site wedge probe cards to prevent extended fab cycle times and avoid relying on custom non-standard micro-probing fixtures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: PEX extraction runtimes using 2.5D/3D field solvers across the full dense 1T1C core array risk blocking tapeout sign-off schedules. We require hierarchical extraction: full 3D boundary-element extraction on the 8F^2 unit cell and sense-amp pitch-adapter boundary, combined with calibrated 2.5D rule-based extraction across repetitive 512-row core sectors, ensuring sign-off verification completes within a strict 48-hour turn-around time.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Bitline-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance (C_c) asymmetry exceeding 2.0 fF between BL and /BL causing sense amplifier sensing offset inversion during wordline activation.
1. Specific contact resistivity degradation (rho_c > 1.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2) at bitline diffusion contacts producing unequal RC time constants and premature sense amplifier latching.
1. Underestimation of M1-M2 interlayer dielectric (ILD) fringing capacitance in PEX techfile leading to silicon-level C_b/C_s > 9.5:1 and total loss of sensing margin under 85°C retention conditions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-3-3-01` | **Inline Femtofarad C-V Extraction of Folded Bitline Parasitics and C_b/C_s Ratio Metrology** | Keysight B1505A/B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multi-Frequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech 200mm semi-automatic shielded probe station, triaxial Kelvin connections. | 1. Land triaxial probe tips on the 100 um x 50 um kelvin test pads for isolated 512-cell BL and /BL test structures. 2. Apply a 1.8V DC bias with 30 mV AC modulation at 1 MHz between BL and grounded substrate/adjacent shielding wires. 3. Measure total bitline capacitance C_b. 4. Land probe tips on dedicated 1T1C discrete storage capacitor array test macro; extract single-cell storage capacitance C_s. 5. Compute the ratio C_b / C_s and differential mismatch delta_C = |C_BL - C_/BL|. | `Total bitline parasitic capacitance C_b must be between 160.0 fF and 230.0 fF; C_s must be >= 26.0 fF; capacitance ratio C_b / C_s must be <= 8.5 : 1; complementary line capacitive imbalance delta_C must be <= 1.8 fF.` |
| `TC-FOLDED-SENSE-AMP-3-3-3-02` | **TLM Specific Contact Resistivity and Distributed Bitline Metallization Resistance Metrology** | Keithley S530 Parametric Test System, 4-wire Kelvin probe card, thermal chuck set to 25°C and 85°C. | 1. Force 1.0 mA DC current between adjacent TLM pads across gaps d = 5 um through 80 um and record 4-wire voltage drops to calculate total resistance R_T. 2. Perform linear regression of R_T vs. gap distance d to extract contact resistance R_c (y-intercept/2), sheet resistance R_s (slope * W), and transfer length L_T. 3. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. 4. Measure end-to-end series resistance along full 512-cell physical bitline metal trace. | `Specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2; sheet resistance R_s must match PDK target within ± 8.0%; total distributed bitline series resistance R_b over 512 cells must be <= 85.0 Ohm.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom nitrile gloves (double-gloved), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact chemical splash safety glasses, ESD-safe cleanroom smock and conductive ground heel straps, Respirator mask with organic vapor/acid gas cartridge (during wet decontamination)
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvents: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and flush skin with copiously flowing deionized water for at least 15 minutes. critics.systems_engineer: In folded-bitline DRAM at 180nm, 3D field-solver parasitic extraction (PEX) must capture intra-layer and inter-layer fringe capacitances between adjacent true/complement bitline pairs (BL and /BL) and overlying wordlines/metal shields. If the post-layout extracted bitline parasitic capacitance C_b exceeds 225 fF against a nominal 28 fF storage cell (C_s), the C_b/C_s capacitance attenuation ratio will surpass 8:1, collapsing the single-ended differential read voltage margin delta_V_BL below 100 mV (nominally delta_V_BL = (V_DD/2) / (1 + C_b/C_s) ≈ 100 mV at V_DD = 1.8V). RC mismatch between complementary lines exceeding 1.5% will cause false latching during sense amplifier fire.
critics.domain_expert: Physical contact resistivity rho_c extracted via inline Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) structures directly influences access latency and sense amplifier equalization. At the 180nm node, tungsten plug contact resistance to n+ bitline diffusion must maintain rho_c < 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2. When extracting parasitic resistance (R_b), distributed RC transmission-line delay along a 512-cell folded column cannot exceed 450 ps; excessive bitline resistance attenuates developing differential signal before the cross-coupled CMOS latch senses, causing catastrophic bit flip or destructive readouts.
critics.supply_chain: Inline automated parametric wafer probers (e.g., Keysight 4080/Keithley S530) and high-frequency S-parameter vector network analyzers / LCR meters required for femtofarad-level C-V extraction are bottlenecked in open-source 200mm fab test bays. Test structures must feature standardized pad cages (100 um x 50 um pads, 100 um pitch) compatible with multi-site wedge probe cards to prevent extended fab cycle times and avoid relying on custom non-standard micro-probing fixtures.
critics.laya_pm: PEX extraction runtimes using 2.5D/3D field solvers across the full dense 1T1C core array risk blocking tapeout sign-off schedules. We require hierarchical extraction: full 3D boundary-element extraction on the 8F^2 unit cell and sense-amp pitch-adapter boundary, combined with calibrated 2.5D rule-based extraction across repetitive 512-row core sectors, ensuring sign-off verification completes within a strict 48-hour turn-around time.
critical_failure_modes: Bitline-to-bitline parasitic coupling capacitance (C_c) asymmetry exceeding 2.0 fF between BL and /BL causing sense amplifier sensing offset inversion during wordline activation.
Specific contact resistivity degradation (rho_c > 1.5e-7 Ohm*cm^2) at bitline diffusion contacts producing unequal RC time constants and premature sense amplifier latching.
Underestimation of M1-M2 interlayer dielectric (ILD) fringing capacitance in PEX techfile leading to silicon-level C_b/C_s > 9.5:1 and total loss of sensing margin under 85°C retention conditions.

testcases.title: Inline Femtofarad C-V Extraction of Folded Bitline Parasitics and C_b/C_s Ratio Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Keysight B1505A/B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer with B1520A Multi-Frequency Capacitance Measurement Unit (MFCMU), Cascade Microtech 200mm semi-automatic shielded probe station, triaxial Kelvin connections.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer at Metal-1/Metal-2 interconnect completion post-passivation; ambient wafer chuck temperature stabilized at 25.0 ± 0.5°C; open/short/load residual fixture de-embedding performed across 10 kHz to 5 MHz.
testcases.procedure: 1. Land triaxial probe tips on the 100 um x 50 um kelvin test pads for isolated 512-cell BL and /BL test structures. 2. Apply a 1.8V DC bias with 30 mV AC modulation at 1 MHz between BL and grounded substrate/adjacent shielding wires. 3. Measure total bitline capacitance C_b. 4. Land probe tips on dedicated 1T1C discrete storage capacitor array test macro; extract single-cell storage capacitance C_s. 5. Compute the ratio C_b / C_s and differential mismatch delta_C = |C_BL - C_/BL|.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Total bitline parasitic capacitance C_b must be between 160.0 fF and 230.0 fF; C_s must be >= 26.0 fF; capacitance ratio C_b / C_s must be <= 8.5 : 1; complementary line capacitive imbalance delta_C must be <= 1.8 fF.

testcases.title: TLM Specific Contact Resistivity and Distributed Bitline Metallization Resistance Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Keithley S530 Parametric Test System, 4-wire Kelvin probe card, thermal chuck set to 25°C and 85°C.
testcases.pre_conditions: Complete metallization etch and alloy/anneal; TLM pad array (pad width W = 100 um, length L_pad = 50 um, gaps d = 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 um) visually inspected free of particle defects.
testcases.procedure: 1. Force 1.0 mA DC current between adjacent TLM pads across gaps d = 5 um through 80 um and record 4-wire voltage drops to calculate total resistance R_T. 2. Perform linear regression of R_T vs. gap distance d to extract contact resistance R_c (y-intercept/2), sheet resistance R_s (slope * W), and transfer length L_T. 3. Calculate specific contact resistivity rho_c = R_c * W * L_T. 4. Measure end-to-end series resistance along full 512-cell physical bitline metal trace.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Specific contact resistivity rho_c must be <= 1.0e-7 Ohm*cm^2; sheet resistance R_s must match PDK target within ± 8.0%; total distributed bitline series resistance R_b over 512 cells must be <= 85.0 Ohm.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Hierarchical Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Charge Pump Generator

**Discipline / Category**: DRAM Circuit Design  
**Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source CMOS  
**Wordline Boosted Voltage ($V_{PP}$)**: $2.50\text{ V} \pm 50\text{ mV}$ (Prevents NMOS $V_{th}$ drop)  
**Row Cycle Time ($t_{RC}$)**: $55.0\text{ ns}$ | **Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$)**: $15.0\text{ ns}$

---

### 1. Hierarchical Row Architecture & Block Diagram

```text
Row Address Bits [A0:A8] (512 Rows per Bank)
        │
        ├─► [ 3-to-8 Predecoder Tree ] ──────────► Predecoded Lines [PRE_A, PRE_B, PRE_C]
        │                                                     │
        │                                                     ▼
        │                                       ┌───────────────────────────┐
        │                                       │   Main Wordline Driver    │
        │                                       │          (MWD)            │
        │                                       └─────────────┬─────────────┘
        │                                                     │
        │                                                     ▼
        │                                       ┌───────────────────────────┐
        │                                       │ High-Voltage Level Shifter│
        │                                       │    (0-1.8V -> 0-2.5V VPP) │
        │                                       └─────────────┬─────────────┘
        │                                                     │
        ▼                                                     ▼
  [ Dickson VPP Charge Pump ] ─────────────────► Sub-Wordline Driver (SWD)
    (4-stage 40MHz oscillator)                                │
                                                              ▼
                                                    Selected Wordline (WL)
                                                 (Drives 256 Cell Gates @ 2.5V)
```

---

### 2. Four-Stage Dickson $V_{PP}$ Charge Pump Architecture

To eliminate the $V_{th}$ threshold drop of the NMOS cell access transistor ($V_{cell} = V_{WL} - V_{th} = 1.8\text{ V} - 0.55\text{ V} = 1.25\text{ V}$), the wordline must be driven by boosted high voltage:

$$V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th(access)} + \Delta V_{overdrive} = 1.80\text{ V} + 0.55\text{ V} + 0.15\text{ V} = 2.50\text{ V}$$

#### Charge Pump Equations:
For an $N$-stage pump ($N = 4$) with clock amplitude $V_{\phi} = 1.80\text{ V}$, flying capacitor $C_{pump} = 25\text{ pF}$, and oscillator frequency $f_{osc} = 40\text{ MHz}$:

$$V_{out} = V_{DD} + N \cdot \left( \frac{C_{pump}}{C_{pump} + C_{str}} V_{\phi} - V_{diode} \right) - \frac{I_{load}}{f_{osc} (C_{pump} + C_{str})}$$

- Flying capacitor: $C_{pump} = 25\text{ pF}$ (MIM capacitor stack)
- Decoupling reservoir capacitor: $C_{res} = 650\text{ pF}$ (maintains $V_{PP}$ ripple $\le 25\text{ mV}$ peak-to-peak)
- Wordline Driver buffer chain: Tapered fanout ($1.0\times, 3.16\times, 10.0\times, 31.6\times$) driving $2.2\text{ pF}$ lumped wordline capacitance with rise time $t_r \le 1.8\text{ ns}$.

---

### 3. Acceptance Verification & Timing Performance Envelope

| Parameter / Metric | Minimum | Typical | Maximum | Units | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Boosted Supply Voltage ($V_{PP}$)** | $2.45$ | $2.50$ | $2.55$ | $\text{V}$ | Digital Multimeter / High-Z Probe |
| **$V_{PP}$ Voltage Ripple ($V_{rip}$)** | $-$ | $18.0$ | $25.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | $500\text{ MHz}$ Digital Oscilloscope |
| **Wordline Rise Time ($t_r$, 10% to 90%)** | $1.2$ | $1.8$ | $2.5$ | $\text{ns}$ | Active Picoprobe (Load: 2.2 pF) |
| **Row Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$)** | $12.0$ | $14.5$ | $15.0$ | $\text{ns}$ | Automated ATE Test Pattern |
| **Decoder Standby Power** | $-$ | $45.0$ | $120.0$ | $\mu\text{W}$ | Current Sense Resistor |

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In a 1.8V core process, boosting VPP to 2.8V imposes extreme gate oxide stress (E_ox approaching 7.5 MV/cm) across the wordline decoder final driver stage unless dual-gate oxide (thick oxide 3.3V/5.0V I/O devices) or cascoded level-shifter topologies are strictly implemented. The Dickson charge pump dynamic regulation loop must exhibit adequate phase margin (>60 deg) under switching bursts to avoid under-damping that could pump VPP past junction breakdown limits (BV_dss ~ 3.6V).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Driving wordline capacitance (approx. 2 pF per mat across 512 access transistors plus RC parasitics) requires dynamic charge reservoir sizing. If the pump reservoir capacitor (C_res) is under 200 pF, wordline activation causes instantaneous droop exceeding 300 mV, directly degrading the write margin and cell signal development Delta V below the 100 mV minimum required by the folded bitline sense amplifier.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Monolithic integration of large flying capacitors (4x 40 pF) and reservoir decoupling consumes substantial silicon area unless high-density metal-insulator-metal (MIM) or dual-poly capacitor options are qualified in the foundry open-source 180nm PDK. Procuring wafers with verified high-voltage thick-oxide options is mandatory to prevent long-term dielectric breakdown failures.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Wordline decoder layout pitch-matching to the DRAM sub-array cell matrix pitch is the primary schedule risk. Level-shifters and pumped VPP routing must fit within the row pitch constraint without violating design rule manual (DRM) latchup spacing rules, which would otherwise force sub-array fragmentation and an area penalty >15%.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown (TDDB) of thin-oxide row driver NMOS devices under continuous 2.8V VPP bias during wordline assertion.
1. VPP voltage pump droop exceeding 250 mV during consecutive multi-bank refresh operations, causing incomplete cell restoration (V_cell < 1.6V) and catastrophic retention data loss.
1. Parasitic substrate minority carrier injection during Dickson pump flying node undershoot, triggering CMOS latchup in adjacent low-voltage decoder logic.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-01` | **Dickson VPP Pump Steady-State Regulation and Load Transient Droop** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Device Parameter Analyzer, Tektronix MSO64B 4GHz Oscilloscope with active high-impedance low-capacitance probe (<0.5 pF), Source Measure Unit (SMU) Keithley 2450. | 1. Measure open-circuit VPP regulated output voltage. 2. Apply a switched load current pulse of 10 mA with 2 ns rise/fall time representing a burst of 4 concurrent row activations. 3. Record VPP steady-state level, transient peak-to-peak droop, and regulation recovery time back to 95% of target. | `VPP open-circuit must regulate between 2.70V and 2.90V; transient droop under 10 mA burst load must not exceed 200 mV (VPP_min >= 2.50V); recovery time must be <= 45 ns.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-02` | **Row Decoder Propagation Delay and High-Voltage Wordline Rise/Fall Dynamics** | Picoprobe Model 10 High-Speed Active Microprobe, Agilent 81110A Pulse/Pattern Generator, Rohde & Schwarz RTO6 6GHz Digital Storage Oscilloscope. | 1. Provide complementary row address pattern A[8:0] to the predecoder stage. 2. Pulse Row Address Strobe (RAS) active low at 100 MHz. 3. Measure time delay between RAS assertion (50% VDD) and final wordline assertion WL[k] reaching 90% of VPP (2.52V). 4. Measure fall time from 90% VPP to 10% VPP. | `Total address-to-WL assertion propagation delay t_RCD_dec <= 8.5 ns; WL rise time (10% to 90% of VPP) <= 3.2 ns; WL fall time <= 2.8 ns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 compatible nitrile gloves (double donning), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV/impact safety glasses with side shields, Electrostatic dissipative (ESD) lab coat and grounded heel straps, Chemical splash apron and face shield during solvent bath refills
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact: wash immediately with copious deionized water for 15 minutes while removing contaminated clothing. Eye contact: flush eyes at eyewash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. Inhalation: move victim to fresh air; administer oxygen if breathing is labored.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Dedicated chemical solvent bench exhaust with face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM); continuous volatile organic compound (VOC) photoionization monitoring with automatic alarm interlocks at 50 ppm.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Segregate spent solvent waste into dedicated grounded poly drums labeled 'Halogen-Free Organic Solvents'. Do not mix with acid/oxidizer streams. Contract certified hazardous material disposal provider according to local EPA/EHS regulations.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.8%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `12 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) or inter-metal dielectric (IMD) post-CMP planarized oxide, surface roughness Ra < 0.3 nm, residual organic contamination < 1e11 atoms/cm².
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Patterned and dry-etched polysilicon/metal wordline interconnects post-solvent clean, completely free of photoresist residues and polymer sidewall veils, ready for inter-layer dielectric PECVD oxide encapsulation.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Moisture absorption and native oxide/fluorine polymer re-deposition along high-aspect-ratio wordline pitch trenches leading to dielectric leakage, inter-line bridging, and accelerated TDDB under continuous 2.8V VPP electric field.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical sign-off and silicon verification of the Gen 2 180nm row/column address decoders and Dickson VPP charge pump, guaranteeing stable wordline overdrive (VPP >= 2.75V) across all process corners (FF, TT, SS) and -40°C to 125°C temperature ranges.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `vpp_charge_pump_transient_droop_test.csv`
- [ ] `row_decoder_timing_and_level_shifter_verification.pdf`
- [ ] `address_decoder_pitch_matched_layout_drc_lvs_report.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Dickson charge pump output voltage under nominal 1.8V VDD input** | `2.80 V` | ±0.10 V | Four-point Kelvin probe electrical measurement via Keysight B1500A on dedicated VPP test pad. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Predecoder and row driver propagation delay from address strobe to 90% VPP assertion** | `7.50 ns` | +1.00 ns / -0.50 ns | High-bandwidth active microprobe oscillography at 2.2 pF simulated wordline load. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **VPP voltage regulation drop during a sustained 10 mA multi-bank refresh burst** | `150 mV` | Max <= 200 mV | Transient DSO waveform capture using Tektronix MSO64B under automated burst pattern. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit requires zero DRC/LVS violations, complete absence of gate oxide overstress (>3.6V V_gd/V_gs) across all simulated corners, confirmed VPP >= 2.70V under maximum burst load, and empirical delivery of all three signed test and inspection artifacts.
