# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Distributed RC Poly/Metal Wordline Transmission Line Modeling & Extraction

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      GDSII Layout      │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Segment RC       │
│     Discretization     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Coupling & Gate Load  │
│       Extraction       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Distributed Ladder   │
│     Netlist Export     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Transient Slew &    │
│    Delay Simulation    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Geometry & Stack Layer Definition**:
   - Extract the physical wordline trace profile from the DRAM cell matrix layout with wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Map poly-gate segments interfacing access transistors with physical channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and gate width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Define gate dielectric stack parameter with thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ having a physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$.

2. **Per-Segment Distributed Resistance Extraction**:
   - Discretize the wordline into discrete $\Pi$- or T-segments corresponding to each individual 1T1C memory cell pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).
   - Calculate sheet resistance across the composite polycide / metal shunt strapping layer to determine line resistance per unit length ($R_{\text{seg}}$).

3. **Capacitive Loading & Dielectric Coupling Formulation**:
   - Compute the active gate oxide capacitance component per cell ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \cdot W \cdot L}{t_{\text{ox}}}$) utilizing the access transistor footprint ($W = 220\text{ nm}, L = 180\text{ nm}, t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Extract lateral inter-wordline parasitic coupling capacitance and wordline-to-bitline crossing capacitance over the folded bitline layout array.

4. **Multi-Stage Transmission Line Netlist Assembly**:
   - Cascade the extracted per-segment $R_{\text{seg}}$ series resistors and parallel shunt capacitors ($C_{\text{gate}} + C_{\text{parasitic}}$) into a multi-stage distributed ladder network.
   - Stitch metal wordline strapping shunt vias to model the parallel low-resistance strap reduction across cell sub-blocks.

5. **Transient Slew & Activation Propagation Verification**:
   - Drive the distributed transmission line with the wordline driver stage ($V_{\text{PP}}$ supply level) in SPICE/transient simulation.
   - Probe rise-time slew rate and signal propagation delay between the nearest cell (near-end) and the furthest cell (far-end) across the memory mat to verify activation integrity.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               180nm DRAM Wordline Structural Metrics   
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░                                        │
 Gate Ox (nm)┤░                                        │
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
WL Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Access W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
Access L (nm)┤█████████████████████                    │
             │█████████████████████                    │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0        90        180       270      360 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wordline Pitch** | $360$ | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | $180$ | $\pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Access Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | $220$ | $\pm 5$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Thermally Grown Gate $\text{SiO}_2$ Dielectric Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry parameters confirming access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms wordline and bitline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$, with thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide at $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (processed at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Governs wordline activation dynamics and folded-bitline cell charge-dump sensing requirements.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Distributed RC transmission line modeling of the composite polysilicon-silicide/metal wordline (WL) is foundational to mitigating row-activation skew across a 512-wordline sub-array block. Relying on lumped RC models produces underdamped or overly optimistic access latency estimates (t_RCD). We must guarantee distributed Pi/T-network ladder segmentation (minimum 32 segments per 512-cell physical WL span) with frequency-dependent skin effect and substrate coupling accounted for, ensuring propagation delay across the furthest access transistor does not exceed 3.2 ns under nominal VPP = 2.8 V overdrive at 85°C junction temperature.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node planar gate stacks with TiSi2/CoSi2 polycide strapped to Metal-1 or Metal-2 bypass lines, wordline sheet resistance typically ranges from 4 to 8 ohm/sq for polycide and 0.08 ohm/sq for metal shunts. The TLM structures must accurately partition diffusion contact resistance (R_c < 15 ohm*um^2) from line resistance. Crucially, the fringing capacitance to adjacent folded bitlines (BL/BL#) and stacked capacitor storage nodes (~28 fF cell target) introduces significant Miller and interline coupling (C_wire ~ 0.22 fF/um), which dominates dynamic rise-time degradation and induces cross-talk wordline bumping on inactive rows.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Test structures require dedicated silicon real estate on parametric test shuttles (KERF/scribe lines) using multi-project wafer (MPW) runs. High-purity refractory targets (Co/Ti/W) and low-k/TEOS inter-metal dielectrics must adhere to standardized commercial 0.18 um foundry PDK design rules (e.g., TSMC 0.18 DRAM or SkyWater 130/180nm mixed-signal derivate) to ensure second-sourcing viability without custom, non-standard silicide or metallization steps.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Delivery of calibrated SPICE subcircuits (.subckt distributed RC models) and S-parameter verification files is gating physical tapeout milestone M2 (Decoder & Driver Layout Freeze). Characterization schedules must balance cryogenic-to-high-temp (0°C to 105°C) 4-port VNA probing turnaround to avoid slip on the core memory peripheral review while locking sign-off corners across SS/TT/FF process splits.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Interline dielectric breakdown and excessive capacitive crosstalk induced by sub-pitch metal bridging or pinholes, causing parasitic wordline coupling (>0.35 V glitch on neighboring unselected rows) and spurious cell access.
1. High contact resistivity (rho_c > 35 ohm*um^2) at polycide-to-tungsten plug vias causing excessive RC propagation delay (>5.5 ns), violating t_RCD and causing sense amplifier activation prior to full cell charge transfer.
1. Transmission line impedance mismatch causing reflections and signal overshoot exceeding gate dielectric breakdown limits (BV_ox > 3.6 V) during rapid sub-nanosecond VPP driver edge transitions.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-2-3-1-01` | **4-Port Vector Network Analyzer S-Parameter Extraction & Distributed Transmission Line Parameter Characterization** | Keysight N5247B PNA-X 4-Port Microwave Network Analyzer (10 MHz - 20 GHz), Cascade Microtech Infinity GSG-100 coplanar microprobes, MPI TS200-SE semi-automated thermal probe station, line-reflect-match (LRM) calibration substrate. | 1. Land GSG microprobes on Input Port 1/2 (Wordline Driver Launch Pad) and Output Port 3/4 (Far-End WL Terminus after 512 memory cell loads). 2. Sweep S-parameters from 10 MHz to 5.0 GHz at -10 dBm RF stimulus power across 1601 measurement points. 3. Measure insertion loss (S21), return loss (S11), and far-end crosstalk (S31, S41). 4. Transform frequency-domain S-parameters via inverse FFT to time-domain reflectometry (TDR) step response. 5. Extract distributed resistance per unit length (R_unit in ohm/mm), inductance (L_unit in nH/mm), capacitance (C_unit in fF/mm), and line characteristic impedance (Z_0). 6. Repeat measurement at chuck temperatures of 0°C, 25°C, and 85°C. | `Distributed wordline line resistance R_unit <= 12.5 ohm/mm (with metal-1 shunt); total distributed capacitance C_unit <= 240 fF/mm; characteristic impedance Z_0 within 45 to 65 ohms; far-end step response 10%-90% rise time t_rise <= 1.85 ns across full 512-cell physical span.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-2-3-1-02` | **High-Bandwidth Active Picoprobe Wordline Slew Rate and End-to-End Activation Propagation Delay Metrology** | Tektronix DPO72004C 20 GHz Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope (50 GS/s), GGB Industries Model 34A Picoprobes (<0.1 pF capacitive loading), Keithley 2450 SourceMeter supplying VPP = 2.80 V, Agilent 81110A Pulse/Pattern Generator. | 1. Configure pulse generator to drive wordline predecoder/driver input with 1.8 V pulse, 500 ps edge rate, 20 ns duration, 1 MHz repetition. 2. Position Channel 1 active Picoprobe at near-end wordline tap immediately following final VPP CMOS driver buffer. 3. Position Channel 2 active Picoprobe at furthest far-end wordline pad (cell index 512, length ~280 um). 4. Acquire 10,000 synchronized waveform averages to suppress random thermal noise. 5. Measure 50%-to-50% propagation delay between near-end VPP transition and far-end transition (t_prop_WL). 6. Calculate slew rate (dV/dt) over 20% to 80% swing range at both near-end and far-end measurement nodes. 7. Monitor unselected adjacent wordlines for transient dynamic cross-talk voltage bounce. | `End-to-end propagation delay t_prop_WL <= 2.20 ns at 85°C; far-end slew rate >= 0.85 V/ns; peak spurious capacitive bounce on unselected adjacent wordline <= 250 mV (must not exceed access transistor subthreshold threshold voltage V_th = 0.55 V).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom chemical splash goggles (ANSI Z87.1 approved), Neoprene over-gloves layered over class-100 cleanroom nitrile gloves, Chemical-resistant PTFE cleanroom apron, Full-face polycarbonate shield during acid bath maintenance and wafer deck cleaning
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For HF exposure: Immediately flush skin with copious cold water for 60 seconds, then immediately massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate USP Gel into affected tissue continuously until medical assistance arrives. For ocular exposure: irrigate eyes with 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic rinse for 15 minutes. For WF6 or acid inhalation: relocate victim immediately to fresh air, administer 100% medical oxygen, and keep supine; summon emergency hazmat response.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical etch benches must maintain dedicated continuous laminar draw face velocity of 100 ± 10 FPM with dedicated ducting to acid scrubbers. Gas cabinets housing WF6 require continuous negative pressure with automated toxic gas monitoring (TGA) detection interlocked to pneumatic cylinder shutoff valves at <0.5 ppm threshold.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent fluoride-bearing chemical waste streams must be routed strictly to dedicated Fluoride Waste Treatment Systems (FWTS). Neutralize via saturated Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) slurry injection to precipitate Calcium Fluoride (CaF2) sludge at pH 8.5 to 9.5; verify effluent free fluoride ion concentration < 10 ppm prior to municipal drainage release.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (BOE 6:1 formulation for pre-contact native oxide removal)** | `7664-39-3` | SEMI Grade 4 / VLSI | `6.8% HF in 34.6% NH4F buffer` |
| **Cobalt(II) Acetate Tetrahydrate (Salicide deposition precursor solution)** | `6147-53-1` | Electronic Grade 99.999% | `99.99% crystalline solid / 0.1 M aqueous precursor` |
| **Tungsten Hexafluoride (CVD W-plug wordline strapping contact fill)** | `7783-82-6` | Electronic Grade 99.999% | `99.999% anhydrous gas` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `45 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `6 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Hydrophobic, freshly deglazed polysilicon and active diffusion contact vias post-dilute HF/BOE clean; contact openings completely free of chemical oxide residue (effective SiO2 thickness < 0.6 nm verified via spectroscopic ellipsometry).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Conformal salicide (CoSi2/TiSi2) reacted and capped with PVD Titanium Nitride (TiN) diffusion barrier (15 nm thickness), impervious to ambient oxygen penetration and moisture absorption.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding Q-time in ambient cleanroom air causes uncontrolled native oxide regrow (1.2 - 1.8 nm SiO2) at polycide-to-silicon and metal-plug interfaces, escalating specific contact resistance rho_c by >300%, leading to unacceptable wordline RC delay degradation, row-access timeout failures, and premature dielectric punch-through.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Calibrated, silicon-verified distributed RLCG SPICE transmission line model (.subckt) and comprehensive extraction report characterizing the 180nm polycide/metal-strapped wordline architecture, matching physical high-frequency S-parameter and transient activation delay measurements within ±7% error across 0°C to 85°C operational boundaries.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_180nm_wordline_distributed_rlcg_model.subckt`
- [ ] `wordline_rc_extraction_and_s_parameter_correlation_report.pdf`
- [ ] `wafer_level_tlm_and_slew_rate_transient_dataset.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Specific contact resistivity (rho_c) extracted via multi-pitch TLM structures at metal-1/polycide strap contacts** | `1.2e-7 ohm*cm^2` | ± 1.5e-8 ohm*cm^2 | Linear regression analysis of total resistance R_T vs contact spacing d (5 um to 80 um) using 4-point Kelvin probe metrology at 25°C. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Distributed transmission line total activation delay (t_RCD_WL) across 512-cell wordline array span at VPP = 2.8 V and T = 85°C** | `1.95 ns` | +0.25 ns / -0.15 ns | Active Picoprobe transient step timing extraction from 50% driver transition to 50% far-end access transistor gate terminal. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Model-to-hardware correlation of transmission line insertion loss (S21) up to 2.5 GHz Nyquist frequency** | `-1.45 dB` | ± 0.20 dB | Keysight PNA-X 4-port VNA calibrated vector measurement versus distributed RLCG SPICE AC simulation. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Formal acceptance requires sign-off from both Lead Circuit Architect and Device Metrology Manager confirming: (1) measured TLM specific contact resistivity rho_c <= 1.5e-7 ohm*cm^2 across >= 95% of characterized wafer die sites; (2) verified SPICE netlist (.subckt) passes Cadence Spectre/Synopsys PrimeSim transient simulation without convergence singularities; and (3) measured end-to-end wordline RC delay at 85°C does not exceed 2.20 ns, leaving >= 1.0 ns timing margin for row sense amplifier strobe.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: High-Bandwidth Active Picoprobe & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Transient Measurement Setup
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-DRAM180-042`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{\text{PP}}$ Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Distributed RC Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay Transient Metrology > High-Bandwidth Active Picoprobe & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Transient Measurement Setup  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu$m scale)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Development Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Environmental Prep & Anti-Vibration Bench Setup (22°C ± 1°C)"] --> B["2. Picoprobe Mechanical Alignment to Wordline Node (Pitch: 360-400 nm)"]
    B --> C["3. High-Z Active Probe Tip Calibration & De-skew (< 0.1 pF parasitic load)"]
    C --> D["4. Row Address Decoder & VPP Pump Step Stimulation"]
    D --> E["5. Distributed RC Slew Rate & Signal Development Capture (Delta V: 100-150 mV)"]
    E --> F["6. In-Situ Automated Validation & Metric Acceptance Check"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Test Environmental Stabilization & Isolation**
   - Ensure the analytical probe station chuck thermal controller is stabilized at nominal room test conditions ($22^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$ or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for accelerated retention/leakage validation).
   - Activate the active vibration isolation platform and verify optical microscope illumination to prevent localized photon-induced silicon carrier generation.

2. **Picoprobe Mechanical Landing & Sub-Micron Positioning**
   - Mount the high-bandwidth active picoprobe (high input impedance FET probe with ultra-low capacitive loading $< 0.1\text{ pF}$) onto the sub-micron 3-axis motorized micro-manipulator.
   - Using high-magnification optics, align the tungsten/beryllium-copper picoprobe tip onto the designated internal metal test pad or de-passivated wordline driver tap along the array edge, strictly respecting the **wordline pitch constraint of 360 nm to 400 nm**.
   - Lower the micro-manipulator with fine Z-axis translation until an electrical contact scrub of $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$ is visually confirmed, avoiding damage to underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide and access transistor channels ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

3. **Instrument Calibration & Ground Reference Loop Optimization**
   - Connect the active picoprobe to a $\ge 4\text{ GHz}$ digital storage oscilloscope terminated into $50\ \Omega$.
   - Mount the ultra-short coaxial ground blade directly to the adjacent localized on-chip $V_{\text{SS}}$ shield/ground pad to minimize parasitic ground lead loop inductance ($L_{\text{gnd}} < 1\text{ nH}$).
   - Perform fixture de-skew and dynamic baseline zeroing prior to pulsing.

4. **Address Decoder & $V_{\text{PP}}$ Wordline Activation**
   - Initialize automated vector test generation to trigger the hierarchical row address predecoders and wordline driver stage.
   - Assert the boosted $V_{\text{PP}}$ wordline pulse to activate the access transistors across the distributed RC wordline matrix.
   - Observe the transient rise time ($10\% - 90\%$), propagation delay across near-end vs. far-end wordline sectors, and $V_{\text{PP}}$ supply droop during peak gate-capacitance charging.

5. **Differential Signal & Cell Readout Correlation**
   - Correlate wordline activation slew rate with differential signal development on the complementary bitline pair ($\Delta V$), verifying that bitline equalization at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$ breaks cleanly into the expected cell readout signal ($100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) prior to sense amplifier latching.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
               180nm DRAM Physical & Metrology Targets  
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
```

### 4. Verified Source Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Signal development charge distribution: $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{\text{cell}} - V_{\text{BL}})$.
   - Bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, typical cell capacitance $C_{\text{s}} = 25\text{ fF}$.
   - Differential signal development target: $\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
   - Precharge operation at $V_{\text{DD}} / 2$.

2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Transistor geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Cell capacitance budget: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell with dielectric stack effective constant $\kappa > 15$.
   - Leakage current target: Sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Physical dimensions: Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Gate dielectric physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
   - Storage capacitance requirement: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$ maintaining data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Picoprobe tip loading capacitance must not exceed 0.1 pF to prevent artificial dampening of the distributed RC wordline propagation delay. At 180nm nodes, an unbuffered high-impedance probe can induce a 15-25% slew rate under-reporting and mask high-frequency VPP pump ripple transients (exceeding 200 MHz switching noise). The measurement loop ground path inductance must be constrained below 1.5 nH via integrated coaxial active tip grounding to eliminate inductive ringing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline overdrive voltage VPP operates between 2.5V and 3.3V to overcome the NMOS transfer gate threshold drop (Vth) during DRAM cell access. The active picoprobe must provide a flat dynamic frequency response up to at least 3.0 GHz with a high input resistance (>1 MOhm) to capture sub-nanosecond rise times (tr < 800 ps) without loading the localized high-impedance charge pump storage reservoir.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procurement of specialized commercial active picoprobes (e.g., GGB Industries Model 34A/35 or FormFactor |Z| Probe series with replaceable tungsten tips) entails an 8-12 week lead time and export control documentation. Secondary sourcing of precision beryllium-copper and tungsten micro-tips (radius <= 0.5 um) must be secured alongside dedicated calibration substrates (e.g., CS-5) to avoid single-point operational bottlenecks.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The capital expenditure budget for this high-bandwidth active probing setup directly impacts the Gen 2 test metrology milestone schedule. Delivery and qualification of the probe station anti-vibration table, high-speed DSO (minimum 4 GHz, 20 GS/s), and active probe heads must conclude prior to tape-out silicon arrival to enable instantaneous first-silicon wordline transient bring-up within 72 hours.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Excessive mechanical contact pressure causing micro-cracking, cratering, or dielectric punch-through of the top-metal (Metal2/Metal3) landing pad down to underlying polysilicon wordlines.
1. Capacitive probe loading exceeding 150 fF, which masks VPP transient undershoot and leads to false-positive wordline activation timing margins.
1. Electrostatic discharge (ESD) through the unshielded high-impedance active FET tip during touchdown, destroying the sub-micron on-die wordline driver transistors.

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 nitrile gloves (static dissipative, 4 mil), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and laser impact safety glasses, ESD wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor, Lint-free antistatic cleanroom smock and conductive footwear
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with IPA, flush thoroughly with copious running water for at least 15 minutes; for eye splash, irrigate immediately at eye wash station holding eyelids open. If inhaled, relocate personnel to clean ambient air. For electrical flash or shock from high-speed probe bias supply, disconnect main power immediately and administer CPR/first aid if unconscious.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized laminar flow hood with HEPA filtration (Class 100/ISO 5) and dedicated solvent-rated exhaust snorkel providing face velocity >= 100 FPM (0.5 m/s) during manual probe tip solvent cleaning.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent wipes and rinse IPA must be collected in dedicated grounded, FM-approved flammable hazardous liquid waste containers; never dispose down sink drains. Treat in accordance with local semiconductor solvent effluent reclamation standards.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly etched/unpassivated aluminum-copper (Al-Cu) or tungsten test pads with native oxide thickness <= 1.5 nm; particulate count <= 1 particle (>0.3 um) per cm2.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Punctured/scrubbed native oxide on probed pad surface showing localized mechanical scrub mark <= 0.8 um width; zero underlying interlayer dielectric (ILD) cratering.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding ambient air queue time results in excessive native alumina (Al2O3) growth (>3.0 nm), requiring aggressive probe overtravel/scrubbing that shatters fragile 180nm landing pads or introduces inconsistent contact resistance (>50 Ohms), corrupting high-frequency transient timing.

**Exit Objective Summary**:

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Far-End Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay ($t_{RCD}$) Oscilloscope Characterization
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-WL-TRCD-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Hierarchical Row/Column Address Predecoder & Wordline Driver Sizing > Distributed RC Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay Transient Metrology > Far-End Wordline Slew Rate & Activation Delay $t_{RCD}$ Oscilloscope Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### Characterization Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  ACT Command & Master  │
│     Clock Trigger      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Active Picoprobe    │
│    Probe Station at    │
│     Far-End WL Pad     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Real-Time DSO Slew   │
│    Rate 10% to 90%     │
│      Acquisition       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Sense Amp Strobe    │
│   SAN/SAP Cross-Over   │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Extract Far-End     │
│  Propagation Delay &   │
│     Effective tRCD     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This procedure defines the experimental oscilloscope metrology to quantify the distributed RC propagation delay and edge degradation (slew rate) along the polycide wordline (WL) at the physical boundary (far-end edge of the 180nm cell mat, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$ access transistor matrix). It directly qualifies the row activation timing margin ($t_{RCD}$: Row-to-Column Command Delay) needed for robust folded-bitline signal charge transfer ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$) into the CMOS cross-coupled sense amplifier latch before strobe activation.

---

### 2. Equipment & Metrology Setup
1. **Real-Time Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO):** $\ge 4\text{ GHz}$ analog bandwidth, $\ge 20\text{ GSa/s}$ real-time sampling rate, 50 $\Omega$ input impedance.
2. **Active High-Impedance Microprobe:** Active FET Picoprobe with input tip capacitance $C_{tip} \le 0.1\text{ pF}$ and input resistance $R_{in} \ge 1\text{ M}\Omega$ to eliminate loading on high-impedance far-end distributed RC poly/silicide lines.
3. **Automated Sub-Micron Analytical Wafer Prober:** Thermal chuck calibrated at $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate high-temperature corner retention and sub-threshold leakage conditions.
4. **Pattern Generator / Automated Test Equipment (ATE):** Delivering synchronous `PRECHARGE`, `ACTIVATE` (Row Address Strobe), and `READ` burst sequences.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

#### Step 3.1: Wafer Loading & Thermal Stabilization
1. Mount the 180nm DRAM test wafer on the micro-probing chuck.
2. Set and stabilize chuck temperature at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** to replicate worst-case retention and channel leakage constraints.
3. Align micropositioner tips to dedicated top-metal unpassivated test pads located at:
   - **Near-End Node:** Wordline driver output node ($WL_{near}$).
   - **Far-End Node:** Termination point of the selected row across the memory mat ($WL_{far}$).
   - **Internal Sensing Node:** Sense amplifier latch strobe test point ($SAN$ pull-down / $SAP$ pull-up).

#### Step 3.2: Pattern Generation & Oscilloscope Synchronization
1. Program the ATE pattern generator to issue a periodic `PRECHARGE-ALL` followed by row `ACTIVATE` command pulses.
2. Ensure precharge equalization verifies complementary bitlines settling to $V_{DD} / 2$ prior to assertion.
3. Trigger DSO Channel 1 on the rising edge of the system clock/master command bus corresponding to `ACTIVATE` (50% amplitude crossing).

#### Step 3.3: Far-End Wordline Slew Rate Acquisition
1. Acquire DSO waveform on Channel 2 ($WL_{far}$) over 512 ensemble-averaged acquisitions to suppress thermal and Johnson-Nyquist noise.
2. Measure the $10\%$ to $90\%$ voltage transition time ($t_{rise}$) from ground ($0\text{ V}$) to the boosted wordline potential ($V_{PP}$).
3. Calculate the far-end wordline slew rate:
   $$\text{Slew Rate} = \frac{V_{PP}(90\%) - V_{PP}(10\%)}{t_{rise(10\%-90\%)}}$$

#### Step 3.4: Signal Development & Effective $t_{RCD}$ Timing Extraction
1. Monitor Channel 3 connected to the sense amplifier pull-down node ($SAN$).
2. Measure the total propagation and activation delay from the external `ACTIVATE` command timestamp ($t_0$) to the $50\%$ crossing of $WL_{far}$ reaching full activation threshold ($V_{th} + \Delta V_{overdrive}$).
3. Measure the time delta between full far-end cell charge dumping ($\Delta V \approx 100\text{--}150\text{ mV}$ signal development) and the strobe activation of $SAN$ pulling to ground.
4. Record the effective $t_{RCD}$ margin:
   $$t_{RCD(\text{meas})} = t(SAN_{\text{active}}) - t(ACT_{\text{cmd}})$$

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Chuck Metrology Temperature** | $85.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ | Calibrated Chuck RTD Sensor |
| **Bitline Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | $100\text{ to }150$ | $\text{mV}$ | $\ge 100\text{ mV}$ min threshold | High-Z Oscilloscope Microprobe |
| **Storage Cell Unit Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25\text{ to }30$ | $\text{fF}$ | $\ge 25\text{ fF}$ ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$ for high-k/noise target) | CV Metrology / Charge Integral Extraction |
| **Access Transistor Physical Gate Length** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Target nominal design rule | In-line CD-SEM / Layout GDS Verification |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
* **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**: Defines folded-bitline topology, bitline equalization to $V_{DD} / 2$, cell charge dumping equation $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$, differential signal development target $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ with $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and sense amplifier latching operation ($SAN$ pulling low).
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Defines the 180nm unit cell geometry (access transistor length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget of $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ per cell for alpha-particle soft error immunity, and sub-threshold/junction leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Defines 1T1C architecture, cell layout ($8F^2$ / $6F^2$), minimum cell storage capacitance range of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ to guarantee data retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, gate dielectric dry oxidation thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$), and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Far-end wordline transient metrology demands rigorous de-embedding of active microprobe parasitics. At Gen 2 geometry, standard passive tips introduce 8-12 pF shunt capacitance, which overwhelms the sub-picofarad distributed RC of the 180nm polysilicon/silicide wordline. Active high-impedance FET probes (<0.2 pF, >1 MΩ, >4 GHz bandwidth) mounted on vibration-isolated 3-axis micromanipulators with localized ground returns directly adjacent to the test pad are mandatory to prevent artificial slew degradation and resonant ringing.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline boost voltage (VPP ~2.8V-3.2V) driving through hierarchical row predecoders and local sub-wordline drivers exhibits non-linear distributed RC delay due to gate-channel capacitance voltage dependency along the row. Slew rate (dV/dt) measured at the 10%-90% swing at the physically farthest memory cell gate must ensure access transistor turn-on is sharp enough to suppress subthreshold leakage during charge sharing, maintaining sufficient signal margin on the bitline before sense amplifier latching (tRCD).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Active high-bandwidth microprobes, beryllium-copper or tungsten probe tips (<1 µm contact radius), and anti-vibration optical tables (pneumatic or sorbothane/neoprene isolation) have extended lead times and significant procurement risk for a domestic pilot line. # Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump [DRAM Circuit Design] > Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV.
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Transient post-layout parasitic extraction (RC extraction) at 180nm must capture distributed wordline metal interconnect resistances and gate capacitances across the entire memory array edge. The Dickson/cross-coupled VPP charge pump introduces high-frequency ripple (>50 MHz) onto the boost node, which, if not decoupled with localized MIM/MOS capacitor tanks, modulates VPP slew rate across far-end row decoders, risking cell pass-transistor gate underdrive or gate oxide overstress beyond the 180nm 5V thick-oxide limit (absolute maximum ~5.5V).
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline driver VPP slew rate (dV/dt) directly dictates access pass-transistor turn-on dynamics versus bitline differential discharge. If wordline turn-on dV/dt exceeds 1.2 V/ns, capacitive displacement currents through the access transistor gate-to-drain/source overlap capacitances inject charge into floating bitlines, inducing false differential sensing. Conversely, a slew rate below 0.35 V/ns compromises row cycle time (tRC) and access latency (tRAC) below the Gen 2 specification.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Active high-bandwidth microprobing (<0.2 pF active probe tips) and low-noise wafer prober chucks rated for sub-100 femtoamp leakage are difficult to acquire under open-source laboratory budgets. Metrology setups must standardize on accessible Picoprobe Model 18C or custom GGB active FET probe tips mounted on manual micromanipulators with MGN12H linear stages and NEMA 17 vibration-damped mounts.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Transient post-layout extraction simulation and silicon bench microprobing verification must not block the tapeout critical path. Fast-spice transient sim signoff and physical microprobing protocols on test coupon structures must correlate within a ±10% margin before freeze date, ensuring that row decoder driver sizing iterations do not cascade into mask re-spin expenses.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. VPP gate-oxide dielectric breakdown (TDDB) during pump overshoot exceeding 5.5V under zero-load conditions during wordline deselection.
1. Dynamic supply bounce and substrate noise injection from simultaneous row address decoding causing VPP voltage drop below 3.0V, resulting in incomplete cell charge restoration ('weak 1' write).
1. Microprobe capacitive loading (>1.0 pF) distorting measured transient slew rates by more than 35%, masking sluggish in-situ wordline rise times.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-01` | **Post-Layout VPP Charge Pump Open-Circuit and Full-Load Slew Rate Metrology** | Keysight DSOX6004A 1GHz/20GSa/s Oscilloscope, GGB Picoprobe Model 35 Active FET Probe (0.1 pF input capacitance, 10:1 divider), Wentworth Laboratory manual microprobe station with anti-vibration sorbothane table. | 1. Land active microprobe tip on designated VPP test pad (unbuffered internal pump node with 10k isolation resistor or dedicated probe pad). 2. Assert PUMP_EN high while maintaining row decoder wordlines in standby (zero active load). 3. Trigger oscilloscope on rising edge of PUMP_EN and record transient waveform to steady-state VPP (0% to 90% rise time and peak overshoot). 4. Apply 50MHz pseudo-random row address cycling activating 1-of-256 wordline decoders to simulate nominal dynamic load (equivalent ~12 pF distributed load). 5. Measure steady-state ripple voltage, loaded rise time (10% to 90%), and falling slew rate upon PUMP_EN deassertion. | `Target steady-state VPP = 3.6V (±0.15V under load). Slew rate (10% to 90%) must be between 0.40 V/ns and 1.00 V/ns. Peak overshoot must not exceed 4.10V under no-load condition. Peak-to-peak ripple at 50MHz must be <= 120 mV.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-02` | **Wordline Driver Far-End Rise/Fall Transient Slew Rate & Delay Metrology** | Tektronix DPO7104C Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope (1 GHz), dual GGB Picoprobe Model 18C probes (0.04 pF active FET input), Agilent 33250A Function/Arbitrary Waveform Generator. | 1. Configure function generator to toggle row address decoder line at 20 MHz with 50% duty cycle. 2. Synchronously capture Channel 1 (near-end wordline) and Channel 2 (far-end wordline) transient rising and falling edges. 3. Calculate 10%-90% rise time, 90%-10% fall time, and near-to-far propagation delay (tPD_WL) across 10,000 acquisition cycles with persistence enabled. 4. Extract dV/dt (slew rate) over linear 20%-80% transition window for both near and far ends. | `Far-end rise slew rate must exceed 0.35 V/ns and not exceed 1.10 V/ns. Propagation skew between near-end and far-end wordline activation must be <= 3.8 ns. Wordline fall slew rate must achieve < 0.80 V/ns without negative undershoot exceeding -0.30V.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom ESD-safe nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil), ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-scratch UV/laser/microscope safety glasses, ESD wrist strap with 1 Mohm series current-limiting resistor, Static-dissipative lint-free lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin contact with solvents: Flush exposed area with copious clean running water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water for 15 minutes at eyewash station, holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. For vapor inhalation: Move person to fresh air immediately. For electrical shock from HV probe amplifiers or bias rails: De-energize source, verify safety, initiate CPR if unresponsive, and summon emergency medical services.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop chemical solvent cleaning must occur under dedicated ductless laminar fume hood with organic vapor carbon filter face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). Microprobe station must operate inside Class 1000/ISO 6 laminar flow enclosure.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent swabs and solvent rinses (IPA, Acetone) must be segregated into closed, grounded, flame-proof red HDPE hazardous solvent waste carboys labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'. Zero drain disposal.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor / Electronic Grade VLSI | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `60 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `48 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly solvent-cleaned, dry, unpassivated or passivated Al-Cu/TiN probe pads free of native oxide hydration, organic particulate, and probe scrub pits.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probe-tested pads inspected under 50x darkfield microscope with probe scrub damage < 15% of pad area; blown dry with ultra-pure filtered nitrogen (0.2 µm filter).
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Native oxide (Al2O3) buildup on aluminum bond pads increases probe contact resistance (>50 ohms), causing false high-frequency slew rate damping and inaccurate voltage drop measurements during microprobing.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completed physical transient microprobing metrology and calibrated post-layout transient simulation overlay confirming that the 180nm VPP charge pump and wordline decoder network meet voltage slew, propagation delay, and ripple criteria across all PVT corners.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `VPP_Slew_Rate_Transient_Metrology_Report.pdf`
- [ ] `Post_Layout_Vs_Silicon_Transient_Waveforms.csv`
- [ ] `Microprobe_Pad_Scrub_Darkfield_Inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Steady-state regulated VPP voltage output under nominal 50MHz row cycling load** | `3.60 V` | ± 0.15 V | High-bandwidth active microprobe (Picoprobe 35) connected to 20GSa/s digital oscilloscope averaged over 10,000 cycles. |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Far-end wordline transient rising slew rate (20% to 80% transition)** | `0.65 V/ns` | +0.35 / -0.25 V/ns | Calibrated dual-channel active FET probe measurement with automated oscilloscope slope measurement math function. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Post-layout transient spice simulation to silicon microprobe waveform correlation margin** | `92.0 %` | >= 88.0 % | Pearson correlation coefficient and RMS error overlay comparison across time domain window [0 to 50 ns] recorded in CSV artifact. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All quantitative assertions validated across minimum 3 separate die test coupons, with far-end wordline rise slew rate >= 0.40 V/ns, VPP ripple <= 120 mV, zero oxide breakdown signatures after 10^7 pump cycles, and formal signoff endorsement from Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.

testcases.instrumentation: Tektronix DPO7104C Digital Phosphor Oscilloscope (1 GHz), dual GGB Picoprobe Model 18C probes (0.04 pF active FET input), Agilent 33250A Function/Arbitrary Waveform Generator.
testcases.pre_conditions: Wafer coupon positioned on probe chuck with ground plane contacted; internal VPP regulator locked at 3.6V; Row Address Strobe (/RAS) signal synced to function generator at 20 MHz; probe 1 landed on near-end wordline tap (decoder output) and probe 2 landed on far-end wordline array boundary.
testcases.procedure: 1. Configure function generator to toggle row address decoder line at 20 MHz with 50% duty cycle. 2. Synchronously capture Channel 1 (near-end wordline) and Channel 2 (far-end wordline) transient rising and falling edges. 3. Calculate 10%-90% rise time, 90%-10% fall time, and near-to-far propagation delay (tPD_WL) across 10,000 acquisition cycles with persistence enabled. 4. Extract dV/dt (slew rate) over linear 20%-80% transition window for both near and far ends.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Far-end rise slew rate must exceed 0.35 V/ns and not exceed 1.10 V/ns. Propagation skew between near-end and far-end wordline activation must be <= 3.8 ns. Wordline fall slew rate must achieve < 0.80 V/ns without negative undershoot exceeding -0.30V.

ppe_required: Class 100 cleanroom ESD-safe nitrile gloves (thickness >= 4 mil)
ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-scratch UV/laser/microscope safety glasses
ESD wrist strap with 1 Mohm series current-limiting resistor
Static-dissipative lint-free lab coat
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: For skin contact with solvents: Flush exposed area with copious clean running water for at least 15 minutes. For eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water for 15 minutes at eyewash station, holding eyelids open; seek immediate ophthalmological attention. For vapor inhalation: Move person to fresh air immediately. For electrical shock from HV probe amplifiers or bias rails: De-energize source, verify safety, initiate CPR if unresponsive, and summon emergency medical services.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Benchtop chemical solvent cleaning must occur under dedicated ductless laminar fume hood with organic vapor carbon filter face velocity >= 0.5 m/s (100 FPM). Microprobe station must operate inside Class 1000/ISO 6 laminar flow enclosure.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent solvent swabs and solvent rinses (IPA, Acetone) must be segregated into closed, grounded, flame-proof red HDPE hazardous solvent waste carboys labeled 'Hazardous Flammable Solvent Waste'. Zero drain disposal.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Freshly solvent-cleaned, dry, unpassivated or passivated Al-Cu/TiN probe pads free of native oxide hydration, organic particulate, and probe scrub pits.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Probe-tested pads inspected under 50x darkfield microscope with probe scrub damage < 15% of pad area; blown dry with ultra-pure filtered nitrogen (0.2 µm filter).
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Native oxide (Al2O3) buildup on aluminum bond pads increases probe contact resistance (>50 ohms), causing false high-frequency slew rate damping and inaccurate voltage drop measurements during microprobing.

expected_result.summary: Completed physical transient microprobing metrology and calibrated post-layout transient simulation overlay confirming that the 180nm VPP charge pump and wordline decoder network meet voltage slew, propagation delay, and ripple criteria across all PVT corners.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Steady-state regulated VPP voltage output under nominal 50MHz row cycling load
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: High-bandwidth active microprobe (Picoprobe 35) connected to 20GSa/s digital oscilloscope averaged over 10,000 cycles.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Far-end wordline transient rising slew rate (20% to 80% transition)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Calibrated dual-channel active FET probe measurement with automated oscilloscope slope measurement math function.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Post-layout transient spice simulation to silicon microprobe waveform correlation margin
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Pearson correlation coefficient and RMS error overlay comparison across time domain window [0 to 50 ns] recorded in CSV artifact.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All quantitative assertions validated across minimum 3 separate die test coupons, with far-end wordline rise slew rate >= 0.40 V/ns, VPP ripple <= 120 mV, zero oxide breakdown signatures after 10^7 pump cycles, and formal signoff endorsement from Systems Engineer and Domain Expert.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Parasitic RC Extraction & Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation
**Chip Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Hierarchy:** `[Architecture & Integration]` > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump `[DRAM Circuit Design]` > Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology `[Metrology]` > Parasitic RC Extraction & Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation `[Circuit Design]`  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Layout & Layer  │
│          Map           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Rule-based 3D PEX    │
│         Engine         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       RC Network       │
│  Distributed Slicing   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wordline Driver &    │
│     Pass-Gate Mesh     │
│        Netlist         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   SPICE Simulation &   │
│  Slew Rate Metrology   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

1. **Layout Design Rule and Geometry Ingestion**:
   - Ingest the physical GDSII layout for the 180nm folded bitline unit cell matrix ($8F^2$ footprint with unit cell area $A_{\text{cell}} = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at feature size $F = 180\ \text{nm}$).
   - Bind the 1T1C NMOS access transistor dimensions with channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and channel width $W = 220\ \text{nm}$, ensuring shared bitline contact definitions across adjacent pairs.

2. **Extraction Stack & Dielectric Profiling**:
   - Configure the extraction rules for the stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) structure erected over drain contacts via tungsten plugs (W-plugs).
   - Set up the dielectric stack rules for high-$\kappa$ dielectrics (effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$, using ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$).
   - Define interconnect metal layers, polysilicon wordline sheet resistance, and contact via resistances.

3. **Distributed RC Segment Slicing & Mesh Extraction**:
   - Run 3D field-solver/rule-based parasitic extraction (PEX) on the continuous wordline line extending across an array sector of $256$ to $512$ unit cells.
   - Symmetrically segment the wordline interconnect into per-cell distributed $\Pi$ or $\text{T}$-filter ladder stages, accounting for wordline series wire resistance ($R_{\text{WL}}$) and gate-to-channel / overlap capacitances ($C_{\text{ox}}, C_{\text{g-ov}}$).
   - Incorporate bitline coupling parasitics and maintain array line loading representing bitline parasitic capacitance $C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$.

4. **VPP Voltage Driver & Storage Node Coupling Stitching**:
   - Instantiate the wordline driver model coupled to the boosted high-voltage rail $V_{\text{PP}}$ ($V_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}$ to $2.8\ \text{V}$, driven by the on-chip 4-stage Dickson oscillator with flying capacitors $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\ \text{pF}$ to $50\ \text{pF}$ and clock frequencies of $20\ \text{MHz}$ to $50\ \text{MHz}$).
   - Wire each distributed access NMOS gate tap to its respective storage node capacitor ($C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$, nominal target $28\ \text{fF}$).
   - Set access device threshold voltage parameters $V_{\text{th}} = 0.5\ \text{V}$ to $0.7\ \text{V}$ (nominally $0.6\ \text{V}$).

5. **Netlist Generation & DRC/LVS Cross-Check**:
   - Export the hierarchical SPICE subcircuit netlist (`wordline_rc_mesh.sp`) including full distributed parasitics, sub-threshold leakage parameters ($I_{\text{leak}} < 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$), and port definitions for near-end and far-end wordline transient metrology.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit Cell Storage Node Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $28.0$ | $\ge 25.0 \text{ to } 30.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-extraction nodal capacitance metrology |
| **Bitline-to-Storage Capacitance Ratio ($C_b / C_s$)** | $\le 9.0 : 1$ | $5.0 : 1 \text{ to } 9.0 : 1$ (hard limit $< 10.0 : 1$) | Ratio | Analytical RC ratio check on 256/512 cell array |
| **Wordline Overdrive Rail Voltage ($V_{\text{PP}}$)** | $2.8$ | $2.5 \text{ to } 2.8$ | $\text{V}$ | SPICE DC/Transient operating point check |
| **Cell Leakage Current ($I_{\text{leak}}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Post-layout static leakage simulation |

---

### Literature Citations & Context Alignment

1. **1T1C DRAM Cell Operation, Folded Bitline Topology & Capacitance Budgets**:
   - Validates cell footprint ($8F^2 = 0.259\ \mu\text{m}^2$ at $F = 180\ \text{nm}$), storage node capacitance budget ($C_s \ge 25\ \text{fF}$ to $30\ \text{fF}$, nominally $28\ \text{fF}$), bitline parasitic budget ($C_b = 150\ \text{fF}$ to $250\ \text{fF}$ for 256/512 cells), and the critical ratio constraint ($C_b / C_s \in [5:1, 9:1]$, degradation above $10:1$).
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Validates access NMOS geometry ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$), stacked COB capacitor with tungsten plug contacts, high-$\kappa$ dielectric parameters ($\kappa > 15$ with ONO or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5 / \text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$), and leakage ceiling of $1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture**:
   - Validates NMOS threshold voltage loss ($V_{\text{th}} \sim 0.5\ \text{V}$ to $0.7\ \text{V}$), the requirement for boosted wordline overdrive voltage $V_{\text{PP}} \ge 2.5\ \text{V}$ to $2.8\ \text{V}$, and Dickson pump design specs (4 stages, $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\ \text{pF}$ to $50\ \text{pF}$, clock rate $20\ \text{MHz}$ to $50\ \text{MHz}$).

---
*Captured micro-knowledge documented in [wordline_pex_sop.md](docs/knowledge/wordline_pex_sop.md).*

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Parasitic RC extraction across a 512-cell wordline array in a 180nm process must capture distributed RC mesh network characteristics rather than lumped models. The elevated wordline overdrive voltage (VPP = 2.8V - 3.0V) and fast slew rates (>1.2 V/ns) drive significant capacitive displacement currents into adjacent floating wordlines and quiet bitlines. Disregarding cross-coupling capacitance (C_c) between adjacent wordline segments (W = 220nm access gate pitch) underestimates wordline propagation delay by up to 35%, causing timing skew across sub-wordline driver (SWD) domains and severe read margin degradation where C_b/C_s approaches the 9:1 threshold.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm with folded bitline 8F^2 topology (cell area = 0.259 um^2), the wordline poly-silicide strapping (WSix/TiSi2 over N+ doped polysilicon) exhibits a sheet resistance of 5 to 10 ohms/sq. Failure to model 3D field-solver parasitic capacitance extraction between the wordline strap, tungsten contact plugs (W-plugs), and overlying bitline metal layers will result in underestimating the RC time constant tau = R_wl * C_wl. A non-uniform RC distributed ladder causes inner-array cells to suffer from truncated gate overdrive time during sensing, limiting stored charge accumulation into the 28 fF stacked ONO/high-k capacitor.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Extraction models must be calibrated strictly against the 180nm CMOS PDK technology files (ITD/ICT format for Calibre xRC or StarRC) certified for commercial foundry tapeout (e.g., TSMC 0.18um or SilTerra 0.18um mixed-signal/eDRAM). Sourcing verified open-source PDK rule decks (such as SkyWater 130nm/180nm or open PDK derivatives) requires rigorous verification of metal thickness, dielectric permittivity (kappa = 3.9 for SiO2 ILD, kappa > 15 for ONO/Al2O3 cap dielectric), and interconnect corner models (Cmin, Cmax, Rmin, Rmax) to prevent post-fab yielding collapse.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The post-layout extraction run and distributed netlist generation schedule must strictly align with the milestone delivery for the Address Decoder and VPP Voltage Pump sign-off. Generating full 3D extraction on a complete 1Mb memory block can exceed 36 hours of CPU runtime and generate netlists exceeding 50GB; therefore, the team must employ hierarchical extraction and cell boundary tiling to cap runtime within an 8-hour nightly regression cycle while guaranteeing LVS/ERC clean verification.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Wordline distributed RC delay mismatch exceeding 1.8 ns between near-end SWD driver and far-end termination, causing cell access transistor under-drive and incomplete bitline charge transfer below 150 mV differential signal.
1. Capacitive crosstalk feedthrough (> 350 mV) onto unselected adjacent wordlines during VPP switching transients, inducing sub-threshold channel conduction (> 1 fA/cell) and destroying cell retention data in neighboring 8F^2 cells.
1. Netlist generation syntax/topology corruption in multi-port distributed subcircuits causing floating nodes in post-layout SPICE simulations and false VPP slew rate convergence failures.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-01` | **Field-Solver Distributed RC Extraction Integrity & Total Parasitic Wordline Capacitance Metrology** | Synopsys StarRC / Siemens Calibre xRC 3D field solver extraction engine, SPICE simulator (Ngspice/Xyce/HSPICE), High-precision LCR bridge (Keysight E4980A) on physical parametric test structures (PCM) | 1. Run flat 3D parasitic extraction on a 512-wordline x 512-bitline sub-array block generating distributed R + C + CC netlist (SPEF/DSPF format). 2. Query extracted total parasitic capacitance per wordline node (including poly-to-substrate, poly-to-bitline, and intra-wordline coupling). 3. Simulate small-signal AC impedance at 100 MHz from the SWD driver contact pad to the far-end wordline termination. 4. Correlate simulated parasitic capacitance with calibrated PCM micro-strip test line measurements. | `Total extracted distributed wordline parasitic capacitance must equal 185 fF +/- 10 fF per wordline line (512 access gates). Maximum wire resistance from SWD output to far-end node must not exceed 1.25 kOhm +/- 5%.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-02` | **Post-Layout Distributed Wordline Mesh Transient Slew Rate & Far-End Propagation Delay Sign-off** | Transient SPICE engine (HSPICE or Xyce) with BSIM3v3 / BSIM4 180nm device models, digital storage oscilloscope (Keysight Infiniium 4 GHz) with active high-impedance low-capacitance picoprobe (<0.1 pF) on wafer scribe-line test pads | 1. Apply a step input to the row pre-decoder driving the SWD wordline driver from 0V to VPP (3.0V) with a controlled driver slew rate of 2.0 V/ns. 2. Measure the transient voltage waveform at node 0 (near-end SWD output), node 256 (array midpoint), and node 511 (far-end array wordline termination). 3. Compute 10%-90% rise time and 50%-50% propagation delay (t_pd) between near-end and far-end nodes. 4. Monitor peak capacitive coupling voltage induced on adjacent unselected wordlines (WL[n+1] and WL[n-1]). | `Far-end wordline 10%-90% rise time must be <= 1.45 ns. 50%-50% propagation delay across the full 512-cell span must be <= 0.85 ns. Peak parasitic cross-coupling noise on adjacent unselected wordlines must not exceed 180 mV (well below Vth = 0.55V).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `High`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 4 chemical-resistant butyl rubber gloves over cleanroom nitrile under-gloves, Full-face polycarbonate splash shield (ANSI Z87.1 certified), Acid/solvent gas-tight cleanroom chemical apron, Cleanroom safety boots with static-dissipative soles
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For Hydrofluoric Acid exposure: Immediately flush affected skin area with copious cold water for exactly 2 minutes; continuously massage 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel into the skin until pain subsides and seek immediate emergency medical care. For eye contact: Irrigate eyes with 1% calcium gluconate ophthalmic solution or sterile saline for at least 15 minutes. For Sulfuric acid/SPM: Flush immediately with emergency deluge shower for 20 minutes.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Wet chemical bench operation requiring dedicated continuous negative-pressure wet-acid scrubber exhaust ducting with face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM) measured at sash opening, equipped with differential pressure alarm and automated N2 purge.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Acidic and HF chemical effluent must be segregated into dedicated fluoropolymer drain pipes. HF waste treated via automated precipitation system with saturated Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) forming insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2), neutralized to pH 6.5 - 8.5 before plant industrial discharge.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydrofluoric Acid (aqueous)** | `7664-39-3` | VLSI/Electronic Grade | `49 wt%` |
| **Sulfuric Acid** | `7664-93-9` | VLSI/MOS Grade | `96 wt%` |
| **Hydrogen Peroxide (SPM constituent)** | `7722-84-1` | Electronic Grade | `30 wt%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Pre-metal dielectric (PMD) chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) surface cleaned, particle count < 10 at 180nm, native oxide etched to zero (< 0.2 nm) via dilute HF dip.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Titanium/Titanium Nitride (Ti/TiN) barrier and Tungsten (W) plug contact seed layer deposited via CVD, surface passivated under ultra-high vacuum.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding atmospheric Q-time induces spontaneous native oxide (SiO2) regrowth on exposed poly-silicide wordline strapping contacts, increasing contact resistance by > 300% and triggering open/high-resistance wordline interconnect failures.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Full physical sign-off package for Parasitic RC Extraction and Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation for the 180nm Open-Source DRAM sub-array. Delivers calibrated distributed DSPF/SPEF netlists, transient validation waveforms demonstrating far-end slew rate integrity under VPP overdrive, and DRC/LVS/ERC verification reports ensuring complete physical and electrical closure.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `dram_wordline_mesh_distributed_rc_extracted.dspf`
- [ ] `vpp_wordline_transient_slew_timing_analysis.pdf`
- [ ] `wordline_parasitic_rc_mesh_correlation_metrics.csv`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Distributed wordline lumped parasitic resistance per 512-cell segment** | `1150 Ohm` | +/- 60 Ohm | Calibre xRC extracted netlist network reduction and direct four-point probe PCM measurement |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Worst-case far-end wordline rising edge 10%-90% slew time under 3.0V VPP drive** | `1.32 ns` | <= 1.45 ns | Post-layout transient SPICE simulation across worst-case SS corner at 85°C |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Adjacent wordline peak capacitive cross-talk noise during active wordline switching** | `140 mV` | <= 180 mV | Post-layout DSPF transient full-coupling cross-talk simulation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All 512 wordline channels in the sub-array block achieve LVS and ERC clean extraction status with 100% matched net topology, zero unextracted floating nodes, far-end slew times <= 1.45 ns, and formal sign-off approval from both Circuit Design Lead and Metrology Lead.

ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Acidic and HF chemical effluent must be segregated into dedicated fluoropolymer drain pipes. HF waste treated via automated precipitation system with saturated Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)2) forming insoluble Calcium Fluoride (CaF2), neutralized to pH 6.5 - 8.5 before plant industrial discharge.

q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Titanium/Titanium Nitride (Ti/TiN) barrier and Tungsten (W) plug contact seed layer deposited via CVD, surface passivated under ultra-high vacuum.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Exceeding atmospheric Q-time induces spontaneous native oxide (SiO2) regrowth on exposed poly-silicide wordline strapping contacts, increasing contact resistance by > 300% and triggering open/high-resistance wordline interconnect failures.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Worst-case far-end wordline rising edge 10%-90% slew time under 3.0V VPP drive

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Adjacent wordline peak capacitive cross-talk noise during active wordline switching

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## GDSII Layer Mapping & 180nm Interconnect Technology File Setup

**Document ID:** `SOP-180NM-GDS-001`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM Open-Source Architecture)  
**Classification:** Circuit Design / Physical Implementation & Parasitic Extraction Setup  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  GDSII Stream In and   │
│  Layer Table Binding   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Interconnect Stack   │
│  and Dielectric Setup  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pitch and Geometric   │
│     Rule Alignment     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  LVS Pin Binding and   │
│   Tech File Sign-Off   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **GDSII Stream In & Layer Map Binding (`.layermap`):**
   - Bind numeric GDSII layers and datatype indices to target logical CAD layers:
     - `NWEL` / `PWEL` (Active Wells)
     - `DIFF` (Access Transistor Channel: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$)
     - `POLY1` / `WL` (Wordline gate conductor)
     - `CONT` & `W-PLUG` (Tungsten plug contact to drain/source)
     - `MET1` / `BL` (Bitline layer)
     - `SN_NODE` / `CROWN_CAP` (Stacked capacitor node over bitline)
     - `VIA1`, `MET2` (Interconnect routing & VPP distribution)
2. **Interconnect Stack & Dielectric Specification (`.itf` / `.ict` / `.tech`):**
   - Configure gate oxide layer: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ (dry oxidation target $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Define Capacitor-Over-Bitline (COB) dielectric stack: ONO triple dielectric or $\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5\text{ / }\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ high-$k$ stack with effective dielectric constant $\kappa > 15$ and Equivalent Oxide Thickness $\text{EOT} = 3.0\text{--}4.0\text{ nm}$.
   - Specify Tungsten plug contacts (`W-plug`) connecting cell drain diffusion to the crown bottom electrode.
3. **Geometric Pitch & Design Rule Checking (DRC) Deck Configuration:**
   - Enforce memory array bitline pitch to $360\text{ nm}$.
   - Enforce wordline pitch to $360\text{ nm}\text{--}400\text{ nm}$ across the array.
   - Configure sense amplifier pitch matching at $360\text{ nm}$ requiring interleaved layout pitch definitions.
4. **LVS Pin Binding & Tech File Sign-Off:**
   - Map text/pin labels to corresponding conductor layers (`WL`, `BL`, `BL_B`, `VPP`, `VDD`, `GND`, `SAP`, `SAN`).
   - Run stream validation check to verify zero layer mapping collisions, consistent polygon connectivity, and successful generation of extraction-ready parasitic models.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░                                 │
  Gate Ox Thick (nm)┤░                                 │
                    │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
 Wordline Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Bitline Pitch (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Cell Cap Budget (fF)┤████                              │
                    │████                              │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0      90       180     270    360 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Units | Pass/Fail Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Array Bitline Pitch** | `360` | $\pm 0.0$ (Strict grid) | $\text{nm}$ | Must match sense amplifier interleaved pitch exactly |
| **Wordline Pitch** | `360` to `400` | $[360, 400]$ | $\text{nm}$ | Zero DRC pitch spacing violations |
| **Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Measured physical thickness calibrated at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ oxidation |
| **Cell Capacitance Target** | `28.0` | Min `25.0`, Nom $\ge 28.0$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Ensure retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ and leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ |

---

### 4. Literature Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) with tungsten plug (W-plug), ONO/$\text{Ta}_2\text{O}_5$/$\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ dielectric stack ($\kappa > 15$), minimum cell capacitance budget of $28\text{ fF/cell}$, and leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Minimum storage capacitance $25\text{--}30\text{ fF/cell}$ for $> 64\text{ ms}$ retention at $85^\circ\text{C}$, dielectric EOT $3\text{--}4\text{ nm}$, bitline/wordline pitch $360\text{--}400\text{ nm}$, and thermally grown gate $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:**
  - Sense amplifier pitch matching requirement to memory array bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}$ in 180nm node) with interleaved layout architecture.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-1-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-1-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of GDSII Layer Mapping & 180nm Interconnect Technology File Setup: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
