# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Full-Array Wordline RC Mesh Extraction & Distributed Parasitic Netlist Generation

**Document ID:** `SOP-DRAM-180-CKT-014`  
**Discipline:** Circuit Design / Physical Verification  
**Process Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Parent Pipeline:** `Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Pump > Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology`

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Step 1: Layout     │
│   Boundary & GDSII    │
│     Layer Mapping     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Step 2: 3D Field    │
│   Solver Parasitic    │
│      Extraction       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Step 3: Distributed  │
│   Pi/T-Mesh Netlist   │
│       Synthesis       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Step 4: SPICE Slew   │
│   Rate & Far-End RC   │
│  Delay Verification   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Layout Boundary Definition & GDSII Mask Layer Mapping:**
   - Import the flattened 180nm memory array layout block containing folded bitline pairs, stacked capacitors over bitline (COB), and wordline drivers.
   - Define extraction boundary for a full array wordline block adhering to the **360 nm to 400 nm** wordline and bitline pitch.
   - Map polysilicon/poly-cide gate strips, tungsten contacts (W-plugs), and access transistor geometries ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

2. **3D Field-Solver Parasitic Extraction (PEX):**
   - Execute quasi-3D / 3D boundary-element extraction across active polysilicon wordlines running over gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Compute wire resistance per cell segment taking into account poly-cide sheet resistance, contact resistance of wordline stitching straps, and cross-coupling capacitance to adjacent perpendicular bitlines ($C_{BL}$ baseline $\approx 250\text{ fF}$) and adjacent parallel wordlines.

3. **Distributed RC $\Pi$-Mesh / T-Mesh Netlist Synthesis:**
   - Discretize continuous wordline traces into an $N$-stage distributed ladder network matching cell coordinates across 8F² / 6F² arrays.
   - Connect access transistor gate nodes ($W/L = 220\text{ nm} / 180\text{ nm}$) to corresponding internal RC nodes, incorporating gate-to-channel and overlap capacitances ($C_{gs}, C_{gd}, C_{gb}$).
   - Export extracted netlist formatted in standard SPICE subcircuit syntax (`.SUBCKT WL_ARRAY_RC_MESH`).

4. **Transient Simulation & Far-End VPP Slew Rate Metrology:**
   - Stimulate the near-end wordline terminal with the output stage of the high-voltage ($V_{PP}$) address decoder driver.
   - Measure waveform propagation, slew rate degradation, and far-end settling time across all distributed cell access ports to guarantee access transistor channel inversion.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
             180nm DRAM Physical Parameters & RC Budgets
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆              │
C_BL Typ (fF)┤◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆              │
             │■■■■                                     │
 C_s Min (fF)┤■■■■                                     │
             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
BL Pitch (nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
WL Pitch (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Access W (nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                 │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                 │
Access L (nm)┤████████████████████                     │
             │████████████████████                     │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
              0        95        190       285      380 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Access Transistor Drawn Channel Length ($L$) | $180 \pm 0.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-02** | Access Transistor Drawn Channel Width ($W$) | $220 \pm 0.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-03** | Wordline & Bitline Center-to-Center Pitch | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-04** | Equivalent Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$) | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **AC-05** | Bitline Target Lumped Capacitance Reference ($C_{BL}$) | $250 \pm 25$ | $\text{fF}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Source 1:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  * *Citation:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
* **Source 2:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  * *Citation:* Wordline and bitline pitch is approximately $360\text{ nm to }400\text{ nm}$; Gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
* **Source 3:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
  * *Citation:* Reference bitline capacitance budget $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$ against storage cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ to }28\text{ fF}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Extracting the distributed RC parasitic network across a 180nm dense DRAM array requires balancing extraction granularity with simulation solvability. Replacing a continuous polycide wordline with lumped pi-segments without accounting for inter-wordline capacitive coupling (C_adj_WL) and bitline-wordline cross-point capacitance (C_WL_BL) will underestimate wordline rise time and VPP booster droop. System timing closure requires segmenting the 512-to-1024-cell wordline length into at least 16 to 32 distributed pi-stages per sub-array to avoid masking distributed voltage attenuation and signal reflection along the far-end cells.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At the 180nm node with a W/L = 220nm / 180nm cell access transistor, the gate polycide (typically WSi2/poly or TiSi2) has a sheet resistance of 5-10 Ohm/sq, while metal strap layers (Metal 1 or Metal 2) run at ~0.08 Ohm/sq with periodic wordline stitching contacts every 16 or 32 cells. An inaccurate extraction that overlooks contact via resistance (Rc ~ 5-15 Ohm/via) or sidewall fringe capacitance to adjacent bitlines will mischaracterize the dynamic gate overdrive, degrading the sensing window and risking incomplete cell restore (V_cell < 1.8V) during active cycles under VPP overdrive (2.8V - 3.1V).
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Extraction rule decks (QRC/StarRC/Magic/PEX) must remain strictly compliant with open-source 180nm PDK technology definitions (such as SkyWater 180nm / open-standard equivalent) without proprietary foundry NDA tech-file encryption. Dependency on non-standard BEOL stack parameters or non-extractable 3D capacitor fringe formulations will restrict layout portability and block multi-wafer fabrication options across open-access fabs like SkyWater, TSMC open MPWs, or regional Asian foundries.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The full-array parasitic netlist must not generate an intractable SPICE node count that stalls iterative Monte Carlo and corner analysis pipelines. The extraction workflow must complete within 2 hours per memory bank on a standard 32-core compute node, providing hierarchical sub-circuit reduction while strictly keeping transient propagation delay discrepancy below 3% relative to 3D field-solver references.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Far-end wordline signal attenuation and dispersion due to lumped R-model underestimation, causing delayed access transistor turn-on and catastrophic read sense amplifier failure.
1. Excessive wordline-to-wordline coupling capacitance causing cross-talk bounce on adjacent non-selected wordlines exceeding V_thn (+0.55V), inducing parasitic soft-unselect data leakage.
1. VPP supply mesh collapse caused by sudden peak dynamic charging current (I_peak > 15mA) across distributed wordline stages not captured in low-order extracted netlists.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Wordline Distributed Delay Metrology & Netlist Benchmark Correlation

**Branch**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Transient Post-Layout Verification & $V_{PP}$ Slew Rate Metrology > Parasitic RC Extraction & Wordline Mesh Netlist Generation > Wordline Distributed Delay Metrology & Netlist Benchmark Correlation  
**Generation**: Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$ / 180nm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  WL Driver VPP Slew   │
│       Injection       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Distributed RC Mesh  │
│  Netlist Extraction   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Picosecond Delay    │
│   Metrology Near vs   │
│          Far          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Transient SPICE    │
│     Correlation &     │
│      Acceptance       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Distributed RC Mesh Layout Netlist Extraction**:
   - Extract post-layout parasitic resistance and capacitance across the continuous wordline strip over an active memory mat with access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$ at wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Include the per-cell stacked capacitor load ($C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ to $28\text{ fF}$) and bitline parasitic capacitance ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$) coupling at unit cell boundaries.

2. **$V_{PP}$ Transient Excitation & Boundary Condition Setup**:
   - Apply the boosted wordline voltage pulse ($V_{PP}$) at the output node of the local wordline driver.
   - Initialize cell storage node voltages to extreme levels ($V_{cell} = V_{DD}$ and $0\text{ V}$) and precharge bitlines to $V_{DD}/2$.

3. **Multi-Tap Wordline Propagation Metrology**:
   - Measure transient $V(t)$ waveforms along 4 distributed nodes: near-end (adjacent to driver output), $25\%$, $50\%$, and far-end termination of the wordline array.
   - Measure wordline 10%–90% slew rate and $50\%\text{ }V_{PP}$ propagation delay time ($\tau_{prop}$) from the driver assertion to far-end access transistor activation.

4. **Charge Sharing Signal Development Correlation**:
   - Verify differential bitline readout voltage development $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{cell} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ across near-end and far-end cells to ensure access transistor channel opening is maintained despite distributed $RC$ attenuation.

5. **Silicon / Benchmark Correlation**:
   - Cross-correlate transient simulation delay against the netlist benchmark dataset. Calculate the correlation error percentage across corner models (typ, fast, slow) at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Storage Node Unit Capacitance ($C_s$)** | $25.0 \text{ to } 28.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Post-layout parasitic extraction / LCR meter |
| **Bitline Parasitic Capacitance ($C_{BL}$)** | $250.0 \pm 10.0$ | $\text{fF}$ | Multi-conductor field solver / RC netlist |
| **Differential Signal Voltage ($\Delta V$)** | $100.0 \text{ to } 150.0$ | $\text{mV}$ | Transient readout waveform at sense amp input |
| **Maximum Retention Verification Temp** | $85.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermal chamber / SPICE junction temperature setting |
| **Unit Access Transistor Gate Length ($L$)** | $180.0 \pm 5.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | CD-SEM / Layout DRC verification |

---

### 4. Correlation Error & Metrology Deviation Metric Profile

```text
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
Differential Sense Delay┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░              │
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒           │
 Extracted RC Mesh Error┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒           │
  Near-End WL Slew Delta┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
                        │▓▓▓▓▓▓                        │
   Far-End WL Rise Delay┤██████████████████████████████│
                        │██████████████████████████████│
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                       0.00   0.85    1.70   2.55  3.40 
                               Deviation (%)
```

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

1. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and bitline differential voltage signal $\Delta V = (C_s / (C_{BL} + C_s)) \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2) \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ with bitlines precharged to $V_{DD}/2$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture, unit capacitance requirement $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, and operating temperature threshold of $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - 1T1C architecture, bitline and wordline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, minimum capacitance boundary of $25\text{ to } 30\text{ fF}$, retention qualification at $85^\circ\text{C}$, and gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: The distributed RC ladder of the polycide wordline across 512 bitline columns exhibits non-uniform distributed propagation delay (tau_prop = 0.5 * R_wl * C_wl). If post-layout extracted mesh parasitics underestimate the Miller capacitance of the 1T1C access transistors (C_g_bl and C_g_sn) or strap stitch contact resistance between Metal-2 and silicided poly, the actual delay at the furthest cell will cause sense amplifier activation (SAN/SAP strobe) prior to full signal development (Delta V >= 120 mV), causing catastrophic single-bit read margin failures across row edges.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: In an 8F^2 folded bitline cell array fabricated at 180nm, polycide sheet resistance (typically 8-12 Ohm/sq) and gate oxide capacitance (~4.2 fF/um^2) create a distributed delay gradient of 1.2 to 2.4 ns across a 512-cell segment. Correlation between the transient SPICE netlist (using R-C-mesh segment blocks per 16 cells) and pico-probe TDR / picosecond laser-voltage-probing (LVP) metrology must specifically calibrate VPP slew rate (dV/dt >= 1.5 V/ns) and plateau ringing against access transistor gate overdrive.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Sub-micron RF active micro-probing tips (GGB Industries Model 34A/Picoprobe) and high-frequency pulse generators with <80 ps edge rates face 14-week lead times and high attrition rates during wafer-level micro-touchdowns. Calibration substrates and tungsten needle replacement tips must be stocked on-site at the fab metrology bay to prevent stalling correlation runs between MPW shuttle tapeout iterations.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: The correlation loop between automated GDS-to-netlist extraction (Calibre xRC/StarRC) and wafer probe transient waveforms is the gating milestone for freezing the wordline driver (VPP level shifter) sizing and row cycle time (t_RC). Failure to achieve netlist-to-silicon delay correlation within +/- 8% will delay tapeout freeze and slip the foundry fab shuttle submission window by 6 weeks.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Premature Sense Amplifier Strobe: Wordline tip delay exceeds timing margin budget, triggering SAN/SAP cross-coupled latch before Delta V reaches the 100 mV minimum sensing threshold, inducing systematic read inversion on edge columns.
1. Metal-to-Polycide Stitch Resistance Spike: Voiding or high contact resistance (>50 Ohm) in the periodic M2-polycide stitch vias exacerbates local RC time constants, creating localized wordline propagation dead-zones and cell access starvation.
1. VPP Supply Sag and Gate Oxide Breakdown: Excessive gate capacitance extraction error leads to miscalculated charge consumption during simultaneous row assertion, inducing pump line sag below 2.8V or transient inductive overshoot exceeding the 3.6V gate oxide breakdown limit.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-3-01` | **Distributed Wordline Near-to-Far Propagation Delay & Slew Metrology** | Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with thermal chuck at 25C and 85C; GGB Industries Model 34A Picoprobe (0.1 pF active load, 3 GHz bandwidth); Keysight Infiniium UXR0254A 25 GHz Oscilloscope; Keysight 81160A Pulse Pattern Generator. | 1. Land Picoprobe Channel A on WL_NEAR pad and Channel B on WL_FAR pad using micro-positioners with optical interferometric touch-down monitoring. 2. Apply a 10 MHz square pulse sequence with 120 ps rise time from the pulse pattern generator to the row address pre-decoder input to trigger wordline activation. 3. Acquire 5000 real-time waveform averages on the 25 GHz oscilloscope, capturing the 10% to 90% rise edges of WL_NEAR and WL_FAR. 4. Extract propagation delay t_prop (50% VPP on WL_NEAR to 50% VPP on WL_FAR) and slew rate (dV/dt from 20% to 80% VPP at WL_FAR). 5. Repeat acquisition across 5 wafer sites (center, north, south, east, west). | `Pass: Wordline distributed propagation delay t_prop (WL_NEAR to WL_FAR) <= 2.20 ns at 25C; 20%-80% rise slew rate at WL_FAR >= 1.25 V/ns; edge-to-edge peak ringing overshoot <= 150 mV above VPP (3.0 V).` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-1-3-02` | **Extracted RC Netlist vs. Silicon Waveform Cross-Correlation Benchmark** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre SPICE Simulation Engine; Automated Python correlation suite (scipy/numpy waveform FFT and Pearson r correlation); Keysight UXR0254A transient export (.h5 format). | 1. Execute transient SPICE simulation of the extracted wordline mesh netlist under exact wafer probe load conditions (including 100 fF active tip loading and 15 nH pad parasitic inductance) matching physical probe touch-down parameters. 2. Export simulated transient node voltages for WL_NEAR, WL_MID, and WL_FAR at 10 ps interpolation timesteps. 3. Align simulated and measured waveforms at the 50% rising threshold of WL_NEAR (t0 = 0.00 ns). 4. Calculate point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) and Pearson correlation coefficient (r) between simulated and measured waveforms across the entire active pulse duration (0 to 15 ns). 5. Compute the percentage mismatch between simulated delay t_sim and measured delay t_meas: delta_tau = |t_sim - t_meas| / t_meas * 100%. | `Pass: Pearson correlation coefficient r >= 0.985 across the 0-15 ns transition window; wordline distributed delay mismatch delta_tau <= 7.5% across all tested dies; steady-state plateau voltage error <= 30 mV.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Static-dissipative cleanroom nitrile gloves (double gloving), EN 166 compliant UV/laser safety side-shield glasses for optical probe illuminators, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) certified lab coat and grounding wrist strap with 1 MOhm resistor, Class 100 cleanroom face mask
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with solvent, wash thoroughly with copious amounts of water for 15 minutes. In case of eye contact, flush eyes at emergency eye-wash station for 15 minutes holding eyelids open and seek immediate medical evaluation. If vapors are inhaled, immediately move personnel to clean laminar fresh air. No specific physiological antidote; treat symptomatically.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station must operate under local laminar flow hood with minimum face velocity of 0.45 m/s (90 fpm) and dedicated solvent exhaust ducting operating under negative pressure for probe tip cleaning cups.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent solvent cleaning wipes and IPA/acetone rinse liquids must be collected in dedicated, grounded, flame-arrested stainless-steel flammable waste carboys. Do not discharge into fab drain. Dispose of through licensed hazardous waste contractor according to local environmental regulations.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | VLSI Electronic Grade | `99.9%` |
| **Acetone** | `67-64-1` | Electronic Grade | `99.5%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Freshly cleaved or unpassivated aluminum/copper test pads post-metal-etch, free of native oxide growth exceeding 1.5 nm and particulate contamination (cleanroom Class 100 specification).
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed test pads inspected post-touchdown; scrub marks must not exceed 25% of pad area; zero surface oxidation or carbon residue from microprobe scrub.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding queue time in ambient air causes native oxide (Al2O3 / CuO) thickening on probe micro-pads, increasing probe tip contact resistance (R_contact > 50 Ohm), introducing artificial RC dispersion, false delay measurements, and pad micro-cracking during excessive scrub needle pressure.

critics.systems_engineer: The distributed RC ladder of the polycide wordline across 512 bitline columns exhibits non-uniform distributed propagation delay (tau_prop = 0.5 * R_wl * C_wl). If post-layout extracted mesh parasitics underestimate the Miller capacitance of the 1T1C access transistors (C_g_bl and C_g_sn) or strap stitch contact resistance between Metal-2 and silicided poly, the actual delay at the furthest cell will cause sense amplifier activation (SAN/SAP strobe) prior to full signal development (Delta V >= 120 mV), causing catastrophic single-bit read margin failures across row edges.
critics.domain_expert: In an 8F^2 folded bitline cell array fabricated at 180nm, polycide sheet resistance (typically 8-12 Ohm/sq) and gate oxide capacitance (~4.2 fF/um^2) create a distributed delay gradient of 1.2 to 2.4 ns across a 512-cell segment. Correlation between the transient SPICE netlist (using R-C-mesh segment blocks per 16 cells) and pico-probe TDR / picosecond laser-voltage-probing (LVP) metrology must specifically calibrate VPP slew rate (dV/dt >= 1.5 V/ns) and plateau ringing against access transistor gate overdrive.
critics.supply_chain: Sub-micron RF active micro-probing tips (GGB Industries Model 34A/Picoprobe) and high-frequency pulse generators with <80 ps edge rates face 14-week lead times and high attrition rates during wafer-level micro-touchdowns. Calibration substrates and tungsten needle replacement tips must be stocked on-site at the fab metrology bay to prevent stalling correlation runs between MPW shuttle tapeout iterations.
critics.laya_pm: The correlation loop between automated GDS-to-netlist extraction (Calibre xRC/StarRC) and wafer probe transient waveforms is the gating milestone for freezing the wordline driver (VPP level shifter) sizing and row cycle time (t_RC). Failure to achieve netlist-to-silicon delay correlation within +/- 8% will delay tapeout freeze and slip the foundry fab shuttle submission window by 6 weeks.
critical_failure_modes: Premature Sense Amplifier Strobe: Wordline tip delay exceeds timing margin budget, triggering SAN/SAP cross-coupled latch before Delta V reaches the 100 mV minimum sensing threshold, inducing systematic read inversion on edge columns.

Metal-to-Polycide Stitch Resistance Spike: Voiding or high contact resistance (>50 Ohm) in the periodic M2-polycide stitch vias exacerbates local RC time constants, creating localized wordline propagation dead-zones and cell access starvation.

VPP Supply Sag and Gate Oxide Breakdown: Excessive gate capacitance extraction error leads to miscalculated charge consumption during simultaneous row assertion, inducing pump line sag below 2.8V or transient inductive overshoot exceeding the 3.6V gate oxide breakdown limit.

testcases.instrumentation: Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station with thermal chuck at 25C and 85C; GGB Industries Model 34A Picoprobe (0.1 pF active load, 3 GHz bandwidth); Keysight Infiniium UXR0254A 25 GHz Oscilloscope; Keysight 81160A Pulse Pattern Generator.

testcases.procedure: 1. Land Picoprobe Channel A on WL_NEAR pad and Channel B on WL_FAR pad using micro-positioners with optical interferometric touch-down monitoring. 2. Extract propagation delay t_prop (50% VPP on WL_NEAR to 50% VPP on WL_FAR) and slew rate (dV/dt from 20% to 80% VPP at WL_FAR). 5. Repeat acquisition across 5 wafer sites (center, north, south, east, west).

testcases.procedure: 1. Execute transient SPICE simulation of the extracted wordline mesh netlist under exact wafer probe load conditions (including 100 fF active tip loading and 15 nH pad parasitic inductance) matching physical probe touch-down parameters. 2. Export simulated transient node voltages for WL_NEAR, WL_MID, and WL_FAR at 10 ps interpolation timesteps. 3. Align simulated and measured waveforms at the 50% rising threshold of WL_NEAR (t0 = 0.00 ns). 4. Calculate point-by-point root-mean-square error (RMSE) and Pearson correlation coefficient (r) between simulated and measured waveforms across the entire active pulse duration (0 to 15 ns). 5. Compute the percentage mismatch between simulated delay t_sim and measured delay t_meas: delta_tau = |t_sim - t_meas| / t_meas * 100%.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Transient Post-Layout Simulation & $V_{PP}$ Charge-Pump Loading Analysis

- **Document ID:** SOP-DRAM180-CKT-014
- **Node / Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)
- **Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump > Transient Post-Layout Verification & $V_{PP}$ Slew Rate Metrology > Transient Post-Layout Simulation & $V_{PP}$ Charge-Pump Loading Analysis
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌─────────────────────────┐
│                         │
│    Extract Wordline     │
│    Array Parasitics     │
│       (SPEF/DSPF)       │
│                         │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│                         │
│      Configure VPP      │
│  Dickson/Cross-Coupled  │
│      Pump Netlist       │
│                         │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│                         │
│    Execute Transient    │
│    Simulation under     │
│  Fast Row-Cycle Burst   │
│                         │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│                         │
│   Measure VPP Voltage   │
│    Droop & Slew Rate    │
│        Metrology        │
│                         │
└────────────┬────────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│                         │
│        Validate         │
│      Multi-Corner       │
│   Acceptance Criteria   │
│                         │
└─────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction of Decoded Wordline Array:**
   - Extract distributed $RC$ parasitics (SPEF/DSPF) of the wordline distribution network across the $8F^2 / 6F^2$ array with wordline pitch between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure the extracted gate geometry of the access transistors accurately captures $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$, with gate oxide physical thickness $T_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
   - Include cell lumped storage capacitance $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$ (stacked capacitor over bitline) and bitline parasitic loading $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$.

2. **Charge-Pump & Driver Co-Simulation Netlist Setup:**
   - Stitch the multi-stage $V_{PP}$ charge-pump circuit, voltage regulator limiter, and wordline driver sub-circuits to the extracted array netlist.
   - Configure pumping reservoir decoupling capacitors ($C_{reg}$) and stage flying capacitors matched to the expected active row activation transient charge transfer.

3. **Burst Transient Dynamic Simulation Execution:**
   - Set up transient simulation (`.tran 10ps 200ns`) under peak operating temperature ($85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Stimulate address decoders to trigger worst-case multi-bank / back-to-back row activation bursts (emulating active read/write and burst refresh cycles over the retention specification period $> 64\text{ ms}$).

4. **Metrology, Slew Rate & Loading Analysis:**
   - Measure $V_{PP}$ rail droop ($\Delta V_{PP}$) at the input of the local wordline driver during simultaneous wordline activation.
   - Extract wordline rise time and slew rate ($10\%$ to $90\%$ of boosted $V_{PP}$ level) across near-end and far-end wordline cells.
   - Verify that charge-pump recovery time returns $V_{PP}$ to regulated nominal potential before the next row activation cycle.

---

### Baseline Array Loading & Physical Extraction Parameters

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                     │█████████████████████████████████████│
WL Pitch Max (400 nm)┤█████████████████████████████████████│
WL Pitch Min (360 nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
                     │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
    C_BL Typ (250 fF)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
   C_cell Typ (28 fF)┤▓▓▓▓                                 │
   C_cell Min (25 fF)┤███                                  │
                     │███                                  │
                     └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                      0       100      200      300     400 
```

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

1. **Storage Cell Capacitance ($C_s$):**
   - **Target Metric:** $\ge 28\text{ fF}$ (minimum allowable limit: $25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$) per unit cell at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **Access Transistor Physical Gate Dimensions & Oxide Thickness:**
   - **Target Metric:** Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm} \pm 5\%$, and gate oxide physical thickness $T_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$.
3. **Wordline Array Interconnect Pitch:**
   - **Target Metric:** $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch across wordline runs.
4. **Leakage Current Budget at Elevated Temperature:**
   - **Target Metric:** Total access transistor sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to preserve retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$.

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source 1:** *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* — Governs bitline capacitance loading ($C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$), cell capacitance load during charge sharing ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$), and signal development ($\Delta V = 100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$).
- **Source 2:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Governs unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), minimum capacitance budget ($\ge 28\text{ fF}$), and maximum leakage threshold ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source 3:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — Governs $8F^2/6F^2$ wordline/bitline pitch range ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$), gate oxide thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$), capacitor budget ($25\text{ fF}$ to $30\text{ fF}$), and retention specification ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Post-layout extraction of the VPP network must account for distributed RC interconnect parasitics between the 4-stage Dickson charge pump core, the decoupling reservoir (C_filter >= 500 pF), and the distributed row decoder driver arrays. A lumped capacitor approximation fails to predict localized instantaneous IR drops and transmission line ringing along the VPP distribution mesh during burst wordline activation across multiple memory banks, potentially dropping local VPP below 2.5V and degrading write restoration.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: At 180nm node operating with boosted VPP = 2.7V on nominal 1.8V thin-gate oxide devices, dielectric reliability is severely threatened by time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB) and hot carrier injection (HCI) across pump pass transistors and wordline level shifters. Dual-oxide (thick-gate 3.3V/5.0V I/O devices) or cascaded cascode topologies must be strictly enforced in the netlist for all nodes experiencing VPP to prevent premature junction punch-through and gate oxide stress.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Specifying integrated high-density MOS/MIM flying capacitors (C_pump = 20-50 pF) and decoupling reservoir (C_filter >= 500 pF) increases die area dramatically if limited to standard dual-poly or metal-insulator-metal options. The procurement of third-party VPP IP cores or foundry PDK add-on layers (such as high-density MIMCap options) requires multi-week PDK license validation and foundry line qualification for 180nm mixed-signal/eDRAM processes.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Verification milestones require strict synchronization between transient post-layout SPICE sign-off and the physical tape-out schedule. The transient simulation over multiple charge-up cycles (0 to 2.7V across >= 500 pF load with 20-50 MHz clocking) demands tens of thousands of cycles, posing compute bottlenecks; sign-off cannot proceed on fast-SPICE approximations without golden full-chip transient correlation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. VPP voltage collapse under simultaneous multi-bank active command bursts due to pump output impedance and RC network bottlenecking exceeding charge delivery capability.
1. Accelerated gate oxide breakdown (TDDB) in wordline level shifters and charge pump flying capacitor switches due to transient overshoots exceeding 3.0V during regulator turn-off delay.
1. Excessive VPP steady-state ripple (>30 mV peak-to-peak) coupling into adjacent bitlines and analog sense amplifiers, inducing sensing faults and data pattern corruption.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-2-01` | **VPP Charge-Up Transient Slew Rate and Regulator Clamping Metrology** | Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre Transient SPICE Engine with extracted DSPF/SPEF parasitic netlist, calibrated at 0.1ps maximum timestep resolution | 1. Initialize simulation at t=0 with VDD stepped from 0V to 1.8V with 10ns rise time. 2. Enable Dickson oscillator clocks (Phi1, Phi2 non-overlapping with 2ns dead time). 3. Measure time delta t_chargeup for VPP node to reach 2.70V regulation threshold from 0V. 4. Monitor dynamic feedback comparator shut-off response and measure peak overshoot voltage before oscillation halts. | `VPP startup time to reach 2.70V must be <= 12.5 us; peak overshoot voltage must not exceed 2.75V (within 2.70V +/- 50 mV envelope); zero DC gate-oxide breakdown stress violation flagged across all devices.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-2-02` | **Post-Layout Dynamic VPP Loading and Ripple Metrology under Burst Row Activation** | Mixed-signal transient simulator running golden SPICE accuracy with automated continuous measurement probes on VPP rail and wordline driver supply terminals | 1. Run steady-state VPP regulation for 5us to establish baseline ripple. 2. Trigger simultaneous burst row activations across 8 wordlines with total transient load current pulse of 15mA peak, 5ns duration. 3. Record instantaneous minimum VPP voltage drop during activation. 4. Measure peak-to-peak voltage ripple on VPP rail during pump re-activation and subsequent recovery to steady state. | `Minimum dynamic VPP under peak switching load must remain >= 2.55V; steady-state and recovery peak-to-peak ripple must be strictly < 30.0 mV; wordline rise time (10% to 90% of VPP) must remain <= 3.8 ns.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Level 1 ESD-safe static dissipative coat, ANSI Z87.1 approved anti-glare safety spectacles, Cleanroom nitrile gloves (Class 100 compatible), Grounding wrist strap with 1 MOhm current-limiting resistor
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin contact with solvent, flush affected area with copiously running deionized water for at least 15 minutes. For vapor inhalation, remove personnel immediately to fresh outdoor air. For accidental eye contact, rinse cautiously with eye-wash station solution for 15 minutes and seek prompt occupational medical evaluation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Server room and EDA laboratory dedicated HVAC system maintaining minimum 15 air changes per hour (ACH), positive differential pressure (+15 Pa), temperature at 20 +/- 2°C, and relative humidity at 45% +/- 5% to inhibit static accumulation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Used IPA wipes and cleaning consumables must be segregated in airtight, grounded, flame-retardant stainless steel disposal bins and routed through hazardous solvent incineration channels under local environmental safety protocols.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) for workstation and server chassis maintenance** | `67-63-0` | Electronic Grade (VLSI) | `99.9%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `24 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted RC netlist database and GDSII mask data verified clean against Design Rule Checking (DRC) and Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) with zero floating nets or un-merged bulk connections.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Validated transient netlist state with complete parasitic back-annotation and signed-off dynamic power/voltage maps ready for tape-out mask preparation and electro-migration/IR-drop sign-off.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Exceeding layout review queue times or un-synchronized PDK version drift invalidates BSIM3v3/BSIM4 model parameter alignment, causing erroneous threshold voltage extraction and undetectable oxide overstress leading to silicon fabrication failure.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete transient post-layout SPICE verification of the Gen 2 180nm DRAM VPP Dickson charge pump and distribution network under extreme corner conditions, proving stable 2.70V regulation, ripple under 30mV, and adequate overdrive drive for reliable retention storage.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `vpp_chargepump_transient_corner_analysis.csv`
- [ ] `vpp_loading_slew_verification_report.pdf`
- [ ] `vpp_mesh_postlayout_dynamic_irdrop_map.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Regulated steady-state VPP output voltage across all PVT corners (FF/SS/TT, -40°C to 125°C, VDD=1.62V-1.98V)** | `2.70 V` | +/- 0.05 V | Automated SPICE transient steady-state extraction over 50us regulated operation |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum peak-to-peak VPP output voltage ripple during active regulation cycle** | `22.5 mV` | < 30.0 mV max limit | Post-layout transient ripple measurement probe across decoupling capacitor terminals under nominal switching frequency |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Wordline boosted write-level overdrive voltage under worst-case simultaneous 8-sub-array access loading** | `2.62 V` | >= 2.50 V absolute minimum | Transient node voltage probe at farthest physical memory cell pass-gate wordline contact during burst write |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Researcher exit approval requires full convergence across TT/SS/FF/FS/SF corners with zero TDDB/HCI electrical rule check (ERC) violations, maximum VPP ripple strictly below 30mV, minimum dynamic wordline VPP >= 2.50V, and formal joint sign-off by Circuit Design Lead and Systems Architect.

critics.supply_chain: Specifying integrated high-density MOS/MIM flying capacitors (C_pump = 20-50 pF) and decoupling reservoir (C_filter >= 500 pF) increases die area dramatically if limited to standard dual-poly or metal-insulator-metal options. The procurement of third-party VPP IP cores or foundry PDK add-on layers (such as high-density MIMCap options) requires multi-week PDK license validation and foundry line qualification for 180nm mixed-signal/eDRAM processes.
critics.laya_pm: Verification milestones require strict synchronization between transient post-layout SPICE sign-off and the physical tape-out schedule. The transient simulation over multiple charge-up cycles (0 to 2.7V across >= 500 pF load with 20-50 MHz clocking) demands tens of thousands of cycles, posing compute bottlenecks; sign-off cannot proceed on fast-SPICE approximations without golden full-chip transient correlation.
critical_failure_modes: VPP voltage collapse under simultaneous multi-bank active command bursts due to pump output impedance and RC network bottlenecking exceeding charge delivery capability.
Accelerated gate oxide breakdown (TDDB) in wordline level shifters and charge pump flying capacitor switches due to transient overshoots exceeding 3.0V during regulator turn-off delay.
Excessive VPP steady-state ripple (>30 mV peak-to-peak) coupling into adjacent bitlines and analog sense amplifiers, inducing sensing faults and data pattern corruption.

testcases.title: VPP Charge-Up Transient Slew Rate and Regulator Clamping Metrology
testcases.instrumentation: Synopsys PrimeSim / Cadence Spectre Transient SPICE Engine with extracted DSPF/SPEF parasitic netlist, calibrated at 0.1ps maximum timestep resolution
testcases.pre_conditions: Post-layout extracted netlist with full 3D field solver parasitic RC extraction (C_coupled, R_metal); VDD=1.8V nominal, Temperature=125°C slow-slow corner; flying capacitors C_pump=35pF, C_filter=550pF uncharged (VPP=0V at t=0); ring oscillator enabled at 40MHz two-phase clock.
testcases.procedure: 1. Initialize simulation at t=0 with VDD stepped from 0V to 1.8V with 10ns rise time. 2. Enable Dickson oscillator clocks (Phi1, Phi2 non-overlapping with 2ns dead time). 3. Measure time delta t_chargeup for VPP node to reach 2.70V regulation threshold from 0V. 4. Monitor dynamic feedback comparator shut-off response and measure peak overshoot voltage before oscillation halts.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: VPP startup time to reach 2.70V must be <= 12.5 us; peak overshoot voltage must not exceed 2.75V (within 2.70V +/- 50 mV envelope); zero DC gate-oxide breakdown stress violation flagged across all devices.

testcases.title: Post-Layout Dynamic VPP Loading and Ripple Metrology under Burst Row Activation
testcases.instrumentation: Mixed-signal transient simulator running golden SPICE accuracy with automated continuous measurement probes on VPP rail and wordline driver supply terminals
testcases.pre_conditions: VPP stabilized at regulated 2.70V steady-state; row decoder testbench configured to fire continuous back-to-back tRC (Row Cycle Time = 55ns) active commands across 8 distributed sub-arrays.
testcases.procedure: 1. Run steady-state VPP regulation for 5us to establish baseline ripple. 2. Trigger simultaneous burst row activations across 8 wordlines with total transient load current pulse of 15mA peak, 5ns duration. 3. Record instantaneous minimum VPP voltage drop during activation. 4. Measure peak-to-peak voltage ripple on VPP rail during pump re-activation and subsequent recovery to steady state.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Minimum dynamic VPP under peak switching load must remain >= 2.55V; steady-state and recovery peak-to-peak ripple must be strictly < 30.0 mV; wordline rise time (10% to 90% of VPP) must remain <= 3.8 ns.

nodes.sop_content:
# SOP: Wordline VPP Slew Rate & Voltage Drop Transient Metrology Protocol

- **Module**: `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `Address Decoders & Wordline VPP Voltage Pump` > `Transient Post-Layout Verification & VPP Slew Rate Metrology`
- **Node Generation**: 180nm CMOS (Gen 2 µm)
- **Action Type**: Make / Metrology Execution

---

## 1. Transient Metrology Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  VPP Pump Subsystem   │
│    Dickson 4-Stage    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       VPP Grid        │
│  Distribution C_pump  │
│        20-50pF        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Wordline Driver    │
│  Actuation NMOS Gate  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Far-End Transient   │
│   Probe WL Rise and   │
│        VPP Sag        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Full Level Restore   │
│  Verification V_cell  │
│         1.8V          │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Simulation Setup & Parasitic Extraction (PEX)
1. Load the fully placed and routed 180nm DRAM sub-array containing the stacked capacitor-over-bitline (COB) architecture ($8F^2$ or $6F^2$, access transistor $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
2. Extract distributed parasitic resistance ($R$) and capacitance ($C$) of the polysilicon/tungsten wordline strapping and bitline routing down to the unit cell storage node ($C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
3. Bias power supplies: core logic $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{ V}$, precharge equalization network $V_{BL\_PRE} = V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{ V}$.

### Step 2: VPP Charge Pump Clocking & Regulated Steady-State Initialization
1. Initialize the 4-stage Dickson charge pump utilizing diode-connected NMOS/pass-gate stages with flying capacitors ($C_{\text{pump}} = 20\text{ pF to } 50\text{ pF}$).
2. Apply two-phase non-overlapping clock pulses ($\Phi_1, \Phi_2$) at a frequency of $20\text{ MHz to } 50\text{ MHz}$.
3. Let the dynamic feedback voltage divider and bandgap-referenced comparator lock the regulated wordline overdrive rail in the range:
   $$V_{PP} = V_{DD} + V_{th} + \Delta V_{\text{overdrive}} \ge 2.5\text{ V to } 2.8\text{ V}$$
   *(where NMOS pass transistor $V_{th} = 0.5\text{ V to } 0.7\text{ V}$)*.

### Step 3: Transient Wordline Actuation & Voltage Sag Metrology
1. Execute simultaneous row address decoding to fire the wordline driver, asserting the target wordline from $0\text{ V}$ to $V_{PP}$.
2. Place transient measurement probe nodes at:
   - **Node A**: Output of the local $V_{PP}$ reservoir capacitor bank.
   - **Node B**: Wordline driver output (near end).
   - **Node C**: Far end of the wordline array across the distributed $RC$ line.
3. Quantify transient voltage drop (sag) on $V_{PP}$ during wordline assertion: ensure $V_{PP\_drop}$ maintains $V_{PP\_min} \ge 2.5\text{ V}$ throughout the switching transient.

### Step 4: Access Transistor Full-Level Restore Verification
1. Monitor write data transfer into the storage cell: verify that the storage node capacitor reaches full $V_{cell} = 1.8\text{ V}$ without encountering threshold voltage loss ($V_{DD} - V_{th} = 1.2\text{ V}$).
2. Confirm the differential voltage development $\Delta V = \frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s} \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{DD}/2)$ on folded bitlines ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, $C_s \approx 25\text{ fF to } 28\text{ fF}$) provides a minimum signal development of $100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$ prior to sense amplifier latch activation.
3. Verify that total access transistor and junction leakage current stays below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required data retention intervals.

---

## 3. Voltage Domain & Metrology Levels

```text
                   Critical DRAM Operating Voltages (V)   
                 ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
Cell Write Target┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
                 │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
Bitline Precharge┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                          │
     VPP Reg High┤███████████████████████████████████████│
                 │███████████████████████████████████████│
      VPP Reg Low┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    │
                 └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
                0.00      0.70     1.40      2.10    2.80 
```

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Steady-State Regulated $V_{PP}$** | `2.5 to 2.8` | $\text{V}$ | 4-stage Dickson pump, $f_{\text{clk}} = 20\text{–}50\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Minimum Transient $V_{PP}$ Under Load** | $\ge 2.5$ | $\text{V}$ | Peak wordline switching transient ($C_{\text{pump}} = 20\text{–}50\text{ pF}$) |
| **Storage Node Write Level ($V_{\text{cell}}$)** | $1.8$ (no $V_{th}$ loss to $1.2\text{ V}$) | $\text{V}$ | NMOS access gate overdrive, $V_{th} = 0.5\text{–}0.7\text{ V}$ |
| **Readout Signal Development ($\Delta V$)** | `100 to 150` | $\text{mV}$ | $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$, precharge $= 0.9\text{ V}$ |
| **Cell Leakage at Temperature** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$, sub-threshold & junction leakage |

---

## 5. Citations & Context References

- **Charge Pump Architecture & Overdrive Formula**: *High-Voltage Wordline Charge Pump (VPP) Dickson Oscillator Architecture* (NMOS $V_{th} = 0.5\text{V to } 0.7\text{V}$, $V_{DD} = 1.8\text{V}$, $V_{PP} \ge 2.5\text{V to } 2.8\text{V}$, 4-stage Dickson with $C_{\text{pump}} = 20\text{–}50\text{ pF}$, clock $\Phi_1, \Phi_2$ at $20\text{–}50\text{ MHz}$).
- **Sense Amplifier & Differential Voltage Development**: *Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout* ($V_{DD}/2 = 0.9\text{V}$ precharge, $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, $\Delta V = 100\text{–}150\text{ mV}$).
- **Cell Geometry & Storage Capacitor Budget**: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Access gate $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $C_s \ge 28\text{ fF}$, leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: In 180nm open-source DRAM architecture, VPP transient droop during simultaneous row activation across multiple sub-banks induces read-disturb and partial transfer states. The Dickson pump regulation loop must maintain VPP >= 2.65V during peak activation transients; excessive IR-drop along the power distribution network (PDN) degrades wordline slew rate below 0.8 V/ns, directly extending tRCD beyond the 18ns target.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline RC distributed delay (polycide sheet resistance ~10-15 Ohm/sq shunted by Metal 2) couples capacitive charge back into VPP during activation. When NMOS pass gates switch into saturation, back-gate body bias effect elevates V_th to ~0.75V, making any transient VPP droop exceeding 150mV fatal to full 1.8V V_DD charge restoration into the 30fF trench/stacked storage node capacitor.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Ultra-low-capacitance active picoprobes (<0.1pF loading) and high-bandwidth (>=4GHz) real-time oscilloscopes required for on-die sub-micron probing of unpassivated VPP sense nodes face regional export restrictions and extended calibration lead times (16-20 weeks) in domestic assembly environments.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Direct microprobing of internal test pads requires dedicated open-pad top-metal FIB edits or specialized test vehicle layout footprints. Omitting sacrificial pad structures forces reliance on external pin measurements which suffer from bond-wire inductance (L_package ~2-5nH) masking true on-die transient ringing and slew rates.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. VPP regulation loop phase margin degradation causing sustained multi-megahertz inductive-capacitive oscillations and gate-oxide breakdown on 180nm high-voltage transistors (tox ~5nm, V_breakdown ~3.3V).
1. Dynamic IR drop on VPP rail exceeding 250mV during concurrent wordline activations, leading to partial charge transfer (V_cell < 1.6V) and rapid retention failure under 64ms refresh intervals.
1. Capacitive probe loading (>0.5pF) artificially damping the wordline slew rate by >40%, yielding false-negative metrology results and incorrect charge pump stage resizing.

| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-02` | **VPP Peak Transient Voltage Droop and Pump Recovery Metrology under Multi-Bank Burst** | Tektronix 6 Series B MSO (4GHz, 25GSa/s), Cascade Microtech DCP-HTR high-precision Kelvin probes, Keithley 2602B SourceMeter, Keysight N6705C DC Power Analyzer with transient logging. | 1. Log current draw on the external auxiliary VPP monitor line. | `Maximum transient droop Delta V_droop must not exceed 150mV (absolute VPP >= 2.55V under 1.62V VDD); pump stabilization and voltage recovery to >= 2.65V must occur within <= 35.0ns following the final wordline activation edge.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (antistatic, powder-free), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and laser-safe safety spectacles, Electrostatic discharge (ESD) grounded wrist strap with 1MOhm series resistor, Standard Class 1000 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive sole boots
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: In case of skin or eye contact with solvent wash, immediately flush with copious amounts of tempered cleanroom eye-wash water for >= 15 minutes. For solvent inhalation, relocate victim to fresh air environment and administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored. For electrical shock from high-voltage probe supplies, disconnect line power immediately before touching victim, call emergency cleanroom rescue, and initiate CPR if pulse is absent.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Probe station wet-cleaning operations must occur under dedicated laminar flow hoods with dedicated VOC solvent exhaust ducted at minimum face velocity of 100 ft/min (0.51 m/s). Probe chamber dry-nitrogen purge must vent into non-confined facility exhaust to prevent nitrogen asphyxiation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Spent IPA and acetone wipe tissues and cleaning effluents must be segregated into dedicated grounded flammable solvent waste carboys equipped with flame arrestor caps; zero discharge to municipal drain allowed.

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `120 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `72 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Open test pad metallization (Al-Cu 0.5% or top TiN/Cu) post-FIB decapsulation/etch, free of native oxide and fluorocarbon polymer etch residue.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Probed test pads cleaned of carbon residue, dried under filtered N2 stream, and sealed in airtight moisture-barrier wafer container.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive atmospheric exposure forms native aluminum oxide (>30 Angstroms) and absorbs airborne humidity, increasing probe contact resistance from <1 Ohm to >50 Ohms, causing severe probe loading distortion and false high-frequency ringing artifacts during transient slew rate acquisition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Complete empirical characterization and verification of wordline high-voltage (VPP) slew rate, dynamic droop, and charge pump regulation transients on the 180nm DRAM test vehicle under all process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) operating corners, proving adequate pass-gate gate overdrive for full bitline signal restoration.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

| `ASSERT-02` | **Maximum dynamic VPP supply droop during 4-bank concurrent burst activation under worst-case low VDD (1.62V, 85°C)** | `120 mV` | <= 150 mV | Fast Fourier transform and instantaneous trough voltage extraction from calibrated oscilloscope rail transient acquisition. |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Dickson charge pump post-droop closed-loop recovery time back to >= 95% nominal VPP level** | `28.0 ns` | <= 35.0 ns | Automated cursor-based timing delta between peak droop minima and regulated steady-state threshold crossing. |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> All tested dice across center, mid-radius, and edge wafer sites demonstrate VPP slew rates >= 0.90 V/ns, VPP droop <= 150mV, and full cell write voltage restoration >= 1.75V across -10°C to 85°C, formally signed off by the Lead Metrology Engineer and Principal DRAM Circuit Architect.

testcases.title: VPP Peak Transient Voltage Droop and Pump Recovery Metrology under Multi-Bank Burst
testcases.instrumentation: Tektronix 6 Series B MSO (4GHz, 25GSa/s), Cascade Microtech DCP-HTR high-precision Kelvin probes, Keithley 2602B SourceMeter, Keysight N6705C DC Power Analyzer with transient logging.
testcases.pre_conditions: V_DD set to worst-case low 1.62V (-10%); Dickson oscillator enabled in dynamic regulated mode with nominal output set to 2.70V; chuck temperature at 85.0°C; 4-bank interleaved active pattern armed.
testcases.procedure:
1. Position low-impedance high-frequency microprobe onto the core VPP distribution ring pad adjacent to the row decoder tree.
2. Execute simultaneous 4-bank interleaved row activations (t_RRD = 10ns, 4-bank activation window tFAW = 40ns).
3. Record VPP rail voltage transient profile over a 500ns capture window.
4. Measure maximum negative deviation (Delta V_droop = VPP_nominal - VPP_min) and recovery time (t_recovery) from minimum trough back to 95% of nominal steady-state VPP.
5. Log current draw on the external auxiliary VPP monitor line.
testcases.pass_fail_criteria: Maximum transient droop Delta V_droop must not exceed 150mV (absolute VPP >= 2.55V under 1.62V VDD); pump stabilization and voltage recovery to >= 2.65V must occur within <= 35.0ns following the final wordline activation edge.

ppe_required: Cleanroom Class 100 Nitrile Gloves (antistatic, powder-free)
ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and laser-safe safety spectacles
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) grounded wrist strap with 1MOhm series resistor
Standard Class 1000 cleanroom bunny suit with conductive sole boots
ehs_protocol.antidote_and_first_aid: In case of skin or eye contact with solvent wash, immediately flush with copious amounts of tempered cleanroom eye-wash water for >= 15 minutes. For solvent inhalation, relocate victim to fresh air environment and administer medical oxygen if breathing is labored. For electrical shock from high-voltage probe supplies, disconnect line power immediately before touching victim, call emergency cleanroom rescue, and initiate CPR if pulse is absent.
ehs_protocol.exhaust_and_ventilation: Probe station wet-cleaning operations must occur under dedicated laminar flow hoods with dedicated VOC solvent exhaust ducted at minimum face velocity of 100 ft/min (0.51 m/s). Probe chamber dry-nitrogen purge must vent into non-confined facility exhaust to prevent nitrogen asphyxiation.
ehs_protocol.waste_neutralization: Spent IPA and acetone wipe tissues and cleaning effluents must be segregated into dedicated grounded flammable solvent waste carboys equipped with flame arrestor caps; zero discharge to municipal drain allowed.

q_time_constraints.incoming_surface_state: Open test pad metallization (Al-Cu 0.5% or top TiN/Cu) post-FIB decapsulation/etch, free of native oxide and fluorocarbon polymer etch residue.
q_time_constraints.outgoing_surface_state: Probed test pads cleaned of carbon residue, dried under filtered N2 stream, and sealed in airtight moisture-barrier wafer container.
q_time_constraints.critical_risk_on_expiry: Excessive atmospheric exposure forms native aluminum oxide (>30 Angstroms) and absorbs airborne humidity, increasing probe contact resistance from <1 Ohm to >50 Ohms, causing severe probe loading distortion and false high-frequency ringing artifacts during transient slew rate acquisition.

expected_result.summary: Complete empirical characterization and verification of wordline high-voltage (VPP) slew rate, dynamic droop, and charge pump regulation transients on the 180nm DRAM test vehicle under all process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) operating corners, proving adequate pass-gate gate overdrive for full bitline signal restoration.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Far-end wordline 10%-90% rising edge slew rate across nominal 1.8V VDD and 25°C chuck temperature
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Multi-point active picoprobe measurement with 10,000-waveform averaging on 4GHz digital storage oscilloscope.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Maximum dynamic VPP supply droop during 4-bank concurrent burst activation under worst-case low VDD (1.62V, 85°C)
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Fast Fourier transform and instantaneous trough voltage extraction from calibrated oscilloscope rail transient acquisition.

quantitative_assertions.assertion: Dickson charge pump post-droop closed-loop recovery time back to >= 95% nominal VPP level
quantitative_assertions.verification_method: Automated cursor-based timing delta between peak droop minima and regulated steady-state threshold crossing.

expected_result.signoff_criteria: All tested dice across center, mid-radius, and edge wafer sites demonstrate VPP slew rates >= 0.90 V/ns, VPP droop <= 150mV, and full cell write voltage restoration >= 1.75V across -10°C to 85°C, formally signed off by the Lead Metrology Engineer and Principal DRAM Circuit Architect.

nodes.label: Picoprobe Micro-Contact Setup & Low-Capacitance Fixture Preparation
nodes.primary_metric: Engineering Tolerance as per Gen 2 (µm)
nodes.sop_content:
An industrial, actionable leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) has been created and persisted into [docs/sop_picoprobe_micro_contact_low_capacitance_fixture.md](docs/sop_picoprobe_micro_contact_low_capacitance_fixture.md).

```text
========================================================================================
SOP: Picoprobe Micro-Contact Setup & Low-Capacitance Fixture Preparation
Hierarchy: 180nm DRAM > Address Decoders & Wordline VPP > Transient Metrology
Generation: Gen 2 (µm) | Action Type: Make
========================================================================================
```

### Key Highlights of the SOP:
1. **Step-by-Step Procedure**:
   - **Vibration-Isolated Stage Setup**: Pneumatic isolation optical breadboard with common star grounding to prevent ESD and ground-loop noise.
   - **Low-Capacitance Fixture & Active Picoprobe Mounting**: Mounting active FET probe with $<2\text{ nH}$ ground lead parasitic loop to eliminate ringing on steep transient edges.
   - **Gen 2 Optical Alignment**: Using high-resolution optics (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) to align tungsten micro-contact tips within $\pm 5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.
   - **Controlled Z-Touchdown**: Fine micrometer descent with $10\text{--}30\text{ mN}$ overtravel scrub force to pierce native oxide without puncturing thin metal interconnects.
   - **Capacitive Loading Audit & Transient Calibration**: Verifying low probe perturbation relative to the 180nm cell capacitance budget ($25\text{--}30\text{ fF}$).

2. **Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria**:
   - **Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)**: `±5 µm` (calibrated optical microscope reticle, 10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
   - **Active Tip Loading Capacitance**: `< 0.1 pF` (nominal `< 0.05 pF`) via VNA/LCR bridge.
   - **Contact Tip Scrub Overtravel Force**: `10 to 30 mN` via calibrated load cell/cantilever deflection.
   - **Ground Loop Inductance**: `< 2.0 nH` via $S_{11}$ reflection TDR.
   - **Positioning Stage Resolution**: `< 0.5 µm` via differential micrometer encoder.

3. **Citations Grounded in Local Literature**:
   - *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*: Optics specification (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25) and Gen 2 alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$).
   - *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology & Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture*: Node capacitance budget baseline ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$, nominal $28\text{ fF}$) ensuring transient metrology does not overwhelm node dynamics.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Probing internal wordline nodes and high-voltage VPP pump rails (~3.3V-4.5V transient in 180nm DRAM) requires ultra-low parasitic tip capacitance (<0.1 pF). Conventional passive probes (>10 pF) load the high-impedance wordline driver tank, distorting measured VPP rise times (slew rate) by >300% and damping ringing. The fixture must integrate an active FET Picoprobe (e.g. GGB Model 34A/35 or Model 12C) mounted onto a high-rigidity 3-axis micro-manipulator with an isolated ground return path (<2 mm loop) to suppress inductive ringing above 500 MHz.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline VPP drivers operate in multi-megahertz switching regimes where dV/dt exceeds 2 V/ns across unbuffered polysilicon/metal-1 contact pads. Gen 2 (µm) design rules feature metal pitch and test pads around 2-5 µm width. Tungsten probe tips (<1 µm radius) risk scrubbing, punching through M1/M2 metallization, or causing gate oxide punch-through if electrostatic discharge (ESD) mitigation is omitted. Active probe tip DC bias and dynamic compliance limit must be calibrated to avoid forward-biasing substrate PN junctions.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Procuring specialized high-bandwidth active Picoprobes (GGB Industries Model 18C/34A or equivalent active differential microprobes) and replaceable tungsten probe tips involves single-source vendor exposure, 6-8 week lead times, and high unit replacement costs ($1,200-$3,500 per probe assembly). Consumable tip inventories (0.5 µm - 1 µm radius tungsten wire) must be pre-stocked with redundant micro-positioner adapters to prevent metrology station downtime.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Low-capacitance active micro-contact setup directly gates transient validation for Milestone MS2 (Wordline Decoder & VPP Driver Verification). Fixture assembly and parasitics calibration must be completed within 3 working days, prior to the arrival of packaged test dies and open-cavity decapsulated wafers, preventing schedule slips into post-layout physical extraction correlation.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Excessive parasitic loop inductance and tip capacitance (>0.2 pF) causing false inductive ringing and underestimating VPP transient slew rate during wordline pull-up.
1. Mechanical over-travel and tip scrub destroying 2-4 µm metal landing pads or puncturing inter-layer dielectric (ILD), causing destructive VPP-to-VSS short circuits.
1. Triboelectric ESD discharge from ungrounded micro-manipulator or floating coax shielding during initial probe touchdown, rupturing thin gate oxides in 180nm row decoders.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-1-01` | **Picoprobe Parasitic Capacitance & Bandwidth Fixture Verification** | Keysight E5061B/E5071C Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) or high-frequency LCR meter (Keysight E4980A), high-precision calibration substrate (CS-5 standard substrate), 3-axis vibration-isolated probe station. | 1. Position active Picoprobe tip on open-circuit calibration standard pad and measure S11 reflection parameter from 100 kHz to 2.5 GHz. 2. Extract input shunt capacitance (C_in) and input parallel resistance (R_in) from Smith chart impedance trajectory. 3. Lower probe tip onto standard 50-ohm load and sweep stepped sine signal to determine -3 dB insertion bandwidth. 4. Verify DC offset voltage drift across active buffer amplifier over a continuous 15-minute window. | `Total effective input capacitance C_in must be <= 0.12 pF across 1 MHz - 1 GHz; -3 dB bandwidth must be >= 1.5 GHz; DC offset drift must remain within ±1.5 mV over 15 minutes.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-1-02` | **In-Situ Wordline VPP Transient Slew Rate & Contact Resistance Verification** | Tektronix/Keysight 4-channel 4 GHz Oscilloscope (>= 20 GSa/s), active Picoprobe (<= 0.1 pF, 10:1 divider), high-resolution optical microscope (100x Mitutoyo objective), vibration isolation optical breadboard table. | 1. Align Picoprobe tip with 3 µm x 3 µm dedicated VPP wordline test landing pad using micro-manipulator fine vernier adjustment (0.5 µm/div). 2. Lower tip until electrical contact is verified via DC voltage readout (target VPP steady-state 3.60V ± 0.05V). 3. Capture 50 consecutive wordline activation transient edges with 20 GSa/s single-shot sampling. 4. Measure 10%-90% rise time, fall time, peak overshoot, and settling time back to steady-state rail. | `Measured wordline 10%-90% rise time must be <= 2.20 ns (slew rate >= 1.30 V/ns); contact resistance variation across 50 cycles must be <= 5 ohms; probe-induced overshoot artifact must not exceed 150 mV above rail.` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Class 100 cleanroom-compatible nitrile gloves (ESD safe, static dissipative), ANSI Z87.1 certified UV and impact-resistant safety glasses, Conductive ESD wrist strap with integrated 1 MOhm safety resistor, Anti-static ESD lab coat
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: For skin/eye contact with IPA, flush immediately with copious DI water for at least 15 minutes at eyewash station. In case of inhalation of solvent vapors, remove victim to fresh air. If active probe power rail shorts to ground causing thermal burn, apply clean cold water pack and seek medical attention.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Benchtop localized fume extraction arm (minimum 50 CFM capture velocity) active during probe tip solvent cleaning and degreasing operations. Metrology station located in ISO Class 6 (Class 1000) cleanroom environment.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Collect spent IPA solvent wipes and cleaning swabs in dedicated, grounded, flammable-waste stainless steel disposal cans. No organic solvents permitted in drain disposal; dispose via hazardous waste chemical contractor according to EPA/OSHA standards.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)** | `67-63-0` | Semiconductor Electronic Grade (VLSI / SLSI) | `99.9%` |
| **Deionized Water (DI H2O)** | `7732-18-5` | Type 1 / ASTM D1193 (> 18.2 MOhm-cm) | `100.0%` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `30 minutes` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `4 hours`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Decapsulated / unpassivated wafer or open-cavity ceramic package with pristine Al-Cu / TiN metallization pads, free of native oxide overgrowth and fluorocarbon etching residues.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Micro-probed metallization pads displaying minimal scrub marks (< 0.8 µm scrub track depth < 50 nm), thoroughly dry, and sealed under dry N2 purge.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Excessive exposure to ambient humidity (>40% RH) induces galvanic corrosion and rapid native alumina (Al2O3) formation on open 180nm metal pads, causing erratic contact resistance (>50 Ohms), intermittent grounding, and probe slippage during transient signal acquisition.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Low-capacitance active Picoprobe micro-contact fixture fully assembled, parasitic-compensated, and verified on 180nm DRAM wordline VPP test pads, delivering accurate transient slew rate metrology with tip capacitance <= 0.12 pF and bandwidth >= 1.5 GHz.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:
- [ ] `picoprobe_fixture_s11_impedance_calibration_report.csv`
- [ ] `wordline_vpp_transient_slew_rate_waveform_data.csv`
- [ ] `microcontact_pad_integrity_post_probe_inspection.tiff`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| Assertion ID | Metric / Physical Assertion | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Verification Instrumentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Active Picoprobe input parasitic shunt capacitance loading** | `0.10 pF` | +0.02 pF / -0.01 pF | VNA S11 parameter de-embedding against calibration substrate between 100 kHz and 1.5 GHz |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Wordline VPP pull-up transition 10%-90% rise time** | `1.85 ns` | ± 0.25 ns | High-bandwidth 4 GHz DSO 50-waveform statistical persistence capture at 20 GSa/s |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Probe touchdown contact resistance to metal test pad** | `2.5 ohms` | ± 1.5 ohms | 4-wire Kelvin DC resistance sense sweep prior to transient trigger activation |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> Active Picoprobe fixture exhibits < 0.12 pF total shunt capacitance, 4-wire contact resistance on 3 µm test pads is <= 4.0 ohms without dielectric punch-through, and captured VPP rise time conforms to post-layout parasitic extraction (PEX) SPICE models within ±15%.
