nodes.primary_metric: Cell Capacitance Cs >= 28 fF, Read Margin Delta V >= 150 mV
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Wordline Driver Pulsed Transient Injection & VPP Droop Measurement

**Discipline / Category**: Metrology  
**Target Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / ISO Class 6 laminar flow bench, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (acid/solvent exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Substrate Fixturing
- Mount substrate securely onto vacuum chuck stage and align mechanical/optical fiducials.
- Zero baseline instruments and establish background electrical/chemical noise floor.

### 3. Recipe Execution & Parameter Control
- Execute process sequence according to verified engineering specifications.
- Monitor thermal, optical, or chemical rate transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Acceptance
- Perform quantitative verification using Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / SPICE Verification.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Pulsed transient injection into the wordline driver must account for parasitic distributed RC of the poly/silicide wordline mesh and supply rail inductance (L_rail dI/dt). Sudden activation of multiple row decoders creates instantaneous current spikes drawing from the VPP charge pump flying and decoupling capacitors (C_pump = 20-50 pF), threatening to collapse VPP below 2.5 V and violating the threshold overdrive margin needed for full 1.8 V storage node writes.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Wordline pass NMOS enhancement transistors in 180nm exhibit Vth ~0.5V-0.7V with body effect; if transient VPP droop exceeds 250 mV during the 5 ns to 10 ns rising edge, access gate overdrive Delta V_overdrive drops below 0.3 V. This reduces transfer conductance, truncates charge transfer Q_s = C_s * (V_cell - V_BL), and directly degrades the folded bitline sense amplifier differential signal margin below the 100 mV minimum required for reliable latching.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Active microprobing and transient injection at high-voltage boosted nodes (2.8 V) require specialized high-bandwidth (>2 GHz), low-capacitive-loading (<0.3 pF) active Picoprobe tips and dedicated high-voltage pulse generators. Single-source availability of sub-picofarad microprobe tips and custom tungsten needle replacement sets introduces a 6-to-8 week lead-time risk during physical metrology ramp.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Test structure pad placement and top-metal Kelvin probe taps for VPP transient injection must strictly align with scribe-line test vehicle (TEG) floorplans. Execution cannot disrupt scheduled wafer-level reliability (WLR) thermal cycling; test vector generation and automated probe station alignment routines must complete within a 48-hour analytical turnaround window.

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. VPP rail sag > 350 mV under simultaneous 64-wordline driver pulsed transient firing, triggering write-disturb and partial transfer into 1T1C storage nodes.
1. Charge pump oscillator dynamic feedback comparator instability causing limit-cycle oscillation and VPP overshoot (>3.3 V), inducing gate oxide breakdown in standard 180nm NMOS access gates.
1. Probe-tip parasitic inductance causing measurement-induced ringing artifact >1 GHz, obscuring intrinsic regulator loop recovery time and false-flagging slew-rate compliance.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-2-01` | **Wordline Driver Pulsed Current Injection and Maximum Dynamic VPP Droop Metrology** | Keysight 81160A 330 MHz Pulse Function Arbitrary Noise Generator, Tektronix MSO64B 4 GHz / 25 GS/s Digital Oscilloscope, GGB Industries Model 35 Active Picoprobe (0.05 pF, 3.5 GHz), Cascade Microtech Summit 12000 Semi-Automated Probe Station. | 1. Land Active Picoprobe tips directly onto dedicated top-metal VPP Kelvin monitoring pad and wordline driver output node. 2. Configure external pulse generator to inject a synchronized 10 ns wide gate assertion pulse into the wordline predecoder stage to trigger 32 distributed row drivers simultaneously. 3. Acquire 1000 consecutive transient acquisition frames at 25 GS/s on oscilloscope channel 1 (VPP) and channel 2 (Wordline node). 4. Measure peak-to-peak voltage droop Delta VPP = VPP_baseline - VPP_min during the 0-20 ns post-trigger transient window. 5. Measure recovery settling time t_settle defined as elapsed time until VPP returns to within ±2% (±56 mV) of 2.800 V. | `Maximum transient VPP droop must not exceed 250.0 mV (VPP_min >= 2.550 V). Recovery settling time t_settle to 98% nominal VPP must be <= 35.0 ns across all 1000 acquired frames.` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-2-02` | **Wordline Transition Slew Rate and Regulator Loop Phase Recovery Characterization** | Keysight B1500A Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer with WGFMU (Waveform Generator / Fast Measurement Unit), LeCroy WaveMaster 8000HD 8 GHz Oscilloscope, Cascade Microtech DC and RF Microchamber Probe Arms. | 1. Position high-impedance low-capacitance differential RF probes across the far-end wordline poly stitch tap and the local VPP decoupling capacitor terminal. 2. Program repetitive row activation sequence at 10 MHz repetition rate (100 ns cycle period) to simulate continuous heavy-burst row cycle read/write access. 3. Record transient rise time t_rise (10% to 90% of transition from 0 V to peak VPP) across 500 burst cycles. 4. Extract dV/dt slew rate during the linear acceleration region. 5. - **Hazard Classification**: `Moderate`

In case of vapor inhalation, remove victim to fresh air immediately. If eye exposure occurs, irrigate eyes at nearest eyewash station for a minimum of 15 minutes holding eyelids open; seek immediate on-site occupational medical consultation.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Operation conducted inside laminar flow cleanroom hood with active HEPA/ULPA filtration (velocity 0.45 m/s ± 0.05 m/s); localized solvent wipe exhaust canopy operational with minimum face velocity of 0.5 m/s (100 FPM).

critics.systems_engineer: Pulsed transient injection into the wordline driver must account for parasitic distributed RC of the poly/silicide wordline mesh and supply rail inductance (L_rail dI/dt). Sudden activation of multiple row decoders creates instantaneous current spikes drawing from the VPP charge pump flying and decoupling capacitors (C_pump = 20-50 pF), threatening to collapse VPP below 2.5 V and violating the threshold overdrive margin needed for full 1.8 V storage node writes.
critics.domain_expert: Wordline pass NMOS enhancement transistors in 180nm exhibit Vth ~0.5V-0.7V with body effect; if transient VPP droop exceeds 250 mV during the 5 ns to 10 ns rising edge, access gate overdrive Delta V_overdrive drops below 0.3 V. This reduces transfer conductance, truncates charge transfer Q_s = C_s * (V_cell - V_BL), and directly degrades the folded bitline sense amplifier differential signal margin below the 100 mV minimum required for reliable latching.
critics.supply_chain: Active microprobing and transient injection at high-voltage boosted nodes (2.8 V) require specialized high-bandwidth (>2 GHz), low-capacitive-loading (<0.3 pF) active Picoprobe tips and dedicated high-voltage pulse generators. Single-source availability of sub-picofarad microprobe tips and custom tungsten needle replacement sets introduces a 6-to-8 week lead-time risk during physical metrology ramp.
critics.laya_pm: Test structure pad placement and top-metal Kelvin probe taps for VPP transient injection must strictly align with scribe-line test vehicle (TEG) floorplans. Execution cannot disrupt scheduled wafer-level reliability (WLR) thermal cycling; test vector generation and automated probe station alignment routines must complete within a 48-hour analytical turnaround window.
critical_failure_modes: VPP rail sag > 350 mV under simultaneous 64-wordline driver pulsed transient firing, triggering write-disturb and partial transfer into 1T1C storage nodes.
Charge pump oscillator dynamic feedback comparator instability causing limit-cycle oscillation and VPP overshoot (>3.3 V), inducing gate oxide breakdown in standard 180nm NMOS access gates.
Probe-tip parasitic inductance causing measurement-induced ringing artifact >1 GHz, obscuring intrinsic regulator loop recovery time and false-flagging slew-rate compliance.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## VPP Slew Rate & IR-Drop Waveform Extraction and Post-Layout Correlation

**Module:** Address Decoders & Wordline $V_{PP}$ Voltage Pump / Transient Post-Layout Verification  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2, $\mu$m)  
**Action Type:** Make / Sign-off Metrology  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Execution Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Start: Parasitic    │
│     Extraction PEX     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Transient Simulation  │
│    & Waveform Probe    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Slew Rate & IR-Drop   │
│   Metric Computation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pre- vs Post-Layout   │
│      Correlation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│     Criteria Check     │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│   Sign-off & Tapeout   │     │    Grid / Wordline     │
│        Release         │     │  Driver Optimization   │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parasitic Extraction (PEX):**
   - Perform full-chip RCK/RCC parasitic extraction on the address decoders, $V_{PP}$ power delivery grid, sub-wordline drivers (SWD), and wordline (WL) interconnect running at a $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ pitch across the folded bitline array.
   - Include distributed gate capacitances of access transistors ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) and coupled bitline parasitic network ($C_{BL} \approx 250\text{ fF}$).

2. **Transient Simulation & Driver Stress Setup:**
   - Configure SPICE/FastSPICE transient analysis at the target operational junction temperature of $85^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Set up wordline activation bursts simulating maximum simultaneous row-selection switching across multiple sub-arrays.
   - Probe dynamic transient waveforms at:
     - Near-end: $V_{PP}$ pump supply output pad / local decoupling capacitor tap.
     - Mid-point: Sub-wordline driver output node.
     - Far-end: Wordline termination at the furthest edge of the 1T1C array block.

3. **Waveform Slew Rate & IR-Drop Extraction:**
   - Extract the $10\%$ to $90\%$ wordline rising slew rate ($t_{\text{rise}}$) and transition slope ($dV/dt$).
   - Quantify dynamic $IR$-drop ($\Delta V_{IR} = V_{PP,\text{nom}} - V_{PP,\text{min}}$) during peak charge consumption of the level-shifting driver.
   - Verify that far-end wordline voltage fully passes the threshold level required to turn on the access transistor and prevent degradation of the developed differential signal:
     $$\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$$
     ensuring $C_s \ge 25\text{ fF}$ charge transfer.

4. **Pre-Layout vs. Post-Layout Correlation:**
   - Overlay pre-layout schematic transient profiles against post-layout extracted waveforms.
   - Quantify delay discrepancies ($\Delta t_{\text{WL}}$) and peak drop delta ($\Delta V_{PP}$).
   - If limits are violated, widen $V_{PP}$ metal distribution straps or adjust driver tapering prior to final sign-off.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                                                        
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         │
Retention Margin Temp┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         │
                     │░░░                              │
 Pre/Post Discrepancy┤░░░                              │
      Far-End IR Drop┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                     │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
WL Rise Time (10-90%)┤██                               │
                     │██                               │
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                      0      30      60      90     120 
```

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Acceptance Target | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Wordline Rise Slew Rate ($10\%\text{--}90\%$ transition time $t_{\text{rise}}$) at far-end cell | $\le 3.0$ | $\text{ns}$ |
| **AC-02** | Maximum Dynamic $V_{PP}$ Line $IR$-Drop at worst-case driver tap | $\le 150$ | $\text{mV}$ |
| **AC-03** | Pre-layout vs. Post-layout Waveform Discrepancy ($\Delta t_{\text{delay}} / t_{\text{delay}}$) | $\le 10.0$ | $\%$ |
| **AC-04** | Transient Metrology Qualification Temperature (Retention verification baseline) | $85$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$); minimum storage capacitance budget ($28\text{ fF}$ per cell); leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ evaluated at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout:** Differential charge development signal formula $\Delta V = \left(\frac{C_s}{C_{BL} + C_s}\right) \cdot \left(V_{\text{cell}} - \frac{V_{DD}}{2}\right)$ with nominal storage capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, bitline capacitance $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$, and target signal window of $100\text{ mV}$ to $150\text{ mV}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Wordline and bitline pitch range ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$); gate dielectric $\text{SiO}_2$ physical thickness ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ thermal oxidation); retention qualification window of $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### Multi-Agent Council Critics & Risk Analysis (FMEA)

- **Systems Engineer Critic**: Topological check: Requires verified wordline driver timing (t_r <= 1.8 ns) and precharge VBLP (0.90V) prior to sense activation. Cascading delay budget must reserve >= 150 mV read margin across folded bitlines.
- **Domain Physicist Critic**: Physical constraint: Storage capacitor Cs must maintain >= 28 fF to resist alpha-particle soft errors. Subthreshold leakage through access NMOS channel (L=180nm, W=220nm) must remain < 1.0 fA/cell at 85°C.
- **Supply Chain Critic**: Supply Chain veto: High-k dielectric precursor (ALD/CVD) is unavailable for DIY fabrication in VN. Strictly enforce 180nm Crown/Stacked SiO2-Si3N4-SiO2 (ONO) node compatible with legacy wet/dry equipment.
- **Project Manager Critic (Laya PM)**: Scope & Risk: Scoped within 40-60 engineer-hours. FMEA Priority: HIGH (Sense amplifier offset mismatch > 15 mV will flip read bitline polarity).

**Critical Failure Modes & Mitigation**:
1. Sense amplifier threshold voltage mismatch (Delta Vth > 15 mV) causing read inversion.
1. Subthreshold access transistor leakage discharging Cs below sense threshold within refresh interval (< 64 ms).
1. Wordline parasitic resistance-capacitance (RC) delay exceeding access strobe window.

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Test Cases (Bits-to-Atoms Testbench)

| Test ID | Objective | Test Apparatus / Fixture | Procedure & Condition | Pass / Fail Criteria |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-3-01` | **Storage Cell Charge Retention & Leakage Test** | Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (Keysight B1500A / Agilent 4156C) & Cryogenic Probe Station | 1. Write logic '1' (charge to 1.80V) into target 1T1C storage capacitor node. 2. Deassert wordline driver to isolate storage node for t_hold = 64 ms (DRAM standard refresh period). 3. Pulse wordline to VPP = 2.50V and sample bitline charge sharing differential voltage Delta V. | `Differential signal Delta V >= 112.2 mV (Pass); subthreshold leakage I_leak <= 1.0 fA/cell (Pass); Delta V < 80 mV (Fail).` |
| `TC-ROW-COLUMN-DECODER-3-3-3-02` | **Sense Amplifier Strobe Timing & Differential Margin Test** | 200 MHz Active Differential Probe & Mixed-Signal Oscilloscope | 1. Inject controlled 50 mV differential offset between BL and BL_B. 2. Trigger SAN pulldown to GND and SAP pullup to 1.80V at strobe edge. 3. Measure sensing delay t_sense (time from strobe to 90% rail separation) and power-rail ripple. | `Sense resolution time t_sense <= 4.2 ns; full rail voltage V_rail >= 1.75V; zero state oscillation (Pass).` |

### Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Hazmat Envelopes

- **Hazard Classification**: `Low`
- **Mandatory PPE**: Standard cleanroom lab coat and ESD wrist strap, Safety glasses
- **Antidote & Immediate Action**: Standard industrial first aid.
- **Ventilation & Interlocks**: Ambient cleanroom ventilation.
- **Waste Disposal & Neutralization**: Standard recycling of scrap silicon.

**Chemical CAS Registry & Sourcing Specifications**:

| Reagent / Chemical Name | CAS Registry No. | Required Purity Grade | Target Concentration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon (Si Substrate)** | `7440-21-3` | Electronic Grade P-type <100> prime wafer | `Single crystal` |

### Queue-Time (Q-Time) & Surface State Handshake Constraints

- **Max Air Exposure Window**: `N/A` | **Max N2 Storage Window**: `N/A`
- **Incoming Wafer Surface State**: Extracted parasitic netlist / fabricated test die on vacuum chuck.
- **Outgoing Wafer Surface State**: Strobed and characterized bitline/cell nodes with logged margin data.
- **Critical Degradation on Q-Time Expiry**: Non-physical queue time; electrical drift under continuous DC bias stress.

### Verifiable Completion Assertions & Expected Results (Definition of Done)

**Exit Objective Summary**:
> Completion of VPP Slew Rate & IR-Drop Waveform Extraction and Post-Layout Correlation: Bitcell storage charge retention, sense amplifier signal margin, and read/write access timing confirmed within 180nm CMOS DRAM specifications.

**Deliverable Artifacts Checklist**:

- [ ] `Monte_Carlo_sense_amp_offset_distribution.pdf`

**Quantitative Completion Assertions**:

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ASSERT-01` | **Storage cell capacitance (Cs)** | `>= 28.0 fF` | +/- 2.0 fF | High-frequency C-V meter (1 MHz) on 100x100 test array |
| `ASSERT-02` | **Subthreshold access transistor leakage current (Ioff)** | `<= 1.0 fA/cell` | Max ceiling at 85°C junction temperature | Keysight B1500A sub-fA High-Resolution SMU |
| `ASSERT-03` | **Folded bitline differential sense voltage margin (Delta VBL)** | `>= 180 mV` | Min threshold >= 150 mV across all PVT corners | Strobe sense amplifier latch comparator with calibrated offset voltage |

**Lead Researcher Exit Sign-Off Criteria**:
> 100% of bitcell test structures pass 64ms retention test without refresh decay; zero soft-error read inversions across 10,000 consecutive read cycles at nominal VDD (1.80V).
